5004040.c1_f1: Ah! I'm too scared to sit!
5004040.c1_f2: Boo! I'm too busy with ghost practice!
5004040.c2_s1: See, even a ghost can sit!
5004040.c2_s2: Landing maneuver complete... Ghosts say that, right?
5004040.c2_s4: Ooo... I'm scary good at sitting!
5004040.c2_f3: I need to study my ghost sitting techniques first.
5004040.c2_f4: Ooo! I need more practice first!
5004040.c3_s1: Boo! I sat really scary this time!
5004040.c3_s3: Ooo! So this is what it's like for a ghost to sit!
5004040.c3_s4: What do you think? Is my sitting scary?
5004040.c3_f1: I'm a ghost! I don't need to sit!
5004040.c3_f2: Boo! The other ghosts'll make fun of me...
5004040.c3_f3: Ooo! I don't think that'd be very scary of me...
5004040.c4_s1: Boo! I'm sitting! Ooooo! ...Is this right?
5004040.c4_s3: Ooo! I think this is it!
5004040.c4_s4: See, I'm sitting like a real ghost!
5004040.c4_f2: Boo! I see a scarier ghost there!
5004040.c4_f4: No. If I sit...I'll mess it up.
5004040.c5_s1: S-Sorry... I'll do better next time.
5004040.c5_s2: Boo! It's embarrassing for a ghost to get scolded.
5004040.c5_f2: Ooo! You can't do this to me!
5004040.c6_s3: Ooo! I'm sorry. I won't do it again.
5004040.c6_f2: It doesn't hurt because I'm a ghost! Really...
5004040.c6_f3: Ooo! I'll pretend I didn't hear that!
5004040.c7_s1: Boo! Even ghosts can get scolded...
5004040.c7_s3: Ooo! I'll be scarier next time, I promise!
5004040.c7_f2: Boo! You can't say that to a ghost!
5004040.c8_s4: Okay! I won't do it again. Boo!
5004040.c8_f2: Ooo! You can't catch me! I'm a ghost!
5004040.c8_f3: Boo! It wasn't me. You got the wrong ghost!
5004040.c10_s1: Boo! I like you too! You're the best!
5004040.c10_s4: I'm a scary ghost, but...I like you too!
5004040.c10_f2: Ooo! What should I say to that?
5004040.c10_f3: That's the scariest thing I ever heard!
5004040.c11_s1: Boo! That's the least scary thing I ever heard!
5004040.c11_s3: Ooo! I'm the happiest ghost around!
5004040.c11_s4: Great! Me too! For real. Boo!
5004040.c11_f2: Ooo! How do I respond to that?
5004040.c12_s1: Boo! I really like you too!
5004040.c12_s2: Ooo! Hearing that gives me strength!
5004040.c12_s4: I forgot to be scary. I like you too!
5004040.c12_f2: Ooo! That's too much, even for a ghost!
5004040.c12_f4: Does that mean I'm not scary...?
5004040.c13_s2: Ooo! I don't have a body!
5004040.c13_f4: Ooo... I'll have to ask a ghost expert about that.
5004040.c14_s3: Ooo! I feel so much lighter! Is it just in my head?
5004040.c14_s4: Incorporeal ghost poop. It's a magical experience!
5004040.c14_f2: Ooo! Being scary takes priority over poop!
5004040.c14_f3: I'm not in the mood for that.
5004040.c14_f4: Boo! Can't I skip that since I'm a ghost?
5004040.c15_s2: Boo! Done! You can clean up!
5004040.c15_s4: Poop done! But it's kinda awkward...
5004040.c15_f1: I'm a ghost and don't need to poop!
5004040.c15_f2: Ooo! That subject is too scary!
5004040.c15_f3: Boo! I'm practicing my scary face right now!
5004040.c16_s1: Boo! Zzz. How does a ghost sleep?
5004040.c16_s2: Ooo! Can I sleep in the air?
5004040.c16_s3: Boo... I think I'll fall asleep like this.
5004040.c16_s4: I'll go to sleep... I hope they're good nightmares!
5004040.c16_f2: Scary ghost doesn't go to bed!
5004040.c16_f3: Ooo... But I can't keep making my scary face when I'm asleep!
5004040.c16_f4: Boo! I'll go to sleep later!
5004040.c17_s4: I'll go to sleep. I'm going to practice to be scary even in my dreams.
5004040.c17_f3: Ooo! Sorry, I was spacing out there.
5004040.c18_s2: Boo... I'm practicing to be scary in my dreams.
5004040.c18_s4: Zzz... Zzz... Need to get my scary sleep...
5004040.c18_f1: Boo! I'll go to sleep after I'm done being scary!
5004040.c18_f2: Ooo! I'm not done with scary time yet!
5004040.c18_f3: Not yet! Boo... I won't sleep!
5004040.c19_s2: Ooo! I'm a real ghost! A real real ghost!
5004040.c19_s3: Should I tell you something s-scary?!
5004040.c19_f1: I have nothing to say right now!
5004040.c19_f2: Ooo! I'm still thinking of something scary to say.
5004040.c19_f3: Boo! I used up all my scary lines for today!
5004040.c19_f4: Um... I don't know what would be scariest.
5004040.c20_s1: Ooo! Night's the scariest time of day!
5004040.c20_s2: Boo! Ghosts love popping out from the shadows!
5004040.c20_s4: I'm Pink Bean Ghost! The world's cutest--I mean scariest ghost!
5004040.c20_f1: Ooo... I don't know what to say.
5004040.c20_f2: Boo! I can't think of anything to say right now!
5004040.c20_f3: What's a scary thing to say...?
5004040.c21_s1: Boo! Everyone runs away when I appear!
5004040.c21_s2: Ooo! I'm a really scary ghost, for real!
5004040.c21_s3: Boo! Should I say something scary?!
5004040.c21_s4: No ghost's scarier than a Pink Bean Ghost!
5004040.c21_f2: Ooo... I'm too scared to talk...
5004040.c21_f3: Boo! I don't gotta say anything on a day like this!
5004040.c22_s1: Boo! I'm invisible! What do you think?
5004040.c22_s3: Ghost Special Technique: Float Float Float!
5004040.c22_s4: See! Scary face! Ooo... Aren't you scared?
5004040.c22_f2: Ooo... My tricks aren't working today...
5004040.c22_f3: I need to practice more... Boo!
5004040.c23_s1: Boo! Now here's a really scary trick!
5004040.c23_s3: Ghost dance! See, this is really scary!
5004040.c23_f2: Ooo! It was so spooky I scared myself!
5004040.c23_f3: I could do a great trick if I felt like it...
5004040.f1_s: Boo! I was getting hungry. Thanks for the food!
5004040.f2_s: Gotta keep my strength up to be scary!
5004040.f2_f: I'm already full... I'll ask for some later.
5004040.f3_s: Boo! Will I get scarier if I eat this?
5004040.f4_s: Thanks. Gotta keep my strength up!
5004040.f4_f: Boo... I'm sorry, but I really can't eat right now.
5004040.s2: Boo... I'm scared when I hear that.
5004040.s3: Ooo! I'm trying hard to be a scary ghost...

5004041.c1_f2: Squersh... I tried, but I slipped!
5004041.c3_s2: Squoosh... I sat. What do you think?
5004041.c3_s4: Bworng! I found my spot! Squoosh!
5004041.c3_f1: Heheh, it'd be weird to sit.
5004041.c3_f3: Squoosh. Hey, why's the floor all slippy?
5004041.c4_s3: I'll show you how it's done! Boing!
5004041.c4_f2: Bwong! I'm trying to sit, but I can't stop laughing.
5004041.c4_f4: Heheh, wait a moment! I'm finding my spot.
5004041.c5_f2: Squoosh squoosh squoosh! You can't catch me!
5004041.c6_s2: Don't be mad, but it was funny, wasn't it...?
5004041.c6_s3: Squoosh! I won't do it again!
5004041.c6_f3: I'm not here right now! Boing boing!
5004041.c7_f1: Squooshy! But I didn't do anything wrong?!
5004041.c8_s2: Boingy-boingy-boingy! These are my bounces of repentance!
5004041.c8_s4: I won't do it again! Byoing!
5004041.c8_f4: Boing! Try and find me. Where am I?
5004041.c9_s1: Boing! I like you too. Squoosh.
5004041.c9_s2: Me too! I like you too!
5004041.c10_s1: Byoing! I really like you too!
5004041.c10_s4: I like you the best! Byoing!
5004041.c10_f2: Bwong... What am I supposed to say to that...?
5004041.c11_s1: Boing! I'm happy you're beside me!
5004041.c11_s2: Squawsh! Me too, I like you too!
5004041.c11_f2: Squoosh... Wait, I gotta snap out of it!
5004041.c12_s1: Squeeesh! I really like you too!
5004041.c12_s4: My fave thing to hear! Squoosh.
5004041.c12_f3: Squeesh... I need time to clear my head.
5004041.c13_s2: Squoosh... Huh? How'd I do that?
5004041.c13_f2: Squish... I'm not in the mood for that!
5004041.c14_f1: Squash... I don't think it's time yet.
5004041.c14_f4: Squeesh! I'm too busy being scary!
5004041.c15_s1: Boingo! All done! Clean it up!
5004041.c15_s4: Slime poop! It's a magical experience!
5004041.c15_f4: Heheh. Wait a little more! Boing!
5004041.c16_s3: Squish... How does a slime sleep...?
5004041.c16_f2: Squiish... I gotta practice my scary face first!
5004041.c16_f3: I'm worried I'll slip off if I sleep.
5004041.c17_s2: Boing... Zzz... Will I have...squishy dreams...?
5004041.c17_f2: Squoosh... I was just resting my eyes!
5004041.c17_f3: That day isn't over yet. Byoing!
5004041.c19_s3: I'm your spooky pal, Ghost Slime!
5004041.c19_s4: Boing! I'll always be at your side. Squeesh...
5004041.c19_f2: Boing... Don't got anything to say.
5004041.c19_f4: I forgot what I was gonna say.
5004041.c20_s1: Squeesh! I'm the cutest ghoulie around!
5004041.c20_s2: Boing boing! I'm a special slime!
5004041.c20_f3: Squeesh... What to say, what to say?
5004041.c21_s1: Boing! It's always fun when I'm with you!
5004041.c21_s4: Byoing! I will always give you smiles!
5004041.c21_f2: Boing... I don't wanna open up.
5004041.c22_s1: Boing boing! Slipping away! What'cha think?
5004041.c22_f4: Boing boing! I can do better next time!
5004041.c23_s1: Boyoing! Time for a real trick!
5004041.f3_s: Boing! I got this taste stuck in my mouth!
5004041.f4_s: Thank you. Squeesh. What a nice day!
5004041.f4_f: Bwoing... I feel like a rest.
5004041.s1: Huh? Squish... What do you mean?
5004041.s2: Boing... You're gonna harsh my mood.
5004041.s3: Squish... Did I do something wrong?

5004042.c1_s2: I honor you with my scary sitting!
5004042.c1_f1: And who are you to tell me to sit?
5004042.c1_f2: I'll stand, thank you. I've got my dignity!
5004042.c2_s1: I'll sit, just for you. No need to thank me.
5004042.c2_s2: Oh yes, I look dignified sitting like this.
5004042.c2_s3: What do you think? Are you scared?
5004042.c2_f2: I'm too busy conquering the world to sit!
5004042.c3_s1: Observe. This is how a master sits!
5004042.c3_s2: My seated posture is terror itself!
5004042.c3_s3: Yes, I shall sit, but it is my choice!
5004042.c3_f1: Hmph. This is no time for sitting!
5004042.c3_f2: I only sit on special occasions!
5004042.c3_f3: Why should I when I'm the scariest in the world?!
5004042.c3_f4: Heheh! I don't feel like sitting today!
5004042.c4_s1: Fine, I shall do you the honor of sitting for you.
5004042.c4_s2: The very cosmos will tremble as I sit myself down!
5004042.c4_s3: The earth will quake in fear when I sit!
5004042.c4_s4: This is how a Mushroom Ghost sits!
5004042.c4_f1: Please, I look much scarier while I'm standing.
5004042.c4_f2: Heheh! I'm too strong to sit!
5004042.c4_f3: I can't sit at a time like this!
5004042.c4_f4: Heheh! My dignity prevents me from sitting!
5004042.c5_s1: Hah! I wanted you to scold me!
5004042.c5_s2: You should be thankful I'm not being more of a terror!
5004042.c5_f2: You won't scold me. I'm too scary!
5004042.c6_s2: I'll never say sorry! Well, maybe just this once!
5004042.c6_s4: For my dignity to suffer so... It builds character.
5004042.c6_f2: Ooh, you are in for the fright of a lifetime!
5004042.c6_f3: You made a terrible mistake just now!
5004042.c6_f4: Ha! You won't lay a finger on me. I'll dodge you!
5004042.c7_f1: How dare you provoke the Ghost Mushroom?
5004042.c7_f3: You have to wake up pretty early in the morning to scold this mushroom!
5004042.c8_s2: Fine, but this is the last time.
5004042.c8_s3: A mark on my dignity... I shall redouble my efforts!
5004042.c8_s4: Understood, but know this: I'm holding back!
5004042.c8_f1: Your words fall on deaf ears!
5004042.c8_f4: I'll vanish before I'll bow to the likes of you!
5004042.c9_s2: You could not resist such a dignified mushroom!
5004042.c9_f1: I am not to be loved, but to be worshiped!
5004042.c10_s1: But of course! No one can resist me.
5004042.c10_s4: You are brave, I will give you that.
5004042.c10_f1: I deserve your awe, not your love!
5004042.c10_f2: Ha! Such affection is beneath me!
5004042.c10_f4: Ha! Are you trying to make me look like a fool?
5004042.c11_s1: Not many recognize my excellence. Great!
5004042.c11_s2: Ha! Well... There are worse things than spending time with you.
5004042.c11_s4: How does it feel, to adore the scariest ghost in the world?
5004042.c11_f4: No! I must concentrate on building my power!
5004042.c12_s1: Of course, you only have eyes for me.
5004042.c12_s2: I agree. I also love me!
5004042.c12_s4: You know, it isn't bad to spend time with you.
5004042.c12_f1: I demand your awe, not your love!
5004042.c12_f2: Ha! I'm not swayed by such words!
5004042.c12_f3: A dignified ghost isn't moved by such words!
5004042.c12_f4: Thanks, but dignity is more important!
5004042.c13_s1: Ha! Tremble in fear before my mighty poop!
5004042.c13_s2: Haha... Is there anything more mysterious than a ghost poop?
5004042.c13_s3: Poop, too, holds its own form of terror.
5004042.c13_s4: Aha! Done with aplomb! As is befitting a dignified mushroom!
5004042.c13_f1: Why should I do something so undignified?
5004042.c13_f2: I am the world's most powerful ghost! Of course I don't poop!
5004042.c13_f3: Does my dignity mean nothing to you?
5004042.c14_s1: Now here is a frightful poop!
5004042.c14_s2: Surely, my poop is the most dignified of all.
5004042.c14_s4: Clean this up. Such work is beneath me.
5004042.c14_f3: There's no reason for me to that!
5004042.c14_f4: It's not time for that yet. Patience!
5004042.c15_s1: That will do it. I leave the cleanup to you.
5004042.c15_s2: A dump most dignified. Remember this moment!
5004042.c15_s3: Even my poop is dignified. Ha!
5004042.c15_s4: The poop of the world's most dignified ghost. A rare sight!
5004042.c15_f4: And if I don't need to?
5004042.c16_s1: Even when I sleep, I am dignified!
5004042.c16_s2: Even in my sleep, I am terrifying.
5004042.c16_f2: Ha! The world's most powerful ghost doesn't need to sleep!
5004042.c16_f3: I'll sleep after I've conquered the world!
5004042.c16_f4: It is time to be awake...with dignity.
5004042.c17_s2: I'll be the scariest ghost in dreamland!
5004042.c17_s4: My sleep is no ordinary sleep. It is dignified rest!
5004042.c17_f1: I cannot sleep. It is too frightening!
5004042.c17_f2: But while I am asleep, who will terrorize the world?
5004042.c17_f3: I still need to stay awake!
5004042.c18_f1: The world's most powerful ghost is beyond sleep!
5004042.c18_f2: The world's balance of terror will collapse if I sleep!
5004042.c18_f4: But I am full of vigor!
5004042.c19_s1: Heheh! I'm the world's scariest ghost!
5004042.c19_s3: Who doesn't tremble before my dignity?
5004042.c19_f1: It is a time for dignified silence.
5004042.c19_f2: Are you worthy of my words?
5004042.c19_f3: Patience. I am still composing the perfect monologue.
5004042.c19_f4: Those with dignity save their breath!
5004042.c20_s1: I am the terror of the night!
5004042.c20_s2: I'm the king of all ghosts!
5004042.c20_s3: Any who see me tremble and run.
5004042.c20_s4: Wherever Mushroom Ghost goes, so goes terror.
5004042.c20_f4: Hehe! Doing it half-heartedly is scarier!
5004042.c21_s1: Ha! My strength requires no explanation.
5004042.c21_s2: My dignity cannot be described in words!
5004042.c21_s3: Listen, and listen well. I...am the scariest.
5004042.c21_s4: There is no ghost as dignified as me!
5004042.c21_f2: My mystery cannot be talked about!
5004042.c21_f4: My dignity will be diminished if I talk to you.
5004042.c22_f2: A trick? I grace you with my frightening presence, and you want a trick?!
5004042.c22_f3: Tricks are so crude. I refuse!
5004042.c22_f4: Is my existence not frightening enough?
5004042.c23_s1: This time will be extra frightening! Prepare yourself!
5004042.c23_s2: Here's the true power of the Mushroom Ghost!
5004042.c23_s4: Look! A trick only I can do!
5004042.c23_f1: I'm too strong to degrade myself for mere tricks.
5004042.c23_f4: I'll show you a great trick...next time.
5004042.f1_f: Away with that. I'm not hungry.
5004042.f3_f: Why does a great ghost such as me have to eat this?
5004042.f4_f: Ah... I am on a diet.
5004042.s1: What did you say to me?
5004042.s2: Be careful. I might scare you to death...
5004042.s3: Did you make a mistake? I think you did.
5004042.s4: Hehe! I'm not swayed by such words!

5004043.c7_f1: 이 정도 훈련은 견딜 수 있어요!
5004043.c18_s1: zZ... 근무 종료 후 취침 중.
5004043.c18_f1: 멍! 잠 못 자요, 임무가 있어서요!
5004043.c20_f1: 멍! 임무 보고 준비 안 됐어요!
5004043.c23_f1: 멍... 오늘은 실력 발휘 안 되네요.

5004044.c12_f2: 멍! 지금은 다른 데 관심 있어요!
5004044.c14_f1: 멍! 아직 마려운 것 같기도 하고...
5004044.c19_s3: 멍! 주인님 어디 가요? 저도 갈래요!
5004044.c19_f3: 헤헷... 하고 싶은 말이 너무 많아요!

5000000.c2_s1: You want me to sit, meoww? I'm one smart cat...meow
5000000.c2_s2: Like this, meow? This is nothing, meow...
5000000.c2_s3: It's a piece of cake, meow.
5000000.c2_f1: I wanna do something fun, meow~
5000000.c2_f2: I wanna do something else, meow~
5000000.c2_f3: It's too nasty for me to sit, meow~
5000000.c2_f4: I can't sit here, because someone peed the ground, meow~
5000000.c3_f1: Master, instead of that...give me some food~ MEOW~
5000000.c3_f2: Master, let's do something else for fun~ Meow~
5000000.c3_f3: I don't wanna sit right now~ MEOW~
5000000.c3_f4: Master, you're talking funny, and I can't understand you~
5000000.c4_s4: Master, whaddaya think? I'm good right?
5000000.c4_f2: Sitting's waaay too easy...let me do something else.
5000000.c4_f3: Ahh..I'm sleepy...what's up? What did you say? I didn't hear you~
5000000.c4_f4: Hehe...I was daydreaming, so I couldn't hear you...
5000000.c6_s3: Please don't make a scary face like that...meow...
5000000.c6_f1: What did I do wrong, meow?
5000000.c6_f2: You're just going off on me, meow...!
5000000.c6_f3: I didn't do anything wrong, meow...!
5000000.c6_f4: You're just doing this because you're bored, meow...!
5000000.c7_s3: Master, are you really mad at me...? MEOW...
5000000.c7_f1: What did I do anyway~! MEOW!
5000000.c7_f2: Master that wasn't cool at all! Meow~!
5000000.c7_f3: Where else will you find an obedient pet like me? MEOW~!
5000000.c7_f4: Master! If you keep doing that, I may one day get out of here! MEOW!
5000000.c8_s4: Master...please give me that scary face...
5000000.c8_f1: Man...I haven't done anything wrong, and still...
5000000.c8_f3: Man...going off on me again for no reason...
5000000.c8_f4: Master must be bored...so I'm treated like crap...
5000000.c10_s3: I don't like hearing that, meow...
5000000.c10_f1: Take back what you just said, meow!
5000000.c11_s1: M...master...I can't believe you said that...MEOW!
5000000.c11_s2: Master, I get hurt when I hear those...MEOW
5000000.c11_s3: That was a joke...right? Right? MEOW?
5000000.c11_s4: You...didn't mean that, right? right? MEOW?
5000000.c11_f2: Take back what you said! MEOW!!!!!
5000000.c12_s1: Master...this is not the first time I've heard this, but it still hurts...
5000000.c12_s2: You aren't gonna leave me out hanging like this, right?
5000000.c12_s4: Do you really not like me??
5000000.c12_f1: Wah? What? I can't hear you~
5000000.c12_f2: You didn't mean what you said, right?
5000000.c12_f3: I'm sick of hearing that everyday...hehe
5000000.c12_f4: If you keep saying that, I can really go pissy on you...
5000000.c14_s3: It...it's not coming out well, meow...
5000000.c14_f1: It's not pooping time yet, meow...
5000000.c14_f2: How can I poop if I don't feel like it, meow...
5000000.c14_f3: Pooping is only for bathroom, meow...
5000000.c15_f1: Master, it hasn't been long since I last pooped...MEOW...
5000000.c15_f2: It's not time to poop yet, master...MEOW...
5000000.c15_f3: Master...I don't feel like pooping yet...MEOW...
5000000.c16_s1: Ahhh...that was good...but it's still embarassing...hehe
5000000.c16_s2: Ahh...whoa, my breakfast just came out like that...hehe

5000046.c25_s3: Kino's best expression is with tongue.
5000046.c25_f2: I don't do this all the time.
5000046.c25_f4: No! No! Kino is not doing it.

5000046.c27_f1: It's no fun if I transform all the time.
5000046.c27_f2: No, I can't just SHOW you.
5000046.c27_f3: It's no fun if I do it all the time.

5000064.c2_f3: I don't sit on the street!
5000064.c2_f4: Unless you give me something to eat!
5000064.c2_s3: Why don't you take a seat too? Oink?
5000064.c3_f2: I am losing so my weight nowadays! Oink...
5000064.c3_s1: Oink! I took a seat. Give me food?
5000064.c3_s3: Oink oink oink! I'm a loyal Golden Pig.
5000064.c3_s4: Oink! Sitting down is so comfortable.
5000064.c4_f3: Ah... I feel so lazy today. Oink!
5000064.c4_f4: I bring luck to you! Oink!
5000064.c4_s1: I'm cuter when I am sitting down, aren't I?
5000064.c4_s2: You want me to sit down? Oink?
5000064.c4_s4: Now I sat. Buy me some delicious food!
5000064.c6_f1: Won't give you any luck if you stay mad all the time!
5000064.c6_f2: Are you making fun of me?
5000064.c6_f4: What did I do this time? Oink?
5000064.c6_s2: Don't be angry. You are scaring me, master.
5000064.c6_s3: I'm sorry! You'll still feed me, right? Oink?
5000064.c6_s4: I'm sorry! I won't eat dinner tonight... Oink!
5000064.c7_f1: Why am I getting punished? Oink?
5000064.c7_f2: What did you say, oink? I was busy eating!
5000064.c7_f3: I eat a lot, but I'm not a bad piggy! Oink!
5000064.c7_s3: Just don't hit me please... Oooink...
5000064.c8_f1: Oink... I don't eat that much... Oink!
5000064.c8_f2: Because I'm a PIG! Did you forget? OINK!
5000064.c8_f3: OINK! That won't even make me blink! OINK!
5000064.c8_f4: Oink oink oink... So yummy. Want some too?
5000064.c8_s1: I won't do it again, master. Oink?
5000064.c8_s2: Don't be mad. Forgive me? Oink?
5000064.c10_f1: I can't just make golden poop anytime you want!
5000064.c10_f2: I not a pooping pig! OINK!
5000064.c10_f3: I am not full enough to take a dump!
5000064.c10_f4: Not ready to take a dump yet, master. Oink!
5000064.c10_s2: If you collect golden waste, it will bring you luck!
5000064.c10_s3: My poop is golden poop... O...ink!
5000064.c11_f1: OINK! I am not ready to go yet!
5000064.c11_f2: Do you want my golden poop? Oink?
5000064.c11_f3: Gimme more yummy food, so I can poop!
5000064.c11_s2: Oink. My poop is golden poop!
5000064.c11_s3: Look at my shy golden poop!
5000064.c11_s4: I feel great! Now I can eat some snack!
5000064.c12_f1: Forget about poo-poo. Let's go for a walk.
5000064.c12_f2: Oink... I wanna play with a ball.
5000064.c12_f3: I don't feel like pooping right now. Oink.
5000064.c12_f4: NO! Let's go eat something delicious! Oink?
5000064.c12_s1: I feel dizzy after taking a dump.
5000064.c12_s2: My golden poop will bring you luck!
5000064.c12_s4: I-I feel so skinny after taking a dump!
5000064.c13_f1: First things first. Please feed me!
5000064.c13_f2: I need to get some rest today... Oink...
5000064.c13_f3: Oh, I want a cup of yummy icy cold Power Elixir! Oink!
5000064.c13_s1: Oink! I want something delicious today!
5000064.c13_s2: I see some good items coming your way today, master.
5000064.c13_s3: I am the Golden Pig and I bring luck to my master!
5000064.c13_s4: Oink, oink. Look at my charming tail!
5000064.c14_f1: Always hungry! I miss food already!!!
5000064.c14_f3: Not ready to take a dump yet, master. Oink!
5000064.c14_f4: How about some more hunting if you got time to chat with me? Oink?
5000064.c14_s1: Go east, you'll meet a nobleman...
5000064.c14_s2: Go west, you'll get something very valuable...
5000064.c14_s3: Master, how about a nice dinner party after hunting today?
5000064.c14_s4: If you collect golden waste, it will bring you luck!
5000064.c15_f2: I might die of hunger... o...i...n...k
5000064.c15_f3: I lost my appetite lately... Oink...
5000064.c15_f4: Oink... Need to sit down now.
5000064.c15_s1: Grandma Yeon's favorite Shrimp Meat is so yummy! Oink!
5000064.c15_s2: Is Dry Treat really that yummy?
5000064.c15_s3: Have you seen a speaking pig? Oink?
5000064.c15_s4: I got hungry so I ate. I ate and now gotta go to the bathroom! Oink!
5000064.c16_f2: Oink! Gotta level up! No sleep for you tonight!
5000064.c16_f3: Gotta get some rare items! Wake up, master!
5000064.c16_f4: Wanna go get some Red Potion from the General Store in Henesys?
5000064.c16_s1: Oink. I was very sleepy anyway...zZZ
5000064.c16_s3: Dream sweet dreams of me, master!
5000064.c16_s4: Oink... Gotta go to bed. Zzz
5000064.c17_f2: I am too hungry to sleep! Oink!
5000064.c17_f3: Why don't we go hunt? Oink?
5000064.c17_f4: I don't want to go to bed now, OINK!
5000064.c17_s1: Can I sleep with you? Oink?
5000064.c17_s2: I am gonna have pretty dreams! Oink.
5000064.c17_s4: You should go to bed too. Oink...
5000064.c18_f1: Buy me a decent bed or something, jeez... Oink
5000064.c18_f3: When is Mrs. Ming Ming's party going to end? Oink!
5000064.c18_f4: I want some delicious Dry Treat. Oink!
5000064.c18_s1: Good night to you too! Oink!
5000064.c18_s2: Time for bed. Good night! Oink.
5000064.c18_s3: I am so sleepy. Sweet dreams, master! Oink...
5000064.c18_s4: It's time for piggy to go to bed. Zzz
5000064.c20_f2: Well, that's enough. Let' go eat something!
5000064.c20_s4: I am so, so, so happy!
5000064.c21_f2: Okay. Who should I tell that, oink?
5000064.c21_f3: Give me food. Then I believe you!
5000064.c21_s4: I have been in love with you as well, master!
5000064.c22_f1: What I need is some snacks!
5000064.c22_f2: What? Can't really hear you... oink!
5000064.c22_f4: I am so hungry... I feel like I'm gonna pass out! Oink!
5000064.c23_f1: How about some White Potion first? OINK?
5000064.c23_f2: I can't perform at the drop of a hat...
5000064.c23_f4: Can I just have a day off? OINK?
5000064.c23_s3: One, two, one, two! Oink oink!
5000064.c23_s4: I'll do it just for you! Oink!
5000064.c24_f1: Trick? What is it? Can I eat it?
5000064.c24_f2: I'll do it a little later!
5000064.c24_f3: Golden Coin Chocolate is the best!
5000064.c24_s1: Great sense of balance comes from my perfect S-shaped body! Oink!
5000064.c24_s2: Look, master! I can do this!
5000064.c24_s4: Sure! Anytime for you, master! One, two, one, two!
5000064.f3_s: Way better than Dry Treat! Oink!
5000064.f4_s: So delicious, I might cry! Oink!
5000064.s4: Oink oink! No luck if you use bad words!

5000065.c3_s2: Why don't we sit together master?
5000065.c3_s4: I'm so nice, listening to your every need.
5000065.c3_f1: I don't just sit on the street.
5000065.c3_f2: What's that? Is that something I can eat?
5000065.c4_s3: How does Ducky look right now?
5000065.c4_f1: Hey, don't you order me around.
5000065.c4_f3: Uh, where's my cushion? I won't sit without it!
5000065.c4_f4: Ducky don't want to do it right now.
5000065.c6_s4: Ducky is very scared of you now.
5000065.c6_f3: Is Ducky being yelled at right now?
5000065.c6_f4: Ducky don't understand why you're mad.
5000065.c7_s1: Ducky's scared when you get mad.
5000065.c7_s2: It hurt Ducky's feelings when you're being mean.
5000065.c7_s3: Ducky won't do that EVER again.
5000065.c8_s2: Ducky won't do it again. Give me a chance.
5000065.c8_s3: Can't you see my tears? Please, have a heart... Ducky...
5000065.c8_f1: If you keep punishing Ducky, Ducky will turn BAD!
5000065.c8_f2: You strange. You keep punishing Ducky without feeding Ducky!
5000065.c8_f3: Ducky will call police if you keep harassing Ducky! QUACK!
5000065.c8_f4: You do that one more time, you see Ducky no more!
5000065.c10_s1: I'm so happy. Say it again, please?
5000065.c10_f2: Quack... Put more emotion into it next time.
5000065.c10_f3: Sorry but I'm taken. Find another duck.
5000065.c10_f4: Master, I'm serious. Snap out of it.
5000065.c11_s2: Love... Is this feeling love? I think I'm falling for you, master.
5000065.c11_s3: This little duck loves you too!
5000065.c11_f2: Quack!! Your words are not very convincing.
5000065.c12_s1: I'm so happy you're my master, quack!
5000065.c12_s3: Tell me that ten times every day!
5000065.c12_s4: I hope you never, ever change!
5000065.c12_f1: It's not you, it's me... I'm a duck, quack. Give up.
5000065.c12_f2: Do you even know what love means?
5000065.c12_f3: Meh... I'm not feeling it... Quack...
5000065.c12_f4: I love you like a family, too!
5000065.c14_s2: I think I'm going to have a wonderful dream tonight, quack!
5000065.c14_s3: You can sleep right next to me, quack!
5000065.c14_s4: How did you know ducky was sleepy?
5000065.c14_f1: It's much too early for that! Quack!
5000065.c14_f3: You want me to sleep all day long? Quack!
5000065.c15_s1: I'm already falling into sleep. Quack...
5000065.c15_s3: I'm going to take a short nap.
5000065.c15_f2: You are telling me to sleep at a place like this. Master, you are mean!
5000065.c15_f3: Are you planning a party for after I fall asleep?
5000065.c15_f4: It's no time for sleeping, you must level up!
5000065.c16_s1: My snuggly pillow is making me...fall..asleep...
5000065.c16_s2: Stand by me while I sleep, please?
5000065.c16_s3: Lately, the more I sleep, the sleepier I get...
5000065.c16_s4: I just wanna sleep all day long!
5000065.c16_f1: Why are you forcing me to sleep? You're suspicious....
5000065.c16_f2: Are you plotting to abandon me when I fall asleep?! I won't fall for that!
5000065.c16_f3: I will sleep when I sleep. Bug off!
5000065.c16_f4: No, no... I won't let you get something yummy while I fall asleep! Never!
5000065.c17_s2: I am talented at talking, I know.
5000065.c17_s4: Nice weather out. How about taking me for a stroll in the Strolling Path?
5000065.c17_f3: Have you not seen a talking duck before?
5000065.c17_f4: I don't want to talk right now.
5000065.c18_s1: What do you think about this red muffler? I'm a fashionista!
5000065.c18_s2: I just wanna talk with you all day long!
5000065.c18_s3: Anything you wanna hear from me?
5000065.c18_f1: Don't wanna talk. Why don't you talk?
5000065.c18_f2: You don't have any friends, do you?
5000065.c18_f4: I am enjoying the solitude right now.
5000065.c19_s1: Scuba Pepe and I are nothing. It's not what you think. Quack!
5000065.c19_s2: This is a secret, but I can transform...
5000065.c19_s3: I love spending time with you, master.
5000065.c19_s4: Once upon a time there was a duck named Ducky...
5000065.c19_f2: I talked too much today. Let's talk again tomorrow.
5000065.c19_f3: Are ya bored, master? Go hunt more!
5000065.c20_s1: This is the dance that'll make you move!
5000065.c20_s2: Everybody! Dance, with, me. Oh yeah.
5000065.c20_s3: Shake it, shake, shake it. Boom boom boom.
5000065.c20_f1: Dance? I need some music, please!
5000065.c20_f2: Why don't you give it a try first? Quack!
5000065.c21_s2: I dance til the end of night! Quack, quack, quack!
5000065.c21_s3: Compliment me, and I shall dance more!
5000065.c21_s4: Look at this crazy steps I'm doing!
5000065.c21_f1: My dancing is so good you might fall in love with me!
5000065.c21_f2: You're gonna make fun of me, aren't you?!
5000065.c21_f4: Dancing is not my thing. Nope. Nada.
5000065.c22_f1: That doesn't just happen out of nowhere!
5000065.c22_f2: What are you going to do for me?
5000065.c22_f3: I can only do it when no one's around...
5000065.c22_f4: I'm too sleepy to do that... Quack.
5000065.c23_s2: This is a once in a lifetime event!
5000065.c23_s3: I practiced every day for this moment!
5000065.c23_s4: You might just fall in love with my transformed self!
5000065.c23_f2: I don't feel like it. Quack...
5000065.c23_f3: Quack, quack. You're not even looking at me. I'm pooped...
5000065.f4_s: You give best food, master! Quack!
5000065.s2: Quack! How could you say that?

5000068.c2_f3: Master, I will take a seat if you give me a chair!
5000068.c2_f4: Oh, no... Do I have to sit?
5000068.c3_s2: Growl! It feels so comfortable to sit down.
5000068.c3_s3: Growl, I like it so much.
5000068.c3_s4: Why don't you take a seat, master?
5000068.c3_f1: I want to go for a walk, growl!
5000068.c3_f2: Growl! Give me something to eat!
5000068.c3_f4: Growl! I don't want to do it!
5000068.c4_s1: Growl! Aren't I so tiny and adorable, master?
5000068.c4_s2: Like this? Aren't I so cute, master?
5000068.c4_s3: Ow, I will listen to you from now on! Growl!
5000068.c4_s4: Master! I will do anything you want!
5000068.c4_f1: Grawr! I don't want to do it!
5000068.c4_f3: Grr, I think I have reached puberty.
5000068.c4_f4: Grr! If you want a seat, just take one for yourself.
5000068.c6_s2: Don't be angry. You are scaring me, master.
5000068.c6_f1: Rawr? What did I do wrong?
5000068.c6_f2: Grrr! Why are you doing this to me?
5000068.c7_s3: Master, why are doing this to your tiny, cute tiger?
5000068.c7_s4: I will be an obedient baby tiger.
5000068.c7_f1: I will be a good tiger.
5000068.c7_f2: Grr, grr! No, I hate it!
5000068.c7_f4: Hehe, I will become an erratic tiger!
5000068.c8_s1: Rawr... I regret what I have done.
5000068.c8_s3: Oh, please go easy on me this time.
5000068.c8_s4: Grawr! Don't get mad. Please just listen to what I have to say! Growl...
5000068.c8_f1: If you give me a piece of cake, I won't eat you up!
5000068.c8_f2: This is boring. Let's play something else, master!
5000068.c8_f3: Growl! I'm not scared at all!
5000068.c8_f4: Grrr! Why are you treating me like this?
5000068.c10_f2: How can I do that here? That would be embarrassing! Growl...
5000068.c10_f3: I don't want to go to a bathroom now, growl.
5000068.c10_f4: Not here! This would be embarrassing, growl.
5000068.c11_s1: Ugh, a baby tiger's poop is used as a medicine whether you believe it or not!
5000068.c11_s2: Oh, I feel so much better! Are you going to poop, too?
5000068.c11_s3: Grr, I feel so much better!
5000068.c11_s4: Grr, it feels so good! Master, please clean this up!
5000068.c11_f1: This place is so dirty! Grr!
5000068.c11_f2: Feel free to take a dump and enjoy yourself, master!
5000068.c11_f3: Growl, I've been having constipation lately...
5000068.c11_f4: I don't want to go to stool now. Phew...
5000068.c12_s1: I feel so much better now, growl!
5000068.c12_s2: Grr! Master! Look how big my poop is!
5000068.c12_s4: Master, I'm done now! Would you please wipe my butt?
5000068.c12_f1: Forget about poo-poo. Let's go for a walk.
5000068.c12_f2: I can't do it, because you keep looking at me! Grr.
5000068.c12_f3: Grr, grr! No, I hate it!
5000068.c13_s1: Master, master! Aren't I so cute and tiny? Growl?
5000068.c13_s2: I'm happen to be an excellent speaker for a tiger! I also speak a foreign language! Woof, woof!
5000068.c13_s3: My cute tail wags gently. Isn't this adorable?
5000068.c13_s4: What do you like about me the most, master? Tell me!
5000068.c13_f1: Grr! I want to be alone now.
5000068.c13_f3: Forget it! Why don't we just go and hunt?
5000068.c14_s1: In fact, I'm not a baby tiger but a kitty! Meow!
5000068.c14_s2: If you give me a piece of cake, I won't eat you up!
5000068.c14_s3: Your head is so huge, master!
5000068.c14_s4: Growl! You can hunt more easily if you entrust your potions to me.
5000068.c14_f1: You must be quiet in places like this. Grr!
5000068.c14_f4: Why are you always ordering me around? You play all the time, master? Grr!
5000068.c15_s1: Shall we play a word chain? I will go first! Growl! Calcium!
5000068.c15_s2: Master, were you born with legs that short?
5000068.c15_s3: Tell me something hilarious! You know, a story from a long, long time ago.
5000068.c15_s4: Isn't Gaga's face way too long? Growl.
5000068.c15_f1: I want to be alone once in a while. Would you please be quiet?
5000068.c15_f2: I don't want to do it once you order me, grr!
5000068.c15_f3: Why don't we just go to sleep? Zzz...
5000068.c15_f4: Should I go to Henesys Pig Farm? Growl!
5000068.c16_s2: Growlie will go to bed now, master.
5000068.c16_s3: Growlie will go off to dreamland.
5000068.c16_f1: Grr! It's not time to sleep yet!
5000068.c16_f2: I'm too hungry to fall asleep... Give me some meat, master!
5000068.c16_f3: Growlie won't sleep in somewhere as noisy as this place!
5000068.c16_f4: I don't want to go to bed now, growl!
5000068.c17_s1: Growl, I feel really sleepy, master!
5000068.c17_s2: I was actually feeling sleepy... You are the best, master!
5000068.c17_s3: Master, would you tuck Growlie up in the bed? Growl!
5000068.c17_s4: Growlie wants to sleep next to you. Zzz...
5000068.c17_f1: You have to at least sing a lullaby to put me to sleep! Grr!
5000068.c17_f2: Master, this is not time for you to sleep! Growl!
5000068.c17_f3: I just woke up! Why do you want me to fall asleep again? Grr!
5000068.c17_f4: I want to go and have fun in Korean Folk Town with you, master!
5000068.c18_s1: Have a wonderful dream, master! Dream of having billions of Mesos, growl!
5000068.c18_s2: I will go to bed if you want me to, grr!
5000068.c18_s3: I will sleep on my pillow, growl.
5000068.c18_s4: Master, don't wake Growlie up from now!
5000068.c18_f1: I'm dying to eat some meat right now. I can't even fall asleep!
5000068.c18_f2: I can't sleep... I miss my mom so much, growl...
5000068.c18_f3: You must make a bed for me to sleep! Grr!
5000068.c18_f4: Growlie wantsto chat and play with you now, master.
5000068.c20_s2: Oh, my! I feel so good!
5000068.c20_s3: I really, really like you as well, master!
5000068.c20_f2: You have a good eye for tigers, grr!
5000068.c20_f3: Not just anyone can earn my love!
5000068.c20_f4: Why don't you give me plenty of food before you say that?
5000068.c21_s1: Oh, I don't know what to say!
5000068.c21_s2: I have been in love with you as well, master!
5000068.c21_f1: Do you say those things to any person, master?
5000068.c21_f2: Grr! That's not what I wanted to hear from you!
5000068.c21_f3: Give me a piece of meat rather than a piece of your mind!
5000068.c21_f4: Master, what about your significant other?
5000068.c22_s2: This is Growlie who loves you and only you, master!
5000068.c22_s3: Can you see hearts coming out from my eyes? Growl.
5000068.c22_s4: Growlie feels so great! I feel like I can fly across the sky!
5000068.c22_f1: Should I just fly off? Growl!
5000068.c22_f2: If you keep saying that, I will just run away! Grrr!
5000068.c22_f3: Never mind! Why don't we go and grab something to eat?
5000068.c22_f4: I also want to eat meat. I feel dizzy.
5000068.f4_s: Master! Please give me a meat everyday!
5000068.f4_f: Give me a tasty side dish, grr!
5000068.s2: Grr! What did you just say?
5000068.s3: Master! You must not say something like that! Grr!
5000068.s4: Grr! You should use only fair words!

5000072.c3_s1: With legs as short as mine, it doesn't matter!
5000072.c3_s2: Shall we rest a bit? Did you pack any sandwiches?
5000072.c3_s4: Good idea. My legs were feeling a bit tired.
5000072.c3_f1: No, you're going to make fun of me because I'm just as short standing as sitting!
5000072.c3_f2: Don't order me around like that! Toot!
5000072.c3_f3: Toot. I don't sit in places like this.
5000072.c4_s2: A nice, leisurely rest would be nice!
5000072.c4_s3: Some weather, huh? Let's relax for a while, master. Toot!
5000072.c4_s4: Anything for you master... Toot toot!
5000072.c4_f1: Poot. Don't tell me what to do!
5000072.c4_f2: You can't always get what you want, master.
5000072.c4_f3: Do I look like easy? Sniff...
5000072.c6_s2: I won't do it again. Toot...
5000072.c6_f1: Why are you doing this? Toot?

5000207.c19_f4: I got nothing special to say. Yip!
5000207.c20_s1: Admins never ask for your password! Yip! What's a password?
5000207.c20_s2: I could look at you all day. Yip yip!
5000207.c20_s3: Is there really a scary dragon living in Leafre? Yip!
5000207.c20_s4: Yip! What do you like most about me, master? Yip yip!
5000207.c20_f1: Yip! Woah, I'm so out of it right now.
5000207.c20_f2: I tried to look up my horoscope, but I can't read. Yip!
5000207.c20_f3: Yip! Yip yip! My back ITCHES!
5000207.c20_f4: Yip! Yip! I can read your miiiind!
5000207.c21_s1: Thanks to all the treats, I got a tummy! Yip!
5000207.c21_s2: I'm not scared of no monsters! Just gimme potions. Yip!
5000207.c21_s3: You look JUST like me, master. Yip!
5000207.c21_s4: Yip! Yip! My tail's wagging! Look at it go!
5000207.c21_f1: Yip yip! I can't understand human language, yip!!
5000207.c21_f2: Let's get on a boat! Yip!
5000207.c21_f3: Yip. What do you want me to say?
5000207.c21_f4: Yip yip yip! Tell me a joke!
5000207.f2_s: Yip yip!! I want some bacon!
5000207.f3_s: Yip yip!! You are the best, master!!
5000207.f4_s: That was the best! Gimme more!
5000207.s3: Yip yip! How could you say that?

5000210.c2_s1: So I sit like this? Peng?
5000210.c2_s2: Peeng? I sat like you told me to!
5000210.c2_s3: Are you worried that my feet are tired?
5000210.c2_f3: Show me how to do it! Peeng!
5000210.c2_f4: I have to sit on this bare ground? Peng?
5000210.c3_s1: You sit down too, master! You look tired! Peng!
5000210.c3_s2: It's a good thing my butt is so fluffy! Peng peng!
5000210.c3_s3: Peng, thank you master! I was actually kinda tired.
5000210.c3_s4: Ah, it feels like I came to a picnic! Peng peng!
5000210.c3_f1: I'm gonna look like a cushion if I sit... peng peng...
5000210.c3_f2: My legs aren't even hurting... do I really have to sit? Peng?
5000210.c3_f3: I don't want to sit unless it's on your lap... Peeng...
5000210.c3_f4: My legs are too short... Peng...
5000210.c4_s1: Now that I sat down, I feel sleepy... peng...
5000210.c4_s2: I'll do whatever you tell me to!
5000210.c4_s3: I was actually feeling a bit tired! Peng!
5000210.c4_s4: Peng peng! You sit down and rest too!
5000210.c4_f1: Sitting makes my belly look fat.
5000210.c4_f2: Right now, I feel more comfortable standing! Peng!
5000210.c4_f3: Once I sit, it will be hard to get up, peng...
5000210.c6_s1: Hearing that from you hurts my feelings. Peng.
5000210.c6_s2: Peeng... I didn't do it on purpose...
5000210.c6_s4: I didn't think it will make you angry. Peeng...
5000210.c6_f1: Peeng? I don't get what I did wrong?
5000210.c6_f2: Peeng! But I told you that I didn't mean to!
5000210.c6_f3: Are you just taking your anger out on me? Peng peng!
5000210.c6_f4: You're scolding me for eating too much, aren't you? Peng peng!
5000210.c7_s1: Don't get angry. I won't do it again... peng peng...
5000210.c7_s2: I just did that to get your attention!
5000210.c7_s3: Peeng... I'll be careful from now on...
5000210.c7_f1: Peng peng! I didn't do anything wrong.
5000210.c7_f3: It's hard to understand your words! Peng peng!
5000210.c7_f4: Peng! You're a real jerk sometimes!
5000210.c8_s1: A-are you gonna throw me away? Peng...
5000210.c8_s2: Peeng. Hearing that makes me so sad.
5000210.c8_s3: I bet you're saying that for my own good.
5000210.c8_f1: I learned it from watching you!
5000210.c8_f2: Peeng! I hate it when you get mad for no reason.
5000210.c8_f3: Peeng! Sometimes I just want to fly away!
5000210.c10_s3: Peng! When I met you, it was love at first sight!
5000210.c10_f2: That was a really bad joke, peng peng.
5000210.c10_f3: I'll pretend I didn't hear that, master... peeng...
5000210.c10_f4: I know what you feel, but that's just... peng...
5000210.c11_s1: I was waiting for those words! Peng peng!
5000210.c11_s3: I'll give you a smooch anytime! Peng peng peng!
5000210.c11_s4: Peng... this is a little weird, but I like it.
5000210.c11_f4: Peng? What did you just say?
5000210.c12_s2: Peng peng! I love giving smooches!
5000210.c12_s3: Give me a smooch too, master!
5000210.c12_f1: I thought I heard something weird...
5000210.c12_f3: It's like the violent winds of El nath...
5000210.c14_s1: Peeng! Excuse me for a second then!
5000210.c14_f3: Peeng peeng... I didn't even eat that much...
5000210.c14_f4: Peeng... I don't feel like pooping.
5000210.c15_s1: Peeng! Can you block for me?
5000210.c15_f1: Take me to a restroom! Peeng?
5000210.c15_f2: Peeng peeng... do I really have to?
5000210.c15_f3: I think I need a laxative... Peeng...
5000210.c16_s2: Don't forget to clean up after I'm done! Peeng!
5000210.c16_f1: That's so embarrassing! I can't... I can't! Peng!
5000210.c16_f3: I think that's against the law...
5000210.c16_f4: I'm too cute to poop! No way! Peng peng!
5000210.c18_s1: Peng? Really? You really think so?
5000210.c18_s3: Thank you for the compliment! Peng peng!
5000210.c18_f1: You're trying to butter me up!
5000210.c18_f2: I like it better when you're honest...
5000210.c18_f3: I've heard that a million times!
5000210.c19_s1: I have an awesome owner! Peng peng!
5000210.c19_s2: Peng peng! I know, everybody tells me that.
5000210.c19_s4: You know how to make a penguin happy! Peng!
5000210.c19_f2: Can't you say something more original? Peeng?
5000210.c20_s1: You sure know how to look at a penguin! Peng peng!
5000210.c20_s2: I feel like I'm falling for you all over again! Peng peng!
5000210.c20_s3: Peng peng! I'm not as awesome as you, though!
5000210.c20_s4: I feel like I can fly when you say that! Peng peng!
5000210.c20_f1: I want to hear 'cool' more than 'pretty'! Peng!
5000210.c20_f2: Sounds like you're just trying to flatter me. Peng?
5000210.c20_f3: Peng? I didn't hear you. Can you say that again?
5000210.c20_f4: Are you sure I don't look fat?
5000210.c22_s1: Peng... I can feel your love!
5000210.c22_f1: Don't say tricky things to me! Peng peng...
5000210.c22_f2: I'm sorry, but you aren't my type. Peng peng.
5000210.c22_f4: Peng... love? Human language is difficult!
5000210.c23_s2: My love for you grows and grows!
5000210.c23_s3: What do I do? My heart won't stop beating! Peeng!
5000210.c23_s4: Peng peng! I just want to brag about this to everyone!
5000210.c23_f2: Why are you trying to flatter me like that?
5000210.c23_f3: Peng peng? Are you trying to eat me?
5000210.c23_f4: Peeng... I only like other penguins. Maybe a parrot...
5000210.c24_s1: Do you see my love overflowing?
5000210.c24_s2: Peeng! I feel like singing a song!
5000210.c24_s4: Love sure is a wonderful word. Peeng!
5000210.c24_f1: Penguins and humans can never be!
5000210.c24_f2: You should bring me a nice fish if you mean it.
5000210.c24_f4: I thought you were seeing someone already!
5000210.c25_s2: Peng peng! Human language is hard!
5000210.c25_s3: You may not think we get cold, but El Nath is super frosty!
5000210.c25_s4: I'm feeling a little chubby. Need more fish!
5000210.c25_f1: So what do you want me to say? Peeng?
5000210.c25_f2: When was the last time you saw a talking penguin?
5000210.c26_s1: Are you wondering if real penguins make the peng noise?
5000210.c26_s2: I want some mackerel ice cream. Peng!
5000210.c26_s3: The Pepes in El Nath are my mean cousins!
5000210.c26_s4: I can't fly, but I'm still a bird!
5000210.c26_f2: I want to hear you talk first. Peng...
5000210.c26_f3: ... I really don't have much to say. Peng?
5000210.c26_f4: Peeng... is there something you want to hear?
5000210.c27_s1: Pepes and yetis are friends, but penguins hate yetis! Peeng.
5000210.c27_s2: Chloe is really good at knitting! You didn't know that, did you?
5000210.c27_s3: Someone even asked me whether I really have legs. Peeng...
5000210.c27_s4: Peng peng... Sometimes I want to fly in the sky.
5000210.c27_f1: Talking to your pets makes you look like a crazy person!
5000210.c27_f2: I don't really have anything to talk about...
5000210.c27_f4: There are too many people here.
5000210.c28_s3: Peng peng! I totally feel the love!
5000210.c28_s4: Hugs make me warm! Peng peng!
5000210.c28_f3: I thought you wanted my hand?
5000210.c29_s2: Hug me tight, master! Peng peng!
5000210.c29_s3: I love being hugged by you, master!
5000210.c29_s4: I can't reach you, master! Pick me up! Peng peng!
5000210.c29_f2: Eh, give me a flipper instead!
5000210.c29_f3: There are too many people watching!
5000210.c29_f4: I'll pretend I didn't hear that!
5000210.c30_s1: I love my hug-loving master! Peng!
5000210.c30_s3: Hug me! Hug me! Hug me master!
5000210.c30_f2: Should I shake your hand instead? Peng.
5000210.c30_f3: We need to talk about personal boundaries...
5000210.c30_f4: I don't want to do that in public!
5000210.c31_f1: Sleep on the ground? Where's the ice?
5000210.c31_f2: I can't sleep when I'm not sleepy. Peng!
5000210.c31_f3: Penguins sleep on full bellies. Peng peng!
5000210.c32_s3: I hope I see a Pepe in my dreams... Peeng...
5000210.c32_f1: There's not even a bed! Why do you hate me?
5000210.c32_f2: You're going to run away as soon as I close my eyes!
5000210.c32_f3: What, do you think I'm lazy?
5000210.c33_s1: You sleep well too. Peng peng!
5000210.c33_s2: I want to sleep on your lap... Peeng...
5000210.c33_s3: I love napping when you're around... Peeng...
5000210.c33_f1: If I sleep too much, I'll get fatter... then I won't be as cute!
5000210.c34_s2: I'll be able to fly one day, right?
5000210.c34_s3: One day, penguins will fly like eagles!
5000210.c34_f1: You have to teach me how to fly first... Peeng...
5000210.c34_f2: What will you give me if I fly? Peng?
5000210.c34_f3: Peeng? Have you ever seen a penguin fly?
5000210.c35_s1: I'll show you that penguins can fly too! Peeng!
5000210.c35_s2: I flew! I flew! Sort of...
5000210.c35_s3: I'll fly us away to the moon one day!
5000210.c35_f1: Oh, no, my belly's too heavy.
5000210.c35_f2: You really think it's possible to fly with these wings? Peng?
5000210.c35_f3: Peng peng? I can't fly away and leave you here all alone!
5000210.f2_s: Thank you for the food! Peng peng!
5000210.f2_f: Arg... I'm too full. It's impossible to eat anymore... Peng...
5000210.f3_s: Peeng! Maybe I'll get taller if I keep eating!!
5000210.f3_f: My stomach is going to pop... peng...
5000210.f4_s: Wow! It must be delicious! Thank you! Peng!
5000210.f4_f: Peeng... Do you have a grudge against me?
5000210.s3: Aren't you supposed to talk nicely? Peeng?
5000210.s4: Peeng? I'll get upset if you keep saying weird things!

5000211.c2_s1: Aye, I could use a little break.
5000211.c2_s2: Ahh, nothin' like relaxin' on a bomb.
5000211.c2_s4: Go on, cap'n. I'll watch this bomb.
5000211.c2_f3: Why do ye ask such things?
5000211.c3_s1: I agree, it be time for a rest.
5000211.c3_s2: This bomb be special, ye know.
5000211.c3_s3: Ye should rest as well. I worry about ye.
5000211.c3_s4: Yarr, me legs were gettin' tired.
5000211.c3_f2: Don't make me peck at ye.
5000211.c3_f3: That not be a very inspirin' order.
5000211.c4_s2: Now all I be needin' is some blueberries.
5000211.c4_s3: I not be sleepin'. Just restin' me eyes.
5000211.c4_f1: I not be carin' for ye orders.
5000211.c4_f2: Ye not be understandin' who yer messin' with...
5000211.c4_f3: Do I look like a dog to ye?
5000211.c7_s2: Don't make me walk the plank!
5000211.c7_f2: Ye need to be more carin' than that.
5000211.c7_f4: Bah. I be wantin' some grub.
5000211.c8_s1: I be reflectin' upon me mistakes.
5000211.c8_s3: Sorry. I'll be a much better pirate.
5000211.c8_f1: Keep this up, and ye'll have a mutiny on ye hands!
5000211.c8_f2: You treat ye crew like this?
5000211.c10_s1: Ye be my best mate, capn'n.
5000211.c10_s2: If we be stuck together, I be okay with that.
5000211.c10_s3: Always good to have the cap'n's ear!
5000211.c10_f1: That's behavior unbecoming a pirate, cap'n!
5000211.c10_f2: Life at sea be lonely, cap'n. Deal with it.
5000211.c10_f3: I feel a bit sick, cap'n. And I not be seasick.
5000211.c10_f4: Stop givin' me the crazy eye, cap'n!
5000211.c11_s1: Ahoy there! Ye be makin' me feathers all ruffled.
5000211.c11_s2: That's a good one, cap'n. Never gets old.
5000211.c11_s3: That's good, cap'n. We are shipmates, after all.
5000211.c11_s4: I'm so glad our piratey ways brought us t'gether!
5000211.c11_f1: Yarr, I be tryin' ta eat here!
5000211.c11_f2: Not sure how I feel about bein' yer crew, cap'n.
5000211.c11_f3: Yeah you do. No surprise there.
5000211.c11_f4: You gone soft on me, cap'n?
5000211.c12_s1: Ye be the only cap'n for me!
5000211.c12_s2: I be swashin' any buckles you want!
5000211.c12_s3: I'll be ye first mate anytime, cap'n.
5000211.c12_s4: This be the happiest moment in me piratey life.
5000211.c12_f1: Nay, cap'n, my ladybird awaits me at our next port of call.
5000211.c12_f2: That's inappropriate conduct for a cap'n, cap'n.
5000211.c12_f3: I love TREASURE, cap'n. And you should, too.
5000211.c12_f4: Ye compliment is bilgewater to me.
5000211.c13_s3: Now THAT is a real pirate's poop.
5000211.c13_f3: Even pirates have standards, ye scallywag!
5000211.c13_f4: This not be the poop deck, cap'n.
5000211.c14_s1: Yarr, I be a few pounds lighter now!
5000211.c14_s3: Yarr, I be givin' it all I've got!
5000211.c14_s4: I'm not swabbin' up after this, cap'n.
5000211.c14_f3: Ye be one strange pirate, cap'n...
5000211.c14_f4: This be hurtin' me confidence in ye.
5000211.c15_s2: It be an unhealthy obsession, but I be needin' ta go...
5000211.c15_s3: I'll not cross swords 'till I've had a good poop!
5000211.c15_s4: I've made me own buried treasure!
5000211.c15_f3: Ye be havin' the sea crazies, cap'n?
5000211.c16_s2: I be dreamin' of plunder tonight.
5000211.c16_s3: I be sleepin' well with a bomb under me pillow.
5000211.c16_s4: Ye takin' first watch, cap'n? Goodnight, then.
5000211.c16_f1: Nay, cap'n, there's work to be done!
5000211.c16_f2: The sun be shinin'! I can't sleep now!
5000211.c16_f3: There's plenty more fight in me, cap'n!
5000211.c16_f4: You sleep. I be takin' first watch.
5000211.c17_s1: Aye, just need a good bomb to sleep on.
5000211.c17_s2: Ye shouldn't disturb a sleepin' pirate...
5000211.c17_s4: You keep watch, cap'n...I'll get some shut-eye.
5000211.c17_f1: I've plenty of fire in me! I don't need sleep!
5000211.c17_f2: I'm not following that order! I'll mutiny!
5000211.c17_f4: Nay, cap'n, there's piratin' to be done!
5000211.c18_s1: Aye, I could use a little sleep after that.
5000211.c18_s2: Gonna catch a few winks before our next voyage.
5000211.c18_s3: Time for bed. Hope the bomb don't blow.
5000211.c18_s4: Aye, I'll be dreamin' of booty!
5000211.c18_f1: Ye don't have ta give orders all the time, cap'n!
5000211.c18_f2: Why sleep when there's pillaging to be done?
5000211.c18_f3: Don't make me turn on ye!
5000211.c18_f4: Ye should repect me! I be a scary pirate!
5000211.c19_s1: I'm gonna be king of the pirates!
5000211.c19_s2: One day, I'll own me own ship...the Black Pebble.
5000211.c19_s3: Want to see me treasure map? Ha! Too bad!
5000211.c19_s4: I once lived with a navy admiral, ye know.
5000211.c19_f3: Let's hear ye story first, cap'n.
5000211.c19_f4: I don't trust ye enough to share me secrets...
5000211.c20_s1: I broke free from a navy admiral's cage.
5000211.c20_s2: The sea be the only place for me.
5000211.c20_s3: I be in love with blueberries, ye know.
5000211.c20_s4: Have ye planned dinner? I be wantin' fruits!
5000211.c20_f2: If ye be bored, round us up some treasure!
5000211.c21_s1: I'll be a great captain meself one day.
5000211.c21_s2: This hat be the finest silk, ye know.
5000211.c21_s3: We spend too much time on land, cap'n!
5000211.c21_s4: I always wanted to be a pirate.
5000211.c21_f3: Nay, it be me alone time.
5000211.c21_f4: I'll abandon ship if ye keep this up!
5000211.c22_s2: See these? These be skin-color tights!
5000211.c22_s3: For me next trick, I'll break out of me cage!
5000211.c22_s4: This be only for ye, cap'n!
5000211.c22_f4: I be too hungry for ye tricks.
5000211.c23_s1: I'd like to see ye do this!
5000211.c23_f2: I be gettin' sick of ye pesterin'.
5000211.c23_f4: Oh, no. Ye go first, cap'n.
5000211.f3_f: Me belly be full ta burstin'!
5000211.f4_s: It be too delicious, I say!
5000211.s3: Ye be abusin' the chain of command.
5000211.s4: Do ye need to go back ta cap'n school?

5000215.c2_s2: I think I will, thank you.
5000215.c2_s3: I'm extra adorable when I sit. Look!
5000215.c2_s4: As you wish! Can I have some ramen now?
5000215.c2_f3: Sigh, why are you so bossy?
5000215.c2_f4: I think better on my feet.
5000215.c3_s1: All right. I think I deserve a rest.
5000215.c3_s3: A bowl of ramen would make this moment perfect.
5000215.c3_s4: Sure. Why don't you sit with me?
5000215.c3_f2: What? Here? At least get me a chair.
5000215.c3_f3: I don't want to get my tail dirty.
5000215.c4_s1: I'll sit here and think about ramen.
5000215.c4_s3: My legs are short and cute, but they get tired sometime.
5000215.c4_f1: I want to travel, not sit!
5000215.c4_f4: I really don't feel like sitting right now.
5000215.c6_s1: You're right. Just 'cause I'm cute doesn't mean I can get away with everything.
5000215.c6_s4: If I let you have my ramen, will you stop scolding me? Please?
5000215.c6_f3: You don't know what you're talking about.
5000215.c6_f4: Are you TRYING to make me mad?
5000215.c7_s2: If I behave, will you give me some ramen?
5000215.c8_s1: You're going to make me cry!
5000215.c8_s3: You still love me, don't you?
5000215.c8_f1: C'mon. You can't scold someone THIS cute.
5000215.c8_f4: I'll run away, and then you'll regret getting mad at me.
5000215.c10_f3: Don't stand so close to me.
5000215.c11_s3: For that, I'll let you scratch my tummy.
5000215.c11_f3: Do I look easy to you?
5000215.c12_s1: Then shower me with ramen, please!
5000215.c12_s3: I always knew I was irresistible.
5000215.c12_f4: Not as much as I love myself.
5000215.c13_s1: When you gotta go, you gotta go.
5000215.c14_s2: Hope you brought along toilet paper!
5000215.c14_s3: Such a perfectly round little pelle!
5000215.c14_f1: Not right now. I have a headache.
5000215.c14_f4: You into that sort of thing?
5000215.c15_s1: Does this make me a party POOPer? Get it?
5000215.c15_f1: Hey! Are you saying I have a stick up my butt?
5000215.c16_s2: Will you sing me a lullaby?
5000215.c16_s3: Don't even THINK of using me as a pillow.
5000215.c16_f1: You're not the boss of me.
5000215.c16_f4: You can sleep if you want. I'm busy.
5000215.c17_s1: I hope I dream of ramen.
5000215.c17_s3: I count pies and donuts to fall asleep.
5000215.c17_s4: Will you pet me until I doze off?
5000215.c17_f1: I only sleep on silk sheets.
5000215.c17_f2: Last time I slept, someone tied my tail to my ears. Pass!
5000215.c17_f4: I'm refusing just to be rebellious.
5000215.c18_s1: I suppose I could afford to take a break.
5000215.c18_s2: Hey, I just wanted to tell you that I think you're really... Zzz.
5000215.c18_s3: You should rest, too. You can cuddle with me.
5000215.c18_s4: Coffee ramen, pizza ramen, donut ramen... Zzz.
5000215.c18_f1: Do I LOOK sleepy to you?
5000215.c18_f2: You're so lazy, sometimes you disgust me.
5000215.c18_f3: I have recipes to create! No time for sleep!
5000215.c19_s1: I'm not chubby, I'm big-boned. Just wanted to let you know.
5000215.c19_s2: Everybody who meets me, loves me. Didja know that?
5000215.c19_s3: Just 'cause I'm cute doesn't mean my life is easy.
5000215.c19_s4: Ramen is really good with sugar and honey. Try it!
5000215.c19_f1: Go away. I'm sick of your face.
5000215.c19_f2: Why do you always follow me around?
5000215.c19_f4: Ugh, what do you want from me?
5000215.c20_s1: My dream is to become the world's best ramen chef!
5000215.c20_s2: I think about new ramen recipes all the time. Imagine: deep-fried ramen!
5000215.c20_s3: Here's a secret: my parents can transform into human shape.
5000215.c20_s4: Do you think red herb ramen would do well in this market?
5000215.c20_f1: Don't you have anyone else to pester?
5000215.c20_f2: You must be really lonely to be bothering me.
5000215.c20_f3: I'm going to pretend I don't see you.
5000215.c20_f4: Don't speak until you're spoken to!
5000215.c21_s1: I figure, if I stick with you, I'll get to travel and try all sorts of ramen!
5000215.c21_s2: I'm actually a really great dancer. I've got the perfect figure for it.
5000215.c21_s3: People who want to bring me down say I'm fat, but I know it isn't true.
5000215.c21_s4: Sometimes people tell me I have no parents. I don't get it. I DO have parents!
5000215.c21_f4: Do I LOOK like I'm in the mood?
5000215.c22_s1: We can dance if we want to!
5000215.c22_s2: Ah, I'm so adorable when I dance, I want to hug myself.
5000215.c22_s3: You love me even more than before I danced, don't you?
5000215.c22_f1: I'm not here for your amusement.
5000215.c22_f2: I'll think about it, IF you get me some ramen.
5000215.c22_f3: Believe it or not, I'm actually quite shy.
5000215.c23_s2: You ain't never seen nobody as cute as me!
5000215.c23_s4: Buy me a mirror so I can admire myself when I dance!
5000215.c23_f1: What, and then you'll give me a treat? How demeaning.
5000215.c23_f3: I'm on strike until you take me to a new ramen restaurant.
5000215.f3_s: This is why I love you.
5000215.f3_f: I could eat ten servings in one sitting!
5000215.f4_f: Mouth...likes. Stomach, not so much. Too full!
5000215.s4: I can hear you, you know.

5000216.c2_s2: Landed too hard. Bruised my butt.
5000216.c2_f1: No thanks. Sometimes when I try to sit, I trip.
5000216.c3_s1: Well, I guess I could use a rest.
5000216.c3_s2: Would you look at that view! Beautiful world we live in, general.
5000216.c3_s3: Sit with me? We can discuss our adventuring strategies, general.
5000216.c3_s4: Whew, I guess I am a little tired.
5000216.c3_f1: But we still have a lot further to go!
5000216.c3_f2: To be honest, it's not that easy for me to sit down.
5000216.c4_s1: I'll just snuggle here next to you, general.
5000216.c4_s2: Oh, good. I needed to groom my wings anyway.
5000216.c4_f3: My wings need exercise. They're getting pudgy!
5000216.c6_s1: Please don't hit me! Are you going to hit me?
5000216.c6_s4: No! I'll be good! I promise!
5000216.c6_f3: When I hum to myself, I can't hear you.
5000216.c7_s1: I'm going to crawl under a rock.
5000216.c7_s3: I think I'm going to cry!
5000216.c7_s4: I'm sorry! I'm sorry! Don't hurt me!
5000216.c7_f1: You just might make me angry for the first time in my life.
5000216.c8_s1: Be nice to me! Please! I'm sorry!
5000216.c8_s4: You... You still love me, don't you?
5000216.c10_f3: But I love CARROTS, not you.
5000216.c11_s3: I'm so happy I could fly, except I'm scared of heights.
5000216.c11_f3: Do you have to say that in such a creepy voice?
5000216.c11_f4: Just keep galloping. Just keep galloping.
5000216.c12_s3: You're the strongest, bestest person I know.
5000216.c12_f3: Just feed me and don't talk, please.
5000216.c12_f4: I'd like to be alone right now.
5000216.c13_s2: Got any toilet paper? I'm all out.
5000216.c13_s4: Oh! I feel much better now! Neigh!
5000216.c14_s2: I'll try not to lose my balance and fall in this time.
5000216.c14_s3: Hey, it's orange! Just like my favorite food, carrots!
5000216.c14_f1: An adventurer never poops in public!
5000216.c15_s1: Whoops, is that a brown speck on my wing?
5000216.c15_s2: Does the texture look a little off to you?
5000216.c15_s3: Quick! Make sure no one's peeking!
5000216.c15_f1: I don't need to go right now.
5000216.c16_s1: This is how I snore: zzzeigh, zzzeigh.
5000216.c16_s4: I could use a quick little nappy nap.
5000216.c16_f1: A true adventurer never rests! Right?
5000216.c16_f2: When I close my eyes, it gets dark, and I'm scared of the dark.
5000216.c16_f3: But what if monsters get me?!
5000216.c16_f4: I think you just want an excuse to nap.
5000216.c17_s1: I hope I dream of carrots!
5000216.c17_s3: Don't let anyone hurt me, mmkay?
5000216.c17_f3: But what if I get nightmares?
5000216.c17_f4: You sleep, general. I'll stand guard.
5000216.c18_s1: Can you buy me a stuffed carrot to hug?
5000216.c18_s2: Keep me secret, keep me safe, general.
5000216.c18_s3: Wake me up if anything interesting happens.
5000216.c18_s4: I can't keep my eyes open. Zzzzzeigh.
5000216.c18_f1: But I just downed an energy drink!
5000216.c18_f4: No! I want to have an adventure!
5000216.c19_s2: Carrots are amazing! They're nutritious, orange, pointy...
5000216.c19_s3: I lick my wings to keep them clean, just like a kitten.
5000216.c19_s4: If you have a heart of courage, the world is your carrot!
5000216.c19_f3: I want to be alone right now, please.
5000216.c20_s1: Sometimes people call me a unicorn, so I tried tying a carrot on my head.
5000216.c20_s2: My second favorite thing in the world? Carrots. My first favorite thing? YOU!
5000216.c20_s3: I want to be just like you when I grow up!
5000216.c20_s4: Where should we adventure to next, general? I can't wait!
5000216.c20_f3: We're too busy to talk right now!
5000216.c21_s1: I trip over my own feet sometimes, but I won't let that stop me!
5000216.c21_s2: Sometimes, my wings get tangled up in each other and I fall on my face.
5000216.c21_s3: Do you think I'm brave, general? I really hope you do.
5000216.c21_s4: What's your favorite? Deep-fried carrot, carrot steak, or carrot stew?
5000216.c21_f2: We should save our energy for our adventures!
5000216.c21_f3: I'm not good at small talk.
5000216.c21_f4: But I want to hear about YOUR adventurers, general!
5000216.c22_s2: Heh, not everyone can pull THIS off.
5000216.c22_s3: Hold on to your hats, ladies and gents!
5000216.c22_f1: I'm an adventurer, not a circus performer!
5000216.c23_s1: Think I deserve a carrot for this, general?
5000216.c23_s3: Let's see a unicorn try to pull this off.
5000216.c23_s4: This comes in real handy for an explorer like me.
5000216.c23_f4: Don't tell me what to do, please.
5000216.f3_f: Hey, I'm a colt, not a pig!
5000216.s2: General! An adventurer ought to know better!
5000216.s4: Do you see the disappointment in my eyes, general?

5000217.c3_s1: Funny, I was just planning to sit anyway.
5000217.c3_s2: I actually look better when I'm sitting.
5000217.c3_s4: I shall sit, but NOT because you told me to.
5000217.c3_f3: And why should I listen to you?
5000217.c3_f4: I can't hear you . Speak up.
5000217.c4_s2: I never tire, I'm just sitting for fun.
5000217.c4_s3: I will permit you to sit next to me.
5000217.c4_f3: I can neither hear nor see you right now.
5000217.c6_s1: Hmph. Fine. I get the point.
5000217.c6_s2: You'll never hear me say this again, but I'm sorry.
5000217.c6_s3: I suppose you detest me now.
5000217.c6_f2: I KNOW you're not talking to ME.
5000217.c6_f3: I'll do you a favor and pretend I didn't hear that.
5000217.c6_f4: You have three seconds to take that back.
5000217.c7_s3: Fine! Just don't expect an apology.
5000217.c7_s4: I don't even know what I did.
5000217.c8_s1: But I'm always up to no good!
5000217.c8_s4: I don't even know why I'm saying this, but sorry.
5000217.c8_f1: Why are you acting like this?
5000217.c8_f3: How DARE you speak to me like this!
5000217.c11_s3: I suppose I ought to say thanks, but instead I'll say: SCRAM.
5000217.c11_f1: You have to do better than that.
5000217.c12_s2: So many fans, so little time to crush all their hearts.
5000217.c12_s3: Yes, I'm one of a kind.
5000217.c12_s4: Stick around. I might have some use for you.
5000217.c12_f2: You're kidding yourself if you think you have a chance with me.
5000217.c12_f3: Have you looked in a mirror lately?
5000217.c14_s1: Now clean it up. Use your hands.
5000217.c14_s3: Consider that a favor. Now you owe me.
5000217.c15_f1: Some things you just don't do in public.
5000217.c15_f2: You're not even going to bribe me?
5000217.c16_f3: I don't know if you can tell, but I'm rolling my eyes.
5000217.c17_s3: Don't bother me while I sleep.
5000217.c17_s4: Okay, but only because I want to.
5000217.c17_f2: You think you can just tell me what to do?
5000217.c17_f3: Maybe if you weren't so NOISY.
5000217.c18_s1: I better get something out of this.
5000217.c18_f1: Do you have any idea what time it is?
5000217.c18_f2: But I'll have nightmares about your face.
5000217.c18_f3: Your stench is too strong. Can't fall asleep.
5000217.c18_f4: You really think you can make me?
5000217.c19_s1: I can spend hours thinking of ways to make people cry.
5000217.c19_s2: There's nothing more satisfying than an evil deed done well.
5000217.c19_s3: The weather annoys me. Change it.
5000217.c19_s4: You want me to talk? There, I talked.
5000217.c20_s2: I enjoy traveling. Why else do you think I let you hang around?
5000217.c20_s3: I enjoy food. So feed me.
5000217.c20_s4: Sometimes, I wonder where I came from.
5000217.c20_f3: Just who do you think you're bossing around?
5000217.c20_f4: If I wanted to talk, I'd talk.
5000217.c21_s1: I want to lock all the people I despise into a dark, windowless room.
5000217.c21_s2: Big Headward has an awfully large head for such a small brain.
5000217.c21_s3: Some creatires are so ugly, I don't know how they can stand to look in the mirror
5000217.c21_s4: That Wonky the Fairy'll eat anything. I've tested it.
5000217.c21_f1: I'm the silent but deadly type.
5000217.f2_s: Well, well. Not bad at all.
5000217.f4_f: Are you blind? Can't you see that I'm full?
5000217.s3: Try to keep it classy, will you?
5000217.s4: Mind your manners. You embarrass me.

5000221.c2_s4: Pyoo, let's a rest a little!
5000221.c2_f4: Pyoo! I'm going to play more!
5000221.c3_f2: Pyoo? Don't we still have a long way to go?
5000221.c3_f3: Ookyu? I don't want to rest right now...
5000221.c4_s2: Pyoo! Am I sitting down, or laying down?
5000221.c4_s3: Ookyu, it's the perfect time to rest!
5000221.c4_s4: Pyoo! Just for a minute, okay?
5000221.c4_f1: Ookyu? I don't like being ordered around!
5000221.c4_f2: We can't rest like this everyday!
5000221.c4_f3: Ookyu, just a couple more steps!
5000221.c4_f4: Pyoo? Are you hurt? Why do you keep wanting to rest?
5000221.c6_f2: Don't talk to me like that!
5000221.c6_f3: Pyoo! Are you really going to keep doing this?!
5000221.c6_f4: I said, don't order me around!
5000221.c7_s1: Ookyu... I miss the north pole...
5000221.c7_f4: Pyoo! I'm going to leave you then!
5000221.c8_s2: Sorry... I won't do it again...
5000221.c8_f1: Hmph! I told you to treat me nicely!!
5000221.c8_f2: Pyoo!! I'm going back to the north pole!
5000221.c8_f3: I'm going to tell on you!
5000221.c8_f4: Pyoo! I can be scary too!
5000221.c10_s4: I like you very much also!
5000221.c11_s2: Pyoo! I like you better than the north pole.
5000221.c11_s4: Pyoo! I'm so lucky to have a master like you!
5000221.c12_s1: Pyoo! I love hanging out with you.
5000221.c12_s4: Pyoo! I'll be with you forever!
5000221.c12_f2: Ookyu, did you eat some bad fish?
5000221.c12_f3: I'm a Harp Seal, and you are a human!
5000221.c13_f3: Ookyu! You should be ashamed of yourself!
5000221.c14_f1: Tell me that AFTER you feed me!!
5000221.c14_f2: You can't order me to do everything!
5000221.c15_s1: Ookyu! Every day is a healthy day!!
5000221.c15_f4: This is shameful! You'll be hearing from my Harp Lawyers!
5000221.c16_f2: The sun is still shining bright!
5000221.c16_f3: Still a long way to go!
5000221.c16_f4: I don't think it's time to sleep yet.
5000221.c17_f1: You are a sleepyhead, aren't you, master?
5000221.c17_f2: I don't want to sleep yet.
5000221.c17_f3: I'll sleep when I get sleepy, okie?
5000221.c18_s3: Good seals are early to bed, early to rise.
5000221.c18_f2: I guess master isn't too healthy...
5000221.c18_f3: Why do you always tell me to sleep?
5000221.c18_f4: Is this going to make us closer?
5000221.c19_s1: Well you know, in the north pole... (It just rambles on)
5000221.c19_s2: I saw this weird animal in the forest... (It won't stop talking)
5000221.c19_s3: Do you know the difference between true seals and fake seals?
5000221.c19_s4: I love it here because there aren't any polar bears.
5000221.c20_s1: I wish I had some snow to lie on.
5000221.c20_s2: I'm all white so I can hide from polar bears in the snow!
5000221.c20_s3: Will you protect me from polar bears, master?
5000221.c20_s4: I'm sure glad for nice people like you, master.
5000221.c21_s1: Pigs sure are weird! Why do their bottoms curl up like that?
5000221.c21_s2: Ookyu ookyu! Isn't it hard walking on two legs, master?
5000221.c21_s3: Where are we going today? Anywhere's fine with me!
5000221.c21_s4: What should we eat for dinner? I want some yummy milk!
5000221.c21_f4: I don't feel like opening my mouth... too much work...
5000221.c22_s2: I love you, you love me!
5000221.c22_s3: Pyoo pyoo pyoo! (It seems to be singing.)
5000221.c22_s4: Ookyu ookyu, pyoo! Ookyu ookyu, pyoo!
5000221.c22_f4: You show me something first, master!
5000221.c23_s1: Itsy bitsy seals and penguins, dancing at north pole!
5000221.c23_s3: Three seals in a house, daddy seal, mommy seal, and baby seal!
5000221.c23_f2: You want your pet to show its talents?
5000221.f3_s: Pyoo! You sure take good care of me, master!
5000221.f4_f: Don't you think I've gotten a little fat?
5000221.s2: What goes around, comes around you know?
5000221.s3: I don't want to be a pottymouth!
5000221.s4: Words reflect your insides, you know?!!

5000225.c2_s1: I'm a nice lamb that obeys well!
5000225.c2_s2: I was going to sit, baa!
5000225.c2_s4: I was actually planning to rest, baa!
5000225.c2_f1: I'm going to play more, baa!
5000225.c3_s3: Baa baa, you should sit down too.
5000225.c3_f1: Baa baa? What did you say?
5000225.c3_f2: I can't hear you, I can't hear you, baa baa!
5000225.c3_f3: I'm going to fly around more, baa baa!
5000225.c4_s1: Should we rest a bit? Baa baa.
5000225.c4_s3: Baa baa! What a peaceful feeling!
5000225.c4_f1: Baa baa? Are you talking to me?
5000225.c4_f2: I don't hear anything, baa baa!
5000225.c4_f4: Baa? What's with you all of sudden?
5000225.c6_s3: Baah! (It appears to be calling its mother...)
5000225.c6_s4: Baa! Don't do this to me...
5000225.c6_f2: Baa... maybe I should change owners.
5000225.c6_f4: I don't even wanna hear it...
5000225.c7_s2: Baa baa! It's all my fault!
5000225.c7_s3: Baa! Did I really mess up that badly?
5000225.c7_s4: Baa... I won't do that again...
5000225.c7_f1: Hmph, I'll be the bigger ram.
5000225.c7_f2: My patience has limits, baa baa.
5000225.c7_f3: Are you going to keep this up, baa?
5000225.c7_f4: If only I had a nicer owner...
5000225.c8_s2: Why do you always yell at me... *Cries*
5000225.c8_s3: I'm going to tell my mommy, baa baa...
5000225.c8_s4: Wahhhh! You're just mean because you're bigger than me!
5000225.c8_f1: I really wish I could just smack you, baa baa.
5000225.c8_f2: I'm gonna call animal protective services!
5000225.c8_f3: I can get scary when I'm angry, baa...
5000225.c8_f4: Baa baa... THAT does it! (Veins popping.)
5000225.c10_s3: Baa baa! I like, I like!
5000225.c10_s4: I like you very much also!
5000225.c10_f2: Baa baa. You aren't supposed to joke around like that.
5000225.c10_f4: Treat me well when you have the chance, baa.
5000225.c11_s2: Baa! I'm always on your side!
5000225.c11_f2: I said... I can't hear you!
5000225.c11_f3: Baa Baa! I got it, I got it!
5000225.c12_s1: Baa! I love hanging out with you!
5000225.c12_s4: Baa! Affectionate actions make Pufframs dance!
5000225.c12_f3: Baa baa. I already know your feelings.
5000225.c12_f4: So what do you want me to do, baa baa?
5000225.c13_f2: I'm shocked, I don't even have words.
5000225.c13_f3: (Little veins are popping out on its forehead.)
5000225.c13_f4: Do you KNOW what you are saying?
5000225.c14_s2: Ahhh, that could heat an entire village for a month!
5000225.c14_f1: Something needs to go in for something to come out!
5000225.c15_s1: Baa baa! Every day is a healthy day!!
5000225.c15_f1: It's not going to come out just because you whine!
5000225.c15_f2: Baa... let's have some common sense, shall we?
5000225.c15_f3: Baa baa... You want to get smacked?
5000225.c15_f4: I'll let you off for today...
5000225.c16_f3: No! I want to play more!
5000225.c16_f4: I want to play more, baa baa!
5000225.c18_s1: Baa... someday I'll soar higher than a dragon. Baa...
5000225.c18_f1: Can't you see that my eyes are still WIDE open?
5000225.c18_f2: Baa baa? What are you saying?
5000225.c18_f4: I'm not that lazy, baa baa.
5000225.c19_s1: Baa Baa! So today, I'm going to... (Now it won't stop talking.)
5000225.c19_s2: Are you amazed by flying lambs? So the secret of our race is...
5000225.c19_s3: Maple World is a pretty nice place to live, baa baa.
5000225.c19_s4: When we were living up in the sky, angels mistook us for clouds.
5000225.c19_f1: Is it strange that I talk?
5000225.c19_f4: Baa? Weren't we talking just a second ago?
5000225.c20_s1: Have you every had a Cloud Candy? It's the baaaaa-st.
5000225.c20_s3: If there's one thing I hate, it's wolves.
5000225.c20_s4: We are called Pufframs because we live above the clouds.
5000225.c20_f1: Baa baa... just leave me alone...
5000225.c20_f2: I don't want to talk right now, baa.
5000225.c20_f3: Mmm... are you hungry for a conversation?
5000225.c21_s1: Baa baa, would it be better to walk or fly?
5000225.c21_s2: Baa baa, you want to hear something interesting?
5000225.c21_s3: Which one of us do you think can fly faster? Me or the eagle?
5000225.c21_s4: To the Pufframs, the Golden Horn is a symbol of adulthood.
5000225.c21_f1: You look bored... too bad I'm not!
5000225.c21_f3: (It appears to be thinking about something.)
5000225.c21_f4: What if I say no, baa baa?
5000225.c22_s3: This is the Puffram booty dance!!
5000225.c22_f2: Am I in the circus or something, baa baa?
5000225.c22_f3: Baa baa... I said, it sounds annoying...
5000225.c22_f4: I actually have this super cool trick... but I don't feel like it right now.
5000225.c23_s1: (Jumps up and down.) Baa! Baa! Baa! Baa!
5000225.c23_s4: It's super fun when you do it above the clouds, baa baa.
5000225.c23_f2: Can't I just be your pet?
5000225.c23_f3: Too hungry... no strength... baa baa.
5000225.f3_s: Baa baa, eating time's my favorite time!!
5000225.s2: You want to get reported, baa baa?
5000225.s4: I'm so disappointed in you, baa baa!!

5000228.c2_s4: I sit on ground for now.
5000228.c3_s2: I sit on ground for now.
5000228.c3_s3: You no want I steal gold? I steal good, Mr'kuma.
5000228.c3_f2: Don't wanna! I wanna set your hair on fire!
5000228.c3_f3: Sit? Me not know word. Hehehe...
5000228.c4_s1: Okay, human. You tell me when we are going to eat monsters again.
5000228.c4_s2: I will sit for you, Mr'kuma. You are scary and powerful!
5000228.c4_s3: I do as you say, for now...
5000228.c4_s4: Later, you sit and I get to burn houses down!
5000228.c4_f1: No way! I am not your kr'grana!
5000228.c4_f2: I don't wanna! I am mighty and full of fangs!
5000228.c4_f3: Rak! Why you always want to sit?!
5000228.c4_f4: You take me to lake of fire first!
5000228.c6_f3: No talk to me like kr'gana. Me much strong!
5000228.c6_f4: Rak unar! I eat your wallet tonight!
5000228.c7_s3: My old boss was scary too. He eat my brother! So fun!
5000228.c7_s4: You scare many monsters with your talk! Scare me a little too...
5000228.c7_f1: No talk to me like kr'gana. Me much strong!
5000228.c7_f2: Rak unar! I eat your wallet tonight!
5000228.c8_s1: I like it when you are angry, Mr'kuma. I will be angry too!
5000228.c8_s2: Yes! Let's find some little kids to yell at!
5000228.c8_s3: Everytime you yell, I feel a little more at home...
5000228.c8_s4: Ha! More! Tell me how worthless I am!
5000228.c8_f1: You always say the same insults. Think up something new!
5000228.c8_f2: I know you can do better than that, Mr'kuma.
5000228.c8_f3: I know you have more rage in you than that...
5000228.c8_f4: I don't want to be flattered right now!
5000228.c10_s3: Why you talk like wimp, Mr'kuma?
5000228.c10_s4: Grauk-mouthed unar! You think I simple?!
