5000261.c2_s3: I will do as you say.
5000261.c2_f1: Scram, my clothes are getting dirty.
5000261.c3_f4: Don't tell me what to do.
5000261.c4_s4: Why don't you take a break too?
5000261.c4_f1: Hmm. Don't block the path of a rabbit.
5000261.c4_f3: Too much dust here. Can't do it.
5000261.c4_f4: These clothes are pricey. I can't just sit down.
5000261.c5_s2: I'm going to put a candle in your head.
5000261.c5_f2: (Little veins are popping out on its forehead.)
5000261.c6_f3: Come at me! I'll take you on.
5000261.c7_s3: It makes me sad that you have to discipline me.
5000261.c7_f1: You want to feel the wrath of the rabbit don't you?
5000261.c7_f2: All right... If that's how you want it.
5000261.c7_f3: If I wasn't a pet... I would....
5000261.c7_f4: Blah... I will take the high road here.
5000261.c8_f2: You ever feel the punch of a rabbit?
5000261.c8_f3: If I was just a bit younger... I would have taken you on.
5000261.c10_s2: I like you a lot too!
5000261.c11_s3: I feel the same way too!
5000261.c11_f2: Give me some time to think it over.
5000261.c11_f4: You are you, and and I am me, and that is all we'll ever be.
5000261.c12_s1: I don't know if feeling this good is legal!
5000261.c12_s2: This is the happiest moment of my life!
5000261.c12_s3: I will be with you always!
5000261.c13_s3: My insides are nice and clean.
5000261.c13_f3: Do you want to get locked up?
5000261.c14_s2: Don't talk to me right now.
5000261.c14_s4: It's good to eat right and live well.
5000261.c14_f1: Now is not a good time.
5000261.c14_f3: I'll get to work on making some.
5000261.c14_f4: Stop that nonsense and let's play!
5000261.c15_s2: My digestive system is in full gear.
5000261.c15_s3: It's time to let it go.
5000261.c15_s4: My eyes are closed. I am one with my bowels.
5000261.c15_f1: I don't want to hear that dirty talk.
5000261.c17_f2: I am still good to go.
5000261.c17_f3: Now is not a good time to sleep.
5000261.c18_f3: Now is not the time to sleep.
5000261.c18_f4: Sleeping is done on beds. Or hutches.
5000261.c19_s2: Do you know what's popular these days?
5000261.c19_s3: You are pretty fashionable, I guess.
5000261.c19_s4: I only like the designer stuff.
5000261.c20_s1: Not all expensive clothes are designer clothes.
5000261.c20_s2: It's important that clothes fit you.
5000261.c20_s3: Don't wear it just because everyone else is wearing it.
5000261.c20_f4: You want me to talk? There, I talked.
5000261.c21_s2: My hair is the product of a famous stylist.
5000261.c21_s3: You want to go shopping with me?
5000261.c21_s4: Be aware of Purty... She is a scary person.
5000261.c22_f2: I don't have such a thing.
5000261.c22_f3: You expect too much from this rabbit.
5000261.f4_s: I am not leaving any leftovers!
5000261.f4_f: I'm so full, I am about to explode!

5000269.c2_s2: I'm tired of getting stuck to the ground.
5000269.c2_s3: I'm not sitting because I want to.
5000269.c2_f2: No... Why do I need to listen to you?
5000269.c3_s1: I am not sitting because you told me to!
5000269.c3_s2: I did what you asked. You should pet me.
5000269.c3_s3: Fine, but you better be thankful!
5000269.c3_s4: I am not doing this for you!
5000269.c3_f2: Nope. Not doing it. Ask your other pets.
5000269.c3_f3: How would it benefit me to listen to you?

5000269.c8_s4: What is leaking from my face?

5000269.c25_f1: Stop telling me what to do!

5000270.c14_s2: I don't know why you want that, but you got it!
5000270.c15_s2: Arooo! My face is all red now!
5000270.c15_s3: I don't think I'll ever stop!
5000270.c15_f3: I'll poop when I wanna poop!
5000270.c15_f4: You're going to get us in trouble!
5000270.c16_f2: I'm independent! I take naps on my own time!
5000270.c16_f4: Going to sleep already? You're lazy!
5000270.c17_s2: Ah, my soft and cozy tail.
5000270.c17_s3: I'm going to dream up a storm!
5000270.c17_f1: Sorry, I can't hear you, I'm having fun right now!
5000270.c17_f2: Sleeping out in the open is romantic, but not now.
5000270.c17_f3: I want to enjoy the day! Aroo!
5000270.c18_s2: Arooo... I miss the prince and rose... zzz
5000270.c18_s3: Sleeping in the desert is SO romantic!
5000270.c18_f2: Bring me a blanket and pillow or no deal!
5000270.c18_f3: Why aren't we out hunting? That's way more fun!

5000270.c19_s2: I used to travel with a wonderful prince!

5000270.c22_f3: Aroo! I wanna do something else!

5000270.c23_f2: We've got all day tomorrow too!

5000270.f4_s: I was JUST thinking about these!
5000270.s2: Do not want! Let's see it again!

5000275.c2_f4: I want to walk a bit more.

5000275.c3_s2: Why don't we sit together, master?
5000275.c3_f1: Stand, sit, it's all the same...

5000275.c4_s2: It would be so much on your big, cushiony leg.

5000275.c4_f2: This is boring. Let's try something harder!
5000275.c4_f3: I will sit when you sit!
5000275.c4_f4: There are times when I want to try other things.

5000275.c6_f3: I am so nice... You've hurt me.

5000275.c8_s2: I'm sorry! I won't do it again.

5000275.c9_s2: You are the only one for me!

5000275.c11_s3: I love you! I love you!
5000275.c11_s4: Master, you always get me so emotional.

5000275.c13_f2: There is a time and place for everything!

5000275.c14_s3: Stop looking at my behind! It's embarrassing.

5000275.f2_f: Do you have a grudge against me?

5000283.c15_s1: Master, you love pooping as much as I do!
5000283.c15_s2: I bet I can burn a hole in the ground with this one...
5000283.c15_s3: I love stinking up your fresh air, Mr'kuma.
5000283.c15_s4: Empty out everything, master. Even your soul!
5000283.c15_f2: I'll let go of this poop when I darn well feel like it.
5000283.c15_f3: My bottom still hurts from the last one.
5000283.c15_f4: I have got to stop eating so many spicy monsters.
5000283.c17_s2: Good unar. We find many nightmare!
5000283.c17_s3: I like sleep. Let me eat many monster heads when wake.
5000283.c17_s4: You sleep too, Mr'kuma. I steal many wallet for you later.
5000283.c17_f1: No! You try take my eyeballs while I sleep!
5000283.c17_f2: I no want to! I want eat shopkeeper toes!
5000283.c17_f4: Sleep yourself, Mr'putama. I go find demon friends.
5000283.c18_s1: I could go for a little power nap on some hot coals.
5000283.c18_s2: Don't destroy any villages without me, okay, Mr'kuma?
5000283.c18_s3: I'll wake up when home freezes over.
5000283.c18_s4: Pitchforks, fire, and screaming people. This is going to be a great dream.
5000283.c18_f1: You can go to sleep if you want. I promise not to chew on your nose.
5000283.c18_f2: I don't need to rest! I'm an infernal machine!
5000283.c18_f3: I ate an entire case of espresso beans while you weren't looking.
5000283.c18_f4: I know better than to trust you.
5000283.c19_s4: I am Mr'kuma to ghost of jealousy like you are Mr'kuma to me.
5000283.c20_s4: I am Mr'kuma to ghost of jealousy like you are Mr'kuma to me.
5000283.c21_s1: Have you felt jealousy of another, unar-master?
5000283.c21_s2: I will let you avoid jealousy, if you prove that you are strong.
5000283.c21_s3: You will see the firey hand of jealousy!
5000283.c21_s4: If you can make me jealous, we can have a real relationship.
5000283.c22_s1: I make poona energy for you, Mr'kuma!
5000283.c22_s2: See my power! We destroy much together!
5000283.c22_s4: My real form is scary, Mr'kuma!
5000283.c22_f2: You do trick. I want laugh when you fall.
5000283.c22_f4: I show you already! You have bad brain!
5000283.c23_s1: What if I did this at your next surprise party?
5000283.c23_s2: Let's go scare some little girls with this trick!
5000283.c23_s3: With this power, I could conquer all of you puny humans.
5000283.c23_s4: Bask in awe, master! I am a being of pure terror!
5000283.c23_f1: How about I torch all your underwear instead?
5000283.c23_f2: Are you sure? You can never unsee it.
5000283.c23_f3: Shouldn't we be undermining somebody's hope?
5000283.c23_f4: I'll eat your eyebrows if you tell me that again!
5000283.f4_f: What are you trying to do to me?!
5000283.s3: Old boss call me that. He so cool.
5000283.s4: Hey! Even we demons have some etiquette.

5000290.c2_s1: I hope no one notices I'm here... Eep!
5000290.c2_s2: Ahh, nice. Maybe it's time for a nap.
5000290.c2_s3: I want to sit... But I need exercise!
5000290.c2_f2: La la la... I don't hear you...
5000290.c2_f3: This place is filthy... I can't be here...
5000290.c3_s1: With legs as short as mine, it doesn't matter!
5000290.c3_s2: Do you know what it's like to sit on a cloud?
5000290.c3_s4: Whew. I guess I am a little tired.
5000290.c4_s1: Ugh, my belly becomes really noticeable when I sit...
5000290.c4_s4: I guess I could do that... THIS time.
5000290.c4_f3: We don't have time for this!
5000290.c5_s1: I don't want to be punished.
5000290.c6_f1: Huh? What are you even saying?
5000290.c7_s1: I think I'm going to cry!
5000290.c7_s2: I'm going to crawl under a rock.
5000290.c7_f1: I didn't do anything wrong. YOU'RE bad!
5000290.c7_f2: Don't take it out on me!
5000290.c8_s1: What is it? I feel lost... I'm scared...
5000290.c8_s3: I'm full of tears! And they're coming out!
5000290.c8_f2: I'm gonna hang out at the Free Market.
5000290.c8_f3: Sometimes I wonder...is all this really worth it?
5000290.c10_s1: Now that you mention it, I love you too!
5000290.c11_s1: Well, um...I kinda I love you too!
5000290.c11_s4: Tee hee... You're making me blush!
5000290.c11_f4: Do you mean it? Are you sure?
5000290.c12_f3: Do you treat all your pets like this?
5000290.c14_f1: Don't you think you're going too far?
5000290.c14_f3: I need to get myself ready.
5000290.c15_s2: *Grunt* It feels like my face is burning.
5000290.c15_f4: I can't, okay? I just can't! Leave me alone!
5000290.c16_f2: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...
5000290.c16_f4: Doot de doo, I can't hear you...
5000290.c17_s1: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...
5000290.c17_f3: I don't even have a blanket...
5000290.c17_f4: The ground is so cold and hard...
5000290.c18_f2: No! I want to play more!
5000290.c18_f3: No! I have lots of energy!
5000290.c19_s1: I just love to play the harp!
5000290.c19_s2: I want to play outside with you!
5000290.c19_f4: I'd like to be alone now.
5000290.c20_s1: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5000290.c20_s2: My brain is just so full of...stuff!
5000290.c20_s4: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000290.c20_f3: But I don't have anything to say...
5000290.c21_s1: A, B, C, D, E, F, G!
5000290.c21_s2: I got a good feeling about today!
5000290.c21_s3: I'm just happy be to with you.
5000290.c21_s4: Did you do your good deed for the day?
5000290.c21_f4: Are there more angels like me?
5000290.f4_s: It's so delicious that it brings me to tears...
5000290.s1: Do you want to become a demon?
5000290.s2: You must not say something as foul as that.
5000290.s4: Why would you say something like that?

5000293.c2_f2: Give me one good reason why!
5000293.c3_s2: Perfect timing! I was getting a little tired.
5000293.c6_s4: I didn't mean to make you mad!
5000293.c7_s1: I was wrong! I was wrong!
5000293.c7_s2: I'll be more careful from now on!
5000293.c8_s2: Are you going to leave me?!
5000293.c8_f4: If I'm misbehaving, it's your fault.
5000293.c9_s1: Is it is because I'm cute?
5000293.c10_f3: But I'm stuck in a robot dog body!
5000293.c11_s2: You've made me the happiest Roo-bot alive!
5000293.c11_s4: I love you, too! I do! I do!
5000293.c11_f3: I don't think you mean it.
5000293.c12_s1: You're my reason for living, master!
5000293.c12_s4: Being with you makes life worthwhile!
5000293.c12_f2: I wish I felt the same way...
5000293.c12_f4: I'd like to be alone, please.
5000293.c13_f3: Do you even have a pooper scrooper?
5000293.c14_f2: I don't need to go right now!
5000293.c14_f4: I don't want to cause pollution!
5000293.c15_s2: How about a snack while I poop?
5000293.c15_s3: Master! Master! I want you to watch!
5000293.c15_f2: Why do you always want me to poop?
5000293.c15_f3: Sleep, sit, poop. That's all I ever get to do.
5000293.c16_f2: I want to play with you!
5000293.c17_s2: Am I cute while I sleep?
5000293.c17_f4: You always make me sleep! Hmph!
5000293.c18_s2: I'm cute when I sleep, huh?
5000293.c18_f4: Buy me a cozy bed first!
5000293.c19_s1: There were lots and lots of other Roo-bots back in the lab.
5000293.c19_s2: Gelimer wasn't mean, but he wasn't nice, either. I like you better!
5000293.c19_s3: Tell me I'm cute! Tell me you'll take care of me!
5000293.c19_s4: I was human once, but this robot body is cuter!
5000293.c20_s1: I miss the other Roo-bots from the lab. I hope they're okay.
5000293.c20_s2: Before Gelimer made me a Roo-bot, I think I lived by the sea.
5000293.c20_s3: Whoa! The world is full of monsters!
5000293.c20_s4: Do you think anybody would miss me if I disappeared?
5000293.c20_f1: What makes you think I have anything worth saying?
5000293.c20_f4: Let me just think of something to say...
5000293.c21_s1: You'll use the Water of Life on me if anything happens, right?
5000293.c21_s2: Sometimes, I think I kind of miss Gelimer... How weird!
5000293.c21_s4: Wanna know a secret? You're my favorite!
5000293.c21_f1: I'm not REALLY a dog, you know. I don't talk on command.
5000293.c21_f3: *Pretends not to hear, because it's funny! Hehe!*
5000293.f1_f: You plan to fatten me up so you can eat me, huh?
5000293.f3_s: I can do anything on a full tummy!
5000293.s1: You want me to say what?!

5000294.c2_s1: Okay, but you have to keep me safe.
5000294.c2_s2: Be on lookout behind me, just in case.
5000294.c2_s3: I guess I could take a break.
5000294.c2_s4: Do you have anything to eat while I sit here?
5000294.c2_f1: I'd rather stand, so I can run if a monster appears.
5000294.c2_f2: What if the ground hurts me?
5000294.c3_s3: I'm counting on you to keep the ground from attacking me!
5000294.c3_s4: My tail keeps me warm and cozy.
5000294.c3_f1: I need to lie down, not sit.
5000294.c3_f2: You just want to hurt me!
5000294.c3_f3: Why?! What're you going to do to me?
5000294.c4_s2: Will you be nice to me if I sit?
5000294.c4_s4: I'm awfully tired from being on high alert all the time.
5000294.c4_f2: Are you trying to hurt me?
5000294.c5_s2: It was my fault! Please stop hitting me!
5000294.c6_s4: I'll be better! Don't hurt me!
5000294.c6_f4: Why are you treating me this way?
5000294.c7_s2: I thought you cared about me!
5000294.c7_f3: I'm going to tell on you!
5000294.c8_f1: You're so mean! I miss Gelimer!
5000294.c8_f4: There's got to be someone I can call!
5000294.c10_s2: I think... I think that makes me happy!
5000294.c11_f4: I know you d-don't mean it.
5000294.c12_s1: I'm so glad I met you!
5000294.c12_s2: I love you so, so, so much!
5000294.c13_s4: I could do this all day.
5000294.c14_s1: I've been holding that in for a long time.
5000294.c14_s2: Promise that it won't hurt me!
5000294.c14_f2: What if it bites me on the way out?!
5000294.c14_f4: I only do that once a day...
5000294.c16_s2: Keep me safe while I rest.
5000294.c16_f1: What if I have bad dreams?
5000294.c17_s1: My tail will keep me safe. Right?
5000294.c17_s2: Don't leave me alone while I sleep, okay?
5000294.c17_s4: Put your hand on my back while I sleep so I know you're near.
5000294.c17_f2: You go first. I'll do it after...
5000294.c17_f3: What if something sneaks up on me?
5000294.c17_f4: No! Don't ask me to do that!
5000294.c18_s1: Stay with me while I sleep, okay?
5000294.c18_s2: One Red Snail... two Red Snails...
5000294.c18_s4: Can you make me a comfy quilt next time?
5000294.c18_f2: There are monsters in the closet!
5000294.c18_f4: But I'm not sleepy! I'm not!
5000294.c19_s1: That mean scientist performed all sorts of experiments on me. *cry*
5000294.c19_s2: I hate thinking about the past. I hate it!
5000294.c19_s3: The outside world is scary, but the lab was even worse.
5000294.c19_s4: I hate science! I hate it so much!
5000294.c19_f2: You won't get anything out of me!
5000294.c19_f3: I won't tell you! I won't!
5000294.c20_s1: I think I was brave before Gelimer came along.
5000294.c20_s2: I wish I weren't so timid, but everything scares me. Except you.
5000294.c20_s3: I'm so worried that one day I'll turn into a doll.
5000294.c20_s4: Sometimes I wish I could fly, but it's too scary.
5000294.c20_f1: Are you going to hurt me?
5000294.c20_f2: I don't like to talk about my past.
5000294.c21_s1: I've always wanted to taste the Water of Life, but I'm too scared.
5000294.c21_s2: Sometimes I think I should wear a disguise so no one can find me.
5000294.c21_s3: It's not safe to have friends. You're the only one I trust.
5000294.c21_s4: If it weren't for you, master, I think I'd be completely alone.
5000294.c21_f1: Are you going to hurt me?
5000294.c21_f3: Go away! I don't want to talk!
5000294.c21_f4: Aah! I thought I heard Gelimer's voice!
5000294.s3: I won't say anything bad, I won't!

5000295.c2_s1: I sat. Now where's my reward?
5000295.c2_f3: Why should I listen to you?
5000295.c3_s2: Ahh, I love how soft my tail is.
5000295.c3_s4: I suppose I could rest my feet for a minute.
5000295.c3_f2: I don't like it here. Let's jet.
5000295.c3_f4: It's dirty here. Let me sit in your lap.
5000295.c4_s1: There's a nice spot next to me with your name on it.
5000295.c4_f1: Do you expect me to do everything you say?
5000295.c4_f2: Come on! Let's do something else!
5000295.c4_f4: I am in no mood to sit.
5000295.c6_s1: Fine. Punish me. I LIKE it.
5000295.c6_s4: I guess I might've deserved that...
5000295.c6_f1: It's not like I meant to do anything wrong.
5000295.c7_s1: I'm sorry. You'll forgive me, right?
5000295.c7_s4: My bad, my bad. Get over it.
5000295.c7_f1: Why are you taking your repressed emotions out on me?
5000295.c7_f2: What're you gonna do, throw me in a rubbish bin?
5000295.c7_f3: I thought you were better than that.
5000295.c8_s2: I admit it, I messed up.
5000295.c8_f3: I might behave better if you FED ME MORE.
5000295.c9_f2: You must want something from me...
5000295.c10_s1: I suppose I can buy that.
5000295.c10_f2: We haven't reached that stage in our relationship.
5000295.c10_f4: You did NOT just say that.
5000295.c11_s1: I kinda liked hearing you say that.
5000295.c11_s3: Say that again while scratching my ears.
5000295.c11_f1: You're cute. Not in a good way.
5000295.c11_f2: Don't say stuff like that before I eat!
5000295.c12_s2: Gotta admit, my favorite time of day is when I'm with you.
5000295.c12_s3: Glad you recognize quality when you see it.
5000295.c12_f4: Is this really the right time for that?
5000295.c13_s3: Pick it up, buddy of mine!
5000295.c13_s4: No peeking! Well, a little bit is okay.
5000295.c13_f1: I thought you were more dignified than that.
5000295.c13_f2: I don't need you to tell me when to poop.
5000295.c13_f3: You don't even have a bag to pick it up!
5000295.c14_s1: Consider that a favor. Now you owe me.
5000295.c14_s3: I want you to breathe it in. Savor it.
5000295.c14_f2: Would you like it if I told YOU when to poop?
5000295.c14_f3: Maybe if you fed me more...
5000295.c14_f4: I'm holding it in, out of spite.
5000295.c15_f2: Feed me and I'll think about it.
5000295.c15_f3: The ground is covered with ants!
5000295.c15_f4: I'm embarrassed to be seen with you.
5000295.c16_s4: I'm pretty sleepy... How'd you know?
5000295.c16_f2: Do I look sleepy to you?
5000295.c16_f3: Maybe if I had a full tummy...
5000295.c16_f4: I'm fine as I am, thank you.
5000295.c17_s1: How'd you know I was tired?
5000295.c17_s2: I suppose I could close my eyes...
5000295.c17_s3: My tail is the perfect blanket.
5000295.c18_s1: Let's see how long I can stay... *snore*
5000295.c18_s3: There's space next to me if you wanna cuddle. Just saying.
5000295.c18_s4: Don't sit on me while I sleep!
5000295.c18_f1: Despite these dark circles under my eyes, I am NOT sleepy. *yawn*
5000295.c18_f2: We have too much to do!
5000295.c18_f4: Can't sleep. Miss my mom too... Nevermind.
5000295.c19_s1: If I ever see Gelimer again, I'll show him what for!
5000295.c19_s2: You have no idea who I really am. Noooo idea.
5000295.c19_s3: My favorite time of day is mealtime!
5000295.c19_s4: I've always dreamed of riding an airship...
5000295.c19_f3: Shoo, go over there and play.
5000295.c20_s1: Gelimer thinks he wiped out my memories, but I remember my mother.
5000295.c20_s2: I miss my life before I was a Roo-bot. Not that I don't enjoy being with you...
5000295.c20_s3: People think they can walk all over me because I'm in a dog's body.
5000295.c20_s4: I won't let anyone stop me from doing what I want to do!
5000295.c20_f2: Isn't there anyone else you can talk to?
5000295.c20_f3: I've got nothing to say right now.

5000311.c18_f2: No! I want to play more!
5000311.c18_f3: No! I have lots of energy!
5000311.c19_s1: I just love to play the harp!
5000311.c19_s2: I want to play outside with you!
5000311.c19_f4: I'd like to be alone now.
5000311.c20_s1: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5000311.c20_s2: My brain is just so full of...stuff!
5000311.c20_s4: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000311.c20_f3: But I don't have anything to say...
5000311.c21_s1: A, B, C, D, E, F, G!
5000311.c21_s2: I got a good feeling about today!
5000311.c21_s3: I'm just happy be to with you.
5000311.c21_s4: Did you do your good deed for the day?
5000311.c21_f4: Are there more angels like me?
5000311.f4_s: It's so delicious that it brings me to tears...
5000311.s1: Do you want to become a demon?
5000311.s2: You must not say something as foul as that.
5000311.s4: Why would you say something like that?
5000311.c23_s3: I have a perfect sense of balance!
5000311.c23_f3: Do I have to do it now?
5000311.c23_f4: I'll show it to you tomorrow!

5000314.c2_s2: You're good to me sometimes. Ook, oook!
5000314.c2_s3: It's great to sit down. Ook!
5000314.c2_s4: Oook. Why don't you take a seat next to me?
5000314.c2_f2: I think I've heard of this. Maybe not. Ook!
5000314.c2_f4: Oook. I know you feel more comfortable standing, too!
5000314.c3_s1: How did you know my legs were tired? Oook!
5000314.c3_s3: Heh heh, I needed this. Oook!
5000314.c3_s4: Come on, take a seat and have a chat. Oook?
5000314.c3_f1: Do you really think I want to sit in this nasty place, master? Ook?
5000314.c3_f2: Oh, you're so funny. Ook, oook!
5000314.c3_f3: How many days has it been since I came to this world? Ook?
5000314.c3_f4: Frankly, everything you want me to do is too much of a hassle. Ook!
5000314.c4_s1: Let's shake our tails in... Oook? Oh, you have no tail.
5000314.c4_s2: I love sitting and looking up the sky. Oook!
5000314.c4_s4: I'm full and the weather is lovely. And you're even lovelier. Oook, oook!
5000314.c4_f1: I'm old enough not to listen to you. Ook.
5000314.c4_f2: Tell me, would you sit on this nasty spot if I asked you? Ook?
5000314.c4_f3: ...Did a monkey just yelp? Or I might have heard something wrong. Oook.
5000314.c4_f4: I'm starving and you still want me to sit... I hope someone will give a banana. Ook.
5000314.c6_s1: Why do I want to cry? Ooook...
5000314.c6_s2: I can't believe you're angry with me for such a little thing. Oook!
5000314.c6_s3: Y-you're not really angry with me, are you? Ook?
5000314.c6_s4: I only did it because I like you... Ooook...
5000314.c6_f1: How dare you yell at me? Ook!
5000314.c6_f3: Don't take your aggression out on me! Ooook!
5000314.c7_s2: I'm not going to cry! I'm not going to give you the satisfaction! Ooook!
5000314.c7_s3: I will be more careful in the future. I promise. Ooook...
5000314.c7_s4: Do you think I'll care if you get mad at me like that? *Sob* Ook...
5000314.c7_f1: I don't like you when you're angry. Ooook...
5000314.c7_f2: I'm the one who should be angry, not you! Ooook!
5000314.c7_f3: You were talking behind my  back, weren't you? I heard it all! Ooook!
5000314.c8_s1: I'm not crying because you yelled at me. *Sob* I got something in my eyes... Ooook...
5000314.c8_s2: How can you be so angry with me? You're so cruel... *Sob* Oook...
5000314.c8_s3: It wasn't such a big deal... Ooook...
5000314.c8_s4: You said you liked me. Ooook... Were you lying to me?
5000314.c8_f1: Can't I eat first? What kind of rule is this? Ooook!
5000314.c8_f2: I'm telling you, it wasn't me... Why won't you believe me? Oook!
5000314.c8_f3: Who are you to punish me? I'm way older than you!
5000314.c8_f4: Did you just say I'm like a monkey? I'm not! Ook!
5000314.c10_f1: Hah. Hah. Hah. Oh, you're funny. Ook?
5000314.c10_f2: Gosh, are you out of your mind? I can't do that in here. Ook!
5000314.c10_f3: I'll pretend you didn't just say that. Ooook...
5000314.c10_f4: Take a look around before you ask me that. Ook.
5000314.c11_s1: I'm embarrassed, but if that's what you want... Ook!
5000314.c11_s2: You know, regular poops are important for your health, right? Ook!
5000314.c11_s3: Oook... I did it. I did it! Oh, no, this is embarrassing!
5000314.c11_s4: Keep an eye out for me, will you? Ook.
5000314.c11_f1: I haven't eaten anything. What did you expect? Ook?
5000314.c11_f2: You're not a monkey. How could you say that? Ook...
5000314.c11_f3: I didn't know you were so rude. Ooook...
5000314.c11_f4: Ook? Ook? Did something get in my ears? I think I heard something weird.
5000314.c12_s1: Ook, how did you know I've been wanting to go?
5000314.c12_s2: Do you have your eyes closed? Don't open them, all right? Ook?
5000314.c12_s3: I'm going to go with pride. I'm not embarrassed! Well, maybe, a little bit. Ooook!
5000314.c12_s4: You've secured a place for me. It'll be rude of me not to use it. Ook!
5000314.c12_f1: I'm not low-leveled anymore. You can't tell me what to do. Ook...
5000314.c12_f2: Crude monkeys expose themselves in public. I'm not like them. Ook...
5000314.c12_f3: No way. I have to think of my reputation. Ook.
5000314.c12_f4: I've lived over 500 years, and I've never pooped out in the open. Ook...
5000314.c14_s1: I-I'm not happy to hear that. Hmpf! Oook...
5000314.c14_s2: I know you're lying! Do you mean it? Oook!
5000314.c14_s3: Oook! I can't keep myself still!
5000314.c14_f1: Ook? That one thing you just said... You didn't say it to me, right?
5000314.c14_f2: Why are you staring at me like that? Ook.
5000314.c14_f3: Are you serious? You have quite peculiar taste. Ook...
5000314.c15_s2: I'm kind of happy. Heh. Ook.
5000314.c15_s3: Ook, stop it. You're making me blush.
5000314.c15_s4: I can't lie... It's all true! Ook!
5000314.c15_f1: Cut it out. It's not funny. Ook.
5000314.c15_f2: What kind of answer do you want from me? Ook!
5000314.c15_f3: I'd like to think I'm tough. Ook.
5000314.c15_f4: I'm tired of people telling me that. Ook.
5000314.c16_s1: Just so you know, I do this when I'm angry. I'm serious. Hee hee.
5000314.c16_s2: Really? You really think so? Heh heh heh! Ahem, well, I've heard that many times. Ook?
5000314.c16_s3: Ook? I'm really not happy, but I can't stop my tail...
5000314.c16_s4: I-I didn't hear what you just said. Ooook! I didn't!
5000314.c16_f1: Please, I'm done with compliments. Ook.
5000314.c16_f2: S-sure, you're cute too. That's what you wanted to hear, right?
5000314.c16_f3: Oook? I'm hungry. I need food, not empty compliments.
5000314.c16_f4: I'm grateful that you care for me, but sometimes you're too clingy. Oook.
5000314.c18_s1: Ugh! What was that? My heart just skipped a beat. Ook.
5000314.c18_s2: Ook? Something's wrong with my heart. What is it?
5000314.c18_s4: Oook... I think I'm in love...
5000314.c18_f2: Thanks... Though I'm having a hard time believing what's happening. Ook.
5000314.c18_f4: So, what do you want from me? Ook, oook!
5000314.c19_s1: Oook... I knew how you felt about me, but hearing it makes me happy just the same.
5000314.c19_s2: I-is this what you call love? Ook?
5000314.c19_s3: Ooook... Did you just confess your love to me? I think I'm happy...
5000314.c19_s4: I like you so much, I can't contain myself. Oook!
5000314.c19_f1: Enough with your love. I need food. Ook.
5000314.c19_f2: Ook? Aren't you tired of saying that?
5000314.c19_f4: If you're lonely, find someone else. I'm tired of you hitting on me. Ook.
5000314.c20_s1: D-don't think what you just said made me happy. If you're seeing hearts, you're hallucinating! Ook!
5000314.c20_s2: You dummy! You shouldn't say that so loud...others can hear you! Ooook!
5000314.c20_s3: Y-you're making me blush... Of course I'm happy. Ook.
5000314.c20_s4: Oook... I can't move... Maybe I'm too happy.
5000314.c20_f2: You've been saying that so much, now I don't know if I should trust you.
5000314.c20_f3: Stop talking nonsense and go away. Ook.
5000314.c20_f4: Ook... I understand you're lonely, but c'mon.
5000314.c21_s1: Please don't compare me to other monkeys. Ook.
5000314.c21_s2: The Happy Valley is a nice neighborhood, though not as nice as my hometown. Ook.
5000314.c21_s3: Oook, 500 years ago, I was strong enough to bring down a Yeti with one blow.
5000314.c21_s4: Ook! Don't ask me how pet feed tastes. Taste it yourself.
5000314.c21_f1: I don't have anything to say. Ook.
5000314.c21_f2: Ook...? Speak? You want me to speak? I can't speak!
5000314.c21_f3: I'm not in the mood to talk. Ooook... You talk.
5000314.c21_f4: Ook... I'm so hungry, I can't talk. Feed me.
5000314.c22_s1: I hate being turned into a doll. Ook. I would rather get locked up in jail.
5000314.c22_s2: Ook, oook! Don't you want to play with my tail? Careful, it has a mind of its own!
5000314.c22_s3: I hate being hungry. I hate being punished. But I hate being alone more than anything. Ook.
5000314.c22_s4: Oook... I can't talk to other pets. They just don't speak the same language.
5000314.c22_f1: You talk first, then I might. Ook.
5000314.c22_f3: I thought you didn't want me to talk because I'm too loud. Ook?
5000314.c22_f4: Are you that bored? I'm a pet, not a human. Ook?
5000314.c23_s1: Ook. How do I shapeshift? Well, I could tell you, but you wouldn't understand.
5000314.c23_s2: Want to know how I can ride on a cloud? Monster Riding is not the only skill! Oook!
5000314.c23_s3: Others pets have no style. Ook. I mean, even a hairpin can make a huge difference.
5000314.c23_s4: I had friends before. An oddball water ghost and a swine monster. What were their names?
5000314.c23_f1: What do you want to talk about? Ook?
5000314.c23_f2: We should keep quiet in public, master. Ook.
5000314.c23_f3: Talk! There, are you happy? Ook?
5000314.c23_f4: But I don't have anything to say... Plus, we are not so close. Are we? Ook.
5000314.c24_s1: It's already time for sleep. Oook...
5000314.c24_s2: I love sleeping on my cloud... Ook...
5000314.c24_s3: Ook... Aren't you sleeping? You look tired.
5000314.c24_f1: I won't sleep until you feed me! Ooook!
5000314.c24_f2: It's too early to sleep. Ook?
5000314.c24_f3: Ook? I can't believe you want me to sleep on the floor.
5000314.c25_s1: ...Ook... I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...
5000314.c25_s3: Wake me up in the morning... Oook.
5000314.c25_f1: I'm not tired yet. Why are you forcing me to sleep? What's your game? Ooook!
5000314.c25_f2: Ook! I don't have time for sleep, let alone for my shapeshifting practice.
5000314.c25_f3: How do you expect me to sleep on an empty stomach? Ook!
5000314.c26_s1: Ook... Sweet dreams to you, master!
5000314.c26_s2: Ook... I'm tired of sleeping... Zzz...
5000314.c26_s3: Ook? Good, I've been awake for too long...
5000314.c26_f1: I'm challenging myself! I will stay awake as long as possible! Ooook!
5000314.c26_f2: You're going to abandon me when I'm asleep. No! Ooook!
5000314.c26_f3: I'm not sleepy. I'm starving! Ook!
5000314.c27_s2: *Spin* Did you see how I shapeshift? Ook?
5000314.c27_s3: Ook! Keep your eyes peeled, or you're going to miss it.
5000314.c27_f1: Stop asking me to shapeshift. Do you know how hard it is? Oook.
5000314.c27_f2: Ooook... Stop asking me to shapeshift. You can't even do it yourself!
5000314.c27_f3: I can't shapeshift when I'm hungry. Ooook!
5000314.c28_s2: I practice every day, just for you! Ooook!
5000314.c28_s3: Oook, this is my specialty! Watch me!
5000314.c28_f1: Promise me you won't sell me to the Free Market after seeing my transformation. Ook?
5000314.c28_f2: You don't even look. Why do you want me to shapeshift all the time? Ook!
5000314.c28_f3: Oook... No, you said I looked funny in my other form.
5000314.f2_s: Oook, food! Ooh, I can't remember when I last ate!
5000314.f2_f: Stop disrupting my diet plan. Ook.
5000314.f3_s: Ooook! If I eat a lot, then maybe I can use magic again.
5000314.f3_f: Ook... Yuck... Don't you have something else?
5000314.f4_s: Oook, anything you give me is good!
5000314.f4_f: I hate eating until my belly hurts... Oook...
5000314.s2: You kiss your mom with that mouth? I'd never say something like that. Oook!
5000314.s3: Why do you always want to force such a strange word out of my mouth? Ook?
5000314.s4: I don't want to say such things. Kind words are better.

5000315.c2_s2: I'm a good boy, right? Gimme a treat! Yip yip!
5000315.c2_s4: Yip, yip! I'm an independent Husky!
5000315.c2_f1: Yip, sometimes I want to be rebellious.
5000315.c2_f2: Yip! Yip! I can't do it!
5000315.c2_f4: You sit down too, master! Yip!
5000315.c3_s4: You're taking it easy on me 'cause you care. Right, master? Yip!
5000315.c3_f3: Yip! Sorry master, but I can't!
5000315.c3_f4: Yip! My legs are numb. I can't move...
5000315.c4_s1: Yip! There's nothing I can't do if I'm with you, master!
5000315.c4_s2: Yip! Yip! I practice every day, just for you!
5000315.c4_s3: Master! Master! Look at me! Yip!
5000315.c4_s4: Am I doing good, master? Am I? Yip!
5000315.c4_f1: Yip! Yip! I can't, my butt hurts!
5000315.c4_f2: This is boring. Let's try something harder! Yip!
5000315.c4_f3: I can't. Why? I don't know... Yip...
5000315.c6_s2: Yip. I'll do what you tell me...
5000315.c6_f1: Yip! I didn't do anything bad!
5000315.c6_f2: Yip! I thought you liked me!
5000315.c7_s1: Sorry. I'll be good! Yip yip!
5000315.c7_f1: It was a mistake! Forgive me! Yip!
5000315.c7_f3: Yip! It was just one mistake!
5000315.c8_f2: It's just a tiny mistake. Yip!
5000315.c8_f3: I don't wanna be in trouble. Yip!
5000315.c10_s1: Yip, yip! I'm a smart Husky!
5000315.c10_s4: Yip! I am too a smart doggy!
5000315.c10_f1: Yip! Takes one to know one!
5000315.c11_s1: Yip! I am smart! I am!
5000315.c11_s3: But you still like me, right? Right?
5000315.c11_s4: I still like you, master. Yip!
5000315.c11_f1: Yip! I'm tired of this joke.
5000315.c11_f2: I know you don't mean it. Yip!
5000315.c11_f3: Let's talk about something else. Yip!
5000315.c12_s3: Well, I think you're the bee's knees! Yip!
5000315.c12_f1: Is this a new game? Yip! Idiot! Mutt! Bad master!
5000315.c12_f2: I know you don't mean it. Yip!
5000315.c12_f4: No! Yip! I'm a big strong doggy!
5000315.c14_s4: I thought I was constipated, but...nope! Yip!
5000315.c14_f1: Yip! But I already did! Yip!
5000315.c14_f4: Yip! I need a bag for my poop!
5000315.c15_s2: Yip! This one looks just like me! Yip!
5000315.c15_s3: Yip! Yip! Okay, now clean it up!
5000315.c15_s4: Watch out! I pooped there! Yip!
5000315.c15_f1: I can't just poop all day, you know? Yip!
5000315.c15_f2: Yip... I think I'm constipated... Grr...
5000315.c15_f3: I'm trying, but there's nothing to poo.
5000315.c15_f4: Master, bathrooms are where poop goes!
5000315.c16_s1: Yip! It doesn't smell bad, does it?
5000315.c16_s4: Yip! Yip! Be careful! I dumped it right next to you.
5000315.c16_f2: I can't go right now. Yip yip!
5000315.c17_s1: I like waking up early! Yip yip yip!
5000315.c17_s2: You're my favorite! If anyone else likes you, I'll bite 'em! Yip!
5000315.c17_s3: Yip! Let's do a quest! Wanna do a quest? Let's do a quest!
5000315.c17_s4: When I look into your eyes, it's like I can read your mind. Yip!
5000315.c17_f2: Yip! Yip! I wanna be quiet right now. Yip yip yip yip yip!
5000315.c17_f3: *Whimper* It's so cloudy today. I wish the sun was out.
5000315.c17_f4: I got nothing special to say. Yip!
5000315.c18_s1: Admins never ask for your password! Yip! What's a password?
5000315.c18_s2: I could look at you all day. Yip yip!
5000315.c18_s3: Is there really a scary dragon living in Leafre? Yip!
5000315.c18_s4: Yip! What do you like most about me, master? Yip yip!
5000315.c18_f1: Yip! Woah, I'm so out of it right now.
5000315.c18_f2: I tried to look up my horoscope, but I can't read. Yip!
5000315.c18_f3: Yip! Yip yip! My back ITCHES!
5000315.c18_f4: Yip! Yip! I can read your miiiind!
5000315.c19_s1: Thanks to all the treats, I got a tummy! Yip!
5000315.c19_s2: I'm not scared of no monsters! Just gimme potions. Yip!
5000315.c19_s3: You look JUST like me, master. Yip!
5000315.c19_s4: Yip! Yip! My tail's wagging! Look at it go!
5000315.c19_f1: I'm hungry. Gimme a snack. Yip!
5000315.c19_f2: Let's get on a boat! Yip!
5000315.c19_f3: Yip. What do you want me to say?
5000315.c19_f4: Yip yip yip! Tell me a joke!
5000315.c20_s1: Don't I look cool? Yip! Yip!
5000315.c20_s2: I can do this all by myself! Yip!
5000315.c20_s4: Yip! Yip! My tummy's on the ground.
5000315.c20_f1: Yip! Does this make my butt look big?
5000315.c20_f4: Gimme more time to practice. Yip! Yip!
5000315.c21_s1: Aren't I good? Gimme a treat! Yip!
5000315.c21_s3: Yip! I can do ANYTHING! Yip yip!
5000315.c21_f2: Ugh, my stomach. It hurts to crawl. Yip yip!
5000315.c21_f3: I'm still working on it. Teach me to do it better! Yip.
5000315.c22_s1: Yip? Yip? I'm a good Husky, am I not?
5000315.c22_s2: I'm a useful Husky,  am I not?
5000315.c22_s4: I'd even get you the stars from the sky if you ask me, master. Yip!
5000315.c22_f1: Sitting down is more comfy. Yip!
5000315.c22_f3: *Whimper*My back huuurts. Someone hit me yesterday!
5000315.c22_f4: Yip! Yip! This is too hard.
5000315.c23_s1: Wow, I can do it too! Yip!
5000315.c23_s2: Yip! Yip! My back was sore, but now it feels better.
5000315.c23_s3: That was hard, but I did it! Yip yip!
5000315.c23_s4: This makes my legs look even shorter! Yip!
5000315.c23_f4: I'm too out of shape... Yip! Yip!
5000315.c24_s1: Yip! Yip! Now I need to learn how to walk like this!
5000315.c24_s2: Yip yip yip! You're still taller than me.
5000315.c24_s4: I'm doing it! I'm doing it! I'm the best dog EVER!
5000315.c24_f1: Don't wanna. Feed me first! Yip!
5000315.c24_f3: It's scary! I might fall! Yip!
5000315.c24_f4: You're mean! I don't wanna! Yip!
5000315.c26_s4: Yip yip yip! I'm so happy!
5000315.c26_f2: You're not talking to me, right? I am a dog. Yip!
5000315.c26_f3: I pooped in your slippers this morning. Yip!
5000315.c27_s2: You're the best master in the whole wide world!
5000315.c27_s3: I love you too, master! Yip yip yip!
5000315.c27_f1: Yip? Of course you do! I'm adorable!
5000315.c27_f2: Don't you have someone better to say that to? Yip!
5000315.c28_s1: I love you SO much! Yip yip!
5000315.c28_s3: If you tell that to another pet, I'll bite you! Yip!
5000315.c28_s4: Yip, yip! I must be the happiest Husky in the world~♡
5000315.c30_f2: I don't think I know this one... Yip?
5000315.c31_s3: Yip yip! Am I doing it right?
5000315.c31_f1: *Whimper* There's a thorn in my paw...
5000315.c31_f2: Yip yip! Huskies don't have hands to shake, silly.
5000315.c32_s1: There's nothing a Husky can't do! Yip yip!
5000315.c32_f2: Yip yip! I'm tired of this. Just shake my tail or something.
5000315.f2_s: How did you know I'm hungry? Yip?
5000315.f3_s: This is so good! SO GOOD!
5000315.f3_f: Master... You're fattening me up... Yip!
5000315.f4_s: Yip yip! It's SO good. Gimme more!
5000315.f4_f: I-I don't wanna turn into a pig. I'm a dog! Yip yip!
5000315.s3: Don't put icky words in my mouth!
5000315.s4: Yip! Yip! Bad word is bad!

5000316.c2_s1: Are you worried that my feet are tired? Thank you!
5000316.c2_s2: You are being considerate of me master? Thank you!
5000316.c2_f4: You go ahead and just stay put master.
5000316.c3_s2: Why don't we sit together master?
5000316.c3_s3: It has been a long time since I got some rest.
5000316.c3_s4: My legs are comfortable when I sit.
5000316.c3_f1: My legs are cramped up right now.

5000328.c8_f3: Are you trying to scold me?
5000328.c9_s2: Get in here and prove if, you big oaf.
5000328.c9_f2: Do I look stupid to you?
5000328.c10_s1: You're giving me shivers. Say it again.
5000328.c10_s2: You're the salt that completes my soup.
5000328.c10_f1: You just want to eat me.
5000328.c10_f3: EH? My ears are clogged with soup.
5000328.c11_s1: There's room for two in here.
5000328.c11_s3: Fine. Take a sip. Go on, but just one.
5000328.c11_s4: Mind giving me a back rub, then?
5000328.c11_f3: I am just too comfy to care.
5000328.c11_f4: I am VON SOUP! Who are you?
5000328.c12_s1: Heh, heh. Wanna take a dip?
5000328.c12_s2: It's like a jacuzzi in here. Hop in!
5000328.c12_f1: Are you hiding a bottle of barbeque sauce behind your back?
5000328.c12_f2: Sure, you'd love to GRILL me.
5000328.c12_f3: Uh huh, I see that spoon you're holding...
5000328.c12_f4: Can't a chicken get a break?
5000328.c17_f1: Get me a pillow or something.
5000328.c18_s4: I don't... wanna wake up yet...
5000328.c19_s1: I'm good for the soul, you know.
5000328.c19_s2: I can never tell whether people like me for me or if they're just cozying up to eat me.
5000328.c19_s3: I used to have a banana in my soup. Don't know what happened to it.
5000328.c19_s4: Hey, weren't you that guy who tried to bake me the other day?
5000328.c20_s1: Carrots, celery, onions... I love them all.
5000328.c20_s2: You have no idea how amazing it feels to live in soup. It's like a waterbed.
5000328.c20_s3: I'm actually a chicken soup lord. I come from money.
5000328.c20_s4: I gave all my servants the year off. Except for you.
5000328.c21_s1: White meat, dark meat, it's all ME, baby.
5000328.c21_s2: Yup, today's gonna be good. I did a veggie reading this morning.
5000328.c21_s3: Hey, fetch me some newspapers, will you? I used mine up for toilet paper.
5000328.c21_s4: Chicks dig my soup bowl. Get it? Chicks?
5000328.s2: Don't me get out of this bowl...
5000328.s3: Someone ought to teach you a lesson.
5000328.s4: I'm not going to warn you again...

5000330.c2_s4: I'm not sitting because I want to.
5000330.c2_f1: Why should I listen to you?
5000330.c3_s1: This is a piece of cake!
5000330.c3_s2: You should sit and relax, too.
5000330.c3_f2: Frankly, everything you want me to do is too much of a hassle.
5000330.c3_f4: Don't tell me what to do.
5000330.c4_s2: I was going to take a break anyway.
5000330.c4_s4: I do as you say, for now...
5000330.c4_f1: I don't want to do it right now.
5000330.c4_f2: I am unaware of this concept.
5000330.c4_f3: No way! I am not your kr'grana!
5000330.c4_f4: You take me to lake of fire first!
5000330.c5_s2: Who do you think you are?
5000330.c5_f1: You're the one that should be punished!
5000330.c6_f1: Rak unar! I eat your wallet tonight!
5000330.c6_f2: Don't take your aggression out on me!
5000330.c7_s2: My old boss was scary too. He eat my brother! So fun!
5000330.c7_s3: Would you please cut me some slack?
5000330.c7_f1: It's you who needs to be punished!
5000330.c7_f2: Don't blame me. It's your fault!
5000330.c8_s1: I won't do it again. Give me a chance.
5000330.c8_s2: Can't you see my tears? Please, have a heart...
5000330.c8_s4: Everytime you yell, I feel a little more at home...
5000330.c8_f1: You always say the same insults. Think up something new!
5000330.c8_f3: Stop it before I'll make you!
5000330.c10_f4: I may be quiet, but I haven't forgiven you.
5000330.c11_s2: I no fall for trick. Old Mr'kuma trick me like this long ago.
5000330.c11_s4: I accept, but understand that I don't feel the same way.
5000330.c12_s3: So many fans, so little time to crush all their hearts.
5000330.c12_s4: Yes, I'm one of a kind.
5000330.c13_f3: I'm not going to throw that away.
5000330.c14_s3: I expect you to clean after me?
5000330.c14_s4: Don't talk to me right now.
5000330.c14_f1: I'll get to work on making some.
5000330.c14_f4: Just who do you think you're bossing around?
5000330.c15_s1: It's time to let it go.
5000330.c15_s4: My digestive system is in full gear.
5000330.c17_s4: Okay, but only because I want to.
5000330.c17_f2: It's much too early for that!
5000330.c18_s2: Don't ditch me while I'm sleeping.
5000330.c18_s3: I also sleep during the daytime.
5000330.c18_s4: I better get something out of this.
5000330.c19_s1: Who do you think you are, kid?
5000330.c19_s4: You want me to talk? There, I talked.
5000330.c19_f1: I don't want to talk right now.
5000330.c19_f2: Never mind... I will tell you tomorrow.
5000330.c19_f3: Can't you just let me rest?
5000330.c19_f4: What do you want me to say?
5000330.c20_s1: Can you defeat Zakum? I don't think you can...
5000330.c20_s2: You'd better feed me on time. Or I'll run away!
5000330.c20_s3: I guess having a big head doesn't mean that person's smart...
5000330.c20_f1: Why are you always ordering me around?
5000330.c20_f3: I said I don't want to talk!
5000330.c21_s4: Do you want to fight me?
5000330.f2_s: I don't want to eat alone.
5000330.s2: This is abuse! I'll have you locked up!
5000330.s3: You kiss your mom with that mouth?

5000331.c2_s2: I'm fully aware that I have short legs...
5000331.c2_s3: Ahh, nice. Maybe it's time for a nap.
5000331.c2_f2: This place is filthy... I can't be here...
5000331.c2_f3: I just don't want to do it anymore...
5000331.c3_s1: Not really... I'm not doing this for you!
5000331.c3_s3: With legs as short as mine, it doesn't matter!
5000331.c3_f1: No, you're going to make fun of me because I'm just as short standing as sitting!
5000331.c3_f3: I think I heard someone saying something...
5000331.c3_f4: Sitting makes my buttocks get bigger.
5000331.c4_s2: I guess I could do that... THIS time.
5000331.c4_s3: Ugh, my belly becomes really noticeable when I sit...
5000331.c4_f1: I'm never going to do it.
5000331.c6_s1: I guess I should stay quiet.
5000331.c6_f1: Huh? What are you even saying?
5000331.c7_s2: I'm going to crawl under a rock.
5000331.c7_f4: Don't take it out on me!
5000331.c8_s3: I'm full of tears! And they're coming out!
5000331.c8_f2: I'm going to find a new owner!
5000331.c10_s1: Now that you mention it, I love you too!
5000331.c10_f1: Are you saying you love me?
5000331.c11_s1: I guess I love you, too?
5000331.c11_s3: Well, um...I kinda I love you too!
5000331.c11_f3: That was a good one... ha ha...
5000331.c12_f2: Ha ha ha... What can I say?
5000331.c12_f3: I already know how you feel...
5000331.c14_s3: I-I'm just a little bit shy...
5000331.c14_f4: Not here! I'll die of shame!
5000331.c15_f1: I feel like everyone is looking at me.
5000331.c15_f2: I'll let you off for today...
5000331.c16_f2: Doot de doo, I can't hear you...
5000331.c16_f4: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...
5000331.c17_s1: I'm sorry to interrupt you, but I can't keep my eyes open...
5000331.c17_s3: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...
5000331.c17_f2: I don't even have a blanket...
5000331.c17_f3: The ground is so cold and hard...
5000331.c18_f1: I don't want to go to bed...
5000331.c19_s3: I want to tell you about so many things...
5000331.c19_f1: I want octopus balls... And fried noodles...
5000331.c19_f2: I feel too shy to talk.
5000331.c19_f4: I don't want to talk about it.
5000331.c20_s2: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000331.c20_s3: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5000331.c20_s4: My brain is just so full of...stuff!
5000331.c20_f1: I'm going to bed. I'm full, I said...
5000331.c20_f2: There's nothing for me to say... I don't want to talk.
5000331.c21_s1: I'm jealous of Yeti and Pepe's relationship...
5000331.c21_s2: Everything will be fine as long as you feed me well.
5000331.f2_s: It's so delicious that it brings me to tears...
5000331.s1: I'll remember this! You watch out!
5000331.s2: Even we Demons know not to cross the line.

5000332.c2_s1: Am I good? Gimme a treat!
5000332.c2_s2: You should give me a complement for this sit.
5000332.c3_s4: Good idea. My legs were feeling a bit tired.
5000332.c3_f1: My legs are cramped up right now.
5000332.c3_f4: My legs aren't even hurting... do I really have to sit?
5000332.c4_s1: I practice every day, just for you!
5000332.c4_s3: There's nothing I can't do if I'm with you, master!
5000332.c4_s4: Master! I will do anything you want!
5000332.c4_f1: I will sit when you sit!
5000332.c4_f3: Right now, I feel more comfortable standing!
5000332.c4_f4: Master, you need to learn how to enunciate.
5000332.c5_f2: You should be setting an example for me.
5000332.c6_s1: *Whimper* Please don't yell at me like that. I like you.
5000332.c6_s3: I'll do what you tell me...
5000332.c6_s4: Stop looking at me with that scary face... You'll make me sad.
5000332.c6_f1: Did something bad happen at your school today?
5000332.c7_s1: You are still the best in my books, master...
5000332.c7_s3: Please don't be mad. It's hard for me to have my only family mad at me.
5000332.c7_f2: I am good and faithful. Why are you always on my back?
5000332.c7_f3: It's hard to understand your words!
5000332.c8_s1: Hearing that makes me so sad.
5000332.c8_s2: Master...I'm sorry for hurting your feelings...
5000332.c8_s4: Please forgive me, just this once.
5000332.c8_f1: I hate it when you get mad for no reason.
5000332.c8_f2: This is boring. Let's play something else, master!
5000332.c11_s1: Your words are always so sweet.
5000332.c11_s2: The words are so sweet, I don't know what to do.
5000332.c11_s3: I can't stop thinking about you, master!
5000332.c11_s4: You can say that a hundred times and I won't get tired of it.
5000332.c11_f3: Yip? Of course you do! I'm adorable!
5000332.c12_s1: Tell me that ten times every day!
5000332.c12_s2: If you tell that to another pet, I'll bite you! Yip!
5000332.c12_f2: I was going to call you master, but... Nah, forget it.
5000332.c12_f3: You're okay, except that you're too easy.
5000332.c12_f4: Master... That's nice... But you smell funny.
5000332.c13_f1: You need to study up on common decency.
5000332.c13_f2: Think things through before you tell me what to do!
5000332.c13_f3: There is a time and place for everything!
5000332.c14_s2: I feel lighter after I went.
5000332.c14_s3: Poo Poo... Let's sing about it!
5000332.c14_f1: How many times a day do you want me to go?
5000332.c14_f4: Why are you telling me to do this?
5000332.c15_s3: How did you know I had to go?
5000332.c15_s4: Would you play with me when I'm done?
5000332.c15_f1: I want to go play at the neighbor's.
5000332.c15_f3: I just pooped. Did you forget?
5000332.c15_f4: I don't know what poop is.
5000332.c16_s1: Aren't you sleeping? You look tired.
5000332.c16_f1: It's not time for bed yet.
5000332.c16_f2: I want to see you in my dreams, master.
5000332.c17_s4: Good thinking! It's time for sleep!
5000332.c17_f1: Can't I just sleep when I want to?
5000332.c17_f3: Master, this is not time for you to sleep!
5000332.c18_s1: Master, don't wake me up anytime soon!
5000332.c18_s2: I wanted to play some more, but okay.
5000332.c18_s3: You go to sleep too, master.
5000332.c18_s4: You're sleepy, too? Come lay down next to me.
5000332.c18_f1: Putting me to bed without food? You are an awful master!
5000332.c18_f2: I will rest while I sit...
5000332.c18_f4: Where do you plan on going after I fall asleep? Take me with you!
5000332.c19_s1: What do you like about me the most, master? Tell me!
5000332.c19_s2: If we run into something scary, you have to protect me.
5000332.c19_s3: You hunt. I'll feed you potions.
5000332.c19_f2: What I'm going to tell you is totally secret...
5000332.c19_f3: What do you want me to say?
5000332.c19_f4: You and I are intellectually incompatable for any kind of productive conversation.
5000332.c20_s1: Are you wondering what noises real penguins make?
5000332.c20_s2: I'm slumming it just by being seen with you.
5000332.c20_s3: Pets all speak different languages. A yeti and a white tiger can't speak to each other.
5000332.c20_s4: I am little tired today. How about you, master?
5000332.c20_f2: Manager Karl in Ludibrium is so kind.
5000332.c20_f3: Are you bored? Let's got get a facial!
5000332.c20_f4: I don't have a big appetite, but anything master gives me is good!
5000332.c21_s1: Watching snow makes me want to see Grandpa Cliff.
5000332.c21_s3: There's a statue that looks just like me at the Floating Market.
5000332.c21_s4: I think you are the strongest in the world!
5000332.c21_f1: I want to hear a story, master.
5000332.c21_f2: I don't know what to say!
5000332.f1_s: Master, this is so delicious... Squerch!
5000332.f3_s: I am about to faint, I ate too much.
5000332.f4_f: I don't want to eat anymore.
5000332.s1: Aren't you supposed to talk nicely?
5000332.s3: What goes around, comes around you know?

5000341.c3_s4: I was tired from all that bouncing.
5000341.c3_f4: Don't tell me what to do.
5000341.c4_s2: I was going to take a break anyway.
5000341.c5_s2: Who do you think you are?
5000341.c7_s2: But look at how cute I am! Boing!
5000341.c7_f1: Take a look in the mirror, buddy.
5000341.c7_f2: What are you blaming ME for?
5000341.c12_s4: How could you not? I'm adorable!
5000341.c13_f3: I can't wipe with gloves on...
5000341.c14_f4: Don't tell me what to do!
5000341.c15_s2: That could go in a museum!
5000341.c15_s4: I kind of want to touch it.
5000341.c16_f4: You sleep. I'm gonna keep working hard.
5000341.c17_s4: Okay, but only because I want to.
5000341.c17_f1: I was just about to, until you said that.
5000341.c17_f4: I'm going to tape my eyes open.
5000341.c19_s2: I never take off these gloves. EVER!
5000341.c19_s3: My weakness is my ears, but don't tell!
5000341.c19_s4: I'm gonna be a pro boxer one day!
5000341.c19_f4: What do you want me to say?
5000341.c20_s1: One day, I'm gonna beat Zakum in a boxing match!
5000341.c20_s2: Feed me lots of protein so I can build muscle mass!
5000341.c20_s3: Takes me 20 minutes each day to do my hair!
5000341.c20_f4: Don't tell me what to do!
5000341.c21_s4: You think you can take me? Let's try!
5000341.c21_f4: Let's just have a moment of silence, okay?
5000341.s2: This is abuse! I'll have you locked up!
5000341.s4: You kiss your mama with that mouth?

5000342.c2_s4: I sit on ground for now.
5000342.c3_s2: I sit on ground for now.
5000342.c4_s4: Later, you sit and I get to burn houses down!
5000342.c4_f3: Rak! Why you always want to sit?!
5000342.c7_s3: But look at how cute I am! Boing!
5000342.c7_s4: You scare many monsters with your talk! Scare me a little too...
5000342.c8_s1: I like it when you are angry, Mr'kuma. I will be angry too!
5000342.c8_s2: Yes! Let's find some little kids to yell at!
5000342.c8_s4: Ha! More! Tell me how worthless I am!
5000342.c8_f2: I know you can do better than that, Mr'kuma.
5000342.c8_f3: I know you have more rage in you than that...
5000342.c8_f4: I don't want to be flattered right now!
5000342.c12_s1: You are the cruelest of all masters...and I like it.
5000342.c12_s3: That is the rudest thing you can say!
5000342.c12_s4: Now I see you are just trying to be mean to me. Thank you!
5000342.c12_f1: There is no such thing as love.
5000342.c12_f2: My heart is cold and black like a piece of coal!
5000342.c12_f3: I'm almost getting used to this constant abuse.
5000342.c12_f4: You're just trying to make me get mad again.
5000342.c14_f4: You no treasure drakla. It MY drakla!
5000342.c15_s3: I love stinking up your fresh air, Mr'kuma.
5000342.c15_s4: Empty out everything, master. Even your soul!
5000342.c15_f2: I'll let go of this poop when I darn well feel like it.
5000342.c15_f3: My bottom still hurts from the last one.
5000342.c15_f4: I have got to stop eating so many spicy monsters.
5000342.c16_s4: Good unar. We find many nightmare!
5000342.c16_f4: I no want to! I want eat shopkeeper toes!
5000342.c17_s2: Good unar. We find many nightmare!
5000342.c17_s4: You sleep too, Mr'kuma. I steal many wallet for you later.
5000342.c17_f2: I no want to! I want eat shopkeeper toes!
5000342.c17_f4: Sleep yourself, Mr'putama. I go find demon friends.
5000342.c18_s2: You sleep too, Mr'kuma. I steal many wallet for you later.
5000342.c18_s3: I'll wake up when home freezes over.
5000342.c18_s4: Pitchforks, fire, and screaming people. This is going to be a great dream.
5000342.c18_f2: I don't need to rest! I'm an infernal machine!
5000342.c18_f3: I ate an entire case of espresso beans while you weren't looking.
5000342.c18_f4: I know better than to trust you.
5000342.c19_s1: I'm gonna be a pro boxer one day!
5000342.c20_s4: I am Mr'kuma to ghost of jealousy like you are Mr'kuma to me.
5000342.c21_s1: Have you felt jealousy of another, unar-master?
5000342.c21_s2: I will let you avoid jealousy, if you prove that you are strong.
5000342.c21_s3: You will see the firey hand of jealousy!
5000342.c21_s4: If you can make me jealous, we can have a real relationship.
5000342.c22_s1: I make poona energy for you, Mr'kuma!
5000342.c22_s2: See my power! We destroy much together!
5000342.c22_s4: My real form is scary, Mr'kuma!
5000342.c22_f2: You do trick. I want laugh when you fall.
5000342.c22_f4: I show you already! You have bad brain!
5000342.c23_s1: What if I did this at your next surprise party?
5000342.c23_s2: Let's go scare some little girls with this trick!
5000342.c23_s3: With this power, I could conquer all of you puny humans.
5000342.c23_s4: Bask in awe, master! I am a being of pure terror!
5000342.c23_f1: How about I torch all your underwear instead?
5000342.c23_f2: Are you sure? You can never unsee it.
5000342.c23_f3: Shouldn't we be undermining somebody's hope?
5000342.c23_f4: I'll eat your eyebrows if you tell me that again!
5000342.s3: Old boss call me that. He so cool.
5000342.s4: Hey! Even we demons have some etiquette.

5000343.c2_s1: I hope no one notices I'm here... Eep!
5000343.c2_s2: Ahh, nice. Maybe it's time for a nap.
5000343.c2_s3: I want to sit... But I need exercise!
5000343.c2_f2: La la la... I don't hear you...
5000343.c2_f3: This place is filthy... I can't be here...
5000343.c3_s1: With legs as short as mine, it doesn't matter!
5000343.c3_s2: Do you know what it's like to sit on a cloud?
5000343.c3_s4: Whew. I guess I am a little tired.
5000343.c4_s1: Ugh, you can see my belly when I sit...
5000343.c4_s4: I guess I could do that... THIS time.
5000343.c4_f3: We don't have time for this!
5000343.c5_s1: I don't want to be punished.
5000343.c6_f1: Huh? What are you even saying?
5000343.c7_s2: I'm going to crawl under a rock.
5000343.c7_f1: I didn't do anything wrong. YOU'RE bad!
5000343.c7_f2: Don't take it out on me!
5000343.c8_s1: What is it? I feel lost... I'm scared...
5000343.c8_f2: I'm gonna hang out at the Free Market.
5000343.c8_f3: Sometimes I wonder...is all this really worth it?
5000343.c10_s1: Now that you mention it, I love you too!
5000343.c11_s1: Well, um...I kinda I love you too!
5000343.c11_s4: Hee hee... You're making me blush!
5000343.c11_f4: Do you mean it? Are you sure?
5000343.c12_f3: Do you treat all your pets like this?
5000343.c14_f1: Don't you think you're going too far?
5000343.c14_f3: I need to get myself ready.
5000343.c15_f4: I can't, okay? I just can't! Leave me alone!
5000343.c16_f2: I'm going! To stay up! All! Nigh...Zzzz...
5000343.c17_s1: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...
5000343.c17_f3: I don't even have a blanket...
5000343.c17_f4: The ground is so cold and hard...
5000343.c18_f2: No! I want to play more!
5000343.c18_f3: No! I have lots of energy!
5000343.c19_s1: I just love to play the harp!
5000343.c19_s2: I want to play outside with you!
5000343.c19_f4: I'd like to be alone now.
5000343.c20_s1: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5000343.c20_s2: My brain is just so full of...stuff!
5000343.c20_s4: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000343.c20_f3: But I don't have anything to say...
5000343.c21_s1: A, B, C, D, E, F, G!
5000343.c21_s2: I got a good feeling about today!
5000343.c21_s3: I'm just happy be to with you.
5000343.c21_s4: Did you do your good deed for the day?
5000343.c21_f4: Are there more angels like me?
5000343.s1: Do you want to become a demon?
5000343.s2: You must not say something as foul as that.
5000343.s4: Why would you say something like that?

5000344.c2_s2: Ahh, nice. Maybe it's time for a nap.

5000344.c2_f2: La la la... I don't hear you...

5000344.c3_s2: Do you know what it's like to sit on a cloud?
5000344.c3_s4: Whew. I guess I am a little tired.

5000344.c4_s4: I guess I could do that... THIS time.
5000344.c4_f3: We don't have time for this!
5000344.c5_s1: I don't want to be punished.
5000344.c6_f1: Huh? What are you even saying?
5000344.c7_s2: I'm going to crawl under a rock.
5000344.c7_f1: I didn't do anything wrong. YOU'RE bad!
5000344.c7_f2: Don't take it out on me!
5000344.c8_s1: What is it? I feel lost... I'm scared...
5000344.c8_f2: I'm gonna hang out at the Free Market.
5000344.c8_f3: Sometimes I wonder...is all this really worth it?
5000344.c10_s1: Now that you mention it, I love you too!
5000344.c11_s1: Well, um...I kinda I love you too!
5000344.c11_s4: Hee hee... You're making me blush!
5000344.c11_f4: Do you mean it? Are you sure?
5000344.c12_f3: Do you treat all your pets like this?
5000344.c14_f1: Don't you think you're going too far?
5000344.c14_f3: I need to get myself ready.
5000344.c15_f4: I can't, okay? I just can't! Leave me alone!
5000344.c16_f2: I'm going! To stay up! All! Nigh...Zzzz...
5000344.c17_s1: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...
5000344.c17_f3: I don't even have a blanket...
5000344.c17_f4: The ground is so cold and hard...
5000344.c18_f2: No! I want to play more!
5000344.c18_f3: No! I have lots of energy!
5000344.c19_s1: I just love to play the harp!
5000344.c19_s2: I want to play outside with you!
5000344.c19_f4: I'd like to be alone now.
5000344.c20_s1: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5000344.c20_s2: My brain is just so full of...stuff!
5000344.c20_s4: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000344.c20_f3: But I don't have anything to say...
5000344.c21_s1: A, B, C, D, E, F, G!
5000344.c21_s2: I got a good feeling about today!
5000344.c21_s3: I'm just happy be to with you.
5000344.c21_s4: Did you do your good deed for the day?
5000344.c21_f4: Are there more angels like me?
5000344.s1: Do you want to become a demon?
5000344.s2: You must not say something as foul as that.
5000344.s4: Why would you say something like that?

5000352.c2_s3: I'll keep you warm and cozy!
5000352.c2_s4: Okay, but don't sit on me!
5000352.c2_f4: I'm a candle! I was born to mooove!
5000352.c3_s1: Whew, I was really burning up.
5000352.c3_s4: A break now and then is refreshing.
5000352.c3_f2: But I like to be carried!
5000352.c3_f4: But I want to travel the world!
5000352.c4_s1: I'll always shine brightly at your side.
5000352.c4_s3: I'll burn any monster that tries to sneak up on us.
5000352.c4_f2: At least buy me a candle holder!
5000352.c4_f3: Don't tell me what to do!
5000352.c6_f1: It was just a tiny mistake...
5000352.c6_f3: How dare you try to punish me?!
5000352.c7_s3: You're making me cry, and CANDLES AND WATER DON'T MIX!
5000352.c8_s4: Even if you hate me, I can't leave you.
5000352.c8_f2: I've had just about enough of you!
5000352.c8_f3: I'm going to count to three. One... Two...
5000352.c10_s1: You've got the hots for me.
5000352.c10_s3: You love just me, right? Just me!
5000352.c10_f3: You just want to steal my light.
5000352.c11_f2: I don't believe someone so dark.
5000352.c11_f3: My light is too bright for you.
5000352.c12_s2: Hide it under a bushel, NO! Our live is gonna shine.
5000352.c12_s3: You're the light of my life, too.
5000352.c12_s4: Your heart is as warm as my flame.
5000352.c12_f4: In the blink of an eye, I can disappear.
5000352.c13_s4: Let's leave it on someone's doorstep.
5000352.c14_s1: Let's set your farts on fire next!
5000352.c14_s3: Gather it up, and you can make a new candle!
5000352.c14_f3: Just because I'm not wearing clothes...
5000352.c15_s1: You ever seen a candle poop before?
5000352.c15_s3: You have to keep the pellets, okay?
5000352.c15_s4: I could do this all day.
5000352.c15_f3: It always burns on the way out.
5000352.c16_s2: Promise to light me again in the morning.
5000352.c16_s4: I promise not to set my blankie on fire this time.
5000352.c16_f3: But I wanna light monsters on fire!
5000352.c16_f4: Go ahead, try and snuff me.
5000352.c17_s2: Cuddle with me. I'll keep you toasty.
5000352.c17_s3: Don't use me to make s'mores while I'm sleeping this time.
5000352.c17_s4: This little light needs to rest up!
5000352.c17_f2: Look at how brightly I'm still shining!
5000352.c18_s1: Buy me a new pillow if I burn this one?
5000352.c18_s2: Keeping my fire lit sure takes up a lot of energy!
5000352.c18_f1: It's too bright! I can't sleep!
5000352.c18_f3: You try sleeping with a flame on your head.
5000352.c18_f4: I still have so much energy to burn.
5000352.c19_s1: I wish I had hands. Then I could play guitar!
5000352.c19_s2: I love to watch things burn.
5000352.c19_s3: When I was little, none of the other household appliances would come near me.
5000352.c19_s4: Use me to roast marshmallows, fish, nuts, you name it!
5000352.c19_f2: I'm a candle. I have nothing to say.
5000352.c20_s1: Once, I burned an entire barn when someone kicked me over.
5000352.c20_s2: My last master was a pale girl with long black hair...
5000352.c20_f2: My flame is more powerful than you could possibly imagine.
5000352.c21_s1: I know a joke! What's got wax and a wick? ME!
5000352.c21_s2: Someone tried to take me into a graveyard once, but I got scared and ran away.
5000352.c21_s3: Do you think I should change my flame color? Been sporting this one for centuries.
5000352.c21_f1: I'm the strong but silent type.
5000352.c21_f2: Like they say, silence is golden.
5000352.f4_f: Feeding me to an early grave.
5000352.s2: Don't do that! You're creeping me out!
5000352.s3: How could you do this to me?!
5000352.s4: Why do you want me to say that?!

5000365.c2_s1: Will you sit with me? Please?
5000365.c2_s2: I love sitting next to you!
5000365.c2_s3: Ah, a rest. Carrying a piece of fruit on my head sure is tiring.
5000365.c2_f1: Does sitting make me look fat?
5000365.c2_f3: If I sit, my cream'll turn sour!
5000365.c2_f4: Sitting makes me too easy to bite!
5000365.c3_s2: My doughy tush makes sitting so comfy!
5000365.c3_s4: You look like you could use a rest, too.
5000365.c3_f1: But I can keep walking forever!
5000365.c3_f2: Sit, stand, sit stand. You're gonna turn my cream into cheese.
5000365.c3_f3: At least put down a blanket or something.
5000365.c3_f4: I've gotten too chubby. I need exercise!
5000365.c4_s1: Together, we can do anything. Even sit!
5000365.c4_s2: I'm in a good mood, so okay.
5000365.c4_s4: Your wish is my puffy command! Heehee!
5000365.c4_f2: You can sit. I'm going without you.
5000365.c4_f4: You just want to step on me.
5000365.c5_f2: It's because you're a poor role model.
5000365.c6_s1: What did I do? I'm sorry!
5000365.c6_s2: You're going to make me cry big, creamy tears!
5000365.c6_f3: I don't like you right now!
5000365.c6_f4: You're projecting your insecurities on to me, aren't you?
5000365.c7_s1: I'm so sorry I disappointed you!
5000365.c7_f2: Don't say that unless you mean it!
5000365.c8_s3: You have to forgive me because I love you.
5000365.c8_s4: But the creampuff fairy told me to do it!
5000365.c8_f1: Too busy eating to listen, la la.
5000365.c8_f2: I hate being in trouble. Hmph.
5000365.c10_s4: I feel all warm, like back in the oven!
5000365.c10_f1: Do you love me or do you love to eat me?
5000365.c10_f2: It's hard to hear you without ears.
5000365.c10_f4: Oh, just kiss my puffy butt.
5000365.c11_s1: You're as sweet as my filling!
5000365.c11_s2: My creamy filling IS pretty great.
5000365.c11_s3: If you love me, then squeeze me!
5000365.c11_f1: I WON'T LET YOU EAT ME!
5000365.c11_f2: I know what you're planning to do to me when my guard is down...
5000365.c12_s1: I love you so much, I'd even let you take a nibble!
5000365.c12_s2: You make me the happiest creampuff alive!
5000365.c12_s3: I feel all warm and gooey inside. Oh, wait. Hehe.
5000365.c12_f1: This is a trick, isn't it?
5000365.c12_f3: We're not even the same food group!
5000365.c12_f4: I know you secretly want to om nom me.
5000365.c13_s2: I love to flush! Flush! Flushhhh!
5000365.c13_s4: Thanks for buying me this mini toilet. Love it!
5000365.c13_f2: That's a faux pas in creampuff society.
5000365.c14_s1: Little cream poops, la la la!
5000365.c14_s2: Ooh, I think I saw a piece of fruit in that one!
5000365.c14_s3: I hope you brought a napkin to wipe me with!
5000365.c14_s4: My poop smells like fruit. Mmmmm!
5000365.c14_f3: But I just went last week.
5000365.c14_f4: The chef who made me would be so ashamed!
5000365.c15_s1: Go on and squeeze it all out of me!
5000365.c15_f1: Why didn't you buy me a stall with this toilet?!
5000365.c15_f4: But then I won't have any filling left inside!
5000365.c16_s2: You should get some rest, too.
5000365.c16_s4: Don't forget me while I'm sleeping!
5000365.c16_f2: It's not time for nite nite yet!
5000365.c17_s1: I'm going to dream of swimming in a pool of coffee.
5000365.c17_f2: I smell to good to sleep.
5000365.c17_f4: I can set my own schedule, thanks very much.
5000365.c18_s2: Whew, I could use a rest.
5000365.c18_s3: Can I sleep in the palm of your hand?
5000365.c19_s1: I was the smallest creampuff in my entire batch!
5000365.c19_s2: Sometimes, I wish I were made of a different fruit. Like, cherries!
5000365.c19_s3: I have nightmares where a giggling girl tears me apart, limb by limb. Then eats me.
5000365.c19_s4: As my BFF, it's your job to make sure I don't get eaten!
5000365.c19_f1: What do you want from me? My brain's made of cream!
5000365.c19_f3: Creampuffs are for eating, not talking. Wait...
5000365.c19_f4: I have a lot on my mind lately. Get it?
5000365.c20_s1: A creampuff without cream might as well be dead.
5000365.c20_s2: Someday, I'm going to have three creampuff babies: plain, chocolate, and green tea!
5000365.c20_s3: At first, my baker made me without legs, but I begged and begged, and now look how cute I am!
5000365.c20_s4: What's the oddest creampuff flavor you can think of? Coconut? Pineapple? Anchovies?
5000365.c20_f2: What makes you think a creampuff can talk?
5000365.c20_f3: I hate small talk! I like big talk! Hehehe!
5000365.c21_s1: I support creampuff rights. We all deserve the right to not be eaten.
5000365.c21_s2: I don't mind if you eat other creampuffs, as long as you don't eat ME.
5000365.c21_s3: Sometimes I wish I were banana flavored. Bananas have all the fun.
5000365.c21_s4: I want to be the first creampuff to travel to the moon.
5000365.c21_f1: Gee, YOU try chatting on demand.
5000365.c21_f2: Shhh! I'm watching a creampuff soap opera!
5000365.c21_f4: Are you making fun of the way I talk?
5000365.f3_f: Are you trying to poison me?!
5000365.f4_s: Ooooh, this is yummier than I am!
5000365.f4_f: My little tummy is going to explode!
5000365.s1: I'm too pure for words like that!
5000365.s3: A cute creampuff likes cute words!
