5000415.c7_s1: Admit that it was your fault.
5000415.c7_s3: Okay, stop it. I get it now!
5000415.c7_s4: I miss Orchid. She's so nice.
5000415.c7_f4: How dare you get angry with me?
5000415.c8_s1: I am actually reflecting on myself for the first time ever.
5000415.c8_s2: Okay, fine. I won't do that anymore.
5000415.c8_s3: So you also don't like me.
5000415.c8_s4: I wanted to be a good person.
5000415.c8_f2: Can you feel the darkness behind me?
5000415.c8_f3: You are nothing but a lowly peon.
5000415.c9_s2: I will accept it. Your heart, that is.
5000415.c9_f2: You will have a crush soon.
5000415.c10_s3: So many fans, so little time to crush all their hearts.
5000415.c10_s4: Those words make me feel nervous and great at the same time!
5000415.c10_f2: You don't even know how to get better.
5000415.c10_f4: How can a person as weak as you...
5000415.c11_s1: I don't really understand what it means, but it sounds nice.
5000415.c11_s3: You make my heart go pitter-patter.
5000415.c11_s4: I didn't know you liked me that much...
5000415.c11_f2: I am already suffering... You don't have to make me suffer even more...
5000415.c12_f2: Honestly, you are not my type.
5000415.c12_f4: Not bad, but not good either.
5000415.c13_s3: You can put this here like that, yeah?
5000415.c13_f1: I don't know what that means.
5000415.c13_f4: I was taught to do that by myself.
5000415.c14_s4: It will be easier to fly now that I feel lighter.
5000415.c14_f2: I feel like I just ate.
5000415.c14_f4: You are such a dirty toy.
5000415.c15_s1: Is this what it feels like to let everything go?
5000415.c15_s4: I want to cover my eyes.
5000415.c15_f1: I don't know how to do that.
5000415.c15_f4: I'm not really in the mood.
5000415.c16_s2: I don't know when my last break was.
5000415.c16_s3: Why don't you take a break?
5000415.c16_f1: I feel like I'm gonna have a nightmare.
5000415.c16_f3: I can't believe you meddle in everything that I do.
5000415.c16_f4: What are you gonna do while I'm sleeping?
5000415.c17_s1: Is it really okay if I'm the only one getting some sleep?
5000415.c17_s2: Will I be able to see Orchid in my dreams?
5000415.c17_s3: I'm gonna sleep, not because you are making me, but because I want to.
5000415.c17_s4: Mhmm, why don't you get some sleep too?
5000415.c17_f2: I can't play any fun games when I'm sleeping.
5000415.c17_f3: I have no time for that.
5000415.c18_s1: Will I have sweet dreams tonight?
5000415.c18_s2: Humans need to take a break from time to time.
5000415.c18_s3: I will hang out with Orchid in my dreams!
5000415.c18_s4: I almost feel too lazy to sleep.
5000415.c18_f1: I got enough sleep when I was in the laboratory.
5000415.c19_s1: I learned to talk a long time ago.
5000415.c19_s2: This world is full of toys for me.
5000415.c19_s3: You are such a lonely person...
5000415.c19_f2: You don't even know how to fly. How dare you?
5000415.c20_s1: I kinda miss being a spirit.
5000415.c20_s2: Why do humans hate what I love?
5000415.c20_f2: Are you acting like this because I look human now?
5000415.c20_f3: Why don't you just keep... doing what you do?
5000415.c20_f4: I'm not really in the mood to talk.
5000415.c21_s1: We are twins, but I was born first.
5000415.c21_s3: My age? Hmm... not sure. I never actually kept track.
5000415.c21_s4: I have nothing to fear as long as I am with Orchid.
5000415.c21_f3: Why not hunt when you are bored?
5000415.f1_s: Eating is such a great pleasure.
5000415.f1_f: I don't want to eat anymore.
5000415.s4: I don't want to hear it.

5000416.c2_s1: My legs were hurting. Thank you so much!
5000416.c2_s3: Take a seat here, little toy.
5000416.c2_f2: I was in bed all day yesterday.
5000416.c2_f3: I must exercise to be stronger.
5000416.c2_f4: I want to take a walk in the grass.
5000416.c3_s1: I feel refreshed! How come I couldn't feel this when I was a spirit?
5000416.c3_s2: I want my legs to get better soon.
5000416.c3_s4: I wish Lotus was by my side.
5000416.c3_f1: Are you telling me to sit on the ground? I am a patient!
5000416.c3_f3: I know I'm ill, but that doesn't mean I will listen to a mere toy.
5000416.c3_f4: I prefer to sit in clean places.
5000416.c4_s2: I'm gonna get better soon so I can fly again!
5000416.c4_s4: Okay. I will sit down for you this time.
5000416.c4_f1: I will think about it if you sit.
5000416.c4_f2: I want to take a walk little more...
5000416.c4_f3: I need to stand still with this IV bottle in my hand.
5000416.c5_f1: You are weaker than my rabbit doll.
5000416.c5_f2: Why are you doing this to me?
5000416.c6_s3: How can you be so cruel to someone sick?
5000416.c6_f1: Little toy, you are a little odd today.
5000416.c6_f2: Are you feeling sick like me?
5000416.c7_s2: I wasn't really feeling good lately. Sorry!
5000416.c7_s3: I sincerely apologize if I offended you.
5000416.c7_f3: Do you want to fly away?
5000416.c7_f4: Don't tell me what to do!
5000416.c8_s1: I feel like my headache is getting worse.
5000416.c8_s2: Even Lotus doesn't do this to me.
5000416.c8_f3: It was just a tiny mistake.
5000416.c8_f4: I'm gonna go back if you keep being this way.
5000416.c9_s2: Ha ha, that makes me happy.
5000416.c9_f1: Sorry. I only like Lotus and rabbits.
5000416.c10_s1: Cough, only you care for me...
5000416.c10_s2: Then just give me a present!
5000416.c10_s3: I don't like you as much I like rabbits, but I do like you.
5000416.c10_f1: Do you have a fever? Come here...
5000416.c10_f3: People don't like it when you tease them so much.
5000416.c11_s4: Do you still like me like this?
5000416.c11_f2: How can I do that with a toy?
5000416.c11_f3: You are nothing but a lowly peon.
5000416.c11_f4: You don't have pointy ears like rabbits.
5000416.c12_s1: Tell me that ten times every day!
5000416.c12_s3: I feel like I will get better sometime soon!
5000416.c12_f2: This emotion is too difficult for me to handle.
5000416.c12_f4: That's nice... But you smell funny.
5000416.c13_s2: Urgh, so annoying. Okay, I'm on it!
5000416.c13_f1: You need to learn some common decency.
5000416.c13_f3: Please do that at the appropriate time and place.
5000416.c13_f4: You should not do that outside.
5000416.c14_s4: Ah... this feeling... I can feel that I'm getting better already..
5000416.c14_f1: I didn't really eat much because I wasn't feeling good.
5000416.c14_f3: Why do you make me do such things?
5000416.c15_s3: How did you know that I had to go?
5000416.c15_s4: It's so annoying to live in a human body.
5000416.c15_f3: I just went. Did you forget?
5000416.c15_f4: What does that mean? I've never heard that before.
5000416.c16_s1: You should get some sleep too. Come here!
5000416.c16_s2: It's not a bad idea to take some rest from time to time.
5000416.c16_s3: I wish I can see Lotus in my dreams.
5000416.c16_s4: I've been suffering from a headache. Night!
5000416.c16_f1: It's not time for bed yet.
5000416.c16_f2: I will think about it if you bring me a rabbit doll.
5000416.c16_f4: I was sleeping all day yesterday in the hospital.
5000416.c17_s1: I feel like I am going to have a great dream tonight!
5000416.c17_s4: I'm so tired. I was walking around with an IV bottle in my hand all day.
5000416.c17_f1: I don't fall asleep just anywhere.
5000416.c17_f2: Are you sleepy? Take a nap. I will keep a lookout for you.
5000416.c17_f3: I want to feel this refreshing breeze little bit more.
5000416.c17_f4: Are you going to bed already?
5000416.c18_s2: *YAWN* I wonder how Lotus is doing.
5000416.c18_s3: You should get some sleep too, little toy.
5000416.c18_s4: Come here, I will hug you like you are my rabbit doll.
5000416.c18_f1: What are you going to do when I fall asleep?
5000416.c18_f2: 4 hours of sleep is enough for a day!
5000416.c18_f3: I cannot fall asleep. Is this because of the medicine that I took?
5000416.c18_f4: Are you going to run away when I'm asleep?
5000416.c19_s1: I remember the first time I met him in Hallowed Forest.
5000416.c19_s2: I love the way I am now!
5000416.c19_s4: AH.. I want to get better so I can fly like before.
5000416.c19_f2: Thought I wouldn't notice you talking?
5000416.c19_f3: Stop speaking to me in such a commanding tone.
5000416.c19_f4: I will think about it if you get on your knees and beg me.
5000416.c20_s1: I want to wear my uniforms again.
5000416.c20_s2: It was great to be with Lotus...
5000416.c20_s3: It's so interesting to live in a human body.
5000416.c20_s4: Do you still have my rabbit hair pin?
5000416.c20_f1: No. I'm not going to do that.
5000416.c20_f3: I have no energy to talk.
5000416.c21_s2: I didn't know what it felt like to be sick when I was a spirit.
5000416.c21_s3: Don't tell anyone, okay? I'm actually really really strong.
5000416.c21_s4: Do you know Lotus, my other half?
5000416.c21_f3: Shhhhh! The rabbit is about to fall asleep!
5000416.f2_f: Overeating is never good for you.
5000416.f3_s: I feel like I am all recovered!
5000416.f3_f: It will only get worse if I gain more weight.
5000416.s2: What a horrible toy you are...
5000416.s3: Huh? Are you talking to me?

5000417.c1_s2: I will sit if you insist!
5000417.c1_f2: The great Gelimer does not sit!
5000417.c2_s1: I am an old man you know...
5000417.c2_s3: It feels nice to be outside of the lab sometimes.
5000417.c2_f2: I am way stronger than I look.
5000417.c2_f3: I'm not planning to sit down at all!
5000417.c2_f4: Why must I listen to you?
5000417.c3_s2: It was not easy... You should get some rest too!
5000417.c3_s3: Is it gonna rain? My joints are stiff and sore.
5000417.c3_s4: Can you hand me the cushion?
5000417.c3_f1: I am full of energy! What does it mean to be tired?
5000417.c3_f2: I will turn you into an Android if you don't stop giving me orders.
5000417.c3_f3: How can you sit on the ground? Not classy!
5000417.c4_s1: It's been so long since the last time I got some fresh air!
5000417.c4_s2: Fresh wind is blowing through my hair. My thinning hair...
5000417.c4_s3: You are a very nice young man!
5000417.c4_f1: I am not the type to work under someone.
5000417.c4_f2: I will think about it if you give me some theoretical evidence.
5000417.c4_f3: Just keep hunting! I still need more data!
5000417.c5_s2: I want to be whiny sometimes HAHA.
5000417.c5_f1: How dare you talk like that to elders!
5000417.c6_s1: This world is coming to an end.
5000417.c6_s3: It's strange... It definitely worked before...
5000417.c6_s4: You haven't heard of the saying 'failure is the mother of success?'
5000417.c6_f1: Let me see... Something's wrong with you for sure.
5000417.c6_f3: I am the best scientist in Maple World!
5000417.c7_s3: Haven't heard that for a while.
5000417.c7_f1: Do you wanna be my research subject?
5000417.c7_f2: I want to study what's inside of your head.
5000417.c7_f3: That's something I would say to my teddy bear.
5000417.c8_s1: I will let this one go. You are lucky that I have a big heart.
5000417.c8_s4: Sorry. I was just so curious.
5000417.c8_f1: Was that not enough of brainwashing?
5000417.c8_f2: You are not even worth studying.
5000417.c8_f4: Are you sure you don't have a headache or something?
5000417.c9_s2: It wasn't to make you happy!
5000417.c10_s2: I'm good at hearts. You will understand...
5000417.c10_s3: This is not the first time I've heard that.
5000417.c10_f1: I will take a look at the experiment data.
5000417.c10_f2: Can you prove this to me mathematically?
5000417.c10_f3: My heart does not react to that...
5000417.c10_f4: Where did my teddy bear go?
5000417.c11_s1: Would you like to be a subject for my experiment?
5000417.c11_s3: HAHA. I haven't heard that in a while.
5000417.c11_s4: You fell for me for sure!
5000417.c11_f2: I don't even know what you look like.
5000417.c11_f4: I don't trust something invisible. I am not that stupid.
5000417.c12_s2: Do you wanna grab a cup of tea sometime?
5000417.c12_s3: I am so skilled at flattering my boss.
5000417.c12_f2: Love is the easiest trick you can use to deceive another.
5000417.c12_f4: I am older than your grandpa.
5000417.c13_s1: This? It's my personal taste. Show some respect!
5000417.c13_s3: Excuse me. I am in a hurry.
5000417.c13_f2: My guts are not done digesting!
5000417.c13_f3: I am a very patient man.
5000417.c14_s1: You will be the one cleaning up, right?
5000417.c14_s2: Was the potion that I took yesterday expired?
5000417.c14_s3: This is so great, just like my intelligence!
5000417.c14_s4: Stop bothering me. I am concentrating!
5000417.c14_f2: I feel like someone is peeking.
5000417.c14_f4: Don't tell me what to do!
5000417.c15_s1: I am such a healthy scientist!
5000417.c15_s3: Ahem! Did you just hear that?
5000417.c15_s4: I was fine when I was a youngster.
5000417.c15_f1: I am very sophisticated, unlike you!
5000417.c15_f2: How can you say that while eating?
5000417.c15_f4: My brain burns all my calories.
5000417.c16_s3: Nothing is more important than a good night's sleep!
5000417.c16_s4: You should get some rest now. You have so much to study later.
5000417.c16_f1: 4 hours of sleep is enough for one day!
5000417.c16_f2: I can sleep with only one eye closed.
5000417.c16_f3: Why don't YOU get some sleep?
5000417.c17_s1: I shall see my teddy bear in my dreams tonight!
5000417.c17_s2: It's little uncomfortable here... Ah well.
5000417.c17_s3: Don't touch anything while I'm asleep!
5000417.c17_f2: I heard stupid humans are sleepyheads.
5000417.c17_f3: We've got enough sleep. This is statistically proven.
5000417.c17_f4: How dare you give me orders!
5000417.c18_s2: Even the genius needs some time off for his brain.
5000417.c18_s3: Don't pester me while I'm sleeping.
5000417.c18_s4: It's better to take some rest like this.
5000417.c18_f1: I have no time to rest!
5000417.c18_f2: I still need to conduct some experiments!
5000417.c19_s1: I am Gelimer, the one who created Black Heaven! HAHA.
5000417.c19_s3: You must sacrifice little things in life to succeed.
5000417.c19_s4: I'm the one who came up with the Evolution System, too!
5000417.c19_f1: Not everyone can hear my voice.
5000417.c19_f2: Can you handle 10-hour lectures on Gelimer's Theory?
5000417.c19_f3: I don't really enjoy talking to humans.
5000417.c20_s1: I am so close to perfecting my greatest creation!
5000417.c20_s2: Takes me 20 minutes each day to do my hair!
5000417.c20_s3: You don't think I am competent as a commander? NONSENSE!
5000417.c20_s4: Everyone I met fell for me because of my beautiful eyes.
5000417.c20_f2: Do you not have anyone else to talk to?
5000417.c20_f3: You are such a lonely subject. Should I make a human clone just for you?
5000417.c20_f4: Keep it down. I can't concentrate!
5000417.c21_s1: What would be the first thing you would do if the world ends now?
5000417.c21_s2: You will be surprised when you learn the secret of my teddy bear.
5000417.c21_s3: I want to press all the red buttons in the world! Are you like that too?
5000417.c21_s4: Arkarium? I'm way smarter than that fool.
5000417.c21_f1: I don't want to deal with you.
5000417.c21_f2: Why not hunt when you are bored?
5000417.c21_f3: Why don't you become friends with a doll if you are lonely?
5000417.f1_s: This is the taste of proper molecule arrangement!
5000417.f1_f: Is this the flavor of motor oil?
5000417.f2_f: Cut it now! I'm not a glutton!
5000417.f3_s: i didn't know I could be this happy by just eating!
5000417.f4_s: I needed some sugar in my system!
5000417.s1: Where did I put my taser?
5000417.s2: I heard humans starts cussing when they have nothing else to say.
5000417.s3: You have not taken any speech classes, have you?
5000417.s4: STOP! Or else I will have you stuffed like a stuffed animal!

5000428.c2_s3: I'm sitting down. Aren't I good?
5000428.c2_f2: But I want to play more...
5000428.c2_f3: I have to sit on this bare ground?
5000428.c3_s1: Yes, a rest would be nice.
5000428.c3_s2: Fine, but I won't always be this easy!
5000428.c3_s4: Whoof, I do need some downtime.
5000428.c3_f3: But I want to play more!
5000428.c4_s2: A nice, leisurely rest would be nice!
5000428.c6_s4: Y-you're not really angry with me, are you?
5000428.c6_f4: I don't understand why you're mad.
5000428.c7_f2: No. I don't wanna be in trouble.
5000428.c8_s2: Stop yelling! Let's just talk this out.
5000428.c8_f2: I'm just gonna head to bed, then.
5000428.c8_f4: What did I do wrong this time?
5000428.c11_s3: This is not simulated? This is real!
5000428.c11_s4: Absolutely! I totally feel the same way.
5000428.c11_f3: I'll pretend you didn't just say that.
5000428.c14_s3: I'm givin' it all I've got!
5000428.c14_f2: I don't need to go. Like, at all.
5000428.c14_f3: No, this is not right! Not right at all!
5000428.c15_s2: My face is all red now!
5000428.c15_f1: I am trying my best... but...
5000428.c15_f3: Why are you laughing at me?
5000428.c16_s1: I was getting a little frazzled...
5000428.c16_f2: I'm not sleepy at all! IN YO FACE!
5000428.c16_f3: But I want to play more!
5000428.c16_f4: Look, the sun is still up!
5000428.c17_s2: Yeah okay, give me a moment to reboot...
5000428.c17_s4: I'm gonna dream of being a real yeti...
5000428.c17_f2: No, I don't need to recharge yet!
5000428.c18_s4: I'll charge up for our next hunt.
5000428.c19_s4: I'd like to relax on the Relaxer.
5000428.c19_f1: I don't know anything about that.
5000428.c20_s1: When are we gonna see Horntail?
5000428.c20_s2: I want to play some games!
5000428.c20_s3: Have you tasted the snow in El Nath?
5000428.c20_s4: Aren't you sick of that hair?
5000428.c20_f2: W-why do you keep talking to me?
5000428.c20_f4: Nope! Just because you said it, I won't!
5000428.c21_s1: I have so many things to learn about life.
5000428.c21_s3: I... I just wanted to fly.
5000428.c21_s4: I want to see El Nath sometime.
5000428.c21_f1: I want to be quiet sometimes.
5000428.f1_s: This is as good as it gets!
5000428.f2_s: That's great to hear. OM NOM NOM!
5000428.s3: Why do you ask me to say all those strange things?

5000429.c3_f2: Don't we still have a long way to go?
5000429.c3_f3: I don't want to rest right now...
5000429.c4_s2: Am I sitting down, or laying down?
5000429.c4_s3: It's the perfect time to rest!
5000429.c4_f1: I don't like being ordered around!
5000429.c4_f2: We can't rest like this every day!
5000429.c4_f4: Are you hurt? Why do you keep wanting to rest?
5000429.c6_f2: Don't talk to me like that!
5000429.c6_f4: I said, don't order me around!
5000429.c8_s2: Sorry... I won't do it again...
5000429.c8_f1: Hmph! I told you to treat me nicely!
5000429.c8_f2: I'm going back to the north pole!
5000429.c8_f3: I'm going to tell on you!
5000429.c11_s2: I like you better than the north pole.
5000429.c11_s4: I'm so lucky to have a master like you!
5000429.c12_s1: I love hanging out with you.
5000429.c12_f2: Did you eat some bad fish?
5000429.c12_f3: I'm a Harp Seal, and you are a human!
5000429.c13_f3: You should be ashamed of yourself!
5000429.c14_f1: Tell me that AFTER you feed me!
5000429.c14_f2: You can't order me to do everything!
5000429.c15_s1: Every day is a healthy day!
5000429.c15_s3: Make sure no one's looking, okay?
5000429.c15_f4: This is shameful! You'll be hearing from my Harp Lawyers!
5000429.c16_f1: But I want to play more!
5000429.c16_f2: Look, the sun is still up!
5000429.c16_f3: Still a long way to go!
5000429.c16_f4: I don't think it's time to sleep yet.
5000429.c17_f1: You are a sleepyhead, aren't you, master?
5000429.c17_f2: I don't want to sleep yet.
5000429.c17_f3: I'll sleep when I get sleepy, okies?
5000429.c18_s3: Good seals are early to bed, early to rise.
5000429.c18_f2: I guess not all your ideas are good...
5000429.c18_f3: Why do you always tell me to sleep?
5000429.c18_f4: Is this going to make us closer?
5000429.c19_s1: Well you know, at the north pole...
5000429.c19_s2: I saw this weird animal in the forest...
5000429.c19_s3: What's the difference between real and fake seals?
5000429.c19_s4: I love it here because there aren't any polar bears.
5000429.c20_s1: I wish I had some snow to lie on.
5000429.c20_s2: I'm all white so I can hide from polar bears in the snow!
5000429.c20_s3: Will you protect me from polar bears, master?
5000429.c20_s4: I'm sure glad for nice people like you, master.
5000429.c21_s1: Pigs sure are weird! Why do their bottoms curl up like that?
5000429.c21_s2: Isn't it hard walking on two legs, master?
5000429.c21_s3: Where are we going today? Anywhere's fine with me!
5000429.c21_f4: I don't feel like it... too much work...
5000429.c22_s2: I love you, you love me!
5000429.c22_f4: You show me something first, master!
5000429.c23_s1: Itsy bitsy seals and penguins, dancing at north pole!
5000429.c23_s3: Three seals in a house, daddy seal, mommy seal, and baby seal!
5000429.f3_s: You sure take good care of me, master!

5000433.c2_s3: I want to sit... But I need exercise!
5000433.c2_f2: I don't think I heard you...
5000433.c2_f3: This place is filthy... I can't be here...
5000433.c3_s1: With legs as short as mine, it doesn't matter!
5000433.c3_s2: Do you know what it's like to sit on a cloud?
5000433.c3_s3: I'm... already sitting. Can't you tell?
5000433.c3_s4: Whew. I guess I am a little tired.
5000433.c4_s1: Ugh, you can see my belly when I sit...
5000433.c4_s4: I guess I could do that... THIS time.
5000433.c4_f3: We don't have time for this!
5000433.c5_s1: I don't want to be punished.
5000433.c10_s1: Now that you mention it, I love you too!
5000433.c11_s1: Well, um... I kinda love you too!
5000433.c11_s4: Hee hee... You're making me blush!
5000433.c11_f4: Do you mean it? Are you sure?
5000433.c12_f3: Do you treat all your pets like this?
5000433.c14_f1: Don't you think you're going too far?
5000433.c15_f4: I can't, okay? I just can't! Leave me alone!
5000433.c17_f3: I don't even have a blanket...
5000433.c18_s3: I miss the thrill of battle...
5000433.c18_f2: No! I want to play more!
5000433.c18_f3: No! I have lots of energy!
5000433.c19_s1: I just love to play the harp!
5000433.c19_s2: I want to journey with you!
5000433.c19_f4: I'd like to be alone now.
5000433.c20_s1: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5000433.c20_s2: My brain is just so full of... stuff!
5000433.c20_s4: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000433.c20_f3: But I don't have anything to say...
5000433.c21_s1: If you could sing me to sleep...
5000433.c21_s2: I've got a good feeling about today!
5000433.c21_s3: I'm just happy to be with you.
5000433.c21_s4: Did you do your good deed for the day?
5000433.c21_f4: Are there more angels like me?

5000434.c3_s4: I was tired from all that walking.
5000434.c3_f4: Don't tell me what to do.
5000434.c4_s2: I was going to take a break anyway.
5000434.c5_s2: Who do you think you are?
5000434.c7_s2: But look at how cute I am!
5000434.c7_f1: Take a look in the mirror, buddy.
5000434.c7_f2: What are you blaming ME for?
5000434.c12_s4: How could you not? I'm adorable!
5000434.c14_f4: Don't tell me what to do!
5000434.c15_s2: That could go in a museum!
5000434.c15_s4: I kind of want to touch it.
5000434.c16_f4: You sleep. I'm gonna keep working hard.
5000434.c17_s4: Okay, but only because I want to.
5000434.c17_f1: I was just about to, until you said that.
5000434.c17_f4: I'm going to tape my eyes open.
5000434.c19_s2: Some days, I just look at the world and smile.
5000434.c19_s3: My weakness is my ears, but don't tell!
5000434.c19_f4: What do you want me to say?
5000434.c20_s1: One day, I'm gonna beat Zakum in a boxing match!
5000434.c20_s2: Feed me lots of protein so I can beef up!
5000434.c20_s3: Takes me 20 minutes each day to do my hair!
5000434.c20_f4: Don't tell me what to do!
5000434.c21_s4: You think you can take me? Let's try!
5000434.c21_f4: Let's just have a moment of silence, okay?
5000434.s2: This is abuse! I'll have you locked up!
5000434.s4: You kiss your mama with that mouth?

5000435.c2_s2: I'm fully aware that I have short legs...
5000435.c2_s3: Ahh, nice. Maybe it's time for a nap.

5000435.c2_f3: I just don't want to do it anymore...

5000435.c3_s3: With legs as short as mine, it doesn't matter!

5000435.c3_f3: I think I heard talking... let's check!
5000435.c3_f4: Sitting makes my butt look big!

5000435.c6_s1: I guess I should stay quiet.

5000435.c11_s3: Well, um... I kinda love you too!
5000435.c11_f3: That was a good one... ha ha...
5000435.c12_f2: Ha ha ha... What can I say?
5000435.c12_f3: I already know how you feel...
5000435.c14_s3: I-I'm just a little bit shy...
5000435.c14_f4: Not here! I'll die of shame!

5000435.c15_f2: I'll let you off for today...
5000435.c17_s1: Sorry, but I can't keep my eyes open...
5000435.c17_f2: I don't even have a blanket...
5000435.c18_f1: I don't want to go to bed...
5000435.c19_s3: I want to tell you about so many things...
5000435.c19_f1: I want something fancy to eat! Octopus balls!
5000435.c19_f4: I don't want to talk about it.
5000435.c20_s2: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000435.c20_s3: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5000435.c20_s4: My brain is just so full of... stuff!
5000435.c20_f1: I'm going to bed. I'm full, I said...
5000435.c20_f2: There's nothing for me to say...
5000435.c21_s1: Yetis and Pepes have such a nice friendship...
5000435.c21_s2: Everything will be fine as long as you feed me.
5000435.s1: I'll remember this! You watch out!
5000435.s2: Even I know not to cross some lines.

5000437.c2_s1: I'll take my sweet time, thanks.
5000437.c2_s4: I did a great job, right?
5000437.c2_f2: I don't want to just sit on the floor.
5000437.c2_f3: I don't know how, hee hee.
5000437.c2_f4: I don't want to! No reason, I just don't want to!
5000437.c3_s1: Sometimes, resting is good for your skin.
5000437.c3_s2: I'm sitting. But now I want to lie down.
5000437.c3_s4: I'm not sitting because you told me to!
5000437.c3_f1: I don't want to get scolded. But still, no.
5000437.c4_s2: Sitting is also a good workout sometimes!
5000437.c4_s3: Like this? Aren't I so cute, master?
5000437.c4_s4: I wouldn't want to wear myself out...
5000437.c4_f3: I'm not listening to anyone... Rawr...
5000437.c5_f1: You better stop or we'll get back at you!
5000437.c5_f2: You better stop! We outnumber you!
5000437.c6_s3: Hearing that from you hurts my feelings.
5000437.c6_s4: They say being angry is bad for your health...
5000437.c6_f4: Are you really going to keep doing this?
5000437.c7_s3: You're so scary when you're angry...
5000437.c7_s4: Argh! Don't hit me! It hurts!
5000437.c7_f4: You're not a friend! You're a bully!
5000437.c8_s1: How can you be so angry with me?
5000437.c8_s3: Wah! I won't do it again!
5000437.c8_f1: I'm going to tell on you!
5000437.c8_f2: I'm gonna call animal protective services!
5000437.c8_f3: You just keep punishing me! How about feeding me?
5000437.c9_s1: I'll show you what I can do! Prepare... for the charm!
5000437.c9_f2: Did you think it would be that easy?
5000437.c10_s2: You know what I'm gonna say!
5000437.c10_f1: You're not talking to me, right? I am a dog. Yip!
5000437.c10_f4: Why don't you feed me before you say that?
5000437.c12_s3: I'm so happy I met you!
5000437.c12_s4: Master, you finally see my worth!
5000437.c12_f4: I'm very busy right now. Can we talk about this later?
5000437.c13_s1: Got any paper? I'm all out.
5000437.c13_s2: Ah! Shh, someone will hear you!
5000437.c13_s4: I didn't think I could do that.
5000437.c13_f4: I'm shocked, I don't even have the words.
5000437.c14_s1: I don't know why you want that, but you got it!
5000437.c14_s2: Look the other way! It's embarrassing!
5000437.c14_f1: I... don't think I can do that.
5000437.c14_f2: I will poop only in a bathroom!
5000437.c14_f4: Hey, I do have SOME shame!
5000437.c15_s1: Why is poop called poop? Poooooooop!
5000437.c15_s2: I should poop quickly and then go eat!
5000437.c15_s3: Look at my poop, SO CUTE!
5000437.c15_s4: No one's watching, right? Keep a look out.
5000437.c15_f3: You want to see me push?
5000437.c16_s3: Okay, maybe just a little... zzz...
5000437.c17_s2: I hope I dream of ramen.
5000437.c17_s4: I only sleep on a full belly.
5000437.c17_f1: So you can doodle on me? No thanks!
5000437.c18_s1: You should rest, too. You can cuddle with me!
5000437.c18_s2: Wake me up if anything interesting happens.
5000437.c18_s3: Aww, you know pretty pets need to sleep a lot, right?
5000437.c18_s4: I'm already jungling in my dreams.
5000437.c18_f1: Play with me! Don't just put me to bed!
5000437.c18_f2: Would you like a glass of cool juice instead?
5000437.c18_f4: We have much to do. There is no time for sleeping!
5000437.c19_s1: I'm just too good looking... So torublesome.
5000437.c19_s3: Don't you think I'm just adorrrrrrable?
5000437.c19_s4: I've heard that Crimson Balrogs found on boats are ugly. Is is true?
5000437.c19_f1: What you want me to say? Annoying...
5000437.c19_f3: Stop talking to me when I'm eating.
5000437.c19_f4: No, I want to do something FUN!
5000437.c20_s1: What about the tasty oranges? ORANGES!
5000437.c20_s2: At least we have each other!
5000437.c20_s3: Sometimes I really just need to peel!
5000437.c20_s4: Oranges are the best, especially in winter!
5000437.c20_f1: ...I really don't have much to say.
5000437.c20_f2: Let's just go to bed... Zzz.
5000437.c20_f4: I think I'm a little hungry.
5000437.c21_s1: Ha! Your belly is bigger than mine.
5000437.c21_s2: I'm cute, pretty, and even know how to talk!
5000437.c21_s3: You and I are always on the same page.
5000437.c21_f2: Talking to your pets makes you look like a crazy person!
5000437.c21_f3: If I speak, you'll say I'm too noisy, won't you?
5000437.f1_f: I think it's the time for me to go on a diet...
5000437.f4_f: I gain weight just by drinking water. Sigh...
5000437.s3: I'm not going to say any bad words!

5000443.c2_s1: Everyone will want to come and talk to me if I sit.
5000443.c2_f1: I don't know how, hee hee.
5000443.c2_f2: I don't want to sit. Sitting makes me look shorter.
5000443.c2_f3: I can't hear you, can you speak up?
5000443.c2_f4: I don't even want to listen...
5000443.c3_s2: I'm getting hungry just sitting around.
5000443.c3_s3: I lost some weight! That makes sitting easier!
5000443.c3_s4: Sometimes, resting is good for your skin.
5000443.c3_f1: Can I lay down? I'm tired.
5000443.c4_s1: Like this? Aren't I so cute, master?
5000443.c4_s2: Hey, you trying to get a better look at me?
5000443.c4_f2: But my butt will get dirty!
5000443.c4_f3: I don't wanna sit. I wanna sleep.
5000443.c5_f1: Why am I being scolded this time?
5000443.c6_s1: I didn't think it would make you angry...
5000443.c6_f3: You're scolding me for eating too much, aren't you?
5000443.c6_f4: Why are you doing this to me?
5000443.c7_f1: Why take it out on me?

5000444.c13_f3: I only do that for ME!

5000444.c14_s4: Okay, so... I can't reach back to wipe...

5000444.c14_f2: I... don't think I can do that.
5000444.c14_f3: That's embarrassing! I should poop in secret.
5000444.c15_f1: I'm sure I didn't just hear you right.
5000444.c15_f2: I need to eat something first!
5000444.c15_f3: You go first. Then I'll think about it.
5000444.c16_s2: Okay, maybe just a little... zzz...
5000444.c16_f1: Nnnno, you've got a look I don't trust.
5000444.c16_f3: I only sleep on a full belly.
5000444.c16_f4: I'm too hungry to fall asleep...

5000444.c18_f3: Look at your belly! You should hit the gym!
5000444.c18_f4: Sleep? That's what you do at night!

5000444.c19_s4: I wish I could cast spells like this.
5000444.c19_f4: What you want me to say? Annoying...

5000444.c20_s3: Kitties are still cute if they eat a lot... right?

5000444.c20_f3: Do you think I have something to say?

5000444.c21_s1: Do you know what Water of Life tastes like? Is it delicious?
5000444.c21_s2: Ha! Your belly is bigger than mine.
5000444.c21_s3: I'm cute, pretty, and even know how to talk!
5000444.c21_s4: Am I cuter as a kitty?
5000444.c21_f3: I got nothing to say, and don't wanna talk...
5000444.c21_f4: If I speak, you'll say I'm too noisy, won't you?
5000444.f1_f: Huh? What if I get fat?

5000445.c8_s2: I'm sorry! I won't do it again.

5000445.c8_f2: How can you get so mad?
5000445.c9_s2: You're the only one for me!
5000445.c11_s2: So sweet, I don't even know!
5000445.c11_s3: I love you! I love you!
5000445.c11_f2: La la la... I don't care!
5000445.c12_f1: That's nice... But you smell funny.

5000452.c12_f4: You can't possibly think I have a good impression of you, can you?
5000452.c14_f4: Stop it, stop it, stop it!
5000452.c15_s2: Boing boing! Hee hee, keep up!
5000452.c16_s1: Keep the nightlight on! I'm scared of the dark.
5000452.c17_s4: I wanna sleep next to you! Zzz...
5000452.c17_f2: Let's play a little longer... Pwwease?
5000452.c18_s1: Nighty night, master! I lov...vee...ee... Zzzz.
5000452.c18_s3: Can you tuck in my blankie if I accidentally kick it off?
5000452.c18_f1: No time for sleep! Must xercise! Get strong!
5000452.c19_s3: What do you want to hear? Piinkaaa?
5000452.c19_s4: Why am I called a bean? I look more like a mouse.
5000452.c19_f2: I can't stay balanced and talk at the same time.
5000452.c20_s1: My dream is to be a DJ.
5000452.c20_s2: I like beef! Pork's okay, too.
5000452.c20_s3: I have many interests. Like knitting.
5000452.c20_s4: I like talkies with you! You funny!
5000452.c21_s1: I was born with big eyes. Sparkly!
5000452.c21_s3: Am I fat? Be honest. I take it.
5000452.c21_s4: I'm endangered. Take care of me!
5000452.c22_s1: Boing! I do lots of things!
5000452.c22_s4: I know how to rock, too!
5000452.c22_f3: Can't hear you, can't hear you!
5000452.c23_s1: I am a guitar master! Wahnananana!
5000452.c23_s2: Look at me! LOOK AT MEEEEEE!
5000452.c23_s4: Gonna be rock star! Have a world tour!
5000452.c23_f2: I have no idea what you're talking about.
5000452.c23_f4: No tricks. I am a quiet and gentle pet.
5000452.f2_f: Buh? What if I get fat?
5000452.f4_f: Waahh! I don't want it! I don't!
5000452.s2: Buh?! I'll remember this! You watch out!

5000459.c2_s4: I will listen because I love you.
5000459.c2_f1: Don't tell meow what to do.
5000459.c3_s3: I will do whatever you say.
5000459.c3_f3: Is that all you can do? Meow.
5000459.c4_s1: Say it and I will do it.
5000459.c4_s4: I practiced every day, just for you!
5000459.c4_f4: I don't feel good. Don't touch me!
5000459.c6_s2: You are all that meow has.
5000459.c6_s3: I will never do wrong again.
5000459.c6_s4: Stop with the scary face! Meow.
5000459.c6_f2: You're projecting your anger on meow?
5000459.c6_f3: You look funny! I'm not scared of you at all!
5000459.c6_f4: Who are you to tell meow what to do?
5000459.c7_s2: How many apology sculptures must I make?
5000459.c7_f1: My ears are made of stone. I hear nothing.
5000459.c7_f3: I thought you were finished hitting me.
5000459.c7_f4: Is that what you think of meow?
5000459.c8_s2: I am just trying to please you, master.
5000459.c8_s3: Please forgive meow, just this once.
5000459.c8_s4: If you stop being mad, I will give you 100 kisses!
5000459.c8_f2: You purified meow heart, please purify yours.
5000459.c8_f4: Fine, I will just smash you in your sleep...
5000459.c10_s1: Meow heart aches to hear you say that...
5000459.c10_s2: Really? Is that how you feel? Meow.
5000459.c10_s3: I don't like what you're saying... Meow.
5000459.c10_f2: You're using such harsh words! Meow!
5000459.c10_f3: I'm so mad, I'm going to faint. Meow.
5000459.c11_s2: Don't hate me for being pretty. Meow.
5000459.c11_s4: When I look into your eyes, I see you're joking. Meow!
5000459.c11_f1: Takes one to know one! Meow.
5000459.c11_f3: I'm not in the mood for jokes! Meow.
5000459.c12_s1: Your words are full of pain. Meow.
5000459.c12_s2: Will you take back what you said if I act nice? Meow.
5000459.c12_s3: Mew! Mew! I'll be sad if you hate me.
5000459.c12_s4: Meow! I will be your friend, no matter what.
5000459.c12_f1: You are the one who is that word you said. Meow.
5000459.c12_f2: Clearly I'm smart! You are wrong. Meow.
5000459.c12_f3: I don't like your arrogant attitude. Meow!
5000459.c12_f4: I'm busy, so I'll ignore you! Meow!
5000459.c14_s3: I clean up after myself. I'm so squeaky clean! Meow.
5000459.c14_s4: Please turn your head, and plug your nose. Meow.
5000459.c14_f3: Where I come from, one does not just go anywhere. Meow!
5000459.c14_f4: How many times a day do you want me to go? Meow.
5000459.c15_s2: Look at it! I sculpted it to look like you. Meow.
5000459.c15_s4: My poo is in abundance... Like your love. Meow.
5000459.c15_f1: My roots must feed first. Meow!
5000459.c15_f2: I do not understand your poop obsession. Meow.
5000459.c15_f3: You cannot force the mountain to move. Meow.
5000459.c15_f4: You told me only to do that on your neighbor's yard. Meow.
5000459.c16_s1: Please turn your head, and plug your nose. Meow.
5000459.c16_s3: It looks just like you. Meow.
5000459.c16_s4: Let's go give this to the neighbor's puppy. Meow.
5000459.c16_f1: I must be fed to create waste. Meow.
5000459.c16_f2: Do not project your own needs on me. Meow!
5000459.c16_f3: I am not sure why you believe I should do that. Meow.
5000459.c16_f4: Only if I can go on your head. Meow.
5000459.c17_s1: You are so awesome today master! I think you must love meow.
5000459.c17_s3: I hear a scary dragon lives nearby... Shall I pay it a visit?
5000459.c17_s4: Nothing beats good food and a cuddle. Meow.
5000459.c17_f1: Why is the sky so blue, then? Meow.
5000459.c17_f2: I don't feel like it. Meow.
5000459.c17_f3: I was not created to talk...
5000459.c18_s1: Niki in the Night Market is so creepy. Meow.
5000459.c18_s2: Meow, you talking with other pets makes me jealous!
5000459.c18_s3: Why do Crimson Balrogs appear on ships? Meow.
5000459.c18_s4: I will eat whatever you feed meow... because it's from you!
5000459.c18_f3: W-why do you keep talking to meow?
5000459.c18_f4: Nope! Just because you said it, I won't!
5000459.c19_s1: Henesys's elder always gets so angry! Mew!
5000459.c19_s3: Meow, I'm so co-o-old.  Hold me tightly.
5000459.c19_s4: I am the only talking cat.
5000459.c19_f2: Are you bored? Go study. Meow.
5000459.c19_f3: I can't hear you! I hear nothing!
5000459.c19_f4: Are you poking fun at meow talking?!
5000459.c20_f3: I will do what you hate.
5000459.c21_s2: Mew! I'm shooting lasers of love.
5000459.c21_s3: Am I cute? Am I? Meow.
5000459.c21_f2: Tell rabbit next door to do cute things. Meow!
5000459.c21_f4: You can't make me do it. Meow.
5000459.c22_s1: How did you know I'm cute?
5000459.c22_f2: You can't make meow do it!
5000459.c23_s2: I will feel the power in my legs once more.
5000459.c23_f1: I can't stand on two feet!
5000459.c24_s3: I practiced every day for this moment!
5000459.c24_f1: I fell and can't get up!
5000459.c26_s1: I will admit to some feelings of adoration.
5000459.c26_f3: Things move slower where I'm come from.
5000459.c26_f4: You and meow are not meant to be!
5000459.c27_s3: Mew! My tail is happy too.
5000459.c28_s1: I was going to say so first.
5000459.c28_f3: I love the rabbit next door.
5000459.f3_s: Is this going to give me love handles?
5000459.f4_s: Prrr... Your specials are the best specials out there!
5000459.s2: Why must meow say such ridiculous things?

5000460.c3_f2: Don't we still have a long way to go?
5000460.c3_f3: I don't want to rest right now...
5000460.c4_s2: Am I sitting down, or laying down?
5000460.c4_s3: It's the perfect time to rest!
5000460.c4_f1: I don't like being ordered around!
5000460.c4_f2: We can't rest like this every day!
5000460.c4_f4: Are you hurt? Why do you keep wanting to rest?
5000460.c6_f2: Don't talk to me like that!
5000460.c6_f4: I said, don't order me around!
5000460.c8_s2: Sorry... I won't do it again...
5000460.c8_f1: Hmph! I told you to treat me nicely!
5000460.c8_f2: I'm going back to the north pole!
5000460.c8_f3: I'm going to tell on you!
5000460.c11_s2: I like you better than the north pole.
5000460.c11_s4: I'm so lucky to have a master like you!
5000460.c12_s1: I love hanging out with you.
5000460.c12_f2: Did you eat some bad fish?
5000460.c12_f3: I'm a Harp Seal, and you are a human!
5000460.c13_f3: You should be ashamed of yourself!
5000460.c14_f1: Tell me that AFTER you feed me!
5000460.c14_f2: You can't order me to do everything!
5000460.c15_s1: Every day is a healthy day!
5000460.c15_s3: Make sure no one's looking, okay?
5000460.c15_f4: This is shameful! You'll be hearing from my Harp Lawyers!
5000460.c16_f1: But I want to play more!
5000460.c16_f2: Look, the sun is still up!
5000460.c16_f3: Still a long way to go!
5000460.c16_f4: I don't think it's time to sleep yet.
5000460.c17_f1: You are a sleepyhead, aren't you, master?
5000460.c17_f2: I don't want to sleep yet.
5000460.c17_f3: I'll sleep when I get sleepy, okies?
5000460.c18_s3: Good seals are early to bed, early to rise.
5000460.c18_f2: I guess not all your ideas are good...
5000460.c18_f3: Why do you always tell me to sleep?
5000460.c18_f4: Is this going to make us closer?
5000460.c19_s1: Well you know, at the north pole...
5000460.c19_s2: I saw this weird animal in the forest...
5000460.c19_s3: What's the difference between real and fake seals?
5000460.c19_s4: I love it here because there aren't any polar bears.
5000460.c20_s1: I wish I had some snow to lie on.
5000460.c20_s2: I'm all white so I can hide from polar bears in the snow!
5000460.c20_s3: Will you protect me from polar bears, master?
5000460.c20_s4: I'm sure glad for nice people like you, master.
5000460.c21_s1: Pigs sure are weird! Why do their bottoms curl up like that?
5000460.c21_s2: Isn't it hard walking on two legs, master?
5000460.c21_s3: Where are we going today? Anywhere's fine with me!
5000460.c21_f4: I don't feel like it... too much work...
5000460.c22_s2: I love you, you love me!
5000460.c22_f4: You show me something first, master!
5000460.c23_s1: Itsy bitsy seals and penguins, dancing at north pole!
5000460.c23_s3: Three seals in a house, daddy seal, mommy seal, and baby seal!
5000460.f3_s: You sure take good care of me, master!
5000460.f4_f: Don't you think I've gotten a little fat?
5000460.s2: What goes around, comes around, you know?
5000460.s3: I don't want to be a pottymouth!
5000460.s4: Words reflect your insides, you know?

5000466.c3_s2: Why don't we sit together, master?
5000466.c3_s4: I'm so nice, obeying your every whim.
5000466.c3_f1: I don't just sit on the street.
5000466.c3_f2: What's that? Is that something I can eat?
5000466.c4_s3: How does Ducky look right now?
5000466.c4_f1: Hey, don't you order me around.
5000466.c4_f3: Uh, where's my cushion? I won't sit without it!
5000466.c4_f4: Ducky don't want to do it right now.
5000466.c6_s4: Ducky is very scared of you now.
5000466.c6_f3: Is Ducky being yelled at right now?
5000466.c6_f4: Ducky don't understand why you're mad.
5000466.c7_s1: Ducky's scared when you get mad.
5000466.c7_s2: It hurt Ducky's feelings when you're being mean.
5000466.c7_s3: Ducky won't do that EVER again.
5000466.c8_s2: Ducky won't do it again. Give me a chance.
5000466.c8_s3: Can't you see my tears? Please, have a heart...
5000466.c8_f1: If you keep punishing Ducky, Ducky will turn BAD!
5000466.c8_f2: You're strange. You keep punishing Ducky without feeding Ducky!
5000466.c8_f3: Ducky will call the police if you keep harassing Ducky! QUACK!
5000466.c8_f4: You do that one more time, you'll never see me again.
5000466.c10_s1: I'm so happy. Say it again, please?
5000466.c10_f2: Quack... Put more emotion into it next time.
5000466.c10_f3: Sorry but I'm taken. Find another duck.
5000466.c10_f4: Master, I'm serious. Snap out of it.
5000466.c11_s2: Love... Is this feeling love? I think I'm falling for you, master.
5000466.c11_s3: This little duck loves you too!
5000466.c11_f2: Quack!! Your words are not very convincing.
5000466.c12_s1: I'm so happy you're my master, quack!
5000466.c12_s3: Tell me that ten times every day!
5000466.c12_s4: I hope you never, ever change!
5000466.c12_f1: It's not you, it's me... I'm a duck, quack. Give up.
5000466.c12_f2: Do you even know what love means?
5000466.c12_f3: Meh... I'm not feeling it... Quack...
5000466.c12_f4: I love you like family, too!
5000466.c14_s2: I think I'm going to have a wonderful dream tonight, quack!
5000466.c14_s3: You can sleep right next to me, quack!
5000466.c14_s4: How did you know ducky was sleepy?
5000466.c14_f1: It's much too early for that! Quack!
5000466.c14_f3: You want me to sleep all day long? Quack!
5000466.c15_s1: I'm already falling into sleep. Quack...
5000466.c15_s3: I'm going to take a short nap.
5000466.c15_f2: You are telling me to sleep at a place like this. Master, you are mean!
5000466.c15_f3: Are you planning a party for after I fall asleep?
5000466.c15_f4: It's no time for sleeping, you must level up!
5000466.c16_s1: My snuggly pillow is making me... fall.. asleep...
5000466.c16_s2: Stand by me while I sleep, please?
5000466.c16_s3: Lately, the more I sleep, the sleepier I get...
5000466.c16_s4: I just wanna sleep all day long!
5000466.c16_f1: Why are you forcing me to sleep? It's creepy...
5000466.c16_f2: Are you plotting to abandon me when I fall asleep?! I won't fall for that!
5000466.c16_f3: I will sleep when I sleep. Bug off!
5000466.c16_f4: No, no... I won't let you get something yummy while I fall asleep! Never!
5000466.c17_s2: I am talented at talking, I know.
5000466.c17_s4: Nice weather out. How about taking me for a stroll along the Strolling Path?
5000466.c17_f3: Have you not seen a talking duck before?
5000466.c17_f4: I don't want to talk right now.
5000466.c18_s1: What do you think about this red muffler? I'm a fashionista!
5000466.c18_s2: I just wanna talk with you all day long!
5000466.c18_s3: Anything you wanna hear from me?
5000466.c18_f1: Don't wanna talk. Why don't you talk?
5000466.c18_f2: You don't have any friends, do you?
5000466.c18_f4: I am enjoying my solitude right now.
5000466.c19_s1: Scuba Pepe and I are nothing. It's not what you think. Quack!
5000466.c19_s2: This is a secret, but I can transform...
5000466.c19_s3: I love spending time with you, master.
5000466.c19_s4: Once upon a time there was a duck named Ducky...
5000466.c19_f2: I talked too much today. Let's talk again tomorrow.
5000466.c19_f3: Are ya bored, master? Go hunt more!
5000466.c20_s1: This is the dance that'll make you move!
5000466.c20_s2: Everybody! Dance, with, me. Oh yeah.
5000466.c20_s3: Shake it, shake, shake it. Boom boom boom.
5000466.c20_f1: Dance? I need some music, please!
5000466.c20_f2: Why don't you give it a try first? Quack!
5000466.c21_s2: I dance til the end of night! Quack, quack, quack!
5000466.c21_s3: Compliment me, and I shall dance more!
5000466.c21_s4: Look at these crazy moves I'm doing!
5000466.c21_f1: My dancing is so good you might fall in love with me!
5000466.c21_f2: You're gonna make fun of me, aren't you?!
5000466.c21_f4: Dancing is not my thing. Nope. Nada.
5000466.c22_f1: That doesn't just happen out of nowhere!

5000473.c10_f4: How can a person as weak as you...

5000473.c11_s3: You make my heart go pitter-patter.
5000473.c11_s4: I didn't know you liked me that much...
5000473.c11_f2: I am already suffering... You don't have to make me suffer even more...
5000473.c12_f2: Honestly, you are not my type.
5000473.c12_f4: Not bad, but not good either.

5000473.c13_f4: I was taught to do that by myself.

5000473.c14_f4: You are such a dirty toy.

5000473.c19_f2: You don't even know how to fly. How dare you?

5000473.c20_f3: Why don't you just keep... doing what you do?
5000473.c20_f4: I'm not really in the mood to talk.

5000473.f4_f: It's not good to stuff yourself.

5000762.c3_s1: Ah, it feels like I came to a picnic!
5000762.c3_s2: I feel like I'm on a picnic!
5000762.c3_s4: I really don't feel like getting up again...
5000762.c3_f1: Can I lay down? I'm tired.
5000762.c3_f3: I'm going to run away. To candy mountain we go!
5000762.c4_s1: Sitting is also a good workout sometimes!
5000762.c4_s2: How do I look when I'm sitting?
5000762.c4_s3: I'll sit right here next to you!
5000762.c4_f1: I'm starving and you still want me to sit...
5000762.c4_f3: Sit? What if something bites me?
5000762.c5_f2: Oh yeah? Let's take this outside.
5000762.c6_s4: No! I'll be good! I promise!
5000762.c6_f2: You're mad 'cause I ate too much, aren't you?
5000762.c7_s3: Why would you punish a cute little thing like me?
5000762.c7_f3: I never thought you'd think so little of me!
5000762.c8_s1: I'm going to tell my mommy...
5000762.c8_s2: I'm not crying! It's just raining on my face.
5000762.c8_f1: I'm going to tell on you!
5000762.c8_f2: I don't have room to talk, but you're ridiculous.
5000762.c8_f3: I'm gonna call animal protective services!
5000762.c9_f1: Only if Wisp says it's okay.
5000762.c10_s4: Hehe... Yeah, I get that a lot.
5000762.c10_f2: Did you just say what I think you said?
5000762.c11_f2: Give me some time to think it over.
5000762.c11_f3: Please don't say that right before a meal...
5000762.c12_s1: Can you see hearts in my eyes?
5000762.c12_s3: I'm so happy I met you!
5000762.c12_f2: I'm very busy right now. Can we talk about this later?
5000762.c12_f3: Please don't be so mushy before I eat...
5000762.c13_s1: Ah! Shh, someone will hear you!
5000762.c13_f2: I'm shocked, I don't even have the words.
5000762.c14_s1: Consider that a favor. Now you owe me
5000762.c14_s2: Can you get me some toilet paper, master?
5000762.c14_s3: I gave it everything I had!
5000762.c14_f1: Why are you so harsh on me?
5000762.c14_f2: How can you do... In a place like this...
5000762.c14_f4: Hey, I do have SOME shame!
5000762.c15_s1: I guess I shouldn't hold it. Here I go! Urgh!
5000762.c15_f3: I need to eat something first!
5000762.c15_f4: Poop? Why don't you try feeding me first?
5000762.c16_s4: I won't sleep until you feed me!
5000762.c16_f1: Nnnno, you've got a look I don't trust.
5000762.c16_f2: I'm too hungry to fall asleep...
5000762.c16_f3: I don't have to listen to you!
5000762.c17_s2: I wanna sleep next to you! Zzz...
5000762.c17_s3: Yeah, I could use a rest.
5000762.c17_f4: You want a pretty pet like me to sleep on the ground?!
5000762.c18_s1: You should rest, too. You can cuddle with me!
5000762.c18_s3: One snail... two snails... three... zzz...
5000762.c18_s4: Wake me up if anything interesting happens.
5000762.c18_f2: Look at your belly! You should hit the gym!
5000762.c18_f3: You make me do all sorts of things.
5000762.c19_s3: I wish I could cast spells like this.
5000762.c19_s4: Some pets are scared of me. Do I look scary?
5000762.c19_f2: Don't bother me! Go play by yourself!
5000762.c19_f3: I'm sleepy... I'll go to sleep...
5000762.c19_f4: What you want me to say? Annoying...
5000762.c20_s1: I think I'm a little hungry. Just a little.
5000762.c20_s2: Pets are still cute if they eat a lot... right?
5000762.c20_s3: I'm cuter than the others, right?
5000762.c20_s4: I'm on a diet. It's not easy.
5000762.c20_f1: I'm not gonna make a peep.
5000762.c20_f2: I'm cuter than the others, right?
5000762.c21_s1: Do you want to hear a funny story?
5000762.c21_s2: The dragons in Leafre seem super strong!
5000762.c21_s3: I wish only birds had wings. Why do Balrogs even have them?
5000762.c21_s4: Sometimes I want to fly. I mean, rarely.
5000762.c21_f1: Why don't we just go to sleep? Zzz...
5000762.f1_f: I was going to go on a diet.
5000762.f2_s: I'm not eating because I want to. I swear.
5000762.f2_f: Aah...I miss the meals back home...
5000762.f4_f: Don't you think I've gotten a little fat?

5000763.c2_s3: I should rest a bit while I freshen up!
5000763.c2_s4: I like sitting because I can see the worms from here.
5000763.c3_s2: Come on, take a seat and have a chat.
5000763.c3_s3: We should take a little break, yeah?
5000763.c3_s4: I am sitting. I am good right?
5000763.c3_f1: Nah. I'm gonna do what I want.
5000763.c4_s1: I want to eat some fresh blueberries.
5000763.c4_s2: I'm full and the weather is lovely. And you're even lovelier.
5000763.c4_s3: I'm going to get some sleep.
5000763.c4_s4: You should come over here. Next to me.
5000763.c4_f1: I'm too lazy to fold my legs.
5000763.c4_f4: I don't like being ordered around!
5000763.c6_s1: I didn't do it on purpose...
5000763.c6_s4: Y-you're not really angry with me, are you?
5000763.c6_f1: What do you want me to do? I didn't do anything.
5000763.c6_f2: Why are you getting angry at me?
5000763.c7_s1: I'll be good from now on! No more bad stuff!
5000763.c7_f3: No. I don't wanna be in trouble.
5000763.c8_s1: It wasn't such a big deal...
5000763.c8_f2: This is no fun... Can we do something else?
5000763.c8_f3: I'm just gonna head to bed, then.
5000763.c9_f1: Wisp told me not to trust anyone!
5000763.c9_f2: Why don't you just give me more acorns?
5000763.c10_s4: Always good to have your ear!
5000763.c11_s4: I love hearing that from you.
5000763.c12_s1: This is the happiest moment in my life.
5000763.c12_s3: Can you see hearts in my eyes?
5000763.c12_s4: I love you SO much! Yip yip!
5000763.c12_f1: Argh! Why are you doing this to me? I told you I HATE it!
5000763.c12_f2: Do you even know what love means?
5000763.c12_f4: I love you like family, too!
5000763.c14_s1: Oo! I did my best, and that's what counts!
5000763.c14_f1: Stop that nonsense and let's play!
5000763.c14_f2: Are you crazy? I can't do that here.
5000763.c15_s1: So refreshing! I feel a thousand pounds lighter!
5000763.c15_f3: I'm very selective about where I poo.
5000763.c15_f4: Why are you laughing at me?
5000763.c16_s1: I had a great day today!
5000763.c16_s4: You're not gonna run away while I sleep, right?
5000763.c16_f1: But I want to play more!
5000763.c16_f2: Look, the sun is still up!
5000763.c16_f3: I'm not sleepy at all! IN YO FACE!
5000763.c17_s2: See you in my dreams, mate!
5000763.c17_f4: I'll sleep when I get sleepy, okies?
5000763.c18_s1: Dream a sweet little dream of me!
5000763.c18_s2: Let's get a good rest and then play some more!
5000763.c18_s3: If you want me to sleep, I'll sleep!
5000763.c18_f1: What? Wait! There might be snakes around here!
5000763.c18_f3: Why do you always tell me to sleep?
5000763.c19_f1: I don't know anything about that.
5000763.c19_f2: What? What are you implying? I know nothing!
5000763.c20_s1: What kind of place is the Free Market? Why is it always crowded?
5000763.c20_s2: I can't talk to other pets. We don't speak the same language.
5000763.c20_s3: If you give me a piece of cake, I won't eat you up!
5000763.c20_s4: With weather like this, I'm sure great items are bound to drop!
5000763.c20_f1: Nope! Because you told me to, I won't!
5000763.c20_f2: I'm curious about you! Tell me stories!
5000763.c20_f3: You thought I was a blabber-mouth?
5000763.c21_s1: So I saw these cool clothes... Not saying you gotta buy them for me or anything!
5000763.c21_s2: Loyalty is something that everyone should have!
5000763.c21_s3: I want to try some unique cuisine!
5000763.c21_s4: You better not cry, old man Cliff is coming to town!
5000763.c21_f1: I don't like to talk that much.
5000763.c21_f3: I don't want to talk today!
5000763.c21_f4: What do you want to talk about?
5000763.s2: You want me to say what?
5000763.s3: You are such a bad person!

5000764.c2_f1: I don't think you're taking this seriously!
5000764.c2_f4: I want to walk a bit more.
5000764.c3_s1: Good idea. My legs were feeling a bit tired.
5000764.c3_s2: Thank you, master! I was actually kinda tired.
5000764.c3_s4: Why don't we sit together master?
5000764.c3_f1: We can't play if we're sitting. Let's go play!
5000764.c3_f2: Stand, sit, it's all the same...
5000764.c3_f3: My legs are numb. I can't move...
5000764.c3_f4: I'm sorry, but I can't do it!
5000764.c4_s1: There's nothing I can't do if I'm with you, master!
5000764.c4_s3: Okay! With you at my side, I can do anything!
5000764.c4_s4: I practice every day, just for you!
5000764.c4_f2: What did you just say, master?
5000764.c4_f4: You shouldn't do that even if you like me so much!
5000764.c6_s1: Please don't yell at me like that. I like you!
5000764.c6_s2: Those words make me tear up...
5000764.c7_s1: You're gonna get wrinkles from all that frowning...
5000764.c7_s2: I feel bad as it is.
5000764.c7_f4: Don't say it unless you mean it!
5000764.c8_s1: I regret what I have done.
5000764.c8_s3: But, but...I was doing it for you...
5000764.c8_s4: I'm gonna be so sad if you get angry like that.
5000764.c9_f1: Oh my, we're not that close yet...
5000764.c10_s3: When I met you, it was love at first sight!
5000764.c11_s1: I can't stop thinking about you!
5000764.c11_s2: You can say that a hundred times, and I won't get tired of it.
5000764.c11_s3: So sweet, I don't even know!
5000764.c11_f2: Wow... Are you falling in love with me?
5000764.c12_s4: Soooooooo, what part of me is most lovable?
5000764.c12_f1: That's nice... But you smell funny.
5000764.c12_f2: I don't have the energy to reply.
5000764.c13_s2: I'll really pour myself into this one!
5000764.c13_f4: You need to learn some common decency.
5000764.c14_s2: Pooping makes me feel lighter! I may be a born pooper!
5000764.c14_f1: You're not even carrying a baggie!
5000764.c14_f2: I can't just go anywhere! Eww!
5000764.c14_f4: How many times a day do you want me to go?
5000764.c15_s1: Will you play with me when I'm done?
5000764.c15_s3: This one looks just like me!
5000764.c15_s4: Watch out, I pooped there! Unless that's your thing...
5000764.c15_f3: I want to go play at the neighbor's.
5000764.c15_f4: I'm dignified. I don't poop in public!
5000764.c16_s3: You should get some rest too.
5000764.c16_f1: Wait, I just buried a raccoon somewhere and I have to find it!
5000764.c16_f2: I think I'm going to pass out.
5000764.c16_f3: It's not time to sleep yet!
5000764.c16_f4: I can't fall asleep in this noisy place!
5000764.c17_s2: We even sleep the same now!
5000764.c17_f1: I don't see a bed, do you?
5000764.c17_f2: I sleep better when I'm near you.
5000764.c18_s1: This was a such a long day!
5000764.c18_s2: I'll see you in my dreams!
5000764.c18_s3: I wanted to play some more, but okay.
5000764.c18_f1: I am in no mood to sleep!
5000764.c18_f2: No, I want to talk and play!
5000764.c18_f4: You're not planning to ditch me, are you?
5000764.c19_s2: Pets can talk. Isn't that weird?
5000764.c19_s3: You hunt. I'll feed you potions.
5000764.c19_f1: I am in no mood to talk today.
5000764.c19_f2: But I don't have anything to say...
5000764.c19_f3: Me no speak your language. Argh!
5000764.c19_f4: What do you want me to say?
5000764.c20_s1: Are you wondering what noises real penguins make?
5000764.c20_s2: I wonder if Pepes are related to Penguins.
5000764.c20_s4: I'll eat whatever you feed me... because it's from you!
5000764.c20_f3: I don't have a big appetite, but anything you give me is good!
5000764.c20_f4: Let's play a game... It's called the quiet game...
5000764.c21_s1: Take me for a walk. I'm a total chick magnet!
5000764.c21_s2: I really like beards. They're so soft and comfy.
5000764.c21_s3: I want to know how Fairy Mir is. Could you check for me?
5000764.c21_s4: I like Chief Tatamo of Leafre, he gives me fun stuff!
5000764.c21_f1: I can't hear you! I hear nothing!
5000764.c21_f4: Let's just have some tea... in silence.
5000764.f1_s: Anything from you HAS to be yummy.
5000764.f1_f: I'm full. I can't eat anymore!
5000764.f2_s: This is the greatest flavor in the world!
5000764.f3_s: Yummm... Your specials are the best specials out there!
5000764.f4_f: Do you have a grudge against me?
5000764.s3: How could you ask that of me?!
5000764.s4: I only want to hear nice things from you!

5000765.c2_s1: I hope no one notices I'm here... Eep!
5000765.c2_s2: Ahh, nice. Maybe it's time for a nap.
5000765.c2_s3: I'm fully aware that I have short legs...
5000765.c2_s4: I want to sit... But I need exercise!
5000765.c2_f3: I don't think I heard you...
5000765.c3_s1: I'm not doing this for you!
5000765.c3_s4: Hey! Sitting or standing, my height doesn't change!
5000765.c3_f1: Help me sit and we'll talk.
5000765.c3_f3: No, I'm so short I don't need to!
5000765.c4_s3: I guess I could do that... THIS time.
5000765.c4_s4: Ugh, you can see my belly when I sit...
5000765.c7_s1: I'm sorry! I'm sorry! Don't hurt me!
5000765.c7_f3: Scolding is bad! Complimenting is good!
5000765.c8_f3: Oh yeah? Maybe I'll just stop eating!
5000765.c10_s2: Now that you mention it, I love you too!
5000765.c10_f3: Are you saying you love me?
5000765.c11_s4: Well, um... I kinda love you too!
5000765.c12_f2: Ha ha ha... What can I say?
5000765.c12_f4: I already know how you feel...
5000765.c14_s3: I-It's a bit embarrassing... Let me just...
5000765.c14_f1: Not here! I'll die of shame!
5000765.c14_f2: How can I do that here?
5000765.c15_s3: Like a little golden pile of sunshine!
5000765.c15_f2: I'll let you off for today...
5000765.c17_f3: I don't even have a blanket...
5000765.c18_f2: I don't want to go to bed...
5000765.c19_s2: I want to tell you about so many things...
5000765.c19_f1: I'd like to be alone now.
5000765.c19_f3: I don't want to talk about it.
5000765.c20_s1: My brain is just so full of... stuff!
5000765.c20_s3: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5000765.c20_s4: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000765.c20_f1: But I don't have anything to say...
5000765.c20_f3: I'm going to bed. I'm full, I said...
5000765.c20_f4: There's nothing for me to say...
5000765.c21_s2: Yetis and Pepes have such a nice friendship...
5000765.c21_s4: Everything will be fine as long as you feed me.
5000765.c21_f1: Should I train to be a thief? It looks like fun...
5000765.s3: Do you want to be a villain or something?

5000766.c2_s1: I sat down. Now feed me!
5000766.c2_s3: We could use some snacks, too.
5000766.c2_f1: Human words are still difficult for me...
5000766.c2_f3: This place looks nasty. Clean it first.
5000766.c2_f4: I don't even want to listen...
5000766.c3_s2: Just... gonna close my eyes... for a second...
5000766.c3_f2: I don't want to sit unless it's on your lap...
5000766.c4_s1: What do you think? I even look cool sitting, right?
5000766.c4_s2: How do I look when I'm sitting?
5000766.c4_s4: I look cute no matter what I do!
5000766.c4_f1: Sorry, I was thinking about food.
5000766.c4_f4: Huh? I'm too hungry to focus...
5000766.c6_s3: Sometimes... I like it when you're mad.
5000766.c6_f3: You're scolding me for eating too much, aren't you?
5000766.c7_s1: I'll eat less to show you I'm truly sorry.
5000766.c7_s2: Why would you punish a cute little thing like me?
5000766.c7_s4: Argh! Don't hit me! It hurts!
5000766.c7_f1: I'm going to workout... I have a big belly, you know.
5000766.c7_f2: I can't understand what you're saying!
5000766.c8_s2: You look very scary when you're angry...
5000766.c8_s3: How can you be so angry with me?
5000766.c8_f1: I'm going to tell on you!
5000766.c8_f4: Well, I don't listen because it's how you taught me! Not to listen!
5000766.c11_s4: Say it again! Say it again!
5000766.c11_f2: Master... I know I'm pretty and all, but...
5000766.c12_s2: Are we going to stay together? Forever?
5000766.c12_s4: I'm so happy you're here with me!
5000766.c12_f1: Love is important, but why don't we eat first?
5000766.c13_f4: I don't want to do that.
5000766.c14_s1: Consider that a favor. Now you owe me
5000766.c14_f2: Take a look around before you ask me that.
5000766.c14_f3: That's embarrassing! I should poop in secret.
5000766.c15_s1: Quick! Make sure no one's peeking!
5000766.c15_s4: Why is poop called poop? Poooooooop!
5000766.c15_f2: I hate poop. I'll poop tomorrow.
5000766.c15_f3: No! No! I don't feel like pooping!
5000766.c16_s3: Okay, maybe just a little... zzz...
5000766.c16_f1: You should go to sleep first.
5000766.c16_f4: Nnnno, you've got a look I don't trust.
5000766.c17_s3: I do this all the time.
5000766.c17_s4: You can sleep right next to me!
5000766.c17_f4: Hey, feed me first. I can't sleep hungry.
5000766.c18_s3: I'm already jungling in my dreams.
5000766.c18_s4: You should rest, too. You can cuddle with me!
5000766.c18_f1: Play with me! Don't just put me to bed!
5000766.c18_f2: Would you like a glass of cool juice instead?
5000766.c18_f4: You want me to sleep in a place like this? Mean!
5000766.c19_s1: I can't eat a lot of things, like...
5000766.c19_s2: Don't I look a bit chubby these days?
5000766.c19_s3: I wish I could cast spells like this.
5000766.c19_s4: I'm just too good looking... So troublesome.
5000766.c19_f1: I've got all kinds of secrets! And I won't tell!
5000766.c19_f2: No, I want to do something FUN!
5000766.c19_f4: Speak? You want me to speak? I can't speak!
5000766.c20_s1: I think Fairy Mir is pretty!
5000766.c20_s3: Don't you want to play with my tail? Careful, it has a mind of its own!
5000766.c20_f3: What do you want to hear from me?
5000766.c20_f4: Can we just play? I don't feel chatty right now.
5000766.c21_s1: Aww, I'm not a pig... But look at this belly!
5000766.c21_s2: I get sad when I don't have anything to eat.
5000766.c21_s3: Do you know what Water of Life tastes like? Is it delicious?
5000766.c21_s4: I wish only birds had wings. Why do Balrogs even have them?
5000766.c21_f4: Why don't we just go to sleep? Zzz...
5000766.f1_f: You can't feed a pretty pet like me such cheap food.
5000766.f2_s: I'm not eating because I want to. I swear.
5000766.f2_f: I think it's the time for me to go on a diet...
5000766.f3_f: I was going to go on a diet.
5000766.s1: Do you see the disappointment in my eyes?
5000766.s3: Don't say weird things. Just give me something to eat.

5000767.c2_s2: Stay right here next to me!
5000767.c2_f1: I don't know how. Nope, nope.
5000767.c2_f2: Show me how to do it!
5000767.c3_s4: Why don't we sit together master?
5000767.c3_f1: Stand, sit, it's all the same...
5000767.c3_f2: But I like clean things.  Maybe there's a chair or sofa somewhere?
5000767.c3_f3: We can't play if we're sitting. Let's go play!
5000767.c4_s2: I practiced every day, just for you!
5000767.c4_s3: Okay! With you at my side, I can do anything!
5000767.c4_f1: What did you just say, master?
5000767.c4_f2: Okay, hut! My legs won't bend!
5000767.c4_f3: I don't feel like sitting anymore... Or eating... Or talking...
5000767.c4_f4: You need to learn how to enunciate.
5000767.c6_s1: Don't get mad. I'll do better.
5000767.c6_s2: I will never do wrong again.
5000767.c6_s4: Why are you doing this to your cute pet?
5000767.c6_f4: Why would you punish someone as cute and little as me?
5000767.c7_s2: I love you and I am sorry.
5000767.c7_s3: I... I... I just can't go on!
5000767.c7_s4: You're still the best in my book...
5000767.c7_f2: Why are you always on my case?
5000767.c7_f3: Don't say it unless you mean it!
5000767.c8_s1: If you stop being mad, I will give you 100 kisses!
5000767.c8_s3: Please forgive me, just this once.
5000767.c8_f1: It was just a tiny mistake.
5000767.c8_f3: How can you get so mad?
5000767.c11_s2: You can say that a hundred times, and I won't get tired of it.
5000767.c11_s3: So sweet, I don't even know!
5000767.c11_f1: What can I say to that?
5000767.c11_f2: What's wrong all of a sudden?
5000767.c12_s2: I'm happy that you're my buddy.
5000767.c12_s3: I... Well, shucks, I love you, too.
5000767.c12_s4: If you tell that to another pet, I'll bite you!
5000767.c12_f2: How far do your exaggerations go?
5000767.c13_s1: I'll really pour myself into this one!
5000767.c14_f2: I should poop in a restroom!
5000767.c15_s1: I need to go... Can you cover me?
5000767.c15_s2: It feels soooooo good to go.
5000767.c15_s3: Watch out, I pooped there! Unless that's your thing...
5000767.c15_s4: How did you know I had to go?
5000767.c15_f2: I just went. Did you forget?

5000924.c2_f3: I don't want to sit. Sitting makes me look shorter.
5000924.c3_s1: I lost some weight! That makes sitting easier!
5000924.c3_f1: What's that? Is it something I can eat?
5000924.c3_f4: I refuse to sit anywhere that doesn't have a proper serving of wasabi.
5000924.c4_s1: I was actually feeling a bit tired!
5000924.c4_s3: What do you think? I even look cool sitting, right?
5000924.c4_s4: I wouldn't want to wear myself out...
5000924.c4_f3: Once I sit, I never get up. I warned you!
5000924.c5_f2: Na na! I can't hear you!
5000924.c6_s1: I didn't think it would make you angry...
5000924.c6_f4: I only ate ten bowls of food. That's all!
5000924.c7_s1: Don't get angry. I won't do it again...
5000924.c7_s2: I don't even know what I did.
5000924.c7_f1: Is it fun? Should I try?
5000924.c7_f3: Maybe I won't play with you anymore!
5000924.c7_f4: I'm going to workout... I have a big belly, you know.
5000924.c8_s2: You don't have to make such a big deal...
5000924.c8_s3: I'm so sorry, master! Please forgive me!
5000924.c8_s4: I'll stop pooping on your socks...
5000924.c8_f1: You just keep punishing me! How about feeding me?
5000924.c8_f3: I don't listen. I learned that from you.
5000924.c8_f4: Why are you acting like this? Are you just angry all the time?
5000924.c9_s1: Of course! You can't help but love me!
5000924.c9_f1: Hmph. I'll bet you say that to all your pets.
5000924.c10_s1: You know what I'm gonna say!
5000924.c10_f1: Why don't you feed me before you say that?
5000924.c11_s2: Am I cuter than the other pets?
5000924.c11_f1: I love eating ramen with an egg in it.
5000924.c11_f2: That's not what I want to hear!
5000924.c12_s2: I was waiting so long for you!
5000924.c12_s3: Just what I wanted to hear!
5000924.c12_f1: Just feed me. No need for rest.
5000924.c12_f3: I want a cookie, but someone isn't buying me any...
5000924.c13_s1: Got any paper? I'm all out.
5000924.c14_s2: FRRRT! N-no, I made that sound with my mouth! Honest!
5000924.c14_s4: Consider that a favor. Now you owe me
5000924.c15_s2: Quick! Make sure no one's peeking!
5000924.c15_f1: You want to see me push?
5000924.c15_f2: I need to eat something first!
5000924.c15_f4: What? Where did that come from?
5000924.c16_f2: Don't tell me to go to sleep! I still want to play!
5000924.c16_f3: I only sleep on a full belly.
5000924.c16_f4: You just want me to go to sleep, so you can snack without me.
5000924.c17_s2: Nothing beats sleeping on a soft, fluffy bed of rice.
5000924.c17_s4: I'm not tired yet. Why are you forcing me to sleep?
5000924.c17_f2: You're going to run away as soon as I close my eyes!
5000924.c17_f3: I'm not sleepy yet. I'll pass.
5000924.c18_s2: I could sleep for three days straight.
5000924.c18_s3: Ah, I love snoozing with a good blanket.
5000924.c18_s4: You should rest, too. You can cuddle with me!
5000924.c18_f1: Bring me a big soft bed, and I'll think about it!
5000924.c18_f2: I'll take care of my own sleep schedule, thank you very much!
5000924.c18_f4: Sleep? That's what you do at night!
5000924.c19_s1: I really am the perfect pet!
5000924.c19_s2: I wanna go on a picnic!
5000924.c19_s3: Aren't I just the cutest thing you've ever seen?
5000924.c19_s4: When I look in the mirror, I can't help but admire my beauty!
5000924.c19_f1: How do you even know I want to talk?
5000924.c19_f2: Speak? You want me to speak? I can't speak!
5000924.c19_f4: I'm too hungry to talk. Feed me first.
5000924.c20_s1: I heard there's a pet park in Henesys! Let's go!
5000924.c20_s2: I think dolls are scary, mostly because I don't like being one.
5000924.c20_s3: I want to travel the world with you!
5000924.c20_s4: Can I talk to you? I think I'm too cute. What do I do?
5000924.c20_f1: I don't want to. Stop trying to make me!
5000924.c20_f2: I'm not gonna make a peep.
5000924.c20_f4: I'm hungry. Can I have food?
5000924.c21_s1: I can be a real chatterbox once you get me started.
5000924.c21_s2: Do you know what Water of Life tastes like? Is it delicious?
5000924.c21_s3: Want to hear a funny story? Well, maybe next time!
5000924.c21_s4: I've me a lot of pets, but honestly, I'm the cutest of them all!
5000924.c21_f1: If I speak, you'll say I'm too noisy, won't you?
5000924.c21_f2: Why don't we just go to sleep? Zzz...
5000924.c21_f3: I should just pretend like I can't hear. This is fun!
5000924.c21_f4: Do you like it when I talk? Huh?
5000924.f1_f: Blech, how could you give me such an awful thing?
5000924.f2_f: Stop feeding me! I'm on a diet!
5000924.f3_s: Mm, so yummy! I give it five stars!
5000924.f3_f: Are you sure this is edible?
5000924.f4_f: Today I learned that eating can be hard...
5000924.s2: How could you say such a thing?
5000924.s3: What did you just say? I'm shocked!
5000924.s4: That was so rude. I'm so disappointed in you.

5000925.c2_s3: How did you know? I really needed to.
5000925.c2_f1: But then I'd have to put in a bunch of effort to get up again!
5000925.c2_f3: My butt shall only rest on fancy cushions.
5000925.c2_f4: Nah, my butt fell asleep the last time I did that.
5000925.c3_s1: Shall we rest a bit? Did you pack any sandwiches?
5000925.c3_s2: You know, not everyone would obey your every whim like this.
5000925.c3_s4: What else do you want from me?
5000925.c3_f1: I don't always feel like doing exactly what you tell me to.
5000925.c3_f4: And mess up my lovely buns? No thanks!
5000925.c4_s2: Well, since you asked so nicely...
5000925.c4_s3: I'm only sitting, because I felt like it.
5000925.c4_f2: No, I won't! I'll sit when I feel like it.
5000925.c4_f4: If I sit, I might get stuck to the floor.
5000925.c5_f1: You have no right to scold me!
5000925.c5_f2: Why are you doing this to me?!
5000925.c6_s1: Please don't be angry. I prefer it when you're happy.
5000925.c6_f1: I don't know what you're saying!
5000925.c6_f2: Stop it, or I'll get really angry.
5000925.c6_f4: Do I seriously have to listen to this?!
5000925.c7_s1: I'm sorry. I don't know what for, but I'm sorry.
5000925.c7_s3: I want to be with you more... That's why I...
5000925.c7_f1: If only I had a nicer owner...
5000925.c7_f4: You missed! You can't hit me!
5000925.c8_s1: I suppose I may have been in the wrong.
5000925.c8_s4: I'm going to sing to make you feel better!
5000925.c8_f1: How could you do this to me?
5000925.c8_f3: Why are you angry about small stuff?
5000925.c9_s2: It makes me happy to know you love me that much.
5000925.c9_f1: I totally feel the same way!
5000925.c10_s3: You'll stay with me forever and ever, right?
5000925.c10_f4: Um, wow, that was kinda out of nowhere!
5000925.c11_s3: I'm expressing my love through dance! Untz untz untz!
5000925.c11_f1: Wait. I think I just saw your nose grow!
5000925.c11_f2: I hope everyone in the world heard what you just said.
5000925.c11_f3: I'm sorry, but I'm kind of a loner by choice...
5000925.c12_f2: I'm sure you say that to all the cute pets.
5000925.c12_f3: Aw, you must be so lonely!
5000925.c13_s1: Do you maybe have some fiber to help things along?
5000925.c13_s3: Ah! Nothing lightens your load like a good poo!
5000925.c13_f1: No! My poop is for me and me alone!
5000925.c13_f2: Why? Are you collecting it or something?
5000925.c13_f3: How can I poop if you don't feed me?
5000925.c13_f4: Actually, I think it might be stuck in there.
5000925.c14_f1: I can't. My tummy's stuffed up.
5000925.c14_f3: You know, that's more of a private activity.
5000925.c14_f4: Are you providing the toilet paper?
5000925.c15_s2: Ah! Perfect pooping posture once again!
5000925.c15_s3: Ew! It stinks! Get rid of it, quick!
5000925.c15_s4: I know I'm cute, but no looking!
5000925.c15_f1: Ugh! Pooping is SO not a dignified activity.
5000925.c15_f3: That's a weird request. Is this some kind of prank?
5000925.c15_f4: I'll poop when I want... like right now!
5000925.c16_s1: You wanna take the first watch?
5000925.c16_s3: I feel safe when you're watching over me.
5000925.c16_s4: Fine. I'm sleeping. Stay awake if you want.
5000925.c16_f1: When I close my eyes, it gets dark, and I'm scared of the dark.
5000925.c16_f2: Going to sleep already? You're lazy!
5000925.c17_s1: Will you tuck me in please?
5000925.c17_f1: Sleep? At this low a level?
5000925.c17_f3: Can you even think of sleeping at your level?
5000925.c17_f4: Get me a comforter and I'll think about it.
5000925.c18_s2: You'll let me sleep in your lap, right?
5000925.c18_s4: I'm so glad you're here to watch over me.
5000925.c18_f1: Why do you keep telling me to sleep? I don't wanna!
5000925.c18_f3: Really? Just for that, I'll stay up all night.
5000925.c18_f4: There's no time for sleep. You must level up!
5000925.c19_s1: I've been seeing a lot of friends that look just like me!
5000925.c19_s2: This is me talking. See? I'm talking.
5000925.c19_s3: Do you think sushi is slimy? I don't think sushi is slimy.
5000925.c19_s4: Have you ever been to Esfera?
5000925.c19_f1: You've gotta be tough, like me!
5000925.c19_f2: Forget it! Why don't we just go and hunt?
5000925.c19_f3: I'm holding out for a better offer. You understand, right?
5000925.c20_s1: Have you ever made a cake? Cake is awesome.
5000925.c20_s3: Your arms and limbs are really stumpy!
5000925.c20_s4: You're almost as cute as I am!
5000925.c20_f1: You can force me to talk, but it doesn't mean I'll like it!
5000925.c20_f2: Why must you keep talking to me?
5000925.c20_f3: I swear, I'm not as talkative as you seem to think I am.
5000925.c20_f4: Can you even understand what I say?
5000925.c21_s1: I used to have a lot more friends. I wonder how they're doing...
5000925.c21_s2: People should always have a good hobby.
5000925.c21_s3: I hear Lachelein is a city of festivals! I wanna visit!
5000925.c21_s4: Your head is so big! But in a cute way, I swear!
5000925.c21_f4: Shouldn't we try to socialize with others when we're out and about?
5000925.f1_s: The food you give me is so much better than anything else.
5000925.f1_f: I don't want to eat that. It's gross.
5000925.f2_s: I wish we could share this. It's so good!
5000925.f3_s: I'm so glad I can eat something so delicious!
5000925.f3_f: Stop feeding me! I'm on a diet!
5000925.s2: Who taught you to speak that way?!
5000925.s3: How could you say such a thing? You're embarrassing me!
5000925.s4: Hey! You're not supposed to say things like that.

5000930.c1_s1: I'm sitting, because I felt like it.
5000930.c1_s2: Your ruler has placed their buttocks on the floor!
5000930.c2_s1: I could use a little bit of a sit-me-down.
5000930.c2_s2: Sitting puts my feet at ease, but standing puts my butt at ease.
5000930.c2_s3: How dare you order me around?!
5000930.c2_s4: Even the best of us needs to sit down occasionally.
5000930.c2_f1: I don't sit on the ground. It's dirty. My tooshie demands the finest of silk cushions.
5000930.c2_f2: I have no plan to do that anytime soon.
5000930.c2_f4: I couldn't do that on demand even if I wanted to!
5000930.c3_s1: I guess sitting is more comfortable anyway.
5000930.c3_s2: I look pretty regal when I'm sitting down, don't I?
5000930.c3_s3: The ground is only so comfortable.
5000930.c3_s4: Now that I'm sitting, I kind of just want to go to sleep.
5000930.c3_f3: Why should I do whatever you tell me to?
5000930.c3_f4: I'd prefer to eat right now.
5000930.c4_s2: Ah, much better! You couldn't have suggested this sooner?
5000930.c4_s3: I was just getting tired... Good idea.
5000930.c4_f2: You need to learn how to ask nicely.
5000930.c4_f3: I deserve to be treated better than this!
5000930.c5_f1: You have no right to do that! I ought to have you locked up!
5000930.c6_s1: I really don't like it when people are mad at me.
5000930.c6_s2: Why do you get so mad?
5000930.c6_s3: What did I do? I thought we were friends!
5000930.c6_s4: How could I have possibly made you mad?
5000930.c6_f1: Why are you doing this to me? I don't understand!
5000930.c6_f4: Anger makes you look super old super fast.
5000930.c7_s1: I guess I messed up somehow.
5000930.c7_s2: I don't know what I did, but I'm sorry!
5000930.c7_s3: I don't like it when you're angry.
5000930.c7_s4: Seeing you so angry makes me so sad.
5000930.c7_f1: I thought we were friends, but I guess not.
5000930.c7_f3: You stop that right now! I'm getting angry!
5000930.c7_f4: What happened?! I thought everything was fine!
5000930.c8_s2: I may have made a mistake, but I think you're overreacting.
5000930.c8_s3: What's got YOUR undies in a bunch?
5000930.c8_s4: I'll never do it again, I swear!
5000930.c8_f1: Get angry if you want. I'll just get angry back!
5000930.c8_f2: You have no right to do that! I ought to have you locked up!
5000930.c8_f4: You're going to get in trouble for that. Not me.
5000930.c9_s1: I love it when people love me!
5000930.c10_s1: I suppose I could crack a smile today.
5000930.c10_s2: I suppose I love you too.
5000930.c10_s3: It's always wonderful to hear how much my subjects love me.
