5000930.c10_s4: I shall hold your love in the highest regard, befitting royalty alone.
5000930.c10_f2: Of course you do. Everyone does.
5000930.c11_s1: I'll be the ruler of your heart if you'll only return the favor.
5000930.c11_s4: Ah, how wonderful! I'll remember this day forever!
5000930.c11_f2: I'll bet you say that to all your pets.
5000930.c11_f3: Nevermind that. I'm hungry. Get me something delicious.
5000930.c11_f4: I think you might be confusing me with someone else.
5000930.c12_s2: I'll give you a million hearts and then some!
5000930.c12_s3: Meeting you was the greatest thing that's ever happened to me.
5000930.c12_s4: This may just be the best day of my life.
5000930.c12_f1: Saying that all the time makes it less special.
5000930.c12_f2: I'm not really looking for anything serious...
5000930.c12_f4: Oh, are we sharing feelings? I'd rather eat a tasty dish right now.
5000930.c13_s1: Got any paper? I'm all out.
5000930.c13_f2: Well that's awfully forward of you!
5000930.c13_f3: I couldn't do that on demand even if I wanted to!
5000930.c14_s3: Make sure the coast is clear!
5000930.c14_s4: Well, that took some doing, but I feel so free now!
5000930.c14_f2: Is this a thing? Do you always go around demanding bowel movements?
5000930.c14_f3: Right here in the open? Did you at least bring a baggie?
5000930.c15_s1: Can we cover it with a rock or dirt or something?
5000930.c15_s2: Clean up! Clean up! Every owner everywhere!
5000930.c15_s3: Wow, that smells! Seriously! Get a whiff of that!
5000930.c15_s4: At least give me some cover while I do this.
5000930.c15_f1: I couldn't do that on demand even if I wanted to!
5000930.c15_f2: What kind of an order is that?!
5000930.c15_f3: You have no idea how gross that demand is, do you?
5000930.c16_s1: If you make me go to sleep now, I'll cry as hard as I can.
5000930.c16_s2: Oh, I'm glad that's what you wanted. I'm pretty tired.
5000930.c16_s3: I'll have dreams sweeter than sugar plums.
5000930.c16_f2: The ground's too hard. Also I need a pillow. And a blanket. And some water.
5000930.c16_f3: I'm not really that sleepy. How about later?
5000930.c17_s1: Shh! You're interrupting my beauty sleep.
5000930.c17_s3: Okay, but only if you do too.
5000930.c17_s4: *yawn* Good. I can barely keep my eyes open.
5000930.c17_f1: I couldn't do that on demand even if I wanted to!
5000930.c17_f3: If you think it's such a good idea, you do it.
5000930.c17_f4: So you can sneak off with all my best things while I nap? I think not!
5000930.c18_s2: Sometimes, I think the best day would be one I can spend lounging and napping.
5000930.c18_s3: I'm only doing this because you told me to, not because I need it.
5000930.c18_f1: We've still got a lot of traveling to do first.
5000930.c18_f2: But what if you leave me behind while I nap?
5000930.c18_f4: You seem awfully grumpy. Sure it's not you who needs the nap?
5000930.c19_s1: Aren't roses just the loveliest flower you've ever seen?
5000930.c19_s2: Is it me, or does it just keep getting more wintery by the day?
5000930.c19_s3: Are you crying, or did you just get glitter in your eye? You may want to handle that.
5000930.c19_s4: I wonder how my friends are doing.
5000930.c19_f2: I'm not in a chit chatting mood right now.
5000930.c19_f4: You talk a lot. I'm your only friend, aren't I?
5000930.c20_s2: My home is such a wonderful place.
5000930.c20_s3: I'll be I have the softest hair in the whole world.
5000930.c20_f4: Talking isn't just about making noise, you know? It's about the conversation.
5000930.c21_s1: I don't appreciate people copying my style. Then it's not unique anymore.
5000930.c21_s2: How about we go on an adventure together?
5000930.c21_s3: I noticed some doll things that look like me. What are they?
5000930.c21_f3: There are very few people I deign to talk to. You are not one of them.
5000930.c21_f4: Do you annoy ALL of your friends this much?
5000930.f1_s: Oh ho! This is pretty tasty!
5000930.f2_s: This is tasty as pie! What is this? Pie?
5000930.f2_f: I'd eat if I could, but I'm full right now.
5000930.f3_f: I couldn't stuff one more bite in there!
5000930.f4_s: Food this tasty always makes me happy.
5000930.f4_f: Do you think I'm just an eating machine?
5000930.s1: What kind of an order is that?!
5000930.s2: You really like to be bossy, don't you?
5000930.s3: Om nom no- Nope. I can't pretend I'm happy about this.
5000930.s4: It's time for me to get serious.

5000931.c1_s1: I sat down! What more do you want from me?
5000931.c1_s2: Sitting! Eating! Pooping! Sleeping! Such is life!
5000931.c2_s2: If I'm going to sit, I may as well lie down and take a nap too!
5000931.c2_s3: I was already sitting! Get with the times!
5000931.c2_s4: I think the only thing more comfy than sitting is maybe... sleeping... or eating... or both.
5000931.c2_f1: I'll pass, thanks. And I wasn't referring to gas.
5000931.c2_f3: You think I'd obey a mere human?
5000931.c2_f4: Why do you keep saying that?
5000931.c3_s1: I was just getting tired of walking! Are you a psychic?
5000931.c3_s2: Why not? My figure appears to the greatest advantage while I'm sitting.
5000931.c3_s3: Sitting IS a talent of mine.
5000931.c3_s4: Yeah! Tell me, who else is this good at sitting, huh?
5000931.c3_f1: I won't sit unless there's an extra cushiony cushion.
5000931.c3_f3: Can't we just hurry up and go home?
5000931.c3_f4: Couldn't you just give me some tasty food?
5000931.c4_s1: I'll only do it if you promise to sit next to me.
5000931.c4_s2: How about I just lie down instead?
5000931.c4_s3: Sitting is just wonderful, isn't it?
5000931.c4_f2: I don't really feel like it, so... no.
5000931.c4_f3: Are you really bossing me around right now?
5000931.c5_f1: You're picking a fight with me? You're going down!
5000931.c6_s1: I don't like it when you're mad.
5000931.c6_f2: What did you just say to me?!
5000931.c6_f3: I'll forgive you for your lapse in judgement... this time.
5000931.c6_f4: How could you possibly be mad at me? I'm amazing.
5000931.c7_s1: I'm not going to feel bad about this until you give me a reason.
5000931.c7_s2: Why are you always so ANGRY with me?!
5000931.c7_s3: P-p-please don't be mad. I'm going to c-c-cry.
5000931.c7_s4: I don't think I could be any more upset right now.
5000931.c7_f1: You too? What is going on today?
5000931.c7_f2: You want some? Come at me!
5000931.c7_f3: Mad AGAIN. Why am I not surprised?
5000931.c8_s1: I think I need to go somewhere quiet and cry...
5000931.c8_s4: Why do you keep getting mad. It's no fun at all.
5000931.c8_f1: You're not as nice as I thought!
5000931.c8_f2: You can't punish me if I can't hear you! La la la la!!!
5000931.c8_f3: You'd better be careful. You're face is going to get stuck like that.
5000931.c8_f4: Do that again, and you'll regret it.
5000931.c9_f2: I don't think I heard you right.
5000931.c10_f1: How much? I need exact figures here.
5000931.c10_f2: Yes, but how much is that worth in terms of food?
5000931.c10_f3: Would you elaborate? I love hearing about how amazing I am.
5000931.c10_f4: I'm not really looking for anything serious right now.
5000931.c11_s2: I love you so much it hurts!
5000931.c11_f1: Uh, that love stuff isn't really my thing.
5000931.c12_s1: Oh my goodness! I love you so, so much!
5000931.c12_s3: You're all I've got, and that's just the way I like it.
5000931.c12_s4: It's like this was meant to be!
5000931.c12_f1: That's a bit... clingy, don't you think?
5000931.c12_f3: Do we have to do this right now?
5000931.c13_s2: Do we really need to be demanding such things?
5000931.c13_s3: Ugh! I can't believe you'd ask that.
5000931.c13_s4: I should have known you'd ask eventually. Everyone does.
5000931.c13_f2: I don't poop. I ooze glitter!
5000931.c13_f3: Well this is awkward. Um. Bleh.
5000931.c14_s1: Well, now that's done, I guess it's time to eat some more.
5000931.c14_s3: I don't like public displays of, ehem, glitter expulsion.
5000931.c14_s4: Could you at least give me some privacy?
5000931.c14_f1: I'll pass, thanks. And I wasn't referring to gas.
5000931.c14_f2: That's not really in my bodily function vocabulary.
5000931.c14_f4: This is neither the time nor the place. Actually, it's never either.
5000931.c15_s1: Tell you what. You turn around. I'll do my thing.
5000931.c15_s4: You think I poop?! Hah! I've moved beyond such things.
5000931.c15_f2: I need food in the tank before I can do that.
5000931.c16_s4: I'm already dozing off... Look! I'm drooling and everything!
5000931.c16_f1: Get me silk blankets! Then we'll talk.
5000931.c16_f2: Sleeping is for people who can't keep up with how awesome I am.
5000931.c16_f4: I'll close my eyes, but I'm not going to sleep.
5000931.c17_s1: If I had some cushy blankets, it would be perfect...
5000931.c17_s2: You should get some sleep too! Good night!
5000931.c17_s3: Are you going to cook up something delicious while I sleep?
5000931.c17_s4: If I go to sleep, you have to promise not to leave me alone.
5000931.c17_f1: I need a full belly to fall asleep, but SOMEBODY isn't giving me any food.
5000931.c17_f3: I don't need sleep! I'll just hold my eyes open with my fingers.
5000931.c17_f4: I'm not even a little sleepy.
5000931.c18_s1: Maybe I'll have a nice dream about spending time with my friends.
5000931.c18_s2: I think I'm sleepy... Yeah. Yeah, I'm sleepy.
5000931.c18_s3: Zzz... Put that monkey's uncle in the mangomobile... Zzz...
5000931.c18_f1: I'd sleep better if I had a good snack first.
5000931.c18_f3: I'm so amazing that I don't need sleep.
5000931.c19_s1: What's the prettiest flower in the world. Here's a hint. It's a rose.
5000931.c19_s2: I know I'm pretty, but I think I might be TOO pretty, know what I mean?
5000931.c19_s4: I hope my friends are doing well.
5000931.c19_f1: Why do you keep bothering me?
5000931.c19_f4: Don't you have someone else you'd rather talk to?
5000931.c20_s1: I miss my friends so much!
5000931.c20_s3: I want to eat something delicious!
5000931.c20_s4: Traveling with you is always fun!
5000931.c20_f4: I don't want to. I'm feeling lazy today.
5000931.c21_s1: I must be pretty amazing. People keep dressing like me!
5000931.c21_s2: Let's hold hands next time we go somewhere!
5000931.c21_s3: You won't let me turn into a doll, will you?
5000931.c21_s4: Wanna know a secret? I'm a really good dancer.
5000931.c21_f1: What?! Oh, for a second, I thought you told me to poop.
5000931.c21_f4: I don't have enough energy to chat. I need food!
5000931.f1_f: Does that mean you'll give me spicy rolls?
5000931.f3_s: I'm pleased to report that this food is amazing!
5000931.f3_f: Any more food, and I might pop!
5000931.f4_s: Eating's the best! More food! More food!
5000931.s2: I'd rather you didn't say weird stuff like that.
5000931.s4: Stop saying stuff like that, or I'm gonna go home.

5000932.c1_s2: Why don't I just make some characteristically cute noises?
5000932.c2_s1: I mean, I AM kind of a master at sitting.
5000932.c2_s2: Next I'll bet you'll tell me to roll over.
5000932.c2_s3: I knew you were going to say that. It's why I already did it!
5000932.c2_s4: Isn't it nice when I do what I'm told? Just don't get used to it.
5000932.c2_f3: You think I'd obey a mere human?
5000932.c2_f4: Why do you keep saying that?
5000932.c3_s1: I was just getting tired of walking! Are you a psychic?
5000932.c3_s2: Sitting just makes me sleepy. I'd rather take a nap.
5000932.c3_s3: Humph. I suppose I'll let you boss me around just this once.
5000932.c3_s4: Look how nice I am! I sat down like you asked and everything!
5000932.c3_f1: I won't sit unless there's an extra cushiony cushion.
5000932.c3_f2: I'm feeling lazy. Why don't we skip the commands today?
5000932.c3_f3: Can't we just hurry up and go home?
5000932.c3_f4: You could at least give me treats when you're going to be bossy.
5000932.c4_s1: Fine, I'll sit for you... But you'd better be grateful.
5000932.c4_s2: How about I just lie down instead?
5000932.c4_s3: Sitting is just wonderful, isn't it?
5000932.c4_s4: Okay, I'll listen, but only because I'm in a good mood.
5000932.c4_f1: You can't boss me around if I can't hear you! La la la!
5000932.c4_f2: You can't tell me what to do! I'm my own self and I do what I want!
5000932.c5_s2: It's like you want me to cry... Sniff...
5000932.c5_f1: You're picking a fight with me? You're going down!
5000932.c5_f2: Just because you're mad, it doesn't mean you can take it out on me.
5000932.c6_s1: You may be upset, but being mean to me won't help things.
5000932.c6_s2: I made a mistake. I'm so sorry!
5000932.c6_f3: You can just be mad all by yourself. I'll wait.
5000932.c6_f4: What's wrong? I don't know what I did.
5000932.c7_s2: You need some anger management courses...
5000932.c7_s3: I just need to go cry in a corner now...
5000932.c7_s4: This... This really hurts my feelings.
5000932.c7_f1: Why is everyone being so mean to me today?!
5000932.c7_f2: You want some? Come at me!
5000932.c7_f3: I don't know why I bother. You always get mad at me anyway.
5000932.c8_s1: You're making me feel really crummy.
5000932.c8_s3: I really didn't mean to make you mad. How can I fix it?
5000932.c8_s4: Why do you keep getting mad. It's no fun at all.
5000932.c8_f1: You're not as nice as I thought!
5000932.c8_f2: What are you even saying right now?
5000932.c8_f3: Let's eat first. You can be mad at me later.
5000932.c8_f4: Do that again, and you'll regret it.
5000932.c9_s1: Not as much as I love you!
5000932.c9_s2: Aww, don't get all mushy on me.
5000932.c9_f2: You mean me, don't you? I'm flattered!
5000932.c10_s1: Not as much as I love you!
5000932.c10_s3: Tell me again! Hearing that never gets old! Ever!
5000932.c10_s4: If hearts were money, I'd be rich!
5000932.c10_f1: How much? I need exact figures here.
5000932.c10_f2: Yes, but how much is that worth in terms of food?
5000932.c10_f3: Would you elaborate? I love hearing about how amazing I am.
5000932.c11_s2: I love you so much I could burst!
5000932.c11_f1: You're not just saying that to see how I'll respond, are you?
5000932.c11_f2: You've got a funny way of showing it.
5000932.c12_s1: Oh my goodness! I love you so, so much!
5000932.c12_s2: You're right here, but I still miss you!
5000932.c12_s4: It's like this was meant to be!
5000932.c12_f1: Uhhh... maybe you should reconsider that.
5000932.c12_f2: I don't like to be tied down.
5000932.c13_s2: Is it supposed to look like little marbles?
5000932.c13_s3: You might want to look away for this...
5000932.c13_s4: I should have known you'd ask eventually. Everyone does.
5000932.c13_f1: Do you have some weird fascination with poo?
5000932.c13_f2: I don't poop. I ooze glitter!
5000932.c13_f3: Not now, and never on command!
5000932.c14_s1: Whew! That was a great ab workout! Now, how about some food?
5000932.c14_s2: Smell it... It smells like rainbows and unicorn farts.
5000932.c14_s3: That has got to be one of my top ten best poos ever!
5000932.c14_s4: Could you at least give me some privacy?
5000932.c14_f1: What a weird request. I suppose you'll pick it up with a baggie too?
5000932.c14_f3: I can't assume the position out in the open like this.
5000932.c14_f4: This is neither the time nor the place. Actually, it's never either.
5000932.c15_s1: Tell you what. You turn around. I'll do my thing.
5000932.c15_s2: You don't have to tell me twice.
5000932.c15_s3: You do it if you think it's so easy!
5000932.c15_s4: We don't use that word where I come from. We prefer 'glorious expulsion'.
5000932.c15_f1: What? You need to poop? No worries. I'll wait.
5000932.c15_f2: What do you think I am, a poop machine?
5000932.c15_f3: I'm going to pretend I didn't hear you say that.
5000932.c15_f4: No. Pooping is sacred. I won't do it here.
5000932.c16_s2: Sure, why not? Naps are good.
5000932.c16_f1: And I'm supposed to use what as a pillow?
5000932.c16_f3: Why don't you sleep for me?
5000932.c17_s1: If I had some cushy blankets, it would be perfect...
5000932.c17_s2: Nighty night! I'm looking forward to some sweet dreams!
5000932.c17_s3: It wouldn't hurt to lie down just for a bit. It might even be nice.
5000932.c17_s4: I'd love to sleep, but you have to stay close and protect me.
5000932.c17_f1: I'd sleep better with a full tummy.
5000932.c17_f2: I need premium bamboo bedding before I'll even think about sleep.
5000932.c17_f3: Let's say I go to sleep. Then what?
5000932.c18_s1: I hope I have nice dreams!
5000932.c18_s2: Naps always make me feel so much better!
5000932.c18_s4: I'll sleep soundly knowing you're here.
5000932.c18_f1: I'd sleep better if I had a good snack first.
5000932.c18_f2: Why do you keep asking me to do stuff? It's annoying. You do it!
5000932.c18_f3: I'm actually doing this new extreme power-napping thing where I catch sleep every time I blink.
5000932.c18_f4: But if I go to sleep, I might miss something really neat!
5000932.c19_s1: Do you think there are others like me?
5000932.c19_s2: Aren't I just the best? I know you'll love me forever.
5000932.c19_s3: How can you even handle my cuteness without cuddling me all the time?
5000932.c19_s4: Was there something specific you wanted to talk about?
5000932.c19_f1: I know. I know. I'm too cute for you to leave me alone!
5000932.c19_f2: I'm not my best self today. Would you do that again another time?
5000932.c19_f3: I'm not just some toy, you know!
5000932.c19_f4: How about you talk, and I listen? I'm a good listener.
5000932.c20_s1: I wonder how my friends are doing.
5000932.c20_s2: I heard there's a really neat place called the Spirit Tree! Wanna check it out sometime?
5000932.c20_s3: Those Rock Spirits are really cute, don't you think?
5000932.c20_s4: I'm so glad we found each other.
5000932.c20_f2: What do you want to know?
5000932.c20_f3: I'm cuter than the others, right?
5000932.c21_s1: Sure, let's talk! I love the sound of my own voice!
5000932.c21_s2: Ha! Your belly is bigger than mine.
5000932.c21_s3: You won't let me turn into a doll, will you?
5000932.c21_f2: I'm not doing it! Quit bugging me!
5000932.c21_f3: Stop telling me to do stuff. It's getting annoying.
5000932.c21_f4: I know we're super close friends and all, but you're getting a bit clingy...
5000932.f1_f: Love does not directly result in yummy food. Where's the yummy food?
5000932.f2_s: You must be a gourmet chef. Your food is always so tasty!
5000932.f2_f: Are you trying to fatten me up? You're not a witch, are you? Do you own a candy house?
5000932.f3_s: Right as my tummy started to rumble, you gave me food. Thanks!
5000932.f3_f: Any more food, and I might pop!
5000932.f4_s: If I could eat every minute of every day, I would!
5000932.f4_f: No, I'm full! I really like food, but I'm full!
5000932.s2: Do you need to rinse your mouth out with soap?
5000932.s4: Why would you even say something like that?!

5000933.c1_s2: Butt on floor! Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle!
5000933.c2_s1: Oh, I'm gonna sit. You just watch. It'll be the best sitting you've ever seen!
5000933.c2_s2: My butt is in full contact with the floor.
5000933.c2_s3: I did it! Now tell me what a great pet I am!
5000933.c2_s4: I sat down! Don't you want to clap for me?
5000933.c2_f3: My tooshie can only handle so much sitting in a day.
5000933.c2_f4: Okay, but if I can't get back up, I'm blaming you.
5000933.c3_s1: I'll sit, but you have to promise not to laugh when I wiggle my way back up.
5000933.c3_s2: Can I sit forever while you wait on me hand and foot?
5000933.c3_s3: I think I'll lie down and take a nap while I'm at it.
5000933.c3_s4: But if I sit, I won't want to get up.
5000933.c3_f1: Are you questioning my ability to stand?
5000933.c3_f4: Standing keeps me more alert. I'd rather do that.
5000933.c4_s2: I sat down! Gimme praise! Gimme treats! Give me everything!
5000933.c4_s3: Cookies would be nice right about now.
5000933.c4_f1: I just got up! I'm not a machine!
5000933.c4_f2: But what if I sit on a bug? OH! What if the bug sits on me?!
5000933.c4_f3: The ground is dirty. I can't get dirty. I don't like being dirty.
5000933.c4_f4: I don't take orders from anyone!
5000933.c6_s2: It's not fair! You yell at me all the time!
5000933.c6_s3: I can't keep the tears away anymore...
5000933.c6_s4: You're super scary when you're mad...
5000933.c6_f1: Some people know how to be more constructive about their anger. You should try it.
5000933.c6_f2: How could you do this to me?
5000933.c6_f3: How can you be mad at something as adorable as I am?
5000933.c7_s1: Every time you get mad, I just want to run away.
5000933.c7_s2: It's like you go out of your way to make me feel icky.
5000933.c7_s3: Calm down! I promise we can fix this!
5000933.c7_f1: You get mad at me so easily.
5000933.c7_f2: I can be mean too, you know? I just choose not to.
5000933.c7_f3: Getting angry and yelling about stuff only hurts you.
5000933.c7_f4: You must think I'm a pushover! I don't have to take that!
5000933.c8_s1: Aw, you used to think it was cute when I misbehaved.
5000933.c8_s2: Violence and anger don't solve anything!
5000933.c8_s4: I guess I made a mistake. I'm sorry.
5000933.c8_f1: I get in trouble all the time. It doesn't even phase me anymore.
5000933.c8_f2: If all you're going to do is get mad at me all the time, I'll just leave.
5000933.c8_f3: If you keep bothering me, I'll get my friend Yeti to help me.
5000933.c8_f4: Why can't you leave me alone?
5000933.c9_s1: I wish you could love me even more!
5000933.c9_s2: Do you think my wish for you to love me more will come true?
5000933.c9_f2: Are you sure you meant me?
5000933.c10_s2: You have no idea how happy I am right now!
5000933.c10_f3: I can't hear you! Doo dee doo!
5000933.c11_s2: That means so much to me!
5000933.c11_s4: Of course you do! I love you too!
5000933.c11_f1: I'll pretend I didn't hear that...
5000933.c11_f2: Say it once more, with feeling!
5000933.c11_f3: I'm so glad! That makes me feel so special!
5000933.c11_f4: Ugh! You think you could save the mushy stuff until after I've eaten?
5000933.c12_s1: I'm so cute, you could love me twice as much as anyone else!
5000933.c12_s2: You LOVE me! You LOVE me! You said you LOVE me!
5000933.c12_s3: I always knew I was irresistible.
5000933.c12_s4: But do you love me more than anything else in the world?
5000933.c12_f1: Aren't you going to shower me with chocolate and flowers?
5000933.c12_f2: I'm pretty high-maintenance. Are you sure?
5000933.c12_f3: You think you could say that again while presenting me with tasty food?
5000933.c12_f4: Did I hear you right? Hang on, let me clean my ears first...
5000933.c13_s2: Do you maybe have some fiber to help things along?
5000933.c13_s3: Unnngh... Nope. I'll have to wait until the opportune moment.
5000933.c13_f2: Why are you so keen to make me poop?
5000933.c13_f3: I don't want to! It's gross!
5000933.c13_f4: You gonna make arts and crafts with it?
5000933.c14_s1: Do I have to do it right now? What would I clean up with?
5000933.c14_s2: Daww! Look at that! Even my poop is cute!
5000933.c14_s3: Would you help me find a good spot?
5000933.c14_s4: Hrrrrgh! Hnnnngh! I don't think it's supposed to be this hard.
5000933.c14_f2: Of all the things I could do for you, this is what you want?
5000933.c14_f4: Too late! Already did! And now you get to figure out where!
5000933.c15_s1: If I try to poop but nothing comes out, does it still count?
5000933.c15_s3: Just... Make sure nobody's looking, okay?
5000933.c15_f1: How can I poop rainbows if you won't feed me sprinkles?
5000933.c15_f2: Not yet. I've got to work up a really smelly one first.
5000933.c15_f3: Do you have some weird fascination with poop?
5000933.c15_f4: You act like I poop just to please you.
5000933.c16_s1: Yaaaawn! All this talk about sleep is making me sleepy.
5000933.c16_s3: Is the world put on pause when I go to sleep? How else do you get along without me?
5000933.c16_s4: That's a good idea. I could really use some shuteye.
5000933.c16_f1: You sleep first. I'll stand guard and contemplate the meaning of my existence.
5000933.c16_f2: Telling me to go to sleep doesn't automatically make me tired.
5000933.c16_f3: That's not happening! I just drank a bunch of tea!
5000933.c16_f4: I'm gonna play instead! You should too!
5000933.c17_s1: Have you heard about those new ice block pillows? They're all the rage.
5000933.c17_s2: I couldn't be more sleepy if I had just read an entire encyclopedia!
5000933.c17_s3: This does seem like a good place to take a nap.
5000933.c17_s4: I'm all cozy and comfy, and my belly is full. Time for a nice nap.
5000933.c17_f1: My rumbling tummy is keeping me wide awake.
5000933.c17_f3: Why? You're not going to run away or something, are you?
5000933.c17_f4: I don't think I heard that right. You want me to sleep right now?
5000933.c18_s1: Wow, you figured me out. I'm a major sleepyhead.
5000933.c18_s2: A nap would be perfect right about now.
5000933.c18_s3: Even the best of us need a good night's rest to be helpful!
5000933.c18_s4: Why would I sleep when there's so much to do?
5000933.c18_f1: You think I can go to sleep anywhere I please? I need comfort!
5000933.c18_f2: At least fetch me a couple of pillows. I need to be comfy!
5000933.c18_f3: I refuse to sleep! I don't need to! I'll be just fine.
5000933.c18_f4: Nah, sleep's no good. You know what would be great right now? Sushi.
5000933.c19_s1: You want to talk about how cute I am, don't you? I knew it.
5000933.c19_s2: You want to have a deep and meaningful conversation? Awesome!
5000933.c19_s3: We could talk about my favorite food. It's sushi, of course!
5000933.c19_s4: You're so great! We can talk about whatever you want!
5000933.c19_f3: I'm too lazy to talk. Just saying this is too much effort.
5000933.c19_f4: If you want to talk, you could at least come up with a good topic.
5000933.c20_s1: I love being showered with attention!
5000933.c20_s2: I'm so glad we can talk any time we want!
5000933.c20_s3: I wonder what my friends are doing right now.
5000933.c20_s4: Every day spent with friends is amazing!
5000933.c20_f1: Actually, I think I'd rather eat right now.
5000933.c20_f3: Don't talk to me. I'm writing my personal memoir in my mind.
5000933.c20_f4: If you want to chat, why don't we talk about this new diet you seem to have me on?
5000933.c21_s1: I heard El Nath sets a new snowfall record every year!
5000933.c21_s2: My biggest hope is that one day you and I can enjoy sushi together.
5000933.c21_s3: Talking to you NEVER gets old! Well, not never, but you know what I mean.
5000933.c21_s4: Let's play a game! Or eat! Or go on an adventure! All the things!
5000933.c21_f1: I'm too lazy to talk. Just saying this is too much effort.
5000933.c21_f2: What do you want me to say? My mind is a blank right now.
5000933.c21_f3: Is that how it works now? I just yap on command?
5000933.c21_f4: I'm not going to waste my singing voice on inane banter.
5000933.f1_s: I think ice cream might just be my new favorite treat.
5000933.f1_f: Looking at whatever that is kind of made me lose my appetite.
5000933.f2_s: Don't you just love munching and crunching on ice sometimes?
5000933.f2_f: I have a refined palate, which means I can't eat things like that.
5000933.f3_s: Food has so many amazing and varied flavors!
5000933.f3_f: I really want to eat more, but I'm so full. I'm not sure I can.
5000933.f4_s: Gosh, I'm glad I get to eat tasty stuff every day!
5000933.s1: Hm? What was that you said?
5000933.s2: If you keep using bad words, I'll stop listening to you.
5000933.s3: How am I supposed to respond to language like that?
5000933.s4: Bad words are for people who have puny vocabularies.

5000934.c1_s1: But my tail's in the way. Wait, do I even have a tail?
5000934.c1_f1: I've been sitting all day. I think I'll pass, thanks.
5000934.c1_f2: Sit-uations where people demand I sit are a pain in the butt.
5000934.c2_s1: Ta da! I sat! Now you can shower me with compliments.
5000934.c2_s3: You want me to put my BUTT on the GROUND?
5000934.c2_s4: I love sitting! It's such a great way to take in the world around you.
5000934.c2_f1: Can't you take me somewhere interesting first, like an ice castle?
5000934.c2_f2: Aw, don't make me sit here by myself. Why don't we visit a pretty ice castle?
5000934.c2_f3: I'm far too amazing to lounge around in a place like this.
5000934.c2_f4: Please don't make me do this here. It's uncomfortable.
5000934.c3_s1: Hm, this is more comfortable than I thought it would be.
5000934.c3_s2: We could even lie down and guess the shapes of the clouds.
5000934.c3_s3: I'm pretty, and I listen. I'm perfect!
5000934.c3_s4: I'll do it as carefully as possible.
5000934.c3_f1: I've been sitting for so long already that my butt fell asleep!
5000934.c3_f2: You're awfully bossy. You really need to give me some kind of incentive.
5000934.c3_f4: I'll pass, thanks. And I wasn't referring to gas.
5000934.c4_s1: Why do you care if I sit?
5000934.c4_s2: I've been good! Do I get a treat now?
5000934.c4_s3: Can I sit right next to you forever?
5000934.c4_s4: Good idea! I was feeling a bit tired.
5000934.c4_f1: Sit? What if something bites me?
5000934.c4_f2: Oh, sorry. I didn't hear you.
5000934.c4_f3: The grass is really pokey though.
5000934.c4_f4: I don't have to do anything I don't want to!
5000934.c5_s2: Why do you make me cry?
5000934.c6_s2: I don't like it when you're mad.
5000934.c6_s3: I didn't know it was possible for you to be mad at me.
5000934.c6_s4: I'm sorry! Please don't hate me forever!
5000934.c6_f1: That's it! It's time to put on my angry face!
5000934.c6_f2: I don't know what to do! I didn't hear you AT ALL!
5000934.c6_f3: Why are you doing this to me?
5000934.c6_f4: Don't take your anger out on me.
5000934.c7_s1: I'll sit and think about what I've done.
5000934.c7_s4: I'm heartbroken knowing I disappointed you.
5000934.c7_f2: You're not a friend! You're a bully!
5000934.c7_f3: I didn't know you could be so mean!
5000934.c7_f4: I never thought you'd think so little of me!
5000934.c8_s2: I'm not c-c-crying. T-t-there's just something in my eye.
5000934.c8_s4: I know you're mad, but please don't leave me alone!
5000934.c8_f4: I'll just run away and find a nicer owner.
5000934.c9_s2: Hearing that makes me so happy!
5000934.c9_f1: You really know how to make a pet feel loved.
5000934.c9_f2: I'm so happy I could wiggle right out of my shoes! Oh wait...
5000934.c10_s1: Wow! Really?! Okay, I'm on board with that.
5000934.c10_s2: Would you believe me if I said you're the best owner ever?
5000934.c10_s4: You know just what to say to make me feel special.
5000934.c11_s1: Well, now you have to promise to say that every day.
5000934.c11_s3: Now that I think about it, I like you too.
5000934.c11_s4: You're the bee's knees! Whoa! What am I, 80 years old?
5000934.c11_f1: Now might not be the best time for that conversation.
5000934.c11_f3: I can't believe my ears! Did you really say that?
5000934.c11_f4: I'll pretend you didn't just say that.
5000934.c12_s1: You make my life so full of meaning!
5000934.c12_s2: I always knew I was irresistible.
5000934.c12_s3: I see my charm has begun to work on you.
5000934.c12_s4: I guess I am kind of beautiful. I knew it! You can't resist me!
5000934.c12_f1: I'm more in the mood for a tasty treat than chatter right now.
5000934.c12_f2: I'll do whatever tricks you want, but you've got to give me treats.
5000934.c12_f3: I would very much enjoy a cookie right now, please and thank you!
5000934.c13_s1: Maybe you should read or something? This might take a while.
5000934.c13_s2: I've been holding it for a moment just like this.
5000934.c13_s3: Poof! I magically transported my poo to another dimension!
5000934.c13_s4: It's always so hard. I'm not sure I'm doing it right.
5000934.c13_f1: Ugh, I hate that word. How about we call it a funky lump?
5000934.c13_f2: I am far too elegant a creature to debase myself with such things as... poop.
5000934.c14_s2: Maybe I could drink some coffee to get things moving?
5000934.c14_s3: Ugh! It's so gross! Don't look at me!!
5000934.c14_f1: How can you do... In a place like this...
5000934.c14_f2: Not out here! I've heard there are special rooms for that.
5000934.c14_f4: Why do you think it's such a good idea to do that now?
5000934.c15_s2: I like to sing when I poop! What about you?
5000934.c15_s3: Poop, eat, sleep. Poop, eat, sleep.
5000934.c15_s4: Boo doo, bee doo, bee doo... Poop!
5000934.c15_f1: I don't like to do that where people can watch. It's creepy.
5000934.c15_f4: Really? Of all the things I can do for you, you want me to poop?
5000934.c16_s2: Did you put a spell on me? I'm falling asleep right... right... Zzz...
5000934.c16_s3: Good idea! I'm sleepier than I thought!
5000934.c16_f1: I'm not really that tired. Maybe I could read for a bit first?
5000934.c16_f2: I tried to sleep earlier, but you wanted me to talk to you!
5000934.c16_f3: I have more important things to do right now. Like daydream.
5000934.c16_f4: I'm too hungry to go to sleep!
5000934.c17_s1: The sooner you make me sleep, the sooner I wake up to bug you!
5000934.c17_s2: I only sleep on a full belly!
5000934.c17_s3: What if I just pretend I'm sleeping? Could you tell?
5000934.c17_s4: I hope I have wonderful dreams about how great you are!
5000934.c17_f1: How can you tell a cute pet like me to sleep on the streets?
5000934.c17_f2: I'm too hungry to fall asleep...
5000934.c17_f3: Wait! You can't tell me to take a nap and then leave me unprotected!
5000934.c17_f4: Play with me! Don't just put me to bed!
5000934.c18_s1: I'll try, but I can't guarantee I'll actually... Zzz...
5000934.c18_s3: All I need is a nice pillow and blanket to cuddle up with.
5000934.c18_f1: I can't just sleep all the time!
5000934.c18_f2: That was one command too many! NO!
5000934.c18_f3: No! I'd rather glare at you and pout.
5000934.c18_f4: We don't have time for sleep! There's so much to do!
5000934.c19_s1: There's no better pet than me, right?
5000934.c19_s2: You must love the sound of my voice. I'm proud of it.
5000934.c19_s3: I'm actually good at singing too. Wanna hear?
5000934.c19_s4: I want to grow up and fight monsters just like you!
5000934.c19_f1: Fine. But you have to give me 1 treat every time I talk.
5000934.c19_f2: I'm much too tired. Couldn't I nap instead?
5000934.c19_f3: I'm sleepy and grumpy. Now's not a good time to talk to me.
5000934.c19_f4: You won't get one peep outta me! Except for that one. And that one... And...
5000934.c20_s1: You know, it looks like a cushy life, but sometimes pet life is tough.
5000934.c20_s2: Do you think if it's cold enough, I could make my own clouds by talking?
5000934.c20_s3: I saw a doll that looks like me... a LOT like me... What was it?
5000934.c20_s4: I want to go to El Nath with you. I heard it's covered in glittering snow.
5000934.c20_f1: You've kind of put me on the spot here. I don't know what to say.
5000934.c20_f3: I'm confused. What do you want to talk about?
5000934.c20_f4: Is this something owners normally like to do with their pets?
5000934.c21_s1: I'd love to go somewhere beautiful and snowy.
5000934.c21_s2: I love snow! It makes the most interesting crunching noise when you walk in it.
5000934.c21_s3: Did you know I can sing? I'm great with classic showtunes.
5000934.c21_s4: Flying is kind of an amazing skill when you think about it.
5000934.c21_f1: I'm much too tired. Couldn't I nap instead?
5000934.c21_f2: Let's go to sleep instead. I could use a good nap.
5000934.c21_f3: Why do you keep talking to me? Nothing's changed.
5000934.c21_f4: Are you bored? I'm not really sure what you need.
5000934.f2_f: You can't feed a pretty pet like me such cheap food.
5000934.f3_s: How did you make this taste so heavenly?
5000934.f3_f: Blech... I think I'll go barf now...
5000934.f4_f: I'm so full that my belly might just drag on the floor.
5000934.s3: Did I just hear what I think I heard?

5000935.c1_s1: I sat! It's waaay comfier than I expected.
5000935.c1_f2: What if I told you I had no butt to sit on?
5000935.c2_s2: The ground is cushy! Who'd have thought?
5000935.c2_s4: Done! What else can I do for you?
5000935.c2_f3: My tooshie can only handle so much sitting in a day.
5000935.c2_f4: Okay, but if I can't get back up, I'm blaming you.
5000935.c3_s1: Boop! I decided to sit down after all.
5000935.c3_s2: Time for me to put my toosh on the ground!
5000935.c3_s4: But I won't want to get back up!
5000935.c3_f2: I've decided I don't need or want to!
5000935.c3_f4: I don't really care whether I'm standing or sitting.
5000935.c4_s2: I sat down! Aren't I the best?
5000935.c4_s3: Now I get cookies? Wait. I didn't sit on them, did I? Eh, they'll still taste fine.
5000935.c4_f1: That is just bossy and rude!
5000935.c4_f2: I don't want to sit! I won't!
5000935.c4_f3: I don't like getting my butt dirty!
5000935.c4_f4: I'm above following your dumb commands!
5000935.c5_s2: I know I made a mistake, but please be nicer to me.
5000935.c5_f1: What are you saying right now?
5000935.c6_s1: I'm scared... I don't like it when you're angry.
5000935.c6_s2: Please don't scold me... It makes me sad.
5000935.c6_s3: I need to cry now. Please leave me alone.
5000935.c6_s4: You're so scary when you're mad!
5000935.c6_f1: I get mad too, but I don't go around being mean to people.
5000935.c6_f2: Why do you keep getting mad at me?
5000935.c6_f3: Why would you take your anger out on me? I'M nice to you.
5000935.c7_s1: I'm scared... I don't like it when you're angry.
5000935.c7_s2: Stop making me cry! It's really mean!
5000935.c7_f1: You get annoyed far to easily.
5000935.c7_f2: Bring it on! I'm not scared of anyone, not even you!
5000935.c7_f3: Are you really getting mad at me right now?
5000935.c7_f4: You think I'm a pushover? I won't let you treat me like this.
5000935.c8_s1: You used to tell me I was cute no matter what I did!
5000935.c8_s2: Please don't. I really don't like it.
5000935.c8_s3: I'm really sorry I messed up. I'll try not to do it again.
5000935.c8_s4: I know I shouldn't have done that. I'm sorry.
5000935.c8_f1: I get in trouble all the time. It doesn't even phase me anymore.
5000935.c8_f2: You think you're mad? I'm furious!
5000935.c8_f3: You make me feel so bad about myself. I don't like you!
5000935.c8_f4: What have you got against me?
5000935.c9_s2: Oh, me too! I love you too!
5000935.c9_f2: No, I can't be tied down right now.
5000935.c10_s2: Oh! I'm so happy to hear that!
5000935.c10_s4: I love you too! Like a lot!!
5000935.c10_f2: You must be mistaking me for someone else.
5000935.c10_f3: You have to try a bit harder to earn my love!
5000935.c11_s2: Aww, I'm really flattered! Thank you!
5000935.c11_s3: I'll bet I love you more!
5000935.c11_s4: Of course you do! I love you too!
5000935.c11_f1: I'll pretend you didn't just say that.
5000935.c11_f3: I don't do mushy declarations like that. Try someone else.
5000935.c11_f4: I'm too in love with myself to have time for anyone else.
5000935.c12_s2: You LOVE me! You LOVE me! You said you LOVE me!
5000935.c12_s3: I always knew I was irresistible.
5000935.c12_s4: I love you the most out of everyone in the whole world!
5000935.c12_f2: Are you sure? I'm kind of mean sometimes.
5000935.c12_f3: You think you could say that again while presenting me with tasty food?
5000935.c13_s2: Do you maybe have some fiber to help things along?
5000935.c13_s3: Unnngh... Nope. I'll have to wait until the opportune moment.
5000935.c13_f2: That's, uh... That's a weird request.
5000935.c13_f4: No, no. That's not okay to demand of me.
5000935.c14_s1: Do I have to do it right now? What would I clean up with?
5000935.c14_s2: Look at that! I'm so cute that even my poop is cute!
5000935.c14_s3: Okay, I'll poop, and you can hide it under a leaf.
5000935.c14_s4: Hrrrrgh! Hnnnngh! I don't think it's supposed to be this hard.
5000935.c14_f2: Of all the things I could do for you, this is what you want?
5000935.c14_f4: Too late! Already did! And now you get to figure out where!
5000935.c15_s1: Just because I CAN poop, doesn't mean I WANT to poop.
5000935.c15_s3: Be on the lookout! This one's happening fast!
5000935.c15_f1: How can I poop rainbows if you won't feed me sprinkles?
5000935.c15_f2: Not yet. I've got to work up a really smelly one first.
5000935.c15_f3: Do you have some weird fascination with poop?
5000935.c15_f4: I'm a little blocked up today actually...
5000935.c16_s1: Yaaaawn! All this talk about sleep is making me sleepy.
5000935.c16_s3: Is the world put on pause when I go to sleep? How else do you get along without me?
5000935.c16_s4: That's a good idea. I could really use some shuteye.
5000935.c16_f1: You sleep first. I'll stand guard and contemplate the meaning of my existence.
5000935.c16_f2: Telling me to go to sleep doesn't automatically make me tired.
5000935.c16_f3: That's not happening! I just drank a bunch of tea!
5000935.c16_f4: I'm gonna play instead! You should too!
5000935.c17_s1: I AM pretty sleepy. Okay... Zzz...
5000935.c17_s2: It's the perfect moment for a little cat nap.
5000935.c17_s3: This does seem like a good place to take a nap.
5000935.c17_s4: I'm all cozy and comfy, and my belly is full. Time for a nice nap.
5000935.c17_f1: My rumbling tummy is keeping me wide awake.
5000935.c17_f3: You're not gonna run off, are you?
5000935.c17_f4: What are you saying? I thought we were going to stay awake forever!
5000935.c18_s1: You should know I'm a bit of a sleepyhead...
5000935.c18_s2: I'm sleepy, but I want to count sheep first.
5000935.c18_s3: Even the best of us need a good night's rest to be helpful!
5000935.c18_s4: Why would I sleep when there's so much to do?
5000935.c18_f1: You think I can go to sleep anywhere I please? I need comfort!
5000935.c18_f2: At least fetch me a couple of pillows. I need to be comfy!
5000935.c18_f3: I'm not sleepy! You can't make me!
5000935.c18_f4: My craving for sushi outweighs my need for sleep.
5000935.c19_s1: You want to talk about how cute I am, don't you? I knew it.
5000935.c19_s2: I want to visit El Nath with you!
5000935.c19_s3: We could talk about my favorite food. It's sushi, of course!
5000935.c19_s4: Oh! Let's talk about all the awesome snacks you can buy me!
5000935.c19_f3: I'm much too tired. Couldn't I nap instead?
5000935.c19_f4: If you want to talk, you could at least come up with a good topic.
5000935.c20_s1: Let's go check out some pretty autumn leaves!
5000935.c20_s3: I wonder what my friends are doing right now.
5000935.c20_s4: Every day spent with friends is amazing!
5000935.c20_f1: Actually, I think I'd rather eat right now.
5000935.c20_f3: Don't talk to me. I'm writing my personal memoir in my mind.
5000935.c20_f4: If you want to chat, why don't we talk about this new diet you seem to have me on?
5000935.c21_s1: I heard El Nath sets a new snowfall record every year!
5000935.c21_s2: I want to eat spicy rolls with you. They're very popular right now!
5000935.c21_s3: Talking to you NEVER gets old! Well, not never, but you know what I mean.
5000935.c21_s4: Let's go on a fun vacation together!
5000935.c21_f2: What do you want me to say? My mind is a blank right now.
5000935.c21_f3: Do I have to speak just because you say so?
5000935.c21_f4: I talked too much today. My voice is done for!
5000935.f1_f: You need to feed me before you drop emotional bombs like that!
5000935.f2_s: Meals are best when they're delicious!
5000935.f2_f: I'm sorry. I don't eat garbage.
5000935.f3_s: Ahhh, this is so tasty! Thank you!
5000935.f3_f: Do you WANT me to barf? Cuz that's what I'll do if you give me any more.
5000935.f4_s: I think your food prep skills are improving!
5000935.f4_f: I'm full! Why are you giving me so much food?
5000935.s1: Do you hear the words coming out of your mouth?
5000935.s2: Words like that are a bit juvenile, don't you think?
5000935.s3: You kiss your mama with that mouth?!
5000935.s4: What would possess you to say such a thing? A poop monster?

5000936.c1_f2: Don't have to worry about me rolling off!
5000936.c2_s1: I can sit... if you promise me some cubes!
5000936.c2_f1: Everything you say sounds so... round.
5000936.c2_f2: Maybe you should set the example.
5000936.c2_f3: Do you keep bugging me because I'm so cute?
5000936.c3_s1: If I sit, I'm gonna wanna lay down! Woof!
5000936.c3_s2: Woof, woof! I listened, so feed me!
5000936.c3_s3: I'm the best! Give me something delicious!
5000936.c3_f2: Nah, my butt fell asleep the last time I did that.
5000936.c4_s2: We can be besties... if you've got some cubes for me?
5000936.c4_s3: Is this the right way to do it?
5000936.c4_f1: Guess it's time to head back to my Cube Puppy house.
5000936.c4_f2: I don't want to hear it if there's no food involved!
5000936.c5_f1: Who do you think you are, to snap at me like that?!
5000936.c5_f2: You look rough when you're mad! Not square at all!
5000936.c6_f3: Hey, I can fight too! My edges are sharp!
5000936.c7_s1: I don't wanna cry... I'm sorry...
5000936.c8_s3: I like master the best, but...
5000936.c8_f3: I hate it when you're like this!
5000936.c8_f4: You should be more square, like me!
5000936.c10_s1: You're one cool cube! Er, person!
5000936.c10_s2: I like you, too! Yes I do!
5000936.c10_f1: I don't like hearts. Too many curves!
5000936.c10_f4: You've been hunting too much, calm down!
5000936.c11_s2: Woof, woof! We fit together perfectly!
5000936.c11_s4: I like you so much! Maybe too much!
5000936.c11_f1: I'll pretend you didn't just embarrass yourself.
5000936.c11_f2: Did you hear something weird? Thought I did...
5000936.c11_f3: I'm sorry... I can't share that side of me.
5000936.c11_f4: Just keep the food coming. That's it!
5000936.c12_s2: You make my little cube heart pound!
5000936.c12_s3: We fit together like two perfect pieces!
5000936.c12_s4: I'm so happy! Just so crazy super happy!
5000936.c12_f1: I can't hear you! Ha ha!
5000936.c12_f2: Gross! I'm gonna toss my cubes!
5000936.c12_f3: Can we eat first? A square meal?
5000936.c13_f3: I need a spot with a few more sides...
5000936.c14_s1: I've been saving this for just such an occasion!
5000936.c14_s2: I ate too much yesterday... I need to go...
5000936.c14_s3: Whoo, wrinkles my little cube nose!
5000936.c14_s4: Cleared my square pipes right out!
5000936.c14_f2: Feed me so I have something to poop!
5000936.c14_f3: I don't poop. I'm just a bunch of pixels.
5000936.c14_f4: It sure would be nice if you stopped asking that...
5000936.c15_f2: I don't drop cubes in public!
5000936.c15_f4: I need a little cube toilet!
5000936.c16_s2: Nah, I don't think... I'm not... Zzz
5000936.c16_f1: It's not time to sleep yet.
5000936.c16_f2: I'm as cubey as I'm going to get. No sleep needed!
5000936.c16_f4: I'm not sleeping here! It's all... curvy!
5000936.c17_s2: If you're here, I can square up next to you... Zzz...
5000936.c17_s4: I'll sleep, but when I wake up it's time to eat!
5000936.c17_f2: Don't be lazy. Stay on edge!
5000936.c18_s1: I was so sleepy... I should sleep... Zzz...
5000936.c18_s2: I've been wanting to sleep for a while... Zzz...
5000936.c18_f1: I don't want to sleep in a place like this.
5000936.c18_f2: Bring me a blanket and I'll consider it. Square on, please.
5000936.c18_f3: This is no time to sleep!
5000936.c18_f4: Surely we have something better to do?
5000936.c19_s1: I don't talk in circles. Only squares!
5000936.c19_s4: Cute little squares make the world go round!
5000936.c19_f3: Annoying! Go talk to Pink Bean or something.
5000936.c19_f4: Only humans talk. I'm not a human, so I can't talk.
5000936.c20_s1: I'm so cute! Don't you agree?
5000936.c20_s2: Spending time with me will make you square, too!
5000936.c20_s3: Seems like cubes are in style these days!
5000936.c20_s4: Let's have a nice meal, just you and me!
5000936.c20_f1: I... don't really have anything to say.
5000936.c20_f2: Could you maybe just stop being weird?
5000936.c20_f4: I'll think about it if you buy me pizza. Square-cut.
5000936.c21_s1: You like talking to me that much?
5000936.c21_s2: I love to roll... It just doesn't work out sometimes...
5000936.c21_s3: I think you're the coolest person in Maple World!
5000936.c21_s4: I stay away from mirrors... Can't resist my own cuteness!
5000936.c21_f4: I don't have anything to say to you. You're no fun.
5000936.f2_s: I feel the fullest when I'm eating!
5000936.f2_f: You can stop... giving me more...
5000936.f3_f: I'm fine with just small portions right now...
5000936.f4_f: Are you fattening me up? You know you can't eat me, right?
5000936.s2: How can you say such a thing?
5000936.s3: You need to square yourself up!

5000937.c1_f1: You telling Cube Kitty what to do?
5000937.c1_f2: I don't like that round-headed talk!
5000937.c3_f1: I give the orders around here, person.
5000937.c3_f2: Where do you get off with that?
5000937.c4_s3: I would curl up, if I was round.
5000937.c4_s4: Just for you, person. Just this once.
5000937.c4_f1: That's not very square of you.
5000937.c4_f3: We need more mesos, person! Go hunt!
5000937.c5_f2: I'm not liking this relationship, person...
5000937.c6_f3: I'm done with you! Done! With! You!
5000937.c6_f4: What did I do wrong, meow?
5000937.c7_f2: You're ugly when you're mad! And the rest of the time!
5000937.c7_f3: Look at how cute and patient I am. Nyeh!
5000937.c8_s4: You're going to make me cry...
5000937.c8_f2: I've got friends who are nicer!
5000937.c9_s1: I don't get mushy, but I like you, person.
5000937.c9_f1: You telling Cube Kitty what to do?
5000937.c9_f2: I don't like that round-headed talk!
5000937.c10_s1: You're not so bad yourself, person.
5000937.c10_s3: Okay, I guess I'll accept your love!
5000937.c10_s4: I'm happy to hear such nice words.
5000937.c10_f4: I'll pretend you didn't just say that.
5000937.c11_s3: This is all a bit much, person...
5000937.c11_f1: You poor person... No date, huh?
5000937.c12_s2: For you, person, I will be a friendly kitty!
5000937.c14_s1: Cube Kitty's poop is pixel poop!
5000937.c14_s2: I'm cute down to even my poop...
5000937.c14_s4: I can do anything and still be cute!
5000937.c14_f1: What kind of person are you?
5000937.c14_f4: You should brush up on your manners.
5000937.c15_s4: Cube Kitty is the best pooper!
5000937.c15_f2: Why would you even ask that?
5000937.c16_s1: I think I might be sleepy.
5000937.c17_s1: I can't keep my eyes open...
5000937.c17_s4: Honestly... I prefer sleeping to playing! Mrrow!
5000937.c17_f1: I have no idea what you're saying.
5000937.c17_f2: Feed me first. I'm too hungry to sleep.
5000937.c17_f3: You're not going to run off, right?
5000937.c17_f4: You don't want to see my adorable face anymore?!
5000937.c18_s3: Pretty people sleep a lot, right? Hmm... Zzz...
5000937.c18_f1: You can't sleep! You need to train!
5000937.c18_f2: No way! You're not ditching me!
5000937.c18_f4: Let's eat, and then I'll consider it.
5000937.c19_s2: Am I too cute for you, person?
5000937.c19_s3: My cuteness is becoming an issue...
5000937.c19_s4: Never doubt the power of the square!
5000937.c19_f1: Don't annoy me with your roundspeak!
5000937.c19_f2: Mouths are made for eating, person.
5000937.c19_f3: All I'm saying is, I want a steak.
5000937.c19_f4: I prefer to be the mysterious type.
5000937.c20_s1: A little more appreciation would be appreciated, meow.
5000937.c20_s2: Is there anyone cuter then me in Maple World?
5000937.c20_s3: I like this weather. It should stay like this forever!
5000937.c20_s4: Aren't people in El Nath cold? Why live there?
5000937.c20_f3: Why couldn't you have said to sleep...
5000937.c21_s1: Do you like the Water of Life? What's it taste like?
5000937.c21_s2: I wish I had cute clothes, too...
5000937.c21_s4: Let's have dinner sometime! Steak on you!
5000937.c21_f1: No! You're gonna yell at me for being loud!
5000937.c21_f3: Meow, meow, meow, I'm ignoring you!
5000937.f1_f: This is it? This is the best you can do?
5000937.f3_s: I like food! Five square meals a day!
5000937.f4_s: All my best memories are of eating!
5000937.s1: How can you say such a thing?!

5000938.c1_s2: Look how nicely Cube Hamster fits!
5000938.c1_f1: Uh oh, you're on Cube Hamster's bad side!
5000938.c1_f2: Square up if you want to deal with me!
5000938.c2_s1: I was feeling a bit tired. I should rest a bit!
5000938.c2_s3: I don't like walking! I want to stay sitting!
5000938.c2_s4: I did well, right? That means you'll feed me, yeah?
5000938.c2_f1: I don't want to sit! I won't sit!
5000938.c2_f4: If I sat, I'd look even smaller!
5000938.c3_s3: Cute, nice, funny... Cube Hamster rules!
5000938.c3_s4: I lost some weight, so it's easier to sit!
5000938.c3_f2: Feed me so I don't have to sit hungry!
5000938.c3_f3: Give me a reason. A tasty reason!
5000938.c3_f4: I don't want to do anything...
5000938.c4_s1: Man, it's actually pretty nice here!
5000938.c4_s3: The ground feels like it's going to give under my butt.
5000938.c4_s4: Nothing like a good sit! Except maybe a good meal...
5000938.c4_f1: No. I might sit on a bug!
5000938.c4_f2: I'm too hungry to be sitting...
5000938.c4_f3: I can't concentrate on that! I'm starving!
5000938.c4_f4: I'm starving and you still want me to sit...
5000938.c5_f2: Ooh, you're lucky Cube Hamster is so patient!
5000938.c6_s4: My little square heart is breaking!
5000938.c6_f1: Hmm? I was thinking about something else.
5000938.c6_f2: Why do you do this to me?!
5000938.c6_f3: I thought you were a nice person... Clearly not!
5000938.c7_s1: I'll be more careful... Please don't be angry...
5000938.c7_f4: I can't believe you have so little faith in me!
5000938.c8_s2: You said you liked me before...
5000938.c8_f1: Stop, or you'll be the one in trouble!
5000938.c9_f1: Uh oh, you're on Cube Hamster's bad side!
5000938.c9_f2: Square up if you want to deal with me!
5000938.c10_s3: Cube Hamster is full of love!
5000938.c11_s2: Why are there no square hearts?!
5000938.c11_s4: Yeah, well... I love you more.
5000938.c11_f2: I just like the food! Not you!
5000938.c12_s1: We fit together so super well!
5000938.c12_s2: You and me, squaring away this round world!
5000938.c12_s3: I know I can count on you!
5000938.c12_f1: You thought I'd say I love you, right? You were wrong!
5000938.c14_f3: Don't tell me to do that.
5000938.c14_f4: I'll do it when I want!
5000938.c16_f4: I don't fit in bed now!
5000938.c17_s3: I wanna sleep next to you! Zzz...
5000938.c18_s2: You have to wake me up early tomorrow...
5000938.c18_s4: I feel like I could sleep for 3 days straight...
5000938.c18_f1: Sleep? I don't know the meaning of the word!
5000938.c18_f2: I won't sleep. Stop trying to make me sleep.
5000938.c18_f3: Bring me a pillow and comforter, then.
5000938.c19_s2: Let's talk about food! I love food!
5000938.c19_s3: I'm the cutest, right? Not off-base with this?
5000938.c19_f1: I'm not gonna make a peep.
5000938.c19_f2: I'm Cube Hamster, not Chat Hamster!
5000938.c19_f4: I'm gonna stuff my face 'till I can't talk!
5000938.c20_f1: I don't know how to talk!
5000938.c20_f4: What do you want to hear from me?
5000938.c21_s1: I'm the happiest when I'm eating!
5000938.c21_s2: I want some seasoned short ribs today.
5000938.c21_s3: Okay! Er, what should we talk about?
5000938.c21_s4: We always talk about food. I like that!
5000938.c21_f3: Can't you see how tired I am?
5000938.f1_s: Time to eat! Best time of the day!
5000938.f3_f: I'm stuffed... I don't want to eat anymore.
5000938.f4_f: You're not feeding Cube Hamster THAT, are you?
5000938.s1: You shouldn't say things like that!

5000939.c2_s1: Well, it doesn't seem like a great idea, but I gues so.
5000939.c2_s2: I sat, because I WANTED to sit, not because you told me to.
5000939.c2_s3: Is there really a difference between standing and sitting?
5000939.c2_s4: I hope no one notices I'm here... Eep!
5000939.c2_f1: Um, can I even do that? I kind of already am...
5000939.c2_f2: Really? Me? The worst thing I could possibly do is sit on the ground.
5000939.c2_f4: Why would you ask something like that of me?
5000939.c3_s1: Hey! Sitting or standing, my height doesn't change!
5000939.c3_s2: Whew. I guess I am a little tired.
5000939.c3_s3: Oops! I farted when I sat!
5000939.c3_s4: I sat, I sat! Don't you want to sit with me?
5000939.c3_f1: Why?! You don't even feed me!
5000939.c3_f2: You're just making fun of me, because I don't have a butt!
5000939.c3_f3: No way! I bet you won't even help me get back up!
5000939.c3_f4: You're so annoying. All you do is boss me around.
5000939.c4_s1: I can behave once in a while.
5000939.c4_s3: Fine, but I'm not getting back up again.
5000939.c4_s4: What if I turn into a pancake?
5000939.c4_f2: I don't want to get all dusty and gross.
5000939.c4_f3: I'm not feeling particularly obedient right now.
5000939.c4_f4: It may not look like it, but I'm busy.
5000939.c5_s1: I knew all those nice things you said were lies.
5000939.c5_f1: I'm food! How mad can I possibly make you?
5000939.c5_f2: I'm not here just so you can yell at me.
5000939.c6_s2: Your face gets all red and veiny when you're mad.
5000939.c6_s3: I'm too scared to even move! What do I do?
5000939.c6_s4: Please stop! I won't do it again!
5000939.c6_f1: Back on this again, are we?
5000939.c6_f3: What?! You wanna slice of me?!
5000939.c7_s1: I'm sorry! I'm sorry! Don't hurt me!
5000939.c7_f1: If you keep doing that, I'll leave. I mean it!
5000939.c7_f2: Scolding is bad! Complimenting is good!
5000939.c7_f3: If you're this mad at me, maybe I should leave...
5000939.c8_s3: You keep making me cry like it's a game for you!
5000939.c8_f3: Really? We're doing this here and now?
5000939.c8_f4: Get over yourself. You'd be lost without me.
5000939.c9_s2: Aw, you're so sweet when you share your feelings!
5000939.c9_f2: Oh, is it feelings time? I'll pass, thanks!
5000939.c10_s1: Well, SOMEbody's in a mood to spill their guts...
5000939.c10_s4: Bet you don't love me more than I love you!
5000939.c10_f1: Maybe if I pretend I didn't hear you, we can both forget that just happened.
5000939.c11_s1: Do you have to get all gooey? You're embarrassing me.
5000939.c11_s4: I feel silly saying it, but... I love you too!
5000939.c11_f2: You what? OH! Look at that really interesting cloud over there!
5000939.c11_f3: You don't know what you're saying.
5000939.c12_s1: Oh my goodness! I thought you'd never say that!
5000939.c12_s2: I love you too! You take such good care of me!
5000939.c12_s3: You must be the best owner in the whole world!
5000939.c13_s3: You'll have to take me to my thinking spot.
5000939.c13_f1: Did you really just ask that? You're weird, you know that?
5000939.c13_f2: How could you possibly expect me to defecate on command?
5000939.c13_f3: Why do you want such weird things? I can do so much more!
5000939.c13_f4: Why? Are you collecting it or something?
5000939.c14_s1: Way to embarrass me in front of our friends...
5000939.c14_f3: How many times do I have to say no?
5000939.c15_s1: I'm not sure I can right now... No, wait... THERE it is.
5000939.c15_s3: I prefer to poop in time to the 1812 Overture.
5000939.c15_f1: I JUST DID! Can't you smell it? Or do I need to waggle my butt in your face?
5000939.c15_f3: I don't think I can roll my eyes any harder.
5000939.c16_s4: I feel so relaxed when I'm fresh from a nap.
5000939.c16_f1: What was that? I can't understand annoying.
5000939.c16_f4: But it's so eeeeeearly! Can't you read me a story first?
5000939.c17_f3: I don't even have a blanket...
5000939.c18_s4: Oh! Maybe I can chow down on candy in my dreams!
5000939.c18_f3: I don't want to go to bed...
5000939.c19_s1: I want to be the trendiest pet out there!
5000939.c19_s2: I don't mind chatting for a slice.
5000939.c19_s3: Since we're getting to be such good friends, I'll talk more.
5000939.c19_f1: I'm not in the mood to chat.
5000939.c19_f2: But your language is too hard...
5000939.c19_f4: The weather is horrible today. I don't feel like talking.
5000939.c20_s1: Do you think about me all the time? I mean, you must. I'm so great!
5000939.c20_s2: If I turn into a doll, please don't forget about me.
5000939.c20_s3: My brain is just so full of... stuff!
5000939.c20_s4: I'd like to visit Esfera someday.
5000939.c20_f1: I'm drawing a blank. Oh! Why don't we draw something?
5000939.c20_f2: Let's get out of here and do something interesting.
5000939.c20_f3: You can't just demand that I talk to you all the time.
5000939.c21_s2: It's such a beautiful day! I wonder if the sun is extra happy...
5000939.c21_s3: There's no one else you'd rather talk to? How flattering!
5000939.c21_s4: Everything will be fine as long as you feed me.
5000939.c21_f1: I want some rest... I'm so tired.
5000939.c21_f3: I wonder if there's bread in space...
5000939.c21_f4: I need munchies first, or I'll fall asleep right in the middle of a... Zzz...
5000939.s4: You have disappointed me on so many levels.

5000940.c1_s1: Pah! I only do that when I feel like it!
5000940.c2_s1: Why don't we have some tea together?
5000940.c2_s2: It's teatime whether you like it or not.
5000940.c2_s3: I needed to sit, so I could eat my snacks.
5000940.c2_s4: I'm pretty even when I sit down.
5000940.c2_f1: I don't take orders from anyone.
5000940.c2_f2: This is hardly and appropriate place for me to sit.
5000940.c2_f3: Common language is so difficult to decipher sometimes.
5000940.c2_f4: It doesn't matter how tired I am. I absolutely cannot sit on the ground.
5000940.c3_s1: It's good to enjoy the little things, like sitting down to afternoon tea.
5000940.c3_s2: I'm even pretty when I'm sitting down.
5000940.c3_s3: Okay, I've got everyting set, so take pictures while I pose.
5000940.c3_s4: My mouth is watering just thinking about afternoon tea.
5000940.c3_f1: What did you say to me?
5000940.c3_f2: Who gave you the right to order me around?
5000940.c3_f3: I only sit on the most luxurious couches.
5000940.c3_f4: Even if I WAS going to sit down, there's a bug there!
5000940.c4_s1: Everything's ready. Let's enjoy afternoon tea together!
5000940.c4_s2: Join me for some tea, won't you?
5000940.c4_s3: I'm the perfect company for tea. Let's sit!
5000940.c4_s4: I could sit here all day.
5000940.c4_f2: You presume to order ME around?
5000940.c4_f3: How dare you take that tone with me?!
5000940.c5_s1: You're... You're going to make me cry.
5000940.c5_f1: Did you just snap at me?
5000940.c6_s1: I'm so sorry to have let you down.
5000940.c6_s2: Try not to be so angry all the time.
5000940.c6_s4: I'll do better from now on.
5000940.c6_f2: Are you trying to pick a fight?
5000940.c6_f4: How can you possibly be angry with me?
5000940.c7_s1: I'm going to spend the rest of the day crying now.
5000940.c7_f4: How dare you talk to me like that when you don't even feed me well.
5000940.c8_s1: What are you so worked up about?
5000940.c8_s3: I should be such a brat. I'm sorry.
5000940.c8_s4: I'll stop pooping on your socks...
5000940.c8_f1: If you keep doing that, I'll find a way to get back at you.
5000940.c8_f2: This wouldn't be a problem if you hadn't annoyed me in the first place.
5000940.c8_f3: You're not allowed to be mad at me. I forbid it.
5000940.c9_f1: I'm sure you do. I'm just that amazing.
5000940.c10_s1: I like the sound of that!
5000940.c10_s2: You know, I think I feel the same way.
5000940.c10_s3: I like you too. Consider yourself honored.
5000940.c10_s4: I'm too shy to say things like that.
5000940.c10_f3: I prefer people express their love with expensive desserts.
5000940.c10_f4: I don't say that to a lot of people. Maybe you shouldn't either.
5000940.c11_s1: I like you a bunch too!
5000940.c11_s2: It makes me so happy when you say that.
5000940.c11_s3: Aw, you've stolen my heart away!
5000940.c11_f3: That's a commitment I'm just not ready for.
5000940.c11_f4: I know I'm amazing, but this is awkward.
5000940.c12_s1: I've never said this before, but... I love you too!
5000940.c12_s3: When I rule my own kingdom, I'll be sure you're well cared for.
5000940.c12_s4: That's all I've been waiting to hear!
5000940.c12_f1: And I love food and accessories! We're a perfect match!
5000940.c12_f2: Yes, yes, you love me. But did you get me shiny gems?
5000940.c12_f3: The only thing I love is decadent jewelry!
5000940.c13_s1: Ewwww! Why is it blue and purple?
5000940.c13_s2: It takes real talent to poop as gracefully as I do.
5000940.c13_s3: I'm gorgeous. My poop is gorgeous. And you should praise me!
5000940.c13_s4: Oh, who cares if it's embarassing?! It feels so good to poop!
5000940.c13_f1: Ew, gross! Why would I want to do that?!
5000940.c13_f2: If you think it's so easy to go in public, you go first.
5000940.c13_f3: That's gross. You're gross. No thanks.
5000940.c13_f4: Has anyone ever told you you're weird? You're weird.
5000940.c14_s1: My poop is so cute and sparkly!
5000940.c14_s2: I want to show you how cute my poop is, so I'll do it this one time.
5000940.c14_s3: That's what you want?! Perfect! I didn't think I could hold it any longer.
5000940.c14_s4: Embarassing or not, this is happening. Move over!
5000940.c14_f3: You shouldn't ask me to do that. Ever.
5000940.c15_s1: Be sure you don't step in it. Frosting's tough to wash out.
5000940.c15_s2: At least make sure no one's watching.
5000940.c15_s3: The faster I poop, the sooner I eat!
5000940.c15_s4: Look at it! I sculpted it to look like you.
5000940.c15_f1: It's not time yet. I can tell.
5000940.c15_f3: That activity is not part of my repertoire.
5000940.c15_f4: Who do you think you're talking to? A dog?
5000940.c16_s1: I've decided I'd like to sleep now.
5000940.c16_s2: Wake me if something important happens.
5000940.c16_s3: I think I'll just knock out right here. Don't wait up!
5000940.c16_f1: I'm too hungry to fall asleep.
5000940.c16_f2: You just want me to go to sleep, so you can snack without me.
5000940.c16_f4: I DO NOT sleep on the ground!
5000940.c17_s1: Napping here in the open will be just like camping!
5000940.c17_s2: Are we sleeping out in the open? I've always wanted to try that!
5000940.c17_s3: I will sleep on only the fluffiest of blankets.
5000940.c17_f1: But I'm not tired yet. Don't make me!
5000940.c17_f2: Sleeping out in the open is romantic, but not now.
5000940.c17_f3: You want me to sleep all day long?
5000940.c17_f4: It takes too long to fall asleep.
5000940.c18_s4: I'm not falling asleep, because... Actually, I'm pretty sleepy... Zzz...
5000940.c18_f1: Play with me! Don't just put me to bed!
5000940.c18_f2: I can't sleep... There's still so much fun to have!
5000940.c18_f4: If you have time to sleep, you should go level up.
5000940.c19_s1: I need to ask something... Am I pretty?
5000940.c19_s2: People tell me I dress well, but now I'm having trouble coming up with better outfits.
5000940.c19_s3: You want to hear me talk? What about?
5000940.c19_s4: You know what sounds good right now? Steak. Steak and potatoes.
5000940.c19_f1: But you haven't given me a snack to chat over!
5000940.c19_f2: That activity is not part of my repertoire.
5000940.c19_f3: I'm hungry. What do you want me to say?
5000940.c19_f4: Talking is more of a human thing, don't you think?
5000940.c20_s1: You'll never find a pet as cute as I am!
5000940.c20_s2: One day, I want to visit Maple Island.
5000940.c20_s3: Sometimes being this cute is exhausting.
5000940.c20_s4: I'm so good at this talking thing!
5000940.c20_f3: I have no idea what to say.
5000940.c20_f4: I have nothing to say. At. All.
5000940.c21_s2: It's so nice to see you're making friends with others.
5000940.c21_s3: Every time I look in the mirror, I'm amazed.
5000940.c21_f1: I have nothing to say to you. Why do you keep trying to talk?
5000940.c21_f2: You must be really bored if you're talking to me.
5000940.c21_f4: That activity is not part of my repertoire.
5000940.f1_s: Oh, this is some fine cooking!
5000940.f1_f: You expect me to eat this slop?
5000940.f2_s: Food always makes me feel good! Oh, except for that time I had too much...
5000940.f2_f: Oh, I ate too much. I don't feel so- Bleeeeeehh!!!
5000940.f3_s: This tastes wonderful! It's like homemade gourmet!
5000940.f3_f: Stop it! You're going to make me fat!
5000940.f4_f: How many times do I have to tell you I'm not hungry!
5000940.s2: What kind of horrible person says stuff like that?
5000940.s3: Don't be crude. You're embarrassing yourself.
5000940.s4: You're beyond tacky. Get out of my sight.

5000945.c1_f1: Keep going until you level up.

5000945.c2_f1: Begin the quest by talking to the NPC with a light bulb shining over their head.

5000945.c3_f1: I think I love you too.

5000952.c2_s1: Landed too hard. Bruised my butt.
5000952.c2_f1: Ah... I'm so hungry... I can't hear anything...
5000952.c2_f4: I want to do something else...
5000952.c3_s2: Come on, take a seat and have a chat.
5000952.c3_f2: I can't hear you, I can't hear you!
5000952.c4_s1: I will wait here and have some juice.
5000952.c4_s2: You should come over here. Next to me.
5000952.c4_s3: It's the perfect time to rest!
5000952.c4_s4: I'm going to get some sleep.
5000952.c4_f2: Ahh, I'm sleepy. Can't hear you...
5000952.c4_f3: You can't always get what you want.
5000952.c4_f4: I don't like being ordered around!
5000952.c6_s1: I didn't do it on purpose...
5000952.c6_s3: I know I messed up, but you still have to feed me, okay?
5000952.c6_s4: I'm sorry! I won't eat dinner tonight...
5000952.c6_f3: Keep scolding and I'll run away!
5000952.c6_f4: I don't understand what I did wrong!
5000952.c7_s3: Hey, relax! I was just messing around!
5000952.c7_s4: I'm going to assume that you said that because you love me...
5000952.c7_f3: I'm gonna have to punish you...
5000952.c7_f4: Why do you hit me? What did I do wrong?
5000952.c8_s2: Please calm down. I get it now.
5000952.c8_s4: Be nice to me! Please! I'm sorry!
5000952.c8_f1: Why are you only yelling at me?
5000952.c8_f3: Nope, not gonna feel bad! I'm gonna BE bad!
5000952.c8_f4: Do you really have to make me mad!?
5000952.c9_f2: Do you really have to make me mad!?
5000952.c10_s2: Always good to have your ear!
5000952.c10_s3: I'm so happy. Say it again, please?
5000952.c10_s4: You love just me, right? Just me!
5000952.c10_f1: Not just anyone is worthy of my love!
5000952.c10_f2: You aren't supposed to joke around like that.
5000952.c11_s2: That's good. We are partners, after all.
5000952.c11_s3: Absolutely! I totally feel the same way.
5000952.c11_f2: You are you, and I am me, and that is all we'll ever be.
5000952.c11_f4: A tasty morsel is more precious than any words you could say.
5000952.c12_s1: This is the happiest moment of my life!
5000952.c12_s2: Can you see hearts in my eyes?
5000952.c12_s3: You're the strongest, bestest person I know.
5000952.c12_s4: Promise to love me forever and ever?
5000952.c12_f1: How many pets have you had before me?
