5000962.c5_s1: Awww... I don't like being in trouble.
5000962.c5_s2: I didn't mean it... I'm sorry.
5000962.c6_s1: That really hurts. I'm so sad now.
5000962.c6_s2: Will you believe how sorry I am if I cry?
5000962.c6_s3: You're scaring me! Please don't be mad!
5000962.c6_f1: Who do you think you are?!
5000962.c6_f3: You don't need to get angry...
5000962.c6_f4: Watch it, or I'll nip you!
5000962.c7_s1: You're not cute when you're angry. You're scary!
5000962.c7_s3: Mad is bad. Mad is bad!
5000962.c7_f3: Getting angry and yelling about stuff only hurts you.
5000962.c7_f4: You must think I'm a pushover! I don't have to take that!
5000962.c8_s1: You used to love me no matter what I did...
5000962.c8_s2: I'm not going to feel bad about this until you give me a reason.
5000962.c8_s3: I apologize. I shouldn't have behaved poorly.
5000962.c8_s4: My eyes are leaking! See! I'm sorry!
5000962.c8_f1: I get in trouble all the time. It doesn't even phase me anymore.
5000962.c8_f2: If all you're going to do is get mad at me all the time, I'll just leave.
5000962.c8_f3: Why do you keep doing this to me?
5000962.c8_f4: I can't live under this kind of stress!
5000962.c9_s1: Isn't love the greatest? It's so smooshy!
5000962.c9_f2: Are you sure you meant me?
5000962.c10_s1: Oh! My heart's bursting, and my eyes are little hearts! See?
5000962.c10_s2: It makes me so happy to hear you say that.
5000962.c10_s3: That's cuz I'm so cute and fluffy!
5000962.c10_s4: I love you too! It feels good to say our feelings.
5000962.c10_f2: If you really loved me, you'd feed me more.
5000962.c11_s2: I love me too! And you! I love you too!
5000962.c11_s3: Not as much as I love you!
5000962.c11_f4: Did you have to say that right before I eat?
5000962.c12_s1: You love little ol' me? Awww...
5000962.c12_s3: I'm really glad you do. You're my favorite.
5000962.c12_f1: What? No yogurt chips and sunflower seeds?
5000962.c12_f2: Only Sunny Seeds can prove your love to me.
5000962.c12_f3: I only accept love in the form of food.
5000962.c13_s2: Do you maybe have some fiber to help things along?
5000962.c13_s3: Unnngh... Nope. I'll have to wait until the opportune moment.
5000962.c13_f2: Uh, I have a designated corner for that...
5000962.c13_f3: If I don't eat, I can't poop.
5000962.c13_f4: You gonna make arts and crafts with it?
5000962.c14_s1: Do I have to do it right now? What would I clean up with?
5000962.c14_s2: Daww! Look at that! Even my poop is cute!
5000962.c14_s3: Would you help me find a good spot?
5000962.c14_s4: Hrrrrgh! Hnnnngh! I don't think it's supposed to be this hard.
5000962.c14_f4: Too late! Already did! And now you get to figure out where!
5000962.c15_f1: But what will I poop? Tank's empty.
5000962.c15_f3: I didn't know you were so rude... I'm disappointed...
5000962.c15_f4: I don't need or want to. And no, I don't want to go 'just in case.'
5000962.c16_s1: Yaaaawn! All this talk about sleep is making me sleepy.
5000962.c16_s3: Is the world put on pause when I go to sleep? How else do you get along without me?
5000962.c16_s4: That's a good idea. I could really use some shuteye.
5000962.c16_f1: You sleep first. I'll stand guard and contemplate the meaning of my existence.
5000962.c16_f2: You can't make me! I'll poop in my bed!
5000962.c16_f4: Bedtime?! More like playtime!!! No sleep! No sleep!
5000962.c17_s1: I love my little cozy house. So comfy...
5000962.c17_s3: Only if you keep me company, so the monsters don't get me.
5000962.c17_s4: A fully belly and a comfy bed! Of course I want to sleep!
5000962.c17_f3: You go to bed if it's so great.
5000962.c17_f4: I thought you knew... I'm as nocturnal as it gets!
5000962.c18_s2: A nap would be perfect right about now.
5000962.c18_s3: Even the best of us need a good night's rest to be helpful!
5000962.c18_s4: I'm not super sleepy, but I could rest my eyes a bit...
5000962.c18_f1: You think I can go to sleep anywhere I please? I need comfort!
5000962.c18_f2: I need warmth and luxury to fall asleep!
5000962.c19_s1: Guess what! I can do hamster wheelies in my wheel!
5000962.c19_s2: I'd love to chat! Let's do this more often!
5000962.c19_s3: I love throwing my fluff around. People think I'm so cute!
5000962.c19_f2: So you know, this is what it looks like when I don't care.
5000962.c19_f3: Why do you gibber jabber so much?
5000962.c19_f4: Ugh, you don't need to talk all the time, you know.
5000962.c20_s1: What will our next adventure be?
5000962.c20_s2: Why don't we chat over Sunny Seeds and yogurt chips?
5000962.c20_s3: I may be tiny, but I've got a big personality!
5000962.c20_s4: I'd go to the moon and back for you!
5000962.c20_f1: I'm about to faint from hunger and you want to talk?
5000962.c20_f3: I'm not really one for small talk.
5000962.c20_f4: Just give me food, will you?
5000962.c21_s1: I heard Fantasy Theme World has a giant hamster wheel!
5000962.c21_s2: I want to ride the giant hamster wheel!
5000962.c21_s3: Nothing's better than chatting with you!
5000962.c21_s4: Let's go on an adventure together!
5000962.c21_f1: Why do you gibber jabber so much?
5000962.c21_f4: I don't have the energy for chatter right now.
5000962.f1_s: Wow! You're a good cook! Or... a good shopper, I guess.
5000962.f1_f: Peh! Peh! It doesn't even smell good!
5000962.f2_s: Can I save some for later in my cheeks? It's so good!
5000962.f3_s: My favorite! How did you know?!
5000962.f3_f: I like eating, but I think I might be sick...
5000962.f4_s: I could eat forever and ever and ever and...
5000962.f4_f: Stop trying to make my tummy pop!
5000962.s1: Did I just hear what I think I heard?
5000962.s2: Use nice words, please. And magic words. It helps.
5000962.s3: Bad words bring bad luck. Be nice!

5000963.c1_s2: Ha! Sitting's so easy! Give me a harder one!
5000963.c1_f1: You think I listen to anyone who barks orders at me?
5000963.c1_f2: I don't feel like it. Maybe later.
5000963.c2_s1: Fine! But you'd better be nice to me after I do!
5000963.c2_s2: All I have to do is sit here? Sure!
5000963.c2_s3: I'm in a good mood. Why not?
5000963.c2_s4: If it'll make you happy, then I'll do it.
5000963.c2_f2: I'll pass, thanks. And I wasn't referring to gas.
5000963.c2_f3: And next you'll have me balance stuff on my nose.
5000963.c3_s1: I'll be super elegant when I do it!
5000963.c3_s3: I'll do it, since you asked so nicely.
5000963.c3_s4: Done! Are you proud of me?
5000963.c3_f2: What if I don't feel like it?
5000963.c4_s1: It's a little boring, but okay.
5000963.c4_s3: I did it! I knew I could!
5000963.c4_s4: I don't do this for just anyone. You should feel honored.
5000963.c4_f2: You can't just order me around.
5000963.c4_f4: I'm not going to do it!
5000963.c5_s2: I'm trying so hard not to cry right now.
5000963.c5_f2: What would possess you to do such a thing?
5000963.c6_s1: I'm genuinely sorry. I just don't show it very well.
5000963.c6_s2: I guess an apology is in order.
5000963.c6_s3: Your face gets all red and veiny when you're mad.
5000963.c6_s4: I don't want you to be mad... I'm sorry.
5000963.c6_f1: Do you really think you have the upper hand here?
5000963.c6_f3: I can't hear you! You can't punish me if I can't hear you!
5000963.c7_s1: Your face gets all red and veiny when you're mad.
5000963.c7_s2: Oh no... You're mad again? I'm sorry.
5000963.c7_s3: I can't believe I let you down...
5000963.c7_f2: Do you hear yourself right now?
5000963.c7_f3: You're getting awfully worked up over nothing.
5000963.c7_f4: Did you think I was some kind of pushover?
5000963.c8_s1: Please don't hate me. I'll be good.
5000963.c8_s4: I might cry... Actually, I'll probably cry...
5000963.c8_f1: I'll forget you did that... this time.
5000963.c8_f2: Is this a 'my house, my rules' thing? Cuz I could just go.
5000963.c8_f3: Don't take your anger out on me. That's not what I'm here for.
5000963.c8_f4: I have no respect for you right now.
5000963.c9_s1: Wow, feelings time... I like you too.
5000963.c9_s2: Omg, you just said that in public! Is anyone staring?
5000963.c9_f1: I think you're confusing me with someone else.
5000963.c10_s2: I'm flattered! I'm blushing and everything!
5000963.c10_s3: It's wonderful to know I'm loved.
5000963.c10_s4: I couldn't be more grateful for your affection.
5000963.c10_f1: I don't think I'm there yet...
5000963.c11_s1: I know it's a weird response, but thank you!
5000963.c11_s3: I don't say this often, but I love you too!
5000963.c11_f4: Ew, way to ruin my appetite.
5000963.c12_s1: Aren't I just the sweetest? I love you too!
5000963.c12_s2: Aw, you caught feelings? Me too!
5000963.c12_s3: I'll love you back if you promise it's forever!
5000963.c12_s4: You make me feel so special!
5000963.c12_f1: I don't need words. I need you to show it!
5000963.c12_f2: Say it again, and try to mean it this time.
5000963.c12_f3: Sure you love me. You starve me, but you love me.
5000963.c12_f4: Ugh, why does everyone have to fall in love with me?
5000963.c13_s1: Um... Is it supposed to look like that?
5000963.c13_s2: Ew, that does NOT smell like roses.
5000963.c13_s4: Uh, this might take a minute.
5000963.c13_f2: Why would you ask for that?! Gross!
5000963.c13_f3: Ugh. Would you like me to barf on command too?
5000963.c13_f4: I have better things to do than follow your poop whims.
5000963.c14_s1: Um... Is it supposed to look like that?
5000963.c14_s2: Okay, breathing... pushing... breathing... This is so gross.
5000963.c14_s3: Okay, but why are you so fascinated with this?
5000963.c14_s4: Oh... Okay, but maybe give me some privacy?
5000963.c14_f1: I have to eat before I can poop. It helps move things along.
5000963.c14_f4: You don't like hearing no, do you? Oh well. No!
5000963.c15_s1: Oh! I feel so much lighter!
5000963.c15_s2: Okay! That snack helped move things along anyway.
5000963.c15_s3: Is there somewhere more private though?
5000963.c15_f1: There's no need to be so rude.
5000963.c15_f4: I can't! You make me too nervous! I'm a nervous pooper, okay?!
5000963.c16_s1: It is kinda cozy right now.
5000963.c16_s2: I guess I could do that. I'm sleepy anyway.
5000963.c16_s3: Okay, but don't draw on my face or anything.
5000963.c16_s4: Will you protect me while I sleep?
5000963.c16_f1: You first. I'm not really feeling it.
5000963.c16_f2: You can't just turn me off like some computer! Well, maybe you can...
5000963.c16_f3: I'm not sleeping unless it's on my terms!
5000963.c16_f4: I have too much to do! I'll sleep later!
5000963.c17_s1: This looks like a good place for a nap.
5000963.c17_s3: You should sleep too! Extra Zs never hurt!
5000963.c17_f3: Sleeping is for babies and cats!
5000963.c18_s1: I suppose a short nap would be nice.
5000963.c18_s2: Why not? I feel super cozy and comfy.
5000963.c18_s3: What better place to fall asleep than next to my best friend?
5000963.c18_s4: Okay, but only for a little while. I don't want to miss anything.
5000963.c18_f1: Yeah right! You didn't even give me comfy pillows!
5000963.c18_f2: I can't sleep in a place like this. It's weird.
5000963.c18_f3: I don't sleep much. Mostly because you stare at me.
5000963.c18_f4: But playing sounds like so much more fun!
5000963.c19_s1: There was something I wanted to say... What was it?
5000963.c19_s2: Maple World is such a wonderful place to make friends.
5000963.c19_s4: You know what I love most? Chocolate. I love chocolate.
5000963.c19_f2: So you know, this is what it looks like when I don't care.
5000963.c19_f3: I'm much too tired. Couldn't I nap instead?
5000963.c19_f4: I'm not in the mood for idle chatter.
5000963.c20_s1: Today feels like a good day, don't you think?
5000963.c20_s2: We should eat something yummy! Eating is great.
5000963.c20_s3: I love going on trips with you.
5000963.c20_s4: Let's be friends forever and ever and ever...
5000963.c20_f3: Don't you have someone else to talk to?
5000963.c20_f4: I only talk when there are treats involved.
5000963.c21_s2: What do you think about my hair pin?
5000963.c21_s3: Black roses are so beautiful! They're my favorite!
5000963.c21_s4: Do you want to go on a trip with me soon?
5000963.c21_f1: I just wanna sleep right now. You bore me that much.
5000963.c21_f3: I can't right now. I have selective speaking.
5000963.c21_f4: I'd prefer to have time to myself actually.
5000963.f1_s: Omg, I'm in heaven with this. Really.
5000963.f1_f: Peh! Peh! It doesn't even smell good!
5000963.f2_s: I can't believe how good this is! I thought it would be horrible!
5000963.f2_f: Stop shoveling food at me! I don't want it!
5000963.f3_s: I could eat tasty stuff like this every day!
5000963.f3_f: I won't eat it! I'd rather starve!
5000963.f4_s: Ooh! Thanks for the tasty treat!
5000963.f4_f: Are you trying to make me barf? I'm stuffed!
5000963.s1: You kiss your mother with that mouth?
5000963.s2: Use nice words, please. And magic words. It helps.
5000963.s3: Bad words bring bad luck. Be nice!
5000963.s4: I thought you were more eloquent than that. Guess not.

5000964.c1_s1: Do I have a butt? Oh, yeah! I do! Done!
5000964.c1_s2: I can roll over too! Sometimes it even happens by accident.
5000964.c1_f2: Why? It's boring, and you're bossy.
5000964.c2_s1: Let's sit together and watch the sun set sometime.
5000964.c2_s2: Do you have a tiny cushion for me?
5000964.c2_s3: Why don't you do it if it's so great?
5000964.c2_s4: My butt is so tiny and adorable! Why not?
5000964.c2_f2: Why? It's boring, and you're bossy.
5000964.c3_s2: Do I have a butt? Oh, yeah! I do! Done!
5000964.c3_s3: I can do that. But what if I have to poo?
5000964.c3_s4: Okay, but can I wiggle my butt while I do it?
5000964.c3_f3: I can roll over too! Sometimes it even happens by accident.
5000964.c4_s1: Do you have a tiny cushion for me?
5000964.c4_s3: How long? Is my butt going to fall asleep?
5000964.c4_s4: Okay, but can I wiggle my butt while I do it?
5000964.c4_f1: I'll sit when I'm good and ready.
5000964.c4_f2: I'd rather eat junk food and play.
5000964.c4_f3: Why don't you do it if it's so great?
5000964.c4_f4: I can roll over too! Sometimes it even happens by accident.
5000964.c5_s1: Why are you angry! I'm sorry!!
5000964.c5_s2: I didn't mean to let you down!
5000964.c6_s1: Oh no. I didn't mean to cause trouble.
5000964.c6_s2: Please forgive me. I'll try harder.
5000964.c6_s3: I can't believe I messed up again...
5000964.c6_s4: I hope this doesn't change your opinion of me.
5000964.c6_f1: Don't you dare treat me like that!
5000964.c6_f2: You're making me not like you at all!
5000964.c6_f3: I don't care what you do! I'll do what I want!
5000964.c6_f4: You don't scare me! I can get just as mean an angry as you!
5000964.c7_s2: A-are you really, really mad at me?
5000964.c7_s3: I guess I'll go sit in the corner for a while.
5000964.c7_s4: Don't take my treats away! Please! I'm sorry!
5000964.c7_f1: It's impossible to make you happy.
5000964.c7_f2: I can't be bothered to care.
5000964.c7_f3: Do your worst! I couldn't care less!
5000964.c7_f4: You get mad a lot. Like, more than is necessary.
5000964.c8_s1: I guess I'll go sit in the corner for a while.
5000964.c8_s2: I made a mistake... How can I fix it?
5000964.c8_s3: But you're so demanding! I'm trying!
5000964.c8_f3: You think that upsets me? Ha!
5000964.c9_s1: Wow! It's really brave of you to say that!
5000964.c9_s2: You really know how to make a fuzzball feel loved.
5000964.c11_s1: Aw, my teeny heart is bursting with gratitude.
5000964.c11_s2: It's so nice to hear you say that. I love you too!
5000964.c11_s3: You make me feel so special!
5000964.c11_s4: You love little ol' me? How wonderful!
5000964.c12_s1: Oh, wow! My teeny heart thanks you!
5000964.c12_s2: You love little ol' me? How wonderful!
5000964.c12_s4: I'm flattered! And blushing! I'm flattered and blushing!
5000964.c12_f1: Uh, I have to go. I have that... that thing I mentioned before...
5000964.c12_f2: What are you angling for? I don't have anything for you.
5000964.c13_s4: Okay! I'll sing my pooping song too!
5000964.c14_s1: Ha! Look at those funny little poo pellets!
5000964.c14_s2: Right here in the open? Okay...
5000964.c14_f3: I poop anywhere and anytime I please, thank you!
5000964.c15_s2: Okay! I'll sing my pooping song too!
5000964.c15_s3: You might want to stand back for this...
5000964.c15_s4: I'm glad you told me that. I might have forgotten otherwise!
5000964.c15_f3: I'm... trying... so... hard! It's stuck!
5000964.c16_s1: I'm not sleepy, and you can't make me!
5000964.c17_s1: I can roll over too! Sometimes it even happens by accident.
5000964.c17_s2: Okay. Do you have something to lay my head on?
5000964.c17_f1: Why don't you do it if it's so great?
5000964.c17_f2: I have more interesting things to do.
5000964.c18_s1: I was about ready for a nap anyway.
5000964.c18_s2: I could use some Zs, and Qs, and a few other letters.
5000964.c18_s3: It does seem like the perfect time for a nap.
5000964.c18_s4: I wish I could sleep all the time. It's so nice!
5000964.c18_f2: But if I sleep, I might miss something cool!
5000964.c18_f3: I've had enough beauty sleep. Don't want to overdo it.
5000964.c18_f4: I'm not sleepy, and you can't make me!
5000964.c19_s1: Bet you thought I could only squeak...
5000964.c19_s2: I love fluffing up my fur and basking in sunlight!
5000964.c19_s4: Isn't my fur the silkiest you've ever seen?
5000964.c20_s2: Dancing's the best! It gives me a chance to wiggle my fuzzy butt!
5000964.c20_s3: How many of me do you think there are in Maple World?
5000964.c20_s4: It's nice getting to know one another.
5000964.c21_s1: I tried to touch my toes, but I'm too fluffy to see them!
5000964.c21_s3: Okay, but can I wiggle my butt while I do it?
5000964.c21_s4: Nobody's adventures are better than ours. I'm sure of it!
5000964.f1_s: How sweet! I love you too!
5000964.f1_f: Omg, why would you say something so crazy?!
5000964.f2_s: I could tell that came from the heart. You're the best!
5000964.f2_f: You say that often? It's a bit clingy.
5000964.f3_s: You must be a very kind, loving person.
5000964.f4_s: I truly believe I was meant to be your pet! You're amazing!
5000964.f4_f: Don't you have someone more important to say that to?
5000964.s1: Wow! I don't know what to say!
5000964.s2: I know you love me! I'm irresistible.
5000964.s3: Oh! I feel the same way!
5000964.s4: Do you love my fluff too? Cuz that's part of the package.

5000965.c2_s1: Butt, butt, butt on the floor, floor, floor!
5000965.c2_s2: Nobody sits better than I do!
5000965.c2_s4: Will you hug me if I do? Thanks!
5000965.c2_f1: I don't need to sit. I'm doing stuff.
5000965.c2_f2: Did it ever occur to you that I might not want to?
5000965.c2_f3: Do you bark orders at everyone you meet, or am I special?
5000965.c2_f4: People won't like you if you're bossy all the time.
5000965.c3_s1: Don't you want to sit with me?
5000965.c3_s3: I will happily take a load off.
5000965.c3_s4: This seems like a good spot to relax.
5000965.c3_f3: Do you bark orders at everyone you meet, or am I special?
5000965.c3_f4: My fanny's had enough sitting for one day.
5000965.c4_s1: Will I win your love and approval if I do? I really want that.
5000965.c4_s3: Why not? This is as good a place as any.
5000965.c4_s4: You don't think I'll get dirty, do you?
5000965.c4_f1: Can it wait? I need to eat first.
5000965.c4_f4: But I don't have a chair or anything.
5000965.c6_s4: I shouldn't have been so rude. I'm sorry.
5000965.c6_f4: Hear my tiny roar! I am mad!
5000965.c7_f4: I'm gonna poop in your shoe if you don't leave me alone.
5000965.c8_s1: I guess I'll go sit in the corner for a while.
5000965.c8_s2: I know I've been bad. Sorry...
5000965.c8_s4: I'll make it up to you somehow.
5000965.c8_f3: You can't do this to me!
5000965.c8_f4: No way! I won't stand for your hate!
5000965.c9_s2: An amazing owner like you is so rare!
5000965.c9_f1: And I love the treats you give me! Got more?
5000965.c10_s3: Ah, you fell for my furry wiles!
5000965.c10_s4: No one can resist the fluff!
5000965.c11_s1: You are the best hero I've ever met!
5000965.c11_s4: Got any treats to back that up? I love you toooooo!
5000965.c11_f4: You say that often? It's a bit clingy.
5000965.c12_s1: Stop! You're going to give me the giggles!
5000965.c12_s2: But do you LIKE like me?
5000965.c12_s3: I'm the luckiest pet in the world!
5000965.c12_f2: And I love the treats you give me! Got more?
5000965.c12_f3: Oh man! Too much, too soon!
5000965.c13_s2: Ewww! It's all wet and squishy and smelly!
5000965.c13_s3: I did it! Where's my treat?!

5002038.c8_f3: I CAN BE MAD TOO! MAD! MAD! MAD!
5002038.c8_f4: Stop yelling at me! You're always yelling!
5002038.c9_s1: I like you too! It feels so go to say that!
5002038.c10_s2: That's exactly what I needed to hear.
5002038.c10_s4: I love you to the moon and back!
5002038.c10_f1: You might want to rethink that.
5002038.c10_f3: Oh, no. You've got the wrong pet.
5002038.c10_f4: Oh! I love me too! But, uh, not you.
5002038.c11_s1: I like you so, so, so much!
5002038.c11_s2: I love you more than anyone else in Maple World!
5002038.c11_s3: I know it's cheesy, but... I love you too.
5002038.c11_s4: I'm so glad we can share our feelings like this.
5002038.c11_f4: You're not just saying that so I'll help you?
5002038.c12_s1: That's the best thing I've heard all day!
5002038.c12_s2: Thanks! You're not so bad yourself!
5002038.c12_s3: I like you! Like a lot! You're amazing!
5002038.c12_s4: I love you too! So much!
5002038.c12_f4: Hm? What? I didn't hear you. Not a word.
5002038.c13_s1: You want me to poo on command? Okay!
5002038.c13_s3: Could you give me some cover? It's embarassing.
5002038.c13_f2: I'm in my own little world, and I can't hear you.
5002038.c13_f3: Gross! Who asks for something like that?!
5002038.c13_f4: Even if I could, I wouldn't.
5002038.c14_s1: I should have known you'd ask eventually. Everyone does.
5002038.c14_s3: Phew! That one took some EFFORT!
5002038.c14_s4: Will you close your eyes while I go? I'm a shy pooper.
5002038.c14_f3: Is that really what you want out of life? Poop?
5002038.c14_f4: I'm not just a poop machine, you know!
5002038.c15_s1: You want me to poo on command? Okay!
5002038.c15_s2: Oh! It smells so bad! Smell it!
5002038.c15_s3: Just don't make fun of the shape, okay?
5002038.c15_s4: Ahhhh... Theeeeere we go. Much better.
5002038.c15_f2: Geez. You're quite the potty mouth.
5002038.c16_s2: Oh good! I could sleep for a week!
5002038.c16_s3: Couldn't hurt to lie down for a minute...
5002038.c16_s4: I'm gonna sleep like a rock.
5002038.c16_f2: I'm not really that sleepy. How about later?
5002038.c16_f4: I'll close my eyes, but I'm not gonna sleep.
5002038.c17_s1: Yeah, okay. I could do that.
5002038.c17_s3: I'll sleep for a little while...
5002038.c17_f4: But it's not time for bed yet!
5002038.c18_s1: A nap sounds nice right about now.
5002038.c18_s2: Why don't you nap too? It'll be refreshing!
5002038.c18_f1: Why is this so important to you?
5002038.c18_f2: You're gonna go have fun without me, aren't you?
5002038.c18_f3: I don't feel like listening right now.
5002038.c18_f4: I already took a nap today. I'm not sleepy.
5002038.c19_s1: You may not know this, but I'm an international snail of mystery.
5002038.c19_s2: Who's king of the insects? The Monarch! Ha!
5002038.c19_s3: What's your favorite food? Mine's green stuff.
5002038.c19_s4: Doesn't fresh watermelon sound amazing right now?
5002038.c19_f1: But what would we talk about?
5002038.c19_f3: I'm an Orange Mushroom, not a horse.
5002038.c19_f4: I'd rather go home. Oh, wait! I'm already there!
5002038.c20_s1: What time does a duck wake up? At the quack of dawn! Ha!
5002038.c20_s2: You are so interesting that you baffle me. BAFFLE me!
5002038.c20_s3: Pink Bean might be cute, but not nearly as cute as I am!
5002038.c20_s4: I love going on adventures when the sun is shining!
5002038.c20_f3: Why are you bossing me around?
5002038.c21_s1: Maple World is such a joyful place.
5002038.c21_s2: I really like adventuring. And shopping. I like shopping.
5002038.c21_s3: Sometimes it's tough to be me, you know?
5002038.c21_s4: You think I'd be a good chef?
5002038.c21_f2: I don't want to talk right now.
5002038.c21_f3: I'm not really in the mood.
5002038.f1_s: Wow! You've really got a talent for quality munchies!
5002038.f2_s: I've never tasted something this good!
5002038.f2_f: Excuse me a moment while I-- hurk!!
5002038.f3_s: After eating this, I can die happy.
5002038.f3_f: I'd slip this to the dog, so I don't have to eat it, but...
5002038.f4_s: This is amazing! You should start a business!
5002038.s1: Did you really just say that?
5002038.s3: There's no need to be so rude.
5002038.s4: How can you say such awful things?

5002039.c2_s2: I'm sitting because you said so.
5002039.c2_f1: Let's go, I don't know, anywhere else.
5002039.c2_f2: I don't know how, hee hee.
5002039.c2_f3: I don't want to sit. Sitting makes me look shorter.
5002039.c3_s1: It's a good thing my little bee bottom is so fuzzy!
5002039.c3_s4: I lost some weight! That makes sitting easier!
5002039.c3_f1: How is a bee supposed to sit?
5002039.c3_f3: I'll do it if you feed me. I'm hungry.
5002039.c4_s1: I wouldn't want to wear myself out...
5002039.c4_s2: What a nice breeze! Great exercise for my wings!
5002039.c4_f1: I'm in no mood to sit.
5002039.c4_f2: My butt is cold! Sitting will make it worse!
5002039.c4_f3: Sorry, I was thinking about food.
5002039.c4_f4: Sit? What if something stings me?
5002039.c5_f2: Mad again? This is getting old.
5002039.c6_s1: Yikes. You're scarier than the Black Mage.
5002039.c6_s4: You make me feel so sad sometimes...
5002039.c6_f1: I only ate ten bowls of food. That's all!
5002039.c6_f4: But I told you I didn't mean to!
5002039.c7_s1: I'm not going to cry! I'm not going to give you the satisfaction!
5002039.c7_s3: I'll be better from now on...
5002039.c7_f2: Yeah? I can be scarier than that!
5002039.c7_f3: You're not a friend! You're a bully!
5002039.c7_f4: Don't you talk behind my back! I can hear you!
5002039.c8_s1: Wah! I won't do it again!
5002039.c8_s4: What's wrong with me? Why do I misbehave?
5002039.c8_f1: If you give me a piece of cake, I won't eat you up!
5002039.c8_f3: I get in trouble all the time. I'm used to it now...
5002039.c8_f4: I'm gonna call insect protective services!
5002039.c9_s1: Oh! Me too! I love me too!
5002039.c9_s2: It's nice to be loved by your friends.
5002039.c9_f1: You what now? Um, this is awkward.
5002039.c9_f2: I don't need to hear that. Way too mushy for me.
5002039.c10_s1: You know what I'm gonna say!
5002039.c10_s2: Hee hee... Yeah, I get that a lot.
5002039.c10_f1: Can't you hear me? Not interested!
5002039.c10_f2: Did you just say what I think you said?
5002039.c11_s1: Am I prettier than a rose?
5002039.c11_s4: Oh, I don't know what to say!
5002039.c11_f3: Give me some time to think it over.
5002039.c11_f4: That's not what I want to hear!
5002039.c12_s3: I'm so happy I met you!
5002039.c12_s4: I always knew I was BEE-utiful!
5002039.c12_f1: Please don't be so mushy before I eat...
5002039.c13_s2: Ah! Shh, someone will hear you!
5002039.c13_f1: You should be ashamed of yourself!
5002039.c14_s3: I think my belly is flatter now after that much pooping!
5002039.c14_f3: Hey, I do have SOME shame!
5002039.c14_f4: That's embarrassing! I should poop in secret.
5002039.c15_s3: Keep an eye out for me, will you?
5002039.c15_f1: You go first. Then I'll think about it.
5002039.c15_f2: I'll only poop at home! Never outside!
5002039.c15_f3: I didn't know you were so rude.
5002039.c15_f4: I hate poop. I'll poop tomorrow.
5002039.c16_s2: Okay, maybe just a little... zzz...
5002039.c16_f1: I'm gonna play instead! You should too!
5002039.c16_f4: I don't have to listen to you!
5002039.c17_s1: Yeah, I could use a rest.
5002039.c17_s4: I'm not tired yet. Why are you forcing me to sleep?
5002039.c17_f1: So you can doodle on me? No thanks!
5002039.c18_s4: Wake me up early tomorrow... Buzzz...
5002039.c18_f1: I at so much sweets, I couldn't fall asleep if I wanted to!
5002039.c18_f2: You make me do all sorts of things.
5002039.c18_f3: Give me a treat and I'll think about it!
5002039.c18_f4: I can't sleep... There's still so much fun to have!
5002039.c19_s1: I wish I could cast spells like this.
5002039.c19_s2: Don't you think I'm just adorrrrrrable?
5002039.c19_f1: I'm sleepy... I'll go to sleep...
5002039.c19_f3: Speak? You want me to speak? I can't speak!
5002039.c20_s1: Aren't my wings shiny and pretty?
5002039.c20_s2: I'm such a cute, fuzzy bumblebee!
5002039.c20_s3: Pets are still cute if they eat a lot... right?
5002039.c20_s4: Would I look better if my antennae were super long?
5002039.c20_f2: I'm cute but not all that chatty.
5002039.c20_f3: I think I'm a little hungry.
5002039.c20_f4: I've got nothing to say, but I've got a lot of things I want to eat!
5002039.c21_s2: I want to wear pretty clothes... Can bees wear clothes?
5002039.c21_s3: I'm a busy bee, but I've always got time for friends!
5002039.c21_s4: Would I be cuter as a kitty?
5002039.c21_f2: I don't really have anything to talk about...
5002039.f2_s: How did you know I'm hungry?
5002039.f4_s: Oh! Is this my reward? It's delicious!
5002039.s2: Whoa, did you really just say that?

5002040.c2_s1: Let's rest here for a while.
5002040.c2_s2: Am I good? Gimme a treat!
5002040.c2_s3: I guess we could follow the five-second rule.
5002040.c2_s4: Happy to! These dogs are barkin'!
5002040.c2_f3: I don't think you're taking this seriously!
5002040.c3_s1: You sit down, too! You look tired!
5002040.c3_s2: I like to take things nice and easy.
5002040.c3_s4: I love sitting on soft ground.
5002040.c3_f2: I think there's dirt on me!
5002040.c3_f4: I'm so cold. Gimme a blanket!
5002040.c4_s1: Okay! With you at my side, I can do anything!
5002040.c4_s3: I like your big, cushiony legs for that.
5002040.c4_f1: C'mon! Let's go see something cool!
5002040.c4_f3: If you want a seat, just take one yourself.
5002040.c4_f4: This is boring. Let's try something challenging!
5002040.c7_s2: Please don't be mad. You're my only family.
5002040.c8_s1: You're doing this for my own good, aren't you?
5002040.c8_s2: Hearing that makes me so sad.
5002040.c8_s4: I'm sorry for hurting your feelings...
5002040.c8_f2: It was just a tiny mistake.
5002040.c8_f3: Let's talk when you've calmed down.
5002040.c11_s1: I can't stop thinking about you!
5002040.c11_s2: You can say that a hundred times, and I won't get tired of it.
5002040.c11_f3: Nah, let's just have some juice or something.
5002040.c12_s4: I'm happy that you're my buddy.
5002040.c12_f1: That's nice... But you smell funny.
5002040.c12_f2: I don't have the energy to reply.
5002040.c12_f3: Money over love, pal. Pay me!
5002040.c13_s3: I'll really pour myself into this one!
5002040.c13_s4: I'm sure I can squeeze somethin' outta these buns.
5002040.c13_f4: This is neither the time nor the place!
5002040.c14_s4: I clean up after myself. I'm so squeaky clean!
5002040.c14_f4: So many eyes here, I can't poop...
5002040.c15_s1: It feels soooooo good to go.
5002040.c15_s3: Will you play with me when I'm done?
5002040.c15_s4: So much poo... Like my love for you!
5002040.c15_f1: I don't know what poop is.
5002040.c16_s4: I suppose I could use a dog-nap.
5002040.c16_f2: Are you sleepy? I'm not sleepy.
5002040.c16_f3: It's not time for bed yet.
5002040.c16_f4: It's not time to sleep yet!
5002040.c17_s2: I love being all BUN-dled up to sleep...
5002040.c17_s3: We even sleep the same now!
5002040.c17_s4: I wanna sleep next to you!
5002040.c17_f1: You don't sleep, I don't sleep.
5002040.c17_f3: I'll see you in my dreams!
5002040.c18_s1: Good, I've been awake for too long...
5002040.c18_s3: Come lay down next to me.
5002040.c18_s4: I wouldn't mind resting on my bun for a bit.
5002040.c18_f1: Stop telling me what to do!
5002040.c18_f4: No, I want to talk and play!
5002040.c19_s1: Weenie dogs and baseball go great together!
5002040.c19_s3: If we run into something scary, you have to protect me.
5002040.c19_f1: What I'm going to tell you is totally secret...
5002040.c19_f3: Me no speak your language. Argh!
5002040.c20_s1: I swear, other weenie dogs are the wurst...
5002040.c20_s2: I'll eat whatever you feed me... because it's from you!
5002040.c20_s3: What do you call a hungry Dachshund? A halloweenie! Ha!
5002040.c20_s4: I just wanna talk with you all day long!
5002040.c20_f1: With weather like this, I'm sure great items are bound to drop!
5002040.c20_f2: Oh. You speak Dachshund now. Great...
5002040.c20_f3: What do I need to say?
5002040.c20_f4: Give me all your potions and you can hunt more easily!
5002040.c21_s1: I love a good bratwurst with sauerkraut, don't you?
5002040.c21_s2: You got any other pets I could be friends with?
5002040.c21_s4: We should hit the beach sometime. I'm great at parties!
5002040.f1_s: This is the greatest flavor in the world!
5002040.f2_s: Everything you give me is good!
5002040.s2: What goes around, comes around, you know?

5002075.c1_s2: Ha! Sitting's so easy! Give me a harder one!
5002075.c1_f2: I'm not sure I like that.
5002075.c2_s3: I suppose I'll comply this once.
5002075.c2_f2: You think I'll listen to you?
5002075.c3_s1: When you need to rest, you need to rest!
5002075.c3_f2: Why should I, the great Taotie, listen to you?
5002075.c4_s3: It's nice to rest now and again.
5002075.c5_f1: You think you can stop me?!
5002075.c5_f2: Just who do you think I am?
5002075.c6_f3: How dare you speak this way to the great Taotie?
5002075.c7_f2: Do you hear yourself right now?
5002075.c7_f4: Did you think I'm some kind of pushover?
5002075.c10_s1: Is that how you feel about me...? I see.
5002075.c10_s2: I'm flattered! I'm blushing and everything!
5002075.c10_f1: How dare you tease your elder?!
5002075.c10_f2: Prepare for the scolding of your life....
5002075.c11_s4: I suppose I like you a little.
5002075.c12_f1: I will sup on your bones!
5002075.c13_f2: Why you! What did you just say to me?
5002075.c13_f3: Just who do you think I am?
5002075.c14_f2: Just who do you think I am?
5002075.c15_s1: Could you turn around for a minute?
5002075.c15_f1: Why you! What did you just say to me?
5002075.c15_f2: Don't you know who I am? I am Taotie!
5002075.c15_f3: How dare you? I am one of the Four Perils!
5002075.c15_f4: I'll overlook this outrage for now.
5002075.c16_s2: Turn the lights off, will you?
5002075.c16_s3: Right. We should rest a bit.
5002075.c17_s3: You should get some sleep too.
5002075.c18_s3: You should get some sleep too.
5002075.c18_f2: You'd better keep an eye out.
5002075.c18_f4: How can you sleep at a time like this?
5002075.c19_s3: I will sup on your bones!
5002075.c19_f2: So you know, this is what it looks like when I don't care.
5002075.c19_f4: I don't feel like talking right now..
5002075.c20_s2: Shut your yap and bring me something to eat.
5002075.c20_s4: What do kids do for fun these days?
5002075.c20_f4: You kids are all the same...
5002075.c21_s2: I, the great Taotie, am without equal!
5002075.c21_s3: The world cries out for Taotie!
5002075.c21_s4: So what's in style these days?
5002075.f3_s: I've never tasted anything like this.
5002075.s2: I know you are, but what am I?!
5002075.s3: What a terrible thing to say!

5002079.c1_f2: I'll do it on my own.
5002079.c2_f4: You're not the boss of me!
5002079.c3_s2: I'm in a good mood. Why not?
5002079.c3_s3: You want me to rest, right?
5002079.c3_s4: I'll listen, since it's your request.
5002079.c3_f2: Who wants to sit on the hard ground?
5002079.c4_s1: Could you sit next to me?
5002079.c4_s4: I'm not real big on following orders.
5002079.c5_s2: Your face gets all red and veiny when you're mad.
5002079.c7_f4: Do you want to get in trouble?
5002079.c8_s2: I'm sorry. I'll do better next time.
5002079.c8_f1: How do I leave the inventory?
5002079.c8_f2: Have you heard the word 'runaway' before?
5002079.c8_f3: Did you really say that? I didn't hear you type it.
5002079.c12_s1: Say it to me every day!
5002079.c12_s2: You're the best in the world.
5002079.c13_s1: Um... Is it supposed to look like that?
5002079.c13_s4: Uh, this might take a minute.
5002079.c13_f3: How could a cultured person just say that?
5002079.c14_s1: Um... Is it supposed to look like that?
5002079.c14_s2: Okay, breathing... pushing... breathing... This is so gross.
5002079.c14_s3: Okay, but why are you so fascinated with this?
5002079.c14_s4: Oh... Okay, but maybe give me some privacy?
5002079.c15_s1: Oh! I feel so much lighter!
5002079.c15_s3: Time to push like I'm giving birth!
5002079.c15_f3: You could ask me to do OTHER things...
5002079.c16_f3: You just don't want to play with me, do you?
5002079.c17_s1: Okay, but only if you sing me a lullaby.
5002079.c17_s4: Thank you for the pony pillow.
5002079.c17_f3: Trying to sneak out somewhere once I doze off?
5002079.c18_f3: But what if I overdose on sleep?
5002079.c18_f4: My pajamas haven't been washed, though...
5002079.c19_s2: Is there a word you want me to say?
5002079.c19_s4: Are you good at horseback riding?
5002079.c20_s1: Glory and Lil Pony are in a bad mood...
5002079.c21_s1: I style my hair every morning to get this great look.
5002079.c21_s2: I met Glory in horseback riding classes.
5002079.c21_s3: I have another 100 sets of this outfit. Gotta keep up my image!
5002079.c21_s4: I get new carrots from the carrot farm every day.
5002079.c21_f1: You should learn how to play on your own.
5002079.c21_f2: What's with you all of the sudden?
5002079.s2: You know that's a bad word, right?

5002080.c1_s2: I guess I could do that... for you.
5002080.c2_s3: Sure. But you better not ask too often, okay?
5002080.c3_s1: Hmph. You know how to pick a spot.
5002080.c3_s2: You know how to levitate too?
5002080.c3_f2: Hey, are you trying to order me around?
5002080.c4_s1: Don't get me wrong. I sat because I wanted to.
5002080.c4_s2: This place makes me feel comfortable.
5002080.c4_s3: I'm perfect even when I'm sitting down.
5002080.c4_f2: Ha! How dare you order me!
5002080.c4_f3: What did you say just now?
5002080.c6_s3: How could you do that to me?
5002080.c6_s4: Your face gets all red and veiny when you're mad.
5002080.c7_s3: Oh yeah? I don't like you either...
5002080.c7_f3: Do you really think you have the upper hand here?
5002080.c8_s1: I'm sorry for making you sad.
5002080.c8_f1: Are you taking your anger out on me?
5002080.c8_f3: I can't hear you. Did you say something?
5002080.c8_f4: Just letting off some steam, right?
5002080.c11_f4: I have no respect for you right now.
5002080.c12_s2: That makes me happy to hear.
5002080.c12_s3: Be sure to tell me that tomorrow, too.
5002080.c12_s4: You should psend time with me every day.
5002080.c12_f1: You can't just say something like that out of the blue!
5002080.c12_f3: A mark of good taste, for sure.
5002080.c12_f4: You have high standards too, eh?
5002080.c14_s1: Don't look while I'm doing it!
5002080.c14_f3: I don't think we're on the same page here.
5002080.c15_s2: Hehe, well, maybe just a little...
5002080.c15_s3: What's going on right now is a secret!
5002080.c15_s4: I'm checking to make sure it doesn't stink!
5002080.c15_f3: You ask for the weirdest things!
5002080.c17_s2: My pony pillow is the prettiest.
5002080.c17_s3: See you in my drea ms.
5002080.c17_f3: You want me to sleep here?
5002080.c17_f4: Ask me again in an hour.
5002080.c18_s1: I wanted to wear my new pajamas.
5002080.c18_f3: I can only sleep on a bed.
5002080.c18_f4: Why do you always order me around?
5002080.c19_s1: Hehe, don't you think my hair's prety? I dyed it!
5002080.c19_s2: You should keep me with you all the time, instead of those other pets.
5002080.c19_s3: When it comes to equestrian clothing, you can't beat red!
5002080.c19_s4: Don't tell him I said so, but I'm faster than Victory.
5002080.c19_f2: Aww, but it's such a bother.
5002080.c19_f4: What do you want to know?
5002080.c20_s2: How's my hairstlye? Pretty cute, huh?
5002080.c20_s3: The pompom on my hat helps me stand out!
5002080.c20_s4: I want to be with Pony and Victory.
5002080.c20_f3: What do you want to talk about?
5002080.c21_s1: Are you good at horseback riding? Let's race sometime.
5002080.c21_s2: Pony only likes fresh carrots, but sometimes it's hard to get them.
5002080.c21_s3: Where can you buy good equestrian clothing?
5002080.c21_s4: Anything fun going on in your life lately?
5002080.f2_f: I don't want to eat anymore.
5002080.f4_f: The taste doesn't jive with me.
5002080.s2: You're in a class all your own.
5002080.s3: It's not enough to say nice things for just a day.
5002080.s4: I thought you were more eloquent than that. Guess not.

5002081.c2_s2: I'm a good pony, yes I am.
5002081.c2_f3: Look at this burst of speed!
5002081.c3_s1: Carrot power keeps me goin' strong!
5002081.c3_f3: I can't stop my need...for speed!
5002081.c4_s1: Am I the sitter, or the sit-ee?
5002081.c4_f1: Why are you doing this to me?
5002081.c4_f2: I only listen to Glory and Victory.
5002081.c4_f3: You've gotta say it more politely.
5002081.c7_s2: I don't want to get in trouble...
5002081.c7_f4: You can fume AFTER you give me a carrot.
5002081.c8_s1: Feeling all this regret is gonna kill my appetite.
5002081.c8_s4: I'll do better from now on.
5002081.c8_f1: We're both mammals. Let's not bicker while the birds conspire against us.
5002081.c8_f3: We should be more polite to each other.
5002081.c11_s4: I'll pretend I didn't hear that.
5002081.c12_s1: I love you even more than carrots, maybe.
5002081.c12_s3: I hope we have many years together.
5002081.c12_s4: I feel the happiest I've ever felt!
5002081.c12_f1: There are some things you shouldn't say lightly.
5002081.c12_f3: You have to understand the other person's situation.
5002081.c12_f4: Maybe sleep on that and think about it in the morning.
5002081.c13_s1: Um... Is it supposed to look like that?
5002081.c13_s4: Uh, this might take a minute.
5002081.c14_s4: How many other ponies can use the potty?
5002081.c14_f1: I think I need a laxative first.
5002081.c14_f3: I can't just will poop to appear!
5002081.c15_s2: Thank you for your fastidious attention.
5002081.c15_s4: Keep a lookout for me, okay?
5002081.c15_f1: Weren't you more cultured than that?
5002081.c15_f3: Even as an amazing pony, I can't do that.
5002081.c15_f4: Some things are too outrageous for even you to ask.
5002081.c17_f1: I don't have any pajamas. Buy me some!
5002081.c17_f3: I can't sleep when it's sunny outside.
5002081.c18_s1: I think maybe you should fill a pillowcase with carrots so I can use that.
5002081.c18_f3: Let's not and say we did.
5002081.c18_f4: Do you dare to deign to me simply because I'm a pony?
5002081.c19_s3: My house is the bestest in the world.
5002081.c19_s4: What can I say? I've got the gift of gab.
5002081.c19_f3: Can we pretend I don't talk for a sec?
5002081.c20_s1: Even when I do nothing, I'm glorious.
5002081.c20_s3: I'm the best horse in the world.
5002081.c20_s4: Have you ever seen a prettier pony than me?
5002081.c20_f2: I'm taking a day off from being a good pony.
5002081.c20_f3: I'm a real rebel. A maverick!
5002081.c21_s1: Sometimes I favor a sugar cube over a carrot.
5002081.c21_s2: Fresh carrots every day. That's the deal.
5002081.c21_s3: My ideal horse? I'm gonna say blue. With a rainbow mane, of course.
5002081.c21_s4: I was BORN with hair this fabulous.
5002081.f2_f: I won't eat this second-rate cuisine.
5002081.f3_s: That's some good food you brought today.
5002081.s1: Wow... Even ponies wouldn't say that.
5002081.s2: Saying that makes you a bad person...

5002082.c1_f1: You're really hurting my feelings, you know.
5002082.c1_f2: Give me a good reason, and I'll consider it.
5002082.c2_s1: Thanks! My feet really needed the break.
5002082.c2_f1: ...down whenever I feel like it? Okay.
5002082.c2_f2: You're really hurting my feelings, you know.
5002082.c3_s3: Oh! I farted at the same time, and it scared me!
5002082.c3_f1: Give me a good reason, and I'll consider it.
5002082.c3_f2: Aw, I thought you were nice...
5002082.c3_f4: I don't feel like it. Deal with it.
5002082.c4_s3: Oh! I sat so fast, I bounced off the ground!
5002082.c4_f1: Aren't there more important things to do?
5002082.c4_f2: Why stop when we could go?
5002082.c4_f4: I can roll over too! Sometimes it even happens by accident.
5002082.c6_f2: You're so mean! I don't like you anymore!
5002082.c6_f3: How about I cook next time? Please.
5002082.c7_s1: You're really hurting my feelings, you know.
5002082.c7_f2: You're so mean! I don't like you anymore!
5002082.c7_f3: You be nice, or I'll tell on you!
5002082.c7_f4: You'll have to try harder than that to get to me.
5002082.c10_s1: Oh, that's so sweet of you!
5002082.c10_s3: I'm flattered! I'll cherish you always.
5002082.c10_s4: Really?! Do you love me the most?
5002082.c11_s3: I'm flattered! I'll cherish you always.
5002082.c13_s1: Um... Is it supposed to look like that?
5002082.c13_s4: Uh, this might take a minute.
5002082.c14_s1: Um... Is it supposed to look like that?
5002082.c14_s2: Okay, breathing... pushing... breathing... This is so gross.
5002082.c14_s4: Oh... Okay, but maybe give me some privacy?
5002082.c14_f1: Not with you staring at me like a creep!
5002082.c14_f2: Can I read a book if I do?
5002082.c15_s1: Uh, you might want to stand back...

5002082.c15_f3: Are you kidding? I've been backed up for ages.
5002082.c15_f4: Why? You collecting it or something?
5002082.c16_s4: Maybe that's not such a bad idea.
5002082.c16_f3: You're so mean! I don't like you anymore!
5002082.c21_s2: Do you think I say 'rawr' too much?

5002085.c2_s1: I was thinking about doing that anyway.
5002085.c2_s2: Good idea. Let's take a little rest.
5002085.c2_s3: You mean right here, right now?
5002085.c3_s1: Does that mean it's time for a picnic?
5002085.c3_s3: I really don't feel like getting up again...
5002085.c3_s4: Just the thing for tired feet.
5002085.c3_f3: I'd prefer to sit somewhere cleaner.
5002085.c3_f4: But I want to run away to the magical cookie land!
5002085.c4_s2: I was actually feeling a bit tired.
5002085.c4_s3: Let me lie down. It's more comfortable as I get older.
5002085.c4_f1: Ouch! I think I stepped on a thorn.
5002085.c4_f3: I can't. I have a big zit on my butt.
5002085.c5_f1: You're mad 'cause I ate too much, aren't you?
5002085.c5_f2: Are you getting up in my grill?
5002085.c7_s1: I promise I won't do it anymore.
5002085.c7_s4: You're can be scary when you're upset...
5002085.c8_f2: I'm telling you, it wasn't me!
5002085.c8_f3: Feed me first, THEN punish me!
5002085.c10_f2: You shouldn't say it unless you mean it.
5002085.c10_f3: I'll pretend you didn't say that.
5002085.c11_s3: Can I leap into your arms?
5002085.c11_f1: Uh... Maybe keep it to yourself.
5002085.c11_f3: That's not what I want to hear!
5002085.c12_s1: I want a big, tasty cookie.
5002085.c12_s2: I'm so happy I met you!
5002085.c12_f1: I can't really return the affection.
5002085.c13_s1: Got any paper? I'm all out.
5002085.c13_s4: I could do this all day!
5002085.c13_f1: I don't want to do that.
5002085.c14_f2: I don't feel the rumblings yet.
5002085.c14_f3: Try as I might, it's just not coming.
5002085.c14_f4: How can you do... In a place like this...
5002085.c15_s3: Hide me from view while I do the deed.
5002085.c15_f1: Is that all you can think about?
5002085.c15_f2: I don't need to go! Do you, master?
5002085.c15_f3: You've gotta give me time time.
5002085.c15_f4: What kind of request is that?
5002085.c17_s1: I'm sleepin' with one eye op... Zzzz...
5002085.c17_f2: You're going to run away as soon as I close my eyes!
5002085.c17_f3: Only if you go to sleep first.
5002085.c18_s3: Well, as long as you wake me up early tomorrow.
5002085.c18_f2: You want me to sleep in this two-star joint?
5002085.c18_f3: Hm? I don't think I heard you right.
5002085.c18_f4: But I don't want to sleep!
5002085.c19_s3: Are you good at baking cookies?
5002085.c19_s4: Let's go to a bakery together sometime.
5002085.c19_f3: You want me to talk, or just listen to you?
5002085.c19_f4: I'm afraid I have a sore throat right now.
5002085.c20_s2: What do you like more, cookies or candy?
5002085.c20_s3: This is a secret between you and me, but...I was made with multigrain flour.
5002085.c20_f3: I've just taken a vow of silence!
5002085.c21_s1: Come visit the cookie kingdom sometime.
5002085.c21_s2: I'm happy to tag along with you, master.
5002085.c21_s3: I'm afraid my cookie body will crumble.
5002085.c21_s4: Could you sprinkle a little flour on me?
5002085.c21_f1: Do you like the sound of my voice?
5002085.f1_s: It's nice of you to say so.
5002085.f2_f: Being loved takes a lot of energy.
5002085.f4_f: Could you just give it a rest?
5002085.s1: I have to say, I'm disappointed!
5002085.s3: I'm not going to say any bad words!

5002086.c2_f2: I don't want to do it.
5002086.c2_f3: I can make my own decisions.
5002086.c3_s1: It's good to give my feet a rest.
5002086.c3_s3: All that walking tired me out.
5002086.c3_f4: You can't tell me what to do!
5002086.c4_s2: What do you want me to sit? A baby?
5002086.c4_s3: I'm a fantastic sitter, just you watch!
5002086.c6_f2: What's with you all of the sudden?
5002086.c6_f4: Whoops. That was sloppy of me.
5002086.c7_f2: What did I do to make you angry?!
5002086.c8_s3: Okay, this one was my bad.
5002086.c8_f3: Is that the best you can do?
5002086.c10_s3: So this is what it feels like to be popular.
5002086.c10_f1: I dunno if I'm ready for that level of feelings.
5002086.c10_f2: Could you leave me alone for a while?
5002086.c11_s1: You'll always have a place in my heart!
5002086.c11_s3: Thanks. You're not so bad yourself.
5002086.c11_f1: Do you need to get your head checked out?
5002086.c11_f3: You wanna share this chew toy with me?
5002086.c12_s1: Show it through your actions...by buying me something!
5002086.c12_s2: You sure do know how to make a pet feel special.
5002086.c12_s4: Thanks. You're not so bad yourself.
5002086.c12_f1: Ack, that caught me off guard.
5002086.c12_f2: Do you like to see me squirm?
5002086.c12_f3: You shouldn't say things like that so lightly.
5002086.c13_s1: Just to let you know, it's coming out now.
5002086.c13_s2: I'm squeezing as hard as I can!
5002086.c13_s4: Um... Is it supposed to look like that?
5002086.c14_s2: I'm leaving the cleanup to you.
5002086.c14_f4: I can't! Not with everyone watching.
5002086.c15_s1: Cha-ching! I have pooped once again.
5002086.c15_s2: I have achieved oneness with my bowels.
5002086.c15_f1: I think I need a little more bran in my diet.
5002086.c17_s3: I hope I dream about something good.
5002086.c17_f2: It's way too early for that!
5002086.c18_s3: I'm gonna sleep like a champ!
5002086.c18_f4: How lazy do you think I am?
5002086.c19_s2: What foods do you like, master?
5002086.c19_s3: I just wanna lie down and plaaaay.
5002086.c20_s1: How many did you have before me?
5002086.c20_s3: Let's go to the farm together!
5002086.c20_s4: Do you think I can get a blanket made of beef?
5002086.c20_f2: Don't tell me what to do!
5002086.c21_s1: This egg blanket is surprisingly fluffy.
5002086.c21_s2: Why am I so hungry every day?
5002086.c21_s3: I want to eat some soft steamed eggs.
5002086.c21_s4: I can share my blanket if you want!
5002086.c21_f3: I wanna be alone right now.
5002086.s2: Even I don't come right out and say that!

5002113.c2_s1: I'm extra adorable when I sit. Look!
5002113.c2_s2: Stay right here next to me!
5002113.c2_s3: I sat like you told me to!
5002113.c2_f1: You go ahead and just stay put.
5002113.c3_s2: As long as I can sit next to you!
5002113.c3_s4: I love sitting on soft ground.
5002113.c3_f1: I'm sorry, but I can't do it!
5002113.c3_f3: We can't play if we're sitting. Let's go play!
5002113.c3_f4: I'm so cold. Gimme a blanket!
5002113.c4_s1: Anything for the wonderful person who feeds me!
5002113.c4_s2: What's a good position to sit and look cute in?
5002113.c4_f1: This is boring. Let's try something challenging!
5002113.c4_f3: We need to exercise, not sit!
5002113.c6_s3: Please don't yell at me like that. I like you!
5002113.c6_s4: Those words make me tear up...
5002113.c6_f4: Did something bad happen to you today?
5002113.c7_s1: I love you and I am sorry.
5002113.c7_f1: I don't even know what I did wrong!
5002113.c8_s1: I'm just trying to please you!
5002113.c8_s3: Please go easy on me this time...
5002113.c8_f2: How can you get so mad?
5002113.c11_s2: So sweet, I don't even know!
5002113.c11_s3: I can't stop thinking about you!
5002113.c11_s4: I love you! I love you!
5002113.c11_f3: La la la... I don't care!
5002113.c11_f4: I'm sorry, but I'm not an easy pet to please!
5002113.c12_s4: I... Well, shucks, I love you, too.
5002113.c12_f2: I don't have the energy to reply.
5002113.c12_f3: I was going to say something, but... Nah, forget it.
5002113.c12_f4: Money over love, pal. Pay me!
5002113.c13_s1: I'll really pour myself into this one!
5002113.c14_s1: Pooping makes me feel lighter! I may be a born pooper!
5002113.c14_f1: You have a weird fascination with my bathroom habits.
5002113.c14_f2: How many times a day do you want me to go?
5002113.c14_f3: I can't just go anywhere! Eww!
5002113.c14_f4: You're not even carrying a baggie!
5002113.c15_s2: I need to go... Can you cover me?
5002113.c15_s3: You tell me to go... I will go...
5002113.c15_s4: It feels soooooo good to go.
5002113.c15_f4: How much do you think I have in me?
5002113.c16_s4: Maybe a little catnap would be good.
5002113.c16_f1: Are you sleepy? I'm not sleepy.
5002113.c16_f3: I can't if I'm not sleepy.
5002113.c17_s1: We even sleep the same now!
5002113.c17_s4: I'll see you in my dreams.
5002113.c17_f1: At least sing me a lullaby!
5002113.c17_f2: This is no time to sleep!
5002113.c18_s1: You go to sleep too, master.
5002113.c18_s3: I want to sleep on your lap...
5002113.c18_s4: Good, I've been awake for too long...
5002113.c18_f2: No, I want to talk and play!
5002113.c19_s1: You hunt. I'll feed you potions.
5002113.c19_s2: If we run into something scary, you have to protect me.
5002113.c19_s3: The grass fields of Henesys are so nice.
5002113.c19_s4: Pets can talk. Isn't that weird?
5002113.c19_f2: Me no speak your language. Argh!
5002113.c19_f3: Why are you always so chatty?
5002113.c19_f4: What I'm going to tell you is totally secret...
5002113.c20_s1: I want to go on a journey with you!
5002113.c20_s2: I am not talking to you because I like you.
5002113.c20_s3: We all speak different languages, you know.
5002113.c20_s4: Niki in the Night Market is so creepy.
5002113.c20_f2: Give me all your potions and you can hunt more easily!
5002113.c20_f3: If you feed me a lot, I'll love you even more.
5002113.c20_f4: Are you bored? Let's go get facials!
5002113.c21_s2: You're the best. Nobody gives me as much food as you!
5002113.c21_s3: There's a statue that looks just like me at the Floating Market.
5002113.c21_s4: Take me for a walk. I'm a total chick magnet!
5002113.c21_f1: I'd rather listen to you talk.
5002113.c21_f2: I can't hear you! I can't hear you!
5002113.c21_f3: My throat hurts. I was chatting with a Husky all night.
5002113.c21_f4: Tell me what you want to say first.
5002113.f1_f: Arg... I'm too full! It's impossible to eat anymore...
5002113.f2_s: Come eat with me. It's delicious!
5002113.f3_f: If I eat any more, I'll burst!
5002113.f4_s: Anything from you HAS to be yummy.

5002137.c1_s1: ...I'll let it slide just this once.
5002137.c2_s1: I guess I could do that... for you.
5002137.c2_s2: Sure. I can do it once.
5002137.c3_s1: Just what are you up to?
5002137.c3_s2: Would you like to sit together?
5002137.c3_f4: I'd prefer not to, thank you.
