5002640.c2_f1: It's not like I don't want to listen to you, but...
5002640.c3_s2: When you sit, you can stars that are super-far away!
5002640.c3_f1: I'm so hungry I don't have the energy to sit.
5002640.c4_s1: You want me to sit still?
5002640.c4_s2: You sit on the moon with me!
5002640.c4_s4: I should sit if you say so.
5002640.c6_f1: I'm not going to take it anymore!
5002640.c8_s2: I deserve this. That's all I'll say.
5002640.c8_s3: I deserve to be disciplined when I do something wrong.
5002640.c8_f1: Keep this up, and I'll go to the moon!
5002640.c11_s2: I love you, I love you!
5002640.c12_f3: Give me some food and I'll think about it.
5002640.c12_f4: You want to back that up?
5002640.c13_s3: Go look at that star! The one over there!
5002640.c14_s1: How did you know I waned to go to the bathroom?
5002640.c14_f2: Look out for yourself, why don't you...
5002640.c15_s4: I'm not doing it because you told me to!
5002640.c15_f4: How can I go when I didn't eat anything?
5002640.c18_s1: Falling asleep under the moonlight is so romantic!
5002640.c18_s3: How did you know I was sleepy?
5002640.c18_f2: How can you sleep at this hour?
5002640.c19_s1: Which is my favorite between pet food, Dry Treats, and Wondercookie? Why not try them yourself?
5002640.c19_s4: You know, the moon and stars look better up close!
5002640.c19_f1: I'm not in the mood to talk.
5002640.c20_s2: I was flying over that way yesterday. What's the point of the story? I don't know!
5002640.c20_s3: Hmm.. so... your head... is too big...
5002640.c20_s4: Hey... your arms and legs are short. Pfft!
5002640.c21_s1: I bet there used to be more stars in the sky...
5002640.c21_s2: Have you ever seen a more elegant butterfly?
5002640.c21_s3: Do you prefer a full moon or a crescent?
5002640.c21_s4: I love the moon! Why? Just 'cause!
5002640.c21_f1: I don't have much to say...
5002640.c21_f2: We're not that close, you know?
5002640.f1_s: I'll eat, recover, and help with hunting!
5002640.s2: You don't have to say that.

5002641.c2_s1: My wings were getting tired anyways.
5002641.c2_s2: Time to take a load off!
5002641.c2_s3: Man, I needed to sit down!
5002641.c2_f2: Do you have anything that goes bang?
5002641.c3_s2: I'll be on top of the moon!
5002641.c3_s3: I like just sitting down and people watching.
5002641.c3_s4: I'm such a good listener, aren't I?
5002641.c3_f1: I want to be alone. Everyone, please log out.
5002641.c4_s1: You really like sitting, don't you?
5002641.c4_s2: I'll sit down and have a conversation with the moon.
5002641.c4_s4: My legs were killing me anyways. Wait... I don't walk!
5002641.c4_f1: Don't tell me what to do!
5002641.c4_f3: Taking a break is a luxury.
5002641.c6_s1: I'm sorry, so don't be angry, please?
5002641.c6_s3: Angry faces will give you wrinkles!
5002641.c6_f3: I could get angry too, you know?!
5002641.c6_f4: Being a master doesn't mean you can treat me like this!
5002641.c8_s3: Don't be so angry! I'll apologize for everything!
5002641.c8_f4: Keep it up and I'll drop a shooting star on you!
5002641.c11_s3: You look so good today, master!
5002641.c11_f3: Why are you looking somewhere else, then?
5002641.c12_s2: I'm so happy to hear that!
5002641.c13_s1: Man, I'm super healthy, aren't I?
5002641.c15_f4: I don't need to go right now.
5002641.c16_s1: To the realm of dreams and the moon!
5002641.c16_s2: All right. I'm taking a nap!
5002641.c16_s3: That's all for today! Good night!
5002641.c16_f1: I can't sleep with all that noise!
5002641.c16_f3: Huh? What are you talking about?
5002641.c16_f4: Still a long way to go!
5002641.c17_s1: You can tell I'm sleepy, huh?
5002641.c17_f2: You shouldn't sleep all the time like that!
5002641.c17_f3: I can't sleep when it's this cold.
5002641.c18_s1: When the moon hits your eye!
5002641.c18_s3: Better sleep while I still can!
5002641.c19_s1: Did you know that a long time ago, butterflies could swim?
5002641.c19_s3: Have... you ever been to the Temple of Darkness?
5002641.c19_s4: Now a question for you! What do you think it'll take to earn my love?
5002641.c20_s1: When I followed my dreams, I fluttered until I found the moon!
5002641.c20_s2: I'm a butterfly! Free to fly anywhere, anytime!
5002641.c20_s3: The moon puts on a lot of weight, but it loses it fast too!
5002641.c20_s4: Ah, enough with all the talking!
5002641.c20_f1: Why don't you start us off?
5002641.c20_f2: I just can't talk with you...
5002641.c21_s1: I never know what to say. ...That counts as saying something, right?
5002641.c21_s2: Do you know what my dream is?
5002641.c21_s3: I was a caterpillar, once upon a time. But now I'm my beautiful self!
5002641.c21_s4: I like flowers and the moon!
5002641.c21_f1: I don't have a lot to say...
5002641.c21_f3: We should be quiet in a public place like this.
5002641.f2_f: Nah, you really don't have to...
5002641.f3_f: I think... I may have had too much.
5002641.f4_s: So good! Want to share with me?

5002642.c2_s2: Taking a break is always good!
5002642.c2_s4: Sure, I could go for a nice break.
5002642.c4_s1: Since you said it so sweetly, I'll listen to you!
5002642.c4_s2: All this sitting has made my gut bigger...
5002642.c4_s3: How do I look sitting down?
5002642.c4_s4: I'm not sitting down because I'm tired! I'm not!
5002642.c4_f4: Come on... Stop telling me to sit...
5002642.c6_f3: Being a master doesn't mean you get a free pass!
5002642.c7_s4: Aren't you being a little prickly?
5002642.c7_f1: Hmph. I'm not playing with you.
5002642.c8_s2: *sob* You're mad because you care, right?
5002642.c8_s3: I get sad when you're angry...
5002642.c8_s4: I'm sorry. My fault, I admit it...
5002642.c8_f1: Can you really stay angry at a face like mine?
5002642.c8_f3: You look really ugly right now.
5002642.c10_s3: I love you so much, my sweet!
5002642.c10_f1: You're really not the type I go for...
5002642.c11_s1: Oh my, oh my, oh my!
5002642.c11_s2: Save it for when we're alone!
5002642.c11_s4: Can you feel my love for you too?
5002642.c11_f1: You can put those feelings away.
5002642.c11_f3: Well you certainly have good taste.
5002642.c12_s1: I'll follow you until the end of the world!
5002642.c12_s3: I'm so happy to hear that!
5002642.c12_s4: I hope your heart never changes!
5002642.c12_f2: Oh, please. How about a cup of coffee?
5002642.c12_f3: Oh, man, are you still single?
5002642.c13_s4: I have a healthy digestive system.
5002642.c13_f1: Hmm, this isn't really the time or the place...
5002642.c13_f4: I've been kind of constipated lately...
5002642.c14_f1: What are people going to think if I do that here?!
5002642.c14_f3: I don't think it's time yet...
5002642.c15_f2: I think I'm going through some constipation...
5002642.c15_f4: You're kind of putting me on the spot...
5002642.c16_s2: I'll sleep, but you keep watch.
5002642.c16_s3: You have to protect me while I sleep, all right?
5002642.c16_f3: I'm not going to sleep right now!
5002642.c17_s1: At least on a bed... Zzz...
5002642.c17_s4: I'll see you tomorrow, fresh and charged!
5002642.c17_f4: Sometimes, I don't want to listen to you!
5002642.c18_s2: Goodnight to the moon and stars... Zzz...
5002642.c18_s3: The core of my skin care is... good sleep.
5002642.c18_s4: The moon is rising, and I'm going to sleep.
5002642.c18_f4: I'm not going to sleep first!
5002642.c19_s1: You should try harder. At everything, you know?
5002642.c19_s2: Do you like fall or spring? I like fall.
5002642.c19_s3: If you ever ended up on an abandoned island, what would you do?
5002642.c19_s4: What's most precious to you? For me, it's the moon.
5002642.c20_s1: I can float on the moon, even if I don't move my wings.
5002642.c20_s2: Can you guess how old I am? If you get it right, I'll give you my love!
5002642.c20_s3: Did you know that the moon and the stars are completely different worlds?
5002642.c20_s4: Talk, talk, talk... but I really don't know what to say!
5002642.c20_f1: I'm a little bit of an introvert...
5002642.c20_f2: We're not close enough to talk.
5002642.c20_f3: Do you not have other friends?
5002642.c21_s2: Because I'm feeling just so peachy!
5002642.c21_s3: Once upon a time, there was a butterfly named Butterfly...
5002642.c21_s4: Can you understand me? We should be talking in different languages!
5002642.c21_f1: Are you bored? I'm not really sure what you need.
5002642.f3_f: If I keep at it, I'll get fat.
5002642.s2: You want a piece of me?
5002642.s4: You don't have to say that.

5002655.c2_f1: There will be time for sitting later!
5002655.c3_s1: Sure I could use a rest.
5002655.c3_s4: No trick is too tricky for me!
5002655.c3_f1: Nope. Not doing it. Ask your other pets.
5002655.c3_f2: I'll get dirt on my scales.
5002655.c3_f4: Don't tell me what to do.
5002655.c4_s3: When I sit, I like to think about the past.
5002655.c4_f3: What'd you say? I can't hear you!
5002655.c5_s1: Who do you think you are?
5002655.c5_f2: You should set a better example, you know.
5002655.c6_s2: Why are you so mad at me?!
5002655.c7_s2: Fine, I won't do it again.
5002655.c8_s2: I won't make that mistake twice.
5002655.c8_s3: Come on, we can talk about this.
5002655.c8_s4: If you keep this up, I'm going to cry.
5002655.c8_f1: If I were just a bit younger... I would take you on.
5002655.c8_f2: What exactly did I do wrong?!
5002655.c10_s4: So many fans, so little time to crush all their hearts.
5002655.c10_f4: Laying it on a little thick, are we?
5002655.c11_s1: Yes, yes. I like you too.
5002655.c11_s4: You can say it a hundred times and it'll still make me smile.
5002655.c11_f4: You didn't eat anything strange, did you?
5002655.c12_s1: I could get used to this.
5002655.c12_s4: How could you not? I'm adorable!
5002655.c14_s3: Oh gosh. Where's the air freshener?
5002655.c16_s2: I was about to sleep anyway.
5002655.c16_f2: I'm going to keep my eyes wide open.
5002655.c16_f3: Must... stay awake... Can't... miss... awesome stuff...
5002655.c17_s1: All right, getting some shut eye.
5002655.c17_f1: Not sleepy. Why don't YOU sleep?
5002655.c17_f3: I'm going to keep my eyes wide open.
5002655.c18_s1: Whatever! I can sleep when I want.
5002655.c18_s4: I'm going to be out for a whiiile.
5002655.c18_f1: Buy me a comfy bed first!
5002655.c19_s2: Take a break, bop some monsters.
5002655.c19_s4: I could really go for some Magic Stones.
5002655.c19_f1: What am I supposed to say?
5002655.c19_f2: That sounds like a lot of work right now...
5002655.c20_s1: Nobody in Maple World stands a chance against OUR cuteness!
5002655.c20_s3: We're one concert away from stardom.
5002655.c20_f1: Let's just focus on hunting, shall we?
5002655.c20_f4: I'm having a moment. Let's not.
5002655.c21_s1: Okay, fine. What's the coolest thing about me?
5002655.c21_f1: Let's just have a moment of silence, okay?
5002655.c21_f4: Let's play the quiet game instead.
5002655.f4_s: I could get used to this.
5002655.s2: You should really be more polite.
5002655.s4: I'm a lot older than you, you know.

5002662.c3_s3: Feels good to take a load off.
5002662.c3_f1: But I want to play some more!
5002662.c4_s1: Should I rest for a while?
5002662.c4_f2: Let's go for a walk instead!
5002662.c4_f4: Sometimes I wanna change things up.
5002662.c6_s1: Why are you doing this to me?
5002662.c6_s2: I'm too cute to accept this sort of treatment!
5002662.c6_s3: I don't want to be punished.
5002662.c6_f3: I don't want to be punished.
5002662.c6_f4: Don't yell at me! I still love you!
5002662.c7_s1: I didn't know it would come to this...
5002662.c7_s4: You don't hate me, do you?
5002662.c7_f1: Tell me what I did wrong!
5002662.c7_f2: How could you do this to me?
5002662.c7_f3: I've learned my lesson. It won't happen again...
5002662.c8_f2: I hate when you get mad for no reason.
5002662.c8_f3: Was that really worth getting mad over?
5002662.c8_f4: Let's talk it out over food.
5002662.c10_s2: I liked you from the start.
5002662.c10_s4: I liked you from the start.
5002662.c11_s3: That always gets me a little giddy.
5002662.c11_f1: I didn't hear you! Say it again!
5002662.c11_f2: Your face is red. Are you okay?
5002662.c12_s2: I'll always be by your side!
5002662.c12_f2: Weren't you mad at me earlier?
5002662.c13_f3: Don't ask me to do that!
5002662.c14_s4: It doesn't even smell, does it?
5002662.c14_f4: Why are you telling me to do this?
5002662.c16_s2: Maybe a little sleep would be good.
5002662.c17_s2: This is a pretty good spot for a nap.
5002662.c17_s3: I leave the rest to you!
5002662.c17_f2: It's not time for bed yet!
5002662.c17_f3: I want to play a little more.
5002662.c19_s1: Believe it or not, I love the summer!
5002662.c19_s3: You can always lean on me!
5002662.c19_f4: I have a lot on my mind lately...
5002662.c20_s1: It's the season for nice, warm bun.
5002662.c20_s3: How old do you think I am?
5002662.c20_f2: A long time ago, in a far away land...
5002662.c21_s1: Do you think it'll snow soon?
5002662.c21_s2: Where do you think Santa and the Rosy Reindeer are?
5002662.c21_f1: There's no time to talk! We need to train!
5002662.c21_f2: Wouldn't it be nice to have some quiet time?
5002662.c21_f3: I'm a bit busy right now!
5002662.f2_s: Why does it taste so good?
5002662.f2_f: I don't want to eat anymore.
5002662.s1: I want you to ask me nicely!

5002665.c1_s1: Knowing when to rest is also important.
5002665.c1_s2: I love playing on the swings!
5002665.c2_s1: Want to play on the swing?
5002665.c3_s1: I want to swing real high!
5002665.c3_s2: I want play on a swing!
5002665.c4_s2: I think I can smell flowers from somewhere!
5002665.c4_s3: Flowers bloom in a garden, and I bloom next to you!
5002665.c4_f3: Thanks, but I don't really feel like it.
5002665.c6_f1: You'll never cultivate fear in my heart.
5002665.c10_s1: I love you a whole lot too, Master!
5002665.c10_s2: I blossomed thanks to you, Master.
5002665.c10_s4: Master loves me... Loves me not... Loves me...
5002665.c12_s2: It's embarrassing, but I love you too, Master.
5002665.c12_s4: I love you as much as flowers!
5002665.c12_f1: Do you really love me the most in the whole world?
5002665.c14_s4: Where is that fresh scent coming from?
5002665.c15_s1: Can you pass me a wipe?
5002665.c15_f2: You think I can do that on command?
5002665.c15_f3: That's not how plants work, silly.
5002665.c16_s3: Want to catch some shut eye with me?
5002665.c16_f2: I'm not ready to go to sleep yet.
5002665.c17_s4: I hope I dream of flowers... Zzz...
5002665.c17_f4: I want to play some more.
5002665.c18_s2: Make sure to dream of me!
5002665.c19_s1: I want visit somewhere full of flowers.
5002665.c19_s3: What's the most beautiful flower in the world? Me, obviously!
5002665.c19_f1: Don't pick flowers you like. Part of their charm is where they grow.
5002665.c20_s1: Did you know figs are technically flowers?
5002665.c20_s2: You're as beautiful as any flower, Master.
5002665.c20_s4: I wonder which flowers we'll find today.
5002665.c21_s1: The color blue is actually pretty rare in nature.
5002665.c21_s3: I like you more than flowers, Master!
5002665.c21_s4: You know who is prettier than flowers? You!
5002665.c21_f1: I saw a withered flower and now I'm sad...

5002666.c2_s1: I want to swing on the swing!
5002666.c2_s2: I was about to sit anyways!
5002666.c4_s1: Sure, I wanted to check out these flowers!
5002666.c4_s3: I wonder what kind of flowers grow here.
5002666.c4_f1: If I sit any more, I'll end up taking root here!
5002666.c6_f1: You won't like flowers when they're angry.
5002666.c7_s1: I'll cry! I'm going to do it!
5002666.c7_s2: Do you see these tears? They're because of you.
5002666.c7_f2: You'll have to try harder than that to make me wilt!
5002666.c12_s3: I bloomed so I could love you!
5002666.c12_f3: Did you step on my flowers or something?
5002666.c15_f2: I'm gonna get angry if you keep it up...
5002666.c16_s3: Let's play together my dream, too!
5002666.c16_f1: I can see a bug over there...!
5002666.c17_f1: I'm not going to sleep right now!
5002666.c17_f2: But I feel like I'm going to have a bad dream...
5002666.c18_s4: Smelling so many flowers... makes me sleepy...
5002666.c18_f1: I'm not going to sleep right now!
5002666.c19_s1: I'm going to discover a new flower and write a botanical journal!
5002666.c19_s2: Did you see that flower? I call it: ME!
5002666.c19_s4: Don't pick flowers you like. Part of their charm is where they grow.
5002666.c20_s1: The most beautiful flower in the world is you!
5002666.c20_s2: Did you know figs are technically flowers?
5002666.c20_s4: What kinds of flowers will we find today?
5002666.c20_f4: Pass me some water, would you?
5002666.c21_s2: I wonder if the sun will come out today...
5002666.c21_s4: I see a bee and a butterfly! Are there flowers nearby?
5002666.c21_f1: I don't want to talk right now.

5002667.c1_s2: Butt on floor! Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle!
5002667.c2_s1: I wanted to take a break anyways!
5002667.c2_s3: Come on, let's get on a swing!
5002667.c2_s4: I want to ride a swing!
5002667.c2_f1: I'm going to lie down instead.
5002667.c3_s1: Everywhere I go smells like flowers.
5002667.c3_s2: When the flowers bloom, I bloom too!
5002667.c4_s2: I do that a lot! Thanks for noticing!
5002667.c4_s4: It feels like we're on a picnic at a flower field!
5002667.c4_f1: If I sit for too long, I may end up being a normal flower.
5002667.c5_s2: Who's the saddest flower in the world? Me...
5002667.c5_f1: At least my tears are will nourish the plants...
5002667.c6_f3: Do you want me to leave?
5002667.c7_f3: Why are you only mean to me?
5002667.c10_s3: If I could make a bouquet of every flower in the world, I would give it to you.
5002667.c11_s2: My love for you blooms like a flower.
5002667.c12_s1: I want to be a beautiful flower for you in every season.
5002667.c12_s2: I'm the world's happiest flower fairy.
5002667.c12_s3: One day, if I bear fruit, it'll be very beautiful.
5002667.c12_s4: I'm so moved... I love you too!
5002667.c15_s4: Do you think I can fertilize the soil?
5002667.c16_s3: I'll find you in my dreams!
5002667.c16_f1: Nah. I'm not going to sleep.
5002667.c16_f2: I want to play some more!
5002667.c17_s4: Let's hang out in our dreams, too!
5002667.c18_s4: Oh, good. I was getting sleepy.
5002667.c18_f2: But it's not night time yet...
5002667.c18_f4: Uh, I'm trying to photosynthesize here.
5002667.c19_s1: The flower on my head reflects my mood.
5002667.c19_s2: I'm glad to have met you.
5002667.c19_s3: When I was younger, I was nothing but a wee flower.
5002667.c19_s4: Since I've met you, I've been the happiest flower fairy ever.
5002667.c19_f1: I'm taking in the sun, give me a sec.
5002667.c20_s1: *gasp* Wait! You're about to step on a flower!
5002667.c20_s2: Even though flowers naturally wilt to bear fruit, it still makes me sad.
5002667.c20_s3: In the language of flowers, I mean 'I love my master!'
5002667.c20_s4: I'm the most beautiful flower fairy in the world. Don't you agree?
5002667.c21_s1: What's your favorite season? Mine's spring!
5002667.c21_s2: If it were up to me, flowers would be everywhere, every day of the year!
5002667.c21_s3: What kind of flower should we go see tomorrow?
5002667.c21_s4: I think I can smell flowers! In that direction!
5002667.c21_f4: I'm busy talking to a butterfly right now. Don't bother me.
5002667.s3: Do you think before you speak?

5002668.c1_s2: Butt on floor! Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle!
5002668.c2_s1: Butt on floor! Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle!
5002668.c2_s3: I did it! Now tell me what a great pet I am!
5002668.c2_s4: I sat down! Don't you want to clap for me?
5002668.c2_f3: My tooshie can only handle so much sitting in a day.
5002668.c2_f4: Okay, but if I can't get back up, I'm blaming you.
5002668.c3_s3: Now that I'm sitting, I want to lie down.
5002668.c3_s4: But if I sit, I won't want to get up.
5002668.c3_f1: Are you questioning my ability to stand?
5002668.c3_f4: Standing keeps me more alert. I'd rather do that.
5002668.c4_s2: I sat down! Gimme praise! Gimme treats! Gimme everything!
5002668.c4_s3: Cookies would be nice right about now.
5002668.c4_f1: I just got up! I'm not a machine!
5002668.c4_f2: But what if I sit on a bug? OH! What if the bug sits on me?!
5002668.c4_f3: But I don't want my butt to be dirty...
5002668.c4_f4: Hmph! I'm not the type of dear that takes orders.
5002668.c5_s1: Sorry... I've been a bad deer...
5002668.c6_s2: It's not fair! You yell at me all the time!
5002668.c6_s3: I can't hold back the tears anymore...
5002668.c6_s4: You're super scary when you're mad...
5002668.c6_f1: Some people know how to be more constructive about their anger. You should try it.
5002668.c6_f2: How could you do this to me?
5002668.c6_f3: How can you do this to little old me?
5002668.c7_s1: Every time you get mad, I just want to run away.
5002668.c7_s2: It's like you go out of your way to make me feel icky.
5002668.c7_s3: Calm down! I promise we can fix this!
5002668.c7_f1: You get mad at me so easily.
5002668.c7_f2: I can be mean too, you know? I just choose not to.
5002668.c7_f3: Getting angry and yelling about stuff only hurts you.
5002668.c7_f4: You must think I'm a pushover! I don't have to take that!
5002668.c8_s1: Aw, you used to think it was cute when I misbehaved.
5002668.c8_s2: Violence and anger don't solve anything!
5002668.c8_s4: I guess I made a mistake. I'm sorry.
5002668.c8_f1: I get in trouble all the time. It doesn't even phase me anymore.
5002668.c8_f2: If all you're going to do is get mad at me all the time, I'll just leave.
5002668.c8_f3: If you keep bothering me, I'll get my friend Yeti to help me.
5002668.c8_f4: Why can't you leave me alone?
5002668.c9_s1: I wish you could love me even more!
5002668.c9_s2: Do you think my wish for you to love me more will come true?
5002668.c9_f2: Are you sure you meant me?
5002668.c10_s2: You make this deer so happy!
5002668.c10_f2: Hmph! Deer only love other deer!
5002668.c10_f3: La la la! I can't hear you!
5002668.c11_s2: Hee hee, thank you for liking me.
5002668.c11_s4: Of course you do! I love you too!
5002668.c11_f1: I'll pretend I didn't hear that...
5002668.c11_f2: Say it once more, with feeling!
5002668.c11_f3: I don't think I can accept your love...
5002668.c11_f4: Ugh! You think you could save the mushy stuff until after I've eaten?
5002668.c12_s1: I'm so cute, you could love me twice as much as anyone else!
5002668.c12_s2: You LOVE me! You LOVE me! You said you LOVE me!
5002668.c12_s3: I always knew I was irresistible!
5002668.c12_f2: Hmph. I'm a picky deer, you know.
5002668.c12_f3: You think you could say that again while presenting me with tasty food?
5002668.c12_f4: Did I hear you right? Hang on, let me clean my ears first...
5002668.c13_s2: Do you maybe have some fiber to help things along?
5002668.c13_s3: Unnngh... Nope. I'll have to wait until the opportune moment.
5002668.c13_f2: Why are you so keen to make me poop?
5002668.c13_f3: I don't want to! It's gross!
5002668.c13_f4: You gonna make arts and crafts with it?
5002668.c14_s1: Do I have to do it right now? What would I clean up with?
5002668.c14_s2: Daww! Look at that! Even my poop is cute!
5002668.c14_s3: Would you help me find a good spot?
5002668.c14_f2: Of all the things I could do for you, this is what you want?
5002668.c14_f4: Too late! I already took care of that!
5002668.c15_s1: You think deer can just do that on command?
5002668.c15_s3: Just... Make sure nobody's looking, okay?
5002668.c15_f1: How can I poop rainbows if you won't feed me sprinkles?
5002668.c15_f2: Not yet. I've got to work up a really smelly one first.
5002668.c15_f3: Do you have some weird fascination with poop?
5002668.c15_f4: You act like I poop just to please you.
5002668.c16_s1: Yaaaawn! All this talk about sleep is making me sleepy.
5002668.c16_s3: Is the world put on pause when I go to sleep? How else do you get along without me?
5002668.c16_s4: That's a good idea. I could really use some shuteye.
5002668.c16_f1: You sleep first. I'll stand guard and contemplate the meaning of my existence.
5002668.c16_f2: Telling me to go to sleep doesn't automatically make me tired.
5002668.c16_f3: That's not happening! I just drank a bunch of tea!
5002668.c17_s1: Have you heard about those new ice block pillows? They're all the rage.
5002668.c17_s2: I couldn't be more sleepy if I had just read an entire encyclopedia!
5002668.c17_s3: This does seem like a good place to take a nap.
5002668.c17_s4: I'm all cozy and comfy, and my belly is full. Time for a nice nap.
5002668.c17_f1: My rumbling tummy is keeping me wide awake.
5002668.c17_f3: Why? You're not going to run away or something, are you?
5002668.c17_f4: I don't think I heard that right. You want me to sleep right now?
5002668.c18_s2: A nap would be perfect right about now.
5002668.c18_s3: Even the best of us need a good night's rest to be helpful!
5002668.c18_s4: Why would I sleep when there's so much to do?
5002668.c18_f1: You think I can go to sleep anywhere I please? I need comfort!
5002668.c18_f2: At least fetch me a couple of pillows. I need to be comfy!
5002668.c18_f3: I refuse to sleep! I don't need to! I'll be just fine.
5002668.c18_f4: I can't sleep, I need to help make the snow fall!
5002668.c19_s1: You want to talk about how cute I am, don't you? I knew it.
5002668.c19_s2: You want to have a deep and meaningful conversation? Awesome!
5002668.c19_s3: I'm a little picky... I like a nice icy branch.
5002668.c19_s4: You're so great! We can talk about whatever you want!
5002668.c19_f3: I'm too lazy to talk. Just saying this is too much effort.
5002668.c19_f4: If you want to talk, you could at least come up with a good topic.
5002668.c20_s1: I love being showered with attention!
5002668.c20_s2: I'm so glad we can talk any time we want!
5002668.c20_s3: I wonder what Snow Ram and Winter Snowy are doing?
5002668.c20_s4: Every day spent with friends is amazing!
5002668.c20_f1: Actually, I think I'd rather eat right now.
5002668.c20_f3: Don't talk to me. I'm writing my personal memoir in my mind.
5002668.c20_f4: If you want to chat, why don't we talk about this new diet you seem to have me on?
5002668.c21_s1: I heard El Nath sets a new snowfall record every year!
5002668.c21_s2: Lets munch on some leaves together! ...What's with that look?
5002668.c21_s3: Talking to you NEVER gets old! Well, not never, but you know what I mean.
5002668.c21_s4: Let's play a game! Or eat! Or go on an adventure! All the things!
5002668.c21_f1: I'm too lazy to talk. Just saying this is too much effort.
5002668.c21_f2: I don't have anything to say...
5002668.c21_f3: Is that how it works now? I just yap on command?
5002668.c21_f4: I'm not going to waste my singing voice on inane banter.
5002668.f1_s: Delicious! Tree branches are just the best!
5002668.f2_s: Don't you just love munching and crunching on ice sometimes?
5002668.f2_f: Deer don't eat stuff like this.
5002668.f3_s: Food has so many amazing and varied flavors!
5002668.f3_f: I really want to eat more, but I'm so full. I'm not sure I can.
5002668.f4_s: Gosh, I'm glad I get to eat tasty stuff every day!
5002668.s1: Hm? What was that you said?
5002668.s2: If you keep using bad words, I'll stop listening to you.
5002668.s3: How am I supposed to respond to language like that?
5002668.s4: Bad words are for people who have puny vocabularies.

5002669.c1_s1: But my tail's in the way. Wait, do I even have a tail?
5002669.c1_f1: I've been sitting all day. I think I'll pass, thanks.
5002669.c1_f2: I don't really feel like sitting...
5002669.c2_s1: Ta da! I sat! Now you can shower me with compliments.
5002669.c2_s3: You want me to put my BUTT on the GROUND?
5002669.c2_s4: I love sitting! It's such a great way to take in the world around you.
5002669.c2_f1: I only sit on the comfiest of snow mounds!
5002669.c2_f2: Only if I get to do it in a snowfield.
5002669.c2_f3: An elegant Snow Ram, such as I, doesn't sit just anywhere.
5002669.c2_f4: Please don't make me do this here. It's uncomfortable.
5002669.c3_s1: Hm, this is more comfortable than I thought it would be.
5002669.c3_s2: We could even lie down and guess the shapes of the clouds.
5002669.c3_s3: I'm pretty, and I listen. I'm perfect!
5002669.c3_s4: I'll do it as carefully as possible.
5002669.c3_f1: I've been sitting for so long already that my butt fell asleep!
5002669.c3_f2: You're awfully bossy. You really need to give me some kind of incentive.
5002669.c3_f4: I'll pass, thanks. And I wasn't referring to gas.
5002669.c4_s2: I've been good! Do I get a treat now?
5002669.c4_s3: Can I sit right next to you forever?
5002669.c4_s4: Good idea! I was feeling a bit tired.
5002669.c4_f1: Sit? What if something bites me?
5002669.c4_f2: Oh, sorry. I didn't hear you.
5002669.c4_f4: I don't have to do anything I don't want to!
5002669.c5_s2: Why do you make me cry?
5002669.c6_s2: I don't like it when you're mad.
5002669.c6_s3: I didn't know it was possible for you to be mad at me.
5002669.c6_s4: I'm sorry! Please don't hate me forever!
5002669.c6_f1: That's it! It's time to put on my angry face!
5002669.c6_f2: I don't know what to do! I didn't hear you AT ALL!
5002669.c6_f3: Why are you doing this to me?
5002669.c6_f4: Don't take your anger out on me.
5002669.c7_s1: I'll sit and think about what I've done.
5002669.c7_s4: I'm heartbroken knowing I disappointed you.
5002669.c7_f2: You're not a friend! You're a bully!
5002669.c7_f3: I didn't know you could be so mean!
5002669.c7_f4: I never thought you'd be suspicious of me like this!
5002669.c8_s2: I'm not c-c-crying. T-t-there's just something in my eye.
5002669.c8_s4: I know you're mad, but please don't leave me alone!
5002669.c9_s2: Hearing that makes me so happy!
5002669.c10_s1: Wow! Really?! Okay, I'm on board with that.
5002669.c10_s2: Would you believe me if I said you're the best owner ever?
5002669.c10_s4: You know just what to say to make me feel special.
5002669.c10_f2: That's not really the feel I'm getting.
5002669.c11_s1: Well, now you have to promise to say that every day.
5002669.c11_s3: Now that I think about it, I like you too.
5002669.c11_s4: You're the bee's knees! Whoa! What am I, 80 years old?
5002669.c11_f1: Now might not be the best time for that conversation.
5002669.c11_f3: I can't believe my ears! Did you really say that?
5002669.c11_f4: I'll pretend you didn't just say that.
5002669.c12_s1: You make my life so full of meaning!
5002669.c12_s2: I always knew I was irresistible!
5002669.c12_s3: I see my charm has begun to work on you.
5002669.c12_s4: I guess I am kind of beautiful. I knew it! You can't resist me!
5002669.c12_f1: I'm more in the mood for a tasty treat than chatter right now.
5002669.c12_f2: I'll do whatever tricks you want, but you've got to give me treats.
5002669.c12_f3: I would really like a cookie right now!
5002669.c13_s2: I've been holding it for a moment just like this.
5002669.c13_s3: Poof! I magically transported my poo to another dimension!
5002669.c13_s4: It's always so hard. I'm not sure I'm doing it right.
5002669.c13_f1: Ugh, I hate that word. How about we call it a funky lump?
5002669.c13_f2: That doesn't really fit my vibe, now does it?
5002669.c14_s2: Maybe I could drink some coffee to get things moving?
5002669.c14_s3: Ugh! It's so gross! Don't look at me!!
5002669.c14_f1: How can you do...? In a place like this...?
5002669.c14_f2: Not out here! I've heard there are special rooms for that.
5002669.c14_f4: Why do you think it's such a good idea to do that now?
5002669.c15_s2: I like to sing when I poop! What about you?
5002669.c15_s3: Poop, eat, sleep. Poop, eat, sleep.
5002669.c15_s4: Boo doo, bee doo, bee doo... Poop!
5002669.c15_f1: I don't like to do that where people can watch. It's creepy.
5002669.c15_f4: Really? Of all the things I can do for you, you want me to poop?
5002669.c16_s2: Did you put a spell on me? I'm falling asleep right... right... Zzz...
5002669.c16_s3: Good idea! I'm sleepier than I thought!
5002669.c16_f1: I'm not really that tired. Maybe I could read for a bit first?
5002669.c16_f2: I tried to sleep earlier, but you wanted me to talk to you!
5002669.c16_f4: I'm too hungry to go to sleep!
5002669.c17_s1: The sooner you make me sleep, the sooner I wake up to bug you!
5002669.c17_s2: I only sleep on a full belly!
5002669.c17_s3: What if I just pretend I'm sleeping? Could you tell?
5002669.c17_s4: I hope I have wonderful dreams about how great you are!
5002669.c17_f1: How can you tell a cute pet like me to sleep on the streets?
5002669.c17_f2: I'm too hungry to fall asleep...
5002669.c17_f3: Wait! You can't tell me to take a nap and then leave me unprotected!
5002669.c17_f4: Play with me! Don't just put me to bed!
5002669.c18_s1: I'll try, but I can't guarantee I'll actually... Zzz...
5002669.c18_s3: All I need is a nice pillow and blanket to cuddle up with.
5002669.c18_f1: I can't just sleep all the time!
5002669.c18_f2: This Snow Ram answers to nobody!
5002669.c18_f4: We don't have time for sleep! There's so much to do!
5002669.c19_s1: There's no better pet than me, right?
5002669.c19_s2: You must love the sound of my voice. I'm proud of it.
5002669.c19_s3: I'm actually good at singing too. Wanna hear?
5002669.c19_s4: I want to grow up and fight monsters just like you!
5002669.c19_f1: Fine. But you have to give me 1 treat every time I talk.
5002669.c19_f2: I don't feel like doing that...
5002669.c19_f3: I'm sleepy and grumpy. Now's not a good time to talk to me.
5002669.c19_f4: You won't get one peep outta me! Except for that one. And that one... And...
5002669.c20_s1: You know, it looks like a cushy life, but sometimes pet life is tough.
5002669.c20_s2: Do you think if it's cold enough, I could make my own clouds by talking?
5002669.c20_s3: I saw a doll that looks like me... a LOT like me... What was it?
5002669.c20_s4: I want to go to El Nath with you. I heard it's covered in glittering snow.
5002669.c20_f1: You've kind of put me on the spot here. I don't know what to say.
5002669.c20_f3: I'm confused. What do you want to talk about?
5002669.c21_s1: I'd love to go somewhere beautiful and snowy.
5002669.c21_s2: I love snow! It makes the most interesting crunching noise when you walk in it.
5002669.c21_s3: Did you know I can sing? I'm great with classic showtunes.
5002669.c21_s4: Flying is kind of an amazing skill when you think about it.
5002669.c21_f1: I don't feel like doing that...
5002669.c21_f2: Let's go to sleep instead. I could use a good nap.
5002669.c21_f3: Why do you keep talking to me? Nothing's changed.
5002669.c21_f4: Are you bored? I'm not really sure what you need.
5002669.f2_f: You can't feed a pretty pet like me such cheap food.
5002669.f3_s: How did you make this taste so heavenly?
5002669.f3_f: Blech... I think I'll go barf now...
5002669.f4_f: I'm so full that my belly might just drag on the floor.
5002669.s3: Did I just hear what I think I heard?

5002670.c1_f2: What if I told you I had no butt to sit on?
5002670.c2_s2: The ground is cushy! Who'd have thought?
5002670.c2_s4: Done! What else can I do for you?
5002670.c2_f3: My tooshie can only handle so much sitting in a day.
5002670.c2_f4: Okay, but if I can't get back up, I'm blaming you.
5002670.c3_s1: Boop! I decided to sit down after all.
5002670.c3_s4: But I won't want to get back up!
5002670.c3_f2: I've decided I don't need or want to!
5002670.c3_f4: I don't really care whether I'm standing or sitting.
5002670.c4_s2: I sat down! Aren't I the best?
5002670.c4_s3: Now I get cookies? Wait. I didn't sit on them, did I? Eh, they'll still taste fine.
5002670.c4_f1: That is just bossy and rude!
5002670.c4_f2: I don't want to sit! I won't!
5002670.c4_f3: I don't like getting my butt dirty!
5002670.c4_f4: I'm above following your dumb commands!
5002670.c5_s2: I know I made a mistake, but please be nicer to me.
5002670.c5_f1: What are you saying right now?
5002670.c6_s1: I'm scared... I don't like it when you're angry.
5002670.c6_s2: Please don't scold me... It makes me sad.
5002670.c6_s3: I need to cry now. Please leave me alone.
5002670.c6_s4: You're so scary when you're mad!
5002670.c6_f1: I get mad too, but I don't go around being mean to people.
5002670.c6_f2: Why do you keep getting mad at me?
5002670.c6_f3: Why would you take your anger out on me? I'M nice to you.
5002670.c7_s1: I'm scared... I don't like it when you're angry.
5002670.c7_s2: Stop making me cry! It's really mean!
5002670.c7_f1: You get annoyed far to easily.
5002670.c7_f2: Bring it on! I'm not scared of anyone, not even you!
5002670.c7_f3: Are you really getting mad at me right now?
5002670.c7_f4: You think I'm a pushover? I won't let you treat me like this.
5002670.c8_s1: You used to tell me I was cute no matter what I did!
5002670.c8_s2: Please don't. I really don't like it.
5002670.c8_s3: I'm really sorry I messed up. I'll try not to do it again.
5002670.c8_s4: I know I shouldn't have done that. I'm sorry.
5002670.c8_f1: I get in trouble all the time. It doesn't even phase me anymore.
5002670.c8_f2: You think you're mad? I'm furious!
5002670.c8_f3: You make me feel so bad about myself. I don't like you!
5002670.c8_f4: What have you got against me?
5002670.c9_s2: Oh, me too! I love you too!
5002670.c9_f2: No, I can't be tied down right now.
5002670.c10_s2: You make me a happy Snowy, you know that?
5002670.c10_s4: I love you too! Like a lot!!
5002670.c10_f2: You must be mistaking me for someone else.
5002670.c10_f3: You have to try a bit harder to earn my love!
5002670.c11_s2: Aww, I'm really flattered! Thank you!
5002670.c11_s3: I'll bet I love you more!
5002670.c11_s4: Of course you do! I love you too!
5002670.c11_f1: I'll pretend you didn't just say that.
5002670.c11_f3: I don't do mushy declarations like that. Try someone else.
5002670.c11_f4: I'm too in love with myself to have time for anyone else.
5002670.c12_s2: You LOVE me! You LOVE me! You said you LOVE me!
5002670.c12_s3: I always knew I was irresistible!
5002670.c12_s4: I love the snow-st of all!
5002670.c12_f2: I'm a prickly Snowy, don't you know?
5002670.c12_f3: You think you could say that again while presenting me with tasty food?
5002670.c13_s2: Do you maybe have some fiber to help things along?
5002670.c13_s3: Unnngh... Nope. I'll have to wait until the opportune moment.
5002670.c13_f2: That's, uh... That's a weird request.
5002670.c13_f4: No, no. That's not okay to demand of me.
5002670.c14_s1: Do I have to do it right now? What would I clean up with?
5002670.c14_s2: Look at that! I'm so cute that even my poop is cute!
5002670.c14_s3: Okay, I'll poop, and you can hide it under a leaf.
5002670.c14_f2: Of all the things I could do for you, this is what you want?
5002670.c14_f4: Too late! I already took care of that!
5002670.c15_s1: Just because I CAN poop, doesn't mean I WANT to poop.
5002670.c15_s3: Be on the lookout! This one's happening fast!
5002670.c15_f1: How can I poop rainbows if you won't feed me sprinkles?
5002670.c15_f2: Not yet. I've got to work up a really smelly one first.
5002670.c15_f3: Do you have some weird fascination with poop?
5002670.c15_f4: I'm a little blocked up today actually...
5002670.c16_s1: Yaaaawn! All this talk about sleep is making me sleepy.
5002670.c16_s3: Is the world put on pause when I go to sleep? How else do you get along without me?
5002670.c16_s4: That's a good idea. I could really use some shuteye.
5002670.c16_f1: You sleep first. I'll stand guard and contemplate the meaning of my existence.
5002670.c16_f2: Telling me to go to sleep doesn't automatically make me tired.
5002670.c16_f3: That's not happening! I just drank a bunch of tea!
5002670.c17_s1: I AM pretty sleepy. Okay... Zzz...
5002670.c17_s2: It's the perfect moment for a little cat nap.
5002670.c17_s3: This does seem like a good place to take a nap.
5002670.c17_s4: I'm all cozy and comfy, and my belly is full. Time for a nice nap.
5002670.c17_f1: My rumbling tummy is keeping me wide awake.
5002670.c17_f3: You're not gonna run off, are you?
5002670.c17_f4: What are you saying? I thought we were going to stay awake forever!
5002670.c18_s3: Even the best of us need a good night's rest to be helpful!
5002670.c18_s4: Why would I sleep when there's so much to do?
5002670.c18_f1: You think I can go to sleep anywhere I please? I need comfort!
5002670.c18_f2: At least fetch me a couple of pillows. I need to be comfy!
5002670.c18_f3: I'm not sleepy! You can't make me!
5002670.c18_f4: My craving for sushi outweighs my need for sleep.
5002670.c19_s1: You want to talk about how cute I am, don't you? I knew it.
5002670.c19_s2: I want to live in a snow-covered world, just with you!
5002670.c19_s3: Please don't put a carrot on my face...
5002670.c19_s4: Oh! Let's talk about all the awesome snacks you can buy me!
5002670.c19_f3: I don't feel like doing that...
5002670.c19_f4: If you want to talk, you could at least come up with a good topic.
5002670.c20_s1: Y'know, I actually find the summer weather pretty cool.
5002670.c20_s3: Do you like winter or summer more?
5002670.c20_s4: Every day spent with friends is amazing!
5002670.c20_f1: Actually, I think I'd rather eat right now.
5002670.c20_f3: Don't talk to me. I'm writing my personal memoir in my mind.
5002670.c20_f4: If you want to chat, why don't we talk about this new diet you seem to have me on?
5002670.c21_s1: What are places where it snows all the time called?
5002670.c21_s2: I just want to eat with you! Unlike my friends, I'll eat anything!
5002670.c21_s3: Talking to you NEVER gets old! Well, not never, but you know what I mean.
5002670.c21_s4: Let's go on a fun vacation together!
5002670.c21_f2: I don't have anything to say...
5002670.c21_f3: Do I have to speak just because you say so?
5002670.c21_f4: I talked too much today. My voice is done for!

5002670.f2_s: Meals are best when they're delicious!
5002670.f2_f: I'm not going to eat THAT!
5002670.f3_s: Ahhh, this is so tasty! Thank you!
5002670.f3_f: Do you WANT me to barf? Cuz that's what I'll do if you give me any more.
5002670.f4_s: I think your food prep skills are improving!
5002670.f4_f: I'm full! Why are you giving me so much food?
5002670.s1: Do you hear the words coming out of your mouth?
5002670.s2: Words like that are a bit juvenile, don't you think?
5002670.s3: You kiss your mama with that mouth?!
5002670.s4: What would possess you to say such a thing? A poop monster?

5002671.c2_s1: Feels nice to get a load off.
5002671.c2_s2: Come sit down with me, Master.
5002671.c2_f2: We still have plenty of places to go.
5002671.c3_s2: I sat! But you know I can do more than that, right?

5002671.c4_f2: Nah, I think I have something else to do.
5002671.c4_f3: I feel like I'm going to melt if I sit.
5002671.c6_s3: What? Are you going to punish me or something?
5002671.c6_s4: I won't do it ever again!
5002671.c6_f1: Don't talk to me like that!
5002671.c6_f3: Don't take your aggression out on me!
5002671.c7_s1: Could you overlook it just this once?
5002671.c7_s2: I know I messed up, so quit being angry.
5002671.c7_f4: I'm the one who should be angry, not you!
5002671.c8_s3: I'll graciously say that I'm sorry first.
5002671.c9_f1: You say you love me, yet you still eat marshmallows?
5002671.c10_s2: Take my heart, it's super squishy!
5002671.c10_s3: Wow, you love me? I love you too!
5002671.c11_s4: I know exactly what you mean!
5002671.c12_s1: I love you lots too, Master!
5002671.c12_s2: Do you think we'll be together forever?
5002671.c12_f2: Is this really the time for that?
5002671.c13_f3: Do you think I can just do that?
5002671.c14_s1: I'll leave the clean up to you.
5002671.c14_f2: Do I really look that bored to you?
5002671.c14_f4: And you call yourself a master...
5002671.c15_s4: Collect my energy and then... HAH!
5002671.c16_f1: It's not even close to night time!
5002671.c17_s1: I'll have a good dream today!
5002671.c17_s2: Make sure you get your full eight hours!
5002671.c17_s3: A good night's sleep makes a day feel better!
5002671.c17_f2: Sleeping too much is actually bad for you, y'know!
5002671.c17_f3: The day is short enough, as is!
5002671.c18_f2: Isn't it time for a midnight snack?
5002671.c19_s1: Choose your favorite, raw, toasted, or burnt!
5002671.c19_s2: I'm good just the way I am!
5002671.c19_s4: I wonder who will give me my sweets?
5002671.c19_f3: This really isn't the time, Master.
5002671.c20_s1: I guess large heads don't always mean large minds!
5002671.c20_s2: What kind of monsters will we face tomorrow?
5002671.c20_s3: I may look weak but I'm hiding an incredible weapon!
5002671.c20_s4: Want to listen to a song?
5002671.c20_f3: What if I don't want to?
5002671.c21_s1: I want a nice, warm campfire to lie down next to.
5002671.c21_s2: Which cookie is the best match for me?
5002671.c21_s3: People are always so happy to see me.
5002671.c21_s4: When you're tired, try something sweet!
5002671.c21_f1: Go find another pet if you want to chat.
5002671.s2: Bad people tend to use bad words.
5002671.s3: I'm not going to stick around if that's how you talk.

5002672.c2_s2: You should take a break too.
5002672.c2_s3: GOOD. I was getting rather sleepy.
5002672.c2_f4: I'd prefer to stay standing for a bit.
5002672.c3_s4: I guessing sitting isn't bad, I guess.
5002672.c4_f2: I've got something to do first.
5002672.c4_f4: I don't like being told what to do.
5002672.c6_s2: I'll go write an apology letter.
5002672.c6_s4: You'll forgive me this once, right?
5002672.c6_f2: I think you really said some mean things.
5002672.c7_s1: I'll be reflecting on what I did...
5002672.c7_s2: I admit that it was my fault...
5002672.c7_f4: How dare you get angry at me?!
5002672.c9_s1: My heart goes pew pew for you too!
5002672.c10_s2: I'm so happy to hear that!
5002672.c11_s2: Here! A little love straight from me!
5002672.c12_f1: I know when people are being insincere.
5002672.c14_s3: I haven't felt this fresh in a while!
5002672.c14_f1: We must wait for the right moment.
5002672.c14_f3: Do you really think this is the place for that?
5002672.c15_s3: I haven't felt this light in a while!
5002672.c16_f1: I'm going to keep my eyes wide open.
5002672.c16_f2: But we just woke up, didn't we?
5002672.c17_s2: Let's take a nap, shall we?

5002672.c17_f2: No! I don't want to! You can't make me!
5002672.c17_f3: You should set an example by going first!
5002672.c17_f4: Haha! The day is still young!
5002672.c18_s4: I was feeling so tired... Please excuse me... Zzz
5002672.c18_f3: What are you planning to do while I sleep?
5002672.c18_f4: But I don't want so sleep yet!
5002672.c19_s1: I really wonder what goes on in your head, Master.
5002672.c19_s2: There was something Pale Smore used to tell me...
5002672.c19_s3: There once was a party of heroes who sat around the fire, gazing at the setting sun...
5002672.c19_s4: You should talk to Burnt Smore first.
5002672.c19_f1: I don't feel like doing anything.
5002672.c19_f4: Shh, we need to be quiet right now.
5002672.c20_s1: Keep to the feeding schedule, all right?
5002672.c20_s2: Which side dish was best today?
5002672.c20_s3: Your clothes are so last season, Master.
5002672.c20_f3: We have nothing to talk about.
5002672.c21_s1: Which dessert goes best with black coffee?
5002672.c21_s2: Pale Smore is actually pretty full of herself.
5002672.c21_s3: I've been told there are more sweets than Smores, but like, who cares?
5002672.c21_f4: If you're bored, go hunting instead of wasting your time.
5002672.f4_f: I'm full. You can stop now.
5002672.s2: I don't say words like that.
5002672.s3: This is abuse! I'll have you locked up!

5002673.c6_s2: I'll be reflecting on my actions...
5002673.c6_f3: Don't take it out on me!
5002673.c6_f4: Why are you so mad at me?!
5002673.c7_s3: I'll apologize, so please forgive me.
5002673.c7_s4: Do I need to do extra chores or what?
5002673.c7_f2: Why am I the one being yelled at?
5002673.c7_f3: I'm the one who should be angry, not you!
5002673.c8_s3: I admit it, it's my fault.
5002673.c8_f1: Do you want me to start crying?

5002673.c9_f2: Is this a new kind of bullying?
5002673.c11_f3: Give me a minute or a thousand to think about that.
5002673.c12_s4: Aw, you're making me feel shy.
5002673.c14_f4: What kind of command is that?
5002673.c15_s3: Three seconds! That's a new record!
5002673.c15_s4: Wow, it's nearly as dark as me!
5002673.c15_f1: I'm too lazy to talk. Just saying this is too much effort.
5002673.c15_f2: I don't think it's time yet...
5002673.c15_f3: I already took care of it!
5002673.c16_f1: But I want to play some more!
5002673.c17_f2: Come on, let's play some more!
5002673.c18_s1: I hope you have sweet dreams!
5002673.c18_f3: I don't think I can sleep here.
5002673.c19_s1: Here's a secret: Toasty Smore is the most talkative when it's just us talking.
5002673.c19_s2: I've had my fill of hot things already.
5002673.c19_s4: Master! I think I just saw a huge dragon fly by!
5002673.c19_f4: What do you want me to say?
5002673.c20_s1: Keep to the feeding schedule, all right?
5002673.c20_s3: I want to live in a world full of delicious things.
5002673.c20_f4: I'm having a moment. Let's not.
5002673.c21_s1: Master, you might be a little full of yourself.
5002673.c21_s2: Time flies you know, so be careful!
5002673.c21_s4: Don't forget that thing you forgot about!
5002673.c21_f1: If you're bored, go hunting instead of wasting your time.
5002673.f1_f: I'm full. You can stop now.
5002673.f2_s: It didn't go bad, did it?
5002673.s1: This is abuse! I'll have you locked up!
5002673.s4: I'm not going to say what I wanna say...

5002674.c1_s1: Knowing when to rest is also important.
5002674.c1_s2: I love playing on the swings!
5002674.c2_s1: Want to play on the swing?
5002674.c3_s1: I want to swing real high!
5002674.c3_s2: I want play on a swing!

5002674.c4_s3: Flowers bloom in a garden, and I bloom next to you!
5002674.c4_f3: Thanks, but I don't really feel like it.

5002674.c12_s4: I love you as much as flowers!
5002674.c12_f1: Do you really love me the most in the whole world?

5002674.c15_f3: That's not how plants work, silly.
5002674.c16_s3: Want to catch some shut eye with me?
5002674.c16_f2: I'm not ready to go to sleep yet.
5002674.c17_s4: I hope I dream of flowers... Zzz...
5002674.c17_f4: I want to play some more.
5002674.c18_s2: Make sure to dream of me!

5002674.c19_s3: What's the most beautiful flower in the world? Me, obviously!
5002674.c19_f1: Don't pick flowers you like. Part of their charm is where they grow.

5002674.c21_s4: You know who is prettier than flowers? You!

5002675.c6_f1: You won't like flowers when they're angry.

5002675.c7_f2: You'll have to try harder than that to make me wilt!
5002675.c12_s3: I bloomed so I could love you!
5002675.c12_f3: Did you step on my flowers or something?

5002675.c16_s3: Let's play together my dream, too!
5002675.c16_f1: I can see a bug over there...!
5002675.c17_f1: I'm not going to sleep right now!
5002675.c17_f2: But I feel like I'm going to have a bad dream...
5002675.c18_s4: Smelling so many flowers... makes me sleepy...
5002675.c18_f1: I'm not going to sleep right now!
5002675.c19_s1: I'm going to discover a new flower and write a botanical journal!
5002675.c19_s2: Did you see that flower? I call it: ME!
5002675.c19_s4: Don't pick flowers you like. Part of their charm is where they grow.
5002675.c20_s1: The most beautiful flower in the world is you!
5002675.c20_s2: Did you know figs are technically flowers?
5002675.c20_s4: What kinds of flowers will we find today?
5002675.c20_f4: Pass me some water, would you?
5002675.c21_s2: I wonder if the sun will come out today...

5002675.c21_f1: I don't want to talk right now.

5002676.c1_s2: Butt on floor! Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle!

5002676.c2_f1: I'm going to lie down instead.

5002676.c5_f1: At least my tears are will nourish the plants...

5002676.c12_s3: One day, if I bear fruit, it'll be very beautiful.
5002676.c12_s4: I'm so moved... I love you too!
5002676.c15_s4: Do you think I can fertilize the soil?
5002676.c16_s3: I'll find you in my dreams!
5002676.c16_f1: Nah. I'm not going to sleep.
5002676.c16_f2: I want to play some more!
5002676.c17_s4: Let's hang out in our dreams, too!
5002676.c18_s4: Oh, good. I was getting sleepy.
5002676.c18_f2: But it's not night time yet...
5002676.c18_f4: Uh, I'm trying to photosynthesize here.

5002676.c19_f1: I'm taking in the sun, give me a sec.
5002676.c20_s1: *gasp* Wait! You're about to step on a flower!
5002676.c20_s2: Even though flowers naturally wilt to bear fruit, it still makes me sad.
5002676.c20_s3: In the language of flowers, I mean 'I love my master!'
5002676.c20_s4: I'm the most beautiful flower fairy in the world. Don't you agree?
5002676.c21_s1: What's your favorite season? Mine's spring!
5002676.c21_s2: If it were up to me, flowers would be everywhere, every day of the year!
5002676.c21_s3: What kind of flower should we go see tomorrow?
5002676.c21_s4: I think I can smell flowers! In that direction!
5002676.c21_f4: I'm busy talking to a butterfly right now. Don't bother me.
5002676.s3: Do you think before you speak?

5002677.c1_f1: I'd like to play with Orchid.
5002677.c3_s1: It looks comfortable over there. Let's rest together.

5002677.c3_f2: I think my pajamas will get dirty.

5002677.c4_s2: Thanks, I was feeling rather tired...

5002677.c5_s1: Sorry, I'm still not used to this whole 'body' thing yet.
5002677.c5_f2: If Orchid and I combine our powers, you'll stand no chance.
5002677.c6_f1: Guess you're not afraid of death, are you?
5002677.c6_f3: Don't you know who I am?!
5002677.c6_f4: You're just trying to scare me.
5002677.c7_s2: I'll apologize this time. THIS time.
5002677.c7_s4: The only other person who's ever defied me is Orchid.
5002677.c7_f3: I don't take orders from peons.
5002677.c7_f4: How dare you get angry with me?!
5002677.c8_f4: How dare you get angry with me?!
5002677.c10_s1: You may grow on me yet.
5002677.c10_s2: I will accept it. Your heart, that is.
5002677.c10_s4: You know, I'm a little nervous, all of a sudden.
5002677.c11_s2: Aw, I'm blushing. Just kidding. Cut it out.
5002677.c11_s3: Someone would appreciate that--not me, mind you.
5002677.c11_f2: I am already suffering... You don't have to make me suffer even more...
5002677.c11_f4: I reserve all my love for Orchid.
5002677.c12_s2: I don't dislike you either, you know.
5002677.c14_s1: I'll see myself to the Little Pets room.
5002677.c15_s2: I feel like even my soul is lighter.

5002677.c15_f4: I'm not really in the mood.

5002677.c17_f3: Couldn't we share a jest or something instead?

5002677.c18_s3: Orchid and I will reunite in my dreams!
5002677.c18_s4: I almost feel too lazy to sleep.
5002677.c18_f1: I got enough sleep when I was in the laboratory.
5002677.c19_s1: I'll talk if the mood strikes.
5002677.c19_s2: I'm curious what kind of dream I'll have today.
5002677.c19_s3: Would you like to have a pillow fight?
5002677.c19_s4: What do you think dreamland is like?
5002677.c20_s1: I kind of miss being a spirit.
5002677.c20_s2: Can you tell me about the dream you had today?
5002677.c20_s4: My last dream? That's a secret.
5002677.c20_f4: I'm not really in the mood to talk.
5002677.c21_s1: Did you know I'm older than Orchid?
5002677.c21_s3: Should I tell you about the time I played with Orchid?
5002677.c21_s4: I have nothing to fear as long as I am with Orchid.
5002677.f3_f: I'd like to eat this with Orchid.

5002678.c3_s1: I'm not taking orders from YOU!
5002678.c6_s1: I guess I should stay quiet...

5002678.c7_f4: What do you want me to do?
5002678.c14_s3: I-I'm just a little bit shy...
5002678.c17_s3: I'm not going to sleep... Zzz...
5002678.c18_f2: How am I supposed to sleep at a time like this?
5002678.c19_s1: You want to hear my story?
5002678.c19_s2: Did you know Lotus is actually older than me?
5002678.c19_s3: I want to tell you about so many things...
5002678.c19_s4: Pat yourself on the back at least once a day.
5002678.c20_s1: What are you thinking right now?
5002678.c20_s2: I look strong, but I'm actually pretty weak...
5002678.c20_s3: Will you remember me even when I turn into a doll?
5002678.c20_s4: What is Lotus doing right now?
5002678.c21_s1: Don't make me pick between you and Lotus.
5002678.c21_s2: I'd like to see the ocean.
5002678.c21_s3: I hope tomorrow is fun and the day after too!

5002679.c13_f1: It's embarrassing to do it here.

5002679.c16_s4: I hope you dream about me!
5002679.c17_s1: I hope you dream about me!
5002679.c18_f3: Isn't it too early for bedtime?!

5002679.c19_f2: I don't want to just blab about myself right now.
5002679.c21_s2: Dreamland is bigger than you think.

5002679.c21_s4: I had a deep talk with Lucid a few days ago about dreams.
5002679.c21_f1: I want to wear pajamas too...
