5002690.c12_f2: Hmm...? We're not so sure, squeak.
5002690.c12_f4: Let's pretend you didn't hear that, squeak!
5002690.c14_s3: You'll keep it a squeak-ret, right?
5002690.c15_f2: We're not really up for it right now, squeak...
5002690.c17_s2: Will you tuck us in, squeak?
5002690.c17_s3: Let's take a quick rest, squeak.
5002690.c17_f2: Hmm... Maybe we could rest, squeak!
5002690.c18_s1: See you in our dreams, squeak!
5002690.c18_s2: A cozy blanket is the best place to be, squeak!
5002690.c18_f3: We're not ready right now, squeak!
5002690.c20_s4: Squeak... squeak! In that case, we'll let you in on a squeak-ret...
5002690.c20_f3: We're not on the same page, squeak!
5002690.c21_s1: We're brave companions who aren't even afraid of cats, squeak!
5002690.c21_s2: We're your friends who love to have fun, squeak!
5002690.c21_s3: We're always ready to play, squeak!
5002690.c21_f1: Let's do something even more fun, squeak!
5002690.c21_f2: Can they understand what we're saying, squeak...?
5002690.c21_f3: We have a squeak-ret to share, squeak...
5002690.c21_f4: We can't tell you yet, squeak!
5002690.f3_s: Is there any that tastes like cheese, squeak...?
5002690.s4: We're good friends who always have a kind word, squeak!

5002691.c2_s2: Woof, woof! Give us a treat!
5002691.c2_s3: Woof! Don't you think we deserve some belly rubs?
5002691.c2_s4: Woof woof woof!!! Are we going for a...walk?!
5002691.c3_s2: Would it help if you held our paws, woof?
5002691.c4_s2: Heeheehee! You've never known better listeners, woof!
5002691.c4_s4: More! More! We want more, woof!
5002691.c4_f3: Come on, woof! Let's go play!
5002691.c4_f4: We don't wanna listen today, woof!
5002691.c6_f1: Woof! We got no time for that!
5002691.c7_s4: We won't do it again, woof!
5002691.c8_s2: Oh, please don't get upset, woof...
5002691.c8_s3: We'll make it up to you, woof...!
5002691.c8_f1: Hmph...! We like you better when you're nice, woof!
5002691.c8_f3: It's not our fault, woof! Why are you scolding us?
5002691.c9_s2: Good thing you can't see us blush!
5002691.c10_s4: We feel the same way, woof!
5002691.c10_f2: We're not that kind of friends, ruff!
5002691.c11_f1: Hmm... We're not falling for that, ruff!
5002691.c11_f2: We need time to think, woof!
5002691.c12_s2: You always make our day, woof!
5002691.c12_s3: We'll be with you 'til the end, woof!
5002691.c12_s4: We feel the same way, woof!
5002691.c12_f3: Did you eat something bad, woof...?
5002691.c14_f2: We don't feel like it, woof!
5002691.c15_s2: Make sure to pick it up, woof! We're outside!
5002691.c15_f1: It's not the right time, woof...
5002691.c17_s2: See you in our dreams, woof!
5002691.c17_s3: We're going to sleep really well, woof!
5002691.c17_f1: Woof! Let's go for a walk!
5002691.c17_f3: It's not time to sleep, woof!
5002691.c18_s1: Hehe we were ready for a nap, woof.
5002691.c18_s3: Playing in dreams is just as fun, woof!
5002691.c18_f2: We want to walk more, woof!
5002691.c18_f3: Let's go on an adventure, woof!
5002691.c18_f4: You want us to do what...? That's ruff.
5002691.c19_s1: What should we talk about, woof?
5002691.c20_s2: Wanna hear what happened at kindergarten today, woof?
5002691.c20_s3: You really wanna hear our story? That's great, woof!
5002691.c20_s4: What should we talk about first, woof?
5002691.c20_f1: We have a secret to share with you, woof!
5002691.c20_f2: Don't think it's time yet, woof...
5002691.c21_s3: You better promise to keep our secret safe, woof!
5002691.c21_s4: Woof! It's nice to have someone listening to US for once!
5002691.c21_f1: Whew... Give us a break, woof!
5002691.c21_f2: Grrr... Why are you teasing us, woof!
5002691.c21_f3: We're always ready for a nap, woof!
5002691.c21_f4: Does your throat feel sore today too, ruff?
5002691.f2_s: That's the funniest doggone thing we've ever seen!
5002691.s3: Get some other dog to do it!

5002692.c2_s1: There better be something in it for us...
5002692.c2_f1: You can't tell us what to do!
5002692.c3_s1: We were going to sit anyway, so don't get any ideas, meow!
5002692.c3_s3: Our paws were starting to get tired, meow.
5002692.c3_s4: Perhaps we could take a nap now? *purr*
5002692.c3_f4: Don't tell us what to do, meow...!
5002692.c4_s1: Meow, meow, meow! We can sit AND sing!
5002692.c4_f4: ...No, we don't believe we will, meow.
5002692.c6_s1: Hmm... We may have erred, meow...
5002692.c6_s4: Our sorrow can only be expressed by the most piercing of meows...
5002692.c6_f1: Ha! Like you could make us stop!
5002692.c6_f2: Don't you know that cats are in charge around here?
5002692.c6_f3: Try saying please next time, meow.
5002692.c6_f4: If we ignore them they're leave, meow.
5002692.c7_s2: We'll do better next time, meow...
5002692.c7_s4: Please don't put us in the dog house, meow...
5002692.c7_f1: Hmph! What's wrong with you, meow?
5002692.c7_f2: We didn't do anything wrong, meow!
5002692.c7_f4: We can do what we want, meow!
5002692.c8_s1: Meow... We won't do it again.
5002692.c8_f1: Hmph... Don't be a dog in the manger, meow!
5002692.c8_f2: Why are you mad now, meow?
5002692.c8_f4: You're not making any sense, meow.
5002692.c9_s2: Ah, well... That's very kind of you, meow...
5002692.c10_s2: How do you think we feel, meow?
5002692.c11_f3: What are you even talking about, meow?
5002692.c12_s2: Of course you fell for our charms, meow.
5002692.c12_s4: We'll bare our hearts too, meow!
5002692.c12_f2: Too soon, meow! Don't just say things!
5002692.c12_f3: We have no idea what you're saying, meow...
5002692.c13_f3: Did you hear someone speaking nonsense? Me neither.
5002692.c14_s1: Of course it doesn't smell much, meow. It isn't yours, after all.
5002692.c14_s2: Meow, meow, meooowww! What? Don't YOU sing after?
5002692.c14_s3: A burden has been lifted, meow.
5002692.c14_f1: This sand is too grainy, meow!
5002692.c15_s1: Meow! Now that there's room... dinner's soon, right?
5002692.c15_f3: *hiss* Don't you know cats are tidy?
5002692.c15_f4: Hmph... We don't need to go right now, meow.
5002692.c16_s2: Hmm... Maybe we'll finally catch that dream mouse...
5002692.c16_f2: What an ugly lullaby your voice makes.
5002692.c16_f4: We'll nap when we want to!
5002692.c17_s1: We'll sleep now, meow... but only because we want to.
5002692.c17_s2: We'll see you tomorrow then, meow.
5002692.c17_s4: We can play together in our dreams, meow!
5002692.c17_f1: We're not ready to sleep, meow!
5002692.c17_f2: *hiss* How do you expect us to sleep in this racket?
5002692.c17_f3: Do...you ever sleep when someone commands you to? Well, sleep!
5002692.c18_s1: *yawn* Perhaps we're a bit sleepy, meow...
5002692.c18_s3: You worked hard today too, though dinner could have come sooner.
5002692.c18_s4: See you in our dreams, meow!
5002692.c18_f1: What are you up to, meow?
5002692.c18_f2: What do you mean? We're wide awake, meow!
5002692.c18_f3: Just try and make us, meow!
5002692.c20_s1: *sigh* What do you want discuss, meow?
5002692.c20_s2: We're not surprised you'd want to hear our stories, meow!
5002692.c20_s4: Just imagine we said something, and it'll be just like we did, meow.
5002692.c20_f1: Cats are on the quiet side, meow...
5002692.c20_f3: Find Fido if you want to play fetch, meow!
5002692.c21_s1: Well, we do know some great stories... Have you heard how curiosity cured the cat?
5002692.c21_s2: We're full of interesting tidbits, meow! But not enough treats, alas.
5002692.c21_s3: Do you ever wish the world was bigger, meow?
5002692.c21_f1: Join the army if you want to shout orders, meow.
5002692.c21_f2: Sometimes silence is a virtue, meow!
5002692.c21_f4: You are just unbearably loud sometimes, meow.
5002692.f1_f: Yuck... Err, that is to say, thank you.
5002692.f2_f: Prove it! Give us some churu, meow!

5002693.c2_s2: *yawn* Why... do you think I'm tired?
5002693.c3_s4: Shrooms know how to take it easy!
5002693.c4_s1: A break? Good--this shroom is gonna swoon!
5002693.c4_s2: We can take a breather together...
5002693.c4_s4: Why is this view so nice?
5002693.c4_f1: Why? I'm a shroom on the move!
5002693.c4_f2: Why? Did you change your mind?
5002693.c4_f3: Why? Maybe it's too much for a shroom to understand.
5002693.c7_f1: Why are you acting like this?
5002693.c8_s3: I'll be the best shroom you ever met.
5002693.c10_s3: Why, I feel the same way!
5002693.c10_f2: Huh? Why would you say that?
5002693.c10_f3: Why now? And why so suddenly?
5002693.c10_f4: What... I mean, why on earth?
5002693.c11_s3: You know the why to a shroom's heart!
5002693.c11_s4: Why can't everyone by as lovely as you?
5002693.c11_f4: Hmph... Why should I believe it?
5002693.c12_s1: Our love is eternal! ...Why wouldn't it be?
5002693.c12_s2: I'm so glad to be your shroom!
5002693.c12_s3: Why, my heart belongs to you!
5002693.c12_f2: Why am I in... this tough spot?!
5002693.c12_f3: Tell me why! Or this ain't nothing but a heartache.
5002693.c13_s1: Why don't you give me some privacy?
5002693.c13_s2: Whew... I mean, why, how refreshing.
5002693.c14_s1: This is just between us shrooms, right?
5002693.c14_s3: Why doesn't it smell? Because I'm a mushroom!
5002693.c14_s4: Why, I bet you've never seen better!
5002693.c15_s2: Heeheehee... I made something precious for you.
5002693.c15_s3: Why alright... but keep it a secret.
5002693.c15_s4: Why don't you know that shrooms have special TP?
5002693.c15_f3: Why? What reason could you possibly have?
5002693.c17_s2: *yawn* I guess shrooms need rest too.
5002693.c17_s3: Why don't you please pass me a blanket...
5002693.c17_s4: I'll be awake again before you can wonder why.
5002693.c17_f4: C'mon, tell me why! I'm curious!
5002693.c18_s1: *yawn* Why don't we both sleep in...?
5002693.c18_s2: Why do our bodies need so much rest?
5002693.c18_s3: *yawn* Shrooms love hearing lullabies, you know.
5002693.c18_s4: Why don't we talk more in our dreams...
5002693.c18_f2: Seriously... tell me why! I want to know!
5002693.c20_s1: Why aren't we on an adventure!
5002693.c20_s2: Camouflage and disguise are excellent ways to avoid predators.
5002693.c20_s3: Don't you think I look just like your average shroom?
5002693.c20_s4: Mushrooms are good for you, but you should never eat them! H-Huh? Why not?
5002693.c21_s1: Why, I think that monster's chasing us!
5002693.c21_s2: If they can't tell you're hiding they can't ask you why.
5002693.c21_s3: A shroom can really relax in Mushroom Town. Why? The sunlight!
5002693.c21_s4: You're curious about the stories of the shrooms? I can see why!
5002693.f4_s: Do you think my cap's grown a bit bigger?
5002693.s1: Why on earth would you do this?

5002694.c2_s1: That's what I like to hear!
5002694.c3_s1: What? Very well, I'll stop here.
5002694.c3_s2: What, you want to rest now?
5002694.c3_s3: What a wonderful time! It's like we're on a picnic!
5002694.c3_s4: It's important to pace yourself, I'll tell you what!
5002694.c4_s1: What, can sitting be exercise too?
5002694.c4_s2: What will you give me for my good behavior?
5002694.c4_s3: This spot is so comfy--I love it!
5002694.c4_s4: Taking it easy is nice, right?
5002694.c4_f3: I honestly don't know what to say.
5002694.c4_f4: What did you say? Why are you like this?
5002694.c7_s3: I guess even shrooms can be wrong...
5002694.c7_s4: I'll be more careful from now on.
5002694.c7_f1: What is it? Why so suddenly?
5002694.c8_s2: What a sad state of affairs.
5002694.c8_s3: Hmm... I'm disappointed that you don't get what I'm saying!
5002694.c8_s4: Haha... What kind of apology should I make...?
5002694.c8_f2: Ha ha, what? Wait, what? What?!
5002694.c8_f4: What is going on? I have no idea.
5002694.c10_s1: Guess what! I like you too!
5002694.c10_s3: That's what I like to hear!
5002694.c10_s4: Waddaya know... I like you too.
5002694.c11_s1: That's what a shroom wants to hear!
5002694.c11_s3: What a happy shroom you've made me.
5002694.c11_f4: Hmph... What? You think I was grown yesterday?
5002694.c12_s1: What an embarrassing thing to say...
5002694.c12_s2: Haha... then maybe I should confess too.
5002694.c12_s3: I... I...like you too! ...What's that expression on your face?
5002694.c12_s4: What? I tried to hold back, but it's not working!
5002694.c12_f1: Just what do you think you're doing?
5002694.c12_f2: ...What do you think our relationship is?
5002694.c12_f3: What? You can't fool a shroom that easily!
5002694.c12_f4: What? I find that hard to believe.
5002694.c14_s1: You know how to give a shroom a hard time, I'll tell you what.
5002694.c14_s2: Phew... What? Wait--it doesn't smell, right?
5002694.c14_s4: What? Then let's do it now!
5002694.c15_s1: Hey... keep an eye out for me, okay?
5002694.c15_s4: Phew... Feels a little easier to fit inside my... What are you looking at?
5002694.c15_f2: ...Poop? What in the world is that?
5002694.c16_f4: What time do you think it is?
5002694.c17_s1: The key to sleep is proper posture. What--I mean it!
5002694.c17_s2: What you need is a good night's sleep!
5002694.c17_s4: Shrooms are used to sleeping rough.
5002694.c17_f4: What? Does this look like a good place for a shroom to sleep?
5002694.c18_s1: *yawn*...What? I was just about to go to sleep!
5002694.c18_s2: Mmm... If there's something more important than sleep, I'd like to hear what it is!
5002694.c18_s4: *nod* Mushrooms spoil easily when they're tired!
5002694.c18_f2: What...? I just don't get it.
5002694.c20_s2: But sometimes even shrooms need to hide!
5002694.c20_s4: What could ever stop a mushroom with its mind made up?
5002694.c21_s1: If we stay still like this, think anyone will notice?
5002694.c21_s2: Look at the sky! What a beautiful sight!
5002694.c21_s4: I'm glad to share my shroom stories with you!
5002694.s1: What? How can you say that?

5002695.c4_s2: How can you be so nice to me?
5002695.c4_s3: T-The floor is cold... is that ok?
5002695.c4_f2: All of a sudden? How come...?
5002695.c6_s4: How can I make it up to you?
5002695.c8_s4: How can I apologize to you properly?
5002695.c8_f2: Ha ha... How come? How could I do that?
5002695.c10_s3: I knew that already! How? It's obvious!
5002695.c10_s4: You know how I feel, right?
5002695.c10_f3: How can you say that so suddenly?
5002695.c11_s1: If that's the case... thank you...
5002695.c11_s2: Of course! I like you too!
5002695.c11_f2: How can you tease me like that?
5002695.c11_f4: Hmph... How now? I can't believe it!
5002695.c12_s2: What do you like best about me?
5002695.c12_s3: How is my heart so full, just seeing you smile?
5002695.c12_s4: It's okay that I love you too, right?
5002695.c12_f3: How could I be fooled by words like that?
5002695.c12_f4: Huh? How come? I can't believe it.
5002695.c14_s1: Don't talk to me right now!
5002695.c14_f2: How do you expect me to do that?
5002695.c15_s1: If I just let go... do you think it would be refreshing?
5002695.c15_s2: How could this have been handled better? ...That's rhetorical.
5002695.c15_s3: Taking a moment to breath is the best thing for a shroom!
5002695.c15_s4: This...is just between us shrooms, right?
5002695.c15_f3: H-How do you expect me to...?
5002695.c17_s3: I was just about to sleep!
5002695.c18_s1: Is good sleep how you got so tall?
5002695.c18_s2: Will you show me how to have good dreams?
5002695.c18_s3: You'll sing me a lullaby, right?
5002695.c18_s4: How can you stay on guard for monsters all night? You're so strong.
5002695.c18_f2: How come...? I want to know why.
5002695.c18_f4: What? How come? How? How come?
5002695.c20_s2: How can I become as smart as you?
5002695.c20_s3: You've never been to Mushroom Town, have you? It's amazing!
5002695.c20_s4: How can we make this moment last forever?
5002695.c21_s1: M-Monsters are scary... but leave them to me!
5002695.c21_s2: How about we play a round?
5002695.c21_s3: I'll show you how a shroom shares secrets!
5002695.c21_f4: You want me to speak?! How come?
5002695.f4_s: How do I feel so good?
5002695.s1: Excuse me! How can you do something like that?
5002695.s3: How come? How can you say that?

5002712.c2_s1: I guess you could put the polearm on something.
5002712.c2_s3: Hmm... Maybe if I float here...
5002712.c2_f2: You know I'm a spirit, right?
5002712.c3_s2: But you should sit down too!
5002712.c3_s4: Surely you're the one who should rest their legs.
5002712.c3_f1: You need a body to sit.
5002712.c4_s3: There's not much point in me sitting down...
5002712.c4_f1: You want to take a break?
5002712.c4_f2: You can sit, if you want...
5002712.c4_f3: But don't you want to keep going?
5002712.c7_s1: Look, I'm sorry if I messed up.
5002712.c7_f2: Come on. What do you want from me?
5002712.c8_s1: I'm sorry if I upset you.
5002712.c8_s3: I'll make it up to you.
5002712.c8_f4: I don't understand. Try calming down.
5002712.c11_s2: Do I really have to say it?
5002712.c11_f2: Are you making fun of me?
5002712.c11_f4: At least try to sound convincing.
5002712.c12_s2: At least you said it first.
5002712.c12_s3: What's with all the mushy stuff?
5002712.c12_s4: I love you too. Stop smiling!
5002712.c14_f2: Why would you even want that?
5002712.c15_s2: At least with spirits there's no smell.
5002712.c15_f1: You can't just walk around talking like that.
5002712.c16_s2: Maybe I could rest my eyes for a bit.
5002712.c16_f2: What if I don't want to?
5002712.c17_s2: Maybe we could use a break.
5002712.c17_s3: See you in your dreams. Or maybe nightmares.
5002712.c17_f2: What? But you just woke up!
5002712.c18_s2: Make sure to set an alarm or something!
5002712.c18_s4: I don't know any lullabies. For the record.
5002712.c18_f1: Want me to freeze you in ice?
5002712.c18_f2: Would you want to sleep, in my shoes?
5002712.c18_f3: I'm tired of watching people sleep.
5002712.c18_f4: I've seen enough sleep for centuries.
5002712.c19_s2: What do you want to talk about?
5002712.c20_s4: You like talking to me, right?
5002712.c20_f2: You know who're cool? Strong, silent types.
5002712.c20_f4: You do enough talking for both of us.
5002712.c21_s1: You know how boring ice is?
5002712.c21_s2: It's been a long time since I've talked this much.
5002712.c21_s3: Centuries of silence... and now so much noise.
5002712.c21_s4: ...I like the sound of your voice.
5002712.c21_f1: I'm bored enough to waste time talking.
5002712.c21_f3: You think I'll talk just cause you tell me to?
5002712.s1: Huh? Why did you say that?
5002712.s3: Ha. You know how to spring it on a spirit.

5002716.c18_s2: *Snore* (It's dreaming of drifting through the deep sea.)
5002716.c18_s3: Kyu... *snore* (In its dream, it's snacking on some seaweed.)
5002716.c18_s4: (It must be sweet to dream of a soothing sea.)

5002717.c18_s2: Phu... *snore* (It's dreaming of drifting through a reef.)
5002717.c18_s3: *Snore* (Now it's dreaming of dozing in a warm sunbeam...)
5002717.c18_s4: (It must be nice to explore the sea in your dreams...)

5002718.c18_s2: Pyu... (It's dreaming of warm seas beneath soothing stars...)
5002718.c18_s3: *Snore* (Now it's dreaming of dancing in seafoam...)
5002718.c18_s4: (It must be comforting to dream of playing in the sea with your friends.)

5002719.c1_f1: You want me to sit here?
5002719.c1_f2: Surely there are better vantage points.
5002719.c2_s1: No need to run ourselves ragged. Let's rest.
5002719.c2_s4: A fine a spot to rest as any!
5002719.c2_f2: You risk the thunder of my wrath!
5002719.c3_s3: Well, then let us rest together.
5002719.c3_s4: Take a moment and listen to the birds sing!
5002719.c3_f1: If you wish to sit so much, you'd be better served with a chipmunk.
5002719.c3_f4: Oh, my poor fur. I always need a bath after adventuring with you...
5002719.c4_s1: We should sit for a portrait like this.
5002719.c4_s2: Truly, this is a fine day.
5002719.c4_s3: You're quite correct. To see the fruits of our efforts, we must rest as well.
5002719.c4_f1: You might lay down a blanket of leaves at least.
5002719.c4_f2: I have no reason to rest here.
5002719.c4_f4: But I have no desire to.
5002719.c6_s3: It was a mistake, on my part.
5002719.c6_f3: Do you wish to taste the thunder?
5002719.c7_f1: (The air seems to tingle with electricity.)
5002719.c7_f2: Do you wish to experience the thunder firsthand?
5002719.c7_f4: Continue in this vein and I shall terminate our partnership.
5002719.c8_f2: (A sudden silence descends, and the air seems heavy with tension.)
5002719.c8_f3: (Cover your ears! The thunder is coming!)
5002719.c9_s1: Well... that is very kind of you.
5002719.c10_s2: Does it please you to make me blush for all to see?
5002719.c10_s3: I care for you as well.
5002719.c10_f4: Do you perhaps feel a fever?
5002719.c11_s1: I enjoy your company as well.
5002719.c12_s1: I enjoy your company as well.
5002719.c12_s2: Love you? Let me list the ways.
5002719.c12_s4: Hehe, I suppose I AM a remarkable specimen.
5002719.c12_f4: As a kindness, I'll ignore that.
5002719.c13_s1: Keep an eye out for me!
5002719.c13_f4: When predators might be lurking? No way!
5002719.c14_s2: Shall I show you the thunder?
5002719.c14_s3: Ha! I feel as light as a leaf!
5002719.c14_s4: Fortunately, I had a superb repast.
5002719.c14_f2: I'll go when I go, and not a moment before.
5002719.c15_s1: Well, I was hoping for a chance to refresh myself...
5002719.c15_s2: Very well, but watch out for predators!
5002719.c15_s4: Ahaha! Behold the beauty of a balanced diet!
5002719.c15_f1: There's needing to relieve yourself and there's being rude. Learn the difference.
5002719.c15_f2: I thought you 'civilized' folk were... well, civilized.
5002719.c16_s3: Let us meet in the meadow of our dreams!
5002719.c16_f1: This place is far too cold to sleep.
5002719.c16_f4: Sleep now? When we have so much day ahead of us?
5002719.c17_s3: Not even dreams...can contain the thunder...
5002719.c17_s4: A fine notion. I was feeling somewhat wearied.
5002719.c17_f1: I won't sleep on the ground like some common chipmunk.
5002719.c17_f2: Need I spell it out for you? N! O!
5002719.c17_f3: How can you expect me to rest here?
5002719.c17_f4: Now? As in, this very moment?
5002719.c18_s1: (That must be some dream. Those little paws are moving furiously.)
5002719.c19_s1: This is a fine day to test our limits!
5002719.c19_s2: Do you believe I was born with the strength to shackle thunder? No! I worked hard each and every day!
5002719.c19_s4: Do you wish to wield the fury of the storm?
5002719.c19_f1: And I thought thunder was loud...
5002719.c19_f3: Silence! You'd fill the forest with your din!
5002719.c19_f4: Just give me a moment's peace, would you?
5002719.c20_s1: How shall we train our bodies today?
5002719.c20_s2: If you wish to harness the thunder, you must first build a strong heart.
5002719.c20_s3: Where shall our feet take us today?
5002719.c20_s4: The peace of Maple World is surely in no small part thanks to my power.
5002719.c20_f2: I can barely hear myself think with your chatter!
5002719.c20_f4: Go find some other fool to while away the wasted hours with you...
5002719.c21_s1: Even in the forest, I am without peer!
5002719.c21_s2: Do you wish to hear the legend of the forest?
5002719.c21_s3: Long ago, when the first trees sprouted... *snore*
5002719.c21_s4: Even my power might be improved!
5002719.c21_f2: You talk enough for both of us...
5002719.c21_f3: Why speak when silence says enough?
5002719.c21_f4: Perhaps we can talk later. Perhaps.
5002719.f1_s: A repast for the body and mind!
5002719.f2_s: Eating well is the foundation of training well!
5002719.f2_f: I... do not have an appetite.
5002719.f3_f: Just how do you expect me to eat this?
5002719.f4_f: I don't suppose you have any acorns?

5002720.c2_s3: I could use a cold glass of water.
5002720.c4_f1: Can't we go somewhere with water?
5002720.c6_f1: Don't make me cry--there might be a flood!
5002720.c6_f2: Do you really want it to rain?
5002720.c7_f2: I can unleash a torrent whenever, you know.
5002720.c7_f4: Keep that up, and I'll wash you away!

5002720.c12_s3: You're as cool as a mountain spring!
5002720.c12_s4: Of course you do! I'm cool!
5002720.c12_f3: Let's keep this arrangement professional, yeah?

5002720.c19_s4: Want to know the secret power of water?
5002720.c19_f3: Let's be quiet for a while, eh?
5002720.c20_s1: First a mountain river... Soon, the sea!
5002720.c20_s2: Before you can master water, you must first master yourself.
5002720.c20_s4: Maple World is peaceful... You're welcome.

5002720.c21_s3: I'm way stronger than that lazy chipmunk, right?
5002720.c21_s4: We'll the strongest--if we stick together!
5002720.f2_s: Food is also a part of training!

5002721.c1_f1: I could use a rest, but...
5002721.c2_s2: Let's put up our feet for a spell.

5002721.c4_f3: Isn't there somewhere a mite cleaner we can rest?
5002721.c6_f2: Curious about the power of making wind?
5002721.c6_f3: I can blow anything away, if I put my mind to it. Maybe even... you!

5002721.c8_f3: Here comes the wind! (Surely a terrible typhoon is coming!)

5002721.c12_s4: Hehe, that makes me so happy!
5002721.c13_s3: Nngh! (Was that a gust of wind?)
5002721.c14_s3: Phew! I feel like a new chipmunk!
5002721.c14_s4: Boy, I'm as light as a cloud!

5002721.c15_s4: What would a squirrel say? Even pooping can be training?

5002721.c16_s3: Let's hang out in our dreams!
5002721.c17_s4: I could use a bit of shut eye... *Snore*

5002721.c18_s1: (Is he dreaming of working out... or eating?)
5002721.c18_f1: Here? Without a pillow, or anything?
5002721.c18_f2: I may be easygoing... but I have standards!

5002721.c19_s4: Even in the face of a typhoon, I'll protect you!
5002721.c19_f1: I'm hankering for some quiet contemplation...

5002721.c21_f3: Quiet, please! I can't hear the breeze...
5002721.f2_s: Eating is the best part of training!
5002721.f4_f: Are there any foods that help you make wind?

5002723.s2: I'll pretend I didn't hear that! But only once!
5002723.s3: You... Do I need to teach you a lesson?

5002747.c7_f3: I don't have to take this from you! I'm a rock star!
5002747.c7_f4: So you don't like folk music. Fine! You don't have to be mean.
5002747.c8_s1: Okay, I'll tell you! Do you know the muffin man?
5002747.c8_s4: *twang* If I could tuuuurn back tiiiime...
5002747.c8_f2: I wouldn't be a rock star if I wasn't a little defiant.
5002747.c9_s1: Aw! You're the milk to my cookie!
5002747.c9_s2: You and me are the perfect batch!
5002747.c9_f1: I literally don't have the words... Or a song...
5002747.c9_f2: You know, we're more like oil and water than milk and cookies...

5002747.c10_f2: You gonna call me cookie or somethin'?
5002747.c10_f3: Wow! You're really laying the frosting on thick!
5002747.c10_f4: I'm really more of a solo guitarist...
5002747.c11_s2: I'm gonna write a song for you!
5002747.c11_s3: You're strumming the chords of my heart.
5002747.c11_f2: My first love will always be music.
5002747.c11_f3: That's SO not rock and roll!
5002747.c11_f4: You sound just like my groupies.
5002747.c12_s1: Oh! Are you gonna be my lead singer?
5002747.c12_s2: You're not just my best friend, you're my Queen!
5002747.c12_f1: I'm really more of a solo guitarist...
5002747.c12_f2: You gonna call me cookie or somethin'?
5002747.c12_f3: Oh, would you look at that?! I broke a string!
5002747.c12_f4: Um... fyi, that song wasn't about you.
5002747.c13_s1: Get ready for a big ol' pile of frosting!
5002747.c13_s2: If I try really hard, I poop sprinkles.
5002747.c13_s3: I'll sing an acoustic while I go!
5002747.c13_s4: Much better! Now I'm ready to rock and roll!
5002747.c13_f3: What a sugary mess that would be!
5002747.c14_s2: I guess I don't need my dressing room...
5002747.c14_s3: What a relief! Now I can write again!
5002747.c14_f2: I don't poop so much as... frost.
5002747.c14_f3: That's SO not rock and roll!
5002747.c14_f4: No time! Writing my next big single!
5002747.c15_s3: With a little musical inspiration... Hngh!
5002747.c15_s4: *beoow* You've gotta fight! For your right! To POOOOTTY!
5002747.c15_f1: You want a cookie to... poop?
5002747.c15_f2: Rock stars poop on tour busses.
5002747.c15_f4: What? You run out of frosting?
5002747.c16_s1: Okay! I'll dream of sugar plum sprinkles.
5002747.c16_s2: I can use some frosting for a pillow! *splat*
5002747.c16_s3: I'll dream about giving my best performance ever!
5002747.c16_f1: Rock stars don't sleep! We PARTY!
5002747.c16_f3: We're NOT gonna sleep now. NO! We ain't gonna sleep now.
5002747.c16_f4: I need to trash a fancy hotel room first. It's tradition.

5002747.c17_f3: No time! Writing my next big single!

5002747.c18_f1: No way! I've got an urge to ROCK!
5002747.c18_f2: Rock stars don't sleep! We PARTY!
5002747.c18_f3: Say pretty please with sprinkles on top!
5002747.c19_s1: What's an avocado's favorite music? Guac 'n' roll!
5002747.c19_s2: My favorite acoustic guitarist? This could take a while...
5002747.c19_s3: What kind of music scares balloons? POP music!
5002747.c19_s4: Why did the guitar smell fishy? Because it was a bass!
5002747.c19_f1: Rock stars don't play on command.
5002747.c19_f2: No way! I've got an urge to ROCK!
5002747.c19_f3: Am I just a performing cookie to you?!
5002747.c19_f4: No time! Writing my next big single!
5002747.c20_s1: I'm the guitarist, not the lead singer.
5002747.c20_s2: Why was the cookie so rich? It had a lot of dough!
5002747.c20_s3: Why did the cookie go to the doctor? It was feeling crumby!
5002747.c20_s4: Life is what you bake of it.
5002747.c20_f1: Nah. I've got a chocolate chip on my shoulder today.
5002747.c20_f4: You first. I've got to deal with some crumbs.
5002747.c21_s1: Dough you think I'm funny? I do.
5002747.c21_s2: Behind this sugary-sweet personality is... more sugar!
5002747.c21_s3: Why do basketball players love cookies? They can dunk them!
5002747.c21_s4: What's a pirate's favorite instrument? A guit-ARRR!
5002747.c21_f4: I'm a guitar, not a jukebox!
5002747.f1_s: Aw! You're the milk to my cookie!

5002748.c2_s1: Stay right here next to me!
5002748.c2_s4: This is just as cozy as a bed of clovers!

5002748.c3_s3: Oh, good. My stems are barking!
5002748.c3_f4: I don't really feel like it!
5002748.c4_s1: How fortuitous. I really needed a rest.
5002748.c4_s2: I was starting to miss you!
5002748.c4_s3: Yes! Let's sit and gather some luck.
5002748.c4_s4: I'm in such a good mood!
5002748.c4_f1: I'm not sure I want to.
5002748.c4_f2: Huh? It's not my favorite thing to do.
5002748.c7_s3: I'll think about what I've done!
5002748.c7_f2: Too much anger isn't good for you!
5002748.c8_s1: Will you forgive me this once?
5002748.c8_f1: I don't wanna get in trouble...
5002748.c11_s1: You do? Then you're in luck!
5002748.c11_f3: If only I could believe it...!
5002748.c12_s3: I'm so lucky to be with the person I love!
5002748.c12_f1: I don't think I do yet!
5002748.c13_s2: This is the power of luck!
5002748.c13_s4: Don't tell anybody I went here, okay?
5002748.c14_s1: Here's a whole load of luck for you!
5002748.c15_s2: Hm... Nice. I should do this more often.
5002748.c15_s3: Just don't tell anyone I went in public, okay?
5002748.c15_s4: This is gonna be a good one. I can feel it!
5002748.c15_f4: You really want me to do... that?
5002748.c16_s3: It's lucky we can rest here.
5002748.c16_f2: I can't! It's too loud here!
5002748.c16_f4: No way! I need to get sun while I can!
5002748.c17_s3: How lucky! I was starting to get tired.
5002748.c17_f1: I still want to play more!
5002748.c18_s1: I'm glad we can go to dreamland together!
5002748.c18_s3: My dreams are full of luck!
5002748.c18_s4: I'll give you lots of luck for good dreams!
5002748.c18_f4: That doesn't feel lucky at all!
5002748.c19_s1: What's green and brings you good luck?
5002748.c19_s2: Luck is always on our side!
5002748.c19_s3: Did you know shamrocks and clovers are different?
5002748.c19_f3: I don't know what to say!
5002748.c20_s1: This is the story of the Very Lucky Clover...
5002748.c20_s2: Today's lucky. I can feel it in my stems.
5002748.c20_s3: As long as we're together, we're always lucky!
5002748.c20_s4: I hope we always have happy stories!
5002748.c20_f2: I'm so thirsty I'm going to wilt!
5002748.c20_f4: You're really that dependent on me?...
5002748.c21_s3: What can we say to bring good luck?
5002748.c21_s4: Remember, you can make your own luck too!
5002748.s1: That's not a lucky thing to say!!!
5002748.s2: All the luck is going to run away!
5002748.s3: Enough!!! I'm really not happy anymore.
5002748.s4: I'll pretend you didn't just say that.

5002785.c3_f3: I don't really feel like it.
5002785.c4_s1: Only because I feel like it.
5002785.c7_s2: Perhaps I was out of line...
5002785.c8_s2: My tears will turn into ice...
5002785.c8_f1: I'll leave if you act like this.
5002785.c10_f1: I don't care much for jests.
5002785.c11_f2: You'll need to do better than that!
5002785.c13_s1: Keep it a secret, will you?

5002785.c14_s3: Keep it a secret, will you?
5002785.c15_s1: I don't need to be told.
5002785.c15_s2: Keep it a secret, will you?
5002785.c17_s1: Sure. I could use the rest.
5002785.c18_f3: I have no idea what you're saying...
5002785.c19_s2: What do you want me to say?
5002785.c20_s1: Have you seen the castle yet?
5002785.c20_s3: Better cold than hot, I say.
5002785.c21_s1: There's no better weather than snow.
5002785.c21_s2: The sun can fizzle out for all I care.

5002786.c2_s3: Only if you sit aside me.

5002786.c3_f3: My legs are cramped up right now.

5002786.c20_s1: Do you like the colder parts of the year?
5002786.c20_s2: I could go for more snow.

5002786.c20_s4: How lucky that we speak the same language.

5002786.c21_s2: There's no such thing as 'too cold.'
5002786.c21_s3: It'd be better if it were always winter.

5002787.c2_f1: But I want to play more...

5002787.c6_f3: I KNOW you're not talking to ME.

5002787.c8_f3: Hmph! That won't even make me blink!

5002787.c21_s4: Won't you come visit the castle?
5002787.c21_f4: I'll pretend you didn't just say that.
5002787.s2: I'll pretend I didn't hear that!

5002796.c2_s1: Just keep sitting. Just keep sitting.

5002796.c12_s2: Thank you! I love you, too!
5002796.c12_s3: We love you more than sweetness itself!

5002796.c14_s4: Don't look at me! It's weird!
5002796.c14_f1: What the top floor eats, the bottom floor wipes...
5002796.c14_f3: That was kind of a waste, don't you think?
5002796.c15_s2: These are the good kind of tummy rumbles.
5002796.c15_s3: I have paper. Well... I ate paper...
5002796.c15_s4: You should do it with me!
5002796.c15_f1: What do you expect of me, really?
5002796.c15_f4: I don't have nothing in the barrel...
5002796.c16_s4: I can't wait to see you tomorrow!
5002796.c16_f3: All I'm hearing is muffled trumpet noises.
5002796.c17_s3: Okay, maybe I'm just a little bit tired...
5002796.c17_f1: I can't sleep...there's too much awesome I could miss.
5002796.c18_s1: Have you ever seen a sweet sleep?
5002796.c18_s4: Nighty night. Don't let the soul bugs bite!
5002796.c19_s2: The spiwit up there is my younger sibwing.
5002796.c19_s3: What flavor do you think I am?
5002796.c19_s4: Just so you know, I'm not mint flavoured.
5002796.c19_f1: Talking takes more energy than I have right now.
5002796.c19_f2: Let me relax in peace, please!
5002796.c20_s1: Who's cuter? Me, or my sibwing up there?
5002796.c20_s2: I can't stand the taste of mint!
5002796.c20_s3: Whipped cream is the best hat for a sweet!
5002796.c20_s4: Sweet beats sour! And savoury... And other stuff...
5002796.c21_s2: Smash a boulder for a wock, a wock for a pwebble, and a pwebble for a wock spiwit!
5002796.c21_s3: All sorts of Awcana spiwits want to ride on my head.
5002796.c21_s4: Two spiwits are better than one!
5002796.c21_f3: Tweasing me is just plain mean.
5002796.c21_f4: No doesn't even begin to cover it!

5002804.c2_s1: I wouldn't be opposed to a little rest.

5002804.c3_f2: Why sit, when I can fly?
5002804.c3_f3: Do you enjoy ordering me around?
5002804.c4_s1: Would you like to rest with me?
5002804.c4_f3: I'm still a dragon, you know.

5002804.c8_f2: If you continue, I'll return to my lake.

5002804.c9_f2: Human emotions are as fickle as the wind.
5002804.c10_f1: I wouldn't poke a sleeping dragon.

5002804.c12_s4: My heart, my gem, and my wings are all yours.
5002804.c13_f1: You would give orders to a dragon??
5002804.c13_f2: I'll make you my next meal!
5002804.c13_f4: For your sake, you'd better not mean that.
5002804.c14_s4: This is NOT where my gem comes from, I'll have you know.
5002804.c14_f2: Do you fancy yourself a jester??
5002804.c14_f3: I'll pretend I didn't hear you.
5002804.c14_f4: I'd sooner lose all my scales!
5002804.c16_f2: I have life left in me yet.
5002804.c17_s3: At my age, a nap couldn't hurt.
5002804.c17_f1: A dragon sleeps when she wishes.
5002804.c18_s4: Travel into the land of dreams with me.
5002804.c18_f1: Yet you are not resting either.
5002804.c18_f2: I spent a hundred years sleeping already.
5002804.c18_f4: But then who will watch over you?
5002804.c19_s1: Do you want to learn more about the imugi?
5002804.c19_s2: Do you wish to hear a story?
5002804.c19_s3: Have your adventures broadened your perspective?
5002804.c19_s4: I fear the stagnation of still waters.
5002804.c19_f4: If only I had an interesting conversational partner.
5002804.c20_s2: Would you like to hear the legend of the imugi?
5002804.c20_s3: The scent of plum blossoms dances in the wind today.
5002804.c20_f3: Dragons have busy schedules, you know.
5002804.c20_f4: My jaw is better suited for biting!
5002804.c21_s1: Stagnation is complacency. Seek the flow of the world's heart.
5002804.c21_s2: Let us soar to greater heights.
5002804.c21_s3: I once... It's of no consequence.
5002804.c21_s4: I wish only joy and laughter for you, my dear.
5002804.s2: Where did such rumors come from?!
5002804.s3: Are we still speaking the same language?!

5002806.c2_s1: Fine, fine. If you really want me to.
5002806.c2_s3: There. My butt's on the ground.
5002806.c2_f1: Ugh. I have things to do!

5002806.c7_f1: I'll smack you with my tail!
5002806.c7_f2: I'll prank you if you don't stop!
5002806.c7_f3: I'm still a dinosaur, you know!
5002806.c7_f4: Hmph! No more jokes for you!
5002806.c8_f1: Blah, blah! I can't hear you!
5002806.c8_f4: Please come back during business hours.

5002806.c9_f2: Hahaha! That was a funny one.
5002806.c10_s2: I don't even feel like pranking you anymore!
5002806.c10_s3: What do you call two dinos drawn together? In love!
5002806.c10_f2: You've gotta try harder than that.
5002806.c11_s1: I must be doing something right!
5002806.c11_s3: I could draw pictures of you forever!
5002806.c11_f4: Well, there's plenty of other dinos in the land!
5002806.c12_s1: I'd even give up pranking for you!
5002806.c12_s3: If you were a marker, I'd pick you!

5002806.c12_f3: You pulling my horn right now?
5002806.c13_f4: Why? What're you gonna do with it?
5002806.c15_s3: Isn't it impressive that I can poop on command?
5002806.c15_f1: But I don't need to yet...
5002806.c15_f2: I'm kinda backed up right now.
5002806.c16_f2: I didn't think we knew each other like that!
5002806.c16_f3: Now that was one heck of a prank.
5002806.c16_f4: Hmph! You can kiss my horns!
5002806.c17_s4: Hehe. Only because you're so nice to me.
5002806.c17_f1: You gotta woo me a little first!
5002806.c17_f2: Aren't we moving a little too fast?
5002806.c18_f1: I didn't brush my teeth yet!
5002806.c18_f3: Careful! My nose spike is pointy!

5002806.c19_s2: Do you wanna hear a joke?

5002806.c19_f4: I'm all out of words today.
5002806.c20_s2: Let's brainstorm some practical jokes together!
5002806.c20_s4: My siblings said they're tired of my pranks...
5002806.c21_s1: Hehe. You want to talk to Toppy?
5002806.c21_s2: Yay! Talking to you is the favorite part of my day!
5002806.c21_s3: Do you have any good jokes?
5002806.c21_s4: You're the funniest person I know!
5002806.c21_f2: Not right now. I'm prepping my stand-up routine.
5002806.f2_s: Now that's what I'm talking about!
5002806.f3_f: Not even T-roar would eat that!

5002807.c3_s1: Same if sit or stand. Stubby legs.
5002807.c3_f3: No tell T-roar what to do!
5002807.c12_s3: T-roar happy from head to toe.

5002807.c12_f3: Don't make T-roar think too hard.

5002807.c21_s2: T-roar sad can't hug owner. Stubby arms.

5002808.c2_s2: I'm sitting really cutely, aren't I?
5002808.c2_s3: Aaand I cross my legs like this... Cute!
5002808.c2_f2: I have to clean my plates.
5002808.c3_s4: Do you think I'm cute when I sit?

5000133.c4_s1: I just place my bottom upon the ground?

5000133.c4_s4: I will, should you bring me a loaf of the meat variety.

5000133.c6_f3: I have done nothing to earn your scorn!
5000133.c6_f4: A bolt of lightning might change your attitude.
5000133.c7_s1: I understand, you are under a lot of stress.

5000133.c7_f1: One of these days, I'm going to drop this marble on your head.
5000133.c7_f3: Is this how you mortals treat one another?!
5000133.c7_f4: I will watch you fry one day.
5000133.c8_s2: I haven't felt this bad since I ate that priest.
5000133.c8_s3: I find you strangely terrifying, mortal.
5000133.c8_s4: I have shamed a thousand generations of my ancestors.
5000133.c8_f1: But I have done everything you asked!
5000133.c8_f2: You are the most fickle mortal I've ever met.
5000133.c8_f3: You are adorable when you are angry.
5000133.c8_f4: Find something else to yell at!

5000133.c10_f4: You are making my scales itch.
5000133.c11_s1: Why do my cheeks feel warm? WHAT HAVE YOU DONE TO ME?!
5000133.c11_s2: My heart thumps when you say these measly words!
5000133.c11_s4: I believe you mortals would say, "ditto".
5000133.c11_f1: My dragon heart is not to be trifled with.
5000133.c11_f2: Do not say anything you will regret.
5000133.c11_f3: I, uh, have to wash my scales tonight.

5000133.c12_s3: Might a humble dragon receive a kiss?

5000133.c12_f4: Who needs love when you have power?!
5000133.c13_s2: My eyes may be closed, but I have the reflexes of a water dragon!

5000133.c13_f1: Perhaps you'll think of a better wish later.
5000133.c13_f2: Grawr! It is not my nap time!

5000133.c14_s1: I suppose I could use a recharge.

5000133.c14_f3: This place is not fit for my great slumber!
5000133.c14_f4: I am no cat, content to lie in the sun!
5000133.c15_s1: May I rest upon your lap? This cloud is quite cold.

5000133.c16_s3: Do know you how luck you are? Let me tell you.

5000133.c16_f4: I did not descend from the heavens to banter!
5000133.c17_s1: Your world is teeming with life.

5000133.c17_s4: I am omnipotent and all powerful, but I do get a little lonely.
5000133.c17_f2: Hold on, let me see if I have anything...NO.
5000133.c17_f3: Why do you waste my power?
5000133.c18_s1: Your enormous head must be quite a burden.

5000133.c19_f3: Do the powers of the gods so amuse you?

5000133.c20_f3: Have you nothing better to wish for?!
5000133.c21_s3: I will sink through my cloud if I eat another bite!

5000134.c8_s4: I might cry if you yell...

5000134.c8_f2: Are you actually scolding me right now?
5000134.c8_f3: I have a LOT of friends who like me!
5000134.c10_s2: You're a one of a kind person!

5000134.c10_f4: Give me some Star Candies, and we'll talk!
5000134.c11_s2: Am I prettier than a rose?
5000134.c11_f4: You don't know how to play!

5000134.c12_f2: I could use a little space.

5000134.c12_f4: I'm a free-spirited fox! Don't try to chain me!
5000134.c13_s2: Okay, but you have to clean it up!
5000134.c13_s3: I'll really pour myself into this one!
5000134.c13_s4: I could do this all day!
5000134.c13_f4: I only do that for ME!
5000134.c14_s2: I don't know why you want that, but you got it!
5000134.c15_s2: Arooo! My face is all red now!
5000134.c15_s3: I don't think I'll ever stop!
5000134.c15_f3: I'll poop when I wanna poop!
5000134.c15_f4: You're going to get us in trouble!
5000134.c16_f2: I'm independent! I take naps on my own time!
5000134.c16_f4: Going to sleep already? You're lazy!
5000134.c17_s2: Ah, my soft and cozy tail.
5000134.c17_s3: I'm going to dream up a storm!

5000134.c17_f2: Sleeping out in the open is romantic, but not now.
5000134.c17_f3: I want to enjoy the day! Aroo!
5000134.c18_s2: Arooo... I miss the prince and rose... zzz
5000134.c18_s3: Sleeping in the desert is SO romantic!
5000134.c18_f2: Bring me a blanket and pillow or no deal!
5000134.c18_f3: Why aren't we out hunting? That's way more fun!
5000134.c19_s1: Aroo! I want to go to the desert of freedom!
5000134.c19_s2: I used to travel with a wonderful prince!
5000134.c19_s3: I love Star Candy so much!
5000134.c19_f1: What are we talking about? I'm a fox!
5000134.c19_f2: Arooo! Did you want to hear something?
5000134.c19_f3: A fox has to keep some secrets!
5000134.c20_s1: Wanna go watch the shooting star?
5000134.c20_s2: The star that the prince and I went to was much better.
5000134.c20_s3: Aren't you curious about the meteor I was on?
5000134.c20_s4: Eating star candy can make you feel better!
5000134.c20_f2: We foxes are known for our quietness.
5000134.c21_s1: I can't believe they have more like me at a ZOO!
5000134.c21_s2: There are so many people on this star!
5000134.c21_s4: I get my fur trimmed on a daily basis.
5000134.c21_f1: You should learn to entertain yourself!
5000134.c22_s3: You should play some music first!
5000134.c22_s4: I want to be in a concert!
5000134.c22_f2: I don't know what that means.
5000134.c22_f3: Aroo! I wanna do something else!
5000134.c23_s1: Up and down my head goes!
5000134.c23_s2: The prince taught me how to do that!
5000134.c23_s3: That dance is super popular on asteroid B-612!
5000134.c23_f2: We've got all day tomorrow too!
5000134.f3_s: It's good to be a fox of the desert!
5000134.f4_s: I was JUST thinking about these!
5000134.s2: Do not want! Let's see it again!
5000134.s3: That word is SO not romantic!
5000134.s4: You say bad things! Earth really is a gloomy place!

5000135.c2_s2: Finally I can get some rest!
5000135.c2_f2: I don't want to sit here.
5000135.c3_s2: Can I take a Chocolate Muffin break?

5000135.c3_f2: Don't order me around like that! I will crush you!
5000135.c3_f3: Humph... I deserve a better place to rest
