5000139.c17_f2: I'm too depressed to talk right now, clickk clickkk!
5000139.c17_f3: I have nothing to say to you... pooof!!
5000139.c18_s1: It's awesome day to fly around today! poooofff!
5000139.c18_s2: I am on Cloud Nine and more good things are coming our way! Pooooof!
5000139.c18_s3: Let's get something nice to eat today shall we? Clickkk clickkk!
5000139.c18_s4: Let's go to the garden today for some fun! Poooofff!
5000139.c18_f1: There's nothing for me to say now,! clickkk clickkkk!
5000139.c18_f3: I have so little to say!
5000139.c19_s1: Are you dating someone? I'm not...
5000139.c19_s2: Hey, can you beat Pink Bean?
5000139.c19_s3: You better play some Gachapon today, cause I'm feeling lucky!
5000139.c19_s4: I heard there's something scary in a cave in Leafre!
5000139.c19_f1: Let's put the talk aside, it's time to get some food to eat! POOOF!
5000139.c19_f2: You must be really bored aren't you? Pooooofff!
5000139.c19_f3: Arrgh...didn't hear a thing...didn't hear a thing...
5000139.c19_f4: Sometime butterflies do have our OFF day!
5000139.c21_f1: You sure you are not lying?
5000139.c22_s1: That's so sweet! I LOVE YOU TOO! Pooooooof!
5000139.c22_s2: Thanks thanks! I love you too! Poooooof!
5000139.c22_s3: I guess I am starting to fall in love with you too! Pooooof!
5000139.c22_s4: I like you very very much! Poooof!
5000139.c22_f3: That came as a surprise! I am experiencing butterflies in my stomach now!
5000139.c23_s1: Catch this cupid's arrow from me to you! Pooooof!
5000139.c23_s2: My heart will go on and on for you, pooooof!
5000139.c23_s3: ORLY? I LOVE YOU TOO! Pooooof!
5000139.c23_s4: You don't really see a butterfly blush don't you? I am blushing now!
5000139.c23_f1: Quit playing games with my heart! Poooof!
5000139.c23_f2: You gotta lay off those gummi bears!
5000139.c23_f3: Don't say you love me, you don't even know me! clickkk clickkk!
5000139.c23_f4: Time to grab some bites! Poooof!
5000139.c24_s1: Time to sleep in my cosy leaf bed! Will you hug me to sleep tonight?
5000139.c24_s3: Hold me tight in your arms! Clickkk Clickkk!
5000139.c24_s4: Don't let the bed bugs bite! Hehe!
5000139.c24_f1: Let's go for some late night! I am not sleepy!
5000139.c24_f2: Sing me a lullaby and I will go to my wonderland!
5000139.c24_f3: Let me dance with the moon and stars tonight!
5000139.c24_f4: I can't sleep cause I am dreaming of something...
5000139.c25_s1: Let the power of the butterflies transform!
5000139.c25_s2: Time to transform into a Monster Moth!
5000139.c25_f1: Can't just do it all the time, you know.
5000139.c25_f2: I can't just do it anywhere.
5000139.c25_f3: Too much only spoils the fun.
5000139.c25_f4: Let's just sit and relax, shall we?
5000139.f2_f: I have to stop eating now! Arghhh!
5000139.f3_s: You're really good at it aren't you?
5000139.f3_f: I'm too full to eat anymore!
5000139.s2: Why are you aking me to say that kind of words? Clickkk clickkkkk~

5000141.c3_f2: Or we could do something else...
5000141.c3_f3: Do you hear yourself? All these commands...
5000141.c4_s4: Check it out... Pretty good, right?
5000141.c4_f3: Ahh... I'm sleepy... Can't hear you...
5000141.c4_f4: Sitting's waaay too easy... I'm feeling underutilized here.
5000141.c6_f2: I was just minding my own business... then this! Squerch!
5000141.c6_f3: Why do you do this? Squerch?
5000141.c6_f4: I know squerch kwon do and I WILL use it! Squerch!
5000141.c7_s3: You're not really mad, right? Right?
5000141.c7_f1: Some masters let their pets have fun...
5000141.c7_f3: I looked up some other masters... Turns out there are plenty of options.
5000141.c8_s3: I promise I'll be good now...
5000141.c8_f1: I haven't done anything wrong, and still...
5000141.c8_f2: Is there a reason for this or do you just like yelling?
5000141.c8_f3: I'm so used to it, I don't even feel it anymore...
5000141.c8_f4: Master gets bored, so I get yelled at...
5000141.c10_f1: It's not pooping time yet. Squerch.
5000141.c10_f2: How can I poop if you don't feed me? Squerch.
5000141.c10_f3: Pooping is only for the bathroom. Squerch.
5000141.c11_s1: Oooh... I almost stepped in it...
5000141.c11_f1: It hasn't been long enough yet, master.
5000141.c11_f3: Not really into pooping on command...
5000141.c11_f4: When do I get to tell YOU to poop, master?
5000141.c12_s2: Ahh... whoa, my breakfast just came out like that...
5000141.c12_s3: Phew! Doesn't my poop look as adorable as me?
5000141.c12_s4: Phew... You can tell it's been a while! Yowza!
5000141.c12_f1: I don't have anything to poop out in the first place!
5000141.c12_f4: I'm saving it all for one big poop.
5000141.c14_f3: Did you just say what I think you said? Squerch.
5000141.c15_s3: I think I love you too!
5000141.c15_f2: And you just had to tell me?
5000141.c15_f3: Ah... I thought you were going to say something else...
5000141.c15_f4: That was a good one... haha...
5000141.c16_s2: You're the only one in my heart, master!
5000141.c16_s3: You're making my gills red, master...
5000141.c16_s4: Oh! Oh!! Me too! Me too!! hehe...
5000141.c16_f3: Probably should have kept that one to yourself...
5000141.c16_f4: You'll have to do better than that...
5000141.c18_f1: You want me to fake it? Squerch.
5000141.c18_f2: Have you seen a shark smile? Not pretty. Squerch.
5000141.c18_f4: How about a treat instead? Squerch.
5000141.c19_s3: I'll do whatever you ask me to do, master!
5000141.c19_s4: I'm already smiling... Cause I'm with you!
5000141.c19_f1: I only open my mouth for food.
5000141.c19_f2: Not really feeling the whole happiness thing right now...
5000141.c19_f3: Now you're in charge of my emotions too?
5000141.c20_f2: Maybe if there's a reward involved.
5000141.c22_s1: How can you say such thing... Squerch.
5000141.c23_s1: M... master... I can't believe you said that...
5000141.c23_s2: That was a joke... right? Right?
5000141.c23_s4: Master, I get hurt when you say that...
5000141.c23_f2: And the meanest master of the year award goes to...
5000141.c23_f3: I see why it's hard for you to make friends.
5000141.c24_s2: Do you really not like me?
5000141.c24_s3: You say this all the time. Maybe I'm doing something wrong.
5000141.c24_f1: Wah? What? I can't hear you.
5000141.c24_f3: Say it again. See what happens.
5000141.c24_f4: I'm sick of you berating me!
5000141.c25_s2: The more you go hunting, the better the items you'll find. Squerch.
5000141.c25_s3: Isn't it nice out here today? We should go somewhere to play! Squerch.
5000141.c25_s4: I need a nap on top of a comfortable blanket. Squerch.
5000141.c25_f1: Have you ever heard of a chatty shark? Squerch.
5000141.c25_f2: I have nothing to say to you... Squerch...
5000141.c25_f4: I can't talk to you right now. Squerch.
5000141.c26_s1: I have a feeling a nice item may come our way today!
5000141.c26_s2: Master, you'll get me some good food today, right?
5000141.c26_s3: How are you today? Good? Good!
5000141.c26_s4: A lot of people are here, so make sure to be courteous!
5000141.c26_f1: I don't have anything to say...
5000141.c26_f2: Not much goin on over here...
5000141.c27_s2: Master, are you dating someone? I just met someone. Maybe we could go on a double date?
5000141.c27_s3: Master, you have a huge head... hahaha. HUGE!
5000141.c27_f1: This is boring... I need something more exciting
5000141.c27_f4: Why do you keep talking to me? I'm trying to sleep...
5000141.c28_s1: Buurrrrpp. Don't I look cute burping? Squerch.
5000141.c28_s2: My friends tell me the same thing! Squerch.
5000141.c28_s3: This is my area of expertise. Squerch.
5000141.c28_f1: You don't have to tell me that...
5000141.c28_f2: That doesn't mean much coming from you.
5000141.c28_f3: Whoa, master must have gone nuts.
5000141.c29_s1: So you want me to burp? Burrrrrpppp. What do you think?
5000141.c29_s3: You won't find a cuter pet anywhere! Squerch.
5000141.c29_s4: Master, what do you think? Cute, right? Squerch!
5000141.c29_f1: Master! Just get me some food! Squerch!
5000141.c29_f2: I don't wanna do cute stuff! Squerch!
5000141.c30_s1: Like this? At least you know a cute act when you see one...
5000141.c30_s2: Here's a nice gassy burp for you!
5000141.c30_s3: No one can match my burping skills!
5000141.c30_f1: You think I'll just do whatever you ask... I thought you were smarter.
5000141.c30_f2: I need to eat in order to burp, you know...
5000141.c30_f3: I ate onions and garlic just now... no burping! No cuteness!
5000141.c30_f4: How do I put this... No?
5000141.c31_s1: I'm tired. I need to sleep. Squerch...
5000141.c31_s2: So sleepy... let me sleep... squerch...
5000141.c31_f1: How am I going to sleep if I'm not even tired! Squerch!
5000141.c32_s3: Don't go eat something good while I'm asleep! Squerch.
5000141.c32_f2: So you can doodle on my fins? No thanks!
5000141.c32_f3: I'm hungry! Can't sleep! Feed me!
5000141.f2_f: I am about to blow up... squerch...
5000141.f3_s: Master, this is so delicious... squerch!!!
5000141.f4_s: This is as good as it gets!
5000141.f4_f: Are you trying to kill me, master?
5000141.s2: Squerch? You asking doesn't always mean me doing...
5000141.s3: Squerch! My precious mouth will not spit those venomous words!
5000141.s4: Please, no... no flavors like that... Squerch.

5000142.c2_s1: I'm a nice lamb that obeys well!
5000142.c2_s2: I was going to sit, baa!
5000142.c2_s4: I was actually planning to rest, baa!
5000142.c2_f1: I'm going to play more, baa!
5000142.c3_s3: Baa baa, you should sit down too.
5000142.c3_f1: Baa baa? What did you say?
5000142.c3_f2: I can't hear you, I can't hear you, baa baa!
5000142.c3_f3: I'm going to fly around more, baa baa!
5000142.c4_s1: Should we rest a bit? Baa baa.
5000142.c4_s3: Baa baa! What a peaceful feeling!
5000142.c4_f1: Baa baa? Are you talking to me?
5000142.c4_f2: I don't hear anything, baa baa!
5000142.c4_f4: Baa? What's with you all of sudden?
5000142.c6_s3: Baah! (It appears to be calling its mother...)
5000142.c6_s4: Baa! Don't do this to me...
5000142.c6_f2: Baa... maybe I should change owners.
5000142.c6_f4: I don't even wanna hear it...
5000142.c7_s2: Baa baa! It's all my fault!
5000142.c7_s3: Baa! Did I really mess up that badly?
5000142.c7_s4: Baa... I won't do that again...
5000142.c7_f1: Hmph, I'll be the bigger ram.
5000142.c7_f2: My patience has limits, baa baa.
5000142.c7_f3: Are you going to keep this up, baa?
5000142.c7_f4: If only I had a nicer owner...
5000142.c8_s2: Why do you always yell at me... *Cries*
5000142.c8_s3: I'm going to tell my mommy, baa baa...
5000142.c8_s4: Wahhhh! You're just mean because you're bigger than me!
5000142.c8_f1: I really wish I could just smack you, baa baa.
5000142.c8_f2: I'm gonna call animal protective services!
5000142.c8_f3: I can get scary when I'm angry, baa...
5000142.c8_f4: Baa baa... THAT does it! (Veins popping.)
5000142.c10_s3: Baa baa! I like, I like!
5000142.c10_s4: I like you very much also!
5000142.c10_f2: Baa baa. You aren't supposed to joke around like that.
5000142.c10_f4: Treat me well when you have the chance, baa.
5000142.c11_s2: Baa! I'm always on your side!
5000142.c11_f2: I said... I can't hear you!
5000142.c11_f3: Baa Baa! I got it, I got it!
5000142.c12_s1: Baa! I love hanging out with you!
5000142.c12_s4: Baa! Affectionate actions make Pufframs dance!
5000142.c12_f3: Baa baa. I already know your feelings.
5000142.c12_f4: So what do you want me to do, baa baa?
5000142.c13_f2: I'm shocked, I don't even have words.
5000142.c13_f3: (Little veins are popping out on its forehead.)
5000142.c13_f4: Do you KNOW what you are saying?
5000142.c14_f1: Something needs to go in for something to come out!
5000142.c15_s1: Baa baa! Every day is a healthy day!!
5000142.c15_f1: It's not going to come out just because you whine!
5000142.c15_f2: Baa... let's have some common sense, shall we?
5000142.c15_f3: Baa baa... You want to get smacked?
5000142.c15_f4: I'll let you off for today...
5000142.c16_f3: No! I want to play more!
5000142.c16_f4: I want to play more, baa baa!
5000142.c18_s1: Baa... someday I'll soar higher than a dragon. Baa...
5000142.c18_f1: Can't you see that my eyes are still WIDE open?
5000142.c18_f2: Baa baa? What are you saying?
5000142.c18_f4: I'm not that lazy, baa baa.
5000142.c19_s1: Baa Baa! So today, I'm going to... (Now it won't stop talking.)
5000142.c19_s2: Are you amazed by flying lambs? So the secret of our race is...
5000142.c19_s3: Maple World is a pretty nice place to live, baa baa.
5000142.c19_s4: When we were living up in the sky, angels mistook us for clouds.
5000142.c19_f1: Is it strange that I talk?
5000142.c19_f4: Baa? Weren't we talking just a second ago?
5000142.c20_s1: Have you every had a Cloud Candy? It's the baaaaa-st.
5000142.c20_s3: If there's one thing I hate, it's wolves.
5000142.c20_s4: We are called Pufframs because we live above the clouds.
5000142.c20_f1: Baa baa... just leave me alone...
5000142.c20_f2: I don't want to talk right now, baa.
5000142.c20_f3: Mmm... are you hungry for a conversation?
5000142.c21_s1: Baa baa, would it be better to walk or fly?
5000142.c21_s2: Baa baa, you want to hear something interesting?
5000142.c21_s3: Which one of us do you think can fly faster? Me or the eagle?
5000142.c21_s4: To the Pufframs, the Golden Horn is a symbol of adulthood.
5000142.c21_f1: You look bored... too bad I'm not!
5000142.c21_f3: (It appears to be thinking about something.)
5000142.c21_f4: What if I say no, baa baa?
5000142.c22_s3: This is the Puffram booty dance!!
5000142.c22_f2: Am I in the circus or something, baa baa?
5000142.c22_f3: Baa baa... I said, it sounds annoying...
5000142.c22_f4: I actually have this super cool trick... but I don't feel like it right now.
5000142.c23_s1: (Jumps up and down.) Baa! Baa! Baa! Baa!
5000142.c23_s4: It's super fun when you do it above the clouds, baa baa.
5000142.c23_f2: Can't I just be your pet?
5000142.c23_f3: Too hungry... no strength... baa baa.
5000142.f3_s: Baa baa, eating time's my favorite time!!
5000142.s2: You want to get reported, baa baa?
5000142.s4: I'm so disappointed in you, baa baa!!

5000143.c2_s2: Why should I listen to you?
5000143.c2_s3: Do I look like a dog to you? Sit, indeed!
5000143.c2_s4: Yes, perhaps I shall rest my wings. RAWK!!
5000143.c2_f3: Who are you to order me around? Hm?
5000143.c2_f4: Birds can't sit, you featherless buffoon!
5000143.c3_s1: I'm sitting already! I'm sitting RIGHT NOW!
5000143.c3_s2: Yes, yes, what is it?! I swear, if you tell me to sit one more time...
5000143.c3_s3: I would be DELIGHTED if you joined me! Don't you have a chair?
5000143.c3_s4: Very well. But what's this? No cushion?
5000143.c3_f2: You dare tell me to sit? RAWK!
5000143.c3_f3: Where shall I sit? On your shoulder? Or on your head?
5000143.c4_s1: The dictionary defines 'sit' as resting with the torso vertical and the body supported on the buttocks. Correct?
5000143.c4_s2: Yes, it's nice to sit with my intellectual equal. RAWK!
5000143.c4_s4: Yes, I am quite tired. We've been on a long journey, and I fear I've talked myself into a stupor. RAWK!
5000143.c4_f1: Why do you insist I sit?
5000143.c4_f2: Don't you know any other commands?!
5000143.c4_f4: No. No, that's quite all right. Rawk!
5000143.c6_s1: Perhaps I was bad. But you'll hear no apology from me!
5000143.c6_s3: Of course. It won't happen again. Whatever you say.
5000143.c6_s4: What can I say? My apologies.
5000143.c6_f4: What is the meaning of this? Unbelievable...
5000143.c7_s1: I've nothing to say to a tyrant like you!
5000143.c7_s2: How does throwing a temper tantrum help anything?
5000143.c7_s3: There's no need to be so forceful.
5000143.c7_s4: I understand. But is this really my fault?
5000143.c7_f2: I'll hear you out. What did I do wrong this time?
5000143.c7_f4: Rawk! Do you want an apology?
5000143.c8_s1: If you can explain to me what I did wrong, I will be more than happy to apologize.
5000143.c8_s2: Perhaps what I did was wrong, but will an apology REALLY make you feel better?
5000143.c8_s3: I know what I did was wrong! I don't need you to remind me.
5000143.c8_s4: Yes, I'm a bad parrot. Does that make you feel better?
5000143.c8_f2: I have nothing to say to you. RAWK!
5000143.c8_f3: I don't know what you're talking about, and I don't care!
5000143.c8_f4: Think this over. Don't you value our friendship? RAWK!
5000143.c10_s1: Love, love. Such a sweet word!
5000143.c10_s2: You like me? You really like me?
5000143.c10_s3: Is your love true? Oh, who cares!
5000143.c10_s4: I'd blush, but parrots can't blush...
5000143.c10_f1: Sorry, but my heart belongs to a little parakeet in Henesys.
5000143.c10_f3: But what will the other parrots think?
5000143.c11_s1: The love between parrot and master is forever!
5000143.c11_s2: Is it the color of my feathers that did it? Or the manly shape of my beak?
5000143.c11_s3: Sh, keep your voice down! You're embarrassing me...
5000143.c11_s4: Caaan you feeel the love tooooday...
5000143.c11_f2: No! I won't let you break this parrot heart!
5000143.c11_f3: Sure, you say that now, but isn't this just a flight of fancy?
5000143.c12_s1: My melancholy heart, once dark like Kerning City's nighttime sky, is brightened by your affection! CRAAAAW!!
5000143.c12_s2: Yes! Very good! Let's have fun! RAWK!
5000143.c12_s3: Thank you. Not that I feel the same way, but it's nice to hear.
5000143.c12_f1: You find me attractive? Is that what you're telling me?
5000143.c12_f2: Do you feel a special kinship for me? Or is it something more?
5000143.c12_f3: Love? I simply can't understand it.
5000143.c13_s2: Good idea to lighten the load. Makes it easier to fly. Rawk!
5000143.c13_s3: Rawk! You need a sample? I didn't know you were a doctor!
5000143.c13_s4: I feel so refreshed. I feel like I can fly! Rawk!
5000143.c13_f1: Sorry. Stomach's not feeling up to the task today!
5000143.c13_f2: What a thing to say! Rawk!
5000143.c13_f3: What a disgusting thing to say!
5000143.c14_s1: Rawk! I'll just make a little room for lunch.
5000143.c14_s2: Rawk! I was going to do that, anyway!
5000143.c14_s4: You can tell I've been eating the good stuff because it doesn't smell. Ha!
5000143.c14_f2: Stop asking me to do such base things! RAWK!
5000143.c14_f3: I'm not a faucet, you know. It doesn't happen on command.
5000143.c15_s1: That's a child's word. I prefer the word feces, myself.
5000143.c15_s2: Observe, as my body excretes the waste it's built up through the digestive process!
5000143.c15_s3: I've got stage fright. Mind singing a song to help me relax?
5000143.c15_f1: RAWK! That didn't feel right out. Maybe I should see a doctor...
5000143.c15_f2: How did you know I had to go? That's a little unsettling...
5000143.c15_f3: Why don't you look after your business, and I'll look after my own? Rawk!
5000143.c15_f4: I seem to be having trouble. Do you have some yogurt I could eat? Rawk!
5000143.c16_s2: This is nice sleeping weather. Rawk!
5000143.c16_s3: I may not have eyelids, but I can sleep with the best of them!
5000143.c16_s4: Remember, even when I sleep, I'm watching you! Zzz...
5000143.c16_f2: What will you do while I sleep? Rawk!
5000143.c16_f3: It's much too early for that!
5000143.c16_f4: You won't put ME to sleep!
5000143.c17_s1: Perhaps I'll wake up early and get the worm... Rawk!
5000143.c17_s2: I'm going to eat well and sleep right. Goodnight!
5000143.c17_s3: Goodnight, and may you dream of many eagles.
5000143.c17_s4: Rawk! I can't sleep right after eating!
5000143.c17_f1: No. I get headaches if I sleep too much.
5000143.c17_f2: I'll not sleep my life away! RAWK!
5000143.c17_f3: I'll sleep when I please, thank you very much!
5000143.c17_f4: Sometimes I get so busy counting sheep I forget to actually sleep.
5000143.c18_s1: Nothing like a good nap when you're feeling sleepy!
5000143.c18_s2: I'll dream of pigs and slimes tonight. I just know it.
5000143.c18_s3: My friends say I talk to much. Makes it hard to sleep. That's not true, is it? RAWK!
5000143.c18_s4: I can't sleep on the floor! Bring me some nice, comfortable branches to perch on.
5000143.c18_f1: I can't talk now. I'd rather chat! Rawk! Rawk! RAAAWK!
5000143.c18_f2: You're going to hit me after I fall asleep, right? I'm on to you!
5000143.c18_f4: You're just trying to get me to shut up, aren't you? Rawk!
5000143.c19_s2: Sometimes the cap'n doesn't use good grammar! Rawk!
5000143.c19_s3: Don't get me wrong, Adriano's a fine navigator. But isn't he a little too quiet?
5000143.c19_s4: Bonkey is dumb as a brick. I wouldn't want to be on his bad side, though!
5000143.c20_s1: Quick! Get me a navigator and a helmsman, and we'll set sail for Florina Beach!
5000143.c20_s2: Secrets? No such thing. If you can tell one person, you can tell everybody!
5000143.c20_s3: They say it's not good to talk too much, but I've never found this to be the case! Rawk!
5000143.c20_s4: A pirate ship is blind without a good parrot in the crow's nest! Rawk!
5000143.c21_s1: Here's a question! Why is it always night in Magatia and day in Ariant?
5000143.c21_s2: Who're the strongest people in Maple World? First Cygnus, then Aran. Third would be the ruler of the Elves, but she's long gone...
5000143.c21_s3: Is the Black Mage real? No one's seen him, have they? It all sounds made up to me!
5000143.c21_s4: According to this, a pirate is someone who...attacks ships at sea and steals from others. Huh, go figure...
5000143.c21_f2: Hello! Hello! Kraw want a cracker!
5000143.c22_s2: Sit back, relax, and enjoy the show. Rawk!
5000143.c22_f2: I don't perform tricks. Do I look like a mere pet to you? RAWK!
5000143.c22_f3: Wouldn't you rather have a deep conversation?
5000143.c22_f4: Sorry, I only perform tricks for people I respect.
5000143.c23_s1: It may be the same trick as last time, but it's always exciting!
5000143.c23_s2: Finally! I was getting sick of talking!
5000143.c23_s3: For you, I can do this all day!
5000143.c23_s4: I'll keep going 'til all my feathers fall off! Rawk!
5000143.c23_f2: Want to see it again? Really?
5000143.c23_f3: Forget it, all right? Just forget it!
5000143.c23_f4: I'm all out of feathers here.
5000143.f1_f: Do I look like a pig to you? Knock it off with the food!
5000143.f2_s: I was hungry enough to eat a shark! Thanks!
5000143.f2_f: Keep this up and I'll be too heavy to fly! Rawk!
5000143.f3_s: I could eat cherries for every meal. Rawk!
5000143.f3_f: I'm stuffed! I don't think I could even eat another cherry.
5000143.f4_s: All this chattering has given me an appetite!
5000143.f4_f: Rawk! You're not fattening me up, are you?
5000143.s1: I may talk a lot, but even I wouldn't say that!
5000143.s2: Let's keep it civil, shall we?
5000143.s3: I know I didn't hear that right. Did I?
5000143.s4: I see what kind of person you are.

5000144.c8_s3: I don't know what to say...
5000144.c12_s4: Ah, I'm so happy. What to do?
5000144.c18_s1: Yes, a nap would be good.
5000144.c18_s3: Yes, I was about to drop off...
5000144.c18_s4: I could use a good rest.
5000144.c21_s3: You must listen before you can talk.
5000144.c21_s4: You can't think and talk at the same time.
5000144.c23_s2: This is what I do for fun.
5000144.c23_s4: I can perform if I have to.
5000144.c23_f2: I have nothing to show you.

5000145.c4_f4: You no tell Bonkey what do!
5000145.c11_f3: No! Bonkey heart broken too many time in past.
5000145.c15_s1: Bonk! Here it come! Heh heh heh...
5000145.c15_s4: Bonkey feel great weight lift off belly!
5000145.c18_s1: Bonkey want to dream about flying! Zoom!
5000145.c18_s4: Bonkey sleep now. Don't wake Bonkey up!
5000145.c18_f4: Bonkey feel sniffly. Sniffly Bonkey no sleep!
5000145.c19_s4: Bonkey love bomb. BOOM! Ha ha ha!
5000145.c21_s1: Bonkey good at lift heavy things! Just don't ask Bonkey to lift vase, okay?
5000145.c21_s2: Bonkey love fruit! But vegetables are groooss.
5000145.c21_s3: Bonkey scared of airplanes! Bonkey want ride boat.
5000145.c21_s4: Bonkey beat up monsters! Bonkey follow captain forever!
5000145.c21_f1: Bonkey have no word. No word!
5000145.c22_s1: Watch Bonkey dance. Watch Bonkey dance!
5000145.c23_s3: Bonkey best dancer. Dance dance dance!
5000145.c23_s4: Shake Bonkey shake! Shake shake shake!

5000146.c2_s4: Pyoo, let's a rest a little!
5000146.c2_f1: I'm still up and kicking, ookyu!
5000146.c2_f4: Pyoo! I'm going to play more!
5000146.c3_f2: Pyoo? Don't we still have a long way to go?
5000146.c3_f3: Ookyu? I don't want to rest right now...
5000146.c4_s2: Pyoo! Am I sitting down, or laying down?
5000146.c4_s3: Ookyu, it's the perfect time to rest!
5000146.c4_s4: Pyoo! Just for a minute, okay?
5000146.c4_f1: Ookyu? I don't like being ordered around!
5000146.c4_f2: We can't rest like this everyday!
5000146.c4_f3: Ookyu, just a couple more steps!
5000146.c4_f4: Pyoo? Are you hurt? Why do you keep wanting to rest?
5000146.c6_f2: Don't talk to me like that!
5000146.c6_f3: Pyoo! Are you really going to keep doing this?!
5000146.c6_f4: I said, don't order me around!
5000146.c7_s1: Ookyu... I miss the north pole...
5000146.c7_f4: Pyoo! I'm going to leave you then!
5000146.c8_s2: Sorry... I won't do it again...
5000146.c8_f1: Hmph! I told you to treat me nicely!!
5000146.c8_f2: Pyoo!! I'm going back to the north pole!
5000146.c8_f3: I'm going to tell on you!
5000146.c8_f4: Pyoo! I can be scary too!
5000146.c10_s4: I like you very much also!
5000146.c11_s2: Pyoo! I like you better than the north pole.
5000146.c11_s4: Pyoo! I'm so lucky to have a master like you!
5000146.c12_s1: Pyoo! I love hanging out with you.
5000146.c12_s2: What a happy day it is today!
5000146.c12_s4: Pyoo! I'll be with you forever!
5000146.c12_f2: Ookyu, did you eat some bad fish?
5000146.c12_f3: I'm a Harp Seal, and you are a human!
5000146.c13_f3: Ookyu! You should be ashamed of yourself!
5000146.c14_f1: Tell me that AFTER you feed me!!
5000146.c14_f2: You can't order me to do everything!
5000146.c15_s1: Ookyu! Every day is a healthy day!!
5000146.c15_f4: This is shameful! You'll be hearing from my Harp Lawyers!
5000146.c16_f2: The sun is still shining bright!
5000146.c16_f3: Still a long way to go!
5000146.c16_f4: I don't think it's time to sleep yet.
5000146.c17_f1: You are a sleepyhead, aren't you, master?
5000146.c17_f2: I don't want to sleep yet.
5000146.c17_f3: I'll sleep when I get sleepy, okie?
5000146.c18_s3: Good seals are early to bed, early to rise.
5000146.c18_f2: I guess master isn't too healthy...
5000146.c18_f3: Why do you always tell me to sleep?
5000146.c18_f4: Is this going to make us closer?
5000146.c19_s1: Well you know, in the north pole... (It just rambles on)
5000146.c19_s2: I saw this weird animal in the forest... (It won't stop talking)
5000146.c19_s3: Do you know the difference between true seals and fake seals?
5000146.c19_s4: I love it here because there aren't any polar bears.
5000146.c20_s1: I wish I had some snow to lie on.
5000146.c20_s2: I'm all white so I can hide from polar bears in the snow!
5000146.c20_s3: Will you protect me from polar bears, master?
5000146.c20_s4: I'm sure glad for nice people like you, master.
5000146.c21_s1: Pigs sure are weird! Why do their bottoms curl up like that?
5000146.c21_s2: Ookyu ookyu! Isn't it hard walking on two legs, master?
5000146.c21_s3: Where are we going today? Anywhere's fine with me!
5000146.c21_s4: What should we eat for dinner? I want some milk!
5000146.c21_f4: I don't feel like opening my mouth... too much work...
5000146.c22_s2: I love you, you love me!
5000146.c22_s3: Pyoo pyoo pyoo! (It seems to be singing.)
5000146.c22_s4: Ookyu ookyu, pyoo! Ookyu ookyu, pyoo!
5000146.c22_f2: Are you really asking me that?
5000146.c22_f4: You show me something first, master!
5000146.c23_s1: Itsy bitsy seals and penguins, dancing at north pole!
5000146.c23_s3: Three seals in a house, daddy seal, mommy seal, and baby seal!
5000146.c23_f2: You want your pet to show its talents?
5000146.f3_s: Pyoo! You sure take good care of me, master!
5000146.f4_f: Don't you think I've gotten a little fat?
5000146.s2: What goes around, comes around you know?
5000146.s3: I don't want to be a pottymouth!
5000146.s4: Words reflect your insides, you know?!!

5000147.c2_s3: WEK~~ this is the way to do it, right?
5000147.c2_s4: Sit? Okay! I stll feel great though ~~~ WEK~ WEK~
5000147.c2_f1: You show me how to do it first...WEK
5000147.c2_f3: I never learned how to sit... weK!
5000147.c3_s1: Keep letting me do this ~~ WEK~
5000147.c3_s3: Do I sit like this? WEK!
5000147.c3_f1: You must be kidding me... WEK
5000147.c3_f3: Don't let me do stupid things like this... WEK..
5000147.c3_f4: It's not like I'll be getting a prize for doing this... WEK
5000147.c4_s1: I mastered the art of sitting.
5000147.c4_s2: I can sit! I really can sit!!
5000147.c4_s4: Give me something harder to do.
5000147.c4_f1: Wait til I turn back into a doll... then I'll sit.
5000147.c4_f2: Look, I'm fat, and it's hard for me to sit.
5000147.c6_f2: And what are you trying to say? WEK!
5000147.c6_f3: Umm... you're no different than me. WEK!
5000147.c6_f4: Don't tell me what to do! WEK!
5000147.c7_s2: I won't do that again... WEK... WEK....
5000147.c7_s3: Okay now ... calm down ... WEK WEK..
5000147.c7_s4: I get it. I'll be a good penguin now.
5000147.c7_f1: What do you want me to do? WEK!
5000147.c7_f2: Did I do anything wrong? WEK?
5000147.c8_s3: My heart's been torn to pieces... sigh...
5000147.c8_s4: What can I do to make you feel better?
5000147.c8_f1: Hey, you're the one that started!
5000147.c8_f2: Seriously, I didn't do anything wrong.
5000147.c10_s3: Don't look! This is embarassing. WEK
5000147.c10_f2: Long way to go before I poop. WEK
5000147.c10_f3: I don't feel like pooping. WEK.
5000147.c11_s2: Hah, I ate a lil too much last night. WEK
5000147.c11_s3: Sorry. It's going to reak here. WEK.
5000147.c11_f1: I don't want anyone seeing this. WEK
5000147.c11_f2: I haven't felt it, yet. WEK.
5000147.c12_s1: Hey, don't look. It's not a pretty sight.
5000147.c12_s4: Ahhh, this is quite a relief.
5000147.c12_f1: You must really like the smell of poop.
5000147.c12_f2: I can't poop now. I held on to it for too long.
5000147.c12_f3: I can't poop what I never ate.
5000147.c12_f4: Can you force yourself to poop?
5000147.c14_s3: Of course, the penguins must stand tall... WEK.
5000147.c14_f1: So I stand and sit, then stant and sit. WEK!
5000147.c14_f4: I don't want to do it, WEK!
5000147.c15_s2: This is a piece of cake, WEK.
5000147.c15_s4: I'm good, right? Give me something harder to do, WEK.
5000147.c15_f1: Can I do something else? I'm tired, WEK.
5000147.c15_f4: Don't tell me what to do, okay? WEK!
5000147.c16_s1: I can do it. I'm the bomb, right?
5000147.c16_s2: What other penguin can stand so beautifully like this?
5000147.c16_s3: If I keep practicing, I may be able to run one of these days.
5000147.c16_f3: Don't repeat the same thing over and over again.
5000147.c17_s1: The weather's beautiful today, perfect for a chit chat, WEK.
5000147.c17_s2: If you find somethng delicious, give me some, WEK.
5000147.c17_s3: Do you want to kiss me on the cheek? WEK!
5000147.c17_s4: I can help you out, WEK!
5000147.c17_f1: What? Who said I was fat? WEK!!
5000147.c17_f2: Have you ever seen a talking penguin? WEK.
5000147.c18_s1: Any good movie to watch, WEK?
5000147.c18_s2: Tell me you love me the most, WEK.
5000147.c18_s3: Treat others just the way you want to be treated, WEK.
5000147.c18_s4: Take me to a seafood store, WEK.
5000147.c18_f2: Don't feel like talking right now, WEK.
5000147.c19_s1: If I ever turn back into a doll, please get me a water of life so I can keep hanging out with you.
5000147.c19_s2: I'll help you gather up some items on the ground.
5000147.c19_s3: I see a lot of elves these days. I heard they were very hard-working.
5000147.c19_s4: Don't tell others your ID and password.
5000147.c19_f1: And what exactly do you want from me?
5000147.c19_f4: Don't bother me. I'm just chillin here.
5000147.c20_s2: Now you gotta kiss me! WEK
5000147.c20_s4: Hehe, give me a warm hug. WEK
5000147.c20_f3: I'm too heavy for you to hug, WEK.
5000147.c21_s1: I've been in need of some love these days... WEK.
5000147.c21_s4: You can hug me as long as you want, WEK!
5000147.c21_f2: NO! You haven't showered in days! WEK!
5000147.c21_f4: I got no time for you, WEK!
5000147.c22_s2: Don't hug me too hard. I can't breathe.
5000147.c22_s4: Awwww, it's embarassing though. Hug me when no one's looking.
5000147.c23_f2: No, I wanna do something fun! WEK!
5000147.c23_f3: Look, it's well into the morning right now, WEK.
5000147.c23_f4: I don't feel like sleeping here, WEK.
5000147.c24_s1: Master, you sleep here with me. WEK.
5000147.c24_s3: I was about to sleep anyway.
5000147.c24_s4: You need to wake me up later.
5000147.c24_f1: Don't tell me what to do.
5000147.c24_f2: It's not time to sleep yet.
5000147.c24_f3: I feel fine, I don't feel like sleeping.
5000147.c26_s4: This makes me feel good, WEK!
5000147.c26_f1: This makes me feel good, WEK!
5000147.c26_f3: Liar. I don't like you, WEK.
5000147.c26_f4: Really? I don't think you do, though. WEK.
5000147.c27_s1: Do you really mean that, WEK?
5000147.c27_s2: You know how I feel about this, right? WEK~
5000147.c27_s3: I love you too, master! WEK!
5000147.c27_s4: Yay, I'm being loved by my master~ WEK!
5000147.c27_f1: And what do you want from me? WEK.
5000147.c27_f2: What? I didn't hear you. WEK.
5000147.c27_f4: I know you say that to others, too. WEK.
5000147.c28_s4: I love you too, master! Yay!!
5000147.c28_f2: We penguins don't take that phrase "I love you" lightly.
5000147.c28_f3: If you don't mean that, that I don't think you should say it.
5000147.c29_s3: So I should just stick it out like this? WEK..
5000147.c30_s2: You know I'm the bomb, WEK.
5000147.c30_f1: No way, I'm too tired. WEK.
5000147.c30_f2: I'm too lazy to do this. WEK.
5000147.c31_s2: Heavy, isn't it? I can't fly with these, though.
5000147.c31_s3: Is it fluffy? It feels good, right? This is fuuuun!
5000147.c31_f1: Ugh, this is quite a chore.
5000147.c31_f3: What am I, a dog? I'm a penguin, you know!
5000147.c32_s3: Make sure not to leave a hole on my cheek!
5000147.c32_f1: Um... do you know exactly where we are right now?
5000147.c32_f3: No way, I don't wanna do it.
5000147.c33_s3: Don't do it for too long, though. Yay!
5000147.c33_f1: Who in the right mind would wanna kiss you?
5000147.c33_f3: You ain't doing this for free.
5000147.c33_f4: Tell me that was a joke.
5000147.c34_s3: I deserve a trophy for this performance!
5000147.c34_s4: I believe I can fly!!! WEK WEK!
5000147.c34_f1: Um...don't I look a litttttle hefty for that?
5000147.c34_f2: Hey, have you ever seen a flying penguin?
5000147.c34_f3: You must have lost your mind.
5000147.c35_s2: Show me another penguin that can fly like me.
5000147.c35_s4: No need to waste time. Here we go!
5000147.c35_f3: I suggest you study a little on penguin's anatomy.
5000147.c35_f4: Um, have you heard of Law of Gravity? Hello!!
5000147.c36_s1: I'm at a loss for words...WEK!
5000147.c36_s2: It's hard to find a penguin as cute-looking as me! WEK!
5000147.c36_s3: Hey, I've been cute for quite some time, you know! WEK!
5000147.c36_s4: Really? You're not kidding, right? WEK!
5000147.c36_f2: I'm not CUTE. I'm DASHING. WEK!!!
5000147.c36_f3: I NEED SOME TRUTH AROUND HERE! WEK!
5000147.c36_f4: What do you want me to say in return, WEK?
5000147.c37_s2: You won't find a penguin quite like me. Enjoy it!
5000147.c37_s3: I can never get enough of your compliments!
5000147.c37_s4: Thanks for your kind words! I really appreciate that!
5000147.c37_f1: Since when did we compliment each other anyway...
5000147.c37_f4: Feed me instead of waxing stupid poetics like that.
5000147.f2_f: I can't eat no more. WEK.
5000147.f3_f: Ugh, I feel like throwing up. WEK.
5000147.f4_f: I need to be on a diet.

5000148.c2_s3: Quack! Is this the right place?
5000148.c2_f1: Quack! Who do you think you are?
5000148.c2_f2: Are you TRYING to make me fat and lazy?
5000148.c2_f4: No way, White Ducks get dirty too easily!
5000148.c3_s4: Quack quack! You got it Boss!
5000148.c3_f1: Who do you think you are?
5000148.c3_f2: Now is not a good time...
5000148.c3_f3: It's too dirty to sit around here...
5000148.c3_f4: Just because you're lazy doesn't mean I am.
5000148.c4_f1: Don't take your anger out on me!
5000148.c5_f1: Quack, that's a bad look for you.
5000148.c5_f4: I was just sitting there, quack quack!
5000148.c6_s1: Wow boss, I really didn't mean it!
5000148.c6_s2: Quack, I'm really scared right now!
5000148.c7_s4: I wanted to stretch my legs anyway!
5000148.c7_f1: Quack quack, I don't think so.
5000148.c7_f4: QUACK! I don't feel like it.
5000148.c8_s1: You're lucky to have such a smart duck.
5000148.c8_s4: Hey, I'm much taller now! Quack Quack.
5000148.c9_s1: I must be REALLY good, right?
5000148.c9_s2: You won't find a Rudolph that can stand like I do
5000148.c9_s3: Now that I'm up like this, I can see things from afar
5000148.c9_s4: Standing up is sooo easy now.
5000148.c9_f3: Why do you keep asking me to do the same thing?
5000148.c9_f4: I can't hear you. I can't hear you
5000148.c10_f1: No, I don't feel like it.
5000148.c10_f3: Quack! It's rude to poop in public!
5000148.c10_f4: I poop when I want to.
5000148.c11_s3: That's the last time I eat at the pet park!
5000148.c11_f3: I'd poop if you fed me.
5000148.c11_f4: Quack Quack I don't tell you when to poop!
5000148.c12_s1: Ahhhhhh, please don't look. It's embarassing
5000148.c12_s2: Ahh...the poop looks really good today
5000148.c12_s3: Careful, you might step in it!
5000148.c12_s4: That's a big smell for a small duck!
5000148.c12_f3: I have a lot on my mind right now, sorry.
5000148.c12_f4: My poop is none of your business!!
5000148.c13_s3: I like getting closer to you.
5000148.c13_s4: I love hearing I LOVE YOU!!
5000148.c13_f1: No. I spit when I talk.
5000148.c13_f4: I don't want to talk to you!
5000148.c14_s2: It's fun being a travelling duck!
5000148.c14_s4: I'd like to hear a joke!
5000148.c14_f1: Just being near you makes me bored.
5000148.c14_f2: I can't talk to someone uglier than I am.
5000148.c14_f3: I think I have a sore throat!
5000148.c14_f4: Quack! I'm a duck, not a professional film and television actor!
5000148.c15_s1: Have you thought about getting a haircut?
5000148.c15_s2: Somebody needs to go on a diet!
5000148.c15_s3: An apple a day keeps the doctor away!
5000148.c15_f1: Don't you have anyone to talk to?
5000148.c16_s4: Nothing like a duck hug! Quack quack!
5000148.c17_s1: Big hugs for my favorite boss!
5000148.c17_s3: I feel so close to you! Quack!
5000148.c17_f1: Do I look like I want to hug you? QUACK!
5000148.c17_f2: Go jump in a lake! Seriously...you smell.
5000148.c17_f3: Boss, don't you have any perfume?
5000148.c18_s2: Quack Quack! Duck hugs are the best!
5000148.c18_s3: I'd take a duck hug over a bear hug any day!
5000148.c18_f2: I don't hug people I don't like.
5000148.c19_s2: Quack! You're not so bad yourself!
5000148.c19_f1: Do we need to have a talk?
5000148.c20_s3: Quack quack, I love you too!
5000148.c20_f1: I only love those who shower.
5000148.c20_f2: I like long walks, especially when they are taken by people who annoy me.
5000148.c21_f2: You need to decide if you love me or hate me.
5000148.c22_s3: How can you resist this face? Quack!
5000148.c22_s4: I got it from my mom!
5000148.c22_f1: I'm having a horrible hair day.
5000148.c23_s2: Say it again! You know you love me!
5000148.c23_s3: I do it for you boss!
5000148.c23_s4: Quack! I'm so cute it should be illegal!
5000148.c23_f1: Quack! You can't make me be cute.
5000148.c23_f2: It's a blessing and a curse.
5000148.c23_f3: I just want to be left alone.
5000148.c23_f4: Quack quack, why don't you be cute?
5000148.c24_s2: It's one of my best qualities!

5000194.c12_f4: I can't hear you...I can't hear you.

5000203.c2_s2: Why should I listen to you?

5000203.c4_f4: No. No, that's quite all right. Rawk!

5000203.c8_f4: Think this over. Don't you value our friendship? RAWK!

5000203.c10_s2: You like me? You really like me?
5000203.c10_s3: Is your love true? Oh, who cares!
5000203.c10_s4: I'd blush, but parrots can't blush...
5000203.c10_f1: Sorry, but my heart belongs to a little parakeet in Henesys.
5000203.c10_f3: But what will the other parrots think?

5000203.c11_s4: Caaan you feeel the love tooooday...

5000203.c12_f2: Do you feel a special kinship for me? Or is it something more?

5000203.c13_f3: What a disgusting thing to say!

5000203.c15_f4: I seem to be having trouble. Do you have some yogurt I could eat? Rawk!
5000203.c16_s2: This is nice sleeping weather. Rawk!
5000203.c16_s3: I may not have eyelids, but I can sleep with the best of them!
5000203.c16_s4: Remember, even when I sleep, I'm watching you! Zzz...

5000203.c16_f4: You won't put ME to sleep!

5000203.c17_f1: No. I get headaches if I sleep too much.
5000203.c17_f2: I'll not sleep my life away! RAWK!

5000203.c17_f4: Sometimes I get so busy counting sheep I forget to actually sleep.

5000203.c18_s2: I'll dream of pigs and slimes tonight. I just know it.

5000203.c18_s4: I can't sleep on the floor! Bring me some nice, comfortable branches to perch on.

5000203.c18_f2: You're going to hit me after I fall asleep, right? I'm on to you!
5000203.c18_f4: You're just trying to get me to shut up, aren't you? Rawk!

5000203.c19_s4: Bonkey is dumb as a brick. I wouldn't want to be on his bad side, though!

5000203.c20_s3: They say it's not good to talk too much, but I've never found this to be the case! Rawk!

5000203.c23_s2: Finally! I was getting sick of talking!
5000203.c23_s3: For you, I can do this all day!
5000203.c23_s4: I'll keep going 'til all my feathers fall off! Rawk!
5000203.c23_f2: Want to see it again? Really?
5000203.c23_f3: Forget it, all right? Just forget it!
5000203.c23_f4: I'm all out of feathers here.

5000203.f2_s: I was hungry enough to eat a shark! Thanks!

5000203.f4_f: Rawk! You're not fattening me up, are you?

5000209.c3_f3: Wouldn't you rather I eat someone?

5000209.c7_s2: I am above your mortal emotions.
5000209.c7_s3: Was I so wrong? It was only a squirrel!
5000209.c7_s4: I will not be sad! I will not be sad!
5000209.c7_f1: One of these days, I'm going to drop this marble on your head.
5000209.c7_f3: Is this how you mortals treat one another?!
5000209.c7_f4: I will watch you fry one day.
5000209.c8_s2: I haven't felt this bad since I ate that priest.
5000209.c8_s3: I find you strangely terrifying, mortal.
5000209.c8_s4: I have shamed a thousand generations of my ancestors.
5000209.c8_f1: But I have done everything you asked!
5000209.c8_f2: You are the most fickle mortal I've ever met.
5000209.c8_f3: You are adorable when you are angry.
5000209.c8_f4: Find something else to yell at!
5000209.c9_s2: I hope you do not come to harm.
5000209.c10_f1: Aren't you supposed to be trembling in fear?
5000209.c10_f3: I will not be talked down to!
5000209.c10_f4: You are making my scales itch.
5000209.c11_s1: Why do my cheeks feel warm? WHAT HAVE YOU DONE TO ME?!
5000209.c11_s2: My heart thumps when you say these measly words!
5000209.c11_s4: I believe you mortals would say, "ditto".
5000209.c11_f1: My dragon heart is not to be trifled with.
5000209.c11_f2: Do not say anything you will regret.
5000209.c11_f3: I, uh, have to wash my scales tonight.
5000209.c11_f4: Hey, how about those Green Mushrooms? Very green, aren't they?
5000209.c12_s1: Would you like me to take you flying?
5000209.c12_s2: I will move the heavens for you!
5000209.c12_s3: Might a humble dragon receive a kiss?
5000209.c12_f1: Are mortal affections given so freely?
5000209.c12_f2: I am sure you say this to all your pets.
5000209.c12_f4: Who needs love when you have power?!
5000209.c13_s2: My eyes may be closed, but I have the reflexes of a water dragon!
5000209.c13_s3: I was already going to do that.
5000209.c13_f1: Perhaps you'll think of a better wish later.
5000209.c13_f2: Grawr! It is not my nap time!
5000209.c13_f4: I have little need for such things.
5000209.c14_s1: I suppose I could use a recharge.
5000209.c14_f1: We mighty dragons have no need for sleep!
5000209.c14_f3: This place is not fit for my great slumber!
5000209.c14_f4: I am no cat, content to lie in the sun!
5000209.c15_s1: May I rest upon your lap? This cloud is quite cold.
5000209.c15_s2: Oh, the dreams I will have!
5000209.c15_s4: Your wish is granted, mortal! Zzzzzz
5000209.c15_f1: What if I were to eat you in my sleep?
5000209.c15_f2: This area is too loud! My dragon ears are sensitive.
5000209.c15_f3: Can't we go battle some monsters?
5000209.c15_f4: I JUST drank some dragon coffee!
5000209.c16_s1: Allow me to fill in your pitiful knowledge of dragons...
5000209.c16_s2: I was once a mere thunder lizard, until I caught this orb.
5000209.c16_s3: Do know you how luck you are? Let me tell you.
5000209.c16_s4: If that is what you wish...
5000209.c16_f4: I did not descend from the heavens to banter!
5000209.c17_s1: Your world is teeming with life.
5000209.c17_s3: My mane is made of the finest spun gold.
5000209.c17_s4: I am omnipotent and all powerful, but I do get a little lonely.
5000209.c17_f2: Hold on, let me see if I have anything...NO.
5000209.c17_f3: Why do you waste my power?
5000209.c18_s1: Your enormous head must be quite a burden.
5000209.c18_s2: Does this orb make my tail look fat?
5000209.c18_s3: All behold the glory of my master and its silly face!
5000209.c18_s4: My wisdom sounds much better in the original Dragon.
5000209.c18_f2: What do you want to talk about?
5000209.c19_f3: Do the powers of the gods so amuse you?
5000209.c19_f4: This show of force is quite exhausting.
5000209.c20_s1: Grawr! Look at all these lightning bolts!
5000209.c20_s2: My thunder will break the heavens!
5000209.c20_s4: This is no mere trick! This is an event!
5000209.c20_f1: I tire of these petty displays.
5000209.c20_f3: Have you nothing better to wish for?!
5000209.c21_s3: I will sink through my cloud if I eat another bite!
5000209.c21_s4: I try to say no, but my belly continues to rumble.
5000209.c21_f1: No more, I have much...um...business to attend to.
5000209.c21_f2: Truly you are a great chef, master!
5000209.c21_f3: Do not look upon me. I am such a fat dragon...
5000209.c21_f4: You will not be my master forever...
5000209.c22: I do not comprehend your ridiculous ways.
5000209.c22_s1: I WILL eat you. You are but a worm in my eyes.
5000209.c22_s2: Do not curse the commander of lightning!
5000209.c22_s4: My real form is scary, Mr'kuma!
5000209.c22_f2: You do trick. I want laugh when you fall.
5000209.c22_f4: I show you already! You have bad brain!
5000209.c23_s1: What if I did this at your next surprise party?
5000209.c23_s2: Let's go scare some little girls with this trick!
5000209.c23_s3: With this power, I could conquer all of you puny humans.
5000209.c23_s4: Bask in awe, master! I am a being of pure terror!
5000209.c23_f1: How about I torch all your underwear instead?
5000209.c23_f2: Are you sure? You can never unsee it.
5000209.c23_f3: Shouldn't we be undermining somebody's hope?
5000209.c23_f4: I'll eat your eyebrows if you tell me that again!
5000209.f4_f: What are you trying to do to me?!
5000209.s3: Old boss call me that. He so cool.
5000209.s4: Hey! Even we demons have some etiquette.

5000212.c3_s2: I sit on ground for now.
5000212.c3_s3: You no want I steal gold? I steal good, Mr'kuma.
5000212.c3_f2: Don't wanna! I wanna set your hair on fire!
5000212.c3_f3: Sit? Me not know word. Hehehe...
5000212.c4_s1: Okay, human. You tell me when we are going to eat monsters again.
5000212.c4_s2: I will sit for you, Mr'kuma. You are scary and powerful!
5000212.c4_s3: I do as you say, for now...
5000212.c4_s4: Later, you sit and I get to burn houses down!
5000212.c4_f1: No way! I am not your kr'grana!
5000212.c4_f2: I don't wanna! I am mighty and full of fangs!
5000212.c4_f3: Rak! Why you always want to sit?!
5000212.c4_f4: You take me to lake of fire first!
5000212.c7_s3: My old boss was scary too. He eat my brother! So fun!
5000212.c7_s4: You scare many monsters with your talk! Scare me a little too...
5000212.c7_f1: No talk to me like kr'gana. Me much strong!
5000212.c7_f2: Rak unar! I eat your wallet tonight!
5000212.c8_s1: I like it when you are angry, Mr'kuma. I will be angry too!
5000212.c8_s2: Yes! Let's find some little kids to yell at!
5000212.c8_s3: Everytime you yell, I feel a little more at home...
5000212.c8_s4: Ha! More! Tell me how worthless I am!
5000212.c8_f1: You always say the same insults. Think up something new!
5000212.c8_f2: I know you can do better than that, Mr'kuma.
5000212.c8_f3: I know you have more rage in you than that...
5000212.c8_f4: I don't want to be flattered right now!
5000212.c11_s1: Why you talk like wimp, Mr'kuma?
5000212.c11_s2: Grauk-mouthed unar! You think I simple?!
5000212.c11_s3: I no fall for trick. Old Mr'kuma trick me like this long ago.
5000212.c11_f2: Hand over wallet, Mr'kuma. You go crazy in your mind.
5000212.c11_f4: I come back when you not trying to eat me.
5000212.c12_s1: You are the cruelest of all masters...and I like it.
5000212.c12_s2: Are you mad at me because I tortured your goldfish? He was asking for it!
5000212.c12_s3: That is the rudest thing you can say in demon culture!
5000212.c12_s4: Now I see you are just trying to be mean to me. Thank you, Mr'kuma!
5000212.c12_f1: There is no such thing as love.
5000212.c12_f2: My heart is cold and black like a piece of coal!
5000212.c12_f3: I'm almost getting used to this constant abuse.
5000212.c12_f4: You're just trying to make me get mad again.

5000212.c14_f3: I not eat enough monster today!
5000212.c14_f4: You no treasure drakla. It MY drakla!
5000212.c15_s1: Master, you love pooping as much as I do!
5000212.c15_s2: I bet I can burn a hole in the ground with this one...
5000212.c15_s3: I love stinking up your fresh air, Mr'kuma.
5000212.c15_s4: Empty out everything, master. Even your soul!
5000212.c15_f2: I'll let go of this poop when I darn well feel like it.
5000212.c15_f3: My bottom still hurts from the last one.
5000212.c15_f4: I have got to stop eating so many spicy monsters.
5000212.c17_s2: Good unar. We find many nightmare!
5000212.c17_s3: I like sleep. Let me eat many monster heads when wake.
5000212.c17_s4: You sleep too, Mr'kuma. I steal many wallet for you later.
5000212.c17_f1: No! You try take my eyeballs while I sleep!
5000212.c17_f2: I no want to! I want eat shopkeeper toes!
5000212.c17_f4: Sleep yourself, Mr'putama. I go find demon friends.

5000212.c18_s2: Don't destroy any villages without me, okay, Mr'kuma?

5000264.c37_s1: Well I don't want to big-note myself, but...

5000265.c7_f3: What do you think you're doing yelling at me?

5000312.c1_s1: Sitting down makes me feel comfortable.
5000312.c1_s2: Why don't you sit with me here? Resting is a necessity. You'll see...
5000312.c1_s4: I shall rest my wings now, so I can fly farther tomorrow.
5000312.c1_f3: I do not wish to sit.
5000312.c2_s1: Alright, I shall sit. What will you do for me in return?
5000312.c2_s2: You're much quicker than I thought.I'm impressed.
5000312.c2_s3: It is comfortable sitting down. I shall rest for now.
5000312.c2_f1: I do not wish to sit. Do you want me to explain why?
5000312.c2_f2: The situation does not call for sitting.
5000312.c2_f3: I suggest you sit. Demanding never works.
5000312.c2_f4: No. I do not feel fatigued.
5000312.c3_s1: Come to think of it, I feel fatigued...
5000312.c3_s3: Yes, I shall save up some energy whenever I can.
5000312.c3_f1: I'm in the middle of an exercise. Demanding never yields good results.
5000312.c3_f2: Be honest. YOU are the one that desires to sit, right?
5000312.c3_f3: Why should I sit on this filth?
5000312.c3_f4: Why should I? Give me a valid reason why I shall sit.
5000312.c4_s3: I'm sorry. Please accept my apology.
5000312.c4_f1: I have been reprimanded by a human being! What a disgrace!
5000312.c4_f4: You're the one that commited the mistake! Krarr!
5000312.c5_s3: Oh, I made a mistake. My apologies.
5000312.c5_s4: I sincerely apologize for the mishap.
5000312.c5_f1: Krarr!!! What are you, a preacher?
5000312.c5_f2: Cut this nonsense and get out of my face.
5000312.c6_s1: I am really sorry. Please forgive me.
5000312.c6_s3: I made a mistake, and I am big enough to admit it. I am sorry.
5000312.c6_s4: Oh no, I feel terrible now. I am really, really sorry.
5000312.c6_f2: Your words mean nothing to me.
5000312.c6_f3: Are you sure you know who's at fault here?
5000312.c6_f4: I heard some noise coming out of your mouth, but I do not understand what you are saying... hmmm...
5000312.c7_s2: Tell me you did not mean it.
5000312.c7_s3: Wow, I need a tissue for this.
5000312.c7_f1: I do not appreciate you looking down on me like that.
5000312.c7_f3: Did your mother teach you to say such a thing?
5000312.c8_s1: I...do not know what to say.
5000312.c8_s3: I will try to be better next time.
5000312.c8_f1: You are in need of a tic-tac sandwich. Like, now.
5000312.c8_f3: Is the fool one who leads or one who follows?
5000312.c9_s1: It pains me to hear it from you.
5000312.c9_s3: I still believe you are a decent person.
5000312.c9_s4: Do you have a vendetta against me?
5000312.c9_f1: Why should I be subject to this gross misconception?
5000312.c9_f3: How would you feel if I called you that?
5000312.c9_f4: Look, please don't call me that. I'm already seen with you.
5000312.c10_s1: Cough cough... this is embarassing. I am pooping in public.
5000312.c10_s2: What a relief. I have had trouble unloading the past few days, but I am good now.
5000312.c10_s4: I am about to unload. Just wait.
5000312.c10_f1: How can you say that out loud?
5000312.c10_f2: That is not something you should iterate in public. Control yourself.
5000312.c10_f3: I am busy. I shall do it later.
5000312.c10_f4: I've been struggling lately. I do not believe you can truly comprehend what I am going through right now.
5000312.c11_s1: I should be done ... pretty soon.
5000312.c11_s2: Today must be my lucky day. I had no trouble unloading.
5000312.c11_s3: I needed to it. Thank you for covering me.
5000312.c11_s4: There's no feeling quite like this. What a relief!
5000312.c11_f1: I cannot poop without a copy of the New Leaf City Times in my hand.
5000312.c11_f2: I heard some noise coming out of your mouth, but I do not understand what you are saying... hmmm...
5000312.c11_f3: How disgusting of you to say that in public! Shame on you!
5000312.c11_f4: This is not the time to speak of that matter. I am disgusted with you.
5000312.c12_s1: What a relief. I do not think you'll truly grasp the feeling of euphoria I'm experiencing right now.
5000312.c12_s2: Oh it's about to come out. Now, if you'll excuse me...
5000312.c12_s4: Yes! I've been holding it all day!
5000312.c12_f1: I am very very busy right now. We shall do this later.
5000312.c12_f2: I need some medicine. I... cannot do it.
5000312.c12_f3: The wind is blowing too hard. I do not wish to poop right this minute.
5000312.c12_f4: I am not an uneducated dragon that defacates anywhere.
5000312.c13_s1: I love you, too. This is quite embarassing...
5000312.c13_s2: I've been waiting for you to say those words.
5000312.c13_s3: That's a nice gesture from you. Me too.
5000312.c13_s4: I feel fantastic with you around.
5000312.c13_f2: I feel fatigued. I shall rest in a bit.
5000312.c13_f4: Hmm... I do not have much to do right now.
5000312.c14_s1: When you are around, I feel a sense of comfort.
5000312.c14_s2: I know I know. Me too!
5000312.c14_s3: Do not worry. I love you too.
5000312.c14_s4: You are a great person. I love you too.
5000312.c14_f2: It is very windy today. I may have a difficult time flying today.
5000312.c14_f4: I am very busy right now. Talk to me later.
5000312.c15_s1: Do you really mean it? That's...very nice of you.
5000312.c15_s2: Do not say another word. I know, I know.
5000312.c15_s3: I love you, too. You're the first person I ever said this to.

5000382.c12_s3: I'm so happy you're here with me!
5000382.c13_f3: Master...can I do it later in the dark?
5000382.c14_f2: It's still a long way to go before coming out...heh
5000382.c14_f3: So many people around here, how am I gonna poop in public??
5000382.c14_f4: I just pooped a few min. ago...
5000382.c15_s2: Ahhhhh...whoa, I almost stepped on it...
5000382.c15_f2: It's not time to go poop yet...
5000382.c15_f4: Master...pooping should only be at bathrooms...
5000382.c16_s3: Maybe a little cat nap would be good...
5000382.c16_f1: Meow. It's not time for bed yet...
5000382.c16_f2: Meow! The sun's still high in the sky!
5000382.c16_f4: Aren't you sleepy, master? I'm sleepy.
5000382.c17_s1: Nothing beats sleeping on a soft pillow.
5000382.c17_s4: Don't let anyone wake me up.
5000382.c17_f1: Can't I just sleep when I want to?
5000382.c17_f2: Why are you putting me to bed? It's too early!
5000382.c18_s1: This was a such a long day.
5000382.c18_s2: I feel like sleeping for 3 days.
5000382.c18_f1: Oh, just let me sleep already!
5000382.c18_f2: I told you, I don't want to sleep!
5000382.c18_f3: Isn't it too early for bed?
5000382.c18_f4: Why do you always want to sleep, master?
5000382.c19_s1: You should switch out the menu sometime. I'm getting tired of eating the same thing...
5000382.c19_s2: Hey master, can you beat Barlog?
5000382.c19_s4: Master, I heard there's something scary in a cave in the middle of the island...
5000382.c19_f1: Ah...screw the talk, just get me some food...
5000382.c19_f3: Arrgh...didn't hear a thing...didn't hear a thing...
5000382.c19_f4: Man I'm tired, and I don't feel like talking...
5000382.c20_s2: I'm always here for  you, master...
5000382.c20_s4: I live to serve you only, master...
5000382.c20_f1: NO! Don't feel like talking! BARK BARK!!
5000382.c20_f2: I don't have anything to say...
5000382.c20_f3: How are you today? Good? Right? Good!! Woof woof!
5000382.c21_f2: I'll listen to whatever you say master.
5000382.f2_s: That was good. I am full now!
5000382.f4_s: Seriously...do I look like someone that's hungry?
5000382.s2: No, please don't say that! Woof!

5000384.c2_s2: I'm fully aware that I have short legs...
5000384.c2_s3: Ahh, nice. Maybe it's time for a nap.
5000384.c2_f2: This place is filthy... I can't be here...
5000384.c2_f3: I just don't want to do it anymore...
5000384.c3_s1: Not really... I'm not doing this for you!
5000384.c3_s3: With legs as short as mine, it doesn't matter!
5000384.c3_f1: No, you're going to make fun of me because I'm just as short standing as sitting!
5000384.c3_f3: I think I heard someone saying something...
5000384.c3_f4: Sitting makes my buttocks get bigger.
5000384.c4_s2: I guess I could do that... THIS time.
5000384.c4_s3: Ugh, my belly becomes really noticeable when I sit...
5000384.c4_f1: I'm never going to do it.
5000384.c6_s1: I guess I should stay quiet.
5000384.c6_f1: Huh? What are you even saying?
5000384.c7_s2: I'm going to crawl under a rock.
5000384.c7_f4: Don't take it out on me!
5000384.c8_s3: I'm full of tears! And they're coming out!
5000384.c8_f2: I'm going to find a new owner!
5000384.c10_s1: Now that you mention it, I love you too!
5000384.c10_f1: Are you saying you love me?
5000384.c11_s1: I guess I love you, too?
5000384.c11_s3: Well, um...I kinda I love you too!
5000384.c11_f3: That was a good one... ha ha...
5000384.c12_f2: Ha ha ha... What can I say?
5000384.c12_f3: I already know how you feel...
5000384.c14_s3: I-I'm just a little bit shy...
5000384.c14_f4: Not here! I'll die of shame!
5000384.c15_f1: I feel like everyone is looking at me.
5000384.c15_f2: I'll let you off for today...
5000384.c16_f2: Doot de doo, I can't hear you...
5000384.c16_f4: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...
5000384.c17_s1: I'm sorry to interrupt you, but I can't keep my eyes open...
5000384.c17_s3: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...
5000384.c17_f2: I don't even have a blanket...
5000384.c17_f3: The ground is so cold and hard...
5000384.c18_f1: I don't want to go to bed...
5000384.c19_s3: I want to tell you about so many things...
5000384.c19_f1: I want octopus balls... And fried noodles...
5000384.c19_f2: I feel too shy to talk.
5000384.c19_f4: I don't want to talk about it.
5000384.c20_s2: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000384.c20_s3: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5000384.c20_s4: My brain is just so full of...stuff!
5000384.c20_f1: I'm going to bed. I'm full, I said...
5000384.c20_f2: There's nothing for me to say... I don't want to talk.
5000384.c21_s1: I'm jealous of Yeti and Pepe's relationship...
5000384.c21_s2: Everything will be fine as long as you feed me well.
5000384.f2_s: It's so delicious that it brings me to tears...
5000384.s1: I'll remember this! You watch out!
5000384.s2: Even we Demons know not to cross the line.

5000424.c2_s1: I am a really good sheep!
5000424.c2_s4: Baa! I really love sitting down!
5000424.c2_f1: Baa..! I don't want to sit!
5000424.c2_f3: My legs are too short, so I cannot sit, baa!
5000424.c3_s4: Baa! Baa! I am going to rest a bit!
5000424.c3_f1: Baa... Ba... I don't want to sit!
5000424.c3_f3: I am going to run! Baa baa!
5000424.c4_s4: Baa.. I am so happy, master!
5000424.c4_f1: Baa? But, I like standing up for now
5000424.c4_f2: I can't hear you well, because my fur is covering my ears, baa...
5000424.c6_s2: I will never do that again.
5000424.c6_f4: Baa! I don't like being punished!
5000424.c7_s2: Baa! I am so sorry. Do not punish me.
5000424.c7_s4: Baa... I won't do that again.
5000424.c7_f3: Are you going to punish me? Baa!
5000424.c8_s3: I am... Going to... Tell... My mum! Baaaa!
5000424.c8_s4: Baaa! Are doing this to me because I am your pet?
5000424.c8_f2: If you do that again, I will run away!
5000424.c8_f3: I give you my word, baa!
5000424.c8_f4: I didn't do anything wrong! Baa?
5000424.c10_s2: I love you, too, master, baa
5000424.c10_f1: Baa, what did you say master?
5000424.c10_f4: Ah... I don't know what to say...
5000424.c11_s2: Baa ♡ I will always love you, master!
5000424.c11_s4: I am happy that you love me so much, baa!
5000424.c11_f1: I can't hear you well, because I have fur on my ears, baa...
5000424.c11_f2: Master, are you sick or something?
5000424.c12_s1: Baa!♡ I am really happy when I am with you!
5000424.c12_s2: I will always be with you!
5000424.c12_s3: I can do anything for you! Baa!
5000424.c12_s4: Baa♡ I am the best among pets, right?
5000424.c12_f1: Don't do that... I am scared...
5000424.c12_f2: Baa..? I don't hear you. Please speak louder.
5000424.c12_f3: I am hungry. Please give me a treat, baa
5000424.c12_f4: I love you! My master! I love you so much!
5000424.c13_f2: I am usually shameless, but I am embarrassed now!
5000424.c13_f4: Baa! Well, I have a stomachache.
5000424.c14_f2: I haven't eaten anything... you didn't know that, master?
5000424.c14_f3: A dignified sheep like me doesn't poo in public!
5000424.c14_f4: Master... If you were me, could you poo here?
5000424.c15_s4: Baa! I am... going to... make... it...!
5000424.c15_f2: I haven't eaten anything... Please give me some cotton candy... and I....
5000424.c15_f3: Baa! I am not going to poo here!
5000424.c16_f3: Please play more! Please play more!
5000424.c16_f4: I want to play more with you, master!
5000424.c17_s2: Baa... I want to eat cotton candy in my dreams...
5000424.c17_s4: Baa.. It was a very tiring day...
5000424.c17_f3: It's not the right time to sleep!
5000424.c17_f4: I want to play more with you, master!
5000424.c18_f1: Can't you see that I am still fine? I am not sleepy yet!
5000424.c18_f2: A pretty sheep like me cannot sleep here!
5000424.c18_f3: But, I woke up several minutes ago...
5000424.c18_f4: Are you sleepy, master? I am not sleepy...
5000424.c19_s1: Have you ever seen a sheep as beautiful sheep as me before?
5000424.c19_s2: My dream is to eat cotton candy every day, baa.
5000424.c19_s3: Baa... What should I say then..?
5000424.c19_s4: When I was living in heaven, angels thought we were clouds
5000424.c19_f1: I don't have much to say... Baa?
5000424.c19_f3: Let's go hunting, shall we? Baa...
5000424.c19_f4: Baa? I was talking to you...
5000424.c20_s1: Did you try any cotton candy? It's really delicious!
5000424.c20_s2: Sometimes... I wish I had longer legs...
5000424.c20_s3: I just look like cotton candy, but please don't eat me!
5000424.c20_s4: What I want is... to live with you forever!
5000424.c20_f1: Baa... I am too hungry to talk.
5000424.c20_f2: I don't want to talk at the moment...
5000424.c21_s1: Look at my pink cheeks. Aren't they pretty?
5000424.c21_s2: Ba... As matter of fact, someone made a confession to me yesterday.
5000424.c21_s3: Well... This is a secret, but I love you the most! Baa...♡
5000424.c21_s4: I will always love you... Forever ♡
5000424.c21_f2: If you give me some cotton candy, I will think about it!
5000424.c21_f3: Baa... (It seems he/she is thinking about something)
5000424.c21_f4: I need some time alone for now... Baa...
5000424.c22_s1: Here you go! Accept my hearts!
5000424.c22_s3: Now you can see how cute I am!
5000424.c22_s4: Baa! This is only for you, master!
5000424.c22_f2: I am not such an easygoing sheep
5000424.c22_f4: I am so hungry that I cannot do anything now... Baa...
5000424.c23_s1: Now I am happy, and I want to show you something!
5000424.c23_s2: Here I go! Take my hearts!
5000424.c23_s4: Everyone likes it when I do this!
5000424.c23_f2: Baa! What do you want from me?
5000424.c23_f3: I am too hungry to do anything... Baa... Baa...
5000424.f3_s: Baa, I am always happy when I can eat!
5000424.f4_f: Can you give me another menu? Baa!
5000424.s2: Do you want to be accused, master? Baa!
5000424.s3: Baa! Baa! We are good, master!

5000442.c1_s2: I will sit if you insist!
5000442.c1_f2: The great Gelimer does not sit!
5000442.c2_s1: I am an old man you know...
5000442.c2_s3: It feels nice to be outside of the lab sometimes.
5000442.c2_f2: I am way stronger than I look.
5000442.c2_f3: I'm not planning to sit down at all!
5000442.c2_f4: Why must I listen to you?
5000442.c3_s2: It was not easy... You should get some rest too!
5000442.c3_s3: Is it gonna rain? My joints are stiff and sore.
5000442.c3_s4: Can you hand me the cushion?
5000442.c3_f1: I am full of energy! What does it mean to be tired?
5000442.c3_f2: I will turn you into an Android if you don't stop giving me orders.
5000442.c3_f3: How can you sit on the ground? Not classy!
5000442.c4_s1: It's been so long since the last time I got some fresh air!
5000442.c4_s2: Fresh wind is blowing through my hair. My thinning hair...
5000442.c4_s3: You are a very nice young man!
5000442.c4_f1: I am not the type to work under someone.
5000442.c4_f2: I will think about it if you give me some theoretical evidence.
5000442.c4_f3: Just keep hunting! I still need more data!
5000442.c5_s2: I want to be whiny sometimes HAHA.
5000442.c5_f1: How dare you talk like that to elders!
5000442.c6_s1: This world is coming to an end.
5000442.c6_s3: It's strange... It definitely worked before...
5000442.c6_s4: You haven't heard of the saying 'failure is the mother of success?'
5000442.c6_f1: Let me see... Something's wrong with you for sure.
5000442.c6_f3: I am the best scientist in Maple World!
5000442.c7_s3: Haven't heard that for a while.
5000442.c7_f1: Do you wanna be my research subject?
5000442.c7_f2: I want to study what's inside of your head.
5000442.c7_f3: That's something I would say to my teddy bear.
5000442.c8_s1: I will let this one go. You are lucky that I have a big heart.
5000442.c8_s4: Sorry. I was just so curious.
5000442.c8_f1: Was that not enough of brainwashing?
5000442.c8_f2: You are not even worth studying.
5000442.c8_f4: Are you sure you don't have a headache or something?
5000442.c9_s2: It wasn't to make you happy!
5000442.c10_s2: I'm good at hearts. You will understand...
5000442.c10_s3: This is not the first time I've heard that.
5000442.c10_f1: I will take a look at the experiment data.
5000442.c10_f2: Can you prove this to me mathematically?
5000442.c10_f3: My heart does not react to that...
5000442.c10_f4: Where did my teddy bear go?
5000442.c11_s1: Would you like to be a subject for my experiment?
5000442.c11_s3: HAHA. I haven't heard that in a while.
5000442.c11_s4: You fell for me for sure!
5000442.c11_f2: I don't even know what you look like.
5000442.c11_f4: I don't trust something invisible. I am not that stupid.
5000442.c12_s2: Do you wanna grab a cup of tea sometime?
5000442.c12_s3: I am so skilled at flattering my boss.
5000442.c12_f2: Love is the easiest trick you can use to deceive another.
5000442.c12_f4: I am older than your grandpa.
5000442.c13_s1: This? It's my personal taste. Show some respect!
5000442.c13_s3: Excuse me. I am in a hurry.
5000442.c13_f2: My guts are not done digesting!
5000442.c13_f3: I am a very patient man.
5000442.c14_s1: You will be the one cleaning up, right?
5000442.c14_s2: Was the potion that I took yesterday expired?
5000442.c14_s3: This is so great, just like my intelligence!
5000442.c14_s4: Stop bothering me. I am concentrating!
5000442.c14_f2: I feel like someone is peeking.
5000442.c14_f4: Don't tell me what to do!
5000442.c15_s1: I am such a healthy scientist!
5000442.c15_s3: Ahem! Did you just hear that?
5000442.c15_s4: I was fine when I was a youngster.
5000442.c15_f1: I am very sophisticated, unlike you!
5000442.c15_f2: How can you say that while eating?
5000442.c15_f4: My brain burns all my calories.
5000442.c16_s3: Nothing is more important than a good night's sleep!
5000442.c16_s4: You should get some rest now. You have so much to study later.
5000442.c16_f1: 4 hours of sleep is enough for one day!
5000442.c16_f2: I can sleep with only one eye closed.
5000442.c16_f3: Why don't YOU get some sleep?
5000442.c17_s1: I shall see my teddy bear in my dreams tonight!
5000442.c17_s2: It's little uncomfortable here... Ah well.
5000442.c17_s3: Don't touch anything while I'm asleep!
5000442.c17_f2: I heard stupid humans are sleepyheads.
5000442.c17_f3: We've got enough sleep. This is statistically proven.
5000442.c17_f4: How dare you give me orders!
5000442.c18_s2: Even the genius needs some time off for his brain.
5000442.c18_s3: Don't pester me while I'm sleeping.
5000442.c18_s4: It's better to take some rest like this.
5000442.c18_f1: I have no time to rest!
5000442.c18_f2: I still need to conduct some experiments!
5000442.c19_s1: I am Gelimer, the one who created Black Heaven! HAHA.
5000442.c19_s3: You must sacrifice little things in life to succeed.
5000442.c19_s4: I'm the one who came up with the Evolution System, too!
5000442.c19_f1: Not everyone can hear my voice.
5000442.c19_f2: Can you handle 10-hour lectures on Gelimer's Theory?
5000442.c19_f3: I don't really enjoy talking to humans.
5000442.c20_s1: I am so close to perfecting my greatest creation!
5000442.c20_s2: Takes me 20 minutes each day to do my hair!
5000442.c20_s3: You don't think I am competent as a commander? NONSENSE!
5000442.c20_s4: Everyone I met fell for me because of my beautiful eyes.
5000442.c20_f2: Do you not have anyone else to talk to?
5000442.c20_f3: You are such a lonely subject. Should I make a human clone just for you?
5000442.c20_f4: Keep it down. I can't concentrate!
5000442.c21_s1: What would be the first thing you would do if the world ends now?
5000442.c21_s2: You will be surprised when you learn the secret of my teddy bear.
5000442.c21_s3: I want to press all the red buttons in the world! Are you like that too?
5000442.c21_s4: Arkarium? I'm way smarter than that fool.
5000442.c21_f1: I don't want to deal with you.
5000442.c21_f2: Why not hunt when you are bored?
5000442.c21_f3: Why don't you become friends with a doll if you are lonely?
5000442.f1_s: This is the taste of proper molecule arrangement!
5000442.f1_f: Is this the flavor of motor oil?
5000442.f2_f: Cut it now! I'm not a glutton!
5000442.f3_s: i didn't know I could be this happy by just eating!
5000442.f4_s: I needed some sugar in my system!
5000442.s1: Where did I put my taser?
5000442.s2: I heard humans starts cussing when they have nothing else to say.
5000442.s3: You have not taken any speech classes, have you?
5000442.s4: STOP! Or else I will have you stuffed like a stuffed animal!

5000449.c2_s1: I hope no one notices I'm here... Eep!
5000449.c2_s2: Ahh, nice. Maybe it's time for a nap.
5000449.c2_s3: I want to sit... But I need exercise!
5000449.c2_f2: La la la... I don't hear you...
5000449.c2_f3: This place is filthy... I can't be here...
5000449.c3_s1: With legs as short as mine, it doesn't matter!
5000449.c3_s3: Hehe, do you like to watch me sit?
5000449.c3_s4: Whew. I guess I am a little tired.
5000449.c4_s1: Ugh, my belly becomes really noticeable when I sit...
5000449.c4_s4: I guess I could do that... THIS time.
5000449.c4_f3: We don't have time for this!
5000449.c6_f1: Huh? What are you even saying?
5000449.c7_s1: I think I'm going to cry!
5000449.c7_s2: I'm going to crawl under a rock.
5000449.c7_f1: I didn't do anything wrong. YOU'RE bad!
5000449.c7_f2: Don't take it out on me!
5000449.c8_s1: What is it? I feel lost... I'm scared...
5000449.c8_s3: I'm full of tears! And they're coming out!
5000449.c8_f2: I'm gonna hang out at the Free Market.
5000449.c8_f3: Sometimes I wonder...is all this really worth it?
5000449.c10_s1: Now that you mention it, I love you too!
5000449.c11_s1: Well, um...I kinda I love you too!
5000449.c11_s4: Tee hee... You're making me blush!
5000449.c14_f3: I need time to prepare myself.
5000449.c15_s2: *Grunt* It feels like my face is burning.
5000449.c16_f2: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...
5000449.c16_f4: Doot de doo, I can't hear you...
5000449.c17_s1: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...
5000449.c17_f3: I don't even have a blanket...
5000449.c17_f4: The ground is so cold and hard...
5000449.c19_s1: I just love to play the harp!
5000449.c19_s2: Play, play, play! I love to play!
5000449.c19_s3: My biggest fear is that you're going to eat my one day.
5000449.c19_f2: What do you want me to say?
5000449.c19_f4: I'd like to be alone now.
5000449.c20_s1: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5000449.c20_s2: My brain is just so full of...stuff!
5000449.c20_s4: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000449.c20_f3: But I don't have anything to say...
5000449.c21_s1: I love spending time in the warm oven.
5000449.c21_s2: My favorite spice? Ground ginger, of course!
5000449.c21_s3: You make me the happiest cookie alive.
5000449.c21_s4: Did you do your good deed for the day?
5000449.c21_f4: La la la... I don't hear you...
5000449.f4_s: It's so delicious that it brings me to tears...
5000449.s1: Do you want to become a demon?
5000449.s2: You must not say something as foul as that.
5000449.s4: Why would you say something like that?

5000451.c1_f2: What do you want from me?
5000451.c1_f4: Sigh...I don't feel like sitting down.
5000451.c2_s1: I do like sitting down from time to time! Roar!!
5000451.c2_f2: Do I have to sit when you tell me to sit?
5000451.c3_s1: I love how my master can't stand the pet being overworked. You're the best!
5000451.c3_s2: I was just getting really tired. Let's have a seat and share a glass of gasoline.
5000451.c3_s3: Ohhh! How did you know I love sitting down? That was awesome!
5000451.c3_s4: A true pet knows how to sit properly. That's my forte, you know.
5000451.c3_f1: Hey, you know I'm the rarest pet around...EVER. Don't disrespect me like that!
5000451.c3_f2: Haha... why don't you sit down first. You have no manners.
5000451.c3_f3: I don't have that command in my system.
5000451.c3_f4: Sit? Well, if you bring something to sit on, then I'll think about it.
5000451.c4_s2: I'm sorry for being so dumb...
5000451.c5_s1: Why do you hate me, master?
5000451.c5_s2: That just breaks my metal heart...
5000451.c5_s3: Yes I am a fool...for your love.
5000451.c5_f1: If you hate me, why don't you just let me go? Roar!!
5000451.c5_f2: I knew you'd say that, so I removed that from my system. Muahaha!
5000451.c5_f3: Nah, I don't like you either.
5000451.c5_f4: Are you out of your mind? I am not the kind of a pet you'd want to mess with!
5000451.c6_s1: If the master tells me I'm stupid... then I'm stupid!
5000451.c6_s2: I think the bolt number 7 on my head is loose. Can you tighten it a little?
5000451.c6_s3: I was once a robot with a lot of promise... if only I was regularly checked up.
5000451.c6_s4: Despite all that, you're still all I've got!
5000451.c6_f1: Are you looking down on me for being a pet? Roar roar!
5000451.c6_f2: System error! Please re-enter the command.
5000451.c6_f3: Who are you to tell me that I'm stupid? lol
5000451.c6_f4: Did you forget the fact that I'm the rarest pet of all time? Sheesh...
5000451.c7_f3: Hey you, do you think you are in position to scold me?
5000451.c8_s3: I want to be loved...sniff sniff...
5000451.c8_s4: I'm sorry...I won't do that again!
5000451.c8_f1: Roar! Roar! What are you saying?
5000451.c8_f3: Roar roar! Say it in plain English!!!
