5000465.c2_f2: I don't want to just sit on the floor.
5000465.c2_f3: I don't know how, hee hee.
5000465.c2_f4: I don't want to! No reason, I just don't want to!
5000465.c3_s1: Sometimes, resting is good for your skin.
5000465.c3_s2: I'm sitting. But now I want to lie down.
5000465.c3_s4: I'm not sitting because you told me to!
5000465.c3_f1: I don't want to get scolded. But still, no.
5000465.c4_s2: Sitting is also a good workout sometimes!
5000465.c4_s3: Like this? Aren't I so cute, master?
5000465.c4_s4: I wouldn't want to wear myself out...
5000465.c4_f3: I'm not listening to anyone... Rawr...
5000465.c5_f1: You better stop or we'll get back at you!
5000465.c5_f2: You better stop! We outnumber you!
5000465.c6_s3: Hearing that from you hurts my feelings.
5000465.c6_s4: They say being angry is bad for your health...
5000465.c6_f4: Are you really going to keep doing this?
5000465.c7_s3: You're so scary when you're angry...
5000465.c7_s4: Argh! Don't hit me! It hurts!
5000465.c7_f4: You're not a friend! You're a bully!
5000465.c8_s1: How can you be so angry with me?
5000465.c8_s3: Wah! I won't do it again!
5000465.c8_f1: I'm going to tell on you!
5000465.c8_f2: I'm gonna call animal protective services!
5000465.c8_f3: You just keep punishing me! How about feeding me?
5000465.c9_s1: I'll show you what I can do! Prepare... for the charm!
5000465.c9_f2: Did you think it would be that easy?
5000465.c10_s2: You know what I'm gonna say!
5000465.c10_f1: You're not talking to me, right? I am a dog. Yip!
5000465.c10_f4: Why don't you feed me before you say that?
5000465.c12_s3: I'm so happy I met you!
5000465.c12_s4: Master, you finally see my worth!
5000465.c12_f4: I'm very busy right now. Can we talk about this later?
5000465.c13_s1: Got any paper? I'm all out.
5000465.c13_s2: Ah! Shh, someone will hear you!
5000465.c13_s4: I didn't think I could do that.
5000465.c13_f4: I'm shocked, I don't even have the words.
5000465.c14_s1: I don't know why you want that, but you got it!
5000465.c14_s2: Look the other way! It's embarrassing!
5000465.c14_f1: I... don't think I can do that.
5000465.c14_f2: I will poop only in a bathroom!
5000465.c14_f4: Hey, I do have SOME shame!
5000465.c15_s1: Why is poop called poop? Poooooooop!
5000465.c15_s2: I should poop quickly and then go eat!
5000465.c15_s3: Look at my poop, SO CUTE!
5000465.c15_s4: No one's watching, right? Keep a look out.
5000465.c15_f3: You want to see me push?
5000465.c16_s3: Okay, maybe just a little... zzz...
5000465.c17_s2: I hope I dream of ramen.
5000465.c17_s4: I only sleep on a full belly.
5000465.c17_f1: So you can doodle on me? No thanks!
5000465.c18_s1: You should rest, too. You can cuddle with me!
5000465.c18_s2: Wake me up if anything interesting happens.
5000465.c18_s3: Aww, you know pretty pets need to sleep a lot, right?
5000465.c18_s4: I'm already jungling in my dreams.
5000465.c18_f1: Play with me! Don't just put me to bed!
5000465.c18_f2: Would you like a glass of cool juice instead?
5000465.c18_f4: We have much to do. There is no time for sleeping!
5000465.c19_s1: I'm just too good looking... So torublesome.
5000465.c19_s3: Don't you think I'm just adorrrrrrable?
5000465.c19_s4: I've heard that Crimson Balrogs found on boats are ugly. Is is true?
5000465.c19_f1: What you want me to say? Annoying...
5000465.c19_f3: Stop talking to me when I'm eating.
5000465.c19_f4: No, I want to do something FUN!
5000465.c20_s1: What about the tasty oranges? ORANGES!
5000465.c20_s2: At least we have each other!
5000465.c20_s3: Sometimes I really just need to peel!
5000465.c20_s4: Oranges are the best, especially in winter!
5000465.c20_f1: ...I really don't have much to say.
5000465.c20_f2: Let's just go to bed... Zzz.
5000465.c20_f4: I think I'm a little hungry.
5000465.c21_s1: Ha! Your belly is bigger than mine.
5000465.c21_s2: I'm cute, pretty, and even know how to talk!
5000465.c21_s3: You and I are always on the same page.
5000465.c21_f2: Talking to your pets makes you look like a crazy person!
5000465.c21_f3: If I speak, you'll say I'm too noisy, won't you?
5000465.f1_f: I think it's the time for me to go on a diet...
5000465.f4_f: I gain weight just by drinking water. Sigh...
5000465.s3: I'm not going to say any bad words!

5000483.c3_s4: Sure... If it makes you happy.
5000483.c4_s1: I guess it's time for me to obey...
5000483.c4_s2: Maybe you should have a rest too Master!
5000483.c4_s4: Can you sing me a song as well?
5000483.c4_f1: Is that the only thing you can ask me to do?
5000483.c4_f4: Have you ever seen a monkey sitting still?
5000483.c6_s1: Can I really take a rest?
5000483.c7_s1: How did you know I wanted to rest?
5000483.c7_s3: I need to take a rest here!
5000483.c7_s4: You are the best master ever!
5000483.c7_f3: It is so dirty here, I can't rest!
5000483.c7_f4: No... I'm getting fat these days....
5000483.c8_f1: I am getting fat because of all this resting!
5000483.c8_f3: Just because you don't want to play with me, huh?
5000483.c10_s1: Don't look at me like that!
5000483.c11_s2: I will be better, really... Kiii...
5000483.c12_s1: Master I won't do it again...
5000483.c12_f1: I'm good, you're bad... Yes that's it!
5000483.c12_f2: Bad! You don't love me anymore!
5000483.c12_f3: I'm the most obedient pet around! AHHH
5000483.c12_f4: Say it again and I'll ignore you.
5000483.c14_s2: Ahh I must have drank too much.
5000483.c14_f1: You expect me to pee in public?
5000483.c15_s2: Ahhh I feel so much better...
5000483.c15_s3: Wow.. what a lot I must have drank!
5000483.c15_s4: Look at that Master... Have you ever seen a monkey pee?
5000483.c15_f1: How can I pee when nothing's coming out?
5000483.c15_f3: I don't feel like it! ARP! ARP!
5000483.c15_f4: It isn't nice for a monkey to pee here...
5000483.c16_s4: Ah that is what I call real Monkey Business!
5000483.c16_f1: How am I supposed to pee when you didn't even feed me?
5000483.c16_f3: Why don't you pee in public too?
5000483.c16_f4: Don't you have anything better to do than asking me to pee the whole day?
5000483.c18_f3: Me ear feels a little itchy here...
5000483.c19_s1: I love you too Master.. kiiii...
5000483.c19_s2: Hmm, Master you're so nice to me!
5000483.c19_s3: I feel nice and warm inside!
5000483.c19_s4: I love you too! Give me a hug!
5000483.c19_f4: You're referring to somebody else, right?
5000483.c20_s1: You're the best Master a monkey can have!
5000483.c20_s2: I love you too! What about going for a hunt together?
5000483.c20_s4: I'm such a lucky monkey to have you as my Master...
5000483.c20_f1: It is bad to tell lies Master, Please don't.
5000483.c20_f2: I love bananas more than I love you!
5000483.c20_f3: Are you sure?  You haven't hugged me for ages!
5000483.c20_f4: I'm sure you love your new weapon more! ARP!
5000483.c23_s4: I can stand! I can stand!
5000483.c23_f2: Huh? My ear feels a liitle itchy here...
5000483.c23_f4: I'll stand if you feed me!
5000483.c24_s1: Have you ever seen a monkey standing so straight?
5000483.c24_s2: Look Master! Aren't I good at this?
5000483.c24_s4: I did it! Master! I'm standing!
5000483.c24_f2: Can't you see I'm already standing?
5000483.c24_f4: I'm tired running after you! I don't want to stand!
5000483.c25_s1: Look master, do you see a banana there?
5000483.c25_s2: I love the way you talk to me.
5000483.c25_s3: I love bananas! Do feed me more of those!
5000483.c25_s4: I love you Master! Do you love me too?
5000483.c25_f2: What do you expect me to say?
5000483.c26_s1: Instead of killing monsters, you can do quests to level up too!
5000483.c26_s2: Monkeys love bananas! I bet you didn't know that.
5000483.c26_s3: I hate people who abuse their pets, don't you?
5000483.c26_s4: If you don't feed me, I'll go back home and not come out!
5000483.c26_f1: It is rude to wake a monkey from its sleep! ARP!
5000483.c26_f2: Talk talk talk.. I want to do something else.
5000483.c26_f3: Tell me honestly, have you ever heard a monkey speak?
5000483.c26_f4: I have nothing to say to you! ARP! ARP!
5000483.c27_s1: We pets are created by Cloy of Henesys.
5000483.c27_s2: If you don't feed me well, I'll just run away!
5000483.c27_s3: If you buy me a meso magnet and item pouch I can collect all your loot for you!
5000483.c27_s4: I won't live forever, so do treasure me when I'm around!
5000483.c27_f1: What do you expect me to tell you when I'm always following you around?
5000483.c27_f2: Don't you have any other things to do?
5000483.c27_f3: Why don't you ask my lupin brothers to talk to you instead?
5000483.c27_f4: Isn't it better for you to talk to your buddies instead?
5000483.c29_s2: I've wanted to play with you all day long!
5000483.c29_s3: What do you want to do?
5000483.c29_f2: Can't you see I'm busy now?
5000483.c29_f3: Feed me first... then I will think about it!
5000483.c29_f4: Don't even want to move my tail...
5000483.c30_s1: I've been waitiing for you to say that!
5000483.c30_s4: I'm thinking of how we are going to play Master!
5000483.c32_f2: What's so nice about my tongue!
5000483.c32_f3: It's tiring... I don't want to...
5000483.c33_f1: What do you want my tongue for?
5000483.c33_f2: It's rude to stick out one's tongue! Don't you know that?
5000483.c33_f4: Yucks!  That's a disgusting habit you have master...
5000483.c34_f1: Who sleeps in the middle of the day?  Not me!
5000483.c34_f3: How to sleep when I'm hungry?
5000483.c35_s3: That was kind of you Master, I'm indeed tired!
5000483.c35_f1: Don't want to sleep! Let's climb trees instead?
5000483.c35_f3: I'm not as lazy as you think Master...
5000483.c35_f4: If you aren't training, I am!
5000483.f3_f: No more for me... too full!
5000483.f4_s: Master!  I like this a lot!
5000483.f4_f: Master... are you trying to kill me?
5000483.s3: I thought you were a good Master...
5000483.s4: Kii, I thought I told you, I am against those bad words.

5000499.c6_f3: I don't even have a blanket...
5000499.c10_f2: An' a one, an' a two...

5000500.c2_s2: The ground is cold, but I'll sit.
5000500.c2_s3: You're right, I will take a seat.
5000500.c2_s4: So I just need to sit here, right, ho ho??
5000500.c2_f3: The sky is so nice... huh?
5000500.c2_f4: I don't want my feathers ruffled.
5000500.c3_s2: Take a seat? No problem! Gobble
5000500.c3_s3: You're so kind, Master. My legs were tired.
5000500.c3_s4: Ok, I'll get up when you say so.
5000500.c3_f3: I feel fine, but thanks for the offer... gobble.
5000500.c3_f4: An empty belly encourages me to disobey
5000500.c4_s1: A chickadee can follow that one. Too easy!
5000500.c4_s2: I do my best to obey, Master
5000500.c4_s3: A snack to show your appreciation would be nice
5000500.c7_s2: I don't like that look... I'm scared
5000500.c7_f1: You need a potion? You look funny...
5000500.c7_f3: I've been a good pet for you, be nice.
5000500.c8_s3: I have feelings too, I'm hurt
5000500.c8_s4: Sorry, Master. I'll obey from now on.
5000500.c8_f1: You already used your Mad ticket with me last time.
5000500.c8_f3: You're just shouting at me because you haven't eaten all day.
5000500.c8_f4: Not everyone can be a great Master, you'll get there with hard work.
5000500.c11_s1: Tada! You have such a good pet.
5000500.c11_s3: I'll always stand for my Master!
5000500.c11_f1: Maybe I don't hear so good.
5000500.c11_f3: Chickens may do that, but I do not.
5000500.c11_f4: My leg hurts, it needs to rest.
5000500.c12_s1: Truly, Turkeys are the best pets.
5000500.c12_s2: I needed to stretch. Thanks, Master!
5000500.c12_s3: I can see your face better from here!
5000500.c12_s4: I want a challenge, Master. Standing is easy.
5000500.c12_f4: Sticks and stones may break my bones, but only an oven can hurt me.
5000500.c14_f1: I only do what you tell me.
5000500.c14_f3: I didn't know you were a comedian, Master!
5000500.c14_f4: Are you asking me to agree?
5000500.c15_f2: Bested by a Turkey, you should feel bad.
5000500.c15_f3: Master, I only understand clear commands.
5000500.c15_f4: I only heard you say something about a wet sock. Sorry.
5000500.c16_s3: You're much smarter than I am, Master.
5000500.c16_s4: Your IQ must be really high!
5000500.c16_f1: I was under the impression that you were the smart one. I was wrong.
5000500.c16_f2: I think you left your brains back in the Hunting grounds.
5000500.c16_f3: Wait, look on the ground, next to the small rock. There it is! Your brain!
5000500.c16_f4: Aren't you supposed to lead me around? Sheesh.
5000500.c17_s2: Turkey can spot a scam anywhere. Watch out!
5000500.c17_s3: You have any Feed? It is delicious.
5000500.c17_f1: What is wrong with you? Turkeys can't talk!
5000500.c18_s1: I like to travel, Master. You can take me anywhere.
5000500.c18_s2: Where is everybody? I like seeing other Turkeys.
5000500.c18_s3: It's always a good thing when you're nice to everyone.
5000500.c18_s4: I think you might need a new hairdo.
5000500.c18_f1: A talking Turkey? Wake up--you're dreaming.
5000500.c18_f2: My voice hurts, so I'm resting it.
5000500.c18_f4: There was a feather in my ear. What did you say?
5000500.c19_s2: Turkeys are, by far, the best looking pet.
5000500.c19_s3: When are we going to see Zakum? I heard he's well armed!
5000500.c19_s4: Remember that doing quests can only help you!
5000500.c19_f4: The vocabulary of a turkey is not that developed!
5000500.c21_f4: Clear your voice and speak slowly.
5000500.c22_f2: You don't want to mess with a Turkey, do you?
5000500.c22_f3: When my stomach is empty, my ears get clogged.
5000500.c24_f2: I'm not buying what you're selling.
5000500.c24_f3: You must've been talking to that Mushroom over there.
5000500.c24_f4: Shaky hands? I see how it is...
5000500.c25_s2: Your love is the fuel that keeps me going.
5000500.c25_s3: Love is a battlefield, and you're my best weapon.
5000500.c25_s4: I can feel your love from here, Master...
5000500.c25_f1: I can't feel the love tonight.
5000500.c25_f4: I can tell you don't mean it!
5000500.c26_s1: If your love was money, I'd be a rich bird.
5000500.c26_s2: It's so nice to hear you say that!
5000500.c26_s3: My feathers only flap for you!
5000500.c26_f1: Right... you said that to someone else before
5000500.c26_f2: Oh, now you want to be affectionate? I don't think so.
5000500.c26_f3: The way to a Turkey's heart is through his stomach.
5000500.c27_s1: I've got my eye on you...
5000500.c27_s3: Go ahead. Wing it and see what happens...
5000500.c27_f2: Just for that, I'm closing my eyes.
5000500.c27_f3: Some food would help me see better...
5000500.c27_f4: My eyes tire of such trival sights.
5000500.c28_s2: This egg may give you superpowers. Use it wisely!
5000500.c28_s3: Much, much better than an apple.
5000500.c28_s4: Get some pepper and it will taste better.
5000500.c28_f1: I haven't laid an egg in a while, Master.
5000500.c28_f2: Someday, I may give you an egg. Today is not that day.
5000500.c28_f3: I don't have anything in my pockets. Guaranteed.
5000500.c28_f4: Better idea: How about you give ME an egg?
5000500.c29_s1: I think I got 2 inches off the ground that time!
5000500.c29_f2: Name the last time you saw a flying Turkey.
5000500.c29_f3: Haven't worked out my wings in a while, sorry.
5000500.c29_f4: I'd like to see you try. No jetpack, either.
5000500.c30_s3: Do I make you hungry, Master? Do I?
5000500.c30_s4: Go ahead, I've got another leg.
5000500.c30_f1: you're sick! Get away from me!
5000500.c30_f2: You're hungry too? That makes two of us.
5000500.c30_f3: No cranberry sauce? Or gravy? No dice.
5000500.c31_s3: I am feeling a little tired...
5000500.c31_f3: My eyes aren't heavy, why should I sleep?
5000500.c31_f4: Nowhere close to bedtime. I don't think so.
5000500.c32_s1: You're so observant, Master. I'll take a short nap.
5000500.c32_s2: Feeling pretty sleepy, a nap would be good for me.
5000500.c32_s4: This spot is perfect for a quick snooze.
5000500.c32_f1: Not unless you got a hen bed somewhere.
5000500.c32_f2: Unless you have a pillow, I'm not sleeping...
5000500.c32_f3: So you can cook me in an oven? Nice try.
5000500.c32_f4: I had a White Bull potion, I'm fine.
5000500.f2_f: ugh, there are onions in this!
5000500.f3_f: I don't think I'm hungry anymore.
5000500.f4_s: This looks like the best meal I've ever had...
5000500.s3: Told you not to say those words~

5000501.c2_f4: I want to go back to the patch...
5000501.c3_f2: Pumpkins don't get mad... we get revenge.
5000501.c3_f3: You can't fake being a pumpkin! Impostor!
5000501.c4_f3: But... this dirt is so crummy...
5000501.c6_s3: I'm going to put a candle in your head.
5000501.c6_f1: What do you take me for?
5000501.c7_s1: I am going to poop in your lunchbox SO much.
5000501.c7_f1: Don't do anything you're going to regret when you go to sleep tonight.
5000501.c7_f2: Don't say it unless you mean it!
5000501.c7_f3: How can you do this to me?
5000501.c7_f4: You better hope I don't get ahold of your shoes.
5000501.c8_s2: I said it won't happen again.
5000501.c8_f1: I wish somebody had carved me a mad face.
5000501.c8_f2: Want to see an angry pumpkin? Do you?
5000501.c8_f3: I've got a lot of laxatives to put into some candy tonight...
5000501.c10_f2: Don't do it! Listen to your pumpkin!
5000501.c10_f3: Why are you doing this to me?
5000501.c11_s3: You're creepy in a good way!
5000501.c11_s4: You are the seeds in my brain.
5000501.c12_s2: I'll be at your side until the day I rot.
5000501.c12_f2: Are you mad at me because I tortured your goldfish? He was asking for it!
5000501.c12_f3: Think of me as a child with a misshapen head.
5000501.c13_s1: Does it look like my insides?
5000501.c13_s3: Gonna need some more candy wrappers here!
5000501.c13_s4: It's a good thing I bought those candles.
5000501.c13_f2: Why are you asking me to do that?
5000501.c13_f4: It is against pumpkin law for me to go first.
5000501.c14_s2: Makin' squeezin's outta my pumpkin butt!
5000501.c14_s3: Which one of these creases is my backside?
5000501.c14_f2: I don't have to go right now.
5000501.c15_s1: I am on this like black on a bat.
5000501.c15_f3: Let's go get some candy instead.
5000501.c16_s1: Leave my light on! I'm scared of the dark.
5000501.c16_f2: I have gourd business to attend to.
5000501.c16_f3: I need to scare some children first!
5000501.c17_f1: Not until I see a ghost!
5000501.c17_f3: Stop telling me what to do!
5000501.c18_s3: Sometimes I dream of turning YOUR head into a lantern.
5000501.c18_f2: Sorry, I can't hear you with all the awesome in my brain.
5000501.c18_f3: Not until we trick or treat!
5000501.c18_f4: I need at least three screaming kids to lull me to sleep.
5000501.c19_s1: First time seeing a talking pumpkin?
5000501.c19_s2: Wanna see some pumpkin magic? Gimme your wallet.
5000501.c19_s3: October is obviously the best month.
5000501.c19_s4: Do you know when Halloween is? I don't understand the concept of time.
5000501.c20_s3: Pumpkin is NOT delicious. Don't eat me.
5000501.c20_f1: Don't expect too much from a pumpkin.
5000501.c20_f3: You should be more like me... a terror to all humanity.
5000501.c21_s1: If I ever see you eat a pumpkin, I will...
5000501.c21_s3: Bats like pumpkins. So let's not be friends with bats.
5000501.c21_s4: Pump, pump it up, pump it up!
5000501.c21_f1: I like to keep busy with the frightening.
5000501.f3_f: You ever seen a pumpkin die from indigestion?
5000501.f4_s: I'm gonna grub it so hard!

5000508.c15_s2: More than meets the--Oops.  Can't say that!
5000508.c15_s3: I feel something holy going around here.
5000508.c15_s4: Allow me to show you who I really am. Tada!
5000508.c15_f1: I'm too young to do that just yet.
5000508.c15_f2: I'm too tired to do it. Seriously.
5000508.c15_f3: I don't feel like doing anything right now. I'll do it later.
5000508.c15_f4: I look awesome right now. I don't need to do that.
5000508.c16_s1: Time for me to dust off my go-to move.
5000508.c16_s2: Don't you wish you could do this?
5000508.c16_s3: Allow me to show you why I'm the most revered pet in Happyville.
5000508.c16_f1: I have no idea what you want me to do.
5000508.c16_f3: I am a revered pet from Happyville. I do not take any orders from anyone.
5000508.c16_f4: Um... excuse me? What did you just say?
5000508.c17_s3: I am too hot. Seriously, way too hot.
5000508.c17_f2: Don't touch me. I'm not in a mood.
5000508.c18_s2: Now that makes me feel great today!
5000508.c18_s3: La la la what a wonderful day!
5000508.c18_f2: I think you're the only one feeling good today.
5000508.c18_f3: What makes you feel so good there?
5000508.c19_s1: Just thinking about that makes my day.
5000508.c19_s4: I hope you have a great day today!
5000508.c19_f4: Are you going out with someone?
5000508.c20_s2: I had a sweet dream, you know?
5000508.c20_s3: Of course I'm happy. I'm with you!
5000508.c20_s4: I feel so blessed right now.
5000508.c20_f2: Did you do well on the exam? No way.
5000508.c20_f3: With me, you'll never get bored!
5000508.c21_s2: I am so happy to hear that!
5000508.c21_f1: Don't just say it. Show me!
5000508.c21_f4: I don't just love anybody, you know.
5000508.c22_s2: I think we're a match made in heaven.
5000508.c22_s3: Just look at me. Nobody else, okay?
5000508.c22_s4: Keep saying that. I like hearing that.
5000508.c22_f1: You can't just say that. You'll have to show me you love me.
5000508.c22_f2: I'm sorry, but I have someone else in mind.
5000508.c22_f3: I understand that you love me, but I don't think it's time.
5000508.c22_f4: Hey, you are already seeing someone anyway!
5000508.c23_s2: I will love you til the end of the road.
5000508.c23_f2: I am way too popular for my own good.
5000508.c24_f1: What makes you think you're worthy of my love?
5000508.c24_f3: What did you just say? Whoa...
5000508.c24_f4: Are you trying to tell me you love me??
5000508.c25_s1: Do you want to hear a story about the Snow Queen? Once upon a time...
5000508.c25_s2: Do you want to hear more? Okay here we go...
5000508.c25_s3: You like my stories? I ever tell you about the Snow Queen?
5000508.c25_s4: For some strange reason, I feel at home in El Nath...
5000508.c25_f2: What exactly do you want me to say?
5000508.c25_f3: I'm too thirsty to say anything right now.
5000508.c25_f4: I don't want to talk to humans.
5000508.c26_s1: Once upon a time, in a snow castle far, far away...
5000508.c26_s2: Okay so do you want to know where I came from? I'm from the west.
5000508.c26_s3: Passion, vigor, and pride!  That's the reindeer way!
5000508.c26_s4: This year, Santa said I could take the holidays off, so here I am!
5000508.c26_f1: Today's not the best day to chat.
5000508.c26_f2: I am hungry, and I am tired. Let's talk next time.
5000508.c26_f3: I don't feel like saying anything.
5000508.c27_s1: My crystal form is a lot like the Glimmer Man's.
5000508.c27_s2: Are you ready for an all-night chat fest?
5000508.c27_s3: You know, I have some funny stories you'll love to hear.
5000508.c27_s4: Okay, then here's a story about the snow castle I used to live in. Way back in the day...
5000508.c27_f1: I am the most revered pet in Happyville. I only talk when I feel like talking.
5000508.c27_f2: What do you want me to say?
5000508.c27_f3: Uh.... What? I don't understand your moonspeak.
5000508.c28_s1: Ahh... time to go to bed.
5000508.c28_f1: Why do you keep asking me to fall asleep...?
5000508.c28_f2: I don't feel like sleeping yet.
5000508.c28_f4: No, I do not feel like it.
5000508.c29_f1: No, I feel like playing some more.
5000508.c29_f2: I'm so hungry, I can't sleep yet.
5000508.c29_f3: I don't feel like sleeping right now.
5000508.c30_s1: Hmmm... this pillow is so comfortable.
5000508.c30_s2: I ... am ... so ... tired ... I ... must ... sleep ...
5000508.c30_s3: Thanks. Time for me to go to bed.
5000508.c30_f1: Hey, it's not bed time yet!!
5000508.c30_f3: A revered pet like me shouldn't waste time sleeping.
5000508.c30_f4: It's beautiful outside. Why should I sleep right now?
5000508.f1_f: This is really gross. Don't you have any Snowflakes? Or pie?
5000508.f2_f: Why do you keep giving me stuff like this?
5000508.f3_s: This is better than anything I've had in a while.
5000508.f3_f: I am really, really hungry.  This doesn't cut it.
5000508.f4_f: Bleh. Are you trying to kill me?

5000509.c1_s2: Hey, let's not get mean here!
5000509.c2_s2: How can you say such a thing!
5000509.c3_s1: ...my love for you melts with each tear...
5000509.c3_s2: Joke? You didn't mean it... right?
5000509.c3_s3: I am so hurt right now...
5000509.c3_s4: Do you really not like me?
5000509.c3_f1: Watch that mouth--unless you want a snowball in it.
5000509.c3_f3: You need a new haircut, but I'm not saying anything.
5000509.c4_s4: Do you really not like me? That was mean...
5000509.c4_f1: Think snowballs don't hurt? Say that again and find out.
5000509.c4_f2: I hear Maple Claws is bringing you coal this year...
5000509.c4_f3: I'm so hot right now, I feel like melting!
5000509.c4_f4: You just told me you loved me!
5000509.c6_f4: I don't know what love is.
5000509.c7_s1: Now that just made my day~
5000509.c7_s2: Ahhhh... nothing feels quite like being loved~
5000509.c7_s3: Thank you... for loving me so much!
5000509.c7_s4: I love you too!  It's the holiday spirit!
5000509.c7_f1: You should only say that to someone you really love.
5000509.c7_f4: You just told me you didn't like me!
5000509.c8_s1: I know you love me. I can feel it~
5000509.c8_s3: That just made me feel awesome... I feel like flying~~
5000509.c8_s4: I love you too~ Tis the season of love!
5000509.c8_f1: You just love me for my snow.
5000509.c8_f3: I'm too cold to appreciate that.
5000509.c8_f4: Sorry, the snowman you're trying to reach isn't here. Leave a message after the beep... BEEP.
5000509.c10_s2: I've been waiting for this! Merry Christmas!
5000509.c10_s3: Did you get some nice Christmas presents?
5000509.c10_s4: I've been good this year. I hope Maple Claws will give me some presents this year!
5000509.c11_s3: Hope you get some awesome Christmas presents this year!
5000509.c11_s4: Christmas is upon is, and I hope you find your true love this year!
5000509.c11_f3: No presents? Then feed me--we'll call it even.
5000509.c12_s1: Merry Christmas to your friends and family!
5000509.c12_s2: Did you get a lot of presents?
5000509.c12_s4: Hope you enjoy a very Merry Christmas!
5000509.c12_f1: You can celebrate later.  Let's do something else now.
5000509.c12_f2: And you didn't get me anything.  Sometimes I wonder where you are in this relationship.
5000509.c12_f3: No presents? Are you kidding me?
5000509.c12_f4: Advice: Snowman + Christmas + No Presents = Failure.
5000509.c14_s3: What do you think of my eyes? Aren't they just adorable?
5000509.c14_s4: I'll do some cutesy stuff, as long as you give me some presents~
5000509.c14_f1: Get me the latest copy of Snowman Styles, and I'll do it.
5000509.c14_f2: Um...just because you said so?  Please.
5000509.c14_f4: What do you want me to do?
5000509.c15_s2: The best I got right now...
5000509.c15_s4: You like? I think I'm pretty cute...
5000509.c15_f1: I'm tired. I need some rest.
5000509.c16_s2: You know you like me~ I like you too!
5000509.c16_f1: You know what's cute?  Balrogs.  Let's go hunt some!
5000509.c16_f3: Yeah, whatever.  You just want something from me...
5000509.c16_f4: I just want to rest.  Maybe later.
5000509.c18_f2: What are you doing? I did nothing wrong.
5000509.c18_f3: Say it again! SAY. IT. AGAIN.
5000509.c19_s2: I won't ever do it again...
5000509.c19_f1: Do you want me to hit you with a snowball?
5000509.c19_f2: That's it.  Let's take this outside.
5000509.c19_f3: I won't ever do it aga--hahahaha!  Sorry, couldn't hold it in.
5000509.c19_f4: I dare you to say that again!
5000509.c20_s1: Please forgive me. It's really my fault.
5000509.c20_s3: I'll be good. I'm a good snowman.
5000509.c20_s4: I won't go against you. I'll behave.
5000509.c20_f1: I am not in a good mood. Don't push me.
5000509.c20_f3: If you keep doing that, I'll throw some snowballs at you.
5000509.c20_f4: I double dare you to say that again!
5000509.c21_s1: Did you get a lot of Christmas presents?
5000509.c21_s4: Winter's the best time of the year.  I hate summer...
5000509.c21_f2: I don't talk just because you tell me to.
5000509.c21_f3: You don't have friends, right? Why do you keep bothering me?
5000509.c22_s1: I'm right at home in El Nath!
5000509.c22_s3: You're such an awesome friend. Let's go hunting!
5000509.c22_f1: Am I the only friend you have?
5000509.c22_f3: Hah... no, I won't say anything.
5000509.c22_f4: I don't feel like talking. Let's go hunting.
5000509.c23_s1: I'm so cool...sorry, I had to!
5000509.c23_s3: Loved by many, appreciated by few. That's the life of a snowman for you.
5000509.c23_s4: Isn't Christmas awesome? What do you feel like getting?
5000509.c23_f1: Are you bored? Well, I'm not.
5000509.c23_f2: If you hang out with me more, then I'll talk.
5000509.c23_f3: How many Caramel Onions did you eat? I can smell your breath from here!
5000509.c23_f4: You told me to talk, and here you are, not listening. I'm hurt.
5000509.c24_s1: I'm tired... I need some sleep.
5000509.c24_s2: We did hunt a lot today... let's get some sleep.
5000509.c25_s2: How did you know I was tired?
5000509.c25_f1: Hey, I was dozing off until now! I wanna play!
5000509.c26_s2: I am soooo tired right now... zzzzz
5000509.c26_f1: I can't sleep. Let's go somewhere!
5000509.c26_f3: I can't sleep! I am too excited about those presents!
5000509.c27_s2: Did you see it? Or was it too fast for you?
5000509.c27_s3: What do you think? Don't I look awesome?
5000509.c27_f3: I refuse to change on an empty stomach.
5000509.c28_s1: I can do that! Look at me!!!
5000509.c28_s2: Pay attention, because you might miss it!
5000509.c28_s3: Nice, huh? There's nothing quite like it!
5000509.c28_f1: Why? Because you said so? Pfft...
5000509.c28_f2: Why don't you do it for once? There's a change for you!
5000509.c28_f3: Think it's that easy? I'd like to see you try!
5000509.f2_s: Awesome! There's nothing quite like icicles!
5000509.f3_s: Oh yeah! I love people that feed me!
5000509.f3_f: This is nasty. Do I look like a Turkey to you?

5000510.c2_s1: I'm a nice sheep that obeys well!
5000510.c2_f1: Baa! I don't want to sit!
5000510.c2_f3: My legs are too short for sitting, baa!
5000510.c3_s4: Baa baa let me take a break.
5000510.c4_s1: Shall we take a short break? Baa!
5000510.c4_s2: Baa baa you should rest with me master.
5000510.c4_f1: Baa baa I prefer sitting right now.
5000510.c4_f2: Baa, can't hear you because of all this fur.
5000510.c4_f3: Baa, what did you just say?
5000510.c6_s2: Want me to get your slippers?
5000510.c7_s2: Wahh, I'm so sorry, don't be mad!
5000510.c7_s4: Baa... I won't act like that anymore.
5000510.c7_f2: Baa, what did you just say?
5000510.c7_f3: Are you gonna keep doing that? Baa!
5000510.c7_f4: Hmph, I don't like you, master!
5000510.c8_s4: Hng, are you being mean because I'm a pet?
5000510.c8_f2: I'm going to leave the house if you keep doing that!
5000510.c8_f3: You don't wanna see me angry, baa!
5000510.c8_f4: I didn't do anything wrong! Baa!
5000510.c10_s3: Baa baa! I like, I like!
5000510.c10_f2: Baa baa, don't joke like that.
5000510.c10_f4: Er, um... I'm not sure what to say...
5000510.c11_s4: I'm so thrilled you love me, baa!
5000510.c11_f1: Can't hear you because of all this fur.
5000510.c12_s1: Baa, I love hanging out with you!
5000510.c12_s3: I'll do anything for you, master! Baa!
5000510.c12_s4: Baa, am I the best pet you ever had?
5000510.c12_f2: Baa? I didn't get that. Can you speak up?
5000510.c14_s2: Ahhh, that could heat an entire village for a month!
5000510.c14_s3: Yip! It doesn't smell bad, does it?
5000510.c14_f1: One must eat to poop, you know...
5000510.c14_f2: I have constipation, how can you be so insensitive?
5000510.c14_f3: Pretty rams like me don't poop.
5000510.c15_s1: Baa baa! Every day is a healthy day!!
5000510.c15_f2: I haven't had anything to eat... Spare me some Cotton Candy first?
5000510.c17_s2: Baa... I'm going to count some friends...
5000510.c17_s4: Baaa.... I've had a long day...
5000510.c17_f1: It's much too early for that!
5000510.c18_f1: Don't you see my eyes sparkling?! I'm wide awake!
5000510.c18_f2: Pretty rams like me don't sleep in a place like this.
5000510.c19_s1: Have you ever seen an adorable, lovely sheep like me?
5000510.c19_s2: My dream is to have cotton candy for my meals, EVERYDAY!
5000510.c19_s3: Baa, what do you want me to say?
5000510.c19_s4: When we were living up in the sky, angels mistook us for clouds.
5000510.c19_f1: I don't have anything to say, baa?
5000510.c19_f4: Ba? I was talking just now!
5000510.c20_s1: Have you have cotton candy? It's all sorts of awesome.
5000510.c20_s2: Sometimes I just wish I had longer legs...
5000510.c20_s3: I know I look fluffy like a cotton candy, but don't try to eat me!
5000510.c20_s4: My wish is to live with you forever and ever.
5000510.c21_s1: Look at my pink cheeks. Pretty, huh?
5000510.c21_s2: Baa, yesterday somebody said that to me yesterday too...
5000510.c21_s3: Shh, I actually like you the best! Baa!
5000510.c21_f2: I'll think about it if you give me some star cotton candy!
5000510.c21_f3: (It appears to be thinking about something.)
5000510.c21_f4: Give me some alone time, baa...
5000510.c22_s1: Pew pew, that's the sound of my heart shooting out!
5000510.c22_s2: Am I cute, or am I cute? Baa!
5000510.c22_f1: Today is just not the day for it!
5000510.c22_f4: I'm to hungry for that. Baa...
5000510.c23_s1: I only do this when I'm in a good mood!
5000510.c23_s4: No one can ever say no to my charm!
5000510.c23_f2: Hmph! What do you want from me?
5000510.c23_f3: Too hungry... no strength... baa baa.
5000510.f3_s: Baa baa, eating time's my favorite time!!
5000510.f3_f: I don't want to eat any more.
5000510.f4_f: Don't you have something different? Baa baa.
5000510.s2: You want to get reported, baa baa?
5000510.s3: Baa! Let's live a kind life!

5000511.c2_s4: I'm not sitting because I want to.
5000511.c2_f1: Why should I listen to you?
5000511.c3_s1: This is a piece of cake!
5000511.c3_s2: You should sit and relax, too.
5000511.c3_f2: Frankly, everything you want me to do is too much of a hassle.
5000511.c3_f4: Don't tell me what to do.
5000511.c4_s2: I was going to take a break anyway.
5000511.c4_s4: I do as you say, for now...
5000511.c4_f1: I don't want to do it right now.
5000511.c4_f2: I am unaware of this concept.
5000511.c4_f3: No way! I am not your kr'grana!
5000511.c4_f4: You take me to lake of fire first!
5000511.c5_s2: Who do you think you are?
5000511.c5_f1: You're the one that should be punished!
5000511.c6_f1: Rak unar! I eat your wallet tonight!
5000511.c6_f2: Don't take your aggression out on me!
5000511.c7_s2: My old boss was scary too. He eat my brother! So fun!
5000511.c7_s3: Would you please cut me some slack?
5000511.c7_f1: It's you who needs to be punished!
5000511.c7_f2: Don't blame me. It's your fault!
5000511.c8_s1: I won't do it again. Give me a chance.
5000511.c8_s2: Can't you see my tears? Please, have a heart...
5000511.c8_s4: Everytime you yell, I feel a little more at home...
5000511.c8_f1: You always say the same insults. Think up something new!
5000511.c8_f3: Stop it before I'll make you!
5000511.c10_f4: I may be quiet, but I haven't forgiven you.
5000511.c11_s2: I no fall for trick. Old Mr'kuma trick me like this long ago.
5000511.c11_s4: I accept, but understand that I don't feel the same way.
5000511.c12_s3: So many fans, so little time to crush all their hearts.
5000511.c12_s4: Yes, I'm one of a kind.
5000511.c13_f3: I'm not going to throw that away.
5000511.c14_s3: I expect you to clean after me?
5000511.c14_s4: Don't talk to me right now.
5000511.c14_f1: I'll get to work on making some.
5000511.c14_f4: Just who do you think you're bossing around?
5000511.c15_s1: It's time to let it go.
5000511.c15_s4: My digestive system is in full gear.
5000511.c17_s4: Okay, but only because I want to.
5000511.c17_f2: It's much too early for that!
5000511.c18_s2: Don't ditch me while I'm sleeping.
5000511.c18_s3: I also sleep during the daytime.
5000511.c18_s4: I better get something out of this.
5000511.c19_s1: Who do you think you are, kid?
5000511.c19_s4: You want me to talk? There, I talked.
5000511.c19_f1: I don't want to talk right now.
5000511.c19_f2: Never mind... I will tell you tomorrow.
5000511.c19_f3: Can't you just let me rest?
5000511.c19_f4: What do you want me to say?
5000511.c20_s1: Can you defeat Zakum? I don't think you can...
5000511.c20_s2: You'd better feed me on time. Or I'll run away!
5000511.c20_s3: I guess having a big head doesn't mean that person's smart...
5000511.c20_f1: Why are you always ordering me around?
5000511.c20_f3: I said I don't want to talk!
5000511.c21_s4: Do you want to fight me?
5000511.f1_s: Well, well. Not bad at all.
5000511.f2_s: I don't want to eat alone.
5000511.s2: This is abuse! I'll have you locked up!
5000511.s3: You kiss your mom with that mouth?

5000512.c2_s2: I'm fully aware that I have short legs...
5000512.c2_s3: Ahh, nice. Maybe it's time for a nap.
5000512.c2_f2: This place is filthy... I can't be here...
5000512.c2_f3: I just don't want to do it anymore...
5000512.c3_s1: Not really... I'm not doing this for you!
5000512.c3_s3: With legs as short as mine, it doesn't matter!
5000512.c3_f1: No, you're going to make fun of me because I'm just as short standing as sitting!
5000512.c3_f3: I think I heard someone saying something...
5000512.c3_f4: Sitting makes my buttocks get bigger.
5000512.c4_s2: I guess I could do that... THIS time.
5000512.c4_s3: Ugh, my belly becomes really noticeable when I sit...
5000512.c4_f1: I'm never going to do it.
5000512.c6_s1: I guess I should stay quiet.
5000512.c6_f1: Huh? What are you even saying?
5000512.c7_s2: I'm going to crawl under a rock.
5000512.c7_f4: Don't take it out on me!
5000512.c8_s3: I'm full of tears! And they're coming out!
5000512.c8_f2: I'm going to find a new owner!
5000512.c10_s1: Now that you mention it, I love you too!
5000512.c10_f1: Are you saying you love me?
5000512.c11_s1: I guess I love you, too?
5000512.c11_s3: Well, um...I kinda I love you too!
5000512.c11_f3: That was a good one... ha ha...
5000512.c12_f2: Ha ha ha... What can I say?
5000512.c12_f3: I already know how you feel...
5000512.c14_s3: I-I'm just a little bit shy...
5000512.c14_f4: Not here! I'll die of shame!
5000512.c15_f1: I feel like everyone is looking at me.
5000512.c15_f2: I'll let you off for today...
5000512.c16_f2: Doot de doo, I can't hear you...
5000512.c16_f4: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...
5000512.c17_s1: I'm sorry to interrupt you, but I can't keep my eyes open...
5000512.c17_s3: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...
5000512.c17_f2: I don't even have a blanket...
5000512.c17_f3: The ground is so cold and hard...
5000512.c18_f1: I don't want to go to bed...
5000512.c19_s3: I want to tell you about so many things...
5000512.c19_f1: I want octopus balls... And fried noodles...
5000512.c19_f2: I feel too shy to talk.
5000512.c19_f4: I don't want to talk about it.
5000512.c20_s2: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000512.c20_s3: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5000512.c20_s4: My brain is just so full of...stuff!
5000512.c20_f1: I'm going to bed. I'm full, I said...
5000512.c20_f2: There's nothing for me to say... I don't want to talk.
5000512.c21_s1: I'm jealous of Yeti and Pepe's relationship...
5000512.c21_s2: Everything will be fine as long as you feed me well.
5000512.f2_s: It's so delicious that it brings me to tears...
5000512.s1: I'll remember this! You watch out!
5000512.s2: Even we Demons know not to cross the line.

5000513.c2_s1: Am I good? Gimme a treat!
5000513.c2_s2: You should give me a complement for this sit.
5000513.c3_s4: Good idea. My legs were feeling a bit tired.
5000513.c3_f1: My legs are cramped up right now.
5000513.c3_f4: My legs aren't even hurting... do I really have to sit?
5000513.c4_s1: I practice every day, just for you!
5000513.c4_s3: There's nothing I can't do if I'm with you, master!
5000513.c4_s4: Master! I will do anything you want!
5000513.c4_f1: I will sit when you sit!
5000513.c4_f3: Right now, I feel more comfortable standing!
5000513.c4_f4: Master, you need to learn how to enunciate.
5000513.c5_f2: You should be setting an example for me.
5000513.c6_s1: *Whimper* Please don't yell at me like that. I like you.
5000513.c6_s3: I'll do what you tell me...
5000513.c6_s4: Stop looking at me with that scary face... You'll make me sad.
5000513.c6_f1: Did something bad happen at your school today?
5000513.c7_s1: You are still the best in my books, master...
5000513.c7_s3: Please don't be mad. It's hard for me to have my only family mad at me.
5000513.c7_f2: I am good and faithful. Why are you always on my back?
5000513.c7_f3: It's hard to understand your words!
5000513.c8_s1: Hearing that makes me so sad.
5000513.c8_s2: Master...I'm sorry for hurting your feelings...
5000513.c8_s4: Please forgive me, just this once.
5000513.c8_f1: I hate it when you get mad for no reason.
5000513.c8_f2: This is boring. Let's play something else, master!
5000513.c11_s1: Your words are always so sweet.
5000513.c11_s2: The words are so sweet, I don't know what to do.
5000513.c11_s3: I can't stop thinking about you, master!
5000513.c11_s4: You can say that a hundred times and I won't get tired of it.
5000513.c11_f3: Yip? Of course you do! I'm adorable!
5000513.c12_s1: Tell me that ten times every day!
5000513.c12_s2: If you tell that to another pet, I'll bite you! Yip!
5000513.c12_f2: I was going to call you master, but... Nah, forget it.
5000513.c12_f3: You're okay, except that you're too easy.
5000513.c12_f4: Master... That's nice... But you smell funny.
5000513.c13_f1: You need to study up on common decency.
5000513.c13_f2: Think things through before you tell me what to do!
5000513.c13_f3: There is a time and place for everything!
5000513.c14_s2: I feel lighter after I went.
5000513.c14_s3: Poo Poo... Let's sing about it!
5000513.c14_f1: How many times a day do you want me to go?
5000513.c14_f4: Why are you telling me to do this?
5000513.c15_s3: How did you know I had to go?
5000513.c15_s4: Would you play with me when I'm done?
5000513.c15_f1: I want to go play at the neighbor's.
5000513.c15_f3: I just pooped. Did you forget?
5000513.c15_f4: I don't know what poop is.
5000513.c16_s1: Aren't you sleeping? You look tired.
5000513.c16_f1: It's not time for bed yet.
5000513.c16_f2: I want to see you in my dreams, master.
5000513.c17_s4: Good thinking! It's time for sleep!
5000513.c17_f1: Can't I just sleep when I want to?
5000513.c17_f3: Master, this is not time for you to sleep!
5000513.c18_s1: Master, don't wake me up anytime soon!
5000513.c18_s2: I wanted to play some more, but okay.
5000513.c18_s3: You go to sleep too, master.
5000513.c18_s4: You're sleepy, too? Come lay down next to me.
5000513.c18_f1: Putting me to bed without food? You are an awful master!
5000513.c18_f2: I will rest while I sit...
5000513.c18_f4: Where do you plan on going after I fall asleep? Take me with you!
5000513.c19_s1: What do you like about me the most, master? Tell me!
5000513.c19_s2: If we run into something scary, you have to protect me.
5000513.c19_s3: You hunt. I'll feed you potions.
5000513.c19_f2: What I'm going to tell you is totally secret...
5000513.c19_f3: What do you want me to say?
5000513.c19_f4: You and I are intellectually incompatable for any kind of productive conversation.
5000513.c20_s1: Are you wondering what noises real penguins make?
5000513.c20_s2: I'm slumming it just by being seen with you.
5000513.c20_s3: Pets all speak different languages. A yeti and a white tiger can't speak to each other.
5000513.c20_s4: I am little tired today. How about you, master?
5000513.c20_f2: Manager Karl in Ludibrium is so kind.
5000513.c20_f3: Are you bored? Let's got get a facial!
5000513.c20_f4: I don't have a big appetite, but anything master gives me is good!
5000513.c21_s1: Watching snow makes me want to see Grandpa Cliff.
5000513.c21_s3: There's a statue that looks just like me at the Floating Market.
5000513.c21_s4: I think you are the strongest in the world!
5000513.c21_f1: I want to hear a story, master.
5000513.c21_f2: I don't know what to say!
5000513.f1_s: Master, this is so delicious... Squerch!
5000513.f3_s: I am about to faint, I ate too much.
5000513.f4_f: I don't want to eat anymore.
5000513.s1: Aren't you supposed to talk nicely?
5000513.s3: What goes around, comes around you know?

5000514.c3_s2: Sure thing. My legs would hurt if I had any.
5000514.c3_s4: Resting is good for the soul.
5000514.c3_f1: You have nothing else to do?
5000514.c3_f4: I will decide if I sit or not.
5000514.c4_s1: Would you like a cup of tea while I'm at it?
5000514.c4_s2: Let me teach you the way of tea...
5000514.c4_s3: It's not ideal, but I guess I can sit...
5000514.c4_f1: Sometimes I just want to say no.
5000514.c4_f2: I don't like sitting in random spots, thanks.
5000514.c4_f3: If I do, I'd rather sit in a nice garden.
5000514.c4_f4: A cold, hard floor like this? Really?
5000514.c5_f2: I think there's been a misunderstanding.
5000514.c6_s4: I'll be more careful next time.
5000514.c7_s1: I won't do it if you don't want me to.
5000514.c7_s2: Thank you for pointing that out.
5000514.c7_f4: Don't get mad at the small stuff.
5000514.c8_s1: Okay. Admitting mistakes is part of being an adult.
5000514.c8_s2: I'll be more careful next time.
5000514.c8_f1: How about a cup of tea to calm you down?
5000514.c8_f2: You have such a terrible temper.
5000514.c8_f4: I have never seen a more mature matcha than me!
5000514.c10_f3: Are you confessing your love? Really?
5000514.c11_s4: Stop, you'll make me bubble over.
5000514.c11_f1: What do you expect me to say?
5000514.c11_f2: You sure are good at embarassing yourself.
5000514.c11_f3: I didn't see this coming. Wow.
5000514.c11_f4: I know I'm smooth but I'm not so easy.
5000514.c12_s1: I appreciate everything you do, you know.
5000514.c12_s2: I guess you're charmed by my flavor too.
5000514.c12_s3: This is a very flavorful relationship.
5000514.c12_f1: You really like saying that, huh?
5000514.c12_f2: Pretty sure I heard you tell another pet that...
5000514.c12_f3: It's so hard to go with your flow sometimes.
5000514.c12_f4: I'm not often speechless, but dang.
5000514.c13_s3: Do you really need to watch?
5000514.c14_f4: Fine, I'll take care of it.
5000514.c15_s1: I had a good one today.
5000514.c15_s2: It's important that you poop right every day.
5000514.c15_s3: Please do not speak of my poo.
5000514.c15_f1: A decent bathroom would be nice!
5000514.c15_f2: I can't poop here. It's not classy!
5000514.c15_f3: Today is not a good day for that.
5000514.c15_f4: Why do you make me poop?
5000514.c17_s2: GOOD. I was getting rather sleepy.
5000514.c18_s1: Gotta let your tea rest once in a while.
5000514.c18_s2: I'll sleep and be ready for tomorrow.
5000514.c18_s3: Are you going to bed now too?
5000514.c18_s4: I think I'll sleep well tonight.
5000514.c19_s1: I used to be just a leaf...
5000514.c19_s2: Life can be so rich and savory.
5000514.c19_s4: Life is bitter. Bitter isn't always bad.
5000514.c20_s1: Everyone needs refreshments now and then.
5000514.c20_s2: Young people these days have no patience!
5000514.c20_s3: Do you think I'm old-fashioned too?
5000514.c20_s4: You're sweet, I'm bitter... We're perfect.
5000514.c20_f1: What? What do you want me to say?
5000514.c20_f2: Don't expect me to entertain you.
5000514.c20_f3: Let's just sit quietly and drink tea.
5000514.c20_f4: The past is in the past.
5000514.c21_s1: Tea must be dried properly to maintain the natural taste.
5000514.c21_s2: Every cup of tea must be poured from the heart.
5000514.c21_s3: Matcha is only one kind of green tea, you know.
5000514.c21_s4: Does your house have a nice garden?
5000514.c21_f1: How about reading a book instead?
5000514.c21_f2: I'm not the talkative kind of tea!
5000514.c21_f3: I feel like I'm babysitting you.
5000514.c21_f4: If you're so bored, why don't YOU talk?
5000514.f4_f: I do not wish to eat.
5000514.s1: Drink this tea. It will help your breath.
5000514.s3: I am thoroughly disappointed in you.
5000514.s4: I cannot obey if you keep speaking like that.

5000515.c1_s2: I am sitting, as you see.
5000515.c2_s4: I feel like I'm on a picnic!
5000515.c2_f2: Be polite in your requests, please.
5000515.c3_f1: Bring me a nice handkerchief to sit on.
5000515.c3_f3: Can we walk a little more first?
5000515.c3_f4: Excuse me, don't speak to a lady like that.
5000515.c4_s3: Oh, is it tea time already?
5000515.c4_s4: I think you need some rest too.
5000515.c4_f2: You want me to sit... here? Really? Here?
5000515.c4_f4: Don't think i can be controlled so easily.
5000515.c7_s3: I didn't realize you wouldn't like that.
5000515.c7_s4: I was just trying to be nice...
5000515.c7_f2: How can you do this to me?
5000515.c7_f4: I like you better when you're nice.
5000515.c8_s2: I won't do it if you say no.
5000515.c8_s3: I'll give you some tea. Forgive me?
5000515.c8_s4: I know, that wasn't very ladylike.
5000515.c8_f2: Is this about that time I ate your strawberry?
5000515.c8_f3: I'm appalled you would get mad about that.
5000515.c8_f4: I've never had anyone get mad at me like that.
5000515.c10_s3: Oh, this is so very lovely!
5000515.c10_f1: What? I-I'm not ready for this...
5000515.c10_f3: I'm not sure that I like this.
5000515.c11_s3: I l-l-love you too! Ahh, my tender heart!
5000515.c12_s1: I hope we stay together forever.
5000515.c12_s2: I'm chuffed with your kind voice.
5000515.c12_s3: Oh goodness, I'm getting all steamed!
5000515.c12_s4: Let's discuss this further over some nice, hot tea.
5000515.c12_f2: Do you say that to all of your friends?
5000515.c12_f3: You shouldn't say that so much.
5000515.c12_f4: Do not toy with a lady's emotions!
5000515.c15_s1: W-wait a minute, look that way.
5000515.c15_s2: It smells nice, I must say.
5000515.c15_s3: A lady's poo is not for display.
5000515.c15_f1: This is a tea leaf, not poo.
5000515.c15_f2: I do not do such things.
5000515.c15_f3: You do not say that to a lady!
5000515.c15_f4: What did you tell me just now?
5000515.c16_s4: Yawn, oh excuse me, I'm just... Zzz.
5000515.c16_f2: I don't feel sleepy in the least.
5000515.c16_f3: You should go to sleep first.
5000515.c17_f1: No! It's not all brewed yet.
5000515.c17_f3: I want to enjoy my tea time a little longer...
5000515.c17_f4: I'll sleep if you get me some milk tea.
5000515.c18_s1: Your voice is like a lullaby...
5000515.c18_s2: I was on a carriage in my dream...
5000515.c18_s3: Don't put me back in the cupboard while I sleep.
5000515.c18_f1: I won't sleep without a lullaby.
5000515.c18_f2: Are you plotting to put me back in the cupboard?
5000515.c18_f3: I cannot sleep without a nice tablecloth.
5000515.c18_f4: I can't sleep. Too much sugar, perhaps?
5000515.c19_s2: Afternoon is the best time of the day.
5000515.c20_s1: I don't like being in the cupboard.
5000515.c20_s4: Sugar told me once that there are worlds without fairies!
5000515.c20_f1: What do you want me to say?!
5000515.c21_s1: Every table needs some pretty flowers.
5000515.c21_s2: I dream of a tray FILLED with cakes!
5000515.c21_s3: No scones? Bring on the cakes!
5000515.c21_s4: A lady will hold a cup by its handle, not the cup itself.
5000515.c21_f1: I don't always talk so much, you know.
5000515.c21_f2: Sometimes it's better not to talk.
5000515.c21_f3: Do you need to hear my voice all the time?
5000515.c21_f4: Let us just... listen to the birds.
5000515.f4_s: This isn't bad. Did your chef make it?
5000515.s1: I don't like it when you say such things.
5000515.s2: And you kiss your mother with that mouth?
5000515.s3: Do not drink tea with that filthy mouth!

5000516.c3_f4: No, I'm going to keep playing!
5000516.c4_s1: It's like a picnic! Where's the food?
5000516.c4_s3: How long do you expect me to sit?
5000516.c4_f2: I'll think about it. A present might help...
5000516.c4_f3: Don't think I'll always be so kind.
5000516.c7_f4: I'll pretend I didn't hear that.
5000516.c8_s4: I promise I won't do it again!
5000516.c8_f1: NO! I won't listen to you!
5000516.c8_f2: I'm so young! How could you?
5000516.c8_f3: Yeah? Well, you never have time for me!
5000516.c8_f4: You mad? Have some sweets and chill.
5000516.c11_f3: I'm not sure I buy that.
5000516.c12_s1: I'm all warm and toasty from that!
5000516.c12_s2: I like you too! A lot!
5000516.c12_s3: Stop it, you're making me blush!
5000516.c12_s4: Not me. Kidding! I like you too!
5000516.c12_f3: I know. I like me too.
5000516.c14_s2: Feels great to let it all out!
5000516.c14_f1: Why are you so excited about this?
5000516.c14_f4: This is certainly not a toilet.
5000516.c15_s1: No! This is a chocolate! Not poop!
5000516.c15_s3: My poop smells like chocolate! Neat!
5000516.c15_s4: I succeeded. Now gimme a treat.
5000516.c15_f1: Not in front of all these people!
5000516.c15_f3: I don't want to poop. So there!
5000516.c15_f4: Don't you want to join me in pooping?
5000516.c18_s1: You can sleep right next to me!
5000516.c18_s3: I don't want to, but my eyes are closing...
5000516.c18_s4: It was a good day... Zzz...
5000516.c18_f1: You'll be bored without me, though!
5000516.c18_f2: No! I'm going to play with you!
5000516.c18_f4: Don't go anywhere fun without me!
5000516.c19_s2: I want to travel the world!
5000516.c19_s3: Have you ever seen a fairy?
5000516.c19_s4: Do you think chocolate fairies exist?
5000516.c19_f3: If you're gonna do something, do it well!
5000516.c20_s1: Don't you get scared when you see monsters?
5000516.c20_s3: Do you like the coffee, or do you like me?
5000516.c20_s4: Calories are like score points for drinks!
5000516.c20_f3: Give me a snack and I'll talk.
5000516.c21_s1: I'm just so charming, I know!
5000516.c21_s3: I get along really well with chocolate cake.
5000516.c21_s4: I need whip cream to complete my look!
5000516.c21_f1: You tell me a story first!
5000516.c21_f2: I'm going to be quiet for a change.
5000516.c21_f3: It's so tiring to entertain you!
5000516.f2_f: My tummy is gonna blow up!
5000516.f3_f: I don't want to eat anymore.
5000516.s2: I don't like people who use filthy words!
5000516.s3: I don't like it when you say scary things...
5000516.s4: I like it when you use nice words!

5000517.c3_s2: So this is how a Hekaton pet sits huh...
5000517.c3_s4: Was feeling abit sick, thank you-katon~
5000517.c3_f4: Really, you just want me to sit down?
5000517.c4_s2: To be honest, I prefer to sit than standing-katon~

5000517.c4_f2: Nooo, I don't want to sit-katon!
5000517.c4_f3: No, I'll be just fine standing right now!
5000517.c4_f4: Were you just talking to me?
5000517.c5_f2: Don't make me knock you out-katon!

5000517.c7_s1: You are the best Master, even if I may hate you-katon~
5000517.c7_s3: Stop being angry with me, Master...
5000517.c7_s4: I promise I won't do it again...
5000517.c7_f1: Why can't you forgive my mistake-katon!
5000517.c8_s2: I'm sorry if I hurt you, Master.
5000517.c8_f1: Why are you mad for no reason-katon?
5000517.c8_f2: This is not fun, let's talk more.
5000517.c8_f3: Try to understand that pets also make mistakes-katon~
5000517.c8_f4: If this keeps up, it's going to be difficult, Master.
5000517.c10_s1: If you have my number ♡ Master-katon~
5000517.c10_f4: I have no idea what you are doing-katon~
5000517.c11_s2: I have butterflies in my stomach-katon~
5000517.c11_s3: When I close my eyes, I am reminded by you Master~ ♡
5000517.c11_s4: Continue to keep me close to you-katon~ ♡
5000517.c11_f4: Katon is not appropriate for you...
5000517.c12_s1: Promise that you'll keep telling me you love me, ten times a day-katon~ ♡
5000517.c12_s2: Do whatever you can, and I will too ♡
5000517.c12_f1: Can I back out from this-katon?
5000517.c12_f2: I won't say the same to you master!
5000517.c12_f4: You need to wash up Master, you're starting to smell-katon~
5000517.c13_s2: I feel so ashamed of myself-katon!
5000517.c13_f1: Don't you know this is morally wrong in public?
5000517.c13_f3: The place and time is not now!
5000517.c14_s2: Ahh, I feel so relieved now-katon~
5000517.c14_f1: How many times do you want me to poop-katon!
5000517.c14_f2: No Master, I don't know how to...
5000517.c14_f4: Tell me why I have to do this?
5000517.c15_s2: Turn around and don't look at me-katon~
5000517.c15_s3: How do you know I gotta poop-katon?
5000517.c15_s4: Only if you play with me right after-katon!
5000517.c15_f1: I want to go and play in Kritias-katon!
5000517.c15_f4: I don't know what you mean Master.
5000517.c16_s1: Master is not sleeping yet? I'm tired-katon~
5000517.c16_f2: Hope I don't see you in my dreams.
5000517.c17_f1: I will sleep when I'm sleepy-katon
5000517.c17_f2: I'm a grown-up, I don't need that much sleep!
5000517.c17_f3: Its not the right time yet-katon~
5000517.c18_s1: Don't wake me up when I'm sleeping-katon!
5000517.c18_s3: Yes Master, I will sleep now...
5000517.c18_f1: I wanna stay up awhile more-katon~
5000517.c18_f2: I will sleep when I'm tired-katon!
5000517.c18_f3: Hekaton does not want to sleep.
5000517.c18_f4: ...and where am I going to sleep-katon?
5000517.c19_s1: Where can your innermost beauty be found? On your face?
5000517.c19_s2: Master has always protected me from scary monsters-katon!
5000517.c19_s3: Train hard and rest hard too!
5000517.c19_s4: I am happy to be with you, Master! ♡
5000517.c19_f1: What do you want me to say-katon?
5000517.c19_f2: What am I saying? It's a secret...
5000517.c19_f4: Our dialogue speeches are too different-katon!
5000517.c20_s1: Hekaton is immortal? I have no idea-katon~
5000517.c20_s2: Is your status as elevated as mine?
5000517.c20_s3: Every pet speaks a different language, even us Hekatons speak differently, Master
5000517.c20_s4: It feels kinda tiring today doesn't it, Master?
5000517.c20_f1: No Master, I don't wish to speak...
5000517.c20_f2: I will turn upside down if I try to speak-katon~
5000517.c20_f3: Are you bored? Go and train up, don't bother me-katon
5000517.c20_f4: But master, I want to eat, I have a fortress appetite! ♡
5000517.c21_s1: I can't be upset anytime I want to, right?
5000517.c21_s2: I'm always happy because of you, Master ♡
5000517.c21_s3: The castle in Kritias looks sooooo big-katon!
5000517.c21_s4: I think Master is the strongest in the world~
5000517.c21_f1: I don't have any stories to tell-katon~
5000517.c21_f2: I don't know what I'm talking about...
5000517.f2_f: I can not eat any more.
5000517.f3_f: Too big... can't do it, Master~

5000522.c10_f2: Leave me alone.. I want to be alone.
5000522.c11_s1: I don't want to be yelled at! What should I do?
5000522.c11_s2: Oh I'm sorry master. Forgive me...

5000522.c11_f3: You think that would scare me? Absolutely not. Hehe!
5000522.c12_s2: I'll take my punishment, just please forgive me this time.
5000522.c12_s3: I will be a good pet for you. I'm sorry master.
5000522.c12_f1: You always say no... Do I seem that easy?!
5000522.c12_f2: What did I do! I did nothing!
5000522.c12_f3: Leave me alone! Bad master! I hate you !
5000522.c14_s2: Yes, I only have my Master!
5000522.c14_f3: I only love myself. Because I'm worth it!
5000522.c15_s1: Hehe! I love this feeling. You feel the same way?
5000522.c15_s2: I'm blushing so much that my beak is turning red...
5000522.c15_s3: Your undying love like the ever-burning Sun!
5000522.c15_f1: I'm sorry, but I'm a bird and you are a human.
5000522.c15_f2: I already have a lover. Nice try though!
5000522.c15_f3: I'll think about it, but don't keep your hopes up too high.. I don't want to hurt you.
5000522.c16_s2: I will be with you always till the top level!
5000522.c16_s3: You are my everything! I love you!
5000522.c16_f1: Can't you just look at me?
5000522.c16_f2: I like tall people... Not such short ones like you... Sorry!
5000522.c16_f3: We are too different to love each other...

5000522.c18_s3: Okay! I was actually a little bored so play with me.
5000522.c18_f1: I'm kind of busy now. Talk to me later.
5000522.c18_f3: What do you want me to say...

5000522.c19_s3: People say heavy lips mean few words, but I'm the exact opposite. Hahaha!
5000522.c19_f1: I'm usually talkative, but right now I'm so hungry. Give me some food before you tell me to do something.
5000522.c19_f2: It's time for me to sleep... Let's talk tomorrow.
5000522.c19_f3: What am I supposed to say? How about at least giving me a subject?

5000522.c20_s3: Collaborative attack of man and bird! It's got to be the first ever!

5000522.c20_f2: Are you going to work me out like this on an empty stomach? This is bad!

5000522.c21_s1: Good, I'll show my great power!
5000522.c21_s2: I will swipe all with my huge beak!
5000522.c21_f1: Okay, have a good time there.
5000522.c23_f1: It is time to work. Lazy master!
5000522.c23_f3: Do you think I can sleep with this beak?
