5000522.c24_s2: Hehe, then shall I try out the new Coconut Palm tree bed!
5000522.c24_s3: You let me rest when I've worked hard! The greatest master ever!
5000522.c24_f1: Look... The sun is staring right into our eyes. You sleep!
5000522.c24_f2: You think you can make a nice weapon with this speed? Hunt more monsters!
5000522.c24_f3: I can't just sleep with my heavy beak... Master will have to hold it up. Will you?
5000522.c25_f1: Can you be quiet so I can sleep?
5000522.c25_f2: You better give up if you think that's going to work on me!
5000522.c26_s1: Your whistle sound is so mellow and sweet...
5000522.c26_s2: Hmm? Actually this is a secret, but I only live in Brazil. Bet you didn't know that? Haha!
5000522.c26_s3: Oh, how do you do that? Tweeeeeeeet!
5000522.c26_f1: Hey you! Want to call out all those monsters? Keep quiet!
5000522.c26_f2: You're embarrassing me with that sound in this great Maple World.
5000522.c26_f3: I'm 30 years old now... I'm too old... Stop this...
5000522.f3_s: Wow, what great food! It's like heaven in my mouth!
5000522.f3_f: This can't fill up my starving tummy.
5000522.f4_s: This is the best ever!! This made my day. I love you master!
5000522.f4_f: You are too harsh... All this time, and you don't know about my taste yet?

5000524.c1_s2: I couls use a break, thanks!
5000524.c1_f1: Hmm? I thought we still had a long way to go?
5000524.c1_f2: I still have plenty of energy!
5000524.c2_s2: How does this look? Am I cute?
5000524.c2_s3: I'm so happy to rest a little.
5000524.c2_s4: Great, my little legs are hurting a bit.
5000524.c3_s1: Yes, let's have a nice sit.
5000524.c3_s2: If you say so, I can do it.
5000524.c3_s4: I like it, I like it!
5000524.c4_s4: I got lots of fluff to sit on!
5000524.c4_f1: What if I don't want to?
5000524.c7_s3: I don't want to be bad...
5000524.c7_s4: I won't do it again! Ever!
5000524.c8_s1: I will think about what I did...
5000524.c8_s2: Oh, now I'm going to cry...
5000524.c8_s4: I'll just stand in the corner.
5000524.c8_f1: What are you so mad about?
5000524.c8_f3: I know, I know, you don't have to say it!
5000524.c8_f4: Do you really want to get mad over that?
5000524.c10_s3: Yep, I like you a lot!
5000524.c10_s4: Can you see it in my eyes?
5000524.c10_f3: Oh stop, I'm not THAT fluffy!
5000524.c10_f4: Never thought I'd be so popular...
5000524.c11_f3: Soooo... can I have something to eat?
5000524.c12_f2: Wat? I had fluff in my ears.
5000524.c14_f1: I don't feel like it yet.
5000524.c17_f4: How can I sleep so much?
5000524.c18_s2: I'll dream of galloping across the plains!
5000524.c18_s3: You should take a break too!
5000524.c18_s4: I'll see you in my dreams...
5000524.c19_s3: I'm so glad you chose me.
5000524.c19_f3: I want some good food first!
5000524.c20_s1: What do you want to hear?
5000524.c20_s2: I can zip across the plains like a cheetah! Really!
5000524.c20_f1: I don't feel like talking now.
5000524.c21_s1: You could use a fluffier look!
5000524.c21_s2: I want to go to Ariant.
5000524.c21_s4: Ooh, how about we race sometime?
5000524.c21_f2: I don't like the sound of that.
5000524.s4: I'd never say something like that!

5000525.c2_f2: How can you sit on the floor?
5000525.c2_f3: I will consider it if you get a cushion for me.
5000525.c3_s1: Good. I was getting tired of being in the air anyway.
5000525.c3_s2: I'm getting sleepy now that I'm lying down.
5000525.c3_s3: Pillows are such a brilliant invention.
5000525.c3_f3: Don't try to look down on me.
5000525.c4_s2: Why don't you take a seat with me?
5000525.c4_s3: Such a great weather to get some sleep.
5000525.c4_f1: Why don't you take a seat first?
5000525.c4_f2: I can't believe a toy can talk!
5000525.c5_s1: Sorry, I'm still not used to this whole 'body' thing yet.
5000525.c5_s2: You are making me really uncomfortable.
5000525.c6_s2: I'll apologize this time. THIS time.
5000525.c6_s4: You are the first person to tell me that other than Orchid.
5000525.c6_f1: I guess you don't mind dying, do you?
5000525.c6_f3: Do you have any idea who you are dealing with?
5000525.c6_f4: Don't tell me you are trying to scare me.
5000525.c7_s1: Admit that it was your fault.
5000525.c7_s3: Okay, stop it. I get it now!
5000525.c7_s4: I miss Orchid. She's so nice.
5000525.c7_f4: How dare you get angry with me?
5000525.c8_s1: I am actually reflecting on myself for the first time ever.
5000525.c8_s2: Okay, fine. I won't do that anymore.
5000525.c8_s3: So you also don't like me.
5000525.c8_s4: I wanted to be a good person.
5000525.c8_f2: Can you feel the darkness behind me?
5000525.c8_f3: You are nothing but a lowly peon.
5000525.c9_s2: I will accept it. Your heart, that is.
5000525.c9_f2: You will have a crush soon.
5000525.c10_s3: So many fans, so little time to crush all their hearts.
5000525.c10_s4: Those words make me feel nervous and great at the same time!
5000525.c10_f2: You don't even know how to get better.
5000525.c10_f4: How can a person as weak as you...
5000525.c11_s1: I don't really understand what it means, but it sounds nice.
5000525.c11_s3: You make my heart go pitter-patter.
5000525.c11_s4: I didn't know you liked me that much...
5000525.c11_f2: I am already suffering... You don't have to make me suffer even more...
5000525.c12_f2: Honestly, you are not my type.
5000525.c12_f4: Not bad, but not good either.
5000525.c13_s3: You can put this here like that, yeah?
5000525.c13_f1: I don't know what that means.
5000525.c13_f4: I was taught to do that by myself.
5000525.c14_s4: It will be easier to fly now that I feel lighter.
5000525.c14_f2: I feel like I just ate.
5000525.c14_f4: You are such a dirty toy.
5000525.c15_s1: Is this what it feels like to let everything go?
5000525.c15_s4: I want to cover my eyes.
5000525.c15_f1: I don't know how to do that.
5000525.c15_f4: I'm not really in the mood.
5000525.c16_s2: I don't know when my last break was.
5000525.c16_s3: Why don't you take a break?
5000525.c16_f1: I feel like I'm gonna have a nightmare.
5000525.c16_f3: I can't believe you meddle in everything that I do.
5000525.c16_f4: What are you gonna do while I'm sleeping?
5000525.c17_s1: Is it really okay if I'm the only one getting some sleep?
5000525.c17_s2: Will I be able to see Orchid in my dreams?
5000525.c17_s3: I'm gonna sleep, not because you are making me, but because I want to.
5000525.c17_s4: Mhmm, why don't you get some sleep too?
5000525.c17_f2: I can't play any fun games when I'm sleeping.
5000525.c17_f3: I have no time for that.
5000525.c18_s1: Will I have sweet dreams tonight?
5000525.c18_s2: Humans need to take a break from time to time.
5000525.c18_s3: I will hang out with Orchid in my dreams!
5000525.c18_s4: I almost feel too lazy to sleep.
5000525.c18_f1: I got enough sleep when I was in the laboratory.
5000525.c19_s1: I learned to talk a long time ago.
5000525.c19_s2: This world is full of toys for me.
5000525.c19_s3: You are such a lonely person...
5000525.c19_f2: You don't even know how to fly. How dare you?
5000525.c20_s1: I kinda miss being a spirit.
5000525.c20_s2: Why do humans hate what I love?
5000525.c20_f2: Are you acting like this because I look human now?
5000525.c20_f3: Why don't you just keep... doing what you do?
5000525.c20_f4: I'm not really in the mood to talk.
5000525.c21_s1: We are twins, but I was born first.
5000525.c21_s3: My age? Hmm... not sure. I never actually kept track.
5000525.c21_s4: I have nothing to fear as long as I am with Orchid.
5000525.c21_f3: Why not hunt when you are bored?
5000525.f1_s: Eating is such a great pleasure.
5000525.f1_f: I don't want to eat anymore.
5000525.s4: I don't want to hear it.

5000526.c2_s1: My legs were hurting. Thank you so much!
5000526.c2_s3: Take a seat here, little toy.
5000526.c2_f2: I was in bed all day yesterday.
5000526.c2_f3: I must exercise to be stronger.
5000526.c2_f4: I want to take a walk in the grass.
5000526.c3_s1: I feel refreshed! How come I couldn't feel this when I was a spirit?
5000526.c3_s2: I want my legs to get better soon.
5000526.c3_s4: I wish Lotus was by my side.
5000526.c3_f1: Are you telling me to sit on the ground? I am a patient!
5000526.c3_f3: I know I'm ill, but that doesn't mean I will listen to a mere toy.
5000526.c3_f4: I prefer to sit in clean places.
5000526.c4_s2: I'm gonna get better soon so I can fly again!
5000526.c4_s4: Okay. I will sit down for you this time.
5000526.c4_f1: I will think about it if you sit.
5000526.c4_f2: I want to take a walk little more...
5000526.c4_f3: I need to stand still with this IV bottle in my hand.
5000526.c5_f1: You are weaker than my rabbit doll.
5000526.c5_f2: Why are you doing this to me?
5000526.c6_s3: How can you be so cruel to someone sick?
5000526.c6_f1: Little toy, you are a little odd today.
5000526.c6_f2: Are you feeling sick like me?
5000526.c7_s2: I wasn't really feeling good lately. Sorry!
5000526.c7_s3: I sincerely apologize if I offended you.
5000526.c7_f3: Do you want to fly away?
5000526.c7_f4: Don't tell me what to do!
5000526.c8_s1: I feel like my headache is getting worse.
5000526.c8_s2: Even Lotus doesn't do this to me.
5000526.c8_f3: It was just a tiny mistake.
5000526.c8_f4: I'm gonna go back if you keep being this way.
5000526.c9_s2: Ha ha, that makes me happy.
5000526.c9_f1: Sorry. I only like Lotus and rabbits.
5000526.c10_s1: Cough, only you care for me...
5000526.c10_s2: Then just give me a present!
5000526.c10_s3: I don't like you as much I like rabbits, but I do like you.
5000526.c10_f1: Do you have a fever? Come here...
5000526.c10_f3: People don't like it when you tease them so much.
5000526.c11_s4: Do you still like me like this?
5000526.c11_f2: How can I do that with a toy?
5000526.c11_f3: You are nothing but a lowly peon.
5000526.c11_f4: You don't have pointy ears like rabbits.
5000526.c12_s1: Tell me that ten times every day!
5000526.c12_s3: I feel like I will get better sometime soon!
5000526.c12_f2: This emotion is too difficult for me to handle.
5000526.c12_f4: That's nice... But you smell funny.
5000526.c13_s2: Urgh, so annoying. Okay, I'm on it!
5000526.c13_f1: You need to learn some common decency.
5000526.c13_f3: Please do that at the appropriate time and place.
5000526.c13_f4: You should not do that outside.
5000526.c14_s4: Ah... this feeling... I can feel that I'm getting better already..
5000526.c14_f1: I didn't really eat much because I wasn't feeling good.
5000526.c14_f3: Why do you make me do such things?
5000526.c15_s3: How did you know that I had to go?
5000526.c15_s4: It's so annoying to live in a human body.
5000526.c15_f3: I just went. Did you forget?
5000526.c15_f4: What does that mean? I've never heard that before.
5000526.c16_s1: You should get some sleep too. Come here!
5000526.c16_s2: It's not a bad idea to take some rest from time to time.
5000526.c16_s3: I wish I can see Lotus in my dreams.
5000526.c16_s4: I've been suffering from a headache. Night!
5000526.c16_f1: It's not time for bed yet.
5000526.c16_f2: I will think about it if you bring me a rabbit doll.
5000526.c16_f4: I was sleeping all day yesterday in the hospital.
5000526.c17_s1: I feel like I am going to have a great dream tonight!
5000526.c17_s4: I'm so tired. I was walking around with an IV bottle in my hand all day.
5000526.c17_f1: I don't fall asleep just anywhere.
5000526.c17_f2: Are you sleepy? Take a nap. I will keep a lookout for you.
5000526.c17_f3: I want to feel this refreshing breeze little bit more.
5000526.c17_f4: Are you going to bed already?
5000526.c18_s2: *YAWN* I wonder how Lotus is doing.
5000526.c18_s3: You should get some sleep too, little toy.
5000526.c18_s4: Come here, I will hug you like you are my rabbit doll.
5000526.c18_f1: What are you going to do when I fall asleep?
5000526.c18_f2: 4 hours of sleep is enough for a day!
5000526.c18_f3: I cannot fall asleep. Is this because of the medicine that I took?
5000526.c18_f4: Are you going to run away when I'm asleep?
5000526.c19_s1: I remember the first time I met him in Hallowed Forest.
5000526.c19_s2: I love the way I am now!
5000526.c19_s4: AH.. I want to get better so I can fly like before.
5000526.c19_f2: Thought I wouldn't notice you talking?
5000526.c19_f3: Stop speaking to me in such a commanding tone.
5000526.c19_f4: I will think about it if you get on your knees and beg me.
5000526.c20_s1: I want to wear my uniforms again.
5000526.c20_s2: It was great to be with Lotus...
5000526.c20_s3: It's so interesting to live in a human body.
5000526.c20_s4: Do you still have my rabbit hair pin?
5000526.c20_f1: No. I'm not going to do that.
5000526.c20_f3: I have no energy to talk.
5000526.c21_s2: I didn't know what it felt like to be sick when I was a spirit.
5000526.c21_s3: Don't tell anyone, okay? I'm actually really really strong.
5000526.c21_s4: Do you know Lotus, my other half?
5000526.c21_f3: Shhhhh! The rabbit is about to fall asleep!
5000526.f2_f: Overeating is never good for you.
5000526.f3_s: I feel like I am all recovered!
5000526.f3_f: It will only get worse if I gain more weight.
5000526.s2: What a horrible toy you are...
5000526.s3: Huh? Are you talking to me?

5000527.c1_s2: I will sit if you insist!
5000527.c1_f2: The great Gelimer does not sit!
5000527.c2_s1: I am an old man you know...
5000527.c2_s3: It feels nice to be outside of the lab sometimes.
5000527.c2_f2: I am way stronger than I look.
5000527.c2_f3: I'm not planning to sit down at all!
5000527.c2_f4: Why must I listen to you?
5000527.c3_s2: It was not easy... You should get some rest too!
5000527.c3_s3: Is it gonna rain? My joints are stiff and sore.
5000527.c3_s4: Can you hand me the cushion?
5000527.c3_f1: I am full of energy! What does it mean to be tired?
5000527.c3_f2: I will turn you into an Android if you don't stop giving me orders.
5000527.c3_f3: How can you sit on the ground? Not classy!
5000527.c4_s1: It's been so long since the last time I got some fresh air!
5000527.c4_s2: Fresh wind is blowing through my hair. My thinning hair...
5000527.c4_s3: You are a very nice young man!
5000527.c4_f1: I am not the type to work under someone.
5000527.c4_f2: I will think about it if you give me some theoretical evidence.
5000527.c4_f3: Just keep hunting! I still need more data!
5000527.c5_s2: I want to be whiny sometimes HAHA.
5000527.c5_f1: How dare you talk like that to elders!
5000527.c6_s1: This world is coming to an end.
5000527.c6_s3: It's strange... It definitely worked before...
5000527.c6_s4: You haven't heard of the saying 'failure is the mother of success?'
5000527.c6_f1: Let me see... Something's wrong with you for sure.
5000527.c6_f3: I am the best scientist in Maple World!
5000527.c7_s3: Haven't heard that for a while.
5000527.c7_f1: Do you wanna be my research subject?
5000527.c7_f2: I want to study what's inside of your head.
5000527.c7_f3: That's something I would say to my teddy bear.
5000527.c8_s1: I will let this one go. You are lucky that I have a big heart.
5000527.c8_s4: Sorry. I was just so curious.
5000527.c8_f1: Was that not enough of brainwashing?
5000527.c8_f2: You are not even worth studying.
5000527.c8_f4: Are you sure you don't have a headache or something?
5000527.c9_s2: It wasn't to make you happy!
5000527.c10_s2: I'm good at hearts. You will understand...
5000527.c10_s3: This is not the first time I've heard that.
5000527.c10_f1: I will take a look at the experiment data.
5000527.c10_f2: Can you prove this to me mathematically?
5000527.c10_f3: My heart does not react to that...
5000527.c10_f4: Where did my teddy bear go?
5000527.c11_s1: Would you like to be a subject for my experiment?
5000527.c11_s3: HAHA. I haven't heard that in a while.
5000527.c11_s4: You fell for me for sure!
5000527.c11_f2: I don't even know what you look like.
5000527.c11_f4: I don't trust something invisible. I am not that stupid.
5000527.c12_s2: Do you wanna grab a cup of tea sometime?
5000527.c12_s3: I am so skilled at flattering my boss.
5000527.c12_f2: Love is the easiest trick you can use to deceive another.
5000527.c12_f4: I am older than your grandpa.
5000527.c13_s1: This? It's my personal taste. Show some respect!
5000527.c13_s3: Excuse me. I am in a hurry.
5000527.c13_f2: My guts are not done digesting!
5000527.c13_f3: I am a very patient man.
5000527.c14_s1: You will be the one cleaning up, right?
5000527.c14_s2: Was the potion that I took yesterday expired?
5000527.c14_s3: This is so great, just like my intelligence!
5000527.c14_s4: Stop bothering me. I am concentrating!
5000527.c14_f2: I feel like someone is peeking.
5000527.c14_f4: Don't tell me what to do!
5000527.c15_s1: I am such a healthy scientist!
5000527.c15_s3: Ahem! Did you just hear that?
5000527.c15_s4: I was fine when I was a youngster.
5000527.c15_f1: I am very sophisticated, unlike you!
5000527.c15_f2: How can you say that while eating?
5000527.c15_f4: My brain burns all my calories.
5000527.c16_s3: Nothing is more important than a good night's sleep!
5000527.c16_s4: You should get some rest now. You have so much to study later.
5000527.c16_f1: 4 hours of sleep is enough for one day!
5000527.c16_f2: I can sleep with only one eye closed.
5000527.c16_f3: Why don't YOU get some sleep?
5000527.c17_s1: I shall see my teddy bear in my dreams tonight!
5000527.c17_s2: It's little uncomfortable here... Ah well.
5000527.c17_s3: Don't touch anything while I'm asleep!
5000527.c17_f2: I heard stupid humans are sleepyheads.
5000527.c17_f3: We've got enough sleep. This is statistically proven.
5000527.c17_f4: How dare you give me orders!
5000527.c18_s2: Even the genius needs some time off for his brain.
5000527.c18_s3: Don't pester me while I'm sleeping.
5000527.c18_s4: It's better to take some rest like this.
5000527.c18_f1: I have no time to rest!
5000527.c18_f2: I still need to conduct some experiments!
5000527.c19_s1: I am Gelimer, the one who created Black Heaven! HAHA.
5000527.c19_s3: You must sacrifice little things in life to succeed.
5000527.c19_s4: I'm the one who came up with the Evolution System, too!
5000527.c19_f1: Not everyone can hear my voice.
5000527.c19_f2: Can you handle 10-hour lectures on Gelimer's Theory?
5000527.c19_f3: I don't really enjoy talking to humans.
5000527.c20_s1: I am so close to perfecting my greatest creation!
5000527.c20_s2: Takes me 20 minutes each day to do my hair!
5000527.c20_s3: You don't think I am competent as a commander? NONSENSE!
5000527.c20_s4: Everyone I met fell for me because of my beautiful eyes.
5000527.c20_f2: Do you not have anyone else to talk to?
5000527.c20_f3: You are such a lonely subject. Should I make a human clone just for you?
5000527.c20_f4: Keep it down. I can't concentrate!
5000527.c21_s1: What would be the first thing you would do if the world ends now?
5000527.c21_s2: You will be surprised when you learn the secret of my teddy bear.
5000527.c21_s3: I want to press all the red buttons in the world! Are you like that too?
5000527.c21_s4: Arkarium? I'm way smarter than that fool.
5000527.c21_f1: I don't want to deal with you.
5000527.c21_f2: Why not hunt when you are bored?
5000527.c21_f3: Why don't you become friends with a doll if you are lonely?
5000527.f1_s: This is the taste of proper molecule arrangement!
5000527.f1_f: Is this the flavor of motor oil?
5000527.f2_f: Cut it now! I'm not a glutton!
5000527.f3_s: i didn't know I could be this happy by just eating!
5000527.f4_s: I needed some sugar in my system!
5000527.s1: Where did I put my taser?
5000527.s2: I heard humans starts cussing when they have nothing else to say.
5000527.s3: You have not taken any speech classes, have you?
5000527.s4: STOP! Or else I will have you stuffed like a stuffed animal!

5000528.c3_s4: Good, my tail was getting heavy.
5000528.c3_f2: No one is going to stand guard?
5000528.c3_f3: If we sit, we can't seeeeeeeeee!
5000528.c4_s3: It's the perfect time to rest!
5000528.c4_f1: Meerkats are diligent! Just look at us!
5000528.c4_f2: We can't rest like this every day!
5000528.c4_f3: We like to move it, move it!!
5000528.c6_f2: Don't talk to me like that!
5000528.c8_s2: Don't get mad at the kids...
5000528.c8_f1: You promised to be nice to us!
5000528.c8_f2: We want to go back to the desert!
5000528.c8_f3: We're gonna tell our family on your!
5000528.c11_s2: Better than the warm desert breeze!
5000528.c11_s4: All three of us like you!
5000528.c11_f1: Wah! You surprised all of us!
5000528.c12_s1: With us you get three times the love!
5000528.c12_s4: Triple the love, triple the fun!
5000528.c12_f2: Did you eat a poisonous scorpion or something?
5000528.c12_f3: You will never be part of our family!
5000528.c13_f3: You should be ashamed of yourself!
5000528.c14_f1: We have nothing left to give!
5000528.c14_f2: There's only one roll of toilet paper!
5000528.c15_s1: Every day is a healthy day!
5000528.c15_s2: We're gonna need another potty... Or two.
5000528.c15_s3: Make sure no one's looking, okay?
5000528.c15_f3: Not enough toilet paper! You should have known!
5000528.c15_f4: Are you trying to bring shame upon our family?
5000528.c16_f1: But we all want to play!
5000528.c16_f2: Look, the sun is still up!
5000528.c16_f3: Still a long way to go!
5000528.c17_f2: We don't need to sleep yet.
5000528.c17_f3: We sleep when we're sleepy, okies?
5000528.c18_s3: Okay team, let's settle down here...
5000528.c18_f1: It's unanimous, we are not sleepy.
5000528.c18_f2: We're not so keen on your ideas...
5000528.c18_f3: Why do you care so much about sleep? Lazy!
5000528.c18_f4: Is this going to make us closer?
5000528.c19_s1: You want to hear about the rest of our family?
5000528.c19_s2: We saw this weird place, with 'trees' or something.
5000528.c19_s3: We saw something weird earlier, but we can't agree on what.
5000528.c19_s4: If you want we can include you into our family!
5000528.c20_s1: So the secret to being a good lookout is...
5000528.c20_s2: That the thing on top of the youngest one's head is a firefly!
5000528.c20_s3: We never thought anywhere would be better than desert.
5000528.c20_s4: We love nice people like you!
5000528.c20_f2: We want to take a break.
5000528.c21_s1: Not all meerkats get to have a flower bloom on top of their heads.
5000528.c21_s2: Isn't it hard walking on two legs, master?
5000528.c21_s3: Where shall we go for today's adventure? We're excited!
5000528.c21_s4: Scorpions are tasty, but tarantulas are delicacies.
5000528.c21_f4: We voted and we don't feel like it...
5000528.c22_s2: We love you, you love us!
5000528.c22_f2: But we're shy! All of us!
5000528.c23_s1: We aren't on sand, but we'll give it a try!
5000528.c23_s2: When the three of us get together, there is nothing we can't accomplish!
5000528.c23_s3: We'll show you what meerkats are made of!
5000528.c23_f2: Do we ALL have to perform?
5000528.f3_s: You sure take good care of us!
5000528.f4_f: Don't you think the youngest got a bit chubbier?
5000528.s2: What goes around, comes around, you know?
5000528.s3: We don't like that! Not one bit!
5000528.s4: Words reflect your insides, you know?

5000529.c2_f2: I don't want to sit here.
5000529.c3_s1: Yes, a rest would be nice.
5000529.c3_s4: Oh, my legs are sore. Thank you. Mrow!
5000529.c3_f2: Don't order me around like that! Meow!
5000529.c3_f3: Meow... I don't sit in places like this.
5000529.c4_s2: A nice, leisurely rest would be nice...mrow!
5000529.c4_s3: Some weather, huh? Let's relax for a while, master. Meow!
5000529.c4_f1: Meow. Don't tell me what to do!
5000529.c4_f2: You can't always get what you want, master.
5000529.c4_f3: Do I look like a remote control cat to you?
5000529.c6_s2: I won't do it again. Meow!
5000529.c6_f1: Why are you doing this? MROW!
5000529.c6_f2: What have I done wrong? Meow!
5000529.c6_f4: Meow! Why are you in such a bad mood?
5000529.c7_s2: I'm sorry! Forgive me! Forgive me!
5000529.c7_s4: H-how can you yell at me like that?!
5000529.c7_f1: Why are you taking it out on me? MROW!
5000529.c7_f3: Meow! I didn't do anything wrong. Bad master!
5000529.c8_s1: I'm sorry! I won't do it again. Meow...
5000529.c8_s2: You're not enjoying this, are you?
5000529.c8_s4: Are you really abandoning me? Meow! Meow!
5000529.c10_f4: Liar! I don't believe you! MROW!
5000529.c11_s3: Say it again! Say it again! Mew!
5000529.c11_s4: MEOW! You're the best! Mew! Mew!
5000529.c11_f2: Mrow... You know I'm a cat, right?
5000529.c11_f3: I'm sure you say that to all your pets.
5000529.c11_f4: Mrrow... What can I say to that?
5000529.c12_s2: I'm happy to follow you around. Meow!
5000529.c12_s4: You're the best master. I'll follow you forever!
5000529.c12_f3: Love is fine, but I'm hungry!
5000529.c13_s2: Ah! Shh, someone will hear you!
5000529.c13_f4: This is not a restroom! Meow, meow!
5000529.c14_s1: Can you get me some toilet paper, master?
5000529.c14_f1: Why...are you telling me to do this?
5000529.c15_s2: No one's watching, right? Watch out for me. Meow!
5000529.c15_s3: I made you a gift, master!
5000529.c15_s4: Errr... I don't have to! Meow!
5000529.c15_f1: I don't need to go! Do you, master?
5000529.c15_f3: Meow... What am I suppose to do here...?
5000529.c15_f4: Meow! Everyone's watching! I can't do it here!
5000529.c16_s3: Maybe a little cat nap would be good...
5000529.c16_f1: Meow. It's not time for bed yet...
5000529.c16_f2: Meow! The sun's still high in the sky!
5000529.c16_f4: Aren't you sleepy, master? I'm sleepy.
5000529.c17_s1: Nothing beats sleeping on a soft pillow.
5000529.c17_s4: Don't let anyone wake me up. Meow!
5000529.c17_f1: Can't I just sleep when I want to? Mrow!
5000529.c17_f2: Why are you putting me to bed? It's too early!
5000529.c17_f4: I still want to play! Mew!
5000529.c18_s1: This was a such a long day.
5000529.c18_s2: I feel like sleeping for 3 days. Meow!
5000529.c18_f1: Oh, just let me sleep already!
5000529.c18_f2: I told you, I don't want to sleep! Meow!
5000529.c18_f3: Isn't it too early for bed?
5000529.c18_f4: Why do you always want to sleep, master? Meow!
5000529.c19_s1: What do you want me to say? Huh? Meow!
5000529.c19_s2: I grew up in an elegant palace.
5000529.c19_s3: Have you ever met as eloquent a cat as I?
5000529.c19_s4: What should we talk about? Meow!
5000529.c19_f3: I'm thirsty... Can I have a red potion?
5000529.c19_f4: It's your turn to talk, master.
5000529.c20_s1: I hope this conversation never ends!
5000529.c20_s2: Have you ever had a Power Elixir? How did it taste? I want one!
5000529.c20_s3: I'm glad you're my master, master.
5000529.c20_f1: Why do you keep saying that? Mew!
5000529.c20_f2: What are you talking to me for? Bored?
5000529.c20_f3: You can't talk me into liking you more, master. Mew!
5000529.c20_f4: You are truly skilled at bothering your pets.
5000529.c21_s1: What's your wish? My wish is to be your kitty forever.
5000529.c21_s3: The most important thing is health. The second most important thing is...also health.
5000529.c21_f1: No thank you. Talking to you makes me mad.
5000529.c21_f2: Why talk when we could eat instead? Mrow!
5000529.c21_f3: Don't you have any other friends?
5000529.c21_f4: I'd rather talk to a wall.
5000529.f2_f: I don't want to eat anymore. Meow!
5000529.f4_f: Don't you have something different? Meow. Meow.
5000529.s3: Meow! How can you talk to me like that...?
5000529.s4: Meow! Are you a bad person, master?

5000530.c2_s1: I hope no one notices I'm here... Eep!
5000530.c2_s2: Ahh, nice. Maybe it's time for a nap.
5000530.c2_s3: I want to sit... But I need exercise!
5000530.c2_f2: I don't think I heard you...
5000530.c2_f3: This place is filthy... I can't be here...
5000530.c3_s1: With legs as short as mine, it doesn't matter!
5000530.c3_s2: Do you know what it's like to sit on a cloud?
5000530.c3_s3: I'm... already sitting. Can't you tell?
5000530.c3_s4: Whew. I guess I am a little tired.
5000530.c4_s1: Ugh, you can see my belly when I sit...
5000530.c4_s4: I guess I could do that... THIS time.
5000530.c4_f3: We don't have time for this!
5000530.c5_s1: I don't want to be punished.
5000530.c10_s1: Now that you mention it, I love you too!
5000530.c11_s1: Well, um... I kinda love you too!
5000530.c11_s4: Hee hee... You're making me blush!
5000530.c11_f4: Do you mean it? Are you sure?
5000530.c12_f3: Do you treat all your pets like this?
5000530.c14_f1: Don't you think you're going too far?
5000530.c15_f4: I can't, okay? I just can't! Leave me alone!
5000530.c17_f3: I don't even have a blanket...
5000530.c18_s3: I miss the thrill of battle...
5000530.c18_f2: No! I want to play more!
5000530.c18_f3: No! I have lots of energy!
5000530.c19_s1: I just love to play the harp!
5000530.c19_s2: I want to journey with you!
5000530.c19_f4: I'd like to be alone now.
5000530.c20_s1: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5000530.c20_s2: My brain is just so full of... stuff!
5000530.c20_s4: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000530.c20_f3: But I don't have anything to say...
5000530.c21_s1: If you could sing me to sleep...
5000530.c21_s2: I've got a good feeling about today!
5000530.c21_s3: I'm just happy to be with you.
5000530.c21_s4: Did you do your good deed for the day?
5000530.c21_f4: Are there more angels like me?

5000531.c3_s4: I was tired from all that walking.
5000531.c3_f4: Don't tell me what to do.
5000531.c4_s2: I was going to take a break anyway.
5000531.c5_s2: Who do you think you are?
5000531.c7_s2: But look at how cute I am!
5000531.c7_f1: Take a look in the mirror, buddy.
5000531.c7_f2: What are you blaming ME for?
5000531.c12_s4: How could you not? I'm adorable!
5000531.c14_f4: Don't tell me what to do!
5000531.c15_s2: That could go in a museum!
5000531.c15_s4: I kind of want to touch it.
5000531.c16_f4: You sleep. I'm gonna keep working hard.
5000531.c17_s4: Okay, but only because I want to.
5000531.c17_f1: I was just about to, until you said that.
5000531.c17_f4: I'm going to tape my eyes open.
5000531.c19_s2: Some days, I just look at the world and smile.
5000531.c19_s3: My weakness is my ears, but don't tell!
5000531.c19_f4: What do you want me to say?
5000531.c20_s1: One day, I'm gonna beat Zakum in a boxing match!
5000531.c20_s2: Feed me lots of protein so I can beef up!
5000531.c20_s3: Takes me 20 minutes each day to do my hair!
5000531.c20_f4: Don't tell me what to do!
5000531.c21_s4: You think you can take me? Let's try!
5000531.c21_f4: Let's just have a moment of silence, okay?
5000531.s2: This is abuse! I'll have you locked up!
5000531.s4: You kiss your mama with that mouth?

5000532.c2_s2: I'm fully aware that I have short legs...
5000532.c2_s3: Ahh, nice. Maybe it's time for a nap.
5000532.c2_f2: This place is filthy... I can't be here...
5000532.c2_f3: I just don't want to do it anymore...
5000532.c3_s1: I'm not doing this for you!
5000532.c3_s3: With legs as short as mine, it doesn't matter!
5000532.c3_f1: No, I'm so short I don't need to!
5000532.c3_f3: I think I heard talking... let's check!
5000532.c3_f4: Sitting makes my butt look big!
5000532.c4_s2: I guess I could do that... THIS time.
5000532.c4_s3: Ugh, you can see my belly when I sit...
5000532.c6_s1: I guess I should stay quiet.
5000532.c8_f2: I'm going to find a new owner!
5000532.c10_s1: Now that you mention it, I love you too!
5000532.c10_f1: Are you saying you love me?
5000532.c11_s1: I guess I love you, too?
5000532.c11_s3: Well, um... I kinda love you too!
5000532.c11_f3: That was a good one... ha ha...
5000532.c12_f2: Ha ha ha... What can I say?
5000532.c12_f3: I already know how you feel...
5000532.c14_s3: I-I'm just a little bit shy...
5000532.c14_f4: Not here! I'll die of shame!
5000532.c15_f1: I feel like everyone is watching me.
5000532.c15_f2: I'll let you off for today...
5000532.c17_s1: Sorry, but I can't keep my eyes open...
5000532.c17_f2: I don't even have a blanket...
5000532.c18_f1: I don't want to go to bed...
5000532.c19_s3: I want to tell you about so many things...
5000532.c19_f1: I want something fancy to eat! Octopus balls!
5000532.c19_f4: I don't want to talk about it.
5000532.c20_s2: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000532.c20_s3: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5000532.c20_s4: My brain is just so full of... stuff!
5000532.c20_f1: I'm going to bed. I'm full, I said...
5000532.c20_f2: There's nothing for me to say...
5000532.c21_s1: Yetis and Pepes have such a nice friendship...
5000532.c21_s2: Everything will be fine as long as you feed me.
5000532.s1: I'll remember this! You watch out!
5000532.s2: Even I know not to cross some lines.

5000533.c2_s1: Everyone will want to come and talk to me if I sit.
5000533.c2_f1: I don't know how, hee hee.
5000533.c2_f2: I don't want to sit. Sitting makes me look shorter.
5000533.c2_f3: I can't hear you, can you speak up?
5000533.c2_f4: I don't even want to listen...
5000533.c3_s2: I'm getting hungry just sitting around.
5000533.c3_s3: I lost some weight! That makes sitting easier!
5000533.c3_s4: Sometimes, resting is good for your skin.
5000533.c3_f1: Can I lay down? I'm tired.
5000533.c4_s1: Like this? Aren't I so cute, master?
5000533.c4_s2: Hey, you trying to get a better look at me?
5000533.c4_f2: But my butt will get dirty!
5000533.c4_f3: I don't wanna sit. I wanna sleep.
5000533.c5_f1: Why am I being scolded this time?
5000533.c6_s1: I didn't think it would make you angry...
5000533.c6_f3: You're scolding me for eating too much, aren't you?
5000533.c6_f4: Why are you doing this to me?
5000533.c7_f1: Why take it out on me?
5000533.c7_f4: Maybe I won't play with you anymore!
5000533.c8_s3: You said you liked me. Were you... lying?
5000533.c8_s4: You don't have to make such a big deal...
5000533.c8_f2: I don't have room to talk, but you're ridiculous.
5000533.c8_f4: I'm telling you, it wasn't me!
5000533.c10_f4: You're not talking to me, right? I am a dog. Yip!
5000533.c11_s1: Say it again! Say it again!
5000533.c12_s3: I always knew I was irresistible.
5000533.c12_s4: Just what I wanted to hear!
5000533.c12_f2: Just feed me. No need for the rest.
5000533.c13_s3: I didn't think I could do that.
5000533.c13_f4: I don't want to do that.
5000533.c14_s3: I know... I'm cute even when I poop!
5000533.c14_f1: Hey, I do have SOME shame!
5000533.c14_f3: Why are you so harsh on me?
5000533.c14_f4: I... don't think I can do that.
5000533.c15_s2: Why is poop called poop? Poooooooop!
5000533.c15_s3: Look at it! I sculpted it to look like you.
5000533.c15_s4: I bet your poop is worse.
5000533.c15_f1: Poop? Why don't you try feeding me first?
5000533.c15_f2: I hate poop. I'll poop tomorrow.
5000533.c15_f3: No! No! I don't feel like pooping!
5000533.c15_f4: Some things you just don't do in public.
5000533.c16_s1: Okay, maybe just a little... zzz...
5000533.c16_f3: I only sleep on a full belly.
5000533.c17_s2: I'm not tired yet. Why are you forcing me to sleep?
5000533.c17_f2: You want a pretty pet like me to sleep on the ground?!
5000533.c18_s1: Wake me up if anything interesting happens.
5000533.c18_f1: Look at your belly! You should hit the gym!
5000533.c18_f2: I can't sleep... There's still so much fun to have!
5000533.c18_f3: You must make a bed for me!
5000533.c18_f4: Sleep? That's what you do at night!
5000533.c19_s1: I wish my legs were just a little bit longer!
5000533.c19_s2: I wish I could cast spells like this.
5000533.c19_s3: Let's talk about my noble bearing.
5000533.c19_s4: I really am the perfect pet!
5000533.c19_f1: I've got all kinds of secrets! And I won't tell!
5000533.c19_f2: No, I want to do something FUN!
5000533.c19_f4: Don't bother me! Go play by yourself!
5000533.c20_s2: I hate being alone more than anything.
5000533.c20_s3: I'm working out these days. It's tough.
5000533.c20_s4: I think I'm a little hungry. Just a little.
5000533.c20_f1: Let's just go to bed... Zzz.
5000533.c20_f2: I'm cuter than the other strays, right?
5000533.c20_f3: It's hard to talk in this form!
5000533.c21_s1: I wish only birds had wings. Why do Balrogs even have them?
5000533.c21_s2: I sing better than I talk. You wanna listen?
5000533.c21_s3: Yeti and Pepe are BFFs. I want a BFF.
5000533.c21_s4: My sister is a real chatterbox if you get her started.
5000533.c21_f1: Do you like it when I talk? Huh?
5000533.c21_f2: If I speak, you'll say I'm too noisy, won't you?
5000533.c21_f4: I should just pretend like I can't hear. This is fun!
5000533.f2_s: You must REALLY like me, master!
5000533.f2_f: Master...You're just fattening me up, aren't you?
5000533.f3_f: I think it's the time for me to go on a diet...
5000533.f4_s: I'll be good as long as the food is good!
5000533.f4_f: Blech, how could you give me such an awful thing?
5000533.s2: Whoa, did you really just say that?
5000533.s3: Um, that's not my style at all.

5000534.c2_s1: This behind could use some rest.
5000534.c2_s3: Do I look better sitting down?
5000534.c2_s4: We could use some snacks, too.
5000534.c2_f2: Let's go, I don't know, anywhere else.
5000534.c2_f3: I don't want to sit. Sitting makes me look shorter.
5000534.c2_f4: There's way too much to do to sit now!
5000534.c3_s2: It's a good thing my butt is so fluffy!
5000534.c3_s3: Let's watch some TV and eat some candy!
5000534.c3_s4: I really don't feel like getting up again...
5000534.c3_f1: I don't want to sit unless it's on your lap...
5000534.c3_f2: I don't like this place. It has nothing good to eat.
5000534.c3_f3: I'd sit if this were a rose field.
5000534.c4_s1: I wouldn't want to wear myself out...
5000534.c4_s4: The ground feels like it's going to give under my butt.
5000534.c4_f1: Huh? I'm too hungry to focus...
5000534.c4_f2: I'm starving and you still want me to sit...
5000534.c4_f3: I'm in no mood to sit.
5000534.c4_f4: Sit? What if something bites me?
5000534.c5_f1: Why am I being scolded this time?
5000534.c6_s1: You're not gonna hit me, are you?
5000534.c6_s2: They say being angry is bad for your health...
5000534.c6_s4: Don't be angry. It's pretty off-putting.
5000534.c6_f3: You're scolding me for eating too much, aren't you?
5000534.c7_s1: I don't even know what I did.
5000534.c7_s3: I'm sorry... I won't do it again...
5000534.c7_f1: Yeah? I can be scarier than that!
5000534.c7_f3: I can't understand what you're saying!
5000534.c8_f2: You just keep punishing me! How about feeding me?
5000534.c10_s2: Hee hee... Yeah, I get that a lot.
5000534.c11_s3: Am I prettier than a rose?
5000534.c11_f1: Give me some time to think it over.
5000534.c12_s1: Can you see hearts in my eyes?
5000534.c13_s1: Got any paper? I'm all out.
5000534.c13_s4: I could do this all day!
5000534.c13_f3: I only do that for ME!
5000534.c14_s3: Look, let's get this over with.
5000534.c14_s4: Okay, so... I can't reach back to wipe...
5000534.c14_f1: Ugh, you can't POSSIBLY be serious.
5000534.c14_f2: I... don't think I can do that.
5000534.c14_f3: That's embarrassing! I should poop in secret.
5000534.c15_f1: I'm sure I didn't just hear you right.
5000534.c15_f2: I need to eat something first!
5000534.c15_f3: You go first. Then I'll think about it.
5000534.c16_s2: Okay, maybe just a little... zzz...
5000534.c16_f1: Nnnno, you've got a look I don't trust.
5000534.c16_f3: I only sleep on a full belly.
5000534.c16_f4: I'm too hungry to fall asleep...
5000534.c17_s4: Yeah, I could use a rest.
5000534.c17_f3: If you're tired, it's okay to go to bed first!
5000534.c17_f4: Sleeping out in the open is romantic, but not now.
5000534.c18_s4: Wake me up if anything interesting happens.
5000534.c18_f2: Yip! Give me a salmon treat and I'll think about it!
5000534.c18_f3: Look at your belly! You should hit the gym!
5000534.c18_f4: Sleep? That's what you do at night!
5000534.c19_s2: What do you think about my fierce eyes?
5000534.c19_s3: Let's talk about my noble bearing.
5000534.c19_s4: I wish I could cast spells like this.
5000534.c19_f4: What you want me to say? Annoying...
5000534.c20_s1: I don't wanna become a doll. I'd rather go to jail!
5000534.c20_s2: You have no idea how much effort I put into my looks!
5000534.c20_s3: Kitties are still cute if they eat a lot... right?
5000534.c20_f1: My belly is itchy. Scratch here, please...
5000534.c20_f3: Do you think I have something to say?
5000534.c20_f4: Can we just play? I don't feel chatty right now.
5000534.c21_s1: Do you know what Water of Life tastes like? Is it delicious?
5000534.c21_s2: Ha! Your belly is bigger than mine.
5000534.c21_s3: I'm cute, pretty, and even know how to talk!
5000534.c21_s4: Am I cuter as a kitty?
5000534.c21_f3: I got nothing to say, and don't wanna talk...
5000534.c21_f4: If I speak, you'll say I'm too noisy, won't you?

5000537.c6_f2: Keep scolding and I'll go away!
5000537.c6_f3: What do you want me to do? I didn't do anything.
5000537.c6_f4: Why are you getting angry at me?

5000537.c7_s2: I'm sorry. I take it all back.
5000537.c8_s1: It wasn't such a big deal...
5000537.c8_s2: Are you trying to play hard to get with me?

5000537.c11_s3: I feel like the happiest creature on earth!

5000537.c12_f2: How many pets have you had before me?
5000537.c12_f4: I can be gone in an instant!

5000537.c14_s3: I'm givin' it all I've got!
5000537.c14_f2: I'm going to use the toilet!
5000537.c14_f4: I don't need to go. Like, at all.
5000537.c15_s4: Oh, I feel so much better! Are you going to poop, too?
5000537.c15_f1: I can't just poop all day, you know?
5000537.c15_f3: I'm trying, but there's nothing to poo.
5000537.c15_f4: No! I'm going to hold it in!
5000537.c16_s2: I was getting a little frazzled...
5000537.c16_f1: Look, the sun is still up!
5000537.c16_f4: Why don't we go hunting instead?

5000537.f1_s: I don't know why but I feel energetic!
5000537.f1_f: I am about to blow up... squerch.

5000546.c2_s4: Sure, I was tired at any rate.
5000546.c2_f3: I'm not in the mood to rest quite yet.

5000546.c6_f4: Civil Disobedience is every Skunk's right!

5000546.c8_s1: This is an activity I'll gladly do.
5000546.c8_s3: Only thing I need now is a snack...
5000546.c8_f1: Let me know when we hit the beach, and I'll think about it.

5000546.c9_s3: Nothing like good company and a good snack!

5000546.c10_f3: I need food before I need to relive myself.
5000546.c10_f4: Skunks only have gas. You know this.

5000546.c13_s2: Apparently, you never seem to get wet after swimming in Aqua Road.
5000546.c13_s3: Fun Fact: I'm an omnivore, not a vegetarian.
5000546.c13_s4: I prefer to be alone, but I've grown rather fond of you...
5000546.c13_f3: There are no words I have to express my disdain at your previous request.
5000546.c14_s1: The true measure of a Mapler can be found not when they're at their best, but at their worst.
5000546.c14_s2: Fun Fact: Skunks actually enjoy walks on the beach.
5000546.c14_s3: I have to wonder, what exactly is in that special sauce?
5000546.c14_s4: Often times, I ask myself, what exactly is in the special sauce?
5000546.c14_f1: Next thing, you'll be asking me to play fetch!
5000546.c14_f3: Yes, I can talk. Get over it.
5000546.c15_s1: Sometimes, just sometimes, I smile at you.
5000546.c15_s2: I only spray my enemies as a last resort.

5000546.c15_s4: Friends don't let Friends say "Mesos plox".

5000546.c15_f3: I got nothing for you. Nothing!

5000546.c17_f3: No, you just think you do.
5000546.c18_s1: My heart beats a tiny bit faster whenever you're near.
5000546.c18_s2: I only wish I could better show the depths of my affection for you.
5000546.c18_f2: I'm just not ready for that kind of commitment yet.
5000546.c18_f3: You just love me for my tail.

5000546.c20_s4: Hugging is a talent, and you definitely got it!
5000546.c20_f3: No food, no hug. Simple concept.

5000546.c21_f4: That's just not what I'm looking for right now.

5000546.c23_f4: The fault lies not just with me, but with you as well.
5000546.c24_s3: I can find it, just bear with me!

5000546.c25_f4: It's not easy being me, you could be nicer!
5000546.c26_s1: Stop. It's not what you think it is.
5000546.c26_f3: What, may I ask, did you expect?
5000546.c26_f4: You should try smelling yours one day.
5000546.c27_f1: You know, your breath isn't exactly 'sweet-smelling' either.
5000546.c27_f2: I ate snail burgers. Sue me.
5000546.c27_f4: I do not have bad breath!
5000546.c28_s2: Ready for a night on the town?
5000546.c28_s4: Don't hate me. Hate the outfit.
5000546.c28_f1: Long night last night, so I need rest.
5000546.c29_s4: Uh, that other Skunk did it.
5000546.c29_f1: Would you rather have it out here or indoors.
5000546.c29_f2: And what? Yours smells like roses and chocolate?
5000546.c29_f3: Contrary to popular belief, yours stink too.
5000546.c30_s4: Why don't you nap with me?
5000546.c30_f4: I can go all day and all night!
5000546.c31_s3: I'm going to get some zzzz.
5000546.c31_f2: Got to keep an eye out for monsters...
5000546.c31_f3: The ground is too hard here.
5000546.c31_f4: It's a bit cold here for me.
5000546.c32_s1: I guess this is as good a spot as any...
5000546.c33_s3: I'm the best. You know this.
5000546.c34_s1: When the going gets tough, the tough call a skunk!
5000546.c34_f2: Boldness isn't always a strong suit.
5000546.c34_f3: Stop trying to kiss my tail.
5000546.c34_f4: So, what are you really after?
5000546.c35_s1: Hold on, getting some dirt off my shoulder.
5000546.c35_s2: Remember, you're dealing with the best.
5000546.c35_f1: Flattery is often seen as a ploy of those with nothing else to offer.
5000546.c35_f2: There's a point where flattery begins to sound hollow.
5000546.c35_f3: I don't know what you're after, but you won't get it from me.
5000546.f3_f: A meal fit for a ruffian. Take it away!
5000546.s2: Kyuu... I am not gonna say that.
5000546.s3: I am not the kind of Rabbit who speaks of evil words,~

5000547.c1_s2: The ground is nice and warm here.
5000547.c2_f1: Trying to lure me into a trap? I don't think so.
5000547.c2_f2: No pillow, so I can't sit.
5000547.c3_s1: You picked the perfect time to relax, Master!
5000547.c3_s3: Time to chill. Got any Mapleade?
5000547.c3_s4: All I need now is a snack...
5000547.c3_f1: Look a bit closer, you'll see why I'm not sitting.
5000547.c3_f2: Did you see the sign? "Porcupines forbidden to sit".
5000547.c3_f3: If only I had a chair...
5000547.c4_f1: Somehow, I will blame you for this.
5000547.c4_f2: Quit looking at me like that.
5000547.c4_f3: Nonsense-you told me to do it!
5000547.c5_f4: No way is this my fault, no way!
5000547.c6_s3: Don't be mad with me, Master!
5000547.c6_f2: Blaming me again? I refuse to cover for you this time!
5000547.c6_f4: Wait, I have something for you...the world's smallest violin.
5000547.c7_s1: When in a fit, just knit!
5000547.c8_s1: I'll finish the socks I was making for you!
5000547.c8_s3: I just got the best cloth...
5000547.c8_f4: You threw away the last thing I made...
5000547.c9_s1: I got a new design to show you!
5000547.c9_s2: Time to make my Master a new pair of undies!
5000547.c9_s4: Maybe I'll make you a pair of pants...
5000547.c9_f1: How about a sock...in the mouth?
5000547.c9_f2: If the knit don't fit, it's time to quit!
5000547.c10_f3: What do you think I am, an animal?
5000547.c11_s3: I hope someone steps in it!
5000547.c11_f1: There's some on your shoe if you're looking for it.
5000547.c11_f3: You want me to stink up the joint? No!
5000547.c12_s1: Nothing compares to the feeling of a great dump. Nothing!
5000547.c12_s3: Let me show you how to make a "prickly bush".
5000547.c12_s4: This is as good a spot as any...
5000547.c12_f2: Fresh out. Try back later-like after dinner.
5000547.c12_f4: I could end battles with this gas...
5000547.c13_s1: When the going gets tough, the tough get going!
5000547.c13_s2: Do not ever mistake me for a hedgehog.
5000547.c13_s3: The Mapler next to me is almost broke.
5000547.c13_s4: Doesn't that guy owe you money?
5000547.c13_f3: I charge 5000 mesos per word. Pay up.
5000547.c14_s1: No time like the present! Let's go!
5000547.c14_s3: I could get used to this...
5000547.c14_s4: You never know what's around the corner-be prepared!
5000547.c14_f3: I'll talk when golden pigs fly.
5000547.c15_s2: My spikes are sharp-if you lean close, I can give you a shave.
5000547.c15_s3: I love it when you level!
5000547.c15_f1: When the going gets tough, I've seen you run away. Fast.
5000547.c15_f2: You don't need a breath mint, you just need to get socked in the face with a mint glove.
5000547.c15_f3: Say something? How about "I'm not talking right now?"
5000547.c15_f4: Put your mesos where your mouth is!
5000547.c16_f2: There is no spark in our relationship.
5000547.c16_f4: Amusing. Do you do tricks, too?
5000547.c17_f3: I can see it in your eyes...it's not true!
5000547.c18_s1: I've waited so long to hear you say that!
5000547.c18_s2: Your love keeps me going, Master!
5000547.c18_s3: I love you just as much!
5000547.c18_f1: I can feel a spark-no, wait. Something was in my foot...
5000547.c18_f2: How funny! HAHAH-wait, you were serious?
5000547.c20_s2: I've got a lotta love to spread around!
5000547.c21_f1: Let's not and say we did.
5000547.c21_f2: I feel a bit uncomfortable now...
5000547.c23_f1: I should throw one at you...
5000547.c24_s3: I've got all the pins you need!
5000547.c24_f4: Why do you hurt me so?
5000547.c25_f2: I got plenty of sleep last night.
5000547.c26_f4: The ground is cold and hard, I'm not sleeping here!
5000547.c27_s3: *YAWN* I think I'm ready for bed.
5000547.c27_f1: So now you notice I'm tired?
5000547.c27_f2: No way, you're going to try something.
5000547.c27_f3: Yea, right, sleep. I don't need any.
5000547.c29_s1: I knew I could do it!
5000547.c29_f1: Your orders aren't exactly clear you know...
5000547.c29_f2: You talk, I ignore you-it's a great combo!
5000547.c29_f3: Who's the brains behind this operation again?
5000547.c29_f4: I guarantee this is your fault.
5000547.c30_s4: I'm a stickler for perfection. HA!
5000547.c30_f3: Porcupines do not speak that language.
5000547.c31_s2: Tell me how good I look...
5000547.c31_f2: What do I look like? A store?
5000547.c31_f3: You need more than a comb.
5000547.c31_f4: It's mine, and you can't have it.
5000547.c32_s2: Got a camera? I'm going to strike a pose.
5000547.c32_s3: I love being one of the beautiful people!
5000547.c32_f4: You can't have mine, get your own.
5000547.c33_f2: I need coconut milk before I do anything.
5000547.c33_f3: Have you fed your porcupine today?
5000547.c34_s4: I love to play with this ball!
5000547.c35_f1: Ninja do not reveal themselves in the day time.
5000547.c35_f2: What make you think I can do that?
5000547.c35_f4: Try again. This time with FEELING!
5000547.c36_f3: And I would do this because...
5000547.f1_f: Um, did you run over that?
5000547.f4_f: But I'm not hungry..I don't want to eat!! Waahhh!!

5000548.c2_f2: Give me one good reason why!
5000548.c3_s2: Perfect timing! I was getting a little tired.
5000548.c6_s4: I didn't mean to make you mad!
5000548.c7_s1: I was wrong! I was wrong!
5000548.c7_s2: I'll be more careful from now on!
5000548.c8_s2: Are you going to leave me?!
5000548.c8_f4: If I'm misbehaving, it's your fault.
5000548.c9_s1: Is it is because I'm cute?
5000548.c10_f3: But I'm stuck in a robot dog body!
5000548.c11_s2: You've made me the happiest Roo-bot alive!
5000548.c11_s4: I love you, too! I do! I do!
5000548.c11_f3: I don't think you mean it.
5000548.c12_s1: You're my reason for living, master!
5000548.c12_s4: Being with you makes life worthwhile!
5000548.c12_f2: I wish I felt the same way...
5000548.c12_f4: I'd like to be alone, please.
5000548.c13_f3: Do you even have a pooper scrooper?
5000548.c14_f2: I don't need to go right now!
5000548.c14_f4: I don't want to cause pollution!
5000548.c15_s2: How about a snack while I poop?
5000548.c15_s3: Master! Master! I want you to watch!
5000548.c15_f2: Why do you always want me to poop?
5000548.c15_f3: Sleep, sit, poop. That's all I ever get to do.
5000548.c16_f2: I want to play with you!
5000548.c17_s2: Am I cute while I sleep?
5000548.c17_f4: You always make me sleep! Hmph!
5000548.c18_s2: I'm cute when I sleep, huh?
5000548.c18_f4: Buy me a cozy bed first!
5000548.c19_s1: There were lots and lots of other Roo-bots back in the lab.
5000548.c19_s2: Gelimer wasn't mean, but he wasn't nice, either. I like you better!
5000548.c19_s3: Tell me I'm cute! Tell me you'll take care of me!
5000548.c19_s4: I was human once, but this robot body is cuter!
5000548.c20_s1: I miss the other Roo-bots from the lab. I hope they're okay.
5000548.c20_s2: Before Gelimer made me a Roo-bot, I think I lived by the sea.
5000548.c20_s3: Whoa! The world is full of monsters!
5000548.c20_s4: Do you think anybody would miss me if I disappeared?
5000548.c20_f1: What makes you think I have anything worth saying?
5000548.c20_f4: Let me just think of something to say...
5000548.c21_s1: You'll use the Water of Life on me if anything happens, right?
5000548.c21_s2: Sometimes, I think I kind of miss Gelimer... How weird!
5000548.c21_s4: Wanna know a secret? You're my favorite!
5000548.c21_f1: I'm not REALLY a dog, you know. I don't talk on command.
5000548.c21_f3: *Pretends not to hear, because it's funny! Hehe!*
5000548.f1_f: You plan to fatten me up so you can eat me, huh?
5000548.f3_s: I can do anything on a full tummy!
5000548.s1: You want me to say what?!

5000549.c2_s1: Okay, but you have to keep me safe.
5000549.c2_s2: Be on lookout behind me, just in case.
5000549.c2_s3: I guess I could take a break.
5000549.c2_s4: Do you have anything to eat while I sit here?
5000549.c2_f1: I'd rather stand, so I can run if a monster appears.
5000549.c2_f2: What if the ground hurts me?
5000549.c3_s3: I'm counting on you to keep the ground from attacking me!
5000549.c3_s4: My tail keeps me warm and cozy.
5000549.c3_f1: I need to lie down, not sit.
5000549.c3_f2: You just want to hurt me!
5000549.c3_f3: Why?! What're you going to do to me?
5000549.c4_s2: Will you be nice to me if I sit?
5000549.c4_s4: I'm awfully tired from being on high alert all the time.
5000549.c4_f2: Are you trying to hurt me?
5000549.c5_s2: It was my fault! Please stop hitting me!
5000549.c6_s4: I'll be better! Don't hurt me!
5000549.c6_f4: Why are you treating me this way?
5000549.c7_s2: I thought you cared about me!
5000549.c7_f3: I'm going to tell on you!
5000549.c8_f1: You're so mean! I miss Gelimer!
5000549.c8_f4: There's got to be someone I can call!
5000549.c10_s2: I think... I think that makes me happy!
5000549.c11_f4: I know you d-don't mean it.
5000549.c12_s1: I'm so glad I met you!
5000549.c12_s2: I love you so, so, so much!
5000549.c13_s4: I could do this all day.
5000549.c14_s1: I've been holding that in for a long time.
5000549.c14_s2: Promise that it won't hurt me!
5000549.c14_f2: What if it bites me on the way out?!
5000549.c14_f4: I only do that once a day...
5000549.c16_s2: Keep me safe while I rest.
5000549.c16_f1: What if I have bad dreams?
5000549.c17_s1: My tail will keep me safe. Right?
5000549.c17_s2: Don't leave me alone while I sleep, okay?
5000549.c17_s4: Put your hand on my back while I sleep so I know you're near.
5000549.c17_f2: You go first. I'll do it after...
5000549.c17_f3: What if something sneaks up on me?
5000549.c17_f4: No! Don't ask me to do that!
5000549.c18_s1: Stay with me while I sleep, okay?
5000549.c18_s2: One Red Snail... two Red Snails...
5000549.c18_s4: Can you make me a comfy quilt next time?
5000549.c18_f2: There are monsters in the closet!
5000549.c18_f4: But I'm not sleepy! I'm not!
5000549.c19_s1: That mean scientist performed all sorts of experiments on me. *cry*
5000549.c19_s2: I hate thinking about the past. I hate it!
5000549.c19_s3: The outside world is scary, but the lab was even worse.
5000549.c19_s4: I hate science! I hate it so much!
5000549.c19_f2: You won't get anything out of me!
5000549.c19_f3: I won't tell you! I won't!
5000549.c20_s1: I think I was brave before Gelimer came along.
5000549.c20_s2: I wish I weren't so timid, but everything scares me. Except you.
5000549.c20_s3: I'm so worried that one day I'll turn into a doll.
5000549.c20_s4: Sometimes I wish I could fly, but it's too scary.
5000549.c20_f1: Are you going to hurt me?
5000549.c20_f2: I don't like to talk about my past.
5000549.c21_s1: I've always wanted to taste the Water of Life, but I'm too scared.
5000549.c21_s2: Sometimes I think I should wear a disguise so no one can find me.
5000549.c21_s3: It's not safe to have friends. You're the only one I trust.
5000549.c21_s4: If it weren't for you, master, I think I'd be completely alone.
5000549.c21_f1: Are you going to hurt me?
5000549.c21_f3: Go away! I don't want to talk!
5000549.c21_f4: Aah! I thought I heard Gelimer's voice!
5000549.s3: I won't say anything bad, I won't!

5000550.c2_s1: I sat. Now where's my reward?
5000550.c2_f3: Why should I listen to you?
5000550.c3_s2: Ahh, I love how soft my tail is.
5000550.c3_s4: I suppose I could rest my feet for a minute.
5000550.c3_f2: I don't like it here. Let's jet.
5000550.c3_f4: It's dirty here. Let me sit in your lap.
5000550.c4_s1: There's a nice spot next to me with your name on it.
5000550.c4_f1: Do you expect me to do everything you say?
5000550.c4_f2: Come on! Let's do something else!
5000550.c4_f4: I am in no mood to sit.
5000550.c6_s1: Fine. Punish me. I LIKE it.
5000550.c6_s4: I guess I might've deserved that...
5000550.c6_f1: It's not like I meant to do anything wrong.
5000550.c7_s1: I'm sorry. You'll forgive me, right?
5000550.c7_s4: My bad, my bad. Get over it.
5000550.c7_f1: Why are you taking your repressed emotions out on me?
5000550.c7_f2: What're you gonna do, throw me in a rubbish bin?
5000550.c7_f3: I thought you were better than that.
5000550.c8_s2: I admit it, I messed up.
5000550.c8_f3: I might behave better if you FED ME MORE.
5000550.c9_f2: You must want something from me...
5000550.c10_s1: I suppose I can buy that.
5000550.c10_f2: We haven't reached that stage in our relationship.
5000550.c10_f4: You did NOT just say that.
5000550.c11_s1: I kinda liked hearing you say that.
5000550.c11_s3: Say that again while scratching my ears.
5000550.c11_f1: You're cute. Not in a good way.
5000550.c11_f2: Don't say stuff like that before I eat!
5000550.c12_s2: Gotta admit, my favorite time of day is when I'm with you.
5000550.c12_s3: Glad you recognize quality when you see it.
5000550.c12_f4: Is this really the right time for that?
5000550.c13_s3: Pick it up, buddy of mine!
5000550.c13_s4: No peeking! Well, a little bit is okay.
5000550.c13_f1: I thought you were more dignified than that.
5000550.c13_f2: I don't need you to tell me when to poop.
5000550.c13_f3: You don't even have a bag to pick it up!
5000550.c14_s1: Consider that a favor. Now you owe me.
5000550.c14_s3: I want you to breathe it in. Savor it.
5000550.c14_f2: Would you like it if I told YOU when to poop?
5000550.c14_f3: Maybe if you fed me more...
5000550.c14_f4: I'm holding it in, out of spite.
5000550.c15_f2: Feed me and I'll think about it.
5000550.c15_f3: The ground is covered with ants!
5000550.c15_f4: I'm embarrassed to be seen with you.
5000550.c16_s4: I'm pretty sleepy... How'd you know?
5000550.c16_f2: Do I look sleepy to you?
5000550.c16_f3: Maybe if I had a full tummy...
5000550.c16_f4: I'm fine as I am, thank you.
5000550.c17_s1: How'd you know I was tired?
5000550.c17_s2: I suppose I could close my eyes...
5000550.c17_s3: My tail is the perfect blanket.
5000550.c18_s1: Let's see how long I can stay... *snore*
5000550.c18_s3: There's space next to me if you wanna cuddle. Just saying.
5000550.c18_s4: Don't sit on me while I sleep!
5000550.c18_f1: Despite these dark circles under my eyes, I am NOT sleepy. *yawn*
5000550.c18_f2: We have too much to do!
5000550.c18_f4: Can't sleep. Miss my mom too... Nevermind.
5000550.c19_s1: If I ever see Gelimer again, I'll show him what for!
5000550.c19_s2: You have no idea who I really am. Noooo idea.
5000550.c19_s3: My favorite time of day is mealtime!
5000550.c19_s4: I've always dreamed of riding an airship...
5000550.c19_f3: Shoo, go over there and play.
5000550.c20_s1: Gelimer thinks he wiped out my memories, but I remember my mother.
5000550.c20_s2: I miss my life before I was a Roo-bot. Not that I don't enjoy being with you...
5000550.c20_s3: People think they can walk all over me because I'm in a dog's body.
5000550.c20_s4: I won't let anyone stop me from doing what I want to do!
5000550.c20_f2: Isn't there anyone else you can talk to?
5000550.c20_f3: I've got nothing to say right now.
5000550.c21_s1: Strangers always touch my tail without asking. I should do it back.
5000550.c21_s2: I know I come off kinda mean, but I really just want a friend...
5000550.c21_s3: My mother had the kindest eyes. And she used to sing me to sleep.
5000550.c21_s4: My most secret dream is to find my mother again, but that's impossible.
5000550.f3_f: What crazy scheme are you up to?
5000550.s1: You want me to say what?
5000550.s2: Are you trying to get me in trouble?
5000550.s3: Come on, we're better than that!

5000551.c2_s2: Are you testing me? Now I'm scared to move.
5000551.c2_s3: Happy now? Can we go now?
5000551.c2_s4: La di da... Doo doo doop...
5000551.c2_f2: Don't you care about saving the world?
5000551.c2_f3: I'll just pretend I didn't hear that.
5000551.c3_s1: La di da... Doo doo doop...
5000551.c4_s1: La di da... Doo doo doop...
5000551.c6_s1: Okay, fine. It was MY fault, okay?!
5000551.c6_f3: It was YOUR fault. You made me do it!
5000551.c7_s2: Okay, fine. It was MY fault, okay?!
5000551.c7_s4: Do you have it in you to forgive me?
5000551.c7_f1: I'll make you regret saying that.
5000551.c7_f2: Don't say it unless you mean it!
5000551.c7_f3: How can you say that to me?!
5000551.c8_s1: I'm sorry, so now  you can't be mad anymore.
5000551.c8_s2: I won't ever do that again. Promise!
5000551.c8_f3: All words have consequences. Just wait and see.
5000551.c8_f4: When you're least expecting it, I'll get you back...
5000551.c10_s4: I'm not unhappy you said that.
5000551.c11_s1: You're kind of sweet, I suppose.
5000551.c11_s3: I'm not quite ready to say it back, but thanks.
5000551.c12_s1: I... Well, shucks, I love you, too.
5000551.c12_f3: At least buy me dinner first.
5000551.c12_f4: I'll just pretend I didn't hear that.
5000551.c13_s3: Please tell me no one's watching.
5000551.c13_f3: I'm not that kind of dragon.
5000551.c13_f4: Don't ask that of me. Please!
5000551.c14_s1: You just don't let up. Oh, very well.
5000551.c14_s2: Why are you doing this to me?
5000551.c14_s3: It makes me uncomfortable that you're watching.
5000551.c14_s4: This... This actually feels kind of good.
5000551.c14_f3: I, uh, I have a headache.
5000551.c15_s1: I'm actually really getting into this.
5000551.c15_s2: You're watching, right? It's not the same if you don't watch.
5000551.c15_f1: Don't MY feelings matter to you?
5000551.c15_f2: Why are you doing this to me?
5000551.c15_f3: Please. I just want to disappear.
5000551.c16_s1: Leave the lights on! I'm scared of the dark.
5000551.c16_f2: I'm fine as I am, thanks very much.
5000551.c16_f3: You go on and mind your own business.
5000551.c16_f4: You may go to bed first, if you wish.
5000551.c17_s2: If you weren't so much bigger than me, I wouldn't have to listen to you.
5000551.c17_f1: I refuse to go to sleep yet!
5000551.c17_f2: Just because you're tired doesn't mean I am.
5000551.c17_f4: You can be a real pest.
5000551.c18_s3: You'll keep the boogieman away, right?
5000551.c18_f1: You're going to have to say that again, and slower.
5000551.c18_f4: But what if the nightmares return? Sniffle.
5000551.c19_s1: I come from a line of prestigious dragons, you know.
5000551.c19_s2: My daddy could change colors. He could even turn invisible!
5000551.c19_s3: My daddy could beat up all the other dragon's daddies.
5000551.c19_s4: My daddy's roar would make you go deaf.
5000551.c19_f2: I'd like to see you try to make me.
5000551.c19_f3: You can be a real pest.
5000551.c20_s1: Someday, I'll rule over ALL the dragons.
5000551.c20_s3: What about YOUR heritage? Are you anyone special?

5000554.c3_f4: I've gotten too chubby. I need exercise!
5000554.c4_s1: Together, we can do anything. Even sit!
5000554.c4_s2: I'm in a good mood, so okay.
5000554.c4_s4: Your wish is my puffy command! Heehee!
5000554.c4_f2: You can sit. I'm going without you.
5000554.c4_f4: You just want to step on me.
5000554.c5_f2: It's because you're a poor role model.
5000554.c6_s1: What did I do? I'm sorry!
5000554.c6_s2: You're going to make me cry big, creamy tears!
5000554.c6_f3: I don't like you right now!
5000554.c6_f4: You're projecting your insecurities on to me, aren't you?
5000554.c7_s1: I'm so sorry I disappointed you!
5000554.c7_f2: Don't say that unless you mean it!
5000554.c8_s3: You have to forgive me because I love you.
5000554.c8_s4: But the creampuff fairy told me to do it!
5000554.c8_f1: Too busy eating to listen, la la.
5000554.c8_f2: I hate being in trouble. Hmph.
5000554.c10_s4: I feel all warm, like back in the oven!
5000554.c10_f1: Do you love me or do you love to eat me?
5000554.c10_f2: It's hard to hear you without ears.
5000554.c10_f4: Oh, just kiss my puffy butt.
5000554.c11_s1: You're as sweet as my filling!
5000554.c11_s2: My creamy filling IS pretty great.
5000554.c11_s3: If you love me, then squeeze me!
5000554.c11_f1: I WON'T LET YOU EAT ME!
5000554.c11_f2: I know what you're planning to do to me when my guard is down...
5000554.c12_s1: I love you so much, I'd even let you take a nibble!
5000554.c12_s2: You make me the happiest creampuff alive!
5000554.c12_s3: I feel all warm and gooey inside. Oh, wait. Hehe.
5000554.c12_f1: This is a trick, isn't it?
5000554.c12_f3: We're not even the same food group!
5000554.c12_f4: I know you secretly want to om nom me.
5000554.c13_s2: I love to flush! Flush! Flushhhh!
5000554.c13_s4: Thanks for buying me this mini toilet. Love it!
5000554.c13_f2: That's a faux pas in creampuff society.
5000554.c14_s1: Little cream poops, la la la!
5000554.c14_s2: Ooh, I think I saw a piece of fruit in that one!
5000554.c14_s3: I hope you brought a napkin to wipe me with!
5000554.c14_s4: My poop smells like fruit. Mmmmm!
5000554.c14_f3: But I just went last week.
5000554.c14_f4: The chef who made me would be so ashamed!
5000554.c15_s1: Go on and squeeze it all out of me!
5000554.c15_f1: Why didn't you buy me a stall with this toilet?!
5000554.c15_f4: But then I won't have any filling left inside!
5000554.c16_s2: You should get some rest, too.
5000554.c16_s4: Don't forget me while I'm sleeping!
5000554.c16_f2: It's not time for nite nite yet!
5000554.c17_s1: I'm going to dream of swimming in a pool of coffee.
5000554.c17_f2: I smell to good to sleep.
5000554.c17_f4: I can set my own schedule, thanks very much.
5000554.c18_s2: Whew, I could use a rest.
5000554.c18_s3: Can I sleep in the palm of your hand?
5000554.c19_s1: I was the smallest creampuff in my entire batch!
5000554.c19_s2: Sometimes, I wish I were made of a different fruit. Like, cherries!
5000554.c19_s3: I have nightmares where a giggling girl tears me apart, limb by limb. Then eats me.
5000554.c19_s4: As my BFF, it's your job to make sure I don't get eaten!
5000554.c19_f1: What do you want from me? My brain's made of cream!
5000554.c19_f3: Creampuffs are for eating, not talking. Wait...
5000554.c19_f4: I have a lot on my mind lately. Get it?
5000554.c20_s1: A creampuff without cream might as well be dead.
5000554.c20_s2: Someday, I'm going to have three creampuff babies: plain, chocolate, and green tea!
5000554.c20_s3: At first, my baker made me without legs, but I begged and begged, and now look how cute I am!
5000554.c20_s4: What's the oddest creampuff flavor you can think of? Coconut? Pineapple? Anchovies?
5000554.c20_f2: What makes you think a creampuff can talk?
5000554.c20_f3: I hate small talk! I like big talk! Hehehe!
5000554.c21_s1: I support creampuff rights. We all deserve the right to not be eaten.
5000554.c21_s2: I don't mind if you eat other creampuffs, as long as you don't eat ME.
5000554.c21_s3: Sometimes I wish I were banana flavored. Bananas have all the fun.
5000554.c21_s4: I want to be the first creampuff to travel to the moon.
5000554.c21_f1: Gee, YOU try chatting on demand.
5000554.c21_f2: Shhh! I'm watching a creampuff soap opera!
5000554.c21_f4: Are you making fun of the way I talk?
5000554.f3_f: Are you trying to poison me?!
5000554.f4_s: Ooooh, this is yummier than I am!
5000554.f4_f: My little tummy is going to explode!
5000554.s1: I'm too pure for words like that!
5000554.s3: A cute creampuff likes cute words!

5000556.c12_f4: I know you secretly want to om nom me.
5000556.c13_s2: I love to flush! Flush! Flushhhh!
5000556.c13_s4: Thanks for buying me this mini toilet. Love it!
5000556.c13_f2: That's a faux pas in creampuff society.
5000556.c14_s1: Little cream poops, la la la!
5000556.c14_s2: Ooh, I think I saw a piece of fruit in that one!
5000556.c14_s3: I hope you brought a napkin to wipe me with!
5000556.c14_s4: My poop smells like fruit. Mmmmm!
5000556.c14_f3: But I just went last week.
5000556.c14_f4: The chef who made me would be so ashamed!
5000556.c15_s1: Go on and squeeze it all out of me!
5000556.c15_f1: Why didn't you buy me a stall with this toilet?!
5000556.c15_f4: But then I won't have any filling left inside!
5000556.c16_s2: You should get some rest, too.
5000556.c16_s4: Don't forget me while I'm sleeping!
5000556.c16_f2: It's not time for nite nite yet!
5000556.c17_s1: I'm going to dream of swimming in a pool of coffee.
5000556.c17_f2: I smell to good to sleep.
5000556.c17_f4: I can set my own schedule, thanks very much.
5000556.c18_s2: Whew, I could use a rest.
5000556.c18_s3: Can I sleep in the palm of your hand?
5000556.c19_s1: I was the smallest creampuff in my entire batch!
5000556.c19_s2: Sometimes, I wish I were made of a different fruit. Like, cherries!
5000556.c19_s3: I have nightmares where a giggling girl tears me apart, limb by limb. Then eats me.
5000556.c19_s4: As my BFF, it's your job to make sure I don't get eaten!
5000556.c19_f1: What do you want from me? My brain's made of cream!
5000556.c19_f3: Creampuffs are for eating, not talking. Wait...
5000556.c20_s1: A creampuff without cream might as well be dead.
5000556.c20_s2: Someday, I'm going to have three creampuff babies: plain, chocolate, and green tea!
5000556.c20_s3: At first, my baker made me without legs, but I begged and begged, and now look how cute I am!
5000556.c20_s4: What's the oddest creampuff flavor you can think of? Coconut? Pineapple? Anchovies?
5000556.c20_f2: What makes you think a creampuff can talk?
5000556.c20_f3: I hate small talk! I like big talk! Hehehe!
5000556.c21_s1: I support creampuff rights. We all deserve the right to not be eaten.
5000556.c21_s2: I don't mind if you eat other creampuffs, as long as you don't eat ME.
5000556.c21_s3: Sometimes I wish I were banana flavored. Bananas have all the fun.
5000556.c21_s4: I want to be the first creampuff to travel to the moon.
5000556.c21_f1: Gee, YOU try chatting on demand.
5000556.c21_f2: Shhh! I'm watching a creampuff soap opera!
5000556.c21_f4: Are you making fun of the way I talk?
5000556.f3_f: Are you trying to poison me?!
5000556.f4_s: Ooooh, this is yummier than I am!
5000556.f4_f: My little tummy is going to explode!
5000556.s1: I'm too pure for words like that!
5000556.s3: A cute creampuff likes cute words!

5000557.c2_s1: I sat like you told me to!
5000557.c2_s4: I am sitting, as you see.
5000557.c2_f2: Can't I just stay like this?
5000557.c2_f3: You go ahead and just stay put.
5000557.c2_f4: I want to walk a bit more.
5000557.c3_s1: I like things nice and easy.
5000557.c3_s2: Why don't we sit together, master?
5000557.c3_f1: Stand, sit, it's all the same...
5000557.c3_f3: I don't like the sound of that!
5000557.c4_s2: I like your big, cushiony leg for that.
5000557.c4_f1: I can't. Why? I don't know...
5000557.c4_f2: This is boring. Let's try something challenging!
5000557.c4_f4: Sometimes I wanna change things up.
5000557.c6_f3: I am so nice... You've hurt me.
5000557.c7_s2: I... I... I just can't go on!
5000557.c7_s3: I just did that to get your attention.
5000557.c8_s1: Hearing that makes me so sad.
5000557.c8_s2: I'm sorry! I won't do it again.
5000557.c8_s3: I'm just trying to please you, master.
5000557.c8_f2: How can you get so mad?
5000557.c9_s2: You're the only one for me!
5000557.c11_s2: So sweet, I don't even know!
5000557.c11_s3: I love you! I love you!
5000557.c11_f2: La la la... I don't care!
5000557.c12_f1: That's nice... But you smell funny.
5000557.c15_s1: You tell me to go... I will go...
5000557.c15_f2: I don't know what poop is.
5000557.c16_f2: Are you sleepy? I'm not sleepy.
5000557.c16_f4: I don't think it's time to sleep yet.
5000557.c17_f1: Let's go play instead! Play, play!
5000557.c17_f4: At least sing me a lullaby!
5000557.c18_s1: I want to sleep on your lap...
5000557.c18_s2: Come lay down next to me.
5000557.c18_s4: I wanted to play some more, but okay.
5000557.c18_f2: I want to play with you!
5000557.c19_s1: Nothing beats good food and a cuddle.
5000557.c19_s2: The grass fields of Henesys are so nice.
5000557.c19_s4: What do you like about me the most?
5000557.c19_f4: Why is the sky so blue, then?
5000557.c20_s1: We all speak different languages, you know.
5000557.c20_s2: I want to go on a journey with you, master!
5000557.c20_s3: Master, you talking with other pets makes me jealous!
5000557.c20_s4: Give me all your potions and you can hunt more easily!
5000557.c20_f1: Are you bored? Let's go get facials!
5000557.c20_f2: Let's play a game... It's called the quiet game...
5000557.c20_f4: What do I need to say?
5000557.c21_s1: You're the best in the world! Right?
5000557.c21_s2: I love spending time with you.
5000557.c21_f2: I don't know what to say!
5000557.c21_f4: I want to be alone once in a while.
5000557.f1_s: This is when I am the happiest!
5000557.f2_f: Do you have a grudge against me?
5000557.f4_s: Come eat with me. It's delicious!
5000557.f4_f: Stop feeding me! I already ate!
