5000561.c2_s4: Do I look pretty sitting down?
5000561.c2_f1: I hate to stay still and do nothing!
5000561.c2_f4: I will sit if you give me a kiss.
5000561.c3_s3: My legs are getting so big!
5000561.c3_f2: Balrog might find us if we stay here.
5000561.c3_f3: Help me sit and we'll talk.
5000561.c3_f4: Let's do something fun. This is boring.
5000561.c4_s1: I could just sit on your head.
5000561.c4_s2: Sitting is easy as eating 100 bananas.
5000561.c4_s3: I feel fat when I sit down.
5000561.c4_s4: You should come over here. Next to me.
5000561.c6_f3: Hey, jerk. Why ask me to do things I hate?
5000561.c6_f4: What is rest? Is it something like eating?
5000561.c7_s3: I'm gonna rest. Maybe take a nap.
5000561.c7_s4: You let me rest. You are the best.
5000561.c7_f1: I can't understand what you're saying!
5000561.c7_f2: I am restless! I wanna play!
5000561.c7_f4: I'm going to work out... I have a big belly, you know.
5000561.c8_s1: You really know me too well.
5000561.c8_s2: A good monkey knows when to work and play.
5000561.c8_s4: You wanted to stay with me too, right?
5000561.c8_f1: Don't stop. You need to lose weight.
5000561.c8_f2: I guess you don't want to play with me.
5000561.c8_f3: No I don't want to do it. I am a rebellious monkey!
5000561.c10_s4: You're not the nice master I knew... Ook...
5000561.c10_f2: I'm going to scold you too! Ook!!
5000561.c10_f4: Don't you know how I feel? Ook!
5000561.c11_s1: Did I do something wrong? Ook!
5000561.c11_s2: I don't want to write an apology! Ook!
5000561.c11_s3: Ook! You don't like me anymore or something?
5000561.c11_s4: Ook! Don't hate me! It's sad...
5000561.c11_f2: Ook! Why are you mad all of a sudden!
5000561.c11_f3: Ook! I'm going to be mad with you! Hmph!
5000561.c11_f4: If you keep scolding me, I'm not gonna eat anymore! Ook!
5000561.c12_s2: I've never seen this side of you!
5000561.c12_s3: Your veins are popping out of your forehead!
5000561.c12_f3: Every day, you hurt my feelings...
5000561.c12_f4: I don't want to talk to you anymore...
5000561.c14_s2: My poo is like your face!
5000561.c14_s4: I know I'm cute even when I poop.
5000561.c15_s2: I love the word poo... Poo, poo!
5000561.c15_f1: I JUST pooped a second ago.
5000561.c15_f2: Ooh, that one wasn't so nice!
5000561.c15_f3: How am I supposed to poop here?
5000561.c16_s3: Take a look at my poo! You like?
5000561.c16_s4: I stepped in it! You need to wipe it off.
5000561.c16_f1: I am trying, but nothing is coming out.
5000561.c16_f2: I am sleepy. Poo and sleep?
5000561.c16_f4: If you can't do it, you just can't do it.
5000561.c18_s2: Are you sure? No going back on that!
5000561.c18_f1: You liar! You think I'll fall for that?
5000561.c18_f3: I already have a monkey lover.
5000561.c18_f4: Nope, you can't change my mind.
5000561.c19_s3: I feel like I can fly! I am so happy.
5000561.c19_f4: You always lie! I am hurt.
5000561.c20_s2: We are on the same page!
5000561.c20_s3: Don't tell anyone else that! I'll be so jealous!
5000561.c20_s4: Okay, repeat that 100 times a day for me.
5000561.c20_f1: You said you didn't want to earlier!
5000561.c20_f2: I won't fall for your lies.
5000561.c20_f3: My love for you is gone.
5000561.c20_f4: I can't trust anything you say.
5000561.c22_s2: I am up! Let's go play!
5000561.c22_s3: My legs hurt! Give them a kiss!
5000561.c22_f2: I'm weak. I can't even stand.
5000561.c23_s4: This is so easy, I can do it with my eyes closed.
5000561.c23_f2: I don't want to. Let's do something else. This is boring!
5000561.c24_s1: I can do things like this since my legs are strong.
5000561.c24_s4: Give me your hand. I want to hold it.
5000561.c24_f2: I think I caught a cold! Ahhchoo!
5000561.c24_f4: I refuse to listen to you today.
5000561.c25_s1: My tail is my best part!
5000561.c25_s2: Is there something fun we can do?
5000561.c25_s3: I can take down Horntail on my own.
5000561.c25_f4: You want to talk? Then feed me!
5000561.c26_s1: Pigs eat a lot! Heh, that's why I'm big!
5000561.c26_s2: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000561.c26_s3: I want to play some games!
5000561.c26_f1: Let's just go to bed quickly...Zzzz
5000561.c26_f2: Well, if you say so... I don't wanna!
5000561.c26_f3: So depressing today. Maybe it's because there are no bananas.
5000561.c26_f4: Bleh, I will just run away.
5000561.c27_s1: There's a statue that looks just like me at the Floating Market.
5000561.c27_s2: Your head and my head are the same size!
5000561.c27_s3: You're the best friend in the world! Right?
5000561.c27_s4: Say hello to everyone for me.
5000561.c27_f2: I want to do something exciting!
5000561.c27_f3: Do you like it when I talk? Huh?
5000561.c28_s1: Do you have something fun in mind?
5000561.c28_f2: I want to play with someone else.
5000561.c29_s1: Do you have a fun game to play?
5000561.c29_s2: Hide-and-Seek? I am good at hiding.
5000561.c29_f2: I can't move. I have indigestion.
5000561.c30_s1: Are we going to play together? Sounds fun!
5000561.c30_s3: Let's go play somewhere new today.
5000561.c30_s4: I found something new to play.
5000561.c30_f1: I just ate. Let me digest first.
5000561.c30_f2: We play every day. When do we hunt?
5000561.c30_f4: Give me 5 more minutes of sleep.
5000561.c31_f1: My tongue is too short for that.
5000561.c32_s2: I love sticking my tongue out at you!
5000561.c32_f4: If you make me do it, it's not fun!
5000561.c33_s2: Meh! Meh! Now you try it!
5000561.c33_s3: I'm pretty good at this, right?
5000561.c33_s4: I can do this all day.
5000561.c33_f1: Monkey's don't stick their tongues out.
5000561.c33_f2: I can't make fun of you.
5000561.c34_s4: Zzz... Challenge the Orange Mushroom! ZzZz...
5000561.c34_f3: You're planning to run away while I sleep. Forget it!
5000561.c35_f1: I am not sleepy. I slept a lot.
5000561.c35_f2: I want to play with you.
5000561.c35_f4: Don't draw nothin' on my face while I sleep!
5000561.s3: You are such a bad person!

5000563.c3_s4: Sure... If it makes you happy.
5000563.c4_s1: I guess it's time for me to obey...
5000563.c4_s2: Maybe you should have a rest too Master!
5000563.c4_s4: Can you sing me a song as well?
5000563.c4_f1: Is that the only thing you can ask me to do?
5000563.c4_f4: Have you ever seen a monkey sitting still?
5000563.c6_s1: Can I really take a rest?
5000563.c7_s1: How did you know I wanted to rest?
5000563.c7_s3: I need to take a rest here!
5000563.c7_s4: You are the best master ever!
5000563.c7_f3: It is so dirty here, I can't rest!
5000563.c7_f4: No... I'm getting fat these days....
5000563.c8_f1: I am getting fat because of all this resting!
5000563.c8_f3: Just because you don't want to play with me, huh?
5000563.c10_s1: Don't look at me like that!
5000563.c11_s2: I will be better, really... Kiii...
5000563.c12_s1: Master I won't do it again...
5000563.c12_f1: I'm good, you're bad... Yes that's it!
5000563.c12_f2: Bad! You don't love me anymore!
5000563.c12_f3: I'm the most obedient pet around! AHHH
5000563.c12_f4: Say it again and I'll ignore you.
5000563.c14_s2: Ahh I must have drank too much.
5000563.c14_f1: You expect me to pee in public?
5000563.c15_s2: Ahhh I feel so much better...
5000563.c15_s3: Wow.. what a lot I must have drank!
5000563.c15_s4: Look at that Master... Have you ever seen a monkey pee?
5000563.c15_f1: How can I pee when nothing's coming out?
5000563.c15_f3: I don't feel like it! ARP! ARP!
5000563.c15_f4: It isn't nice for a monkey to pee here...
5000563.c16_s4: Ah that is what I call real Monkey Business!
5000563.c16_f1: How am I supposed to pee when you didn't even feed me?
5000563.c16_f3: Why don't you pee in public too?
5000563.c16_f4: Don't you have anything better to do than asking me to pee the whole day?
5000563.c18_f3: Me ear feels a little itchy here...
5000563.c19_s1: I love you too Master.. kiiii...
5000563.c19_s2: Hmm, Master you're so nice to me!
5000563.c19_s3: I feel nice and warm inside!
5000563.c19_s4: I love you too! Give me a hug!
5000563.c19_f4: You're referring to somebody else, right?
5000563.c20_s1: You're the best Master a monkey can have!
5000563.c20_s2: I love you too! What about going for a hunt together?
5000563.c20_s4: I'm such a lucky monkey to have you as my Master...
5000563.c20_f1: It is bad to tell lies Master, Please don't.
5000563.c20_f2: I love bananas more than I love you!
5000563.c20_f3: Are you sure?  You haven't hugged me for ages!
5000563.c20_f4: I'm sure you love your new weapon more! ARP!
5000563.c23_s4: I can stand! I can stand!
5000563.c23_f2: Huh? My ear feels a liitle itchy here...
5000563.c23_f4: I'll stand if you feed me!
5000563.c24_s1: Have you ever seen a monkey standing so straight?
5000563.c24_s2: Look Master! Aren't I good at this?
5000563.c24_s4: I did it! Master! I'm standing!
5000563.c24_f2: Can't you see I'm already standing?
5000563.c24_f4: I'm tired running after you! I don't want to stand!
5000563.c25_s1: Look master, do you see a banana there?
5000563.c25_s2: I love the way you talk to me.
5000563.c25_s3: I love bananas! Do feed me more of those!
5000563.c25_s4: I love you Master! Do you love me too?
5000563.c25_f2: What do you expect me to say?
5000563.c26_s1: Instead of killing monsters, you can do quests to level up too!
5000563.c26_s2: Monkeys love bananas! I bet you didn't know that.
5000563.c26_s3: I hate people who abuse their pets, don't you?
5000563.c26_s4: If you don't feed me, I'll go back home and not come out!
5000563.c26_f1: It is rude to wake a monkey from its sleep! ARP!

5000614.c15_f2: I'll let you off for today...

5000614.c17_s3: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...

5000614.c17_f3: The ground is so cold and hard...
5000614.c18_f1: I don't want to go to bed...
5000614.c19_s3: I want to tell you about so many things...

5000614.c19_f4: I don't want to talk about it.

5000631.c15_s4: I came, I cawed, I conquered!
5000631.c16_f1: How can I sleep here? Caw.
5000631.c16_f3: I'm not sleepy right now. Caw.
5000631.c16_f4: No! No! No way! Caw caw.Caw caw.caw.
5000631.c17_f1: Why don't YOU get some sleep? Caw caw.
5000631.c17_f2: Caw caw.caw! Woof! I mean caw!
5000631.c17_f3: No! No! No way! Caw caw.Caw caw.caw.
5000631.c17_s4: I hope I dream of shiny things, caw.
5000631.c18_f1: Caw caw.caw! Woof! I mean caw!
5000631.c18_f2: No! No! No way! Caw caw.Caw caw.caw.
5000631.c19_f1: I'll talk if you feed me. Caw.
5000631.c19_f2: What you want me to say? Caw.
5000631.c19_f3: Don't bother me, I'm meditating! Caw.
5000631.c19_f4: I'm too hungry to talk. Caw.
5000631.c19_s1: You're lucky I'm too small to use magic, caw.
5000631.c19_s2: Who's a pretty birdy? Tengu! Caw.
5000631.c19_s3: Some pets are scared of me. Do I look scary? Caw.
5000631.c2_f4: Caw caw caw! Woof! I mean caw!
5000631.c20_f4: Hang on. Just wait a moment, Caw caw..
5000631.c20_s1: I love sunny days. Usually! Caw.
5000631.c20_s2: Sure, I'm up for whatever. Caw caw caw.
5000631.c20_s3: Want to hear my story? Caw, caw.
5000631.c20_s4: I'm really sensitive, some would say that's a plus. Caw.
5000631.c21_f4: Let's talk again tomorrow. Caw caw.
5000631.c21_s1: I sing better than I talk. Caw caw.
5000631.c21_s2: The world revolves, and I am part of the world. Caaw
5000631.c21_s3: I'm enjoying my me time right now. Caaw
5000631.c21_s4: Come to me whenever you need advice. Caaw
5000631.c3_f3: Ask me nicely. Poot... Caw caw.
5000631.c3_f4: Ew. I prefer clean places. Caw caw.
5000631.c3_s2: I'm pretty, and I listen. What a catch! Caw caw.
5000631.c3_s3: I feel like I'm on a picnic! Caw caw.
5000631.c3_s4: Master, you sit down too. Caw caw.
5000631.c4_f4: Huh? Did you say something? Caw caw.
5000631.c4_s1: Perfect! I was missing you. Caw caw caw.
5000631.c4_s2: I'm hungry... HINT, HINT! Caw caw caw.
5000631.c4_s3: Yip! What a nice breeze! Caw caw caw.
5000631.c5_f1: How dare you? Caw caw caw caw.
5000631.c6_f3: Do you want to get scolded too? Caw caw caw caw caw caw!
5000631.c6_f4: No! No! No way! Caw caw caw caw caw.
5000631.c6_s1: Don't scold me. Caw caw caw.
5000631.c6_s2: Don't get angry! Caw caw caw.
5000631.c6_s3: Sometimes... I like it when you're mad. Caw caw caw.
5000631.c6_s4: Eek! I don't like this! Caw caw caw.
5000631.c7_f2: I don't understand you. Caw caw caw.
5000631.c7_f4: I'm going to hit you! Caw caw caw.
5000631.c7_s1: My heart breaks. Caw caw caw.
5000631.c7_s2: How could you say that? Caw caw caw.
5000631.c7_s3: Please cut me some slack. Caw caw caw.
5000631.c7_s4: I'll be more careful! I promise! Caw caw caw.
5000631.c8_f1: It's all a misunderstanding! Caw caw caw.
5000631.c8_f2: All you do is order me around. Caw caw caw caw caw.
5000631.c8_f3: I'm not scared of you! Caw caw caw!
5000631.c8_f4: Stop telling me what to do, caw caw caw!
5000631.c8_s1: Stop scolding me! Caw caw caw!
5000631.c8_s2: I won't do it again! Caw caw caw!
5000631.c8_s3: I won't do that! Caw caw caw!
5000631.c8_s4: I messed up... Sorry... Caw caw caw!
5000631.c9_f2: What are you saying, caw caw caw?
5000631.f1_f: I don't want to get fat... Caw caw caw!
5000631.f1_s: You're the only one for me master! Caw caw.
5000631.f2_f: Stop! Stop! Caw caw caw! Caw caw caw! Caw caw caw!
5000631.f2_s: Delicious! Caw caw caw! Caw caw caw!
5000631.f3_s: Food is always good. Caw caw caw! Caw caw caw!
5000631.f4_f: Are you trying to see if I explode? Caw caw caw! Caw caw caw!
5000631.f4_s: Mine! Caw caw caw! Caw caw caw!
5000631.s2: Say nice things! Caw caw caw!
5000631.s3: Stop making me say strange things! Caw caw caw!
5000631.s4: I know you are but what am I. Caw caw caw!

5000632.c4_s1: Beagles in the morning, Beagles in the evening, Beagles at supper time...
5000632.c4_s2: How was my day at the office? It was ruff!
5000632.c4_f2: What are you looking at? Aroooo!
5000632.s1: One out of ten! Would not eat again.

5000636.c3_s1: The witch didn't make me talk to her.
5000636.c3_s2: Either I can talk, or you're hearing voices!
5000636.c4_s1: Nice voice! Ever thought of doing commercials?
5000636.c4_s2: Life is more fun than when I'm with my friends!
5000636.s3: I'm going to tell the witch if you keep doing that.

5000639.c3_s2: Either I can talk, or you're hearing voices!
5000639.c3_f1: I don't talk to just anyone!
5000639.c4_s1: You should be honored I'm talking to you!
5000639.c4_s2: It's always fun being with you.
5000639.f3_f: Does it have a bow on it? I only eat fancy food!
5000639.f4_s: Where did you get such delicious food?
5000639.s1: Where did you learn to say that?

5000654.c2_f4: I want to go back to the patch...
5000654.c3_f2: Pumpkins don't get mad... we get revenge.
5000654.c3_f3: You can't fake being a pumpkin! Impostor!
5000654.c4_f3: But... this dirt is so crummy...
5000654.c6_s3: I'm going to put a candle in your head.
5000654.c6_f1: What do you take me for?
5000654.c7_s1: I am going to poop in your lunchbox SO much.
5000654.c7_f1: Don't do anything you're going to regret when you go to sleep tonight.
5000654.c7_f2: Don't say it unless you mean it!
5000654.c7_f3: How can you do this to me?
5000654.c7_f4: You better hope I don't get ahold of your shoes.
5000654.c8_s2: I said it won't happen again.
5000654.c8_f1: I wish somebody had carved me a mad face.
5000654.c8_f2: Want to see an angry pumpkin? Do you?
5000654.c8_f3: I've got a lot of laxatives to put into some candy tonight...
5000654.c10_f2: Don't do it! Listen to your pumpkin!
5000654.c10_f3: Why are you doing this to me?
5000654.c11_s3: You're creepy in a good way!
5000654.c11_s4: You are the seeds in my brain.
5000654.c12_s2: I'll be at your side until the day I rot.
5000654.c12_f2: Are you mad at me because I tortured your goldfish? He was asking for it!
5000654.c12_f3: Think of me as a child with a misshapen head.
5000654.c13_s1: Does it look like my insides?
5000654.c13_s3: Gonna need some more candy wrappers here!
5000654.c13_s4: It's a good thing I bought those candles.
5000654.c13_f2: Why are you asking me to do that?
5000654.c13_f4: It is against pumpkin law for me to go first.
5000654.c14_s2: Makin' squeezin's outta my pumpkin butt!
5000654.c14_s3: Which one of these creases is my backside?
5000654.c14_f2: I don't have to go right now.
5000654.c15_s1: I am on this like black on a bat.
5000654.c15_f3: Let's go get some candy instead.
5000654.c16_s1: Leave my light on! I'm scared of the dark.
5000654.c16_f2: I have gourd business to attend to.
5000654.c16_f3: I need to scare some children first!
5000654.c17_f1: Not until I see a ghost!
5000654.c17_f3: Stop telling me what to do!
5000654.c18_s3: Sometimes I dream of turning YOUR head into a lantern.
5000654.c18_f2: Sorry, I can't hear you with all the awesome in my brain.
5000654.c18_f3: Not until we trick or treat!
5000654.c18_f4: I need at least three screaming kids to lull me to sleep.
5000654.c19_s1: First time seeing a talking pumpkin?
5000654.c19_s2: Wanna see some pumpkin magic? Gimme your wallet.
5000654.c19_s3: October is obviously the best month.
5000654.c19_s4: Do you know when Halloween is? I don't understand the concept of time.
5000654.c20_s3: Pumpkin is NOT delicious. Don't eat me.
5000654.c20_f1: Don't expect too much from a pumpkin.
5000654.c20_f3: You should be more like me... a terror to all humanity.
5000654.c21_s1: If I ever see you eat a pumpkin, I will...
5000654.c21_s3: Bats like pumpkins. So let's not be friends with bats.
5000654.c21_s4: Pump, pump it up, pump it up!
5000654.c21_f1: I like to keep busy with the frightening.
5000654.f3_f: You ever seen a pumpkin die from indigestion?
5000654.f4_s: I'm gonna grub it so hard!

5000657.c2_s1: Will you sit with me? Please?
5000657.c2_s2: I love sitting next to you!
5000657.c2_s3: Ah, a rest. Carrying a piece of fruit on my head sure is tiring.
5000657.c2_f1: Does sitting make me look fat?
5000657.c2_f3: If I sit, my cream'll turn sour!
5000657.c2_f4: Sitting makes me too easy to bite!
5000657.c3_s2: My doughy tush makes sitting so comfy!
5000657.c3_s4: You look like you could use a rest, too.
5000657.c3_f1: But I can keep walking forever!
5000657.c3_f2: Sit, stand, sit stand. You're gonna turn my cream into cheese.
5000657.c3_f3: At least put down a blanket or something.
5000657.c3_f4: I've gotten too chubby. I need exercise!
5000657.c4_s1: Together, we can do anything. Even sit!
5000657.c4_s2: I'm in a good mood, so okay.
5000657.c4_s4: Your wish is my puffy command! Heehee!
5000657.c4_f2: You can sit. I'm going without you.
5000657.c4_f4: You just want to step on me.
5000657.c5_f2: It's because you're a poor role model.
5000657.c6_s1: What did I do? I'm sorry!
5000657.c6_s2: You're going to make me cry big, creamy tears!
5000657.c6_f3: I don't like you right now!
5000657.c6_f4: You're projecting your insecurities on to me, aren't you?
5000657.c7_s1: I'm so sorry I disappointed you!
5000657.c7_f2: Don't say that unless you mean it!
5000657.c8_s3: You have to forgive me because I love you.
5000657.c8_s4: But the creampuff fairy told me to do it!
5000657.c8_f1: Too busy eating to listen, la la.
5000657.c8_f2: I hate being in trouble. Hmph.
5000657.c10_s4: I feel all warm, like back in the oven!
5000657.c10_f1: Do you love me or do you love to eat me?
5000657.c10_f2: It's hard to hear you without ears.
5000657.c10_f4: Oh, just kiss my puffy butt.
5000657.c11_s1: You're as sweet as my filling!
5000657.c11_s2: My creamy filling IS pretty great.
5000657.c11_s3: If you love me, then squeeze me!
5000657.c11_f1: I WON'T LET YOU EAT ME!
5000657.c11_f2: I know what you're planning to do to me when my guard is down...
5000657.c12_s1: I love you so much, I'd even let you take a nibble!
5000657.c12_s2: You make me the happiest creampuff alive!
5000657.c12_s3: I feel all warm and gooey inside. Oh, wait. Hehe.
5000657.c12_f1: This is a trick, isn't it?
5000657.c12_f3: We're not even the same food group!
5000657.c12_f4: I know you secretly want to om nom me.
5000657.c13_s2: I love to flush! Flush! Flushhhh!
5000657.c13_s4: Thanks for buying me this mini toilet. Love it!
5000657.c13_f2: That's a faux pas in creampuff society.
5000657.c14_s1: Little cream poops, la la la!
5000657.c14_s2: Ooh, I think I saw a piece of fruit in that one!
5000657.c14_s3: I hope you brought a napkin to wipe me with!
5000657.c14_s4: My poop smells like fruit. Mmmmm!
5000657.c14_f3: But I just went last week.
5000657.c14_f4: The chef who made me would be so ashamed!
5000657.c15_s1: Go on and squeeze it all out of me!
5000657.c15_f1: Why didn't you buy me a stall with this toilet?!
5000657.c15_f4: But then I won't have any filling left inside!
5000657.c16_s2: You should get some rest, too.
5000657.c16_s4: Don't forget me while I'm sleeping!
5000657.c16_f2: It's not time for nite nite yet!
5000657.c17_s1: I'm going to dream of swimming in a pool of coffee.
5000657.c17_f2: I smell to good to sleep.
5000657.c17_f4: I can set my own schedule, thanks very much.
5000657.c18_s2: Whew, I could use a rest.
5000657.c18_s3: Can I sleep in the palm of your hand?
5000657.c19_s1: I was the smallest creampuff in my entire batch!
5000657.c19_s2: Sometimes, I wish I were made of a different fruit. Like, cherries!
5000657.c19_s3: I have nightmares where a giggling girl tears me apart, limb by limb. Then eats me.
5000657.c19_s4: As my BFF, it's your job to make sure I don't get eaten!
5000657.c19_f1: What do you want from me? My brain's made of cream!
5000657.c19_f3: Creampuffs are for eating, not talking. Wait...
5000657.c19_f4: I have a lot on my mind lately. Get it?
5000657.c20_s1: A creampuff without cream might as well be dead.
5000657.c20_s2: Someday, I'm going to have three creampuff babies: plain, chocolate, and green tea!
5000657.c20_s3: At first, my baker made me without legs, but I begged and begged, and now look how cute I am!
5000657.c20_s4: What's the oddest creampuff flavor you can think of? Coconut? Pineapple? Anchovies?
5000657.c20_f2: What makes you think a creampuff can talk?
5000657.c20_f3: I hate small talk! I like big talk! Hehehe!
5000657.c21_s1: I support creampuff rights. We all deserve the right to not be eaten.
5000657.c21_s2: I don't mind if you eat other creampuffs, as long as you don't eat ME.
5000657.c21_s3: Sometimes I wish I were banana flavored. Bananas have all the fun.
5000657.c21_s4: I want to be the first creampuff to travel to the moon.
5000657.c21_f1: Gee, YOU try chatting on demand.
5000657.c21_f2: Shhh! I'm watching a creampuff soap opera!
5000657.c21_f4: Are you making fun of the way I talk?
5000657.f3_f: Are you trying to poison me?!
5000657.f4_s: Ooooh, this is yummier than I am!
5000657.f4_f: My little tummy is going to explode!
5000657.s1: I'm too pure for words like that!
5000657.s3: A cute creampuff likes cute words!

5000663.c12_s2: Master, I love you so much!
5000663.c12_s3: Master, you finally see my worth. Brr...
5000663.c12_s4: Master, I'm so lucky to have met you. Proomph...
5000663.c12_f1: Please don't be so mushy before I eat...
5000663.c12_f3: Neigh...I prefer the company of horses...
5000663.c12_f4: Master... That's nice... But you smell funny.
5000663.c14_f1: I don't want to... I'm not going to...
5000663.c14_f4: Why? What are you gonna do with it?
5000663.c15_s1: Okay, but watch my back. Proompfh!
5000663.c15_s3: My poop is cute like me!
5000663.c15_f1: You go first. Then I'll think about it.
5000663.c15_f3: Poop? Why don't you try feeding me first?
5000663.c15_f4: I am a dignified unicorn. I don't poop in public!
5000663.c16_f4: I'm not gonna do what you say! Proomph!
5000663.c17_s3: I want to dream of you...neigh...
5000663.c17_f1: You want me to sleep on the ground?!
5000663.c17_f3: If I sleep too much, I'll get fat!
5000663.c17_f4: I want to play more. Wehee...
5000663.c18_s1: A pretty unicorn like me deserves a beauty sleep, right?
5000663.c18_s2: Can you brush my mane while I sleep?
5000663.c18_s3: I'll get a good sleep so we can play some more!
5000663.c18_s4: My beautiful skin requires lots of sleep...zzz...
5000663.c18_f1: Should we be sleeping when your level is so low? Go hunt!
5000663.c18_f2: Neigh... I decide when and where I sleep...and I'm not sleepy!
5000663.c18_f3: Where do you plan on going after I fall asleep? Take me with you!
5000663.c18_f4: Proomph...I don't want to sleep in a place like this. Hmmpfh!
5000663.c19_s1: My hobby is brushing my mane...
5000663.c19_s2: I need to polish my horn sometime.
5000663.c19_s3: I'm your most special pet, right?
5000663.c19_s4: Have you ever seen a unicorn as pretty as me?
5000663.c19_f2: I don't have anything to say...
5000663.c20_s1: My golden mane can be difficult to manage!
5000663.c20_s2: Some days, I just want to run free and wild!
5000663.c20_s3: I'm so happy that you are my master.
5000663.c20_s4: So, what do you think of my skills?
5000663.c20_f2: Today is a good day for meditation.
5000663.c20_f4: You are truly skilled at bothering your pets.
5000663.c21_s1: One of these days, I want to soar through the sky with you on my back!
5000663.c21_s2: I wish I could find a nice horse to be with...
5000663.c21_s3: I've thought about dying my mane, but it's already the best color!
5000663.c21_s4: I was 1st place in the Unicorn Beauty Pageant!
5000663.c21_f1: I'm enjoying my peace and quiet, master!
5000663.c21_f2: Master, you need to grow up!
5000663.c21_f3: Oh, I was just talking to myself. What did you say?
5000663.c21_f4: Too much talking will give me wrinkles!
5000663.c22_s2: You'll cry tears of joy, master.
5000663.c22_s3: Proompfh. I'm only showing this to you, master!
5000663.c22_s4: It's a secret to everyone else. Okay?
5000663.c22_f3: Today is just not the day for it!
5000663.c22_f4: It's not something you can see anytime you want!
5000663.c23_s2: Transformation time! Master, just you wait!
5000663.c23_s3: Heh, sometimes a cute look like this ain't too bad.
5000663.c23_s4: The beautiful unicorn is multi-talented, as well. Proompfh!
5000663.c23_f2: Is that your best? I don't think so!
5000663.c23_f3: Nothing in this world is free! Proompfh!
5000663.c23_f4: I'm just too tired right now. I'll show you some other time.
5000663.f3_f: I'm gonna get fat if I eat any more...
5000663.f4_s: Yummy food! Neigh... I'm so happy!
5000663.f4_f: You can't feed a pretty unicorn like me such cheap food.
5000663.s3: Pretty master, please use pretty words...wehee...
5000663.s4: True beauty starts with sincerity! Remember that!

5000664.c2_s3: Lala...such a cool wind in my mane.
5000664.c2_f1: Wehee...I don't desire to do so!
5000664.c3_s2: Ah...I miss the chairs in the castle...
5000664.c3_s4: Thank you for your kind consideration.
5000664.c3_f4: How dare you? Do you realize who you are speaking to?!
5000664.c4_s2: Aah, since you are asking, I shall.
5000664.c4_s4: If that is what you wish! Wehee!
5000664.c4_f1: Owie! I've been pricked by a thorn!
5000664.c4_f2: I'd rather not, I'm a bit sore.
5000664.c4_f3: Wehee! How dare you try to command me?
5000664.c4_f4: Okay, hut! Ahh! My legs won't bend!
5000664.c6_s4: I am truly sorry, but I cannot return the sentiment.
5000664.c6_f4: La ti da...I can't hear you...
5000664.c7_s4: Lala, I am singing a song of repentance!
5000664.c7_f1: I am of a noble personage.
5000664.c7_f2: I can get angry as well! You...cough cough...my throat...
5000664.c8_s2: You must not like me anymore.
5000664.c8_s3: I acknowledge my mistake. I am sorry!
5000664.c8_s4: Please accept the apology of a unicorn prince.
5000664.c8_f1: Do you realize that you are speaking to one of nobility?!
5000664.c8_f3: I am quite disappointed in you!
5000664.c8_f4: Sigh...It is only natural for a horse to move forward!
5000664.c10_f1: I am truly sorry, but I cannot return the sentiment.
5000664.c10_f2: I am not the right one for you.
5000664.c12_s1: Lala... My heart is yours as well!
5000664.c12_s2: I hope that your heart shall never change.
5000664.c12_s3: I will stand by you always!
5000664.c12_s4: I will overcome our differences, to stand by you!
5000664.c12_f1: I shall be returning to my kingdom soon.
5000664.c12_f3: We are of different classes. I am sorry.
5000664.c12_f4: Did you at least bring me some sugar cubes?
5000664.c13_s4: If that is what you desire...
5000664.c14_s3: I am a prince, but I can be down to earth! Hrrgh!
5000664.c14_f1: No, this is not right! Not right at all!
5000664.c14_f4: I hope that you will learn to be a bit more elegant.
5000664.c15_f1: Phhhhhhrt... You didn't hear that! It wasn't me!
5000664.c15_f2: Unicorns are too dignified for pooping.
5000664.c15_f3: I am no commoner. How can I go in such a place as this?
5000664.c15_f4: My leavings are not for all to see!
5000664.c16_s4: You should get some rest too.
5000664.c16_f2: I am find just as I am!
5000664.c16_f4: You need to move around more. Look at your love handles!
5000664.c17_s2: Posture is important, even when sleeping...zzz...
5000664.c17_s4: So, this is how the homeless sleep...
5000664.c17_f1: Can you even think of sleeping at your level?
5000664.c17_f2: Why don't you prepare a nice bed for me first?
5000664.c17_f3: Aah...I miss my golden bed back in the castle.
5000664.c17_f4: I am not used to taking orders!
5000664.c18_s1: I wish for my kingdom to appear in my dreams.
5000664.c18_f2: We have much to do. There is no time for sleeping!
5000664.c18_f3: How dare you try to command me!
5000664.c18_f4: Bring me some sugar cubes! I am hungry!
5000664.c19_s1: Lala...I am the first prince of the Unicorn Kingdom!
5000664.c19_s2: I have come here just to meet you.
5000664.c19_s3: Dignity and elegance are my pride and calling.
5000664.c19_s4: I shall invite you to my kingdom someday.
5000664.c19_f4: Lala... Let us sing a song!
5000664.c20_s1: My sister is a beautiful unicorn with a light blue mane.
5000664.c20_s2: Esel and I are good friends.
5000664.c20_s3: I hope that my sister will be able to visit Maple World.
5000664.c20_s4: Esel and I still feel quite...lonely.
5000664.c21_s1: Members of the royal family like myself must be careful in all that we say and do!
5000664.c21_s2: It wasn't a mistake that brought me to Maple World.
5000664.c21_s3: My kingdom is inhabited by only unicorns.
5000664.c21_s4: Do you wish to learn some manners from me?
5000664.c21_f1: Elegant unicorns such as myself enjoy silence.
5000664.c21_f2: What? You surprised me. I wasn't expecting you to talk to me.
5000664.c21_f3: I'm in no mood to talk.
5000664.c21_f4: There are days when i just feel like being alone. Alone!
5000664.c22_s3: It is not for anyone to see.
5000664.c22_s4: If I don't move for 10 minutes, call a doctor.
5000664.c22_f1: How dare you command a member of the royal family!
5000664.c22_f2: I refuse! How can an unicorn of my stature stoop so low?
5000664.c22_f3: Wehee! How dare you try to command me?
5000664.c22_f4: I am too tired for a trick!
5000664.c23_s1: I shall show you something that Esel can't even attempt!
5000664.c23_s2: This is a secret move, passed down through the royal family.
5000664.c23_s3: Aah...I don't think I can perform that today!
5000664.c23_f1: How can you ask me to do such a thing? I cannot!
5000664.c23_f3: I am too tired. Please bring me a sugar cube.
5000664.c23_f4: Wehee. It's not something you can see anytime you want to!
5000664.f2_f: I am quite full! Please, no more!
5000664.f3_f: Aah...I miss the meals back in my kingdom..
5000664.s3: A beautiful word for a beautiful person...

5000665.c2_f2: How can you sit on the floor?
5000665.c2_f3: I will consider it if you get a cushion for me.
5000665.c3_s1: Good. I was getting tired of being in the air anyway.
5000665.c3_s2: I'm getting sleepy now that I'm lying down.
5000665.c3_s3: Pillows are such a brilliant invention.
5000665.c3_f3: Don't try to look down on me.
5000665.c4_s2: Why don't you take a seat with me?
5000665.c4_s3: Such a great weather to get some sleep.
5000665.c4_f1: Why don't you take a seat first?
5000665.c4_f2: I can't believe a toy can talk!
5000665.c5_s1: Sorry, I'm still not used to this whole 'body' thing yet.
5000665.c5_s2: You are making me really uncomfortable.
5000665.c6_s2: I'll apologize this time. THIS time.
5000665.c6_s4: You are the first person to tell me that other than Orchid.
5000665.c6_f1: I guess you don't mind dying, do you?
5000665.c6_f3: Do you have any idea who you are dealing with?
5000665.c6_f4: Don't tell me you are trying to scare me.
5000665.c7_s1: Admit that it was your fault.
5000665.c7_s3: Okay, stop it. I get it now!
5000665.c7_s4: I miss Orchid. She's so nice.
5000665.c7_f4: How dare you get angry with me?
5000665.c8_s1: I am actually reflecting on myself for the first time ever.
5000665.c8_s2: Okay, fine. I won't do that anymore.
5000665.c8_s3: So you also don't like me.
5000665.c8_s4: I wanted to be a good person.
5000665.c8_f2: Can you feel the darkness behind me?
5000665.c8_f3: You are nothing but a lowly peon.
5000665.c9_s2: I will accept it. Your heart, that is.
5000665.c9_f2: You will have a crush soon.
5000665.c10_s3: So many fans, so little time to crush all their hearts.
5000665.c10_s4: Those words make me feel nervous and great at the same time!
5000665.c10_f2: You don't even know how to get better.
5000665.c10_f4: How can a person as weak as you...
5000665.c11_s1: I don't really understand what it means, but it sounds nice.
5000665.c11_s3: You make my heart go pitter-patter.
5000665.c11_s4: I didn't know you liked me that much...
5000665.c11_f2: I am already suffering... You don't have to make me suffer even more...
5000665.c12_f2: Honestly, you are not my type.
5000665.c12_f4: Not bad, but not good either.
5000665.c13_s3: You can put this here like that, yeah?
5000665.c13_f1: I don't know what that means.
5000665.c13_f4: I was taught to do that by myself.
5000665.c14_s4: It will be easier to fly now that I feel lighter.
5000665.c14_f2: I feel like I just ate.
5000665.c14_f4: You are such a dirty toy.
5000665.c15_s1: Is this what it feels like to let everything go?
5000665.c15_s4: I want to cover my eyes.
5000665.c15_f1: I don't know how to do that.
5000665.c15_f4: I'm not really in the mood.
5000665.c16_s2: I don't know when my last break was.
5000665.c16_s3: Why don't you take a break?
5000665.c16_f1: I feel like I'm gonna have a nightmare.
5000665.c16_f3: I can't believe you meddle in everything that I do.
5000665.c16_f4: What are you gonna do while I'm sleeping?
5000665.c17_s1: Is it really okay if I'm the only one getting some sleep?
5000665.c17_s2: Will I be able to see Orchid in my dreams?
5000665.c17_s3: I'm gonna sleep, not because you are making me, but because I want to.
5000665.c17_s4: Mhmm, why don't you get some sleep too?
5000665.c17_f2: I can't play any fun games when I'm sleeping.
5000665.c17_f3: I have no time for that.
5000665.c18_s1: Will I have sweet dreams tonight?
5000665.c18_s2: Humans need to take a break from time to time.
5000665.c18_s3: I will hang out with Orchid in my dreams!
5000665.c18_s4: I almost feel too lazy to sleep.
5000665.c18_f1: I got enough sleep when I was in the laboratory.
5000665.c19_s1: I learned to talk a long time ago.
5000665.c19_s2: This world is full of toys for me.
5000665.c19_s3: You are such a lonely person...
5000665.c19_f2: You don't even know how to fly. How dare you?
5000665.c20_s1: I kinda miss being a spirit.
5000665.c20_s2: Why do humans hate what I love?
5000665.c20_f2: Are you acting like this because I look human now?
5000665.c20_f3: Why don't you just keep... doing what you do?
5000665.c20_f4: I'm not really in the mood to talk.
5000665.c21_s1: We are twins, but I was born first.
5000665.c21_s3: My age? Hmm... not sure. I never actually kept track.
5000665.c21_s4: I have nothing to fear as long as I am with Orchid.
5000665.c21_f3: Why not hunt when you are bored?
5000665.f1_s: Eating is such a great pleasure.
5000665.f1_f: I don't want to eat anymore.
5000665.s4: I don't want to hear it.

5000666.c2_s1: My legs were hurting. Thank you so much!
5000666.c2_s3: Take a seat here, little toy.
5000666.c2_f2: I was in bed all day yesterday.
5000666.c2_f3: I must exercise to be stronger.
5000666.c2_f4: I want to take a walk in the grass.
5000666.c3_s1: I feel refreshed! How come I couldn't feel this when I was a spirit?
5000666.c3_s2: I want my legs to get better soon.
5000666.c3_s4: I wish Lotus was by my side.
5000666.c3_f1: Are you telling me to sit on the ground? I am a patient!
5000666.c3_f3: I know I'm ill, but that doesn't mean I will listen to a mere toy.
5000666.c3_f4: I prefer to sit in clean places.
5000666.c4_s2: I'm gonna get better soon so I can fly again!
5000666.c4_s4: Okay. I will sit down for you this time.
5000666.c4_f1: I will think about it if you sit.
5000666.c4_f2: I want to take a walk little more...
5000666.c4_f3: I need to stand still with this IV bottle in my hand.
5000666.c5_f1: You are weaker than my rabbit doll.
5000666.c5_f2: Why are you doing this to me?
5000666.c6_s3: How can you be so cruel to someone sick?
5000666.c6_f1: Little toy, you are a little odd today.
5000666.c6_f2: Are you feeling sick like me?
5000666.c7_s2: I wasn't really feeling good lately. Sorry!
5000666.c7_s3: I sincerely apologize if I offended you.
5000666.c7_f3: Do you want to fly away?
5000666.c7_f4: Don't tell me what to do!
5000666.c8_s1: I feel like my headache is getting worse.
5000666.c8_s2: Even Lotus doesn't do this to me.
5000666.c8_f3: It was just a tiny mistake.
5000666.c8_f4: I'm gonna go back if you keep being this way.
5000666.c9_s2: Ha ha, that makes me happy.
5000666.c9_f1: Sorry. I only like Lotus and rabbits.
5000666.c10_s1: Cough, only you care for me...
5000666.c10_s2: Then just give me a present!
5000666.c10_s3: I don't like you as much I like rabbits, but I do like you.
5000666.c10_f1: Do you have a fever? Come here...
5000666.c10_f3: People don't like it when you tease them so much.
5000666.c11_s4: Do you still like me like this?
5000666.c11_f2: How can I do that with a toy?
5000666.c11_f3: You are nothing but a lowly peon.
5000666.c11_f4: You don't have pointy ears like rabbits.
5000666.c12_s1: Tell me that ten times every day!
5000666.c12_s3: I feel like I will get better sometime soon!
5000666.c12_f2: This emotion is too difficult for me to handle.
5000666.c12_f4: That's nice... But you smell funny.
5000666.c13_s2: Urgh, so annoying. Okay, I'm on it!
5000666.c13_f1: You need to learn some common decency.
5000666.c13_f3: Please do that at the appropriate time and place.
5000666.c13_f4: You should not do that outside.
5000666.c14_s4: Ah... this feeling... I can feel that I'm getting better already..
5000666.c14_f1: I didn't really eat much because I wasn't feeling good.
5000666.c14_f3: Why do you make me do such things?
5000666.c15_s3: How did you know that I had to go?
5000666.c15_s4: It's so annoying to live in a human body.
5000666.c15_f3: I just went. Did you forget?
5000666.c15_f4: What does that mean? I've never heard that before.
5000666.c16_s1: You should get some sleep too. Come here!
5000666.c16_s2: It's not a bad idea to take some rest from time to time.
5000666.c16_s3: I wish I can see Lotus in my dreams.
5000666.c16_s4: I've been suffering from a headache. Night!
5000666.c16_f1: It's not time for bed yet.
5000666.c16_f2: I will think about it if you bring me a rabbit doll.
5000666.c16_f4: I was sleeping all day yesterday in the hospital.
5000666.c17_s1: I feel like I am going to have a great dream tonight!
5000666.c17_s4: I'm so tired. I was walking around with an IV bottle in my hand all day.
5000666.c17_f1: I don't fall asleep just anywhere.
5000666.c17_f2: Are you sleepy? Take a nap. I will keep a lookout for you.
5000666.c17_f3: I want to feel this refreshing breeze little bit more.
5000666.c17_f4: Are you going to bed already?
5000666.c18_s2: *YAWN* I wonder how Lotus is doing.
5000666.c18_s3: You should get some sleep too, little toy.
5000666.c18_s4: Come here, I will hug you like you are my rabbit doll.
5000666.c18_f1: What are you going to do when I fall asleep?
5000666.c18_f2: 4 hours of sleep is enough for a day!
5000666.c18_f3: I cannot fall asleep. Is this because of the medicine that I took?
5000666.c18_f4: Are you going to run away when I'm asleep?
5000666.c19_s1: I remember the first time I met him in Hallowed Forest.
5000666.c19_s2: I love the way I am now!
5000666.c19_s4: AH.. I want to get better so I can fly like before.
5000666.c19_f2: Thought I wouldn't notice you talking?
5000666.c19_f3: Stop speaking to me in such a commanding tone.
5000666.c19_f4: I will think about it if you get on your knees and beg me.
5000666.c20_s1: I want to wear my uniforms again.
5000666.c20_s2: It was great to be with Lotus...
5000666.c20_s3: It's so interesting to live in a human body.
5000666.c20_s4: Do you still have my rabbit hair pin?
5000666.c20_f1: No. I'm not going to do that.
5000666.c20_f3: I have no energy to talk.
5000666.c21_s2: I didn't know what it felt like to be sick when I was a spirit.
5000666.c21_s3: Don't tell anyone, okay? I'm actually really really strong.
5000666.c21_s4: Do you know Lotus, my other half?
5000666.c21_f3: Shhhhh! The rabbit is about to fall asleep!
5000666.f2_f: Overeating is never good for you.
5000666.f3_s: I feel like I am all recovered!
5000666.f3_f: It will only get worse if I gain more weight.
5000666.s2: What a horrible toy you are...
5000666.s3: Huh? Are you talking to me?

5000667.c1_s2: I will sit if you insist!
5000667.c1_f2: The great Gelimer does not sit!
5000667.c2_s1: I am an old man you know...
5000667.c2_s3: It feels nice to be outside of the lab sometimes.
5000667.c2_f2: I am way stronger than I look.
5000667.c2_f3: I'm not planning to sit down at all!
5000667.c2_f4: Why must I listen to you?
5000667.c3_s2: It was not easy... You should get some rest too!
5000667.c3_s3: Is it gonna rain? My joints are stiff and sore.
5000667.c3_s4: Can you hand me the cushion?
5000667.c3_f1: I am full of energy! What does it mean to be tired?
5000667.c3_f2: I will turn you into an Android if you don't stop giving me orders.
5000667.c3_f3: How can you sit on the ground? Not classy!
5000667.c4_s1: It's been so long since the last time I got some fresh air!
5000667.c4_s2: Fresh wind is blowing through my hair. My thinning hair...
5000667.c4_s3: You are a very nice young man!
5000667.c4_f1: I am not the type to work under someone.
5000667.c4_f2: I will think about it if you give me some theoretical evidence.
5000667.c4_f3: Just keep hunting! I still need more data!
5000667.c5_s2: I want to be whiny sometimes HAHA.
5000667.c5_f1: How dare you talk like that to elders!
5000667.c6_s1: This world is coming to an end.
5000667.c6_s3: It's strange... It definitely worked before...
5000667.c6_s4: You haven't heard of the saying 'failure is the mother of success?'
5000667.c6_f1: Let me see... Something's wrong with you for sure.
5000667.c6_f3: I am the best scientist in Maple World!
5000667.c7_s3: Haven't heard that for a while.
5000667.c7_f1: Do you wanna be my research subject?
5000667.c7_f2: I want to study what's inside of your head.
5000667.c7_f3: That's something I would say to my teddy bear.
5000667.c8_s1: I will let this one go. You are lucky that I have a big heart.
5000667.c8_s4: Sorry. I was just so curious.
5000667.c8_f1: Was that not enough of brainwashing?
5000667.c8_f2: You are not even worth studying.
5000667.c8_f4: Are you sure you don't have a headache or something?
5000667.c9_s2: It wasn't to make you happy!
5000667.c10_s2: I'm good at hearts. You will understand...
5000667.c10_s3: This is not the first time I've heard that.
5000667.c10_f1: I will take a look at the experiment data.
5000667.c10_f2: Can you prove this to me mathematically?
5000667.c10_f3: My heart does not react to that...
5000667.c10_f4: Where did my teddy bear go?
5000667.c11_s1: Would you like to be a subject for my experiment?
5000667.c11_s3: HAHA. I haven't heard that in a while.
5000667.c11_s4: You fell for me for sure!
5000667.c11_f2: I don't even know what you look like.
5000667.c11_f4: I don't trust something invisible. I am not that stupid.
5000667.c12_s2: Do you wanna grab a cup of tea sometime?
5000667.c12_s3: I am so skilled at flattering my boss.
5000667.c12_f2: Love is the easiest trick you can use to deceive another.
5000667.c12_f4: I am older than your grandpa.
5000667.c13_s1: This? It's my personal taste. Show some respect!
5000667.c13_s3: Excuse me. I am in a hurry.
5000667.c13_f2: My guts are not done digesting!
5000667.c13_f3: I am a very patient man.
5000667.c14_s1: You will be the one cleaning up, right?
5000667.c14_s2: Was the potion that I took yesterday expired?
5000667.c14_s3: This is so great, just like my intelligence!
5000667.c14_s4: Stop bothering me. I am concentrating!
5000667.c14_f2: I feel like someone is peeking.
5000667.c14_f4: Don't tell me what to do!
5000667.c15_s1: I am such a healthy scientist!
5000667.c15_s3: Ahem! Did you just hear that?
5000667.c15_s4: I was fine when I was a youngster.
5000667.c15_f1: I am very sophisticated, unlike you!
5000667.c15_f2: How can you say that while eating?
5000667.c15_f4: My brain burns all my calories.
5000667.c16_s3: Nothing is more important than a good night's sleep!
5000667.c16_s4: You should get some rest now. You have so much to study later.
5000667.c16_f1: 4 hours of sleep is enough for one day!
5000667.c16_f2: I can sleep with only one eye closed.
5000667.c16_f3: Why don't YOU get some sleep?
5000667.c17_s1: I shall see my teddy bear in my dreams tonight!
5000667.c17_s2: It's little uncomfortable here... Ah well.
5000667.c17_s3: Don't touch anything while I'm asleep!
5000667.c17_f2: I heard stupid humans are sleepyheads.
5000667.c17_f3: We've got enough sleep. This is statistically proven.
5000667.c17_f4: How dare you give me orders!
5000667.c18_s2: Even the genius needs some time off for his brain.
5000667.c18_s3: Don't pester me while I'm sleeping.
5000667.c18_s4: It's better to take some rest like this.
5000667.c18_f1: I have no time to rest!
5000667.c18_f2: I still need to conduct some experiments!
5000667.c19_s1: I am Gelimer, the one who created Black Heaven! HAHA.
5000667.c19_s3: You must sacrifice little things in life to succeed.
5000667.c19_s4: I'm the one who came up with the Evolution System, too!
5000667.c19_f1: Not everyone can hear my voice.
5000667.c19_f2: Can you handle 10-hour lectures on Gelimer's Theory?
5000667.c19_f3: I don't really enjoy talking to humans.
5000667.c20_s1: I am so close to perfecting my greatest creation!
5000667.c20_s2: Takes me 20 minutes each day to do my hair!
5000667.c20_s3: You don't think I am competent as a commander? NONSENSE!
5000667.c20_s4: Everyone I met fell for me because of my beautiful eyes.
5000667.c20_f2: Do you not have anyone else to talk to?
5000667.c20_f3: You are such a lonely subject. Should I make a human clone just for you?
5000667.c20_f4: Keep it down. I can't concentrate!
5000667.c21_s1: What would be the first thing you would do if the world ends now?
5000667.c21_s2: You will be surprised when you learn the secret of my teddy bear.
5000667.c21_s3: I want to press all the red buttons in the world! Are you like that too?
5000667.c21_s4: Arkarium? I'm way smarter than that fool.
5000667.c21_f1: I don't want to deal with you.
5000667.c21_f2: Why not hunt when you are bored?
5000667.c21_f3: Why don't you become friends with a doll if you are lonely?
5000667.f1_s: This is the taste of proper molecule arrangement!
5000667.f1_f: Is this the flavor of motor oil?
5000667.f2_f: Cut it now! I'm not a glutton!
5000667.f3_s: i didn't know I could be this happy by just eating!
5000667.f4_s: I needed some sugar in my system!
5000667.s1: Where did I put my taser?
5000667.s2: I heard humans starts cussing when they have nothing else to say.
5000667.s3: You have not taken any speech classes, have you?
5000667.s4: STOP! Or else I will have you stuffed like a stuffed animal!

5000668.c2_s4: I soft, so I comfy anywhere.
5000668.c3_s3: I sit now. You sing me song!
5000668.c4_s1: I'm sleepy, but I can't sleep...
5000668.c8_s2: You no play with me no more?
5000668.c12_s1: You are my favorite! Love you!
5000668.c12_s4: You just as cute as me! Love you!
5000668.c12_f3: You want love? I want ribs!
5000668.c12_f4: La la la, can't hear you!
5000668.c14_f4: Stop it, stop it, stop it!
5000668.c15_s2: Boing boing! Hee hee, keep up!
5000668.c17_s4: Wanna sleep next to you! Zzz...
5000668.c18_f1: No time for sleep! Exercise! Get strong!
5000668.c19_s3: Talk about ribs? I wanna rib. Mmm...rib.
5000668.c19_s4: You get nice thingies for me?
5000668.c20_s2: I like beef. Pork okay, too.
5000668.c20_s3: I have many interests. Like knitting.
5000668.c20_s4: I like talkies with you! You funny!
5000668.c21_s1: I born with big eyes. Sparkly!
5000668.c21_s3: Am I fat? Be honest. I take it.
5000668.c21_s4: I endangered creature. Take care of me!
5000668.c22_s1: Boing! I do lots of things!
5000668.c22_s4: I know how to rock, too!
5000668.c22_f3: Can't hear you, can't hear you!
5000668.c23_s2: Look at me! LOOK AT MEEEEEE!
5000668.c23_s4: Gonna be rock star! Have world tour!
5000668.c23_f2: I have no idea what you talk about.
5000668.c23_f4: No tricks. I am quiet and gentle pet.
5000668.f2_f: Buh? What if I get fat?
5000668.f3_f: No more eat! Exercise! Bouncy bouncy!
5000668.f4_f: Waahh! I don't want it! I don't!
5000668.s2: Buh?! I remember this! You watch out!

5000669.c2_f2: Give me one good reason why!
5000669.c3_s2: Perfect timing! I was getting a little tired.
5000669.c6_s4: I didn't mean to make you mad!
5000669.c7_s1: I was wrong! I was wrong!
5000669.c7_s2: I'll be more careful from now on!
5000669.c8_s2: Are you going to leave me?!
5000669.c8_f4: If I'm misbehaving, it's your fault.
5000669.c9_s1: Is it is because I'm cute?
5000669.c10_f3: But I'm stuck in a robot dog body!
5000669.c11_s2: You've made me the happiest Roo-bot alive!
5000669.c11_s4: I love you, too! I do! I do!
5000669.c11_f3: I don't think you mean it.
5000669.c12_s1: You're my reason for living, master!
5000669.c12_s4: Being with you makes life worthwhile!
5000669.c12_f2: I wish I felt the same way...
5000669.c12_f4: I'd like to be alone, please.
5000669.c13_f3: Do you even have a pooper scrooper?
5000669.c14_f2: I don't need to go right now!
5000669.c14_f4: I don't want to cause pollution!
5000669.c15_s2: How about a snack while I poop?
5000669.c15_s3: Master! Master! I want you to watch!
5000669.c15_f2: Why do you always want me to poop?
5000669.c15_f3: Sleep, sit, poop. That's all I ever get to do.
5000669.c16_f2: I want to play with you!
5000669.c17_s2: Am I cute while I sleep?
5000669.c17_f4: You always make me sleep! Hmph!
5000669.c18_s2: I'm cute when I sleep, huh?
5000669.c18_f4: Buy me a cozy bed first!
5000669.c19_s1: There were lots and lots of other Roo-bots back in the lab.
5000669.c19_s2: Gelimer wasn't mean, but he wasn't nice, either. I like you better!
5000669.c19_s3: Tell me I'm cute! Tell me you'll take care of me!
5000669.c19_s4: I was human once, but this robot body is cuter!
5000669.c20_s1: I miss the other Roo-bots from the lab. I hope they're okay.
5000669.c20_s2: Before Gelimer made me a Roo-bot, I think I lived by the sea.
5000669.c20_s3: Whoa! The world is full of monsters!
5000669.c20_s4: Do you think anybody would miss me if I disappeared?
5000669.c20_f1: What makes you think I have anything worth saying?
5000669.c20_f4: Let me just think of something to say...
5000669.c21_s1: You'll use the Water of Life on me if anything happens, right?
5000669.c21_s2: Sometimes, I think I kind of miss Gelimer... How weird!
5000669.c21_s4: Wanna know a secret? You're my favorite!
5000669.c21_f1: I'm not REALLY a dog, you know. I don't talk on command.
5000669.c21_f3: *Pretends not to hear, because it's funny! Hehe!*
5000669.f1_f: You plan to fatten me up so you can eat me, huh?
5000669.f3_s: I can do anything on a full tummy!
5000669.s1: You want me to say what?!

5000670.c2_s1: Okay, but you have to keep me safe.
5000670.c2_s2: Be on lookout behind me, just in case.
5000670.c2_s3: I guess I could take a break.
5000670.c2_s4: Do you have anything to eat while I sit here?
5000670.c2_f1: I'd rather stand, so I can run if a monster appears.
5000670.c2_f2: What if the ground hurts me?
5000670.c3_s3: I'm counting on you to keep the ground from attacking me!
5000670.c3_s4: My tail keeps me warm and cozy.
5000670.c3_f1: I need to lie down, not sit.
5000670.c3_f2: You just want to hurt me!
5000670.c3_f3: Why?! What're you going to do to me?
5000670.c4_s2: Will you be nice to me if I sit?
5000670.c4_s4: I'm awfully tired from being on high alert all the time.
5000670.c4_f2: Are you trying to hurt me?
5000670.c5_s2: It was my fault! Please stop hitting me!
5000670.c6_s4: I'll be better! Don't hurt me!
5000670.c6_f4: Why are you treating me this way?
5000670.c7_s2: I thought you cared about me!
5000670.c7_f3: I'm going to tell on you!
5000670.c8_f1: You're so mean! I miss Gelimer!
5000670.c8_f4: There's got to be someone I can call!
5000670.c10_s2: I think... I think that makes me happy!
5000670.c11_f4: I know you d-don't mean it.
5000670.c12_s1: I'm so glad I met you!
5000670.c12_s2: I love you so, so, so much!
5000670.c13_s4: I could do this all day.
5000670.c14_s1: I've been holding that in for a long time.
5000670.c14_s2: Promise that it won't hurt me!
5000670.c14_f2: What if it bites me on the way out?!
5000670.c14_f4: I only do that once a day...
5000670.c16_s2: Keep me safe while I rest.
5000670.c16_f1: What if I have bad dreams?
5000670.c17_s1: My tail will keep me safe. Right?
5000670.c17_s2: Don't leave me alone while I sleep, okay?
5000670.c17_s4: Put your hand on my back while I sleep so I know you're near.
5000670.c17_f2: You go first. I'll do it after...
5000670.c17_f3: What if something sneaks up on me?
5000670.c17_f4: No! Don't ask me to do that!
5000670.c18_s1: Stay with me while I sleep, okay?
5000670.c18_s2: One Red Snail... two Red Snails...
5000670.c18_s4: Can you make me a comfy quilt next time?
5000670.c18_f2: There are monsters in the closet!
5000670.c18_f4: But I'm not sleepy! I'm not!
5000670.c19_s1: That mean scientist performed all sorts of experiments on me. *cry*
5000670.c19_s2: I hate thinking about the past. I hate it!
5000670.c19_s3: The outside world is scary, but the lab was even worse.
5000670.c19_s4: I hate science! I hate it so much!
5000670.c19_f2: You won't get anything out of me!
5000670.c19_f3: I won't tell you! I won't!
5000670.c20_s1: I think I was brave before Gelimer came along.
5000670.c20_s2: I wish I weren't so timid, but everything scares me. Except you.
5000670.c20_s3: I'm so worried that one day I'll turn into a doll.
5000670.c20_s4: Sometimes I wish I could fly, but it's too scary.
5000670.c20_f1: Are you going to hurt me?
5000670.c20_f2: I don't like to talk about my past.
5000670.c21_s1: I've always wanted to taste the Water of Life, but I'm too scared.
5000670.c21_s2: Sometimes I think I should wear a disguise so no one can find me.
5000670.c21_s3: It's not safe to have friends. You're the only one I trust.
5000670.c21_s4: If it weren't for you, master, I think I'd be completely alone.
5000670.c21_f1: Are you going to hurt me?
5000670.c21_f3: Go away! I don't want to talk!
5000670.c21_f4: Aah! I thought I heard Gelimer's voice!
5000670.s3: I won't say anything bad, I won't!

5000671.c2_s1: I sat. Now where's my reward?
5000671.c2_f3: Why should I listen to you?
5000671.c3_s2: Ahh, I love how soft my tail is.
5000671.c3_s4: I suppose I could rest my feet for a minute.
5000671.c3_f2: I don't like it here. Let's jet.
5000671.c3_f4: It's dirty here. Let me sit in your lap.
5000671.c4_s1: There's a nice spot next to me with your name on it.
5000671.c4_f1: Do you expect me to do everything you say?
5000671.c4_f2: Come on! Let's do something else!
5000671.c4_f4: I am in no mood to sit.
5000671.c6_s1: Fine. Punish me. I LIKE it.
5000671.c6_s4: I guess I might've deserved that...
5000671.c6_f1: It's not like I meant to do anything wrong.
5000671.c7_s1: I'm sorry. You'll forgive me, right?
5000671.c7_s4: My bad, my bad. Get over it.
5000671.c7_f1: Why are you taking your repressed emotions out on me?
5000671.c7_f2: What're you gonna do, throw me in a rubbish bin?
5000671.c7_f3: I thought you were better than that.
5000671.c8_s2: I admit it, I messed up.
5000671.c8_f3: I might behave better if you FED ME MORE.
5000671.c9_f2: You must want something from me...
5000671.c10_s1: I suppose I can buy that.
5000671.c10_f2: We haven't reached that stage in our relationship.
5000671.c10_f4: You did NOT just say that.
5000671.c11_s1: I kinda liked hearing you say that.
5000671.c11_s3: Say that again while scratching my ears.
5000671.c11_f1: You're cute. Not in a good way.
5000671.c11_f2: Don't say stuff like that before I eat!
5000671.c12_s2: Gotta admit, my favorite time of day is when I'm with you.
5000671.c12_s3: Glad you recognize quality when you see it.
5000671.c12_f4: Is this really the right time for that?
5000671.c13_s3: Pick it up, buddy of mine!
5000671.c13_s4: No peeking! Well, a little bit is okay.
5000671.c13_f1: I thought you were more dignified than that.
5000671.c13_f2: I don't need you to tell me when to poop.
5000671.c13_f3: You don't even have a bag to pick it up!
5000671.c14_s1: Consider that a favor. Now you owe me.
5000671.c14_s3: I want you to breathe it in. Savor it.
5000671.c14_f2: Would you like it if I told YOU when to poop?
5000671.c14_f3: Maybe if you fed me more...
5000671.c14_f4: I'm holding it in, out of spite.
5000671.c15_f2: Feed me and I'll think about it.
5000671.c15_f3: The ground is covered with ants!
5000671.c15_f4: I'm embarrassed to be seen with you.
5000671.c16_s4: I'm pretty sleepy... How'd you know?
5000671.c16_f2: Do I look sleepy to you?
5000671.c16_f3: Maybe if I had a full tummy...
5000671.c16_f4: I'm fine as I am, thank you.
5000671.c17_s1: How'd you know I was tired?
5000671.c17_s2: I suppose I could close my eyes...
5000671.c17_s3: My tail is the perfect blanket.
5000671.c18_s1: Let's see how long I can stay... *snore*
5000671.c18_s3: There's space next to me if you wanna cuddle. Just saying.
5000671.c18_s4: Don't sit on me while I sleep!
5000671.c18_f1: Despite these dark circles under my eyes, I am NOT sleepy. *yawn*
5000671.c18_f2: We have too much to do!
5000671.c18_f4: Can't sleep. Miss my mom too... Nevermind.
5000671.c19_s1: If I ever see Gelimer again, I'll show him what for!
5000671.c19_s2: You have no idea who I really am. Noooo idea.
5000671.c19_s3: My favorite time of day is mealtime!
5000671.c19_s4: I've always dreamed of riding an airship...
5000671.c19_f3: Shoo, go over there and play.
5000671.c20_s1: Gelimer thinks he wiped out my memories, but I remember my mother.
5000671.c20_s2: I miss my life before I was a Roo-bot. Not that I don't enjoy being with you...
5000671.c20_s3: People think they can walk all over me because I'm in a dog's body.
5000671.c20_s4: I won't let anyone stop me from doing what I want to do!
5000671.c20_f2: Isn't there anyone else you can talk to?
5000671.c20_f3: I've got nothing to say right now.
5000671.c21_s1: Strangers always touch my tail without asking. I should do it back.
5000671.c21_s2: I know I come off kinda mean, but I really just want a friend...
5000671.c21_s3: My mother had the kindest eyes. And she used to sing me to sleep.
5000671.c21_s4: My most secret dream is to find my mother again, but that's impossible.

5000671.s1: You want me to say what?
5000671.s2: Are you trying to get me in trouble?
5000671.s3: Come on, we're better than that!

5000676.c2_s4: I am sitting, as you see.
5000676.c2_f2: Can't I just stay like this?
5000676.c2_f3: You go ahead and just stay put.
5000676.c2_f4: I want to walk a bit more.

5000676.c4_f4: Sometimes I wanna change things up.

5000676.c8_s2: I'm sorry! I won't do it again.

5000676.c8_f2: How can you get so mad?
5000676.c9_s2: You're the only one for me!

5000676.c11_s3: I love you! I love you!
5000676.c11_f2: La la la... I don't care!
5000676.c12_f1: That's nice... But you smell funny.

5000676.c17_f4: At least sing me a lullaby!
5000676.c18_s1: I want to sleep on your lap...
5000676.c18_s2: Come lay down next to me.
5000676.c18_s4: I wanted to play some more, but okay.
5000676.c18_f2: I want to play with you!

5000676.c19_f4: Why is the sky so blue, then?

5000676.c21_f4: I want to be alone once in a while.

5000679.c4_s3: It's the perfect time to rest!
5000679.c4_f1: I don't like being ordered around!
5000679.c4_f2: We can't rest like this every day!
5000679.c4_f4: Are you hurt? Why do you keep wanting to rest?

5000679.c8_s2: Sorry... I won't do it again...
5000679.c8_f1: Hmph! I told you to treat me nicely!
5000679.c8_f2: I'm going back to the north pole!
5000679.c8_f3: I'm going to tell on you!
5000679.c11_s2: I like you better than the north pole.
5000679.c11_s4: I'm so lucky to have a master like you!
5000679.c12_s1: I love hanging out with you.
5000679.c12_f2: Did you eat some bad fish?
5000679.c12_f3: I'm a Harp Seal, and you are a human!
5000679.c13_f3: You should be ashamed of yourself!
5000679.c14_f1: Tell me that AFTER you feed me!
5000679.c14_f2: You can't order me to do everything!
5000679.c15_s1: Every day is a healthy day!
5000679.c15_s3: Make sure no one's looking, okay?
5000679.c15_f4: This is shameful! You'll be hearing from my Harp Lawyers!
5000679.c16_f1: But I want to play more!
5000679.c16_f2: Look, the sun is still up!
5000679.c16_f3: Still a long way to go!
5000679.c16_f4: I don't think it's time to sleep yet.
5000679.c17_f1: You are a sleepyhead, aren't you, master?
5000679.c17_f2: I don't want to sleep yet.
5000679.c17_f3: I'll sleep when I get sleepy, okies?
5000679.c18_s3: Good seals are early to bed, early to rise.
5000679.c18_f2: I guess not all your ideas are good...
5000679.c18_f3: Why do you always tell me to sleep?
5000679.c18_f4: Is this going to make us closer?
5000679.c19_s1: Well you know, at the north pole...
5000679.c19_s2: I saw this weird animal in the forest...
5000679.c19_s3: What's the difference between real and fake seals?
5000679.c19_s4: I love it here because there aren't any polar bears.
5000679.c20_s1: I wish I had some snow to lie on.
5000679.c20_s2: I'm all white so I can hide from polar bears in the snow!
5000679.c20_s3: Will you protect me from polar bears, master?
5000679.c20_s4: I'm sure glad for nice people like you, master.
5000679.c21_s1: Pigs sure are weird! Why do their bottoms curl up like that?
5000679.c21_s2: Isn't it hard walking on two legs, master?
5000679.c21_s3: Where are we going today? Anywhere's fine with me!
5000679.c21_f4: I don't feel like it... too much work...
5000679.c22_s2: I love you, you love me!
5000679.c22_f4: You show me something first, master!
5000679.c23_s1: Itsy bitsy seals and penguins, dancing at north pole!
5000679.c23_s3: Three seals in a house, daddy seal, mommy seal, and baby seal!
5000679.f3_s: You sure take good care of me, master!
5000679.f4_f: Don't you think I've gotten a little fat?
5000679.s2: What goes around, comes around, you know?
5000679.s3: I don't want to be a pottymouth!
5000679.s4: Words reflect your insides, you know?

5000682.c1_s2: Hey, let's not get mean here!
5000682.c2_s2: How can you say such a thing!
5000682.c3_s1: ...my love for you melts with each tear...
5000682.c3_s2: Joke? You didn't mean it... right?
5000682.c3_s3: I am so hurt right now...
5000682.c3_s4: Do you really not like me?
5000682.c3_f1: Watch that mouth--unless you want a snowball in it.
5000682.c3_f3: You need a new haircut, but I'm not saying anything.
5000682.c4_s4: Do you really not like me? That was mean...
5000682.c4_f1: Think snowballs don't hurt? Say that again and find out.
5000682.c4_f2: I hear Maple Claws is bringing you coal this year...
5000682.c4_f3: I'm so hot right now, I feel like melting!
5000682.c4_f4: You just told me you loved me!
5000682.c6_f4: I don't know what love is.
5000682.c7_s1: Now that just made my day~
5000682.c7_s2: Ahhhh... nothing feels quite like being loved~
5000682.c7_s3: Thank you... for loving me so much!
5000682.c7_s4: I love you too!  It's the holiday spirit!
5000682.c7_f1: You should only say that to someone you really love.
5000682.c7_f4: You just told me you didn't like me!
5000682.c8_s1: I know you love me. I can feel it~
5000682.c8_s3: That just made me feel awesome... I feel like flying~~
5000682.c8_s4: I love you too~ Tis the season of love!
5000682.c8_f1: You just love me for my snow.
5000682.c8_f3: I'm too cold to appreciate that.
5000682.c8_f4: Sorry, the snowman you're trying to reach isn't here. Leave a message after the beep... BEEP.
5000682.c10_s2: I've been waiting for this! Merry Christmas!
5000682.c10_s3: Did you get some nice Christmas presents?
5000682.c10_s4: I've been good this year. I hope Maple Claws will give me some presents this year!
5000682.c11_s3: Hope you get some awesome Christmas presents this year!
5000682.c11_s4: Christmas is upon is, and I hope you find your true love this year!
5000682.c11_f3: No presents? Then feed me--we'll call it even.
5000682.c12_s1: Merry Christmas to your friends and family!
5000682.c12_s2: Did you get a lot of presents?
5000682.c12_s4: Hope you enjoy a very Merry Christmas!
5000682.c12_f1: You can celebrate later.  Let's do something else now.
5000682.c12_f2: And you didn't get me anything.  Sometimes I wonder where you are in this relationship.
5000682.c12_f3: No presents? Are you kidding me?
5000682.c12_f4: Advice: Snowman + Christmas + No Presents = Failure.
5000682.c14_s3: What do you think of my eyes? Aren't they just adorable?
5000682.c14_s4: I'll do some cutesy stuff, as long as you give me some presents~
5000682.c14_f1: Get me the latest copy of Snowman Styles, and I'll do it.
5000682.c14_f2: Um...just because you said so?  Please.
5000682.c14_f4: What do you want me to do?
5000682.c15_s2: The best I got right now...
5000682.c15_s4: You like? I think I'm pretty cute...
5000682.c15_f1: I'm tired. I need some rest.
5000682.c16_s2: You know you like me~ I like you too!
5000682.c16_f1: You know what's cute?  Balrogs.  Let's go hunt some!
5000682.c16_f3: Yeah, whatever.  You just want something from me...
5000682.c16_f4: I just want to rest.  Maybe later.
5000682.c18_f2: What are you doing? I did nothing wrong.
5000682.c18_f3: Say it again! SAY. IT. AGAIN.
5000682.c19_s2: I won't ever do it again...
5000682.c19_f1: Do you want me to hit you with a snowball?
5000682.c19_f2: That's it.  Let's take this outside.
5000682.c19_f3: I won't ever do it aga--hahahaha!  Sorry, couldn't hold it in.
5000682.c19_f4: I dare you to say that again!
5000682.c20_s1: Please forgive me. It's really my fault.
5000682.c20_s3: I'll be good. I'm a good snowman.
5000682.c20_s4: I won't go against you. I'll behave.
5000682.c20_f1: I am not in a good mood. Don't push me.
5000682.c20_f3: If you keep doing that, I'll throw some snowballs at you.
5000682.c20_f4: I double dare you to say that again!
5000682.c21_s1: Did you get a lot of Christmas presents?
5000682.c21_s4: Winter's the best time of the year.  I hate summer...
5000682.c21_f2: I don't talk just because you tell me to.
5000682.c21_f3: You don't have friends, right? Why do you keep bothering me?
5000682.c22_s1: I'm right at home in El Nath!
5000682.c22_s3: You're such an awesome friend. Let's go hunting!
5000682.c22_f1: Am I the only friend you have?
5000682.c22_f3: Hah... no, I won't say anything.
5000682.c22_f4: I don't feel like talking. Let's go hunting.
5000682.c23_s1: I'm so cool...sorry, I had to!
5000682.c23_s3: Loved by many, appreciated by few. That's the life of a snowman for you.
5000682.c23_s4: Isn't Christmas awesome? What do you feel like getting?
5000682.c23_f1: Are you bored? Well, I'm not.
5000682.c23_f2: If you hang out with me more, then I'll talk.
5000682.c23_f3: How many Caramel Onions did you eat? I can smell your breath from here!
5000682.c23_f4: You told me to talk, and here you are, not listening. I'm hurt.
5000682.c24_s1: I'm tired... I need some sleep.
5000682.c24_s2: We did hunt a lot today... let's get some sleep.
5000682.c25_s2: How did you know I was tired?
5000682.c25_f1: Hey, I was dozing off until now! I wanna play!
5000682.c26_s2: I am soooo tired right now... zzzzz
5000682.c26_f1: I can't sleep. Let's go somewhere!
5000682.c26_f3: I can't sleep! I am too excited about those presents!
5000682.c27_s2: Did you see it? Or was it too fast for you?
5000682.c27_s3: What do you think? Don't I look awesome?
5000682.c27_f3: I refuse to change on an empty stomach.
5000682.c28_s1: I can do that! Look at me!!!
5000682.c28_s2: Pay attention, because you might miss it!
5000682.c28_s3: Nice, huh? There's nothing quite like it!
5000682.c28_f1: Why? Because you said so? Pfft...
5000682.c28_f2: Why don't you do it for once? There's a change for you!
5000682.c28_f3: Think it's that easy? I'd like to see you try!
5000682.f2_s: Awesome! There's nothing quite like icicles!
5000682.f3_s: Oh yeah! I love people that feed me!
5000682.f3_f: This is nasty. Do I look like a Turkey to you?

5000683.c2_s1: You want me to sit like this? bark?
5000683.c2_s2: I get sleepy sitting down, bark!
5000683.c2_s3: Ahh... this is easier~ BARK BARK~
5000683.c2_f1: I can't understand what the master is saying~ BARK BARK!
5000683.c2_f2: It's too hard to understand~ BARK BARK!
5000683.c2_f3: I have no clue what you said! Bark bark!
5000683.c2_f4: No. I don't want to sit! BARK BARK!
5000683.c3_s1: Master, this is how you sit, right? Woof!
5000683.c3_s2: Master, I'm doing well, right? Right? Woof woof!
5000683.c3_s3: I hope the master keeps asking me to sit...woof woof~
5000683.c3_s4: I have short legs, so it's easy to sit~ Woof woof!
5000683.c3_f1: Master, I can't tell what you're saying~ Woof woof~
5000683.c3_f2: Master, do I HAVE to sit right now? Woof woof!
5000683.c3_f3: Let's do something else right now~ Woof woof!
5000683.c3_f4: It's too dirty to sit here! Woof woof!
5000683.c4_s1: Still telling me to sit? It's waaay too easy...
5000683.c4_s3: My hind legs are so short. I feel more comfortable sitting like this... hehe...
5000683.c4_s4: You want me to sit? Here... this is the right way, right?
5000683.c4_f1: Ahh... itchy... (acting like I didn't hear it...)
5000683.c4_f2: Sitting is waaaay too easy. Give me something harder.
5000683.c4_f3: (scratching) Whoa? What did you just say? I didn't hear you~
5000683.c6_s2: Please don't give me that look... bark bark!
5000683.c6_f1: Krrr...Do you want to be punished by ME?
5000683.c6_f2: I didn't do anything wrong! BARK BARK!
5000683.c6_f3: I was just sitting here... BARK BARK!
5000683.c6_f4: Krrrr...One of these days, I won't take it anymore... BARK BARK!
5000683.c7_s4: Master, I'll be careful from here on out... wooof...
5000683.c7_f1: Master! Things like that happen at times... why so mad? Woof woof!
5000683.c7_f2: Master, boredom doesn't give you the right to abuse me! Woof woof!!
5000683.c7_f3: Where else will you find a cute pet like this? Krrrr...
5000683.c7_f4: I didn't do anything wrong! Woof woof!
5000683.c8_s1: Master... I'll be more careful next time...
5000683.c8_f1: Man, master's going off on me again and I didn't do a thing...
5000683.c8_f2: Master, things happen sometimes... why so mad??
5000683.c8_f3: Rrrr... master's not happy over nothing...
5000683.c10_s2: I'll be better... bark... much better...
5000683.c10_s3: I'm hurt inside... pretty bad... bark...
5000683.c10_s4: How can you say such thing... bark...

5000694.c17_f4: I'm going to tape my eyes open.

5000694.c19_f3: You really think you can keep up?

5000694.c20_s3: Feed me lots of yummy treats, okay?
5000694.c20_s4: Nobody in Maple World stand's a chance against MY cuteness!
5000694.c20_f2: Why don't you just keep... doing what you do?
5000694.c21_s2: You think you can take me? Let's try!
5000694.c21_f2: Let's just have a moment of silence, okay?
5000694.f2_f: Are you blind? Can't you see that I'm full?
5000694.s2: I don't want to be a pottymouth!
5000694.s4: I'd never say that. Not in a million years.

5000695.c2_s1: Landed too hard. Bruised my butt.
5000695.c2_f1: Ah... I'm so hungry... I can't hear anything...
5000695.c2_f4: I want to do something else...
5000695.c3_s2: Come on, take a seat and have a chat.
5000695.c3_f2: I can't hear you, I can't hear you!
5000695.c4_s1: I will wait here and have some juice.
5000695.c4_s2: You should come over here. Next to me.

5000695.c4_s4: I'm going to get some sleep.
5000695.c4_f2: Ahh, I'm sleepy. Can't hear you...
5000695.c4_f3: You can't always get what you want.
5000695.c4_f4: I don't like being ordered around!

5000695.c6_s3: I know I messed up, but you still have to feed me, okay?
5000695.c6_s4: I'm sorry! I won't eat dinner tonight...
5000695.c6_f3: Keep scolding and I'll run away!
5000695.c6_f4: I don't understand what I did wrong!
5000695.c7_s3: Hey, relax! I was just messing around!
5000695.c7_s4: I'm going to assume that you said that because you love me...
5000695.c7_f3: I'm gonna have to punish you...
5000695.c7_f4: Why do you hit me? What did I do wrong?
5000695.c8_s2: Please calm down. I get it now.
5000695.c8_s4: Be nice to me! Please! I'm sorry!
5000695.c8_f1: Why are you only yelling at me?
5000695.c8_f3: Nope, not gonna feel bad! I'm gonna BE bad!
5000695.c8_f4: Do you really have to make me mad!?
5000695.c9_f2: Do you really have to make me mad!?
5000695.c10_s2: Always good to have your ear!
5000695.c10_s3: I'm so happy. Say it again, please?
5000695.c10_s4: You love just me, right? Just me!
5000695.c10_f1: Not just anyone can earn my love!
5000695.c10_f2: You aren't supposed to joke around like that.
5000695.c10_f3: You shouldn't say such things like that!
5000695.c11_s2: That's good. We are partners, after all.
5000695.c11_s3: Absolutely! I totally feel the same way.
5000695.c11_f2: You are you, and and I am me, and that is all we'll ever be.
5000695.c11_f4: A tasty morsel is more precious than any words you could say.
5000695.c12_s1: This is the happiest moment of my life!
5000695.c12_s2: Can you see hearts in my eyes?
5000695.c12_s3: You're the strongest, bestest person I know.
5000695.c12_s4: Promise to love me forever and ever?
5000695.c12_f1: How many pets have you had before me?
5000695.c12_f2: If you keep saying that, I will just run away!
5000695.c12_f4: I love you like family, too!
5000695.c13_f3: Who do you think I am?
5000695.c14_f4: You can't order me to do everything!
5000695.c15_s3: Oh, I feel so much better! Are you going to poop, too?
5000695.c15_f2: How am I supposed to go when I don't have to?
5000695.c15_f3: You want me to do that HERE?!
5000695.c16_s2: You're not gonna run away while I sleep, right?
5000695.c16_s3: How can I sleep when I'm not sleepy?
5000695.c16_f2: You sleep. I'll take first watch.
5000695.c17_f1: I don't want to sleep yet.
5000695.c18_s3: Have some wonderful dreams! Dream of having billions of mesos!
5000695.c18_s4: If you want me to sleep, I'll sleep!
5000695.c19_s4: What do you want to hear?
5000695.c19_f3: You want to talk? Then feed me!
5000695.c19_f4: I don't know anything about that.
5000695.c20_s1: I want to play some games!
5000695.c20_s3: Aren't you curious... about what the Maple Admin looks like without her hat?
5000695.c20_s4: I can't talk to other pets. We don't speak the same language.
5000695.c20_f3: My throat still hurts from talking earlier...
5000695.c21_s1: Have you ever seen a Crimson Balrog in real life?
5000695.c21_s2: I wanna become stronger! Like a Crimson Balrog!
5000695.c21_s3: You better not cry, old man Cliff is coming to town!
5000695.c21_s4: I want to try some unique cuisine!
5000695.c21_f1: I don't like to talk that much.
5000695.f1_s: Heh heh, this is my favorite!
5000695.f1_f: I don't want to eat any more.
5000695.f2_s: You sure take good care of me!
5000695.f3_f: I'm gonna get fat if I eat any more...
5000695.s1: Mind your manners. You embarrass me.
5000695.s2: You want me to say what?
5000695.s3: I'd never say something like that!

5000698.c2_s2: It feels really comfortable to sit!
5000698.c2_f1: I don't want to do it... I feel so sad.
5000698.c2_f4: I want to go back to the patch...
5000698.c3_s4: It's good for bears to rest! A lot.
5000698.c6_s3: I'm going to put a candle in your head.
5000698.c6_f1: Come to think it, I feel so furious!
5000698.c7_s1: Why are you trying to pick a fight with me?
5000698.c7_f2: Don't say it unless you mean it!
5000698.c7_f3: How can you do this to me...
5000698.c7_f4: You went too far. I mean it...
5000698.c8_s2: I won't ever do that again!
5000698.c8_f1: You just bummed out a bear...
5000698.c8_f2: I am going to run away from home.
5000698.c8_f4: Be careful on the street at night.
5000698.c10_f3: Why are you doing this to me?
5000698.c12_s2: I'll always be at your side.
5000698.c13_f2: Why are you asking me to do that?
5000698.c13_f4: You do it first. Go on!
5000698.c14_s1: Hahaha, I did it! I took a dump!
5000698.c14_f2: I don't want to take a dump now.
5000698.c14_f3: Not now... It's all fluffy down there.
5000698.c15_f3: I'm going to do it at my home.
5000698.c16_s1: Leave my light on! I'm scared of the dark.
5000698.c16_f4: You may go to bed first.
5000698.c17_s4: I have to go to bed.
5000698.c18_s3: I am in the dream world.
5000698.c19_s1: Hold on, I have to think about this.
5000698.c19_s2: There were three bears in a house...
5000698.c19_s4: It's all because of a bear!
5000698.c20_s1: Sometimes us bears get a little snoozy.
5000698.c20_s3: The word for bear is 'bear' in Korean.
5000698.c20_f3: You should be able to spend time alone.
5000698.c21_s1: A bear's belly is as round as a plate.
5000698.c21_s2: I've been a fool for my entire life until now. A fluffy fool!
5000698.c21_s3: Are you interested in gall bladders? Because that's gross.
5000698.f4_s: I am going to eat everything here!
5000698.s2: Huh? How could you do that?
5000698.s3: You're awful! Don't tell me about it.
