5000701.c2_s4: I want to sit... But I need exercise!
5000701.c3_s1: I'm not doing this for you!
5000701.c3_s2: Hey! Sitting or standing, my height doesn't change!
5000701.c3_s3: I'm so nice. I do whatever you say. I'm the best.
5000701.c3_f2: Sitting makes my butt look big!
5000701.c3_f4: No, I'm so short I don't need to!
5000701.c4_s1: Ugh, you can see my belly when I sit...
5000701.c4_s3: I guess I could do that... THIS time.
5000701.c6_s4: I guess I should stay quiet.
5000701.c7_s1: I'm sorry! I'm sorry! Don't hurt me!
5000701.c7_f2: Why am I so short compared to you? Not fair!
5000701.c8_f1: Oh yeah? Maybe I'll just stop eating!
5000701.c8_f3: You do that one more time, you'll never see me again.
5000701.c9_s2: I-It's a bit embarrassing... Let me just...
5000701.c10_s2: Now that you mention it, I love you too!
5000701.c10_f3: Are you saying you love me?
5000701.c11_s2: I guess I love you too?
5000701.c11_s3: Well, um... I kinda love you too!
5000701.c11_f2: That was a good one... ha ha...
5000701.c12_f4: Ha ha ha... What can I say?
5000701.c14_s2: Ahhh, that could heat an entire village for a month!
5000701.c14_s4: I-It's a bit embarrassing... Let me just...
5000701.c14_f1: How can I do that here?
5000701.c14_f4: Not here! I'll die of shame!
5000701.c15_f3: I feel like everyone is watching me.
5000701.c15_f4: I'll let you off for today...
5000701.c17_s3: Sorry, but I can't keep my eyes open...
5000701.c17_f4: I don't even have a blanket...
5000701.c18_f4: I don't want to go to bed...
5000701.c19_s2: I want to tell you about so many things...
5000701.c19_f2: I'd like to be alone now.
5000701.c19_f3: I want something fancy to eat! Octopus balls!
5000701.c20_s2: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5000701.c20_s3: My brain is just so full of... stuff!
5000701.c20_s4: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000701.c20_f3: I'm going to bed. I'm full, I said...
5000701.c21_s2: Yetis and Pepes have such a nice friendship...
5000701.c21_s3: Everything will be fine as long as you feed me.
5000701.c21_f2: I want some rest... I'm so tired.
5000701.c21_f4: Should I train to be a thief? It looks like fun...

5000702.c2_s4: If you want me to sit, fine.
5000702.c2_f4: I don't feel like it today.
5000702.c3_s1: Come here and sit next to me.
5000702.c3_s3: Good idea, I was feeling a bit tired.
5000702.c4_s2: I was going to take a break anyway.
5000702.c4_s4: If you want me to sit, then I'll sit.
5000702.c4_f1: Why are you ordering me around?
5000702.c4_f4: I don't feel good. Don't touch me!
5000702.c5_s2: Who do you think you are?
5000702.c6_s2: Awww... I hate being yelled at!
5000702.c6_f3: How could you get so angry at me?
5000702.c7_f1: Do you want to make me mad?
5000702.c7_f2: Take a look in the mirror, buddy.
5000702.c8_s2: I don't even know why I'm saying this, but sorry.
5000702.c8_f1: Are you sure you don't have a headache?
5000702.c11_s1: If you love me, gimme money!
5000702.c11_f2: Show your love with actions, not words.
5000702.c12_s1: How could you not? I'm adorable!
5000702.c13_s2: This is what it sounds like!
5000702.c13_f3: How can you make me do that?
5000702.c14_s4: I leave the rest to you.
5000702.c15_s4: That could go in a museum!
5000702.c15_f2: Don't talk to me about stuff like that.
5000702.c16_f2: You sleep. I'm gonna keep working hard.
5000702.c16_f3: Hey, I'm not the one with bags under their eyes.
5000702.c17_s1: Okay, but only because I want to.
5000702.c17_f4: I'm going to tape my eyes open.
5000702.c18_s1: I'm going to enjoy a nice, long sleep.
5000702.c19_s1: I love... boxing! Would you have guessed?
5000702.c19_s2: My weakness is my ears, but don't tell!
5000702.c19_s3: Some days, I just look at the world and smile.
5000702.c19_f2: What do you want me to say?
5000702.c20_s2: Takes me 20 minutes each day to do my hair!
5000702.c20_s3: Feed me lots of yummy treats, okay?
5000702.c20_s4: Master, what do you want from me?
5000702.c20_f1: Is that all you have to say?
5000702.c20_f2: Why don't you just keep... doing what you do?
5000702.c21_s3: Do you even have a nose?
5000702.c21_f3: Let's just have a moment of silence, okay?

5000703.c2_s1: Let's rest here for a while.
5000703.c2_s2: Am I good? Gimme a treat!
5000703.c2_s3: This is a marvelous place to sit!
5000703.c2_s4: Are you worried that my feet are tired?
5000703.c2_f3: I don't think you're taking this seriously!
5000703.c3_s1: You sit down, too! You look tired!
5000703.c3_s2: I like to take things nice and easy.
5000703.c3_s4: I love sitting on soft ground.
5000703.c3_f2: I think there's dirt on me!
5000703.c3_f4: I'm so cold. Gimme a blanket!
5000703.c4_s1: Okay! With you at my side, I can do anything!
5000703.c4_s3: I like your big, cushiony leg for that.
5000703.c4_f1: C'mon! Let's go see something cool!
5000703.c4_f3: If you want a seat, just take one yourself.
5000703.c4_f4: This is boring. Let's try something challenging!
5000703.c7_s2: Please don't be mad. You're my only family.
5000703.c8_s1: You're doing this for my own good, aren't you?
5000703.c8_s2: Hearing that makes me so sad.
5000703.c8_s4: I'm sorry for hurting your feelings...
5000703.c8_f2: It was just a tiny mistake.
5000703.c11_s1: I can't stop thinking about you!
5000703.c11_s2: You can say that a hundred times and I won't get tired of it.
5000703.c11_f3: Nah, let's just have some juice or something.
5000703.c12_s4: I'm happy that you're my buddy.
5000703.c12_f1: That's nice... But you smell funny.
5000703.c12_f2: I don't have the energy to reply.
5000703.c12_f3: Money over love, pal. Pay me!
5000703.c13_s3: I'll really pour myself into this one!
5000703.c14_s4: I clean up after myself. I'm so squeaky clean!
5000703.c14_f4: So many eyes here, I can't poop...
5000703.c15_s1: It feels soooooo good to go.
5000703.c15_s3: Will you play with me when I'm done?
5000703.c15_s4: So much poo... Like my love for you!
5000703.c15_f1: I don't know what poop is.
5000703.c16_f2: Are you sleepy? I'm not sleepy.
5000703.c16_f3: It's not time for bed yet.
5000703.c16_f4: It's not time to sleep yet!
5000703.c17_s3: We even sleep the same now!
5000703.c17_s4: I wanna sleep next to you!
5000703.c17_f1: You don't sleep, I don't sleep.
5000703.c17_f3: I'll see you in my dreams!
5000703.c18_s1: Good, I've been awake for too long...
5000703.c18_s3: Come lay down next to me.
5000703.c18_f1: Stop telling me what to do!
5000703.c18_f4: No, I want to talk and play!
5000703.c19_s3: If we run into something scary, you have to protect me.
5000703.c19_f1: What I'm going to tell you is totally secret...
5000703.c19_f3: Me no speak your language. Argh!
5000703.c20_s1: You look prettier with me at your side, don't you think so?
5000703.c20_s2: I'll eat whatever you feed me... because it's from you!
5000703.c20_s3: I'm slumming it just being seen with you.
5000703.c20_s4: I just wanna talk with you all day long!
5000703.c20_f1: With weather like this, I'm sure great items are bound to drop!
5000703.c20_f2: I don't have a big appetite, but anything you give me is good!
5000703.c20_f3: What do I need to say?
5000703.c20_f4: Give me all your potions and you can hunt more easily!
5000703.c21_s2: I really like beards. They're so soft and comfy.
5000703.c21_s4: I love the snow! Can we play in the snow?
5000703.c21_f3: I can't hear you! I hear nothing!
5000703.f1_s: This is the greatest flavor in the world!
5000703.f2_s: Everything you give me is good!
5000703.s2: What goes around, comes around, you know?

5000704.c2_s1: You are being considerate of me master? Thank you!
5000704.c2_f1: Can't I just stay like this?
5000704.c3_s2: Why don't we sit together master?
5000704.c3_s3: I love sitting on soft ground.
5000704.c3_f2: Okay. Rock, paper, scissors. Loser sits.
5000704.c3_f3: I can't. Hm, I wonder why.
5000704.c4_s1: How did you know I wanted some rest?
5000704.c4_f1: Carry me on your back, master!
5000704.c4_f3: Are you hurt? Why do you keep wanting to rest?
5000704.c4_f4: If you want a seat, just take one for yourself.
5000704.c5_f2: You should be setting an example for me.
5000704.c6_s2: *Whimper* Please don't yell at me like that. I like you.
5000704.c6_s3: Why are you doing this to your cute pet?
5000704.c6_f2: Did something bad happen at your school today?
5000704.c6_f4: There's been a misunderstanding, I'm telling you!
5000704.c7_s1: I feel bad as it is.
5000704.c7_s2: I love you and I am sorry.
5000704.c7_f1: It's hard to understand your words!
5000704.c7_f3: Dummy! You are a big dummy, master!
5000704.c7_f4: Don't say it unless you mean it!
5000704.c8_s1: I feel bad as it is. Please forgive me.
5000704.c8_s3: Master...I'm sorry for hurting your feelings...
5000704.c8_f1: Why are you so upset with me?
5000704.c8_f2: This is not unusual, and you're just overreacting.
5000704.c8_f4: Master, you always have such bad thoughts of me...
5000704.c10_s1: I like you today. I'll like you more tomorrow.
5000704.c11_s1: My heart always goes out to you!
5000704.c11_s4: I love you! I love you!
5000704.c11_f1: Yip? Of course you do! I'm adorable!
5000704.c11_f3: That's enough. Let's just drink some juice.
5000704.c12_s3: I'm happy that you're my master.

5000711.c20_s3: Manager Karl in Ludibrium is so kind.
5000711.c20_s4: I wonder if Pepes are related to Penguins.
5000711.c20_f1: Let's play a game... The game is to see who can be silent longer.
5000711.c20_f3: What do I need to say?
5000711.c20_f4: I don't have a big appetite, but anything master gives me is good!
5000711.c21_s2: I think you are the strongest in the world!

5000711.c21_f1: I can't hear you! I hear nothing!

5000712.c4_s2: Couldn't I just sit like this every day?

5000712.c7_s4: I love you and I am sorry.

5000712.c7_f4: Dummy! You are a big dummy, master!

5000712.c8_s3: Hearing that makes me so sad.
5000712.c8_f3: Why are you so upset with me?
5000712.c8_f4: Sure sure. You are always right. I will just pretend that away.
5000712.c9_s1: You are the only one for me!
5000712.c10_s1: I like you very much also!
5000712.c11_s2: The words are so sweet, I don't know what to do.

5000712.c11_s4: Your words are always so sweet.
5000712.c11_f2: Your words are not very convincing.
5000712.c11_f3: That's enough. Let's just drink some juice.
5000712.c11_f4: Are you falling in love with me?

5000712.c12_f2: How far do your exaggerations go?
5000712.c12_f4: I was going to call you master but... Nah, forget it.
5000712.c13_f1: You need to study up on common decency.
5000712.c13_f2: Think things through before you tell me what to do!
5000712.c13_f3: You ever heard of common decency?!
5000712.c14_s2: Poo Poo... Let's sing about it!
5000712.c14_f1: Why are you telling me to do this?
5000712.c14_f3: Really? You want me to do what?!
5000712.c14_f4: How many times a day do you want me to go?
5000712.c15_s1: This one looks just like me!
5000712.c15_s2: How did you know I had to go?

5000712.c15_f2: I need to pee. Can I pee?
5000712.c15_f3: I haven't eaten enough to poop.
5000712.c15_f4: I don't know what poop is.

5000712.c16_f3: I don't think it's time to sleep yet.

5000712.c17_s1: Wake me up when it's chow time!
5000712.c17_s4: I want to see you in my dreams, master.
5000712.c17_f1: You don't sleep, I don't sleep.
5000712.c17_f2: There's not even a bed! Why do you hate me?
5000712.c17_f3: Maybe you need a nap! Yip!
5000712.c18_s1: I am going to sleep with master!
5000712.c18_s2: You go to sleep too, master.
5000712.c18_s4: Enjoy your travels even if I sleep.
5000712.c18_f1: Isn't it too early for bed?
5000712.c18_f2: I am in no mood to sleep!
5000712.c18_f3: I want to play with master! Play I say!
5000712.c18_f4: Why are you always telling me what to do?

5000712.c19_s4: Human language is not easy to learn!
5000712.c19_f1: I want to chat, but that would be too loud.
5000712.c19_f2: What do you want me to say?

5000712.c19_f4: I will not say anything more.
5000712.c20_s1: I want to go on a journey with you, master!

5000712.c20_s4: Wish upon a star and it will come true!
5000712.c20_f1: Manager Karl in Ludibrium is so kind.
5000712.c20_f2: Wish upon a star and it will come true!
5000712.c20_f3: Are you bored? Let's got get a facial!
5000712.c20_f4: I am enjoying the solitude right now.
5000712.c21_s1: I think you are the strongest in the world!
5000712.c21_s2: We have been together a while. Maybe I should call you master now?

5000712.c21_s4: My wish is that you become happy.

5000712.c21_f4: I have no comment on that question.
5000712.f1_f: I don't want to be turned into a pig.
5000712.f3_f: I am full and I can't eat anymore!
5000712.s1: I am not going to listen to you, master.
5000712.s3: Pretty master, please use pretty words...
5000712.s4: Stop making me say such things.

5000713.c2_s1: Why don't sit next to me?
5000713.c2_f4: But I don't wanna lie down!
5000713.c3_s2: Okay, you should get some rest too.
5000713.c3_s3: I shall sit, but NOT because you told me to.
5000713.c3_f4: Don't tell me what to do.
5000713.c4_s1: Later, you sit and I hunt!
5000713.c5_s1: Who do you think you are?

5000713.c6_s4: I apologize with all my heart!
5000713.c6_f2: I can be really scary when I'm mad!

5000713.c8_s2: I might cry if you yell...
5000713.c8_s4: I don't even know why I'm saying this, but sorry.
5000713.c8_f3: I've only ever been nice to you!
5000713.c9_s2: So many fans, so little time to crush all their hearts.
5000713.c10_s2: So many fans, so little time to crush all their hearts.
5000713.c12_s2: How could you not? I'm adorable!
5000713.c12_f1: I know when people are being insincere.
5000713.c14_f1: Don't tell me what to do!
5000713.c14_f2: I'll pretend you didn't just say that.
5000713.c16_s4: Off to dreamland for me, then.
5000713.c16_f3: You sleep. I'm gonna keep working hard.
5000713.c17_s4: Nah. You sleep, I'm too buzzed.
5000713.c17_f1: I'm not sleepy. YOU go to sleep.
5000713.c17_f2: Let's play a little longer, okay?
5000713.c17_f3: I was just about to, until you said that.
5000713.c17_f4: I'm going to tape my eyes open.
5000713.c19_s1: My weakness is my ears, but don't tell!
5000713.c19_s2: I love... boxing! Would you have guessed?
5000713.c19_s4: Some days, I just look at the world and smile.
5000713.c19_f3: You really think you can keep up?
5000713.c20_s1: Takes me 20 minutes each day to do my hair!
5000713.c20_s3: Feed me lots of yummy treats, okay?
5000713.c20_s4: Nobody in Maple World stand's a chance against MY cuteness!
5000713.c20_f2: Why don't you just keep... doing what you do?
5000713.c21_s2: You think you can take me? Let's try!
5000713.c21_f2: Let's just have a moment of silence, okay?
5000713.f2_f: Are you blind? Can't you see that I'm full?
5000713.s2: I don't want to be a pottymouth!
5000713.s4: I'd never say that. Not in a million years.

5000714.c2_s1: Landed too hard. Bruised my butt.
5000714.c2_f1: Ah... I'm so hungry... I can't hear anything...
5000714.c2_f4: I want to do something else...
5000714.c3_s2: Come on, take a seat and have a chat.
5000714.c3_f2: I can't hear you, I can't hear you!
5000714.c4_s1: I will wait here and have some juice.
5000714.c4_s2: You should come over here. Next to me.
5000714.c4_s3: It's the perfect time to rest!
5000714.c4_s4: I'm going to get some sleep.
5000714.c4_f2: Ahh, I'm sleepy. Can't hear you...
5000714.c4_f3: You can't always get what you want.
5000714.c4_f4: I don't like being ordered around!
5000714.c6_s1: I didn't do it on purpose...
5000714.c6_s3: I know I messed up, but you still have to feed me, okay?
5000714.c6_s4: I'm sorry! I won't eat dinner tonight...
5000714.c6_f3: Keep scolding and I'll run away!
5000714.c6_f4: I don't understand what I did wrong!
5000714.c7_s3: Hey, relax! I was just messing around!
5000714.c7_s4: I'm going to assume that you said that because you love me...
5000714.c7_f3: I'm gonna have to punish you...
5000714.c7_f4: Why do you hit me? What did I do wrong?
5000714.c8_s2: Please calm down. I get it now.
5000714.c8_s4: Be nice to me! Please! I'm sorry!
5000714.c8_f1: Why are you only yelling at me?
5000714.c8_f3: Nope, not gonna feel bad! I'm gonna BE bad!
5000714.c8_f4: Do you really have to make me mad!?
5000714.c9_f2: Do you really have to make me mad!?
5000714.c10_s2: Always good to have your ear!
5000714.c10_s3: I'm so happy. Say it again, please?
5000714.c10_s4: You love just me, right? Just me!
5000714.c10_f1: Not just anyone can earn my love!
5000714.c10_f2: You aren't supposed to joke around like that.
5000714.c10_f3: You shouldn't say such things like that!
5000714.c11_s2: That's good. We are partners, after all.
5000714.c11_s3: Absolutely! I totally feel the same way.
5000714.c11_f2: You are you, and and I am me, and that is all we'll ever be.
5000714.c11_f4: A tasty morsel is more precious than any words you could say.
5000714.c12_s1: This is the happiest moment of my life!
5000714.c12_s2: Can you see hearts in my eyes?
5000714.c12_s3: You're the strongest, bestest person I know.
5000714.c12_s4: Promise to love me forever and ever?
5000714.c12_f1: How many pets have you had before me?
5000714.c12_f2: If you keep saying that, I will just run away!
5000714.c12_f4: I love you like family, too!
5000714.c13_f3: Who do you think I am?
5000714.c14_f4: You can't order me to do everything!
5000714.c15_s3: Oh, I feel so much better! Are you going to poop, too?
5000714.c15_f2: How am I supposed to go when I don't have to?
5000714.c15_f3: You want me to do that HERE?!
5000714.c16_s2: You're not gonna run away while I sleep, right?
5000714.c16_s3: How can I sleep when I'm not sleepy?
5000714.c16_f2: You sleep. I'll take first watch.
5000714.c17_f1: I don't want to sleep yet.
5000714.c18_s3: Have some wonderful dreams! Dream of having billions of mesos!
5000714.c18_s4: If you want me to sleep, I'll sleep!
5000714.c19_s4: What do you want to hear?
5000714.c19_f3: You want to talk? Then feed me!
5000714.c19_f4: I don't know anything about that.
5000714.c20_s1: I want to play some games!

5000714.c20_f3: My throat still hurts from talking earlier...

5000714.c21_s3: You better not cry, old man Cliff is coming to town!

5000714.c21_f1: I don't like to talk that much.

5000715.c4_s3: I like your big, cushiony leg for that.

5000715.c7_s4: You're still the best in my book...

5000715.c8_s2: I'm sorry for hurting your feelings...
5000715.c8_f1: How can you get so mad?
5000715.c8_f2: Why are you so upset with me?
5000715.c10_s3: When I met you, it was love at first sight!
5000715.c11_s1: I can't stop thinking about you!
5000715.c11_f3: Wow... Are you falling in love with me?
5000715.c11_f4: What can I say to that?
5000715.c12_s4: If you tell that to another pet, I'll bite you!
5000715.c12_f2: Money over love, pal. Pay me!
5000715.c12_f3: How far do your exaggerations go?
5000715.c12_f4: I was going to say something, but... Nah, forget it.
5000715.c13_s4: I'll really pour myself into this one!
5000715.c14_s1: I clean up after myself. I'm so squeaky clean!
5000715.c14_f1: How many times a day do you want me to go?
5000715.c14_f2: So many eyes here, I can't poop...
5000715.c15_s3: This one looks just like me!
5000715.c15_f2: I think there's something wrong with you.
5000715.c15_f3: I'm dignified. I don't poop in public!
5000715.c15_f4: I think you like poop way too much!
5000715.c16_f1: It's not time for bed yet.
5000715.c16_f2: I think I'm going to pass out.
5000715.c16_f3: I can't fall asleep in this noisy place!
5000715.c16_f4: Are you sleepy? I'm not sleepy.
5000715.c17_s1: I wanna sleep next to you!
5000715.c17_s3: Good thinking! It's time for sleep!
5000715.c17_s4: I'll see you in my dreams.
5000715.c17_f1: I don't see a bed, do you?
5000715.c17_f3: You don't sleep, I don't sleep.
5000715.c17_f4: Can't I just sleep when I want to?
5000715.c18_s2: This was a such a long day!
5000715.c18_s3: I sleep better when I'm near you.
5000715.c18_f2: Do YOU see anywhere to sleep here?
5000715.c18_f3: Stop telling me what to do!
5000715.c18_f4: You're not planning to ditch me, are you?
5000715.c19_s1: What do you like about me the most?
5000715.c19_s2: If you're tired, I'll carry you.
5000715.c19_s3: You hunt. I'll feed you potions.
5000715.c19_s4: Pets can talk. Isn't that weird?
5000715.c19_f1: What do you want me to say?
5000715.c19_f2: Me no speak your language. Argh!
5000715.c19_f3: I have a lot on my mind lately...
5000715.c19_f4: I don't talk. That's how I am.
5000715.c20_s1: I am not talking to you because I like you.
5000715.c20_s2: I'll eat whatever you feed me... because it's from you!
5000715.c20_s3: I just wanna talk with you all day long!
5000715.c20_s4: I'm slumming it just being seen with you.
5000715.c20_f1: I'm enjoying my me time right now.
5000715.c20_f2: Give me all your potions and you can hunt more easily!
5000715.c21_s1: I'm sure I'm the only talking pet in the world!
5000715.c21_s2: I really like beards. They're so soft and comfy.
5000715.c21_s3: There's a statue that looks just like me at the Floating Market.
5000715.c21_s4: We have been together a while. Maybe I should call you master now?
5000715.c21_f2: Are you poking fun at me?!
5000715.c21_f4: I can't hear you! I can't hear you!
5000715.f4_f: I hate eating until my belly hurts...

5000716.c3_s4: I shall take... a low stance.
5000716.c3_f3: I will not hear of it!
5000716.c4_f2: If I sit, there will be no getting up!
5000716.c4_f3: But then the enemy can surprise us!
5000716.c4_f4: A ninja is like the wind. Wind does not sit.
5000716.c6_f1: I will not agree to that.
5000716.c6_f3: I was thinking of something else.
5000716.c6_f4: I don't understand what you are saying.

5000716.c7_f4: I do not want to rest yet.
5000716.c8_f3: I cannot follow such a command.
5000716.c8_f4: I do not want to rest yet.
5000716.c10_s2: Don't look at me like that.
5000716.c11_s4: I will not make the same mistake twice.
5000716.c11_f2: You have made a grave mistake.
5000716.c12_s2: No... A true ninja sheds no tears...!
5000716.c12_f2: It is you who is wrong!
5000716.c12_f3: Does it really matter that much?
5000716.c14_s4: I seem to have eaten too much...
5000716.c14_f4: That has been taken care of.
5000716.c15_s2: I will give it my all!
5000716.c15_s4: Done! Ready for my next mission!
5000716.c15_f3: Now is not a good time.

5000716.c16_f3: I do not care for your tone.
5000716.c16_f4: That is simply too much to ask.
5000716.c18_s4: You are the only one I serve.
5000716.c18_f4: Feed my stomach, not my heart.

5000716.c19_f4: Is that supposed to make me happy?
5000716.c20_f1: My love is for another ninja...
5000716.c20_f4: I will not fall for that again!
5000716.c21_f3: I see no need of that now.

5000716.c24_s2: Our enemy is on the move!
5000716.c24_s4: I will bring honor to my clan!
5000716.c24_f1: I have nothing to talk about.
5000716.c24_f4: This is no time for chatter.

5000716.c25_f2: I am meditating at the moment.

5000716.c26_s4: How about we race to 1000 KOs?
5000716.c26_f2: There is no time to play.

5000716.c28_s3: I have a talent for hide and seek.
5000716.c28_s4: How about hide and seek? I am... pretty good at that.
5000716.c28_f1: I am meditating at the moment.
5000716.c28_f3: I must concentrate on my training.
5000716.c29_s2: I have an unbeatable sleeping technique!
5000716.c29_s3: I am still deadly, even asleep!
5000716.c29_f1: I am fine. Let us continue.
5000716.c29_f2: I have matters to attend to.
5000716.c29_f3: The enemy could strike at any moment!

5000716.c30_f3: I lurk in the shadows, not sleep.

5000716.f4_f: I am picky about my sushi.
5000716.s3: I do not want to hear it.

5000717.c2_f1: Scram, my clothes are getting dirty.
5000717.c3_f4: Don't tell me what to do.
5000717.c4_s4: Why don't you take a break too?
5000717.c4_f1: Hmm. Don't block the path of a rabbit.
5000717.c4_f3: Too much dust here. Can't do it.
5000717.c4_f4: These clothes are pricey. I can't just sit down.

5000594.c8_f1: You're gonna get stuck if you don't stop!

5000780.c6_s2: Maybe I was a bit hard on you.

5000780.c6_f1: Who are you trying to hit right now?
5000780.c6_f2: You're angry about something so trivial?
5000780.c7_s1: You're starting to scare me, so stop it.
5000780.c7_s3: I'm sorry. It won't happen again.
5000780.c7_f1: What's wrong with you? I didn't do anything!
5000780.c7_f2: I told you I was sorry more than enough times!
5000780.c8_s2: You're saying I did something wrong...?
5000780.c8_f1: All you do is get angry, huh?
5000780.c8_f3: I won't take any more of this!
5000780.c9_s2: Of course you like me! Hmph!
5000780.c9_f1: Oh my, what is wrong with you?
5000780.c10_s4: I guess I'm okay with that...
5000780.c10_f2: Do I have to explain it to you?
5000780.c11_s4: You don't have to say anything...
5000780.c11_f2: I don't have to respond to that, right?
5000780.c11_f4: Don't stand so close to me!
5000780.c12_s1: I think I'll understand if you just tell me again.
5000780.c12_s3: Heh heh, I know there's no other pet like me.
5000780.c13_s2: Ungh... ungh... This is a secret!
5000780.c13_s4: Make sure to be my lookout!
5000780.c13_f1: Can you not act like we know each other?
5000780.c13_f2: Who're you saying is going to poop?!
5000780.c13_f3: Oh my! What are you talking about?
5000780.c14_s2: What's going on right now is a secret!
5000780.c14_s4: Ungh... My stomach was hurting anyway.
5000780.c14_f1: Oh my, that is just so... tsk.
5000780.c14_f3: You want me to do it here? Outside?
5000780.c14_f4: We are so not on the same page.
5000780.c15_s1: You're going to clean up after me.
5000780.c15_s2: I guess I can go a little. Ungh.
5000780.c15_s4: I'm checking to make sure it doesn't stink!
5000780.c15_f1: Ugh! Don't you have any shame?
5000780.c15_f2: How can you ask me to do something like that?
5000780.c15_f3: I'm just not going to say anything.
5000780.c16_s4: This is a nice spot to sleep... Yawn.
5000780.c16_f2: Are you asking me to sleep here?
5000780.c16_f3: Do you really think I can sleep here?
5000780.c17_s2: Snore... To be honest... I like you... Zzz
5000780.c17_s3: Yawn. How did you know I was sleepy?
5000780.c17_f2: How am I supposed to sleep outside?
5000780.c17_f3: You want me to sleep with the lights still on?
5000780.c18_s2: Yawn... Wake me up in 3 hours.
5000780.c18_s3: I was so tired today, too... Snore...
5000780.c18_s4: How am I supposed to... Zzz...
5000780.c18_f1: How am I supposed to sleep here?
5000780.c18_f2: Why don't you hand me a luxurious blanket first?
5000780.c18_f3: Don't you know anything about society?
5000780.c18_f4: How can you have so little common sense...
5000780.c19_s3: Hmm... I'm doing well thanks to you.
5000780.c19_s4: Exploring with you isn't so bad.
5000780.c19_f1: You ask me to do the strangest things!
5000780.c19_f3: Stop bothering me and go over there.
5000780.c20_s1: Well, talking is a basic skill.
5000780.c20_s3: I like the Yeti's pretty white fur...
5000780.c20_s4: Your hunting is pretty cool, I guess.
5000780.c20_f1: Will you leave me alone while I'm resting?
5000780.c20_f2: You want to play a word game?
5000780.c20_f4: You should be glad I'm nice enough to tolerate you.
5000780.c21_s1: A whale that flies in the sky... Awesome.
5000780.c21_s2: I think I enjoy talking with you.
5000780.c21_s3: That place we went to yesterday wasn't so bad.
5000780.c21_f1: I think you like me a little too much.
5000780.c21_f4: I'm in the middle of dressing, so please be quiet.
5000780.f1_s: Now this is worthy of my luxurious taste buds.
5000780.f1_f: I don't like crummy food like this!
5000780.f2_f: Are you giving me all this to eat?
5000780.f3_s: I want to eat that again next time.
5000780.f3_f: Why don't you eat this on your own?
5000780.f4_s: Thank you for taking care of me.
5000780.f4_f: How do you expect me to eat this?
5000780.s1: How can you say that? You really have no class, do you?
5000780.s2: How can you use a word like that? Sheesh, you're really exhausting!
5000780.s3: How do you not know that's a bad word?
5000780.s4: I don't want to put a word like that in my mouth!

5000781.c2_s1: This is a marvelous place to sit!
5000781.c2_f3: Can't I just stay like this?
5000781.c2_f4: I don't think you're taking this seriously!
5000781.c3_s4: Why don't you take a seat?
5000781.c3_f1: I think there's dirt on me!
5000781.c3_f2: I don't like the sound of that!
5000781.c3_f3: My legs aren't even hurting... do I really have to sit?
5000781.c4_s1: Some weather, huh? Let's relax for a while, master!
5000781.c4_s2: Perfect! I was just about to call you!
5000781.c4_s3: Anything for the wonderful person who feeds me!
5000781.c4_s4: I listened well, now where's my reward?
5000781.c4_f1: Let's just hang around here for a while.
5000781.c4_f4: If you want a seat, just take one yourself.
5000781.c6_f3: I am so nice... You've hurt me.
5000781.c7_s1: I didn't know any better. Forgive me!
5000781.c7_s2: Please don't be mad. You're my only family.
5000781.c7_f4: I am starting to not like you.
5000781.c8_s1: If you stop being mad, I will give you 100 kisses!
5000781.c8_s2: I'm just trying to please you!
5000781.c8_s4: Please forgive me, just this once.
5000781.c8_f1: How can you get so mad?
5000781.c8_f2: This is boring. Let's play something else!
5000781.c8_f4: It was just a tiny mistake.
5000781.c11_s2: You can say that a hundred times, and I won't get tired of it.
5000781.c11_f4: Wow... Are you falling in love with me?
5000781.c12_s3: You're the best master. I'll follow you forever!
5000781.c12_f3: That's nice... But you smell funny.
5000781.c12_f4: I don't have the energy to reply.
5000781.c14_s3: I clean up after myself. I'm so squeaky clean!
5000781.c14_f1: So many eyes here, I can't poop...
5000781.c14_f2: I can't just go anywhere! Eww!
5000781.c15_s1: Look at it! I sculpted it to look like you.
5000781.c15_s2: It feels soooooo good to go.
5000781.c15_s4: Watch out! Don't step on my poop!
5000781.c15_f1: You go poop then, if you're so set on it happening!
5000781.c15_f2: I just went. Did you forget?
5000781.c15_f3: I think there's something wrong with you.
5000781.c16_f2: Are you sleepy? I'm not sleepy.
5000781.c16_f4: I don't think it's time to sleep yet.
5000781.c17_s1: I'll see you in my dreams.
5000781.c17_s2: Good thinking! It's time for sleep!
5000781.c17_s4: I have much better dreams when I'm near you.
5000781.c17_f1: I don't see a bed, do you?
5000781.c17_f2: I sleep better when I'm near you.
5000781.c17_f3: At least sing me a lullaby!
5000781.c18_s1: I want to sleep on your lap...
5000781.c18_s2: Come lay down next to me.
5000781.c18_s3: I'll see you in my dreams!
5000781.c18_s4: Master, don't wake me up anytime soon!
5000781.c18_f1: No, I want to talk and play!
5000781.c18_f2: I am in no mood to sleep!
5000781.c18_f3: I will rest while I sit...
5000781.c18_f4: Why are you always telling me what to do?
5000781.c19_s1: You are so awesome today! I think I am in love!
5000781.c19_s2: You hunt. I'll feed you potions.
5000781.c19_s3: Nothing beats good food and a cuddle.
5000781.c19_f1: But I don't have anything to say...
5000781.c19_f2: Why is the sky so blue, then?
5000781.c19_f3: I don't talk. That's how I am.
5000781.c20_s3: I am not talking to you because I like you.
5000781.c20_s4: We all speak different languages, you know.
5000781.c20_f1: What do I need to say?
5000781.c20_f2: Are you bored? Let's go get facials!
5000781.c20_f3: Let me think of what I want to say...
5000781.c20_f4: If you feed me a lot, I'll love you even more.
5000781.c21_s1: You're the best. Nobody gives me as much food as you!
5000781.c21_s2: Do you know how to use scrolls?
5000781.c21_s3: Take me for a walk. I'm a total chick magnet!
5000781.c21_f4: I want to be alone once in a while.
5000781.f2_s: You've figured out what I like, huh?
5000781.f2_f: I hate eating until my belly hurts...
5000781.f4_f: Arg... I'm too full! It's impossible to eat anymore...
5000781.s2: How could you ask that of me?!

5000782.c2_s1: I hope no one notices I'm here... Eep!
5000782.c2_s3: Sitting like a ninja. Hee hee.
5000782.c2_f1: This place is filthy... I can't be here...
5000782.c2_f2: I just don't want to do it anymore...
5000782.c3_s2: I'm so nice. I do whatever you say. I'm the best.
5000782.c3_s3: I'm not doing this for you!
5000782.c3_s4: Hey! Sitting or standing, my height doesn't change!
5000782.c3_f1: I think I heard talking... let's check!
5000782.c3_f2: Sitting makes my butt look big!
5000782.c4_s1: Ugh, you can see my belly when I sit...
5000782.c4_s4: I guess I could do that... THIS time.
5000782.c4_f3: Forget it! I'm not doing anything you say!
5000782.c7_f1: Scolding is bad! Complimenting is good!
5000782.c8_f3: You do that one more time, you'll never see me again.
5000782.c10_s3: Now that you mention it, I love you too!
5000782.c10_f4: Are you saying you love me?
5000782.c11_s2: You're the best! The best in the whole wide world!
5000782.c12_f1: I already know how you feel...
5000782.c12_f2: Ha ha ha... What can I say?
5000782.c14_s2: I-I'm just a little bit shy...
5000782.c14_f4: Right next to you? Oh, please!
5000782.c15_s2: Like a little golden pile of sunshine!
5000782.c15_f1: I'll let you off for today...
5000782.c15_f2: I feel like everyone is watching me.
5000782.c17_f2: I don't even have a blanket...
5000782.c18_f3: I don't want to go to bed...
5000782.c19_s1: I want to tell you about so many things...
5000782.c20_s1: My brain is just so full of... stuff!
5000782.c20_s3: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000782.c20_s4: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5000782.c20_f2: There's nothing for me to say...
5000782.c21_s2: Yetis and Pepes have such a nice friendship...
5000782.c21_s3: Everything will be fine as long as you feed me.
5000782.c21_f3: I want some rest... I'm so tired.
5000782.s3: Why did you say that to me?

5000783.c2_s1: Just keep sitting. Just keep sitting.
5000783.c2_s3: Yeah, I'm sitting. No one sits like I do!
5000783.c2_s4: Oh, good. It was starting to get uncomfortable.
5000783.c3_s1: Uhh, I'm kind of already sitting. You know?
5000783.c3_s2: I'm sitting because it's comfortable and I wanted to.
5000783.c3_f1: I can't hear you. Rocks don't have ears.
5000783.c3_f2: I shall stay as still as stone.
5000783.c4_s1: This place makes me miss Arcana.
5000783.c4_s2: I suppose I could sit for you this time.
5000783.c4_s4: If it will make you happy, I'll sit.
5000783.c4_f1: I don't feel like listening right now.
5000783.c4_f2: I can't hear you. Rocks don't have ears.
5000783.c4_f3: Obey? I laugh at you. Ha!
5000783.c6_s1: I didn't mean it! I'm sorry!
5000783.c6_f1: Who do you think you are?
5000783.c7_f3: I only have so much patience.
5000783.c7_f4: Don't mess with me. I'm a rock, and rocks are tough.
5000783.c8_s1: I can admit when I'm wrong.
5000783.c8_s3: Sometime getting mad just feels better.
5000783.c10_f4: You're too scary! I don't feel good!
5000783.c11_s3: I totally feel the same way!
5000783.c11_f4: I have a secret fling... it's a slingshot! Ha!
5000783.c12_s2: I love you more than rock itself!
5000783.c12_s4: How did you know I like that word too?!
5000783.c12_f3: Arrogance is not flattering on you.
5000783.c14_s1: I just need a bit of quiet time.
5000783.c14_s2: Don't look at me! It's weird!
5000783.c14_s3: Pooping always makes me feel so much better!
5000783.c14_f3: That was kind of a waste, don't you think?
5000783.c15_s1: These are the good kind of tummy rumbles.
5000783.c15_s2: I have paper. Well... I ate paper...
5000783.c15_s3: You should do it with me!
5000783.c15_f1: What do you expect of me, really?
5000783.c15_f2: Has your common sense left you?!
5000783.c15_f4: Why would you do this to me. I'm so sad!
5000783.c16_s1: But I just went to sleep!
5000783.c16_s4: I can't wait to see you tomorrow!
5000783.c16_f4: All I'm hearing is muffled trumpet noises.
5000783.c17_s2: Okay, maybe I'm just a little bit tired...
5000783.c17_s4: I'm gonna sleep like a rock!
5000783.c17_f1: I can't sleep... there's too much awesome I could miss.
5000783.c18_s2: Nighty night. Don't let the rock bugs bite!
5000783.c18_s3: You can't make me get up. I'll just ragdoll if you try.
5000783.c18_f4: Have you ever seen a rock sleep?
5000783.c19_f1: Eating takes more energy than I have right now.
5000783.c19_f2: Let me relax in peace, please!
5000783.c20_s2: Feed me on time, or I'll pout a bunch.
5000783.c20_s3: I'm smarter than a box of rocks!
5000783.c20_s4: Rock beats scissors! And swords... And other stuff...
5000783.c20_f2: You go first to show me how it's done.
5000783.c21_s1: Two heads are better than one pet.
5000783.c21_s3: Don't you call me a paperweight!
5000783.c21_s4: This is such a beautiful place. Makes me want to sit like a lump in grass.
5000783.c21_f1: You need to ask reeeally nicely.
5000783.c21_f2: Teasing me is just plain mean.
5000783.c21_f3: No doesn't even begin to cover it.
5000783.c21_f4: I just imitate human noises, so you'll feed and love me.
5000783.f3_s: This is a lot to eat. Like... a lot.
5000783.f4_s: Ah, my taste buds are singing!
5000783.s1: I won't stoop to eat that swill.

5000828.c4_s2: I feel like something good will happen today! Let's go on an adventure!
5000828.c4_f1: I feel like a melting glacier...
5000828.s4: I'm going to tell on you to the GM!

5000829.c4_s2: I'm so glad you're my friend!
5000829.f3_f: That's got a pretty ruff taste!
5000829.s3: Ruff and tumble words are no fun!
5000829.s4: Grrr... You want a piece of me?!

5000830.c3_s1: How do you like my coat?
5000830.c4_s1: Thanks for always taking care of me!
5000830.c4_s2: I don't care where we go as long as it's with you.
5000830.c4_f1: I wanna take a nice long walk to the shop!
5000830.c4_f2: If I don't get home soon, I'll pancake right here!
5000830.s3: Ew, I don't like gruff language!

5000831.c4_s2: I want to be brave just like you!
5000831.f4_s: Thank you, thank you! So, so yummy!
5000831.f4_f: Blech! This is making my tummy hurt!
5000831.s3: Keep talking like that and I'll have to growl at you!
5000831.s4: Your language is barking up the wrong tree!

5000785.c4_s1: A loyal puppy will always do its master's bidding!
5000785.c4_s2: For you, I'll take on the whole world!
5000785.c4_f1: Sometimes earning your keep is ruff.
5000785.c4_f2: Just a wee puppy here, nothin' to say.
5000785.f2_f: Are you just messing with me?
5000785.f3_s: You've really got an eye for food!
5000785.f4_s: Feel free to buy this tasty chow in bulk!

5000644.c2_s2: Why should I listen to you?
5000644.c2_s3: Do I look like a dog to you? Sit, indeed!
5000644.c2_s4: Yes, perhaps I shall rest my wings. RAWK!!
5000644.c2_f3: Who are you to order me around? Hm?
5000644.c2_f4: Birds can't sit, you featherless buffoon!
5000644.c3_s1: I'm sitting already! I'm sitting RIGHT NOW!
5000644.c3_s2: Yes, yes, what is it?! I swear, if you tell me to sit one more time...
5000644.c3_s3: I would be DELIGHTED if you joined me! Don't you have a chair?
5000644.c3_s4: Very well. But what's this? No cushion?
5000644.c3_f2: You dare tell me to sit? RAWK!
5000644.c3_f3: Where shall I sit? On your shoulder? Or on your head?
5000644.c4_s1: The dictionary defines 'sit' as resting with the torso vertical and the body supported on the buttocks. Correct?
5000644.c4_s2: Yes, it's nice to sit with my intellectual equal. RAWK!
5000644.c4_s4: Yes, I am quite tired. We've been on a long journey, and I fear I've talked myself into a stupor. RAWK!
5000644.c4_f1: Why do you insist I sit?
5000644.c4_f2: Don't you know any other commands?!
5000644.c4_f4: No. No, that's quite all right. Rawk!
5000644.c6_s1: Perhaps I was bad. But you'll hear no apology from me!
5000644.c6_s3: Of course. It won't happen again. Whatever you say.
5000644.c6_s4: What can I say? My apologies.
5000644.c6_f4: What is the meaning of this? Unbelievable...
5000644.c7_s1: I've nothing to say to a tyrant like you!
5000644.c7_s2: How does throwing a temper tantrum help anything?
5000644.c7_s3: There's no need to be so forceful.
5000644.c7_s4: I understand. But is this really my fault?
5000644.c7_f2: I'll hear you out. What did I do wrong this time?
5000644.c7_f4: Rawk! Do you want an apology?
5000644.c8_s1: If you can explain to me what I did wrong, I will be more than happy to apologize.
5000644.c8_s2: Perhaps what I did was wrong, but will an apology REALLY make you feel better?
5000644.c8_s3: I know what I did was wrong! I don't need you to remind me.
5000644.c8_s4: Yes, I'm a bad parrot. Does that make you feel better?
5000644.c8_f2: I have nothing to say to you. RAWK!
5000644.c8_f3: I don't know what you're talking about, and I don't care!
5000644.c8_f4: Think this over. Don't you value our friendship? RAWK!
5000644.c10_s1: Love, love. Such a sweet word!
5000644.c10_s2: You like me? You really like me?
5000644.c10_s3: Is your love true? Oh, who cares!
5000644.c10_s4: I'd blush, but parrots can't blush...
5000644.c10_f1: Sorry, but my heart belongs to a little parakeet in Henesys.
5000644.c10_f3: But what will the other parrots think?
5000644.c11_s1: The love between parrot and master is forever!
5000644.c11_s2: Is it the color of my feathers that did it? Or the manly shape of my beak?
5000644.c11_s3: Sh, keep your voice down! You're embarrassing me...
5000644.c11_s4: Caaan you feeel the love tooooday...
5000644.c11_f2: No! I won't let you break this parrot heart!
5000644.c11_f3: Sure, you say that now, but isn't this just a flight of fancy?
5000644.c12_s1: My melancholy heart, once dark like Kerning City's nighttime sky, is brightened by your affection! CRAAAAW!!
5000644.c12_s2: Yes! Very good! Let's have fun! RAWK!
5000644.c12_s3: Thank you. Not that I feel the same way, but it's nice to hear.
5000644.c12_f1: You find me attractive? Is that what you're telling me?
5000644.c12_f2: Do you feel a special kinship for me? Or is it something more?
5000644.c12_f3: Love? I simply can't understand it.
5000644.c13_s2: Good idea to lighten the load. Makes it easier to fly. Rawk!
5000644.c13_s3: Rawk! You need a sample? I didn't know you were a doctor!
5000644.c13_s4: I feel so refreshed. I feel like I can fly! Rawk!

5000994.c8_f3: Please don't be mad at me.
5000994.c8_f4: You're going to make me cry!
5000994.c11_s3: I accept your love and send some back!
5000994.c11_f3: Oh, what's that shiny thing over there?
5000994.c11_f4: We're not having great weather today.

5000994.c12_f3: Love is such a strange thing.
5000994.c12_f4: It's rare for a human to love a fairy.

5000994.c13_s3: You have got to be kidding me. Right now?
5000994.c14_s4: How about a bit more solitude first?

5000994.c14_f4: I don't know the meaning of the word.
5000994.c15_s2: You have got to be kidding me. Right now?
5000994.c15_s3: Doesn't the cloud kinda look like...
5000994.c15_f4: Well, if I wasn't in a bad mood before, I am now.
5000994.c17_f1: A sprinkling of clouds in the sky would look perfect right now.
5000994.c17_f2: I don't want to sleep, but thanks for checking.
5000994.c18_s1: I'm gonna go to sleep now.
5000994.c18_f2: But I want to know more about monsters!
5000994.c18_f3: Wanna go shopping at the General Store instead?
5000994.c18_f4: Go make a friend if you're bored!
5000994.c19_s1: Do you have a special friend?
5000994.c19_s2: I know I'm a cutie pie!
5000994.c19_s3: Have you ever seen anything as pretty as me?
5000994.c19_f1: You've come to the right person. I'm the biggest chatterbox out there!
5000994.c20_s1: I love the color of the sky.
5000994.c20_s2: The prettiest clouds appear after it rains.
5000994.c20_s3: I wish the wind would blow all the dust away!
5000994.c20_s4: Do you like soda? I like soda.
5000994.c20_f2: I'm just going to close my eyes for a minute.
5000994.c21_s2: I want to snack on some nice, cold snow cones.
5000994.c21_s3: I'm more concerned about beautiful weather than anything else.
5000994.c21_s4: The bright moonlight is so beautiful!
5000994.f2_f: Hmm, that wasn't the flavor I was expecting!
5000994.f3_f: I won't be able to fly if I eat any more!
5000994.f4_s: This flavor is unbelievable! So good!
5000994.s1: Don't say bad words like that!
5000994.s2: You really shouldn't use bad words.

5000995.c2_f3: Why would I do that when I can fly?
5000995.c3_s1: Can you see clouds better when you're sitting down?

5000995.c4_s4: Come here and sit next to me.

5000995.c5_f1: You're not getting through to me at all.
5000995.c6_s3: I was bad! I was wrong! I admit it!
5000995.c6_s4: What are you gonna do? Ground me?
5000995.c7_f3: You want a piece of me?
5000995.c8_s3: Were you really angry with me?
5000995.c8_f2: But this is the way I am.
5000995.c8_f4: No! My sparkling personality didn't protect me!
5000995.c9_s2: Your love made me feel all sparkly!
5000995.c10_f2: I've succeeded in stealing your heart away.
5000995.c10_f3: It's rare for a human to love a fairy.
5000995.c11_f3: Are you sure you mean me?
5000995.c11_f4: This isn't the time for flowery declarations.
5000995.c13_s1: I would appreciate a bit of solitude.
5000995.c13_s2: Uh, I'm not sure I want to do that here.
5000995.c13_s3: Why would I poop on command?!
5000995.c13_s4: I can't do that, especially not with you staring at me!
5000995.c13_f2: Who do you think I am?
5000995.c13_f3: I'm a fairy for crying out loud!
5000995.c14_f2: Uh... I'll see you later, okay?
5000995.c14_f3: That kind of thing takes time.
5000995.c14_f4: How about I make cloud wisps instead?
5000995.c15_s3: You have got to be kidding me. Right now?
5000995.c15_f2: I'm gonna get mad at you!
5000995.c16_f1: I don't want to sleep, but thanks for checking.
5000995.c16_f3: Now I'm more awake than ever!
5000995.c16_f4: I'd rather go on a hunt.
5000995.c17_f3: Let's go for a walk together instead.
5000995.c18_f1: I am NOT going to sleep!
5000995.c18_f2: I'm not even a little sleepy.
5000995.c18_f4: I'd rather go on a hunt.
5000995.c19_s1: Sparkly shiny clouds are the best!
5000995.c19_s3: Wait, you walk around? You don't fly?
5000995.c19_s4: Aren't you totally jealous that I can fly?
5000995.c20_s1: Have you ever heard of fairy lessons?
5000995.c20_s2: Ooh, moonlight! We should make a wish!
5000995.c20_s3: I didn't like the food I got yesterday.
5000995.c20_s4: I'll always stay the same. Isn't that great?!
5000995.c20_f1: Move it, move it! Dance your butt off!
5000995.c21_s1: Look out! There's a monster behind you!
5000995.c21_s2: Humans make so many strange sounds!
5000995.c21_s3: Rainbows are my favorite thing after it rains.
5000995.c21_f3: I'm just going to close my eyes for a minute.
5000995.s2: Don't say horrible things like that!
5000995.s3: I think I need to teach you a lesson!
5000995.s4: Repeat after me: I won't use bad words again.

5000996.c3_s4: Good, my tail was getting heavy.
5000996.c3_f2: No one is going to stand guard?
5000996.c3_f3: If we sit, we can't seeeeeeeeee!
5000996.c4_s3: It's the perfect time to rest!
5000996.c4_f1: Meerkats are diligent! Just look at us!

5000996.c4_f3: We like to move it, move it!!
5000996.c6_f2: Don't talk to me like that!
5000996.c8_s2: Don't get mad at the kids...
5000996.c8_f1: You promised to be nice to us!
5000996.c8_f2: We want to go back to the desert!
5000996.c8_f3: We're gonna tell our family on your!
5000996.c11_s2: Better than the warm desert breeze!
5000996.c11_s4: All three of us like you!
5000996.c11_f1: Wah! You surprised all of us!
5000996.c12_s1: With us you get three times the love!
5000996.c12_s4: Triple the love, triple the fun!
5000996.c12_f2: Did you eat a poisonous scorpion or something?
5000996.c12_f3: You will never be part of our family!
5000996.c13_f3: You should be ashamed of yourself!
5000996.c14_f1: We have nothing left to give!
5000996.c14_f2: There's only one roll of toilet paper!
5000996.c15_s1: Every day is a healthy day!
5000996.c15_s2: We're gonna need another potty... Or two.
5000996.c15_s3: Make sure no one's looking, okay?
5000996.c15_f3: Not enough toilet paper! You should have known!
5000996.c15_f4: Are you trying to bring shame upon our family?
5000996.c16_f1: But we all want to play!
5000996.c16_f2: Look, the sun is still up!
5000996.c16_f3: Still a long way to go!
5000996.c17_f2: We don't need to sleep yet.
5000996.c17_f3: We sleep when we're sleepy, okies?
5000996.c18_s3: Okay team, let's settle down here...
5000996.c18_f1: It's unanimous, we are not sleepy.
5000996.c18_f2: We're not so keen on your ideas...
5000996.c18_f3: Why do you care so much about sleep? Lazy!
5000996.c18_f4: Is this going to make us closer?
5000996.c19_s1: You want to hear about the rest of our family?
5000996.c19_s2: We saw this weird place, with 'trees' or something.
5000996.c19_s3: We saw something weird earlier, but we can't agree on what.
5000996.c19_s4: If you want we can include you into our family!
5000996.c20_s1: So the secret to being a good lookout is...
5000996.c20_s2: That the thing on top of the youngest one's head is a firefly!
5000996.c20_s3: We never thought anywhere would be better than desert.
5000996.c20_s4: We love nice people like you!
5000996.c20_f2: We want to take a break.
5000996.c21_s1: Not all meerkats get to have a flower bloom on top of their heads.
5000996.c21_s2: Isn't it hard walking on two legs, master?
5000996.c21_s3: Where shall we go for today's adventure? We're excited!
5000996.c21_s4: Scorpions are tasty, but tarantulas are delicacies.
5000996.c21_f4: We voted and we don't feel like it...
5000996.c22_s2: We love you, you love us!
5000996.c22_f2: But we're shy! All of us!
5000996.c23_s1: We aren't on sand, but we'll give it a try!
5000996.c23_s2: When the three of us get together, there is nothing we can't accomplish!
5000996.c23_s3: We'll show you what meerkats are made of!
5000996.c23_f2: Do we ALL have to perform?
5000996.f3_s: You sure take good care of us!
5000996.f4_f: Don't you think the youngest got a bit chubbier?
5000996.s2: What goes around, comes around, you know?
5000996.s3: We don't like that! Not one bit!
5000996.s4: Words reflect your insides, you know?
