5000971.c1_s2: Hehe! Okay! I'm a good pet after all!
5000971.c2_s3: I'm sitting. But now I want to lie down.
5000971.c2_f2: My legs don't feel right... Wait. Do I even have legs?!
5000971.c2_f3: I don't want to sit. Sitting makes me look shorter.
5000971.c3_s1: I lost some weight! That makes sitting easier!
5000971.c3_f1: What's that? Is it something I can eat?
5000971.c3_f4: I refuse to sit anywhere that doesn't have a proper serving of wasabi.
5000971.c4_s1: I was actually feeling a bit tired!
5000971.c4_s3: What do you think? I even look cool sitting, right?
5000971.c4_s4: I wouldn't want to wear myself out...
5000971.c4_f3: Once I sit, I never get up. I warned you!
5000971.c5_f2: Na na! I can't hear you!
5000971.c6_s1: I didn't think it would make you angry...
5000971.c6_f4: I only ate ten bowls of food. That's all!
5000971.c7_s1: Don't get angry. I won't do it again...
5000971.c7_s2: I don't even know what I did.
5000971.c7_f1: Is it fun? Should I try?
5000971.c7_f3: Maybe I won't play with you anymore!
5000971.c7_f4: I'm going to work out... I have a big belly, you know.
5000971.c8_s2: You don't have to make such a big deal...
5000971.c8_s3: I'm so sorry, Master! Please forgive me!
5000971.c8_s4: I'll stop pooping on your socks...
5000971.c8_f1: You just keep punishing me! How about feeding me?
5000971.c8_f3: I don't listen. I learned that from you.
5000971.c8_f4: Why are you acting like this? Are you just angry all the time?
5000971.c9_s1: Of course! You can't help but love me!
5000971.c9_f1: Hmph. I'll bet you say that to all your pets.
5000971.c10_s1: You know what I'm gonna say!
5000971.c10_f1: Why don't you feed me before you say that?
5000971.c11_s2: Am I cuter than the other pets?
5000971.c11_f1: I love eating ramen with an egg in it.
5000971.c11_f2: That's not what I want to hear!
5000971.c12_s2: I was waiting so long for you!
5000971.c12_s3: Just what I wanted to hear!
5000971.c12_f1: Just feed me. No need for rest.
5000971.c12_f3: I want a cookie, but someone isn't buying me any...
5000971.c13_s1: Got any paper? I'm all out.
5000971.c14_s2: FRRRT! N-no, I made that sound with my mouth! Honest!
5000971.c14_s4: Consider that a favor. Now you owe me
5000971.c15_s2: Quick! Make sure no one's peeking!
5000971.c15_f1: You want to see me push?
5000971.c15_f2: I need to eat something first!
5000971.c15_f4: What? Where did that come from?
5000971.c16_f2: Don't tell me to go to sleep! I still want to play!
5000971.c16_f3: I only sleep on a full belly.
5000971.c16_f4: You just want me to go to sleep, so you can snack without me.
5000971.c17_s2: Nothing beats sleeping on a soft, fluffy bed of rice.
5000971.c17_s4: I'm not tired yet. Why are you forcing me to sleep?
5000971.c17_f2: You're going to run away as soon as I close my eyes!
5000971.c17_f3: I'm not sleepy yet. I'll pass.
5000971.c18_s2: I could sleep for three days straight.
5000971.c18_s3: Ah, I love snoozing with a good blanket.
5000971.c18_s4: You should rest, too. You can cuddle with me!
5000971.c18_f1: Bring me a big soft bed, and I'll think about it!
5000971.c18_f2: I'll take care of my own sleep schedule, thank you very much!
5000971.c18_f4: Sleep? That's what you do at night!
5000971.c19_s1: I really am the perfect pet!
5000971.c19_s2: I wanna go on a picnic!
5000971.c19_s3: Aren't I just the cutest thing you've ever seen?
5000971.c19_s4: When I look in the mirror, I can't help but admire my beauty!
5000971.c19_f1: How do you even know I want to talk?
5000971.c19_f2: Speak? You want me to speak? I can't speak!
5000971.c19_f4: I'm too hungry to talk. Feed me first.
5000971.c20_s1: I heard there's a pet park in Henesys! Let's go!
5000971.c20_s2: I think dolls are scary, mostly because I don't like being one.
5000971.c20_s3: I want to travel the world with you!
5000971.c20_s4: Can I talk to you? I think I'm too cute. What do I do?
5000971.c20_f1: I don't want to. Stop trying to make me!
5000971.c20_f2: I'm not gonna make a peep.
5000971.c20_f4: I'm hungry. Can I have food?
5000971.c21_s1: I can be a real chatterbox once you get me started.
5000971.c21_s2: Do you know what Water of Life tastes like? Is it delicious?
5000971.c21_s3: Want to hear a funny story? Well, maybe next time!
5000971.c21_s4: I've me a lot of pets, but honestly, I'm the cutest of them all!
5000971.c21_f1: If I speak, you'll say I'm too noisy, won't you?
5000971.c21_f2: Why don't we just go to sleep? Me first...
5000971.c21_f3: I should just pretend like I can't hear. This is fun!
5000971.c21_f4: Do you like it when I talk? Huh?
5000971.f1_f: Blech, how could you give me such an awful thing?
5000971.f2_f: Stop feeding me! I'm on a diet!
5000971.f3_s: Mm, so yummy! I give it five stars!
5000971.f3_f: Are you sure this is edible?
5000971.f4_f: Today I learned that eating can be hard...
5000971.s2: How could you say such a thing?
5000971.s3: What did you just say? I'm shocked!
5000971.s4: That was so rude. I'm so disappointed in you.

5000972.c2_s3: How did you know? I really needed to.
5000972.c2_f1: But then I'd have to put in a bunch of effort to get up again!
5000972.c2_f3: My butt shall only rest on fancy cushions.
5000972.c2_f4: Nah, my butt fell asleep the last time I did that.
5000972.c3_s1: Shall we rest a bit? Did you pack any sandwiches?
5000972.c3_s2: You know, not everyone would obey your every whim like this.
5000972.c3_s4: What else do you want from me?
5000972.c3_f1: I don't always feel like doing exactly what you tell me to.
5000972.c3_f4: And mess up my lovely buns? No thanks!
5000972.c4_s2: Well, since you asked so nicely...
5000972.c4_s3: I'm only sitting, because I felt like it.
5000972.c4_f2: No, I won't! I'll sit when I feel like it.
5000972.c4_f4: If I sit, I might get stuck to the floor.
5000972.c5_f1: You have no right to scold me!
5000972.c5_f2: Why are you doing this to me?!
5000972.c6_s1: Please don't be angry. I prefer it when you're happy.
5000972.c6_f1: I don't know what you're saying!
5000972.c6_f2: Stop it, or I'll get really angry.
5000972.c6_f4: Do I seriously have to listen to this?!
5000972.c7_s1: I'm sorry. I don't know what for, but I'm sorry.
5000972.c7_s3: I want to be with you more... That's why I...
5000972.c7_f1: If only I had a nicer owner...
5000972.c7_f4: You missed! You can't hit me!
5000972.c8_s1: I suppose I may have been in the wrong.
5000972.c8_s4: I'm going to sing to make you feel better!
5000972.c8_f1: How could you do this to me?
5000972.c8_f3: Why are you angry about small stuff?
5000972.c9_s2: It makes me happy to know you love me that much.
5000972.c9_f1: I totally feel the same way!
5000972.c10_s3: You'll stay with me forever and ever, right?
5000972.c10_f4: Um, wow, that was kinda out of nowhere!
5000972.c11_s3: I'm expressing my love through dance! Untz untz untz!
5000972.c11_f1: Wait. I think I just saw your nose grow!
5000972.c11_f2: I hope everyone in the world heard what you just said.
5000972.c11_f3: I'm sorry, but I'm kind of a loner by choice...
5000972.c12_f2: I'm sure you say that to all the cute pets.
5000972.c12_f3: Aw, you must be so lonely!
5000972.c13_s1: Do you maybe have some fiber to help things along?
5000972.c13_s3: Ah! Nothing lightens your load like a good poo!
5000972.c13_f1: No! My poop is for me and me alone!
5000972.c13_f2: Why? Are you collecting it or something?
5000972.c13_f3: How can I poop if you don't feed me?
5000972.c13_f4: Actually, I think it might be stuck in there.
5000972.c14_f1: I can't. My tummy's stuffed up.
5000972.c14_f3: You know, that's more of a private activity.
5000972.c14_f4: Are you providing the toilet paper?
5000972.c15_s2: Ah! Perfect pooping posture once again!
5000972.c15_s3: Ew! It stinks! Get rid of it, quick!
5000972.c15_s4: I know I'm cute, but no looking!
5000972.c15_f1: Ugh! Pooping is SO not a dignified activity.
5000972.c15_f3: That's a weird request. Is this some kind of prank?
5000972.c15_f4: I'll poop when I want... like right now!
5000972.c16_s1: You wanna take the first watch?
5000972.c16_s3: I feel safe when you're watching over me.
5000972.c16_s4: Fine. I'm sleeping. Stay awake if you want.
5000972.c16_f1: When I close my eyes, it gets dark, and I'm scared of the dark.
5000972.c16_f2: Going to sleep already? You're lazy!
5000972.c17_s1: Will you tuck me in please?
5000972.c17_f1: Sleep? At this low a level?
5000972.c17_f3: Can you even think of sleeping at your level?
5000972.c17_f4: Get me a comforter and I'll think about it.
5000972.c18_s2: You'll let me sleep in your lap, right?
5000972.c18_s4: I'm so glad you're here to watch over me.
5000972.c18_f1: Why do you keep telling me to sleep? I don't wanna!
5000972.c18_f3: Really? Just for that, I'll stay up all night.
5000972.c18_f4: There's no time for sleep. You must level up!
5000972.c19_s1: I've been seeing a lot of friends that look just like me!
5000972.c19_s2: This is me talking. See? I'm talking.
5000972.c19_s3: Do you think sushi is slimy? I don't think sushi is slimy.
5000972.c19_s4: Have you ever been to Esfera?
5000972.c19_f1: You've gotta be tough, like me!
5000972.c19_f2: Forget it! Why don't we just go and hunt?
5000972.c19_f3: I'm holding out for a better offer. You understand, right?
5000972.c20_s1: Have you ever made a cake? Cake is awesome.
5000972.c20_s3: Your arms and limbs are really stumpy!
5000972.c20_s4: You're almost as cute as I am!
5000972.c20_f1: You can force me to talk, but it doesn't mean I'll like it!
5000972.c20_f2: Why must you keep talking to me?
5000972.c20_f3: I swear, I'm not as talkative as you seem to think I am.
5000972.c20_f4: Can you even understand what I say?
5000972.c21_s1: I used to have a lot more friends. I wonder how they're doing...
5000972.c21_s2: People should always have a good hobby.
5000972.c21_s3: I hear Lachelein is a city of festivals! I wanna visit!
5000972.c21_s4: Your head is so big! But in a cute way, I swear!
5000972.c21_f4: Shouldn't we try to socialize with others when we're out and about?
5000972.f1_s: The food you give me is so much better than anything else.
5000972.f1_f: I don't want to eat that. It's gross.
5000972.f2_s: I wish we could share this. It's so good!
5000972.f3_s: I'm so glad I can eat something so delicious!
5000972.f3_f: Stop feeding me! I'm on a diet!
5000972.s2: Who taught you to speak that way?!
5000972.s3: How could you say such a thing? You're embarrassing me!
5000972.s4: Hey! You're not supposed to say things like that.

5000846.c1_f1: I don't want to right now.
5000846.c2_s2: Oh, good. I was getting tired.
5000846.c2_s3: Ah... This feels nice. I want to stay like this.
5000846.c2_s4: I don't want to get up...
5000846.c2_f1: I don't want to sit here.
5000846.c2_f3: I want to do something else.
5000846.c3_f1: I want to go somewhere comfy.
5000846.c3_f2: I can't see anything if I sit.
5000846.c3_f4: I don't want to sit... I want to lie down...
5000846.c4_s1: Let's rest a bit and then continue.
5000846.c4_s3: I was waiting for those words. Nice!
5000846.c4_f1: Why do I have to do that?
5000846.c4_f4: I don't want to sit. I want to lie down.
5000846.c5_s1: I didn't realize you wouldn't like that...
5000846.c7_s1: Are you mad because I was lying around?
5000846.c7_f3: I was just lying here the whole time.
5000846.c8_s3: I don't want to be punished... Don't hit me...
5000846.c8_f2: I'm not going to talk to you.
5000846.c10_f2: Go to the hospital if you're feeling sick.
5000846.c12_s4: You're annoying, but I still like you!
5000846.c12_f1: You don't ever let me rest...
5000846.c13_s2: I was holding it in. What a relief.
5000846.c13_s4: I don't want to get up...
5000846.c13_f3: I'm lazy, but going in front of people is a bit...
5000846.c14_s2: What a relief. I was holding it in.
5000846.c14_s3: I'm lazy but I need to pee.
5000846.c14_s4: Cover your ears for a moment.
5000846.c14_f2: No, there's no place for that.
5000846.c14_f3: I don't want to. I'm lazy.
5000846.c14_f4: I'll do it when there's a bush.
5000846.c15_s4: Now I'll know for the next time.
5000846.c15_f1: It doesn't just come out whenever.
5000846.c15_f2: I don't want to when someone's looking.
5000846.c16_f3: I just want to lie down.
5000846.c17_s4: Zzz... Master... I don't want to go yet...
5000846.c17_f2: I'm lazy but I'd rather go home and sleep.
5000846.c17_f3: I can't sleep on a hard surface.
5000846.c19_s2: I want to get some sun and take a nap.
5000846.c19_s3: It'd be nice to sleep on the pet walkway...
5000846.c19_s4: I want to lie on a comfy cushion.
5000846.c20_s1: The monster I saw earlier was scary... I feel like I'm going to have nightmares.
5000846.c20_s2: If I had pajamas... I'd probably sleep better, right?
5000846.c20_s3: I wonder how it feels to sleep in an aquarium?
5000846.c20_f3: I'm sleepy. I don't want to.
5000846.c20_f4: Later... When I'm not so sleepy.
5000846.c21_s2: If only I could do everything lying down...
5000846.c21_s3: I like talking because I can do it while lying down.
5000846.c21_s4: I heard, in Elluel, there are sleeping elves...
5000846.c21_f1: I don't want to right now.
5000846.c21_f2: I'll lie down. Tell me a story.
5000846.c21_f4: I want to rest... I'm so tired.
5000846.f1_f: I don't want to eat this.
5000846.f2_s: Even if I'm lazy, I gotta eat.
5000846.f2_f: I want to lie down now.
5000846.f3_s: Food is just as great as lying down.
5000846.f4_s: You need energy to lie down too.
5000846.s3: I don't want to say those words.

5000847.c1_f1: No! I want to play right now!
5000847.c1_f2: I haven't had time to rest! Even for a little!
5000847.c2_f1: You're already going to take a break?
5000847.c2_f2: I don't want to sit! Let's play some more!
5000847.c2_f4: I don't want to! You sit by yourself!
5000847.c3_s2: How did you know I was tired?
5000847.c3_s3: Here! Come sit next to me!
5000847.c3_f2: Later! I wanna play some more!
5000847.c4_s2: Great! Let's rest for a bit!
5000847.c4_s3: I said sit next to me!
5000847.c4_s4: Let's rest a bit and then play again!
5000847.c6_s1: I'm sorry, Master. Let's play while resting...
5000847.c6_s2: Eek! If you look at me with a scary face like that...
5000847.c6_s3: Next time I won't play so much...
5000847.c6_s4: Sorry! I won't do it next time!
5000847.c6_f3: If you keep doing that, I'm going to go by myself!
5000847.c6_f4: I want to go to the Pet Walkway! I'm angry!
5000847.c7_s1: Sorry! I won't do it again...
5000847.c7_s3: Are you angry? Please don't be angry...
5000847.c7_f2: Stupid! Master doesn't even know anything!
5000847.c7_f3: Why are you scolding me again?
5000847.c7_f4: I told you I wasn't going to do it again!
5000847.c8_s1: Sorry... I'm so tired of being scolded...
5000847.c8_s4: I'll be careful while taking a walk...!
5000847.c8_f2: Is it wrong to have fun?!
5000847.c8_f3: How come you're only scolding me?
5000847.c8_f4: No! I'm not going to listen!
5000847.c9_s2: I'm so happy I can't stay still!
5000847.c9_f2: I couldn't hear you! What did you say?
5000847.c10_s1: Thank you for going on a walk with me!
5000847.c10_s2: I'm so happy! I love running.
5000847.c10_s3: All right! I'm feeling great! Ten laps at the pet walkway! Go!
5000847.c10_s4: I love you! As much as I love going on walks!
5000847.c10_f2: I won't be fooled again! You did that last time and we didn't go on a walk!
5000847.c10_f3: Hm... I'd rather go for a walk...
5000847.c11_s3: Walks with you are the best!
5000847.c11_f1: All right, I get it. Let's go for a walk now!
5000847.c11_f2: What's up? I want to go on a walk!
5000847.c11_f3: What's going on all of a sudden? Are we not going on a walk?
5000847.c11_f4: Master! Say it looouuuder! What'd you say?
5000847.c12_s2: Ha! You felt the same way as me!
5000847.c12_s3: Let's go on walks every single day!
5000847.c12_s4: I'm so happy! Master! Thank you!
5000847.c12_f2: Hm... Let's go for a walk!
5000847.c12_f4: I going to get punished now?
5000847.c13_f2: How am I supposed to go outside?
5000847.c13_f3: I don't poop outside! That's obvious!
5000847.c13_f4: Master... I see you differently now...
5000847.c14_s3: Pretend you didn't see that! Ungh!
5000847.c14_s4: I was just about to do it! Great!
5000847.c14_f1: How can you make me do that?
5000847.c14_f2: I don't need to go yet!
5000847.c14_f3: I think I can if I run around for a bit!
5000847.c14_f4: Let's go take a walk right now!
5000847.c15_s2: This is why I need to exercise more! Ungh!
5000847.c15_s4: Wait a moment! I'll be done soon!
5000847.c15_f1: I think I need to exercise more! It won't come out!
5000847.c15_f3: Ah! I didn't eat after taking a walk! Let's eat first!
5000847.c15_f4: I don't want to unless it's in a bathroom!
5000847.c16_s1: I'm going to sleep first. Night!
5000847.c16_f1: We're not done with our walk yet!
5000847.c16_f2: Master! Look outside! It's so sunny!
5000847.c17_s2: I wanna take a walk in my dreams too...!
5000847.c17_s3: Yaaawn. I had a great time playing today too!
5000847.c17_s4: I'll see you in my dreams, Master!
5000847.c17_f2: We didn't go on our walk yet!
5000847.c17_f3: You said we were going on a walk today...
5000847.c18_s1: I'm going to have fun tomorrow too... Snore...
5000847.c18_s2: I have to sleep now if I want to go on a walk tomorrow!
5000847.c18_s3: Snore... snore... mm... let's run some more, Master...
5000847.c18_f2: But it's too early to sleep!
5000847.c18_f3: Go on and sleep! I'm going to play some more before I go to bed.
5000847.c19_s1: Yesterday's walk was so much fun!
5000847.c19_s2: I want to run in the snowfields of El Nath!
5000847.c19_s3: Is it true you can swim in Aquarium?
5000847.c19_s4: I'm not going to lose when we meet a monster someday!
5000847.c19_f1: What kind of Master makes you talk!
5000847.c19_f2: What? What do you expect me to say?
5000847.c19_f3: You talk first! Then I'll go!
5000847.c19_f4: Pant pant... I can't because I'm breathless from running.
5000847.c20_s1: Taking a walk with Master is the best!
5000847.c20_s3: Pet Walkway of Ludibrium... or Henesys? I can't choose!
5000847.c20_s4: Do you still need to get ready to go for a walk?
5000847.c20_f1: I don't like sitting and talking!
5000847.c20_f2: I don't have anything to say...
5000847.c20_f4: I want to go outside instead of wasting my time like this!
5000847.c21_s1: I want to spend my entire life exploring with Master!
5000847.c21_s3: It's a perfect day for a walk!
5000847.c21_f1: Talk! Talk! Talk! Now let's go play!
5000847.c21_f2: I'll go on a walk by myself then!
5000847.c21_f3: But I don't have anything to say...
5000847.c21_f4: I don't have time for this, Master!
5000847.f3_s: Yum! Do you want to try some?
5000847.f4_s: I'm going to go on a walk after I'm done eating!
5000847.f4_f: I'm so full, I can't move.
5000847.s2: Master! What do you think you're saying?
5000847.s4: What?! 100 laps around the Pet Walkway as punishment!

5000848.c1_s2: I guess I can sit for you.
5000848.c1_f1: How am I supposed to sit here?
5000848.c1_f2: You want me to sit here?
5000848.c2_s2: Hm... Guess it's kind of comfy.
5000848.c2_s3: You should've told me to sit earlier... hmph.
5000848.c2_s4: Well, I guess this is comfy.
5000848.c2_f2: I don't want to sit right now.
5000848.c2_f3: You want me to sit again?
5000848.c2_f4: Why are you ordering me around?
5000848.c3_s1: I think I'm a little sleepy.
5000848.c3_s2: I'm not sitting because you told me to...
5000848.c3_s3: I'm sitting because I want to. Don't get the wrong idea.
5000848.c3_s4: Yawwwn. Oh my, why are you still standing?
5000848.c3_f3: I don't really want to sit.
5000848.c3_f4: Oh, my! Are you ordering me to?
5000848.c4_s1: This is warm and kinda nice.
5000848.c4_s3: I'll be here resting. You can go on yourself.
5000848.c4_f1: What? Can you tell me again?
5000848.c4_f2: Don't you think it's about time we did something else?
5000848.c4_f3: Haven't you asked me for enough?
5000848.c5_s1: I think I was wrong this time.
5000848.c5_f1: Is that something to be angry about?
5000848.c5_f2: What in the world? Be quiet!
5000848.c6_s1: Sorry... Well... I'm sorry this time.
5000848.c6_s2: Maybe I was a bit hard on you.
5000848.c6_s3: I'll think about what I did.
5000848.c6_f1: Who are you trying to hit right now?
5000848.c6_f2: You're angry about something so trivial?
5000848.c7_s1: You're starting to scare me, so stop it.
5000848.c7_s3: I'm sorry. It won't happen again.
5000848.c7_f1: What's wrong with you? I didn't do anything!
5000848.c7_f2: I told you I was sorry more than enough times!
5000848.c8_s2: You're saying I did something wrong...?
5000848.c8_f1: All you do is get angry, huh?
5000848.c8_f3: I won't take any more of this!
5000848.c9_s2: Of course you like me! Hmph!
5000848.c9_f1: Oh my, what is wrong with you?
5000848.c10_s4: I guess I'm okay with that...
5000848.c10_f2: Do I have to explain it to you?
5000848.c11_s4: You don't have to say anything...
5000848.c11_f2: I don't have to respond to that, right?
5000848.c11_f4: Don't stand so close to me!
5000848.c12_s1: I think I'll understand if you just tell me again.
5000848.c12_s3: Heh heh, I know there's no other pet like me.
5000848.c13_s2: Ungh... ungh... This is a secret!
5000848.c13_s4: Make sure to be my lookout!
5000848.c13_f1: Can you not act like we know each other?
5000848.c13_f2: Who're you saying is going to poop?!
5000848.c13_f3: Oh, my! What are you talking about?
5000848.c14_s2: What's going on right now is a secret!
5000848.c14_s4: Ungh... My stomach was hurting anyway.
5000848.c14_f1: Oh my, that is just so... tsk.
5000848.c14_f3: You want me to do it here? Outside?
5000848.c14_f4: We are so not on the same page.
5000848.c15_s1: You're going to clean up after me.
5000848.c15_s2: I guess I can go a little. Ungh.
5000848.c15_s4: I'm checking to make sure it doesn't stink!
5000848.c15_f1: Ugh! Don't you have any shame?
5000848.c15_f2: How can you ask me to do something like that?
5000848.c15_f3: I'm just not going to say anything.
5000848.c16_s4: This is a nice spot to sleep... Yawn.
5000848.c16_f2: Are you asking me to sleep here?
5000848.c16_f3: Do you really think I can sleep here?
5000848.c17_s2: Snore... To be honest... I like you... Zzz
5000848.c17_s3: Yawn. How did you know I was sleepy?
5000848.c17_f2: How am I supposed to sleep outside?
5000848.c17_f3: You want me to sleep with the lights on?
5000848.c18_s2: Yawn... Wake me up in 3 hours.
5000848.c18_s3: I was so tired today, too... Snore...
5000848.c18_s4: How am I supposed to... Zzz...
5000848.c18_f1: How am I supposed to sleep here?
5000848.c18_f2: Why don't you hand me a luxurious blanket first?
5000848.c18_f3: Don't you know anything about society?
5000848.c18_f4: How can you have so little common sense...
5000848.c19_s3: Hmm... I'm doing well thanks to you.
5000848.c19_s4: Exploring with you isn't so bad.
5000848.c19_f1: You ask me to do the strangest things!
5000848.c19_f3: Stop bothering me and go over there.
5000848.c20_s1: Well, talking is a basic skill.
5000848.c20_s3: I like the Yeti's pretty white fur...
5000848.c20_s4: Your hunting is pretty cool, I guess.
5000848.c20_f1: Will you leave me alone while I'm resting?
5000848.c20_f2: You want to play a word game?
5000848.c20_f4: You should be glad I'm nice enough to tolerate you.
5000848.c21_s1: A whale that flies in the sky... Awesome.
5000848.c21_s2: I think I enjoy talking with you.
5000848.c21_s3: That place we went to yesterday wasn't so bad.
5000848.c21_f1: I think you like me a little too much.
5000848.c21_f4: I'm in the middle of dressing, so please be quiet.
5000848.f1_s: Now this is worthy of my luxurious taste buds.
5000848.f1_f: I don't like crummy food like this!
5000848.f2_f: Are you giving me all this to eat?
5000848.f3_s: I want to eat that again next time.
5000848.f3_f: Why don't you eat this on your own?
5000848.f4_s: Thank you for taking care of me.
5000848.f4_f: How do you expect me to eat this?
5000848.s1: How can you say that? You really have no class, do you?
5000848.s2: How can you use a word like that? Sheesh, you're really exhausting!
5000848.s3: How do you not know that's a bad word?
5000848.s4: I don't want to put a word like that in my mouth!

5000849.c1_s2: Hehe! Okay! I'm a good pet after all!
5000849.c1_f1: How am I supposed to sit here?
5000849.c1_f2: You want me to sit here?
5000849.c2_s3: I'm sitting. But now I want to lie down.
5000849.c2_f2: My legs don't feel right... Wait. Do I even have legs?!
5000849.c2_f3: I don't want to sit. Sitting makes me look shorter.
5000849.c3_s1: I lost some weight! That makes sitting easier!
5000849.c3_f1: What's that? Is it something I can eat?
5000849.c3_f4: I refuse to sit anywhere that doesn't have a proper serving of wasabi.
5000849.c4_s1: I was actually feeling a bit tired!
5000849.c4_s3: What do you think? I even look cool sitting, right?
5000849.c4_s4: I wouldn't want to wear myself out...
5000849.c4_f3: Once I sit, I never get up. I warned you!
5000849.c5_f2: Na na! I can't hear you!
5000849.c6_s1: I didn't think it would make you angry...
5000849.c6_f4: I only ate ten bowls of food. That's all!
5000849.c7_s1: Don't get angry. I won't do it again...
5000849.c7_s2: I don't even know what I did.
5000849.c7_f1: Is it fun? Should I try?
5000849.c7_f3: Maybe I won't play with you anymore!
5000849.c7_f4: I'm going to work out... I have a big belly, you know.
5000849.c8_s2: You don't have to make such a big deal...
5000849.c8_s3: I'm so sorry, Master! Please forgive me!
5000849.c8_s4: I'll stop pooping on your socks...
5000849.c8_f1: You just keep punishing me! How about feeding me?
5000849.c8_f3: I don't listen. I learned that from you.
5000849.c8_f4: Why are you acting like this? Are you just angry all the time?
5000849.c9_s1: Of course! You can't help but love me!
5000849.c9_f1: Hmph. I'll bet you say that to all your pets.
5000849.c10_s1: You know what I'm gonna say!
5000849.c10_f1: Why don't you feed me before you say that?
5000849.c11_s2: Am I cuter than the other pets?
5000849.c11_f1: I love eating ramen with an egg in it.
5000849.c11_f2: That's not what I want to hear!
5000849.c12_s2: I was waiting so long for you!
5000849.c12_s3: Just what I wanted to hear!
5000849.c12_f1: Just feed me. No need for rest.
5000849.c12_f3: I want a cookie, but someone isn't buying me any...
5000849.c13_s1: Got any paper? I'm all out.
5000849.c14_s2: FRRRT! N-no, I made that sound with my mouth! Honest!
5000849.c14_s4: Consider that a favor. Now you owe me
5000849.c15_s2: Quick! Make sure no one's peeking!
5000849.c15_f1: You want to see me push?
5000849.c15_f2: I need to eat something first!
5000849.c15_f4: What? Where did that come from?
5000849.c16_f2: Don't tell me to go to sleep! I still want to play!
5000849.c16_f3: I only sleep on a full belly.
5000849.c16_f4: You just want me to go to sleep, so you can snack without me.
5000849.c17_s2: Nothing beats sleeping on a soft, fluffy bed of rice.
5000849.c17_s4: I'm not tired yet. Why are you forcing me to sleep?
5000849.c17_f2: You're going to run away as soon as I close my eyes!
5000849.c17_f3: I'm not sleepy yet. I'll pass.
5000849.c18_s2: I could sleep for three days straight.
5000849.c18_s3: Ah, I love snoozing with a good blanket.
5000849.c18_s4: You should rest, too. You can cuddle with me!
5000849.c18_f1: Bring me a big soft bed, and I'll think about it!
5000849.c18_f2: I'll take care of my own sleep schedule, thank you very much!
5000849.c18_f4: Sleep? That's what you do at night!
5000849.c19_s1: I really am the perfect pet!
5000849.c19_s2: I wanna go on a picnic!
5000849.c19_s3: Aren't I just the cutest thing you've ever seen?
5000849.c19_s4: When I look in the mirror, I can't help but admire my beauty!
5000849.c19_f1: How do you even know I want to talk?
5000849.c19_f2: Speak? You want me to speak? I can't speak!
5000849.c19_f4: I'm too hungry to talk. Feed me first.
5000849.c20_s1: I heard there's a pet park in Henesys! Let's go!
5000849.c20_s2: I think dolls are scary, mostly because I don't like being one.
5000849.c20_s3: I want to travel the world with you!
5000849.c20_s4: Can I talk to you? I think I'm too cute. What do I do?
5000849.c20_f1: I don't want to. Stop trying to make me!
5000849.c20_f2: I'm not gonna make a peep.
5000849.c20_f4: I'm hungry. Can I have food?
5000849.c21_s1: I can be a real chatterbox once you get me started.
5000849.c21_s2: Do you know what Water of Life tastes like? Is it delicious?
5000849.c21_s3: Want to hear a funny story? Well, maybe next time!
5000849.c21_s4: I've me a lot of pets, but honestly, I'm the cutest of them all!
5000849.c21_f1: If I speak, you'll say I'm too noisy, won't you?
5000849.c21_f2: Why don't we just go to sleep? Me first...
5000849.c21_f3: I should just pretend like I can't hear. This is fun!
5000849.c21_f4: Do you like it when I talk? Huh?
5000849.f1_f: Blech, how could you give me such an awful thing?
5000849.f2_f: Stop feeding me! I'm on a diet!
5000849.f3_s: Mm, so yummy! I give it five stars!
5000849.f3_f: Are you sure this is edible?
5000849.f4_f: Today I learned that eating can be hard...
5000849.s2: How could you say such a thing?
5000849.s3: What did you just say? I'm shocked!
5000849.s4: That was so rude. I'm so disappointed in you.

5000850.c1_f1: How am I supposed to sit here?
5000850.c1_f2: You want me to sit here?
5000850.c2_s3: How did you know? I really needed to.
5000850.c2_f1: But then I'd have to put in a bunch of effort to get up again!
5000850.c2_f3: My butt shall only rest on fancy cushions.
5000850.c2_f4: Nah, my butt fell asleep the last time I did that.
5000850.c3_s1: Shall we rest a bit? Did you pack any sandwiches?
5000850.c3_s2: You know, not everyone would obey your every whim like this.
5000850.c3_s4: What else do you want from me?
5000850.c3_f1: I don't always feel like doing exactly what you tell me to.
5000850.c3_f4: And mess up my lovely buns? No thanks!
5000850.c4_s2: Well, since you asked so nicely...
5000850.c4_s3: I'm only sitting, because I felt like it.
5000850.c4_f2: No, I won't! I'll sit when I feel like it.
5000850.c4_f4: If I sit, I might get stuck to the floor.
5000850.c5_f1: You have no right to scold me!
5000850.c5_f2: Why are you doing this to me?!
5000850.c6_s1: Please don't be angry. I prefer it when you're happy.
5000850.c6_f1: I don't know what you're saying!
5000850.c6_f2: Stop it, or I'll get really angry.
5000850.c6_f4: Do I seriously have to listen to this?!
5000850.c7_s1: I'm sorry. I don't know what for, but I'm sorry.
5000850.c7_s3: I want to be with you more... That's why I...
5000850.c7_f1: If only I had a nicer owner...
5000850.c7_f4: You missed! You can't hit me!
5000850.c8_s1: I suppose I may have been in the wrong.
5000850.c8_s4: I'm going to sing to make you feel better!
5000850.c8_f1: How could you do this to me?
5000850.c8_f3: Why are you angry about small stuff?
5000850.c9_s2: It makes me happy to know you love me that much.
5000850.c9_f1: I totally feel the same way!
5000850.c10_s3: You'll stay with me forever and ever, right?
5000850.c10_f4: Um, wow, that was kinda out of nowhere!
5000850.c11_s3: I'm expressing my love through dance! Untz untz untz!
5000850.c11_f1: Wait. I think I just saw your nose grow!
5000850.c11_f2: I hope everyone in the world heard what you just said.
5000850.c11_f3: I'm sorry, but I'm kind of a loner by choice...
5000850.c12_f2: I'm sure you say that to all the cute pets.
5000850.c12_f3: Aw, you must be so lonely!
5000850.c13_s1: Do you maybe have some fiber to help things along?
5000850.c13_s3: Ah! Nothing lightens your load like a good poo!
5000850.c13_f1: No! My poop is for me and me alone!
5000850.c13_f2: Why? Are you collecting it or something?
5000850.c13_f3: How can I poop if you don't feed me?
5000850.c13_f4: Actually, I think it might be stuck in there.
5000850.c14_f1: I can't. My tummy's stuffed up.
5000850.c14_f3: You know, that's more of a private activity.
5000850.c14_f4: Are you providing the toilet paper?
5000850.c15_s2: Ah! Perfect pooping posture once again!
5000850.c15_s3: Ew! It stinks! Get rid of it, quick!
5000850.c15_s4: I know I'm cute, but no looking!
5000850.c15_f1: Ugh! Pooping is SO not a dignified activity.
5000850.c15_f3: That's a weird request. Is this some kind of prank?
5000850.c15_f4: I'll poop when I want... like right now!
5000850.c16_s1: You wanna take the first watch?
5000850.c16_s3: I feel safe when you're watching over me.
5000850.c16_s4: Fine. I'm sleeping. Stay awake if you want.
5000850.c16_f1: When I close my eyes, it gets dark, and I'm scared of the dark.
5000850.c16_f2: Going to sleep already? You're lazy!
5000850.c17_s1: Will you tuck me in please?
5000850.c17_f1: Sleep? At this low a level?
5000850.c17_f3: Can you even think of sleeping at your level?
5000850.c17_f4: Get me a comforter and I'll think about it.
5000850.c18_s2: You'll let me sleep in your lap, right?
5000850.c18_s4: I'm so glad you're here to watch over me.
5000850.c18_f1: Why do you keep telling me to sleep? I don't wanna!
5000850.c18_f3: Really? Just for that, I'll stay up all night.
5000850.c18_f4: There's no time for sleep. You must level up!
5000850.c19_s1: I've been seeing a lot of friends that look just like me!
5000850.c19_s2: This is me talking. See? I'm talking.
5000850.c19_s3: Do you think sushi is slimy? I don't think sushi is slimy.
5000850.c19_s4: Have you ever been to Esfera?
5000850.c19_f1: You've gotta be tough, like me!
5000850.c19_f2: Forget it! Why don't we just go and hunt?
5000850.c19_f3: I'm holding out for a better offer. You understand, right?
5000850.c20_s1: Have you ever made a cake? Cake is awesome.
5000850.c20_s3: Your arms and limbs are really stumpy!
5000850.c20_s4: You're almost as cute as I am!
5000850.c20_f1: You can force me to talk, but it doesn't mean I'll like it!
5000850.c20_f2: Why must you keep talking to me?
5000850.c20_f3: I swear, I'm not as talkative as you seem to think I am.
5000850.c20_f4: Can you even understand what I say?
5000850.c21_s1: I used to have a lot more friends. I wonder how they're doing...
5000850.c21_s2: People should always have a good hobby.
5000850.c21_s3: I hear Lachelein is a city of festivals! I wanna visit!
5000850.c21_s4: Your head is so big! But in a cute way, I swear!
5000850.c21_f4: Shouldn't we try to socialize with others when we're out and about?
5000850.f1_s: The food you give me is so much better than anything else.
5000850.f1_f: I don't want to eat that. It's gross.
5000850.f2_s: I wish we could share this. It's so good!
5000850.f3_s: I'm so glad I can eat something so delicious!
5000850.f3_f: Stop feeding me! I'm on a diet!
5000850.s2: Who taught you to speak that way?!
5000850.s3: How could you say such a thing? You're embarrassing me!
5000850.s4: Hey! You're not supposed to say things like that.

5000997.c1_s1: Ever seen a pig tap dance? Me neither.
5000997.c1_s2: How about we discuss the merits of mud baths?
5000997.c1_f2: What do you want from me?
5000997.c2_s1: I don't know how my tail got so curly! Stop asking!
5000997.c2_s2: Ever seen a pig tap dance? Me neither.
5000997.c2_f1: Contrary to popular belief, not all pigs like to get dirty.
5000997.c2_f2: Do you have food for me? I really like pastries!
5000997.c3_s1: You know, I think you're starting to grow on me.
5000997.c3_s2: I like going on adventures with you!
5000997.c3_f1: I'm working on listening to my emotional needs more.
5000997.c3_f2: You can't just poke my stomach and expect me to squeal like some pastry mascot.
5000997.c4_s1: I've got a feeling today is going to be pretty great.
5000997.c4_s2: You're not gonna make me exercise again, are you?
5000997.c4_f1: I'm taking lessons in dancing and taekwondo. It's so challenging!
5000997.c4_f2: You really shouldn't annoy farm animals. We can get pretty mean.
5000997.f1_f: What do you want from me?
5000997.f2_s: There's so much to enjoy about this!
5000997.f3_s: Wow! You must have put some real effort into this. Thanks!
5000997.f3_f: I've had farm slop that tasted better.
5000997.f4_s: If I didn't know better, I'd say this was prepared by a gourmet chef!
5000997.f4_f: Few things in the world can inspire a pig to barf, but you've managed it.
5000997.s2: Have you thought about how your actions make others feel?
5000997.s3: That's pretty foul. You're not as nice as I thought.
5000997.s4: I don't have to listen to this garbage. Talk to me when you've changed your tune.

5000998.c1_f1: What do you want from me?
5000998.c1_f2: Do you have food for me? I really like pastries!
5000998.c2_s1: Have you thought about how your actions make others feel?
5000998.c2_s2: Contrary to popular belief, not all pigs like to get dirty.
5000998.c2_f1: I'm not just hot. I'm sizzlin'!
5000998.c2_f2: I'm starting a motorcycle fan club. We're called the Pork Choppers.
5000998.c3_s1: I'm running out of topics, but I'll do my best!
5000998.c3_s2: If we put our heads together, we can conquer the world!
5000998.c3_f1: Don't you ever get tired of talking? I know I do.
5000998.c3_f2: I'm all talked out for the day.
5000998.c4_s1: I'm going to take dancing lessons, and I will be amazing!
5000998.c4_s2: Now's our chance! Let's go be awesome!
5000998.c4_f1: Could we chat later? I'm not in the best mood right now.
5000998.c4_f2: Why are you always so demanding? I don't want to talk!
5000998.f1_s: Whoa! That is some primo chow right there!
5000998.f1_f: Do you have food for me? I really like pastries!
5000998.f2_s: Chomp, chomp, chomp! Munch, munch, munch!
5000998.f2_f: You, uh... got anything else I could try?
5000998.f3_s: I don't care if it's bad for me! I want to keep eating all day!
5000998.f3_f: Please don't make me eat any more. It's not even that good.
5000998.f4_s: Where do you keep finding all this amazing food?
5000998.f4_f: Stop making me eat sub-par food. It's not worth the calories.
5000998.s1: Do you have food for me? I really like pastries!
5000998.s2: I'm not just hot. I'm sizzlin'!
5000998.s3: I'm not looking for friends who talk like that.
5000998.s4: Isn't it exhausting being awful all the time?

5000999.c1_s2: You really are a chatty one, aren't you?
5000999.c1_f1: I'd love some ballet shoes to go with my tutu.
5000999.c1_f2: Tutus are the best! They make me look like a pudgy cupcake!
5000999.c2_s1: I'm not just hot. I'm sizzlin'!
5000999.c2_s2: You hear about the pig in the tanning bed? They said he was bacon!
5000999.c3_f2: I talk when I have something to say, not because I have to say something.
5000999.c4_s1: How I dance doesn't matter so much as what it communicates.
5000999.c4_s2: I really appreciate you hanging out with me, even when I'm grumpy.
5000999.c4_f1: Don't make me angry! I will DEFINITELY make you regret it.
5000999.c4_f2: Touch me, and you might lose a finger.
5000999.f1_s: What do you want from me?
5000999.f1_f: I'd love some ballet shoes to go with my tutu.
5000999.f2_s: I won't say no to free food.
5000999.f2_f: Wait, I'm confused. What do you want?
5000999.f3_f: Uhh... I don't feel so good...
5000999.f4_s: Food is more fuel for dancing and fighting! I'll take it!
5000999.f4_f: I think cardboard might be more nutritious.
5000999.s2: Wait, I'm confused. What do you want from me?
5000999.s3: Don't hit me unless you expect to get your butt kicked.
5000999.s4: Keep doing that. I dare you. I will not hesitate to retaliate.

5000855.c2_s2: I'm fully aware that I have short legs...
5000855.c2_s3: Ahh, nice. Maybe it's time for a nap.
5000855.c2_f2: This place is filthy... I can't be here...
5000855.c2_f3: I just don't want to do it anymore...
5000855.c3_s1: Not really... I'm not doing this for you!
5000855.c3_s3: With legs as short as mine, it doesn't matter!
5000855.c3_f1: No, you're going to make fun of me because I'm just as short standing as sitting!
5000855.c3_f3: I think I heard someone saying something...
5000855.c3_f4: Sitting makes my buttocks get bigger.
5000855.c4_s2: I guess I could do that... THIS time.
5000855.c4_s3: Ugh, my belly becomes really noticeable when I sit...
5000855.c4_f1: I'm never going to do it.
5000855.c6_s1: I guess I should stay quiet.
5000855.c6_f1: Huh? What are you even saying?
5000855.c7_s2: I'm going to crawl under a rock.
5000855.c7_f4: Don't take it out on me!
5000855.c8_s3: I'm full of tears! And they're coming out!
5000855.c8_f2: I'm going to find a new owner!
5000855.c10_s1: Now that you mention it, I love you too!
5000855.c10_f1: Are you saying you love me?
5000855.c11_s1: I guess I love you, too?
5000855.c11_s3: Well, um...I kinda I love you too!
5000855.c11_f3: That was a good one... ha ha...
5000855.c12_f2: Ha ha ha... What can I say?
5000855.c12_f3: I already know how you feel...
5000855.c14_s3: I-I'm just a little bit shy...
5000855.c14_f4: Not here! I'll die of shame!
5000855.c15_f1: I feel like everyone is looking at me.
5000855.c15_f2: I'll let you off for today...
5000855.c16_f2: Doot de doo, I can't hear you...
5000855.c16_f4: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...
5000855.c17_s1: I'm sorry to interrupt you, but I can't keep my eyes open...
5000855.c17_s3: I'm going to stay up all night... Zzz...
5000855.c17_f2: I don't even have a blanket...
5000855.c17_f3: The ground is so cold and hard...
5000855.c18_f1: I don't want to go to bed...
5000855.c19_s3: I want to tell you about so many things...
5000855.c19_f1: I want octopus balls... And fried noodles...
5000855.c19_f2: I feel too shy to talk.
5000855.c19_f4: I don't want to talk about it.
5000855.c20_s2: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5000855.c20_s3: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5000855.c20_s4: My brain is just so full of...stuff!
5000855.c20_f1: I'm going to bed. I'm full, I said...
5000855.c20_f2: There's nothing for me to say... I don't want to talk.
5000855.c21_s1: I'm jealous of Yeti and Pepe's relationship...
5000855.c21_s2: Everything will be fine as long as you feed me well.
5000855.f2_s: It's so delicious that it brings me to tears...
5000855.s1: I'll remember this! You watch out!
5000855.s2: Even we Demons know not to cross the line.

5002003.c1_s1: Did you know I'm always a teacher's pet?
5002003.c1_f1: Am I the apple of your eye?
5002003.c1_f2: I'm so sweet... Wait! Don't eat me!
5002003.c2_s2: What do you want to talk about?
5002003.c3_s1: You're A-OK! A for apple, that is!
5002003.c3_f1: Bobbing around all day isn't easy, you know.
5002003.c3_f2: Ugh, I feel like someone dropped me. Was it you?
5002003.c4_s1: Today's the day! Let's get to it!
5002003.c4_s2: On a scale of 1 to 10, I feel like a 100!
5002003.c4_f1: On a scale of 1 to 10, I feel like a 0...
5002003.c4_f2: This is just the pits. And I don't even have a pit!
5002003.f1_f: Huh? This is worse than applesauce!
5002003.f2_s: Ah! It's like music to my... tastebuds?
5002003.f3_s: I could eat this all day!
5002003.f4_s: You have pleased my tastebuds greatly.
5002003.s1: Well, you're a bad apple if I ever saw one!
5002003.s2: You're as bitter as my yucky seeds!
5002003.s4: Time to wash your mouth out with soap.

5002004.c1_s2: Aren't I just as sweet as pie?!
5002004.c1_f1: You wanna talk to me? Why?
5002004.c1_f2: Talk to me, but don't squeeze me. I bruise.
5002004.c2_s1: Well, aren't you just a peach!
5002004.c2_s2: I want a hug, but what if my insides smoosh out?
5002004.c2_f1: I'm not feeling all that chatty.
5002004.c2_f2: Mess with the peach and you'll get the pit!
5002004.c3_s2: I pride myself on being plump and delicious. That requires relaxation.
5002004.c3_f2: I'm so tired that just thinking about talking is hard.
5002004.c4_s1: Let's take our time, shall we?
5002004.c4_s2: Keep up the good work! You're great!
5002004.c4_f1: I need to relax! Nobody likes a stress peach!
5002004.c4_f2: I need to catch my breath first. Bouncing is hard!
5002004.f1_s: However did you find something so fresh and wonderful?!
5002004.f1_f: This is worse than bruised produce!
5002004.f2_f: Why would I like this mush? It looks like baby food.
5002004.f3_s: I could eat this all day!
5002004.f4_s: I'm going to slow down and really savor this.
5002004.f4_f: This meal is the absolute pits.
5002004.s1: Don't take that attitude with me, fruitcake.
5002004.s4: HEY! You can't treat me like this!

5002005.c1_s1: Gimme some sugar, and I'll be your best summer friend!
5002005.c1_f1: Can't you find something else to do?
5002005.c2_s1: I'll make sure you've always got a little zing in your life!
5002005.c2_s2: Between you and me, I'm terrified of juicers...
5002005.c2_f1: As a lemon, my cheeks are always puckered.
5002005.c3_s1: Let's roll! That's all I can do anyway. Ha!
5002005.c3_s2: Aw! You're the sugar to my lemon!
5002005.c3_f1: Nothin' doin', and you can't make me!
5002005.c3_f2: Not right now. My tummy's feeling a bit sour.
5002005.c4_s1: When life hands you lemons, don't turn me into lemonade!
5002005.c4_s2: I've got zest, zing, and everything in between!
5002005.c4_f1: No thanks. I'd rather do something fun.
5002005.c4_f2: Stop threatening to make lemonade. Then we can talk.
5002005.f1_f: I'm fruit! Why wouldn't you serve me the best!
5002005.f2_s: Hm, it could use a bit more zing, but I like it!
5002005.f2_f: As nature's dessert, I have much higher standards than this slop.
5002005.f3_f: I hate to say it, but this meal's a real lemon.
5002005.f4_s: I could eat this until I burst!
5002005.f4_f: There. I tried it. Can I spit it out now?
5002005.s3: Your attitude is like citric acid, and I don't mean in a good way.
5002005.s4: I've had it with you and your attitude!

5000852.c1_s2: Shall we have a heartfelt conversation?
5000852.c1_s3: Today's weather is making me want to open up.
5000852.c1_s4: Should we converse with beautiful eloquence?
5000852.c1_f1: I don't know what to say when you put me on the spot like that.
5000852.c1_f3: Huh? What are you getting at?
5000852.c1_f4: What are you going to make me do this time?
5000852.c2_s1: I'm a big fan of mellow, sensitive songs.
5000852.c2_s2: I don't like sad stories. They always have me breaking out the tissues.
5000852.c2_s3: It's nice to have someone to chat with now and then.
5000852.c2_s4: Can you tell me YOUR story?
5000852.c2_f1: You should show me how it's done first.
5000852.c2_f2: I'm tired right now. Let's talk later.
5000852.c2_f3: I'm not feeling inclined to converse.
5000852.c2_f4: Could you just...not bother me right now?
5000852.c3_s1: I want to belt out an awesome tune!
5000852.c3_s2: Everyone's got their own story they want to tell.
5000852.c3_s4: I've been waiting to talk with you!
5000852.c3_f1: Are you feeling lonely? You keep trying to make conversation.
5000852.c3_f2: You DO have other friends, right?
5000852.c4_s1: I'm looking forward to all our stories yet to be told.
5000852.c4_s2: I always appreciate the little moments we can share.
5000852.c4_s3: A story told with sincerity really feels life-affirming.
5000852.c4_s4: Tell me about this world's beauty, okay?
5000852.c4_f1: ...Huh? What were you saying? I was kinda lost in thought there.
5000852.c4_f2: I couldn't quite make out what you just said.
5000852.c4_f3: Wait, wait. I just thought of something really amazing! Don't bother me for a minute, 'kay?
5000852.c4_f4: I get that you're bored, but could you not pester me so much?
5000852.c6_s1: I must have messed something up, huh?
5000852.c6_f1: I don't know what I did wrong...
5000852.c6_f3: Why are you taking out your anger on me?
5000852.c7_s1: I'm sorry. Please don't be mad, okay?
5000852.c7_s3: I'll be more careful next time.
5000852.c7_f1: B-But I didn't do anything wrong!
5000852.c7_f2: It wasn't my fault! I didn't start it!
5000852.c7_f4: D-Don't take it out on me!
5000852.c8_s1: It was my fault. You'll forgive me, right?
5000852.c8_s3: I'm taking a little time out to reflect on my wrongdoings.
5000852.c8_f1: I don't think I did anything wrong, really...
5000852.c8_f2: I hate when you get mad for no reason.
5000852.c8_f3: Hey, I get mad sometimes too!
5000852.c8_f4: Why do you keep getting upset?
5000852.c10_f2: Ooof. If that was a joke, you've gotta work on your timing.
5000852.c11_s3: I'll summon up all my feelings!
5000852.c11_f2: You know I'm not gonna turn into a prince, right?
5000852.c11_f3: This is all just so sudden. I'm flustered!
5000852.c13_s2: Just out of the blue like that? Now I feel bashful.
5000852.c13_s4: I'm so happy I could take off like a rocket!
5000852.c13_f1: It takes more than just talk, y'know.
5000852.c13_f2: Are you being honest with me here?
5000852.c14_s2: That feels nice no matter how many times I hear it!
5000852.c14_s4: Thank you! I won't forget your kindness!
5000852.c14_f1: You've gotta say it like you mean it.
5000852.c14_f2: Don'tcha have anything more original to say?
5000852.c14_f3: It's embarrassing to hear something like that!
5000852.c16_s2: Hearing you say that really lifts my spirits!
5000852.c16_f1: You shouldn't say you love me if you don't really mean it...
5000852.c16_f2: Thanks, but...I don't really deserve your love.
5000852.c17_s1: Me too! Hearing that always gives me good vibes.
5000852.c17_s2: I guess we're feeling pretty simpatico!
5000852.c17_f1: You shouldn't treat love so lightly.
5000852.c17_f2: Why are you being suspiciously nice all of the sudden?
5000852.c17_f3: Well, that came out of nowhere.
5000852.c17_f4: I feel like I've heard that from you a million times.
5000852.c18_s3: I'm all about the hugs right now!
5000852.c18_s4: Nothing soothes the despairing heart like a warm hug!
5000852.c18_f2: A hug? Eh...how about a firm handshake instead?
5000852.c19_s4: I'm so happy I could burst!
5000852.c19_f1: C'mon, isn't that kind of childish?
5000852.c19_f2: I think I just need some space right now.
5000852.c19_f3: I'm not really in the mood.
5000852.c19_f4: I'm gonna assume you were just kidding.
5000852.c20_s2: A hug from you jazzes me right up!
5000852.c20_s3: I can't remember the last time I was as happy as I am today!
5000852.c20_s4: I feel lucky to have met you!
5000852.c20_f1: I'm glad you feel that way, but...maybe not right now.
5000852.c20_f3: You're acting even more childish than usual today.
5000852.c20_f4: Hmm... I'm just not feeling like it.
5000852.f2_f: I think I ate too much. *burrrp*
5000852.f3_f: Overeating will only make me fat.
5000852.s4: You shouldn't keep saying weird things like that!

5002021.c1_s1: No joke, I saw an astronaut in a flying car the other day.
5002021.c1_s2: I'm just wearing a ring to fit in with the cool planets.
5002021.c1_f1: Huh? What? Sorry. I spaced out for a second there.
5002021.c1_f2: I'm literally too cool to talk to you.
5002021.c2_s1: They named that candy bar after me, you know.
5002021.c2_s2: Visit Mars! I'm more than just a cold, unfeeling rock.
5002021.c2_f1: Talk to me until we're both red in the face. I don't care.
5002021.c2_f2: I'm not interested in idle chat. Take a space hike!
5002021.c3_s1: Why diet when you can just tell people your Mars weight?
5002021.c3_s2: I like you. When humans colonize Mars, you should visit.
5002021.c3_f1: Talk to me after my next revolution. You know, *way* later.
5002021.c3_f2: I'm not Earth, okay?! I only kind of like people!
5002021.c4_s1: I'm so amazing, even Sinatra sang about me!
5002021.c4_s2: I've had so many *opportunities* to make robot friends!
5002021.c4_f1: I'm not a space oddity! You're a space oddity!
5002021.c4_f2: Don't bother me! I'm named after a Roman god for a reason.
5002021.f1_s: Ah, I love a fresh surge of starlight in the morning!
5002021.f2_s: Wow! This stuff gets me totally wired!
5002021.f3_s: This star had a meaningful end... sustaining my molten core.
5002021.f3_f: You didn't even make it yourself!
5002021.f4_s: Dead stars are life! Or... well... They're life for me, I guess.
5002021.f4_f: Ah! It's too hot! What were you thinking?!
5002021.s1: You really think you can make ME feel guilty?
5002021.s2: You're insulting on a planetary scale!
5002021.s3: Stop everything you're doing. It's all wrong!
5002021.s4: Do you regret being mean, or are you as cold as my atmosphere?

5002022.c1_s1: My rings are all the bling I need.
5002022.c1_s2: You spin me right round, baby, right-- Oh wait, that's me!
5002022.c1_f1: I'm rotating, because I don't want to talk to you.
5002022.c1_f2: Can't you talk to someone a little closer to home?
5002022.c2_s1: How do you throw a swanky party in space? You plan-et, dahling.
5002022.c2_s2: My very educated mother just served us nine... What was it again?
5002022.c2_f1: No offense, but you've got to be an astronaut to hang with me.
5002022.c2_f2: In the vacuum of space, I can't hear a word you say.
5002022.c3_s1: All this rotating and revolving is bound to make a girl dizzy!
5002022.c3_s2: Nachos! My very educated mother just served us NACHOS!
5002022.c3_f1: My rings are so dusty! Let's chat after I've cleaned up.
5002022.c3_f2: I'm sorry. I can't sustain life or meaningful conversation.
5002022.c4_s1: That dog star never laughs at my jokes. He's way too Sirius.
5002022.c4_s2: Did you know they named a video game console after me?
5002022.c4_f1: When I'm ready to chat, I'll give you a ring.
5002022.c4_f2: You're just like my 62 friends... always mooning over me.
5002022.f1_s: Ah, this is a meal fit for superstars!
5002022.f1_f: Someone as well-to-do as me deserves better.
5002022.f2_s: I love the taste of raw energy!
5002022.f2_f: Did you just grab the first supernova you found? Ew.
5002022.f3_s: Who needs energy drinks when you can have a supernova!
5002022.f3_f: This supernova might make me a little gassy...
5002022.f4_s: You really went above and beyond for this meal!
5002022.f4_f: Ew, it tastes like it's 10 billion years old!
5002022.s1: You're more hostile than my environment.
5002022.s2: I'll forgive you for that... this time.
5002022.s3: Ouch! And I thought I was cold.
5002022.s4: You're just jealous of my rings, aren't you?

5002023.c1_s1: Blue is my favorite color! Good thing, huh?
5002023.c1_s2: Earth keeps telling me to get a life...
5002023.c1_f1: Stop telling me jokes about cling-ons!
5002023.c1_f2: Why all the jokes?! I don't even *have* a butt!
5002023.c2_s1: Keep Earth clean! After all, it's not Uranus.
5002023.c2_s2: My rings might not be as flashy as Saturn's, but I like them.
5002023.c2_f1: Don't bother chatting. I'm stone cold to the core.
5002023.c2_f2: What about me screams warm and friendly to you?
5002023.c3_s1: I might be the coldest planet, but your heroism warms my core.
5002023.c3_s2: Visit Uranus! I've got enough helium to talk like a chipmunk!
5002023.c3_f1: You know what else emits noxious gasses?
5002023.c3_f2: Got tired of contemplating your bellybutton?
5002023.c4_s1: Whatever happened to the ninth planet? I miss that little guy...
5002023.c4_s2: I love being in your orbit!
5002023.c4_f1: I'd rather chill right now, if that's okay with you.
5002023.c4_f2: Do we hafta chat? Orbiting the sun is so exhausting!
5002023.f1_s: Supernovas are almost as fun to look at as they are to eat.
5002023.f1_f: You're just trying to stuff me full of junk food!
5002023.f2_s: Mm... Maybe this will help me grow warm and volcano-y.
5002023.f2_f: If you are what you eat, then I should reconsider this...
5002023.f3_s: I'm picking up notes of tangy, flamey perfection!
5002023.f3_f: I'm a gas giant! Are you *trying* to make me explode?
5002023.f4_s: I like my meals like I like the sun... gaseous and blazing hot! Thanks!
5002023.f4_f: Oh, that definitely didn't agree with me...
5002023.s1: I'm cooler than a cucumber. You on the other hand...
5002023.s2: Watch it, or I might frostbite you!
5002023.s3: Is this how you treat all the friends in your orbit?
5002023.s4: I think I need some space... like, billions of miles of it.

5000866.c9_f2: I AM a charming cat, aren't I?

5000866.c12_s1: How could you not? I'm adorable!
5000866.c12_s3: You are the cruelest of all masters... and I like it.
5000866.c12_s4: Stick around. I might have some use for you.
5000866.c12_f2: I love people that don't talk too much.
5000866.c14_s4: This is a very important moment.
5000866.c15_f4: What is this poop you speak of?
5000866.c16_s4: Off to dreamland for me, then.
5000866.c17_s1: I'm going to sleep for ages!
5000866.c17_f2: Maybe if you weren't so NOISY.
5000866.c18_s2: I just want a little peace and quiet for now, thanks.

5000866.c19_s4: My weakness is my ears, but don't tell!

5000867.c2_f4: I want to do something else...
5000867.c3_s2: Come on, take a seat and have a chat.
5000867.c3_f2: I can't hear you, I can't hear you!
5000867.c4_s1: I will wait here and have some juice.
5000867.c4_s2: You should come over here. Next to me.
5000867.c4_s3: It's the perfect time to rest!
5000867.c4_s4: I'm going to get some sleep.
5000867.c4_f2: Ahh, I'm sleepy. Can't hear you...
5000867.c4_f3: You can't always get what you want.
5000867.c4_f4: I don't like being ordered around!
5000867.c6_s1: I didn't do it on purpose...
5000867.c6_s3: I know I messed up, but you still have to feed me, okay?
5000867.c6_s4: I'm sorry! I won't eat dinner tonight...
5000867.c6_f3: Keep scolding and I'll run away!
5000867.c6_f4: I don't understand what I did wrong!
5000867.c7_s3: Hey, relax! I was just messing around!
5000867.c7_s4: I'm going to assume that you said that because you love me...
5000867.c7_f3: I'm gonna have to punish you...
5000867.c7_f4: Why do you hit me? What did I do wrong?
5000867.c8_s2: Please calm down. I get it now.
5000867.c8_s4: Be nice to me! Please! I'm sorry!
5000867.c8_f1: Why are you only yelling at me?
5000867.c8_f3: Nope, not gonna feel bad! I'm gonna BE bad!
5000867.c8_f4: Do you really have to make me mad!?
5000867.c9_f2: Do you really have to make me mad!?
5000867.c10_s2: Always good to have your ear!
5000867.c10_s3: I'm so happy. Say it again, please?
5000867.c10_s4: You love just me, right? Just me!
5000867.c10_f1: Not just anyone is worthy of my love!
5000867.c10_f2: You aren't supposed to joke around like that.
5000867.c10_f3: You shouldn't say such things like that!
5000867.c11_s2: That's good. We are partners, after all.
5000867.c11_s3: Absolutely! I totally feel the same way.
5000867.c11_f2: You are you, and I am me, and that is all we'll ever be.
5000867.c11_f4: A tasty morsel is more precious than any words you could say.
5000867.c12_s1: This is the happiest moment of my life!
5000867.c12_s2: Can you see hearts in my eyes?
5000867.c12_s3: You're the strongest, bestest person I know.
5000867.c12_s4: Promise to love me forever and ever?
5000867.c12_f1: How many pets have you had before me?
5000867.c12_f2: If you keep saying that, I will just run away!
5000867.c12_f4: I love you like family, too!
5000867.c13_f3: Who do you think I am?
5000867.c14_f4: You can't order me to do everything!

5000867.c15_f2: How am I supposed to go when I don't have to?
5000867.c15_f3: You want me to do that HERE?!
5000867.c16_s2: You're not gonna run away while I sleep, right?
5000867.c16_s3: How can I sleep when I'm not sleepy?
5000867.c16_f2: You sleep. I'll take first watch.
5000867.c17_f1: I don't want to sleep yet.
5000867.c18_s3: Have some wonderful dreams! Dream of having billions of mesos!
5000867.c18_s4: If you want me to sleep, I'll sleep!
5000867.c19_s4: What do you want to hear?
5000867.c19_f3: You want to talk? Then feed me!
5000867.c19_f4: I don't know anything about that.
5000867.c20_s1: I want to play some games!
5000867.c20_s3: Aren't you curious... about what the Maple Admin looks like without her hat?

5002066.c18_s4: Master, don't wake me up anytime soon!
5002066.c18_f1: No, I want to talk and play!
5002066.c18_f2: I am in no mood to sleep!
5002066.c18_f3: I will rest while I sit...
5002066.c18_f4: Why are you always telling me what to do?
5002066.c19_s1: You are so awesome today! I think I am in love!
5002066.c19_s2: You hunt. I'll feed you potions.
5002066.c19_s3: Nothing beats good food and a cuddle.
5002066.c19_f1: But I don't have anything to say...
5002066.c19_f2: Why is the sky so blue, then?
5002066.c19_f3: I don't talk. That's how I am.
5002066.c20_s3: I am not talking to you because I like you.
5002066.c20_s4: We all speak different languages, you know.
5002066.c20_f1: What do I need to say?
5002066.c20_f2: Are you bored? Let's go get facials!
5002066.c20_f3: Let me think of what I want to say...
5002066.c20_f4: If you feed me a lot, I'll love you even more.
5002066.c21_s1: You're the best. Nobody gives me as much food as you!
5002066.c21_s2: Do you know how to use scrolls?
5002066.c21_s3: Take me for a walk. I'm a total chick magnet!
5002066.c21_f4: I want to be alone once in a while.
5002066.f2_s: You've figured out what I like, huh?
5002066.f2_f: I hate eating until my belly hurts...
5002066.f4_f: Arg... I'm too full! It's impossible to eat anymore...
5002066.s2: How could you ask that of me?!

5002067.c2_s1: I hope no one notices I'm here... Eep!
5002067.c2_s3: Sitting like a ninja. Hee hee.
5002067.c2_f1: This place is filthy... I can't be here...
5002067.c2_f2: I just don't want to do it anymore...
5002067.c3_s2: I'm so nice. I do whatever you say. I'm the best.
5002067.c3_s3: I'm not doing this for you!
5002067.c3_s4: Hey! Sitting or standing, my height doesn't change!
5002067.c3_f1: I think I heard talking... let's check!
5002067.c3_f2: Sitting makes my butt look big!
5002067.c4_s1: Ugh, you can see my belly when I sit...
5002067.c4_s4: I guess I could do that... THIS time.
5002067.c4_f3: Forget it! I'm not doing anything you say!
5002067.c7_f1: Scolding is bad! Complimenting is good!
5002067.c8_f3: You do that one more time, you'll never see me again.
5002067.c10_s3: Now that you mention it, I love you too!
5002067.c10_f4: Are you saying you love me?
5002067.c11_s2: You're the best! The best in the whole wide world!
5002067.c12_f1: I already know how you feel...
5002067.c12_f2: Ha ha ha... What can I say?
5002067.c14_s2: I-I'm just a little bit shy...
5002067.c14_f4: Right next to you? Oh, please!
5002067.c15_s2: Like a little golden pile of sunshine!
5002067.c15_f1: I'll let you off for today...
5002067.c15_f2: I feel like everyone is watching me.
5002067.c17_f2: I don't even have a blanket...
5002067.c18_f3: I don't want to go to bed...
5002067.c19_s1: I want to tell you about so many things...
5002067.c20_s1: My brain is just so full of... stuff!
5002067.c20_s3: Have you heard of the witch under the sea?
5002067.c20_s4: Don't ever forget about me, okay?
5002067.c20_f2: There's nothing for me to say...
5002067.c21_s2: Yetis and Pepes have such a nice friendship...
5002067.c21_s3: Everything will be fine as long as you feed me.
5002067.c21_f3: I want some rest... I'm so tired.
5002067.s3: Why did you say that to me?

5002068.c2_s1: Just keep sitting. Just keep sitting.
5002068.c2_s3: Yeah, I'm sitting. No one sits like I do!
5002068.c2_s4: Oh, good. It was starting to get uncomfortable.
5002068.c3_s1: Uhh, I'm kind of already sitting. You know?
5002068.c3_s2: I'm sitting because it's comfortable and I wanted to.
5002068.c3_f1: I can't hear you. Rocks don't have ears.
5002068.c3_f2: I shall stay as still as stone.
5002068.c4_s1: This place makes me miss Arcana.
5002068.c4_s2: I suppose I could sit for you this time.
5002068.c4_s4: If it will make you happy, I'll sit.
5002068.c4_f1: I don't feel like listening right now.
5002068.c4_f2: I can't hear you. Rocks don't have ears.
5002068.c4_f3: Obey? I laugh at you. Ha!
5002068.c6_s1: I didn't mean it! I'm sorry!
5002068.c6_f1: Who do you think you are?
5002068.c7_f3: I only have so much patience.
5002068.c7_f4: Don't mess with me. I'm a rock, and rocks are tough.
5002068.c8_s1: I can admit when I'm wrong.
5002068.c8_s3: Sometime getting mad just feels better.
5002068.c10_f4: You're too scary! I don't feel good!
5002068.c11_s3: I totally feel the same way!
5002068.c11_f4: I have a secret fling... it's a slingshot! Ha!
5002068.c12_s2: I love you more than rock itself!
5002068.c12_s4: How did you know I like that word too?!
5002068.c12_f3: Arrogance is not flattering on you.
5002068.c14_s1: I just need a bit of quiet time.
5002068.c14_s2: Don't look at me! It's weird!
5002068.c14_s3: Pooping always makes me feel so much better!
5002068.c14_f3: That was kind of a waste, don't you think?
5002068.c15_s1: These are the good kind of tummy rumbles.
5002068.c15_s2: I have paper. Well... I ate paper...
5002068.c15_s3: You should do it with me!
5002068.c15_f1: What do you expect of me, really?
5002068.c15_f2: Has your common sense left you?!
5002068.c15_f4: Why would you do this to me. I'm so sad!
5002068.c16_s1: But I just went to sleep!
5002068.c16_s4: I can't wait to see you tomorrow!
5002068.c16_f4: All I'm hearing is muffled trumpet noises.
5002068.c17_s2: Okay, maybe I'm just a little bit tired...
5002068.c17_s4: I'm gonna sleep like a rock!
5002068.c17_f1: I can't sleep... there's too much awesome I could miss.
5002068.c18_s2: Nighty night. Don't let the rock bugs bite!
5002068.c18_s3: You can't make me get up. I'll just ragdoll if you try.
5002068.c18_f4: Have you ever seen a rock sleep?
5002068.c19_f1: Eating takes more energy than I have right now.
5002068.c19_f2: Let me relax in peace, please!
5002068.c20_s2: Feed me on time, or I'll pout a bunch.
5002068.c20_s3: I'm smarter than a box of rocks!
5002068.c20_s4: Rock beats scissors! And swords... And other stuff...
5002068.c20_f2: You go first to show me how it's done.
5002068.c21_s1: Two heads are better than one pet.
5002068.c21_s3: Don't you call me a paperweight!
5002068.c21_s4: This is such a beautiful place. Makes me want to sit like a lump in grass.
5002068.c21_f1: You need to ask reeeally nicely.
5002068.c21_f2: Teasing me is just plain mean.
5002068.c21_f3: No doesn't even begin to cover it.
5002068.c21_f4: I just imitate human noises, so you'll feed and love me.
5002068.f3_s: This is a lot to eat. Like... a lot.
5002068.f4_s: Ah, my taste buds are singing!
5002068.s1: I won't stoop to eat that swill.

5002069.c2_s1: Oh! I sat, but then I rolled over!
5002069.c2_s2: My butt's on the floor! It's so cold!
5002069.c2_s3: Okay! Just need to rearrange my fluff real quick...
5002069.c2_f2: How about I poop on your hand instead? It's the hamster way.
5002069.c2_f3: I'd rather stuff my face... literally!
5002069.c3_s2: Okay, but a cushion would be nice next time.
5002069.c3_s3: I sat! But you know I can do more than that, right?
5002069.c3_s4: I sat down! I can't believe I nearly forgot how!
5002069.c3_f4: I have more important things to do right now. Like daydream.
5002069.c4_s3: How long? Is my butt going to fall asleep?
5002069.c4_s4: Okay, but can I wiggle my butt while I do it?
5002069.c4_f1: You overestimate your control of me.
5002069.c5_s1: Awww... I don't like being in trouble.
5002069.c5_s2: I didn't mean it... I'm sorry.
5002069.c6_s1: That really hurts. I'm so sad now.
5002069.c6_s2: Will you believe how sorry I am if I cry?
5002069.c6_s3: You're scaring me! Please don't be mad!
5002069.c6_f1: Who do you think you are?!
5002069.c6_f3: You don't need to get angry...
5002069.c6_f4: Watch it, or I'll nip you!
5002069.c7_s1: You're not cute when you're angry. You're scary!
5002069.c7_s3: Mad is bad. Mad is bad!
5002069.c7_f3: Getting angry and yelling about stuff only hurts you.
5002069.c7_f4: You must think I'm a pushover! I don't have to take that!
5002069.c8_s1: You used to love me no matter what I did...
5002069.c8_s2: I'm not going to feel bad about this until you give me a reason.
5002069.c8_s3: I apologize. I shouldn't have behaved poorly.
5002069.c8_s4: My eyes are leaking! See! I'm sorry!
5002069.c8_f1: I get in trouble all the time. It doesn't even phase me anymore.
5002069.c8_f2: If all you're going to do is get mad at me all the time, I'll just leave.
5002069.c8_f3: Why do you keep doing this to me?
5002069.c8_f4: I can't live under this kind of stress!
5002069.c9_s1: Isn't love the greatest? It's so smooshy!
5002069.c9_f2: Are you sure you meant me?
5002069.c10_s1: Oh! My heart's bursting, and my eyes are little hearts! See?
5002069.c10_s2: It makes me so happy to hear you say that.
5002069.c10_s3: That's cuz I'm so cute and fluffy!
5002069.c10_s4: I love you too! It feels good to say our feelings.
5002069.c10_f2: If you really loved me, you'd feed me more.
5002069.c11_s2: I love me too! And you! I love you too!
5002069.c11_s3: Not as much as I love you!
5002069.c11_f4: Did you have to say that right before I eat?
5002069.c12_s1: You love little ol' me? Awww...
5002069.c12_s3: I'm really glad you do. You're my favorite.
5002069.c12_f1: What? No yogurt chips and sunflower seeds?
5002069.c12_f2: Only Sunny Seeds can prove your love to me.
5002069.c12_f3: I only accept love in the form of food.
5002069.c13_s2: Do you maybe have some fiber to help things along?
5002069.c13_s3: Unnngh... Nope. I'll have to wait until the opportune moment.
5002069.c13_f2: Uh, I have a designated corner for that...
5002069.c13_f3: If I don't eat, I can't poop.
5002069.c13_f4: You gonna make arts and crafts with it?
5002069.c14_s1: Do I have to do it right now? What would I clean up with?
5002069.c14_s2: Daww! Look at that! Even my poop is cute!
5002069.c14_s3: Would you help me find a good spot?
5002069.c14_s4: Hrrrrgh! Hnnnngh! I don't think it's supposed to be this hard.
5002069.c14_f4: Too late! Already did! And now you get to figure out where!
5002069.c15_f1: But what will I poop? Tank's empty.
5002069.c15_f3: I didn't know you were so rude... I'm disappointed...
5002069.c15_f4: I don't need or want to. And no, I don't want to go 'just in case.'
5002069.c16_s1: Yaaaawn! All this talk about sleep is making me sleepy.
5002069.c16_s3: Is the world put on pause when I go to sleep? How else do you get along without me?
5002069.c16_s4: That's a good idea. I could really use some shuteye.
5002069.c16_f1: You sleep first. I'll stand guard and contemplate the meaning of my existence.
5002069.c16_f2: You can't make me! I'll poop in my bed!
5002069.c16_f4: Bedtime?! More like playtime!!! No sleep! No sleep!
5002069.c17_s1: I love my little cozy house. So comfy...
5002069.c17_s3: Only if you keep me company, so the monsters don't get me.
5002069.c17_s4: A fully belly and a comfy bed! Of course I want to sleep!
5002069.c17_f3: You go to bed if it's so great.
5002069.c17_f4: I thought you knew... I'm as nocturnal as it gets!
5002069.c18_s2: A nap would be perfect right about now.
5002069.c18_s3: Even the best of us need a good night's rest to be helpful!
5002069.c18_s4: I'm not super sleepy, but I could rest my eyes a bit...
5002069.c18_f1: You think I can go to sleep anywhere I please? I need comfort!
5002069.c18_f2: I need warmth and luxury to fall asleep!
5002069.c19_s1: Guess what! I can do hamster wheelies in my wheel!
5002069.c19_s2: I'd love to chat! Let's do this more often!
5002069.c19_s3: I love throwing my fluff around. People think I'm so cute!
5002069.c19_f2: So you know, this is what it looks like when I don't care.
5002069.c19_f3: Why do you gibber jabber so much?
5002069.c19_f4: Ugh, you don't need to talk all the time, you know.
5002069.c20_s1: What will our next adventure be?
5002069.c20_s2: Why don't we chat over Sunny Seeds and yogurt chips?
5002069.c20_s3: I may be tiny, but I've got a big personality!
5002069.c20_s4: I'd go to the moon and back for you!
5002069.c20_f1: I'm about to faint from hunger and you want to talk?
5002069.c20_f3: I'm not really one for small talk.
5002069.c20_f4: Just give me food, will you?
5002069.c21_s1: I heard Fantasy Theme World has a giant hamster wheel!
5002069.c21_s2: I want to ride the giant hamster wheel!
5002069.c21_s3: Nothing's better than chatting with you!
5002069.c21_s4: Let's go on an adventure together!
5002069.c21_f1: Why do you gibber jabber so much?
5002069.c21_f4: I don't have the energy for chatter right now.

5002069.f1_f: Peh! Peh! It doesn't even smell good!

5002069.s2: Use nice words, please. And magic words. It helps.
5002069.s3: Bad words bring bad luck. Be nice!

5002071.c6_f1: Who do you think you are?!
5002071.c6_f3: You don't need to get angry...
5002071.c6_f4: Watch it, or I'll nip you!
5002071.c7_s1: You're not cute when you're angry. You're scary!
5002071.c7_s3: Mad is bad. Mad is bad!
5002071.c7_f3: Getting angry and yelling about stuff only hurts you.
5002071.c7_f4: You must think I'm a pushover! I don't have to take that!
5002071.c8_s1: You used to love me no matter what I did...
5002071.c8_s2: I'm not going to feel bad about this until you give me a reason.
5002071.c8_s3: I apologize. I shouldn't have behaved poorly.
5002071.c8_s4: My eyes are leaking! See! I'm sorry!
5002071.c8_f1: I get in trouble all the time. It doesn't even phase me anymore.
5002071.c8_f2: If all you're going to do is get mad at me all the time, I'll just leave.
5002071.c8_f3: Why do you keep doing this to me?
5002071.c8_f4: I can't live under this kind of stress!
5002071.c9_s1: Isn't love the greatest? It's so smooshy!
5002071.c9_f2: Are you sure you meant me?
5002071.c10_s1: Oh! My heart's bursting, and my eyes are little hearts! See?
5002071.c10_s2: It makes me so happy to hear you say that.
5002071.c10_s3: That's cuz I'm so cute and fluffy!
5002071.c10_s4: I love you too! It feels good to say our feelings.
5002071.c10_f2: If you really loved me, you'd feed me more.
5002071.c11_s2: I love me too! And you! I love you too!
5002071.c11_s3: Not as much as I love you!
5002071.c11_f4: Did you have to say that right before I eat?
5002071.c12_s1: You love little ol' me? Awww...
5002071.c12_s3: I'm really glad you do. You're my favorite.
5002071.c12_f1: What? No yogurt chips and sunflower seeds?
5002071.c12_f2: Only Sunny Seeds can prove your love to me.
5002071.c12_f3: I only accept love in the form of food.
5002071.c13_s2: Do you maybe have some fiber to help things along?
5002071.c13_s3: Unnngh... Nope. I'll have to wait until the opportune moment.
5002071.c13_f2: Uh, I have a designated corner for that...
5002071.c13_f3: If I don't eat, I can't poop.
5002071.c13_f4: You gonna make arts and crafts with it?
5002071.c14_s1: Do I have to do it right now? What would I clean up with?
5002071.c14_s2: Daww! Look at that! Even my poop is cute!
5002071.c14_s3: Would you help me find a good spot?
5002071.c14_s4: Hrrrrgh! Hnnnngh! I don't think it's supposed to be this hard.
5002071.c14_f4: Too late! Already did! And now you get to figure out where!
5002071.c15_f1: But what will I poop? Tank's empty.
5002071.c15_f3: I didn't know you were so rude... I'm disappointed...
5002071.c15_f4: I don't need or want to. And no, I don't want to go 'just in case.'
5002071.c16_s1: Yaaaawn! All this talk about sleep is making me sleepy.
5002071.c16_s3: Is the world put on pause when I go to sleep? How else do you get along without me?
5002071.c16_s4: That's a good idea. I could really use some shuteye.
5002071.c16_f1: You sleep first. I'll stand guard and contemplate the meaning of my existence.
5002071.c16_f2: You can't make me! I'll poop in my bed!
5002071.c16_f4: Bedtime?! More like playtime!!! No sleep! No sleep!
5002071.c17_s1: I love my little cozy house. So comfy...
5002071.c17_s3: Only if you keep me company, so the monsters don't get me.
5002071.c17_s4: A fully belly and a comfy bed! Of course I want to sleep!
5002071.c17_f3: You go to bed if it's so great.
5002071.c17_f4: I thought you knew... I'm as nocturnal as it gets!
5002071.c18_s2: A nap would be perfect right about now.
5002071.c18_s3: Even the best of us need a good night's rest to be helpful!
5002071.c18_s4: I'm not super sleepy, but I could rest my eyes a bit...
5002071.c18_f1: You think I can go to sleep anywhere I please? I need comfort!
5002071.c18_f2: I need warmth and luxury to fall asleep!
5002071.c19_s1: Guess what! I can do hamster wheelies in my wheel!
5002071.c19_s2: I'd love to chat! Let's do this more often!
5002071.c19_s3: I love throwing my fluff around. People think I'm so cute!
5002071.c19_f2: So you know, this is what it looks like when I don't care.
5002071.c19_f3: Why do you gibber jabber so much?
5002071.c19_f4: Ugh, you don't need to talk all the time, you know.
5002071.c20_s1: What will our next adventure be?
5002071.c20_s2: Why don't we chat over Sunny Seeds and yogurt chips?
5002071.c20_s3: I may be tiny, but I've got a big personality!
5002071.c20_s4: I'd go to the moon and back for you!
5002071.c20_f1: I'm about to faint from hunger and you want to talk?
5002071.c20_f3: I'm not really one for small talk.
5002071.c20_f4: Just give me food, will you?
5002071.c21_s1: I heard Fantasy Theme World has a giant hamster wheel!
5002071.c21_s2: I want to ride the giant hamster wheel!
5002071.c21_s3: Nothing's better than chatting with you!
5002071.c21_s4: Let's go on an adventure together!
5002071.c21_f1: Why do you gibber jabber so much?
5002071.c21_f4: I don't have the energy for chatter right now.
5002071.f1_s: Wow! You're a good cook! Or... a good shopper, I guess.
5002071.f1_f: Peh! Peh! It doesn't even smell good!
5002071.f2_s: Can I save some for later in my cheeks? It's so good!
5002071.f3_s: My favorite! How did you know?!
5002071.f3_f: I like eating, but I think I might be sick...
5002071.f4_s: I could eat forever and ever and ever and...
5002071.f4_f: Stop trying to make my tummy pop!
5002071.s1: Did I just hear what I think I heard?
5002071.s2: Use nice words, please. And magic words. It helps.
5002071.s3: Bad words bring bad luck. Be nice!

5002045.c1_s2: Okay, but I better go slow, so I don't slosh.
5002045.c2_s2: But I can't help being bubbly!
5002045.c3_s1: I guess the love potion works!
5002045.c3_s2: Of course you do! I'm fizzy, fun, and irresistible.
5002045.c4_s1: Don't mind me. I'm leaking on purpose.
5002045.c4_s2: Just a drip here and a drop there.
5002045.c5_s1: If you ever need a pick-me-up, I'll raise your spirits!
5002045.c5_s2: For a new lease on life, I'm your brew!
