5000900.c2_f3: I don't feel like doing anything.
5000900.c2_f4: I know you feel more comfortable standing, too!
5000900.c3_s3: You look tired. Why don't you come sit, too?
5000900.c3_f2: And why should I listen to you?
5000900.c3_f3: I can't understand you at all!
5000900.c4_s1: I was going to sit anyway!
5000900.c4_s3: Don't tell me to sit! You sit!
5000900.c4_f2: Don't tell me what to do!
5000900.c5_s2: Who do you think you are?
5000900.c6_s1: I apologize with all my heart!
5000900.c6_f2: Come at me! I'll take you on.
5000900.c6_f4: I'll do you a favor and pretend I didn't hear that.
5000900.c7_s4: I didn't mean it. Cut me some slack.
5000900.c7_f2: I'm the one who should be angry, not you!
5000900.c8_s2: I don't even know why I'm saying this, but sorry.
5000900.c8_s3: Okay, this one was my bad.
5000900.c8_f1: How dare you get angry at me?!
5000900.c11_f3: Do you like to see me suffer?
5000900.c11_f4: Have you been eating strange mushrooms?
5000900.c12_s3: Stick around. I might have some use for you.
5000900.c12_f3: I know when people are being insincere.
5000900.c14_f2: Don't tell me what to do!
5000900.c15_s2: I am one with my bowels.
5000900.c15_s3: That could go in a museum!
5000900.c15_f2: Don't talk to me about stuff like that.
5000900.c17_s3: I'm going to enjoy a nice, long sleep.
5000900.c17_f3: Let's play a little longer, okay?
5000900.c18_s3: Whatever! I'll sleep when I want.
5000900.c18_f4: How dare you try to command me!
5000900.c19_s1: My weakness is my ears, but don't tell!
5000900.c19_s2: Some days, I just look at the world and smile.
5000900.c19_s3: I love... boxing! Would you have guessed?
5000900.c19_f1: I don't have anything to say. Gosh.
5000900.c19_f2: What do you want me to say?
5000900.c20_s1: Nobody in Maple World stands a chance against MY cuteness!
5000900.c20_s2: Feed me lots of yummy treats, okay?
5000900.c20_s3: Takes me 20 minutes each day to do my hair!
5000900.c20_f1: I don't wanna talk right now! I'm in a bad mood!
5000900.c21_s2: You think you can take me? Let's try!
5000900.c21_f2: If you're bored, go hunting instead of wasting your time.
5000900.s2: This is abuse! I'll have you locked up!
5000900.s4: You kiss your mama with that mouth?

5000901.c2_s1: I'm sitting down. Aren't I good?
5000901.c2_s4: Landed too hard. Bruised my butt.
5000901.c2_f1: No, no! I want to do something else!
5000901.c2_f2: I want to walk a bit more.
5000901.c3_s1: Yes, a rest would be nice.
5000901.c3_s3: How did you know I was getting tired?
5000901.c3_f1: Don't order me around like that!
5000901.c3_f2: But I want to play more!
5000901.c3_f3: I want to take a walk!
5000901.c3_f4: Well... I usually like doing things MY way.
5000901.c4_s1: I did well, yes? Compliment me!
5000901.c4_f1: I don't want to do it!
5000901.c4_f2: How dare you try to command me?
5000901.c4_f3: I'm tired... I need some sleep medicine...
5000901.c4_f4: Uh, where's my cushion? I won't sit without it!
5000901.c6_s1: I'm scared... I need some comfort food...
5000901.c6_s4: Okay, okaaaaay. I'll listen to you from now on!
5000901.c6_f1: I don't understand what I did wrong!
5000901.c6_f4: What? How dare you try to punish me?!
5000901.c7_s1: I'll be more careful next time.
5000901.c7_s2: I'll be good from now on! No more bad stuff!
5000901.c7_f1: No! I don't want to go on time out. Time to go play!
5000901.c8_s1: I'll be careful now... Humans are scary...
5000901.c8_s4: You... You still love me, don't you?
5000901.c8_f2: You're just taking it out on me because you're stressed and tired, right?
5000901.c8_f3: Are you mad because I'm too expensive to feed? Waahhh.
5000901.c8_f4: Stop! Do I have to get mad at you again?!
5000901.c10_s3: You love just me, right? Just me!
5000901.c10_s4: I love your way with words!
5000901.c10_f4: You're sick. Take something for that.
5000901.c11_s1: This is not simulated? This is real!
5000901.c11_s2: I feel like the happiest creature on earth!
5000901.c11_s4: I love you too! Yip yip yip!
5000901.c11_f1: I said, I can't hear you!
5000901.c11_f3: You are you, and I am me, and that is all we'll ever be.
5000901.c11_f4: Love? Take it to the Jr. Reapers!
5000901.c12_s2: You're as warm-hearted as I thought.
5000901.c12_s3: Can you see hearts in my eyes?
5000901.c12_s4: Promise to love me forever and ever?
5000901.c12_f1: We are of different classes. I am sorry.
5000901.c12_f4: I'm a pet. And you're a human!
5000901.c14_s1: It's so much fun reading the paper while going poop!
5000901.c14_s3: I had a tummy ache! Good idea!
5000901.c14_f3: Try not to be so crude.
5000901.c15_s1: I did it! I did it!
5000901.c15_s2: Did I eat something bad yesterday... Or maybe I ate too much...
5000901.c15_f2: I don't want to poop now.
5000901.c15_f3: I can't just poop all day, you know?
5000901.c16_s1: It's so cozy under the blanket!
5000901.c16_s4: I was getting a little frazzled...
5000901.c16_f2: No! I wanna play some more!
5000901.c16_f4: No! I want to play more!
5000901.c17_s1: I think I'm going to have a wonderful dream tonight!
5000901.c17_f2: Now is not the right time to sleep.
5000901.c17_f3: Can you give me a blanket and a pillow?
5000901.c17_f4: I'll sleep when I get sleepy, okies?
5000901.c18_s2: I can't keep my eyes open...
5000901.c18_s4: Time to sleep on my comfy, squishy pillow.
5000901.c18_f1: Why do you always tell me to sleep?
5000901.c18_f2: What? Wait! There might be snakes around here!
5000901.c18_f3: I guess not all your ideas are good...
5000901.c19_s2: Teach me how to talk first!
5000901.c19_s3: I hear a scary dragon lives nearby... Should I pay it a visit?
5000901.c19_s4: I am talented at talking, I know.
5000901.c19_f1: What? What are you implying? I know nothing!
5000901.c19_f2: You want to talk? Then feed me!
5000901.c19_f4: I want to chat with Peplock!
5000901.c20_s1: I can't talk to other pets. We don't speak the same language.
5000901.c20_s2: It's always snowing in El Nath!
5000901.c20_s3: Have you tasted the snow in El Nath?
5000901.c20_s4: What kind of place is the Free Market? Why is it always crowded?
5000901.c20_f1: I'm curious about you! Tell me stories!
5000901.c20_f2: Ow... I'm so hungry that I can't even talk...
5000901.c20_f3: Nope! Because you told me to, I won't!
5000901.c20_f4: I thought you didn't want me to talk because I'm too loud.
5000901.c21_s2: How do I shapeshift? Well, I could tell you, but you wouldn't understand.
5000901.c21_s3: Where do I go to purchase awesome threads?
5000901.c21_s4: Have you ever seen a Crimson Balrog in real life?
5000901.c21_f1: I don't like to talk that much.
5000901.c21_f4: I don't want to talk today!
5000901.f2_s: This is as good as it gets!
5000901.f3_f: I do not eat when I am full.
5000901.s3: How could you do this to me?!
5000901.s4: Mind your manners. You embarrass me.

5000902.c2_s4: I did a great job, right?
5000902.c2_f3: I don't want to sit. Sitting makes me look shorter.
5000902.c3_s2: I'm pretty, and I listen. I'm perfect!
5000902.c3_f2: I prefer to sit in clean places.
5000902.c3_f3: I'll do it if you feed me. I'm hungry.
5000902.c3_f4: I don't like this place. It has nothing good to eat.
5000902.c4_s1: What do you think? I even look cool sitting, right?
5000902.c4_s2: How do I look when I'm sitting?
5000902.c4_f1: Sorry, I was thinking about food.
5000902.c4_f2: Sitting makes my belly look fat.
5000902.c4_f3: But my butt will get dirty!
5000902.c4_f4: I'm starving and you still want me to sit...
5000902.c6_s2: It was my fault? I didn't know...
5000902.c6_f1: I'm good, so don't scold me!
5000902.c6_f3: Are you really going to keep doing this?
5000902.c7_s3: I'm sorry... I won't do it again...
5000902.c7_f1: Is it fun? Should I try?
5000902.c7_f2: Yeah? I can be scarier than that!
5000902.c7_f4: Don't you talk behind my back! I can hear you!
5000902.c8_s2: I'm going to tell my mommy...
5000902.c8_f1: I don't have room to talk, but you're ridiculous.
5000902.c8_f3: If you keep that up, I might run away.
5000902.c8_f4: Do I know you?? You look like a different person when you're angry!
5000902.c10_s4: You know what I'm gonna say!
5000902.c11_s1: Say it again! Say it again!
5000902.c11_s2: Oh, I don't know what to say!
5000902.c11_f1: Please don't say that right before a meal...
5000902.c12_s1: I always knew I was irresistible.
5000902.c12_s2: I'm so happy you're here with me!
5000902.c12_s3: I've been waiting so long for you to say that!
5000902.c12_f1: I can't heeaaar yooouu! I can't heeaaar yooouu!
5000902.c12_f2: Just feed me. No need for rest.
5000902.c12_f3: Please don't be so mushy before I eat...
5000902.c13_s1: I could do this all day!
5000902.c13_f4: I only do that for ME!
5000902.c14_s2: I'm embarrassed. Please turn your head the other way.
5000902.c14_s3: I think my belly is flatter now after that much pooping!
5000902.c14_f2: Hey, I do have SOME shame!
5000902.c15_s1: Eat, sleep... You know the drill.
5000902.c15_s2: Quick! Make sure no one's peeking!
5000902.c15_s3: Look at my poop, SO CUTE!
5000902.c15_s4: I should poop quickly and then go eat!
5000902.c15_f1: I hate poop. I'll poop tomorrow.
5000902.c15_f3: I'll only poop at home! Never outside!
5000902.c15_f4: I need to eat something first!
5000902.c16_f2: What? Sleep on the floor? Nonsense!
5000902.c17_s4: I hope I dream of ramen.
5000902.c17_f2: Hey, feed me first. I can't sleep hungry.
5000902.c17_f3: You're going to run away as soon as I close my eyes!
5000902.c18_f1: Look at your belly! You should hit the gym!
5000902.c18_f2: I'm dying to eat some meat right now. I can't even fall asleep!
5000902.c18_f4: You're going to abandon me while I'm asleep. No!
5000902.c19_s1: Don't you think I'm just adorrrrrrable?
5000902.c19_s2: I wish I could cast spells like this.
5000902.c19_s3: My nose is my best part.
5000902.c19_f1: No, I want to do something FUN!
5000902.c19_f4: I'll talk if you feed me.
5000902.c20_s1: I hate being alone more than anything.
5000902.c20_s2: Pets are still cute if they eat a lot... right?
5000902.c20_s3: I think I'm a little hungry. Just a little.
5000902.c20_s4: There are so many monsters in the world.
5000902.c20_f1: What do you want to hear from me?
5000902.c20_f2: Do you think I have something to say?
5000902.c20_f3: I've got nothing to say, but I've got a lot of things I want to eat!
5000902.c21_s1: I'm cute, pretty, and even know how to talk!
5000902.c21_s2: I want to wear pretty clothes... Not saying you gotta buy them for me or anything!
5000902.c21_s3: You and I are always on the same page.
5000902.c21_s4: I get sad when I don't have anything to eat.
5000902.c21_f1: I don't really have anything to talk about...
5000902.c21_f2: Talking to your pets makes you look like a crazy person!
5000902.c21_f3: Why do you continue to test me?
5000902.f1_s: Oh! Is this my reward? It's delicious!
5000902.f1_f: Blech, how could you give me such an awful thing?
5000902.f2_f: You can't feed a pretty pet like me such cheap food.
5000902.f3_s: It's so delicious that I feel like I'm flying!

5002087.c4_s2: What goes in, must come out.

5002088.c4_s2: What goes in, must come out.

5002089.c4_s2: What goes in, must come out.

5002090.c3_s1: I am the biggest, baddest pet there is! Rawr!
5002090.c3_f1: How dare you defy me and my tiny cuteness?! Rawr!
5002090.c3_f2: I may not have opposable thumbs, but you shall not defy me!
5002090.c4_s1: You're the best person a pet could have.
5002090.c4_f1: Dare to defy me again, and I shall bite you!
5002090.f2_s: Let's play tug of war, so I can growl!
5002090.f3_f: Pfft! You call this food? Peh!

5002098.f2_s: Tasty food makes me so happy!
5002098.f2_f: Oh, I ate too much. I don't feel so- Bleeeeeehh!
5002098.f3_s: This one has its own unique flavor!
5002098.f3_f: Stop it! You're going to make me fat!
5002098.f4_s: Wow! You've really got a talent for quality munchies!
5002098.f4_f: How many times do I have to tell you I'm not hungry!
5002098.s1: Please don't say things like that.
5002098.s2: Use nice words, please. And magic words. It helps.
5002098.s3: Be nice! Too much negativity gets you down.

5002114.c1_s2: There's so much I wanna say!
5002114.c1_f1: I'm not in the mood to chat.
5002114.c1_f2: But your language is too hard...
5002114.c2_s1: Since we're getting to be such good friends, I'll talk more.
5002114.c2_s2: Some days, I just feel all gooey inside.
5002114.c2_f2: The weather is horrible today. I don't feel like talking.
5002114.c3_s1: I want to be the trendiest snack out there!
5002114.c3_s2: If I turn into a doll, please don't forget about me.
5002114.c3_f1: Let's get out of here and do something interesting.
5002114.c3_f2: You can't just monopolize all my time, y'know.
5002114.c4_s1: Do you think about me a lot? I mean, you must. I'm pretty super!
5002114.c4_s2: It's such a beautiful day! I wonder if the sun is happy today, too...
5002114.c4_f1: I'm drawing a blank. Oh! Why don't we draw something?
5002114.f2_s: To be good food, I have to eat good food.
5002114.f3_f: Do you WANT me to barf? Cuz that's what I'll do if you give me any more.
5002114.f4_s: I think your cooking skills are improving!
5002114.f4_f: I'm full! Why are you giving me so much food?
5002114.s1: Please don't be mean to me...
5002114.s3: If you can't say something nice...
5002114.s4: You kiss your mother with that mouth?

5002115.c1_s1: I want to be friends with lots of different people.
5002115.c1_s2: It's so nice to see you're making friends with others.
5002115.c1_f1: So you know, this is what it looks like when I don't care.
5002115.c1_f2: I'm avoiding eye contact with you. Can you tell?
5002115.c2_s1: You'll never find a pet as cute as little ol' me!
5002115.c2_s2: I've gotten pretty good at English, huh?
5002115.c2_f1: I was hoping you wouldn't want to talk today.
5002115.c2_f2: I can't think of anything to say.
5002115.c3_s1: I'm telling you, there's nothing I'm not good at!
5002115.c3_s2: Am I that pretty? I am, right?
5002115.c3_f1: I don't have anything to say right now.
5002115.c4_s1: I want to go on a trip!
5002115.c4_s2: I'm pretty great at talking, huh? I really put my mind to it!
5002115.c4_f1: Do you ever get tired of wanting to talk?
5002115.c4_f2: Doing that isn't part of my repertoire.
5002115.f2_f: If I ate another bite, I'm afraid I'd pop!
5002115.s3: What kind of horrible person says stuff like that?
5002115.s4: Be nice! Too much negativity gets you down.

5002116.c1_s1: I'm a busy bee, but I've always got time for friends!
5002116.c1_f1: So you know, this is what it looks like when I don't care.
5002116.c1_f2: I'm avoiding eye contact with you. Can you tell?
5002116.c2_s1: Sometimes, I've got a lot on my mind. But I'm happy right now.
5002116.c2_s2: You want to have a deep and meaningful conversation? Awesome!
5002116.c2_f2: So you know, this is what it looks like when I don't care.
5002116.c3_s1: I love being showered with attention!
5002116.c3_s2: I'm so glad we can talk any time we want!
5002116.c3_f1: I'm way too tired. Couldn't I nap instead?
5002116.c4_s1: Talking to you NEVER gets old! Well, not never, but you know what I mean.
5002116.c4_s2: Let's play a game! Or eat! Or go on an adventure! All the things!
5002116.c4_f1: Is that how it works now? I just yap on command?
5002116.c4_f2: I talked too much today. My voice is done for!
5002116.f1_s: This is some mighty fine cooking!
5002116.f1_f: You expect me to eat this slop?
5002116.f2_s: Tasty food makes me so happy!
5002116.f2_f: Oh, I ate too much. I don't feel so- Bleeeeeehh!
5002116.f3_s: This one has its own unique flavor!
5002116.f3_f: Stop it! You're going to make me fat!
5002116.f4_s: Wow! You've really got a talent for quality munchies!
5002116.f4_f: How many times do I have to tell you I'm not hungry!
5002116.s1: Please don't say things like that.
5002116.s2: Use nice words, please. And magic words. It helps.
5002116.s3: Be nice! Too much negativity gets you down.

5002117.c2_f3: I don't feel like doing anything.
5002117.c2_f4: I know you feel more comfortable standing, too!
5002117.c3_s3: You look tired. Why don't you come sit, too?
5002117.c3_f2: And why should I listen to you?
5002117.c3_f3: I can't understand you at all!
5002117.c4_s1: I was going to sit anyway!
5002117.c4_s3: Don't tell me to sit! You sit!
5002117.c4_f2: Don't tell me what to do!
5002117.c5_s2: Who do you think you are?
5002117.c6_s1: I apologize with all my heart!
5002117.c6_f2: Come at me! I'll take you on.
5002117.c6_f4: I'll do you a favor and pretend I didn't hear that.
5002117.c7_s4: I didn't mean it. Cut me some slack.
5002117.c7_f2: I'm the one who should be angry, not you!
5002117.c8_s2: I don't even know why I'm saying this, but sorry.
5002117.c8_s3: Okay, this one was my bad.
5002117.c8_f1: How dare you get angry at me?!
5002117.c11_f3: Do you like to see me suffer?
5002117.c11_f4: Have you been eating strange mushrooms?
5002117.c12_s3: Stick around. I might have some use for you.
5002117.c12_f3: I know when people are being insincere.
5002117.c14_f2: Don't tell me what to do!
5002117.c15_s2: I am one with my bowels.
5002117.c15_s3: That could go in a museum!
5002117.c15_f2: Don't talk to me about stuff like that.
5002117.c17_s3: I'm going to enjoy a nice, long sleep.
5002117.c17_f3: Let's play a little longer, okay?
5002117.c18_s3: Whatever! I'll sleep when I want.
5002117.c18_f4: How dare you try to command me!
5002117.c19_s1: My weakness is my ears, but don't tell!
5002117.c19_s2: Some days, I just look at the world and smile.
5002117.c19_s3: I love... boxing! Would you have guessed?
5002117.c19_f1: I don't have anything to say. Gosh.
5002117.c19_f2: What do you want me to say?
5002117.c20_s1: Nobody in Maple World stands a chance against MY cuteness!
5002117.c20_s2: Feed me lots of yummy treats, okay?
5002117.c20_s3: I spend 20 minutes a day doing my hair!
5002117.c20_f1: I don't wanna talk right now! I'm in a bad mood!
5002117.c21_s2: You think you can take me? Let's try!
5002117.c21_f2: If you're bored, go hunting instead of wasting your time.
5002117.s2: This is abuse! I'll have you locked up!
5002117.s4: You kiss your mama with that mouth?

5002118.c2_s1: I'm sitting down. Aren't I good?
5002118.c2_s4: Landed too hard. Bruised my butt.
5002118.c2_f1: No, no! I want to do something else!
5002118.c2_f2: I want to walk a bit more.
5002118.c3_s1: Yes, a rest would be nice.
5002118.c3_s3: How did you know I was getting tired?
5002118.c3_f1: Don't order me around like that!
5002118.c3_f2: But I want to play more!
5002118.c3_f3: I want to take a walk!
5002118.c3_f4: Well... I usually like doing things MY way.
5002118.c4_s1: I did well, yes? Compliment me!
5002118.c4_f1: I don't want to do it!
5002118.c4_f2: How dare you try to command me?
5002118.c4_f3: I'm tired... I need some sleep medicine...
5002118.c4_f4: Uh, where's my cushion? I won't sit without it!
5002118.c6_s1: I'm scared... I need some comfort food...
5002118.c6_s4: Okay, okaaaaay. I'll listen to you from now on!
5002118.c6_f1: I don't understand what I did wrong!
5002118.c6_f4: What? How dare you try to punish me?!
5002118.c7_s1: I'll be more careful next time.
5002118.c7_s2: I'll be good from now on! No more bad stuff!
5002118.c7_f1: No! I don't want to go on time out. Time to go play!
5002118.c8_s1: I'll be careful now... Humans are scary...
5002118.c8_s4: You... You still love me, don't you?
5002118.c8_f2: You're just taking it out on me because you're stressed and tired, right?
5002118.c8_f3: Are you mad because I'm too expensive to feed? Waahhh.
5002118.c8_f4: Stop! Do I have to get mad at you again?!
5002118.c10_s3: You love just me, right? Just me!
5002118.c10_s4: I love your way with words!
5002118.c10_f4: You're sick. Take something for that.
5002118.c11_s1: This is not simulated? This is real!
5002118.c11_s2: I feel like the happiest creature on earth!
5002118.c11_s4: I love you too! Yip yip yip!
5002118.c11_f1: I said, I can't hear you!
5002118.c11_f3: You are you, and I am me, and that is all we'll ever be.
5002118.c11_f4: Love? Take it to the Jr. Reapers!
5002118.c12_s2: You're as warm-hearted as I thought.
5002118.c12_s3: Can you see hearts in my eyes?
5002118.c12_s4: Promise to love me forever and ever?
5002118.c12_f1: We are of different classes. I am sorry.
5002118.c12_f4: I'm a pet. And you're a human!
5002118.c14_s1: It's so much fun reading the paper while going poop!
5002118.c14_s3: I had a tummy ache! Good idea!
5002118.c14_f3: Try not to be so crude.
5002118.c15_s1: I did it! I did it!
5002118.c15_s2: Did I eat something bad yesterday... Or maybe I ate too much...
5002118.c15_f2: I don't want to poop now.
5002118.c15_f3: I can't just poop all day, you know?
5002118.c16_s1: It's so cozy under the blanket!
5002118.c16_s4: I was getting a little frazzled...
5002118.c16_f2: No! I wanna play some more!
5002118.c16_f4: No! I want to play more!
5002118.c17_s1: I think I'm going to have a wonderful dream tonight!
5002118.c17_f2: Now is not the right time to sleep.
5002118.c17_f3: Can you give me a blanket and a pillow?
5002118.c17_f4: I'll sleep when I get sleepy, okies?
5002118.c18_s2: I can't keep my eyes open...
5002118.c18_s4: Time to sleep on my comfy, squishy pillow.
5002118.c18_f1: Why do you always tell me to sleep?
5002118.c18_f2: What? Wait! There might be snakes around here!
5002118.c18_f3: I guess not all your ideas are good...
5002118.c19_s2: Teach me how to talk first!
5002118.c19_s3: I hear a scary dragon lives nearby... Should I pay it a visit?
5002118.c19_s4: I am talented at talking, I know.
5002118.c19_f1: What? What are you implying? I know nothing!
5002118.c19_f2: You want to talk? Then feed me!
5002118.c19_f4: I want to chat with Peplock!
5002118.c20_s1: I can't talk to other pets. We don't speak the same language.
5002118.c20_s2: It's always snowing in El Nath!
5002118.c20_s3: Have you tasted the snow in El Nath?
5002118.c20_s4: What kind of place is the Free Market? Why is it always crowded?
5002118.c20_f1: I'm curious about you! Tell me stories!
5002118.c20_f2: Ow... I'm so hungry that I can't even talk...
5002118.c20_f3: Nope! Because you told me to, I won't!
5002118.c20_f4: I thought you didn't want me to talk because I'm too loud.
5002118.c21_s2: How do I shapeshift? Well, I could tell you, but you wouldn't understand.
5002118.c21_s3: Where do I go to purchase awesome threads?
5002118.c21_s4: Have you ever seen a Crimson Balrog in real life?
5002118.c21_f1: I don't like to talk that much.
5002118.c21_f4: I don't want to talk today!
5002118.f2_s: This is as good as it gets!
5002118.f3_f: I do not eat when I am full.
5002118.s3: How could you do this to me?!
5002118.s4: Mind your manners. You embarrass me.

5002119.c2_s4: I did a great job, right?
5002119.c2_f3: I don't want to sit. Sitting makes me look shorter.
5002119.c3_s2: I'm pretty, and I listen. I'm perfect!
5002119.c3_f2: I prefer to sit in clean places.
5002119.c3_f3: I'll do it if you feed me. I'm hungry.
5002119.c3_f4: I don't like this place. It has nothing good to eat.
5002119.c4_s1: What do you think? I even look cool sitting, right?
5002119.c4_s2: How do I look when I'm sitting?
5002119.c4_f1: Sorry, I was thinking about food.
5002119.c4_f2: Sitting makes my belly look fat.
5002119.c4_f3: But my butt will get dirty!
5002119.c4_f4: I'm starving and you still want me to sit...
5002119.c6_s2: It was my fault? I didn't know...
5002119.c6_f1: I'm good, so don't scold me!
5002119.c6_f3: Are you really going to keep doing this?
5002119.c7_s3: I'm sorry... I won't do it again...
5002119.c7_f1: Is it fun? Should I try?
5002119.c7_f2: Yeah? I can be scarier than that!
5002119.c7_f4: Don't you talk behind my back! I can hear you!
5002119.c8_s2: I'm going to tell my mommy...
5002119.c8_f1: I don't have room to talk, but you're ridiculous.
5002119.c8_f3: If you keep that up, I might run away.
5002119.c8_f4: Do I know you?? You look like a different person when you're angry!
5002119.c10_s4: You know what I'm gonna say!
5002119.c11_s1: Say it again! Say it again!
5002119.c11_s2: Oh, I don't know what to say!
5002119.c11_f1: Please don't say that right before a meal...
5002119.c12_s1: I always knew I was irresistible.
5002119.c12_s2: I'm so happy you're here with me!
5002119.c12_s3: I've been waiting so long for you to say that!
5002119.c12_f1: I can't heeaaar yooouu! I can't heeaaar yooouu!
5002119.c12_f2: Just feed me. No need for rest.
5002119.c12_f3: Please don't be so mushy before I eat...
5002119.c13_s1: I could do this all day!
5002119.c13_f4: I only do that for ME!
5002119.c14_s2: I'm embarrassed. Please turn your head the other way.
5002119.c14_s3: I think my belly is flatter now after that much pooping!
5002119.c14_f2: Hey, I do have SOME shame!
5002119.c15_s1: Eat, sleep... You know the drill.
5002119.c15_s2: Quick! Make sure no one's peeking!
5002119.c15_s3: Look at my poop, SO CUTE!
5002119.c15_s4: I should poop quickly and then go eat!
5002119.c15_f1: I hate poop. I'll poop tomorrow.
5002119.c15_f3: I'll only poop at home! Never outside!
5002119.c15_f4: I need to eat something first!
5002119.c16_f2: What? Sleep on the floor? Nonsense!
5002119.c17_s4: I hope I dream of ramen.
5002119.c17_f2: Hey, feed me first. I can't sleep hungry.
5002119.c17_f3: You're going to run away as soon as I close my eyes!
5002119.c18_f1: Look at your belly! You should hit the gym!
5002119.c18_f2: I'm dying to eat some meat right now. I can't even fall asleep!
5002119.c18_f4: You're going to abandon me while I'm asleep. No!
5002119.c19_s1: Don't you think I'm just adorrrrrrable?
5002119.c19_s2: I wish I could cast spells like this.
5002119.c19_s3: My nose is my best part.
5002119.c19_f1: No, I want to do something FUN!
5002119.c19_f4: I'll talk if you feed me.
5002119.c20_s1: I hate being alone more than anything.
5002119.c20_s2: Pets are still cute if they eat a lot... right?
5002119.c20_s3: I think I'm a little hungry. Just a little.
5002119.c20_s4: There are so many monsters in the world.
5002119.c20_f1: What do you want to hear from me?
5002119.c20_f2: Do you think I have something to say?
5002119.c20_f3: I've got nothing to say, but I've got a lot of things I want to eat!
5002119.c21_s1: I'm cute, pretty, and even know how to talk!
5002119.c21_s2: I want to wear pretty clothes... Not saying you gotta buy them for me or anything!
5002119.c21_s3: You and I are always on the same page.
5002119.c21_s4: I get sad when I don't have anything to eat.
5002119.c21_f1: I don't really have anything to talk about...
5002119.c21_f2: Talking to your pets makes you look like a crazy person!
5002119.c21_f3: Why do you continue to test me?
5002119.f1_s: Oh! Is this my reward? It's delicious!
5002119.f1_f: Blech, how could you give me such an awful thing?
5002119.f2_f: You can't feed a pretty pet like me such cheap food.
5002119.f3_s: It's so delicious that I feel like I'm flying!

5002110.c2_s2: Keep your feather bed; I'll take my box!
5002110.c2_f1: Why would I think outside the box?
5002110.c3_s2: It looks uncomfortable? This box is the HEIGHT of comfort!
5002110.c3_f1: I'm going to sleep so no loud noises plz...
5002110.c3_f2: Ugh... So sleepy... Can has quiet?
5002110.c4_s1: Thanks... I sure have a good master...
5002110.c4_s2: I sure have a good master...
5002110.c4_f1: Go to sleep... Aren't you tired?
5002110.f3_s: Don't you have more? This was so gooood...
5002110.f4_s: I'll eat a bit more before going to sleep...

5002111.c1_f2: Hey! Is this the best you can do?
5002111.c2_s1: I can't sit still! Let's go!
5002111.c2_f1: I'm not in the mood! Let's do something else!
5002111.c2_f2: This is lame! Let's do something else!
5002111.c3_s1: Let's find something fun to do today!
5002111.c3_s2: It feels like something fun's gonna happen today!
5002111.c3_f2: Let's do something else! This isn't fun.
5002111.c4_s1: Thanks to you, every day is a fun day for me!
5002111.c4_s2: I'm always grateful for you. You're the best!
5002111.c4_f1: Hey! I told you this isn't fun!
5002111.f3_s: This is the best! So delicious!
5002111.f4_s: This is the best food I've ever tasted!
5002111.f4_f: Gahhh, ptooey! Are you kidding me?!
5002111.s2: That's really no fun at all!

5002112.c3_s1: Okay, then let's get started on today's adventure!
5002112.c3_s2: You're the protagonist here. I'm just your loyal, lovable pet!
5002112.c3_f1: I told you I'll do what you say.
5002112.c3_f2: You know being like that makes you seem uncool, right?
5002112.c4_s1: Thank you, master. I'll always be scooting along three steps behind you.
5002112.c4_s2: I'm happy I was adopted by such a cool master.
5002112.c4_f1: Hmm... You not being a cool cat right now, you know?
5002112.c4_f2: I'll leave the decision up to you.
5002112.f2_f: Hmm... It tastes weird, doesn't it?
5002112.f4_s: That was almost as good as a full course meal.
5002112.f4_f: I'm sorry, but this tastes awful. But I can deal with it. That's what us cool cats do.
5002112.s2: What did you say? I can't hear you!
5002112.s3: Hmm... You know that what you said just now wasn't cool, right?
5002112.s4: What you did just now was super uncool.

5002122.c1_s2: Okay! I'm really good at that!
5002122.c1_f2: I love eating peanut butter, don't you?
5002122.c2_s1: Okay! I'm really good at that!
5002122.c2_s3: Woo! My booty is best buddies with the floor!
5002122.c2_s4: You should sit down too. It's nice!
5002122.c2_f2: Are you sure? You've got a lot of options.
5002122.c3_s1: The ground is gross. There's poop and stuff.
5002122.c3_s2: Okay! I'm really good at that!
5002122.c3_s4: Can I roll around too? I'm kind of itchy.
5002122.c4_s1: Okay! I'm really good at that!
5002122.c4_s3: Oooooh, yikes! The ground is cold.
5002122.c5_s1: Oh no. I messed up big time, didn't I?
5002122.c5_s2: I can roll over too! Sometimes it even happens by accident.
5002122.c5_f1: You won't get away with treating me like this!
5002122.c6_s1: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to make you mad.
5002122.c6_s2: Sorry... How can I make it up to you?
5002122.c6_s3: Did I hurt your feelings? You're hurting mine right now...
5002122.c6_f3: I can't sleep when you stare at me all creepy like that.
5002122.c6_f4: Why do you want me to feel bad?
5002122.c7_s2: Oh no. I messed up big time, didn't I?
5002122.c7_s4: Find somebody else to do your poopy work.
5002122.c7_f2: Okay! I'm really good at that!
5002122.c7_f3: I don't like you very much when you're like this.
5002122.c7_f4: Stop it! Stop being mad at me right now!
5002122.c8_s1: Find somebody else to do your poopy work.
5002122.c8_s2: Sorry... How can I make it up to you?
5002122.c8_s3: I can't believe I let you down...
5002122.c8_s4: I don't want you to be mad... I'm sorry.
5002122.c8_f1: Hear my tiny roar! I am mad!
5002122.c8_f2: I'm gonna poop in your shoe if you don't leave me alone.
5002122.c8_f3: Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers...
5002122.c8_f4: I'll forget you did that... this time.
5002122.c9_s1: It's so nice to know somebody out there does.
5002122.c10_s1: I love you too, because you're the best!
5002122.c10_s3: Aww, it's so sweet of you to say that!
5002122.c10_s4: You're head over heels for my adorable face, aren't you?
5002122.c10_f1: I'm not ready for that kind of commitment.
5002122.c10_f4: Are you sure? You've got a lot of options.
5002122.c11_s1: You're so nice to me. I'm glad we found each other.
5002122.c11_s3: It's so nice to know somebody out there does.
5002122.c11_s4: You love me?! I can't believe it!
5002122.c11_f1: Urp! I think I just barfed a little.
5002122.c11_f2: You are way too gooey for me.
5002122.c11_f4: Okay! I'm really good at that!
5002122.c12_s3: Then let's go on an adventure together!
5002122.c12_s4: I'm so glad you do! I love you too!
5002122.c12_f3: I love eating peanut butter, don't you?

5002504.c4_f3: Once I sit, it's going to be hard to get up...

5002504.c6_f1: Stop it... or I'll get mad!
5002504.c6_f2: Who do you think you're getting mad at?!
5002504.c7_s2: There's something in my eye, is all.
5002504.c7_s4: I want to be with you more... That's why I...
5002504.c7_f2: Look at that angry face. So unbecoming...
5002504.c7_f3: If I weren't a pet, I'd...
5002504.c7_f4: Hmm. See if I do what YOU say next time.
5002504.c8_s1: All right, if you don't like it, I won't do it.
5002504.c8_s2: I like you, Master. Even when you scold me.
5002504.c8_s3: I get sad when you're mad!
5002504.c8_s4: Aw, you just want my attention, don't you?
5002504.c8_f3: Ooh, I love your angry face.
5002504.c8_f4: Sticks and stones may break my bones, but your face is really ugly.
5002504.c10_s3: You'll stay with me forever and ever, right?
5002504.c11_s1: Wait... I can't be falling for you!
5002504.c11_s2: Aww, that's a beautiful thing to say! Same!
5002504.c11_f1: That's enough. Let's just drink some juice.
5002504.c11_f2: Love gets in the way of adventures.
5002504.c11_f3: You say that, but I know your heart's somewhere else.
5002504.c11_f4: Sorry to say the feeling's not quite mutual.
5002504.c12_s2: All right. I've got your back.
5002504.c12_s4: I hope you always feel that way!
5002504.c12_f2: Did you... eat something you shouldn't have?
5002504.c12_f3: It's all my fault. I'm sorry.
5002504.c13_s1: I thought I was constipated, but... nope!
5002504.c13_f1: How would you feel if I told YOU to do that?
5002504.c13_f4: I'm actually having trouble with that these days...
5002504.c14_s4: My poop is like your face!
5002504.c14_f2: I can't. My tummy's stuffed up.
5002504.c14_f3: What are people going to think if I do that here?!
5002504.c15_s1: I CAN poop! I just have to believe in myself!
5002504.c15_s3: I know I'm cute, but no peeking!
5002504.c15_f1: Ah, I was so busy reading comics earlier, I forgot to go.
5002504.c15_f2: Ugh! Pooping is SO not a dignified activity.
5002504.c15_f4: What poo? I need a refreshing glass of juice.
5002504.c16_s3: Fine. I'm sleeping. Stay awake if you want.
5002504.c16_s4: Be quiet! I'm trying to sleep!
5002504.c16_f1: Still a long way to go!
5002504.c16_f3: Huh? We're not done yet. Let's keep going!
5002504.c17_s1: Can I have a blanket, please?
5002504.c17_s3: I'm going to sleep. You go hunt for some loot or something.
5002504.c17_s4: Could you tuck me in, please?
5002504.c17_f1: I'm tough! I don't need sleep!
5002504.c17_f2: You are a sleepyhead, aren't you, Master?
5002504.c17_f4: Why don't you prepare a nice bed for me first?
5002504.c18_s1: Will I still be cute if I'm so lazy?
5002504.c18_s3: I need a lot of sleep to keep everything so smooth.
5002504.c18_s4: Sleeping next to you is the best!
5002504.c18_f1: Should we be sleeping when your level's so low? Go hunt!
5002504.c18_f3: Why do you want me to sleep? What don't you want me to see?
5002504.c18_f4: Why don't you go to sleep first? I've got things to do!
5002504.c19_s1: I can take down Horntail on my own...
5002504.c19_s2: Nice weather out. How about taking me for a stroll along the Strolling Path?
5002504.c19_s3: Don't ask me how pet feed tastes. Taste it yourself.
5002504.c19_s4: Have you been to the Cursed Temple yet?
5002504.c19_f1: I don't want to right now.
5002504.c19_f3: Forget it! Why don't we just go hunting?
5002504.c19_f4: I'm holding out for a better offer. You understand, right?
5002504.c20_s1: How do you run with those legs?
5002504.c20_s2: Tell me about your favorite holidays.
5002504.c20_s4: Your arms and legs are really stumpy!
5002504.c20_f1: You talk first, then I might.
5002504.c20_f3: We all speak different languages, you know.
5002504.c20_f4: I swear, I'm not as talkative as you seem to think I am.
5002504.c21_s1: Pepes and yetis are friends, but penguins hate yetis!
5002504.c21_s2: I had friends before. An oddball water ghost and a swine monster. What were their names?
5002504.c21_s3: Ever tried to talk to a White Tiger? They're incomprehensible.
5002504.c21_s4: Your neck muscles must be ridiculously strong.
5002504.c21_f2: There are too many people here.
5002504.c21_f4: Are ya bored, Master? Go hunt some more!
5002504.f2_s: This is it! The taste I was looking for!

5002504.f4_f: Hmm, this tastes funny... Ew, it's spoiled!
5002504.s3: You want me to say THAT?
5002504.s4: Why do you want me to say bad things?

5002505.c2_s1: Happy to! These dogs are barkin'!

5002505.c8_f4: I don't wanna get in trouble...

5002505.c13_f3: You need to learn some common decency.

5002505.c15_f4: I'm dignified. I don't poop in public!

5002505.c18_f4: I'm wide awake! Don't tell me to sleep!

5002505.c19_s2: Pets can talk. Isn't that weird?
5002505.c19_s3: You're so awesome today! I think I'm in love!
5002505.c19_s4: The grass fields of Henesys are so nice.
5002505.c19_f1: I don't talk. That's how I am.
5002505.c19_f2: Why is the sky so blue, then?
5002505.c19_f3: Why are you always so chatty?
5002505.c19_f4: Me no speak your language. Argh!
5002505.c20_s1: I just wanna talk with you all day long!
5002505.c20_s3: I wonder if Pepes are related to Penguins.

5002505.c20_f2: Let's play a game. It's called the quiet game...
5002505.c20_f4: With weather like this, I'm sure great items are bound to drop!

5002505.c21_s3: Take me for a walk. I'm a total chick magnet!
5002505.c21_s4: I'm so co-o-old. Hold me tight!
5002505.c21_f2: I can't hear you! I hear nothing!
5002505.c21_f4: Let's just have some tea... in silence.

5002505.f2_s: You should eat too! Yummy food!
5002505.f3_s: I'm about to faint. I ate too much.
5002505.f3_f: I don't want to eat any more.

5002506.c15_f3: Pooping at a place like this... Embarrassing!
5002506.c15_f4: I don't want to poop now.
5002506.c16_f1: I'm gonna play instead! You should too!

5002506.c17_s4: Nothing beats sleeping on a soft pillow.

5002506.c17_f4: You want me to sleep all day long?
5002506.c18_s1: Aww, you know pretty pets need to sleep a lot, right?
5002506.c18_s4: One snail... two snails... three... zzz...
5002506.c18_f1: Look at your belly! You should hit the gym!
5002506.c18_f2: I can't sleep... There's still so much fun to have!
5002506.c18_f3: You want me to sleep in a place like this? Mean!
5002506.c18_f4: Give me a treat and I'll think about it!
5002506.c19_s1: What do you think about my fierce eyes?
5002506.c19_s2: I've heard that Crimson Balrogs found on boats are ugly. Is this true?
5002506.c19_s3: There's a lot I can't eat, like...
5002506.c19_s4: I wish my legs were just a little bit longer!
5002506.c19_f1: What you want me to say? You're bugging me...
5002506.c19_f2: Don't bother me! Go play by yourself!
5002506.c19_f4: Stop talking to me when I'm eating.
5002506.c20_s1: I'm working out these days. It's tough.
5002506.c20_s2: I hate being alone more than anything.
5002506.c20_s3: I'm cuter than the others, right?
5002506.c20_s4: Don't you want to play with my tail? Careful, it has a mind of its own!
5002506.c20_f1: Bleh, I should just run away.
5002506.c20_f2: Let's just go to bed... Zzz...
5002506.c20_f3: It's hard to talk in this form!
5002506.c20_f4: I want to hear you talk first.
5002506.c21_s1: I'm cute, pretty, and even know how to talk!
5002506.c21_s2: The dragons in Leafre seem super strong!
5002506.c21_s3: Do you know what Water of Life tastes like? Is it delicious?
5002506.c21_s4: Yeti and Pepe are BFFs. I want a BFF.
5002506.c21_f1: I don't really have anything to talk about...
5002506.f1_f: Why are you fattening me up? What are you up to?
5002506.f3_f: You can't feed a pretty pet like me such cheap food.
5002506.f4_f: Blech, why'd you GIVE me that?!
5002506.s1: I'll get upset if you keep saying things like that!
5002506.s4: I'm not going to say any bad words!

5002713.c15_f3: I need to pee. Can I pee instead?
5002713.c15_f4: I haven't eaten enough to poop.

5002713.c17_f3: I sleep better when I'm near you.
5002713.c17_f4: I'm gonna see you in my dreams!
5002713.c18_s1: I want to sleep on your lap...
5002713.c18_s2: Good, I've been awake for too long...

5002713.c18_f1: I'm wide awake! Don't tell me to sleep!
5002713.c18_f4: I am in no mood to sleep!

5002713.c19_s2: Nothing beats good food and a cuddle.
5002713.c19_s3: If you're tired, I'll carry you.

5002713.c19_f3: Why is the sky so blue? It makes me sad.

5002713.c20_s4: I'm slumming it just by being seen with you.

5002714.c3_s4: With legs as short as mine, it doesn't matter!

5002714.c3_f3: I want to do other things, too.

5002714.c14_f3: How can I do that here?

5002727.c19_f1: I'd like to be alone today.
5002727.c20_f3: Why don't you tell me a fun story?
5002727.c21_s1: Honestly, don't I look pretty today?

5002727.c21_f2: (Let's feed the cat some milk at tea time...)
5002727.f2_s: Wow! This would be better with tea.

5002727.s4: What did you say just now?

5002728.c10_f4: What hour, minute, and second is it?
5002728.c11_s1: You will think of a person you like at 11:11!
5002728.c11_s2: Do you love me as much as you love the grandfather clock?
5002728.c11_f3: I like my grandfather clock better.
5002728.c12_s1: My heart is going pew pew!
5002728.c12_s3: Isn't that a line from a fairy tale?
5002728.c13_s4: I'm going to be living in the restroom at this rate!
5002728.c13_f2: No, we're going to be late!
5002728.c14_f2: I use the restroom, you know.
5002728.c14_f4: I can use the restroom too.
5002728.c17_s2: What time is it? It's so late!
5002728.c17_f1: It's not even night time! The sun's out!
5002728.c17_f2: This is no time for sleep!
5002728.c17_f3: Where's my bed? I want my bed!
5002728.c18_s1: I'll charge up for our next hunt!
5002728.c18_s2: Tick tock? Tick... tock... Tick... tock...
5002728.c18_f4: One! Two! I'm still full of energy!
5002728.c19_s3: Do you hear the hands of the clock ticking? I heard it!
5002728.c19_s4: Is there anything fun to do?
5002728.c19_f1: Sorry, I don't feel like it!
5002728.c20_s1: Do you hear the hands of the clock ticking? Do you hear it?!
5002728.c20_s3: Who's faster, the turtle or the hare?
5002728.f1_s: That was good. Give me more!
5002728.f4_f: I'll gain weight if I eat more...

5002598.c3_f1: I can't hear you, I can't hear you!
5002598.c3_f2: Let's do something fun. This is boring.

5002776.c3_f3: I'm so tired after all that lifting...
5002776.c4_s1: Sitting is also a good workout sometimes!
5002776.c4_s2: I look cute no matter what I do!
5002776.c4_s3: How do I look when I'm sitting?
5002776.c4_s4: Being tired is like, not cool.
5002776.c4_f1: Sitting makes my belly look fat.
5002776.c4_f2: I didn't hear you... I was too busy admiring myself.
5002776.c5_f2: You can just put it to me kindly!
5002776.c6_s3: I don't mind a little scolding.
5002776.c6_s4: It was my fault? I didn't know...
5002776.c6_f1: What exactly did I do wrong?
5002776.c6_f3: You're just taking your anger out on me...
5002776.c6_f4: Hmm? I was distracted for like, a second.
5002776.c7_s1: Look, I'm sorry, okay? What do you want from me?
5002776.c7_s2: I'm going to cry a literal river now!
5002776.c7_s3: I'll be better from now on...
5002776.c7_s4: I don't even know what I did.
5002776.c7_f1: I'm going to make things worse!
5002776.c7_f2: Why are you taking out you anger on me?
5002776.c7_f3: Are you going to hit me?
5002776.c7_f4: Was that fun? Is it my turn now?
5002776.c8_s2: I don't feel great when you're upset at me like that...
5002776.c8_s3: Wahhhh! You're just mean because you're bigger than me!
5002776.c8_s4: I'm going to tell my mommy...
5002776.c8_f1: Do I know you? You look like a different person when you're angry!
5002776.c8_f2: I'm telling you, it wasn't me!
5002776.c8_f4: If you give me a piece of cake, I won't eat you up!
5002776.c10_s4: Yeah, I'm pretty charming, aren't I?
5002776.c11_s2: I can feel the love rising!
5002776.c11_f1: I'll pretend you didn't say that.
5002776.c11_f2: I saw you with your actual love already!
5002776.c11_f4: Give me some time to think it over.
5002776.c12_s2: I'm so happy I met you!
5002776.c12_s4: I love you very much too, Master!
5002776.c12_f3: Man, being this popular is super tiring!
5002776.c13_s3: I could do this all day!
5002776.c13_f3: You should be ashamed of yourself!
5002776.c13_f4: I can't do something like that!
5002776.c14_s1: After all of that... now I'm hungry...
5002776.c14_s2: Can you get me some toilet paper, Master?
5002776.c14_s4: Look the other way! It's embarrassing!
5002776.c14_f1: Ugh, you can't POSSIBLY be serious.
5002776.c14_f3: I shouldn't just do that anywhere!
5002776.c14_f4: I won't do something that'll stink up the place.
5002776.c15_s3: I should poop quickly and then go eat!
5002776.c15_f2: A pretty pet like me doesn't do something like poop.
5002776.c15_f4: I didn't know you lacked so much common sense...
5002776.c16_s3: I won't sleep until I eat!
5002776.c16_f2: Hmph! I don't need to listen to you!
5002776.c16_f4: I don't feel like sleeping right now.
5002776.c17_s1: I want to sleep next to my master...
5002776.c17_s2: Don't leave me alone while I sleep, okay?
5002776.c17_s3: Ugh. Sleeping out in the open...
5002776.c17_s4: Need to maintain good posture even when sleeping...
5002776.c17_f1: I can't fall asleep when I'm so hungry! I could use a snack.
5002776.c17_f4: You want a pretty pet like me to sleep on the ground?!
5002776.c18_f1: These dark circles aren't from sleepiness--it's starvation.
5002776.c18_f3: I can't sleep because I miss my mom too much!
5002776.c18_f4: You can't expect me to sleep in a place like this! Hmph!
5002776.c19_f2: Oh man, my mouth sure is empty right now.
5002776.c19_f3: What do you want me to say? You're bugging me...
5002776.c19_f4: If you want to talk so much, you start first.
5002776.c20_s1: These guns are because of dedication, dude.
5002776.c20_s3: Sometimes, I feel like the luckiest pet alive!
5002776.c20_s4: I think I'm a little hungry. Just a little.
5002776.c20_f1: I've been feeling lonely lately... I can feel that way too, you know?
5002776.c20_f2: My stomach itches... Can you scritch it?
5002776.c20_f3: Can we just play? I don't feel chatty right now.
5002776.c20_f4: ...I don't have much to say, you know?
5002776.c21_s1: I get so sad when there's nothing to eat...
5002776.c21_s2: I'm cute, pretty, and can even talk well!
5002776.c21_s3: Have you heard of the Water of Life? Do you think it tastes good?
5002776.c21_s4: Your belly is bigger than mine, you know.
5002776.c21_f1: Do you like it when I talk? Huh?
5002776.c21_f3: Everything feels so annoying right now...
5002776.c21_f4: Heh... Actions always speak louder than words!
5002776.f1_s: How did you know I was hungry?
5002776.f2_s: Oh! Is this my reward? It's delicious!
5002776.f2_f: I'm trying to get in shape...
5002776.f3_s: I've never had something like this. It's good!
5002776.f3_f: Master... you're trying to fatten me up for something, aren't you?
5002776.f4_f: I don't want to get fat...
5002776.s2: Pretty words only from now on!
5002776.s4: Quit being weird and feed me something.

5002777.c2_s2: I'm not even grown up and I can do this so well!
5002777.c2_s3: What do you think? Do you want to lie down with me?
5002777.c2_f1: But I don't like this spot!
5002777.c2_f3: I hate to stay still and do nothing!
5002777.c3_s1: You must already know that I love to sit down!
5002777.c3_s2: I listened to you, so you should pet me!
5002777.c3_f1: I want to run around, free!
5002777.c3_f4: But I don't want to rest right now...
5002777.c4_s1: You should come over here. Next to me.
5002777.c4_s3: You should come sit here with me!
5002777.c4_f4: Did you really think it'd be that easy?
5002777.c6_s3: I'll be good from now on! Honest!
5002777.c6_s4: I know I messed up, but you still have to feed me, okay?
5002777.c6_f1: Keep scolding and I'll run away!
5002777.c6_f4: What? How dare you try to punish me?!
5002777.c7_s2: I'll be good from now on! I promise!
5002777.c7_s3: You're in a mood today, huh?
5002777.c7_f1: No. I don't wanna be in trouble.
5002777.c7_f2: Argh! I hate you for being mad at me!
5002777.c8_s1: A-are you gonna throw me away?
5002777.c8_s4: Sorry, Master. I'll obey from now on.
5002777.c8_f1: You purified my heart, please purify yours.
5002777.c8_f2: You got mad? Fine, I'll just leave next time.
5002777.c8_f4: Hmph! I told you to treat me nicely!
5002777.c10_s1: You love just me, right? Just me!
5002777.c10_f1: Not just anyone is worthy of my love!
5002777.c10_f4: You shouldn't say things like that!
5002777.c11_s2: Can you say that again, please?
5002777.c11_s3: You can say that a hundred times, and I won't get tired of it.
5002777.c11_f2: You're you, and I'm just a pet!
5002777.c11_f3: Why... why are you licking your lips like that?
5002777.c12_s1: I'm so excited, and I just can't hide it!
5002777.c12_s2: You're as warm-hearted as I thought.
5002777.c12_s3: You're the strongest, bestest person I know.
5002777.c12_f3: We are of different classes. I am sorry.
5002777.c13_f2: Do you want to be arrested?
5002777.c14_s4: Excuse me for just one second!
5002777.c14_f1: You go first! I'll follow your example!
5002777.c14_f3: I can use the restroom too, you know.
5002777.c14_f4: I'm going to use the toilet!
5002777.c15_s1: Oh, I feel so much better! Are you going to poop, too?
5002777.c15_s2: It feels so good! Master, please clean this up!
5002777.c15_s4: That's it for what I had planned for today!
5002777.c15_f2: Are you capable doing your business anywhere?
5002777.c15_f4: I can't believe a person would say that and not another pet...
5002777.c16_s1: Is it time to sleep already?
5002777.c16_s2: I guess I should tuck myself in.
5002777.c16_s4: I had a great day today!
5002777.c16_f1: I'll sleep when I get home!
5002777.c17_s2: How did you know that I was sleepy? Shall we take a quick nap?
5002777.c17_s4: I'm going to dance in my dreams...
5002777.c17_f3: No! I'm going to play more! Not listening to you!
5002777.c17_f4: What's in it for me if I sleep?
5002777.c18_s4: Let's get a good rest and then play some more!
5002777.c19_s2: My favorite part of winter is the snow.
5002777.c19_s3: I hear a scary dragon lives nearby... Should I pay it a visit?
5002777.c19_f4: I want to chat with Peplock!
5002777.c20_s1: I want to fly, fly up high!
5002777.c20_s2: If you feed me a lot, I'll love you even more.
5002777.c20_s3: If we go to Henesys, we'll meet my distant relatives!
5002777.c20_f1: You need to be quiet in places like this!
5002777.c20_f4: I've heard people talking about dragons in Leafre...
5002777.c21_s1: What's going on between Scuba Pepe and Ducky?
5002777.c21_s2: How do I shapeshift? Well, I could tell you, but you wouldn't understand.

5002868.c1_s2: Butt on floor! Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle!
5002868.c2_s1: Butt on floor! Wiggle, wiggle, wiggle!
5002868.c2_s3: I did it! Now tell me what a great pet I am!
5002868.c2_s4: I sat down! Don't you want to clap for me?
5002868.c2_f3: My tooshie can only handle so much sitting in a day.
5002868.c2_f4: Okay, but if I can't get back up, I'm blaming you.
5002868.c3_s3: Now that I'm sitting, I want to lie down.
5002868.c3_s4: But if I sit, I won't want to get up.
5002868.c3_f1: Are you questioning my ability to stand?
5002868.c3_f4: Standing keeps me more alert. I'd rather do that.
5002868.c4_s2: I sat down! Gimme praise! Gimme treats! Gimme everything!
5002868.c4_s3: Cookies would be nice right about now.
5002868.c4_f1: I just got up! I'm not a machine!
5002868.c4_f2: But what if I sit on a bug? OH! What if the bug sits on me?!
5002868.c4_f3: But I don't want my butt to be dirty...
5002868.c4_f4: Hmph! I'm not the type of dear that takes orders.
5002868.c5_s1: Sorry... I've been a bad deer...
5002868.c6_s2: It's not fair! You yell at me all the time!
5002868.c6_s3: I can't hold back the tears anymore...
5002868.c6_s4: You're super scary when you're mad...
5002868.c6_f1: Some people know how to be more constructive about their anger. You should try it.
5002868.c6_f2: How could you do this to me?
5002868.c6_f3: How can you do this to little old me?
5002868.c7_s1: Every time you get mad, I just want to run away.
5002868.c7_s2: It's like you go out of your way to make me feel icky.
5002868.c7_s3: Calm down! I promise we can fix this!
5002868.c7_f1: You get mad at me so easily.
5002868.c7_f2: I can be mean too, you know? I just choose not to.
5002868.c7_f3: Getting angry and yelling about stuff only hurts you.
5002868.c7_f4: You must think I'm a pushover! I don't have to take that!
5002868.c8_s1: Aw, you used to think it was cute when I misbehaved.
5002868.c8_s2: Violence and anger don't solve anything!
5002868.c8_s4: I guess I made a mistake. I'm sorry.
5002868.c8_f1: I get in trouble all the time. It doesn't even phase me anymore.
5002868.c8_f2: If all you're going to do is get mad at me all the time, I'll just leave.
5002868.c8_f3: If you keep bothering me, I'll get my friend Yeti to help me.
5002868.c8_f4: Why can't you leave me alone?
5002868.c9_s1: I wish you could love me even more!
5002868.c9_s2: Do you think my wish for you to love me more will come true?
5002868.c9_f2: Are you sure you meant me?
5002868.c10_s2: You make this deer so happy!
5002868.c10_f2: Hmph! Deer only love other deer!
5002868.c10_f3: I can't hear you! Doo dee doo!
5002868.c11_s2: Hee hee, thank you for liking me.
5002868.c11_s4: Of course you do! I love you too!
5002868.c11_f1: I'll pretend I didn't hear that...
5002868.c11_f2: Say it once more, with feeling!
5002868.c11_f3: I don't think I can accept your love...
5002868.c11_f4: Ugh! You think you could save the mushy stuff until after I've eaten?
5002868.c12_s1: I'm so cute, you could love me twice as much as anyone else!
5002868.c12_s2: You LOVE me! You LOVE me! You said you LOVE me!
5002868.c12_f2: Hmph. I'm a picky deer, you know.
5002868.c12_f3: You think you could say that again while presenting me with tasty food?
5002868.c12_f4: Did I hear you right? Hang on, let me clean my ears first...
5002868.c13_s2: Do you maybe have some fiber to help things along?
5002868.c13_f2: Why are you so keen to make me poop?
5002868.c13_f3: I don't want to! It's gross!
5002868.c13_f4: If I don't eat, I can't poop.
5002868.c14_s1: Do I have to do it right now? What would I clean up with?
5002868.c14_s2: Daww! Look at that! Even my poop is cute!
5002868.c14_s3: Would you help me find a good spot?
5002868.c14_s4: Hrrrrgh! Hnnnngh! I don't think it's supposed to be this hard.
5002868.c14_f2: Of all the things I could do for you, this is what you want?
5002868.c14_f4: Too late! I already did! And now you get to figure out where!
5002868.c15_s1: You think deer can just do that on command?
5002868.c15_s3: Just... Make sure nobody's looking, okay?
5002868.c15_f1: How can I poop rainbows if you won't feed me sprinkles?
5002868.c15_f2: Not yet. I've got to work up a really smelly one first.
5002868.c15_f3: Do you have some weird fascination with poop?
5002868.c15_f4: You act like I poop just to please you.
5002868.c16_s1: Yaaaawn! All this talk about sleep is making me sleepy.
5002868.c16_s4: Is the world put on pause when I go to sleep? How else do you get along without me?
5002868.c16_f1: You sleep first. I'll stand guard and contemplate the meaning of my existence.
5002868.c16_f2: Telling me to go to sleep doesn't automatically make me tired.
5002868.c16_f3: That's not happening! I just drank a bunch of tea!
5002868.c16_f4: I'm gonna play instead! You should too!
5002868.c17_s1: Have you heard about those new ice block pillows? They're all the rage.
5002868.c17_s2: I couldn't be more sleepy if I had just read an entire encyclopedia!
5002868.c17_s3: This does seem like a good place to take a nap.
5002868.c17_s4: I'm all cozy and comfy, and my belly is full. Time for a nice nap.
5002868.c17_f1: My rumbling tummy is keeping me wide awake.
5002868.c17_f3: Why? You're not going to run away or something, are you?
5002868.c17_f4: I don't think I heard that right. You want me to sleep right now?
5002868.c18_s2: A nap would be perfect right about now.
5002868.c18_s3: Even the best of us need a good night's rest to be helpful!
5002868.c18_s4: Why would I sleep when there's so much to do?
5002868.c18_f1: You think I can go to sleep anywhere I please? I need comfort!
5002868.c18_f2: At least fetch me a couple of pillows. I need to be comfy!
5002868.c18_f3: I refuse to sleep! I don't need to! I'll be just fine.
5002868.c18_f4: I can't sleep, I need to help make the snow fall!
5002868.c19_s1: You want to talk about how cute I am, don't you? I knew it.
5002868.c19_s2: You want to have a deep and meaningful conversation? Awesome!
5002868.c19_s3: I'm a little picky... I like a nice icy branch.
5002868.c19_s4: You're so great! We can talk about whatever you want!
5002868.c19_f3: I'm too lazy to talk. Just saying this is too much effort.
5002868.c19_f4: If you want to talk, you could at least come up with a good topic.
5002868.c20_s1: I love being showered with attention!
5002868.c20_s2: I'm so glad we can talk any time we want!
5002868.c20_s3: I wonder what Snow Ram and Winter Snowy are doing?
5002868.c20_s4: Every day spent with friends is amazing!
5002868.c20_f1: Actually, I think I'd rather eat right now.
5002868.c20_f3: Don't talk to me. I'm writing my personal memoir in my mind.
5002868.c20_f4: If you want to chat, why don't we talk about this new diet you seem to have me on?
5002868.c21_s1: I heard El Nath sets a new snowfall record every year!
5002868.c21_s2: Lets munch on some leaves together! ...What's with that look?
5002868.c21_s3: Talking to you NEVER gets old! Well, not never, but you know what I mean.
5002868.c21_s4: Let's play a game! Or eat! Or go on an adventure! All the things!
5002868.c21_f1: I'm too lazy to talk. Just saying this is too much effort.
5002868.c21_f2: What do you want me to say? My mind is blank right now.
5002868.c21_f3: Is that how it works now? I just yap on command?
5002868.c21_f4: I'm not going to waste my singing voice on inane banter.
5002868.f1_s: Delicious! Tree branches are just the best!
5002868.f1_f: Looking at whatever that is made me lose my appetite.
5002868.f2_s: Don't you just love munching and crunching on ice sometimes?
5002868.f2_f: Deer don't eat stuff like this.
5002868.f3_s: Food has so many amazing and varied flavors!
5002868.f3_f: I really want to eat more, but I'm so full. I'm not sure I can.
5002868.f4_s: Gosh, I'm glad I get to eat tasty stuff every day!
5002868.s1: Hm? What was that you said?
5002868.s2: If you keep using bad words, I'll stop listening to you.
5002868.s3: How am I supposed to respond to language like that?
5002868.s4: Bad words are for people who have puny vocabularies.

5002869.c1_f1: I've been sitting all day. I think I'll pass, thanks.
5002869.c1_f2: You want me to talk, or just listen to you?
5002869.c2_s1: Ta da! I sat! Now you can shower me with compliments.
5002869.c2_s3: You want me to put my BUTT on the GROUND?
5002869.c2_s4: I love sitting! It's such a great way to take in the world around you.
5002869.c2_f1: I only sit on the comfiest of snow mounds!
5002869.c2_f2: Only if I get to do it in a snowfield.
5002869.c2_f3: An elegant Snow Ram, such as I, doesn't sit just anywhere.
5002869.c2_f4: Please don't make me do this here. It's uncomfortable.
5002869.c3_s1: Hm, this is more comfortable than I thought it would be.
5002869.c3_s2: We could even lie down and guess the shapes of the clouds.
5002869.c3_s3: I'm pretty, and I listen. I'm perfect!
5002869.c3_s4: I'll do it as carefully as possible.
5002869.c3_f1: I've been sitting for so long already that my butt fell asleep!
5002869.c3_f2: You're awfully bossy. You really need to give me some kind of incentive.
5002869.c3_f4: I'll pass, thanks. And I wasn't referring to gas.
5002869.c4_s2: I've been good! Do I get a treat now?
5002869.c4_s3: Can I sit right next to you forever?
5002869.c4_s4: Good idea! I was feeling a bit tired.
5002869.c4_f1: Sit? What if something bites me?
5002869.c4_f2: Oh, sorry. I didn't hear you.
5002869.c4_f3: The grass is really pokey, though.
5002869.c4_f4: I don't have to do anything I don't want to!
5002869.c5_s2: Why do you make me cry?
5002869.c6_s2: I don't like it when you're mad.
5002869.c6_s3: I didn't know it was possible for you to be mad at me.
5002869.c6_s4: I'm sorry! Please don't hate me forever!
5002869.c6_f1: That's it! It's time to put on my angry face!
5002869.c6_f2: I don't know what to do! I didn't hear you AT ALL!
5002869.c6_f3: Why are you doing this to me?
5002869.c6_f4: Don't take your anger out on me.
5002869.c7_s1: I'll sit and think about what I've done.
5002869.c7_s4: I'm heartbroken knowing I disappointed you.
5002869.c7_f2: You're not a friend! You're a bully!
5002869.c7_f3: I didn't know you could be so mean!
5002869.c7_f4: I never thought you'd think so little of me!
5002869.c8_s2: I'm not c-c-crying. T-t-there's just something in my eye.
5002869.c8_s4: I know you're mad, but please don't leave me alone!
5002869.c9_s2: Hearing that makes me so happy!
5002869.c10_s1: Wow! Really?! Okay, I'm on board with that.
5002869.c10_s2: Would you believe me if I said you're the best owner ever?
5002869.c10_s4: You know just what to say to make me feel special.
5002869.c11_s1: Well, now you have to promise to say that every day.
5002869.c11_s3: Now that I think about it, I like you too.
5002869.c11_s4: You're the bee's knees! Whoa! What am I, 80 years old?
5002869.c11_f1: Now might not be the best time for that conversation.
5002869.c11_f3: I can't believe my ears! Did you really say that?
5002869.c11_f4: I'll pretend you didn't just say that.
5002869.c12_s1: You make my life so full of meaning!
5002869.c12_s3: I see my charm has begun to work on you.
5002869.c12_s4: I guess I am kind of beautiful. I knew it! You can't resist me!
5002869.c12_f1: I'm more in the mood for a tasty treat than chatter right now.
5002869.c12_f2: I'll do whatever tricks you want, but you've got to give me treats.

5002869.c13_s2: I've been holding it for a moment just like this.

5002869.c13_s4: It's always so hard. I'm not sure I'm doing it right.
5002869.c13_f1: Ugh, I hate that word. How about we call it a funky lump?
5002869.c13_f2: That doesn't really fit my vibe, now does it?
5002869.c14_s2: Maybe I could drink some coffee to get things moving?
5002869.c14_s3: Ugh! It's so gross! Don't look at me!!
5002869.c14_f1: How can you do...? In a place like this...?
5002869.c14_f2: Not out here! I've heard there are special rooms for that.
5002869.c14_f4: Why do you think it's such a good idea to do that now?
5002869.c15_s2: I like to sing when I poop! What about you?
5002869.c15_s3: Poop, eat, sleep. Poop, eat, sleep.
5002869.c15_s4: Boo doo, bee doo, bee doo... Poop!
5002869.c15_f1: I don't like to do that where people can watch. It's creepy.
5002869.c15_f4: Really? Of all the things I can do for you, you want me to poop?

5002869.c16_s3: Good idea! I'm sleepier than I thought!

5002869.c16_f4: I'm too hungry to go to sleep!

5002869.c17_s2: I only sleep on a full belly!
5002869.c17_s3: What if I just pretend I'm sleeping? Could you tell?
5002869.c17_s4: I hope I have wonderful dreams about how great you are!
5002869.c17_f1: How can you tell a cute pet like me to sleep on the streets?
5002869.c17_f2: I'm too hungry to fall asleep...
5002869.c17_f3: Wait! You can't tell me to take a nap and then leave me unprotected!
5002869.c17_f4: Play with me! Don't just put me to bed!
5002869.c18_s1: I'll try, but I can't guarantee I'll actually... Zzz...
5002869.c18_s3: All I need is a nice pillow and blanket to cuddle up with.
5002869.c18_f1: I can't just sleep all the time!
5002869.c18_f2: This Snow Ram answers to nobody!
5002869.c18_f4: We don't have time for sleep! There's so much to do!
5002869.c19_s1: There's no better pet than me, right?
5002869.c19_s2: You must love the sound of my voice. I'm proud of it.
5002869.c19_s3: I'm actually good at singing too. Wanna hear?
5002869.c19_s4: I want to grow up and fight monsters just like you!
5002869.c19_f1: Fine. But you have to give me 1 treat every time I talk.
5002869.c19_f2: I'm way too tired. Couldn't I nap instead?
5002869.c19_f3: I'm sleepy and grumpy. Now's not a good time to talk to me.
5002869.c19_f4: You won't get one peep outta me! Except for that one. And that one... And...
5002869.c20_s1: You know, it looks like a cushy life, but sometimes pet life is tough.

5002869.c20_s3: I saw a doll that looks like me...a LOT like me... What was it?

5002869.c20_f1: You've kind of put me on the spot here. I don't know what to say.
5002869.c20_f3: I'm confused. What do you want to talk about?
5002869.c21_s1: I'd love to go somewhere beautiful and snowy.
5002869.c21_s2: I love snow! It makes the most interesting crunching noise when you walk in it.
5002869.c21_s3: Did you know I can sing? I'm great with classic showtunes.
5002869.c21_s4: Flying is kind of an amazing skill when you think about it.
5002869.c21_f1: I'm way too tired. Couldn't I nap instead?
5002869.c21_f2: Let's go to sleep instead. I could use a good nap.
5002869.c21_f3: Why do you keep talking to me? Nothing's changed.
5002869.c21_f4: Are you bored? I'm not really sure what you need.
5002869.f2_f: You can't feed a pretty pet like me such cheap food.
5002869.f3_s: How did you make this taste so heavenly?
5002869.f3_f: Blech... I think I'll go barf now...

5002869.s3: Did I just hear what I think I heard?

5002870.c2_f4: Okay, but if I can't get back up, I'm blaming you.
5002870.c3_s1: Boop! I decided to sit down after all.
5002870.c3_s4: But I won't want to get back up!
5002870.c3_f2: I've decided I don't need or want to!
5002870.c3_f4: I don't really care whether I'm standing or sitting.
5002870.c4_s2: I sat down! Aren't I the best?
5002870.c4_s3: Now I get cookies? Wait. I didn't sit on them, did I? Eh, they'll still taste fine.
5002870.c4_f1: That is just bossy and rude!
5002870.c4_f2: I don't want to sit! I won't!
5002870.c4_f3: I don't like getting my butt dirty!
5002870.c4_f4: I'm above following your dumb commands!
5002870.c5_s2: I know I made a mistake, but please be nicer to me.
5002870.c5_f1: What are you saying right now?
5002870.c6_s1: I'm scared... I don't like it when you're angry.
5002870.c6_s2: Please don't scold me... It makes me sad.
5002870.c6_s3: I need to cry now. Please leave me alone.
5002870.c6_s4: You're so scary when you're mad!

5002870.c6_f2: Why do you keep getting mad at me?
5002870.c6_f3: Why would you take your anger out on me? I'M nice to you.
5002870.c7_s1: I'm scared... I don't like it when you're angry.
5002870.c7_s2: Stop making me cry! It's really mean!
5002870.c7_f1: You get annoyed far to easily.
5002870.c7_f2: Bring it on! I'm not scared of anyone, not even you!
5002870.c7_f3: Are you really getting mad at me right now?
5002870.c7_f4: You think I'm a pushover? I won't let you treat me like this.
5002870.c8_s1: You used to tell me I was cute no matter what I did!
5002870.c8_s2: Please don't. I really don't like it.
5002870.c8_s3: I'm really sorry I messed up. I'll try not to do it again.
5002870.c8_s4: I know I shouldn't have done that. I'm sorry.
5002870.c8_f1: I get in trouble all the time. It doesn't even phase me anymore.
5002870.c8_f2: You think you're mad? I'm furious!
5002870.c8_f3: You make me feel so bad about myself. I don't like you!
5002870.c8_f4: What have you got against me?
5002870.c9_s2: Oh, me too! I love you too!
5002870.c9_f2: No, I can't be tied down right now.
5002870.c10_s2: You make me a happy Snowy, you know that?
5002870.c10_s4: I love you too! Like a lot!!
5002870.c10_f2: You must be mistaking me for someone else.
5002870.c10_f3: You have to try a bit harder to earn my love!
5002870.c11_s2: Aww, I'm really flattered! Thank you!
5002870.c11_s3: I'll bet I love you more!
5002870.c11_s4: Of course you do! I love you too!
5002870.c11_f1: I'll pretend you didn't just say that.
5002870.c11_f3: I don't do mushy declarations like that. Try someone else.
5002870.c11_f4: I'm too in love with myself to have time for anyone else.
5002870.c12_s2: You LOVE me! You LOVE me! You said you LOVE me!
5002870.c12_s4: I love the snow-st of all!
5002870.c12_f2: I'm a prickly Snowy, don't you know?
5002870.c12_f3: You think you could say that again while presenting me with tasty food?
5002870.c13_s2: Do you maybe have some fiber to help things along?
5002870.c13_f2: That's, uh... That's a weird request.
5002870.c13_f4: No, no. That's not okay to demand of me.
5002870.c14_s1: Do I have to do it right now? What would I clean up with?
5002870.c14_s2: Look at that! I'm so cute that even my poop is cute!
5002870.c14_s3: Okay, I'll poop, and you can hide it under a leaf.
5002870.c14_s4: Hrrrrgh! Hnnnngh! I don't think it's supposed to be this hard.
5002870.c14_f2: Of all the things I could do for you, this is what you want?
5002870.c14_f4: Too late! I already did! And now you get to figure out where!
5002870.c15_s1: Just because I CAN poop, doesn't mean I WANT to poop.
5002870.c15_s3: Be on the lookout! This one's happening fast!
5002870.c15_f1: How can I poop rainbows if you won't feed me sprinkles?
5002870.c15_f2: Not yet. I've got to work up a really smelly one first.
5002870.c15_f3: Do you have some weird fascination with poop?
5002870.c15_f4: I'm a little blocked up today actually...
5002870.c16_s1: Yaaaawn! All this talk about sleep is making me sleepy.
5002870.c16_s4: Is the world put on pause when I go to sleep? How else do you get along without me?
5002870.c16_f1: You sleep first. I'll stand guard and contemplate the meaning of my existence.
5002870.c16_f2: Telling me to go to sleep doesn't automatically make me tired.
5002870.c16_f3: That's not happening! I just drank a bunch of tea!
5002870.c16_f4: I'm gonna play instead! You should too!
5002870.c17_s1: I AM pretty sleepy. Okay... Zzz...
5002870.c17_s2: It's the perfect moment for a little cat nap.
5002870.c17_s3: This does seem like a good place to take a nap.
5002870.c17_s4: I'm all cozy and comfy, and my belly is full. Time for a nice nap.
5002870.c17_f1: My rumbling tummy is keeping me wide awake.
5002870.c17_f3: You're not gonna run off, are you?
5002870.c17_f4: What are you saying? I thought we were going to stay awake forever!
5002870.c18_s2: I'm sleepy, but I want to count sheep first.
5002870.c18_s3: Even the best of us need a good night's rest to be helpful!
5002870.c18_s4: Why would I sleep when there's so much to do?
5002870.c18_f1: You think I can go to sleep anywhere I please? I need comfort!
5002870.c18_f2: At least fetch me a couple of pillows. I need to be comfy!
5002870.c18_f3: I'm not sleepy! You can't make me!
5002870.c18_f4: My craving for sushi outweighs my need for sleep.
5002870.c19_s1: You want to talk about how cute I am, don't you? I knew it.
5002870.c19_s2: I want to live in a snow-covered world, just with you!
5002870.c19_s3: Please don't put a carrot on my face...
5002870.c19_s4: Oh! Let's talk about all the awesome snacks you can buy me!
5002870.c19_f3: I'm way too tired. Couldn't I nap instead?
5002870.c19_f4: If you want to talk, you could at least come up with a good topic.
5002870.c20_s1: Y'know, I actually find the summer weather pretty cool.
5002870.c20_s3: Do you like winter or summer more?
5002870.c20_s4: Every day spent with friends is amazing!
5002870.c20_f1: Actually, I think I'd rather eat right now.
5002870.c20_f3: Don't talk to me. I'm writing my personal memoir in my mind.
5002870.c20_f4: If you want to chat, why don't we talk about this new diet you seem to have me on?
5002870.c21_s1: What are places where it snows all the time called?
5002870.c21_s2: I just want to eat with you! Unlike my friends, I'll eat anything!
5002870.c21_s3: Talking to you NEVER gets old! Well, not never, but you know what I mean.
5002870.c21_s4: Let's go on a fun vacation together!
5002870.c21_f2: What do you want me to say? My mind is blank right now.
5002870.c21_f3: Do I have to speak just because you say so?
5002870.c21_f4: I talked too much today. My voice is done for!
5002870.f1_f: You need to feed me before you drop emotional bombs like that!
5002870.f2_s: Meals are best when they're delicious!
5002870.f2_f: I'm not going to eat THAT!
5002870.f3_s: Ahhh, this is so tasty! Thank you!

5002870.s3: You kiss your mama with that mouth?!
5002870.s4: What would possess you to say such a thing? A poop monster?

5002866.c7_s1: I made a mistake. I accept that.
5002866.c7_f3: Surely you're not talking to me.

5002866.c8_s3: I will try to do better.

5002866.c8_f4: Do not speak to me with that tone.
5002866.c11_s4: The sight of you brings joy to my life.

5002866.c14_s1: I have no time for this foolishness.

5002866.c16_f1: I still have far too much to attend to.
5002866.c17_f1: I still have far too much to attend to.

5002866.c19_s4: The color of cherry blossoms brings me peace.
5002866.c19_f3: I must attend to matters of state.

5002866.c20_s3: I've always had an interest in art.

5002866.c21_s2: I've always had an interest in art.
5002866.c21_s4: There is nothing I'd rather do.
5002866.f4_f: What is this supposed to be?

5002878.c1_s1: Would you like me to sing for you?
5002878.c2_s1: The wind is too strong today.
5002878.c3_s2: I'm proud of my soft, white feathers!
5002878.c4_s1: What song would you like to hear today? Taking song requests!
5002878.c4_s2: I may look young, but I'm not a baby bird.
5002878.f1_f: Gimme some sugar, and I'll be your best summer friend!
5002878.f2_s: Is it a special meal today? Nom nom.
5002878.f3_s: I have a very big appetite today!
5002878.f4_s: This is just to my taste!
5002878.f4_f: I want to eat something delicious for once.
5002878.s3: I'd like to be alone today.

5002879.c1_s1: Would you like to see me act cute?
5002879.c2_s1: Should we go on a fun trip somewhere?
5002879.c2_s2: Do I look like a chick to you?
5002879.c3_s1: I'd like to have giant wings one day.
5002879.c3_s2: My yellow color is my charm!
5002879.c4_s1: I'm cute and lovely, aren't I!
5002879.c4_s2: Mama tells me that I'm the cutest in the world!
5002879.f1_f: Gimme some sugar, and I'll be your best friend!
5002879.f2_s: I think I'll actually be able to finish the food today.

5002880.f1_f: Gimme some sugar, and I'll be your best friend!
5002880.f2_f: I don't really have an appetite today.
5002880.f3_s: I bet I end up overeating today.
5002880.f3_f: It's not exactly to my taste.

5002871.c2_s1: Neigh! This is as comfy as hay!
5002871.c2_s4: It would be nice to take a load off my hooves.
5002871.c2_f4: Can't we gallop some more first?
5002871.c3_s2: Why don't you come sit with me? *whinny*
5002871.c3_s4: Good idea. My shoes are nearly worn down to my hooves!
5002871.c3_f2: But I just got brushed down! Let's run!
5002871.c3_f4: Why sit, when we can run?
5002871.c4_s1: Overwork is terrible for your hooves, neigh...
5002871.c4_s2: I love feeling the wind in my mane, neigh...
5002871.c4_s3: I was just thinking that a break would be nice.
5002871.c4_s4: I don't suppose you have any oats?
5002871.c4_f1: Watch yourself! Horses bite too, you know!
5002871.c4_f2: I'm just going to keel over.
5002871.c4_f3: We can't rest now, there's plenty of room to run!
5002871.c6_s3: No need to get into a lather...
5002871.c7_f2: I'll buck if you keep this up!
5002871.c8_s1: Neigh... I did not mean to hurt you...
5002871.c8_s3: Neigh... Please forgive me...I'll be a good horsey...
5002871.c8_s4: We're still members of the same herd. *whinny*
5002871.c8_f1: Don't make a crop of your words... *snort*
5002871.c8_f2: Why spur me with your anger? *whinny*
5002871.c8_f4: I may be a horsey, but I can still buck!
5002871.c10_f4: Nice! Maybe give me some oats?
5002871.c11_s1: So I'm your favorite horsey, right?
5002871.c11_s2: I love it when you say that.
5002871.c11_f1: Of course you do. Just look at my mane.
5002871.c11_f2: I hear that all the time.
5002871.c12_s1: That makes me happier than a brushed mane!
5002871.c12_s4: I'm so glad I met you. *whinny*
5002871.c12_f3: Neigh... I'm more of a horsey sort of horsey, if you get my meaning...
5002871.c12_f4: That's, uh, nice...but maybe take a bath first next time?
5002871.c13_s2: Oof... That can't be the oats, can it?
5002871.c14_f1: I don't wanna, and I'm not gonna.
5002871.c14_f4: Why? What are you gonna do with it?
5002871.c15_f2: Eh? Horseys only poo when they need to.
5002871.c15_f3: Poop? Why don't you try feeding me first?
5002871.c15_f4: What kind of horsey do you take me for? I'm a horsey of dignity and cultivation!
5002871.c16_s1: Maybe for a little bit... *sleepy whinny*
5002871.c16_s4: *snore* If a cow...can jump over the moon...so can I... *snore*
5002871.c16_f3: You sleep if you want to.
5002871.c16_f4: I can't just force myself to sleep, you know.
5002871.c17_s3: *snore* I would like some more oats...yes....
5002871.c17_f1: You'd really make a high class horsey sleep in the dirt?
5002871.c17_f3: How am I supposed to gallop while I'm asleep?
5002871.c17_f4: But I want to keep running! *whinny*
5002871.c18_s1: Well, horseys do need their beauty sleep.
5002871.c18_s2: Mind brushing my mane while I sleep?
5002871.c18_s3: Okay, let's rest...but only so we can play more later! *whinny*
5002871.c18_s4: It takes a lot of sleep...to stay this beautiful. *snore*
5002871.c18_f1: Why are we sleeping when we could be galloping? *neigh*
5002871.c18_f2: Neigh... I decide when I sleep...and I'm not sleepy!
5002871.c18_f3: You're not going to hoof it without me when I nod off, are you?
5002871.c18_f4: *whinny* This place isn't restful at all, though...
5002871.c19_s1: *whinny* I love having my mane brushed.
5002871.c19_s2: Do you think I should polish my horseshoes?
5002871.c19_s4: Have you ever seen a horsey as cool as me?
5002871.c19_f2: I don't have anything to say...
5002871.c19_f3: Why don't we go running instead?
5002871.c20_s1: My mane can be hard to manage!
5002871.c20_s2: Some days, I just want to run free! *neigh*
5002871.c20_s3: I'm so happy to ride with you.
5002871.c20_s4: Have you ever seen a horsey gallop so fast?
5002871.c20_f1: Perhaps we should enjoy some quiet contemplation...
5002871.c20_f2: *neigh* Have you ever tried silent meditation?
5002871.c20_f4: You're really like a fly in the ear...
5002871.c21_s1: Someday, we'll gallop faster than the wind itself!
5002871.c21_s2: Sometimes I miss being a part of a big herd of horseys...
5002871.c21_s3: Can you keep a secret? Sometimes I like to walk around on two feet, not four!
5002871.c21_s4: I took first place in my debut race, you know. *whinny*
5002871.c21_f1: Why can't you enjoy the peace and quiet?
5002871.c21_f2: You're noisier than a crying colt!
5002871.c21_f4: All this talking is making me hungry... Do you have any oats?
5002871.c22_s2: Watch close... This'll be so good you'll cry!
5002871.c22_s3: *whinny* Okay, but this is just for you!
5002871.c22_s4: You're the only one who gets to see this. *neigh*
5002871.c22_f2: You need to feed me if you want tricks.
5002871.c22_f4: I don't do tricks on command. *snort*
5002871.c23_s3: Heh, sometimes it's nice to be cute. *whinny*
5002871.c23_s4: I'm a horsey of many talents! *neigh*
